context_zh_TW: 旁分泌衰老經由包含胞外體在內的細胞外囊泡擴散，這些囊泡攜帶如 IFITM3 以及可能的 miRNAs 與染色質片段等誘發衰老的貨物。此囊泡介導的途徑補充可溶 SASP 因子以傳遞停滯狀態，允許受保護、濃縮的訊號遞送至受體細胞。此機制拓寬衰老傳播的溝通工具組，並經由核酸貨物連結到 cGAS-STING 軸。它也提供用於偵測衰老細胞衍生囊泡的生物標記表面。

label: inhibits
context: Pyroptosis can inhibit tumor growth by inducing cell death and stimulating an inflammatory response in the tumor microenvironment. This positions pyroptosis as a tumor-suppressive modality in some contexts. Inducers such as Ivermectin have been observed to trigger pyroptosis in cancer cells.
context_zh_TW: Pyroptosis 可透過誘導細胞死亡並刺激腫瘤微環境中的發炎反應來抑制腫瘤生長。這使細胞焦亡在某些情境下成為腫瘤抑制形式。已觀察到 Ivermectin 等誘導劑可觸發癌細胞中的細胞焦亡。

label: is_associated_with
context: Pyroptosis is a form of programmed cell death distinct from apoptosis, although both are regulated cell-death modalities. In some contexts they are mutually regulated, for example when Ivermectin induces both apoptosis and autophagy alongside pyroptosis. Understanding their crosstalk matters for cancer therapy.
context_zh_TW: Pyroptosis 是與細胞凋亡不同的程式性細胞死亡形式，雖然兩者都是受調控的細胞死亡方式。在某些情境下它們互相調節，例如 Ivermectin 在誘導細胞焦亡的同時也誘導細胞凋亡與自噬。了解它們的交叉對話對癌症治療很重要。

label: connects_to
context: SADS connects to retrotransposon and LINE-1 activation, as satellite-repeat derepression in senescence permits mobilization of normally silenced repetitive elements. Derepressed LINE-1 generates cytoplasmic cDNA that fuels cGAS-STING signaling and the SASP, linking constitutive heterochromatin relaxation to innate immune activation. This connection positions SADS within the broader chromatin-immune axis of senescence, where loss of heterochromatin integrity amplifies inflammation. It is a newer, moderate-confidence mechanism in the senescence field.
context_zh_TW: SADS 連結到逆轉錄轉座子與 LINE-1 活化，因衰老中的衛星重複去抑制允許 normally 靜默的重複元件移動。去抑制的 LINE-1 產生胞質 cDNA 助長 cGAS-STING 訊號與 SASP，將組成性異染色質鬆弛連結到先天免疫活化。此連結將 SADS 定位於衰老更廣的染色質—免疫軸中，其中異染色質完整性喪失放大發炎。它是該領域較新、中等信度的機制。

label: contributes_to
context: SASP-driven inflammaging contributes to osteoarthritis pathology by promoting cartilage degradation, synovial inflammation, and joint pain through cytokines and proteases acting on chondrocytes and the synovial microenvironment. The chronic low-grade inflammation from accumulated senescent joint cells accelerates structural damage, and senescent chondrocytes are a prominent feature of OA cartilage. This supports senolytic and senomorphic trials in OA, which aim to clear or tame senescent joint cells. The contribution is mechanistically plausible though multifactorial.
context_zh_TW: 慢性 SASP 驅動的 inflammaging 透過細胞激素與蛋白酶作用於軟骨細胞與滑膜微環境，促進軟骨降解、滑膜發炎與關節疼痛，貢獻骨關節炎病理。來自累積衰老關節細胞的慢性低程度發炎加速結構損傷，且衰老軟骨細胞是 OA 軟骨顯著特徵。這支持 OA 中的 senolytic 與 senomorphic 試驗，旨在清除或馴服衰老關節細胞。此貢獻在機制上合理儘管多因素。

label: is_regulated_by
context: The METTL3-METTL14 m6A methyltransferase complex promotes SASP factor expression by installing N6-methyladenosine marks on mRNA that facilitate enhancer-promoter looping and stabilize SASP transcripts. This epitranscriptomic layer adds post-transcriptional control to the secretome, coordinating the sustained expression of multiple SASP genes. The relationship is mechanistically plausible and supported by knockout studies showing reduced SASP, but the field is newer and less consolidated than the NF-kB/mTOR axes, so confidence is moderate.
context_zh_TW: METTL3-METTL14 m6A 甲基轉移酶複合體透過在 mRNA 上安裝 N6-甲基腺苷標記，促進 SASP 因子表現，該標記促進增強子—啟動子環化並穩定 SASP 轉錄本。此表觀轉錄層次為分泌組添加轉錄後控制，協調多種 SASP 基因的持續表現。此關係在機制上合理且獲剔除研究（顯示 SASP 降低）支持，但此領域較新、較不如 NF-κB/mTOR 軸整合，故信度中等。

label: is_associated_with
context: The Met/Met genotype is associated with higher anxiety traits, consistent with the worrier phenotype in which elevated prefrontal dopamine and norepinephrine promote heightened vigilance and emotional reactivity. Multiple studies report increased anxiety sensitivity in slow COMT individuals, though effect sizes are modest and context-dependent. The association follows from altered catecholamine tone rather than a direct anxietogenic mutation. It is frequently discussed in gene-environment and stress reactivity research.
context_zh_TW: Met/Met 基因型與 higher anxiety 性狀相關，與擔憂者表型一致，其中前額葉多巴胺升高和 norepinephrine 促進提高警覺性和情緒反應性。多項研究報告稱，慢速 COMT 個體的焦慮敏感性有所增加，但效果大小適中且取決於具體情況。這種關聯源自於兒茶酚胺音調的改變，而不是直接的焦慮突變。它在基因環境和壓力反應研究中經常被討論。

label: is_gated_by
context: The PRDX6 to HSPA8 axis controls the ASAP to SASP transition; apigenin binds PRDX6, inhibiting its iPLA2 activity and thereby restraining secretome maturation. PRDX6 thus operates as a gatekeeper linking redox and lipid signaling to inflammatory progression during senescence initiation. Its role adds a peroxide/phospholipase dimension to the early stress response, complementing the ATM/p38 kinase axis. Confidence is moderate, as the axis is mechanistically documented but less consolidated than the ATM/TAK1/p38 pathway, and further studies are needed to fully define PRDX6's contribution in vivo.
context_zh_TW: PRDX6 到 HSPA8 軸控制 ASAP 到 SASP 的轉變；apigenin 結合 PRDX6，抑制其 iPLA2 活性從而抑制分泌組成熟。PRDX6 因此作為連結氧化還原與脂質訊號到衰老起始期間發炎進展的守門者。其角色為早期壓力反應增添過氧化氫/磷脂酶維度，補充 ATM/p38 激酶軸。信度中等，因此軸機制上已有記載但較 ATM/TAK1/p38 路徑不 consolidated，且需進一步研究以完全定義 PRDX6 體內貢獻。

label: contributes_to
context: VEGF-C contributes to paracrine senescence: VEGFR2/FLT3 inhibition suppressed paracrine arrest, indicating VEGF-family signaling is one branch mediating transmissible growth arrest. This positions VEGF-C among the less obvious SASP factors with arrest-inducing capacity and broadens the mechanistic basis of paracrine senescence beyond classical cytokines. The relationship is supported by inhibitor studies showing reduced paracrine arrest upon VEGFR blockade. Confidence is moderate, as the VEGF branch is one of several cooperating signals.
context_zh_TW: VEGF-C 貢獻旁分泌衰老：VEGFR2/FLT3 抑制抑制了旁分泌停滯，顯示 VEGF 家族訊號是介導可傳播生長停滯的一分支。這將 VEGF-C 定位於具停滯誘發能力的、較不顯眼的 SASP 因子之一，補充 TGFbeta 與 Activin A 的停滯臂。其角色例示 SASP 如何透過多種獨立配體驅動旁分泌衰老，確保強健的生長抑制擴散。

label: regulates
context: p16 overexpression induces a DDR-free senescent state with a unique SASP profile, sometimes called a p16-associated secretory phenotype (PASP), that includes factors such as IGFBP3 and ISG15 and can be p53-dependent for composition. This shows the SASP is shaped by the upstream arrest pathway rather than being identical across inducers. The p16-SASP relationship highlights qualitative variation in the secretome and its dependence on the mode of senescence entry. Confidence is moderate as the PASP concept is still being defined.
context_zh_TW: p16 過表現誘發無 DDR 的衰老狀態，帶有獨特 SASP 輪廓，有時稱為 p16 相關分泌表型（PASP），包含如 IGFBP3 與 ISG15 等因子，且組成上可依賴 p53。這顯示 SASP 由上游停滯路徑塑造，而非跨越誘發因子相同。p16-SASP 關係凸顯分泌組的性質變異及其對衰老進入模式的依賴。由於 PASP 概念仍在定義中，信度中等。

label: is_associated_with
context: The COMT Val allele is associated with increased schizophrenia risk in some populations, particularly through its effect on prefrontal dopamine signaling and possibly gene-environment interactions. Meta-analyses support a modest but significant association, which is stronger in certain ethnic groups and clinical subgroups, reflecting heterogeneity in genetic background. The biological rationale is that excessive dopamine catabolism in fast COMT may disrupt prefrontal networks implicated in the disorder, consistent with the dopamine hypothesis. The effect is small relative to the overall genetic architecture of schizophrenia.
context_zh_TW: COMT Val allele 與某些人群中精神分裂症風險增加有關，特別是透過其對前額多巴胺訊號傳導以及可能的基因-環境交互作用的影響。薈萃分析支持一種適度但顯著的關聯，這種關聯在某些種族群體和臨床亞組中更為強烈，反映了遺傳背景的異質性。生物學原理是，快速 COMT 中過多的多巴胺分解代謝可能會破壞與疾病有關的前額葉網絡，這與多巴胺假說一致。相對於精神分裂症的整體遺傳結構，這種影響很小。

label: is_associated_with
context: The Met/Met genotype is associated with better working memory performance on complex cognitive tasks, attributed to the higher prefrontal dopamine tone produced by slower COMT activity. Under the inverted-U model, this places slow individuals nearer the cognitive optimum during non-stressed conditions, favoring stability and maintenance of information. The association is well replicated but moderated by sex, task, and stress, and is strongest on demanding load-bearing paradigms. It represents a cornerstone of gene-cognition research in humans.
context_zh_TW: Met/Met 基因型與複雜認知任務中較好的工作記憶表現有關，這歸因於速度較慢的 COMT activity 產生的前額葉多巴胺音調較高。在倒U模型下，這使得反應遲鈍的人在無壓力的情況下更接近認知最佳狀態，有利於訊息的穩定性和維護。這種關聯得到了很好的複製，但受到性別、任務和壓力的調節，並且在要求較高的承重範式上最強。它代表了人類基因認知研究的基石。

label: is_associated_with
context: The Val/Val (fast) COMT genotype is associated with poorer working memory performance, especially under stress, because rapid dopamine clearance lowers prefrontal dopamine below the optimal range of the inverted-U curve. Stress-induced dopamine release is more quickly inactivated in fast genotypes, worsening cognitive efficiency precisely when performance matters most. This effect is most evident on demanding, load-bearing working memory tasks and under challenging conditions. The interaction between genotype and environmental stress is a hallmark finding in COMT research.
context_zh_TW: Val/Val（快速）COMT genotype 與較差的工作記憶表現相關，尤其是在壓力下，因為快速多巴胺清除會將前額葉多巴胺降低到倒 U 曲線的最佳範圍以下。在快速基因型中，壓力引起的多巴胺釋放會更快失活，從而在表現最重要的時候使認知效率惡化。這種效應在要求高、承載工作記憶任務和具有挑戰性的條件下最為明顯。基因型與環境壓力之間的相互作用是 COMT 研究的一個標誌性發現。

label: impacts
context: The Val158Met polymorphism impacts stimulus-response (S-R) learning, a striatal-dependent form of habit learning sensitive to dopamine signaling. Fast (Val) genotypes alter the dopamine dynamics in corticostriatal circuits that support S-R acquisition, and COMT overexpression models show impaired S-R learning when excess enzyme accelerates dopamine clearance. The direction and magnitude of the effect depend on whether COMT activity is increased or decreased and on the specific task parameters. This extends COMT's influence from prefrontal cognition into striatal habit formation.
context_zh_TW: Val158Met 多態性會影響刺激反應（S-R）學習，這是一種對多巴胺訊號敏感的紋狀體依賴性習慣學習形式。 Fast (Val) 基因型改變了支持 S-R 獲取的皮質紋狀體迴路中的多巴胺動態，而當過量的酶加速多巴胺清除時，COMT 過度表現模型顯示 S-R 學習受損。效果的方向和幅度取決於 COMT activity 是增加還是減少以及特定的任務參數。這將 COMT 的影響從前額認知擴展到紋狀體 habit formation。

label: impacts
context: Val158Met impacts risk for psychiatric disorders such as schizophrenia, with the Val allele associated with modestly increased risk through prefrontal dopaminergic dysregulation, though effects are modified by environment and other genes. The association is replicated but small in absolute terms, reflecting the polygenic architecture of psychiatric disorders. It illustrates how a single functional polymorphism can contribute to complex neuropsychiatric vulnerability. COMT remains a candidate gene of sustained interest in psychiatric genetics.
context_zh_TW: Val158Met 影響精神分裂症等精神疾病的風險，Val 等位基因透過前額葉多巴胺能失調與適度增加的風險相關，儘管影響會受到環境和其他基因的影響。這種關聯是重複的，但絕對值很小，反映了精神疾病的多基因結構。它說明了單一功能多態性如何導致複雜的神經精神脆弱性。 COMT 仍然是精神遺傳學領域持續關注的候選基因。

label: is_associated_with
context: Val158Met is associated with poorer cognitive performance, particularly on prefrontal tasks, in individuals carrying the faster Val allele due to reduced dopamine availability at D1/D2 receptors. The relationship follows the inverted-U model, so the direction of cognitive effect depends on genotype and task demands, with fast genotypes disadvantaged on stability-dependent tasks. Meta-analytic evidence supports small-to-moderate effect sizes on executive function and working memory. These effects are most pronounced under cognitive load and stress, where dopamine demand is highest.
context_zh_TW: Val158Met 與 poorer cognitive performance 相關，特別是在前額葉任務中，在由於 D1/D2 受體多巴胺可用性降低而攜帶更快 Val 等位基因的個體中。這種關係遵循倒 U 型模型，因此認知效果的方向取決於基因型和任務需求，而快速基因型在依賴穩定性的任務中處於不利地位。薈萃分析證據支持 executive function 和工作記憶的效果量為小到中等。這些影響在認知負荷和壓力下最為明顯，此時多巴胺需求最高。

label: reduces
context: A 2015 randomized controlled trial found that low-dose methylene blue reduced anxiety and depression scores compared to placebo in a clinical population, providing the cleanest human evidence for mood benefits. The mood-relevant dose range in research is 0.5-2 mg, which provides enough MAOI activity for mild anxiolytic and mood-stabilizing effects. Because methylene blue's mood effects come primarily from its monoamine oxidase inhibition - increasing synaptic serotonin, dopamine, and norepinephrine - it carries the same drug-interaction risks as prescription MAOIs, and combining it with any serotonergic medication can potentially trigger serotonin syndrome, making physician supervision essential.
context_zh_TW: 2015 年一項隨機對照試驗發現，低劑量亞甲基藍在臨床人群中可降低焦慮和抑鬱分數，與安慰劑相比，提供了最乾淨的人類情緒益處證據。研究中與情緒相關的劑量範圍為 0.5-2 mg，提供足夠的 MAOI 活性以產生輕度抗焦慮和情緒穩定效果。由於亞甲基藍的情緒效果主要來自其單胺氧化酶抑制作用——增加突觸中的血清素、多巴胺和去甲腎上腺素——它與處方 MAOIs 具有相同的藥物交互作用風險，與任何血清素能藥物結合可能引發血清素症候群，因此需要醫師監督。

label: upregulated_in
context: ACSL4 is up-regulated during cellular senescence, contributing to the pro-ferroptotic state of senescent cells and their vulnerability to ferroptosis. Its PUFA-charging activity converges with acid ceramidase on membrane PUFA-phospholipid abundance but through an independent mechanism (ACSL4 levels are unchanged by ACase knockdown).
context_zh_TW: ACSL4 在細胞衰老過程中被上調，促成衰老細胞的促鐵死亡狀態及其對鐵死亡的脆弱性。它的 PUFA 活化活性與 acid ceramidase 在膜 PUFA-磷脂豐度上趨同，但機制各自獨立（ACase 敲低不改變 ACSL4 含量）。

label: contributes_to
context: AIF contributes to Chemotherapy. Apoptosis-inducing factor is a mitochondrial flavoprotein that, once released, executes a caspase-independent form of chromatin condensation and DNA fragmentation. Chemotherapy uses cytotoxic agents to kill rapidly dividing cells, and its efficacy is limited by innate and acquired resistance mechanisms. The relationship is directional, with AIF acting as the operative agent upon Chemotherapy rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: AIF 貢獻於 Chemotherapy。 Apoptosis誘導因子是一種粒線體黃素蛋白，一旦釋放，就會執行不依賴半胱天冬酶的形式的chromatin condensation和DNA斷裂。 Chemotherapy 使用細胞毒性劑殺死快速分裂的細胞，其功效受到先天和後天抗藥性機制的限制。這種關係是有方向的，AIF 充當 Chemotherapy 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: is_linked_to
context: ALIX is linked to Breast Cancer. ALIX is an ESCRT-associated protein that controls exosome biogenesis and the surface presentation of PD-L1 and EGFR. Breast cancer is a heterogeneous malignancy in which molecular subtypes (luminal, HER2-enriched, basal/triple-negative) dictate targeted therapy choice. The directionality runs from Breast Cancer toward ALIX, so Breast Cancer is the active agent and ALIX the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: ALIX 連結至 Breast Cancer。 ALIX 是一種 ESCRT 相關蛋白，控制外泌體生物發生以及 PD-L1 和 EGFR 的表面呈現。 Breast Cancer 是一種異質性惡性腫瘤，其分子亞型（管腔型、HER2富集型、基礎/三陰性）決定了標靶治療的選擇。方向性從 Breast Cancer 向 ALIX，因此 Breast Cancer 是主動主體，ALIX 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: regulates
context: ALIX regulates EGFR. ALIX is an ESCRT-associated protein that controls exosome biogenesis and the surface presentation of PD-L1 and EGFR. EGFR is a receptor tyrosine kinase whose activating mutations and overexpression couple extracellular cues to proliferative and survival signaling. The relationship is directional, with ALIX acting as the operative agent upon EGFR rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: ALIX調節EGFR。 ALIX 是一種 ESCRT 相關蛋白，控制外泌體生物發生以及 PD-L1 和 EGFR 的表面呈現。 EGFR 是一種受體酪胺酸激酶，其活化突變和過度表現將細胞外訊號與增殖和生存訊號傳導結合。這種關係是有方向的，ALIX 充當 EGFR 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: regulates
context: ALIX regulates PD-L1. ALIX is an ESCRT-associated protein that controls exosome biogenesis and the surface presentation of PD-L1 and EGFR. PD-L1 is an immune-checkpoint ligand expressed by tumor and stromal cells that engages PD-1 on T cells to suppress antitumor immunity. The relationship is directional, with ALIX acting as the operative agent upon PD-L1 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: ALIX 調節 PD-L1。 ALIX 是一種 ESCRT 相關蛋白，控制外泌體生物發生以及 PD-L1 和 EGFR 的表面呈現。 PD-L1 是一種由腫瘤和基質細胞表達的免疫檢查點配體，可與 T 細胞上的 PD-1 結合以抑制抗腫瘤免疫。這種關係是有方向的，ALIX 充當 PD-L1 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: promotes
context: AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK), a master energy sensor activated by rising AMP/ATP ratios, lipid stress, or low glucose, promotes peroxisome biogenesis by stimulating lipid synthesis and incorporation of lipids into developing peroxisomal membranes. In disorders like ALD, however, VLCFA-driven AMPK activation is overwhelmed by the massive lipid load.
context_zh_TW: AMPK（AMP-activated protein kinase）是主要的能量感測器，會因 AMP/ATP 比值上升、脂質壓力或低血糖而活化；它透過刺激脂質合成並促進脂質嵌入發育中的過氧化物體膜來促進過氧化物體生成。然而在 ALD 等疾病中，VLCFA 驅動的 AMPK 活化仍敵不過巨大的脂質負荷。

label: is_activated_by
context: ATM also responds to oxidative stress and replication stress, so its activation is not uniquely radiation-driven. This broader activation means ATM sits at the nexus of multiple genotoxic and metabolic stresses. It expands the physiological role of ATM beyond ionizing radiation.
context_zh_TW: ATM 也會對氧化壓力和複製壓力作出反應，因此其激活並非僅由輻射驅動。這種更廣泛的激活意味著 ATM 位於多種基因毒性與代謝壓力的交會點。這擴展了 ATM 在游離輻射之外的生理角色。

label: induces
context: Adrenochrome and related pathway intermediates can promote methemoglobin formation, hemolysis at high concentrations, and lipid peroxidation in erythrocyte membranes under oxidative conditions. Adrenochrome-induced hemolysis (rupture of red blood cells) has been observed in experimental settings, and older research from the 1960s-1970s examined whether erythrocytes from some patients were more susceptible to adrenochrome-induced lysis, though results were mixed and not strongly replicated. These effects position adrenochrome as a potential reactant that can damage red blood cells rather than a molecule normally stored or produced inside healthy erythrocytes.
context_zh_TW: Adrenochrome and related pathway intermediates can promote methemoglobin formation, hemolysis at high concentrations, and lipid peroxidation in erythrocyte membranes under oxidative conditions。Adrenochrome-induced hemolysis (rupture of red blood cells) has been observed in experimental settings, and older research from the 1960s-1970s examined whether erythrocytes from some patients were more susceptible to adrenochrome-induced lysis, though results were mixed and not strongly replicated。These effects position adrenochrome as a potential reactant that can damage red blood cells rather than a molecule normally stored or produced inside healthy erythrocytes。

label: is_an_intermediate_in
context: Adrenochrome, or related aminochromes, can form as an intermediate in neuromelanin synthesis, particularly in dopaminergic neurons such as those of the substantia nigra. In this context, oxidation of catecholamines and their cyclization products feed into the polymerization that produces neuromelanin, a normal physiological pigment. Excess accumulation of these reactive intermediates may relate to oxidative damage in catecholaminergic neurons, and this pathway connects adrenochrome chemistry to neurodegenerative processes involving oxidative stress in the brain.
context_zh_TW: Adrenochrome, or related aminochromes, can form as an intermediate in neuromelanin synthesis, particularly in dopaminergic neurons such as those of the substantia nigra。In this context, oxidation of catecholamines and their cyclization products feed into the polymerization that produces neuromelanin, a normal physiological pigment。Excess accumulation of these reactive intermediates may relate to oxidative damage in catecholaminergic neurons, and this pathway connects adrenochrome chemistry to neurodegenerative processes involving oxidative stress in the brain。

label: phosphorylated_by
context: Akt phosphorylates and inhibits the FOXO1/FOXO3 transcription factors, which normally promote autophagy and stress-resistance gene expression, thereby indirectly suppressing autophagy downstream of insulin/PI3K signaling. The reciprocal interaction reflects the broader antagonism between growth-factor-driven anabolism (via Akt-mTOR) and the autophagy-promoting FOXO program. When Akt is inactive during fasting, FOXO factors are de-repressed and contribute to autophagic and longevity pathways. This axis embeds autophagy control within the insulin-signaling network that also regulates mTORC1.
context_zh_TW: Akt 磷酸化並抑制 FOXO1/FOXO3 轉錄因子，後者通常促進自噬和壓力抵抗基因表現，從而在胰島素/PI3K 信號下游間接抑制自噬。此相互關係反映了生長因子驅動的合成代謝（經由 Akt-mTOR）與促自噬 FOXO 程序之間更廣泛的拮抗。當禁食期間 Akt 失活時，FOXO 因子被解除抑制並貢獻於自噬和長壽途徑。此軸將自噬控制嵌入同時調節 mTORC1 的胰島素信號網絡中。

label: causes
context: Alu elements are short interspersed nuclear elements that, when derepressed, produce transcripts that contribute to genomic instability. In aging and stressed cells, loss of epigenetic silencing permits Alu transcription, and the resulting double-stranded RNA and retrotransposition intermediates challenge genome integrity by promoting insertions and activating innate immune DNA and RNA sensing pathways. Aberrant Alu activity is therefore both a consequence and a driver of the accumulating genomic instability recognized as a hallmark of aging.
context_zh_TW: Alu 元件是短散佈的核元件，當去抑制時，會產生導致基因組不穩定的轉錄物。在老化和壓力的細胞中，表觀遺傳沉默的喪失允許 Alu 轉錄，由此產生的雙股 RNA 和逆轉錄轉座中間體透過促進插入和激活先天免疫 DNA 和 RNA 感測途徑來挑戰基因組完整性。因此，異常的 Alu 活性既是基因組不穩定性累積的結果，也是其驅動因素，而基因組不穩定性被認為是老化的標誌。

label: modifies
context: Aminochromes such as adrenochrome can covalently modify the IKK complex (IkappaB kinase), a key upstream activator of NF-kappaB, via Michael addition to critical cysteine residues. IKK relies on cysteine residues for its activation, so alkylation would impair its kinase function and prevent phosphorylation-dependent activation of NF-kappaB. By disabling this upstream regulator, low concentrations of adrenochrome are hypothesized to suppress NF-kappaB-driven SASP transcription, shifting the senescent cell into a less inflammatory, senomorphic state rather than killing it outright.
context_zh_TW: 氨基色素如腎上腺素色素可通過麥克爾加成共價修飾IKK複合物（IκB激酶），NF-κB的關鍵上游激活因子，針對關鍵半胱氨酸殘基。IKK依賴半胱氨酸殘基進行激活，因此烷基化會損害其激酶功能並阻止NF-κB的磷酸化依賴性激活。通過禁用此上游調節因子，假定低濃度的腎上腺素色素抑制NF-κB驅動的SASP轉錄，將衰老細胞轉變為較少炎症的衰老模仿狀態，而非直接殺死。

label: is_induced_by
context: Apoptosis is induced by Fenbendazole. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. Fenbendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic under investigation for anticancer effects via microtubule interference, glycolysis suppression, and p53 activation. The directionality runs from Fenbendazole toward Apoptosis, so Fenbendazole is the active agent and Apoptosis the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: Apoptosis 由 Fenbendazole 誘發。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。 Fenbendazole 是一種苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，正在研究透過微管幹擾、糖酵解抑制和 p53 活化來發揮抗癌作用。方向性從 Fenbendazole 向 Apoptosis，因此 Fenbendazole 是活性劑，Apoptosis 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: is_induced_by
context: Apoptosis is induced by Gossypol. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. Gossypol is a natural BH3-mimetic derived from cottonseed that, unusually, also engages Mcl-1. The directionality runs from Gossypol toward Apoptosis, so Gossypol is the active agent and Apoptosis the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: Apoptosis 由 Gossypol 誘發。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。 Gossypol 是一種從棉籽中提取的天然 BH3 模擬物，不同尋常的是，它也參與 Mcl-1。方向性從 Gossypol 向 Apoptosis，因此 Gossypol 是活性劑，Apoptosis 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: is_induced_by
context: Apoptosis is induced by Ivermectin. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. The directionality runs from Ivermectin toward Apoptosis, so Ivermectin is the active agent and Apoptosis the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: Apoptosis 由 Ivermectin 誘發。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。方向性從 Ivermectin 朝向 Apoptosis，因此 Ivermectin 是活性劑，Apoptosis 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: is_induced_by
context: Apoptosis is induced by melittin. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. Melittin is the principal peptide of honeybee venom that permeabilizes membranes and suppresses oncogenic receptors and checkpoints. The directionality runs from melittin toward Apoptosis, so melittin is the active agent and Apoptosis the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: Apoptosis 由 melittin 誘發。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。蜂毒肽是蜜蜂毒液的主要勝肽，可透化膜並抑制致癌受體和檢查點。方向性從 melittin 向 Apoptosis，因此 melittin 是活性劑，Apoptosis 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: reduces
context: Ascorbic acid reduces adrenochrome (conf 0.75) and inhibits adrenochrome formation (conf 0.9) by scavenging the oxidizing species that drive epinephrine oxidation — the redox-counterpart edge placing ascorbate on the trigger side of the graph's Fiedler seam.
context_zh_TW: 抗壞血酸還原 adrenochrome（conf 0.75）並藉清除驅動腎上腺素氧化的氧化物種抑制 adrenochrome 形成（conf 0.9）——此氧化還原對應邊把抗壞血酸置於圖 Fiedler 接縫的觸發器側。

label: are_a_type_of
context: BET inhibitors are a type of Senomorphic. BET inhibitors displace bromodomain proteins such as BRD4 from acetylated chromatin, silencing MYC and inflammatory transcription programs. Senomorphics are agents that suppress senescent-cell secretory output rather than eliminating the cells themselves. The directionality runs from Senomorphic toward BET inhibitors, so Senomorphic is the active agent and BET inhibitors the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context_zh_TW: BET inhibitors 是Senomorphic 的一種。 BET inhibitors 取代乙醯化染色質中的溴結構域蛋白，例如 BRD4，沉默 MYC 和發炎轉錄程序。它們是抑制衰老細胞分泌輸出而不是消除細胞本身的藥物。方向性從 Senomorphic 向 BET inhibitors，因此 Senomorphic 是活性劑，BET inhibitors 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: include
context: BH3 mimetics include Gossypol. BH3 mimetics are small molecules that occupy the hydrophobic groove of anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 proteins, freeing Bax/Bak to kill tumor cells. Gossypol is a natural BH3-mimetic derived from cottonseed that, unusually, also engages Mcl-1. The relationship is directional, with BH3 mimetics acting as the operative agent upon Gossypol rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context_zh_TW: BH3 mimetics 包括 Gossypol。 BH3 mimetics 是佔據抗凋亡 Bcl-2 蛋白疏水溝的小分子，釋放 Bax/Bak 來殺死腫瘤細胞。 Gossypol 是一種從棉籽中提取的天然 BH3 模擬物，不同尋常的是，它也參與 Mcl-1。這種關係是有方向的，BH3 mimetics 充當 Gossypol 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: is_evaluated_by
context: BRCA is evaluated by melittin. BRCA1 and BRCA2 are tumor suppressors that orchestrate homology-directed repair of DNA double-strand breaks and genome stability. Melittin is the principal peptide of honeybee venom that permeabilizes membranes and suppresses oncogenic receptors and checkpoints. The directionality runs from melittin toward BRCA, so melittin is the active agent and BRCA the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
context_zh_TW: BRCA 由 melittin 評估。 BRCA1 和 BRCA2 負責協調 DNA 雙股斷裂的同源定向修復和基因組穩定性。蜂毒肽是蜜蜂毒液的主要勝肽，可透化膜並抑制致癌受體和檢查點。方向性從 melittin 向 BRCA，因此 melittin 是活性劑，BRCA 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

label: is_inhibited_by
context: Bad is inhibited by PAK1. Bad is a BH3-only protein whose survival-factor-responsive phosphorylation controls its binding to Bcl-xL/Bcl-w and thereby the death threshold. PAK1 is a p21-activated kinase downstream of Rac/Cdc42 that promotes survival, invasion, and cancer-stem-cell signaling and is inhibited by ivermectin. The directionality runs from PAK1 toward Bad, so PAK1 is the active agent and Bad the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context_zh_TW: Bad 被 PAK1 抑制。 Bad 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，其生存因子反應性磷酸化控制其與 Bcl-xL/Bcl-w 的結合，從而控制死亡閾值。 PAK1 是 Rac/Cdc42 下游的 p21 活化激酶，可促進存活、侵襲和癌症幹細胞訊號傳導，並被伊維菌素抑制。方向性從 PAK1 向 Bad，因此 PAK1 是主動主體，Bad 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: synergizes_with
context: Because many therapy-resistant cancers rely on FSP1 for ferroptosis resistance, iFSP1 is being explored to sensitize tumors (e.g., hepatocellular carcinoma) to ferroptosis-based therapy, often in combination with GPX4 or system Xc- inhibitors rather than as monotherapy, reflecting the two-pillar ferroptosis-defense model.
context_zh_TW: 由於許多治療抗性腫瘤依賴 FSP1 來抵抗鐵死亡，iFSP1 被探索用於使腫瘤（例如肝細胞癌）對鐵死亡療法增敏，通常與 GPX4 或 system Xc- 抑制劑合併使用而非單藥，這反映鐵死亡的雙支柱防禦模型。

label: inhibits
context: Beyond direct K-type SIRT1 activation, quercetin (with apigenin) inhibits CD38, an NAD+ hydrolase, thereby boosting cellular NAD+ availability — a NAD+-boosting mechanism distinct from allostery. This dual role means quercetin sits in both the direct-STAC and the NAD+-modulator camps.
context_zh_TW: 除了直接 K 型活化 SIRT1，quercetin（與 apigenin）還抑制 CD38（一種 NAD+ 水解酶），從而提升細胞 NAD+ 可及性——這是不同於別構的 NAD+ 提升機制。此雙重角色使 quercetin 同時處於直接 STAC 與 NAD+ 調節劑兩個陣營。

label: inhibits
context: Beyond senolysis, Fisetin inhibits the activity of several pro-inflammatory cytokines (TNF-alpha, IL-6) and the transcription factor NF-kB, contributing to its anti-inflammatory profile and to reduced SASP factor expression in treated tissues.

label: acts_as
context: Bik acts as Tumor Suppressor. Bik is a BH3-only protein that directly activates Bax/Bak and is itself suppressed by oncogenic kinase signaling. label: suppresses
context: Bmf suppresses Metastasis. Bmf is a cytoskeleton-sequestered BH3-only protein that enforces anoikis and restrains dissemination of detached cells. The relationship is directional, with Bmf acting as the operative agent upon Metastasis rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.

label: activates_via_k_type
context: Butein, a chalcone, is among the first-reported SIRT1 polyphenolic STACs (with resveratrol, piceatannol, quercetin, myricetin), activating SIRT1 via K-type allosteric lowering of Km. It attenuates sepsis-induced brain injury through SIRT1 signaling.
context_zh_TW: Butein 是一種查耳酮，是最早被報導的 SIRT1 多酚類 STACs 之一（與白藜蘆醇、piceatannol、quercetin、myricetin 並列），透過 K 型別構降低 Km 來活化 SIRT1。它透過 SIRT1 訊號減緩敗血症誘發的腦損傷。

label: downregulated_by
context: CD73, the rate-limiting ectonucleotidase that converts AMP to immunosuppressive adenosine in the tumor microenvironment, is downregulated following intermittent fasting. Reduced CD73 expression leads to diminished extracellular adenosine, which can relieve adenosine-mediated immune suppression and enhance anti-tumor immunity. The regulation is observed in vitro under fasting-mimetic conditions, linking IF to both metabolic and immunological remodeling. Because adenosine signaling promotes tumor evasion, CD73 downregulation represents a plausible mechanism by which fasting improves cancer therapy outcomes.
context_zh_TW: CD73是腫瘤微環境中將AMP轉化為免疫抑制性腺苷的限速胞外核苷酸酶，在間歇性斷食後下調。CD73表現降低導致細胞外腺苷減少，可緩解腺苷介導的免疫抑制並增強抗腫瘤免疫。此調節在體外斷食模擬條件下觀察到，將IF與代謝和免疫重塑連結。由於腺苷訊號促進腫瘤逃避免疫，CD73下調代表斷食改善癌症治療結果的一個合理機制。

label: alternative_autophagy_inducer_to
context: Caloric restriction and rapamycin are alternative inducers of autophagy that, like spermidine, engage the lysosomal-degradative program to promote healthspan, but each carries translational limitations. Caloric restriction is difficult to sustain long-term in humans and can have adverse metabolic consequences, while rapamycin has immunosuppressive and potential metabolic side effects. Spermidine offers a more tractable, well-tolerated means to mimic these benefits through safe autophagy induction. The existence of multiple inducers provides flexibility in designing anti-aging interventions.
context_zh_TW: 熱量限制和雷帕黴素是自噬的替代性誘發物，它們如同精胺一般，運用溶酶體—降解程序來促進健康壽命，但各自帶有轉譯限制。熱量限制難以在人類中長期維持，且可能有不良代謝後果，而雷帕黴素具有免疫抑制和潛在代謝副作用。精胺提供了一種更可行、耐受性良好的方式，透過安全的自噬誘發來模擬這些益處。多種誘發物的存在為設計抗衰老介入提供了靈活性。

label: increases
context: Caloric restriction increases the sensitivity of tumor cells to chemotherapy by creating a differential stress resistance in which normal cells enter a protective, autophagy-dependent quiescent state while cancer cells remain vulnerable. CR additionally stimulates CD8+ T cell-mediated anti-tumor immunity and enhances apoptotic priming of malignant cells. The improved therapeutic index allows lower effective doses and reduced toxicity. These effects position CR and its mimetics as adjuncts to conventional cancer therapy.
context_zh_TW: 熱量限制透過創造差異性壓力抵抗來增加腫瘤細胞對化療的敏感性：正常細胞進入保護性、依賴自噬的靜止狀態，而癌細胞仍保持脆弱。熱量限制還刺激 CD8+ T 細胞介導的抗腫瘤免疫，並增強惡性細胞的凋亡啟動。改善的治療指數允許更低的有效劑量和減少的毒性。這些效應將熱量限制及其擬似物定位為常規癌症治療的輔助手段。

label: reverses
context: Caloric restriction, the best-characterized lifespan-extending intervention, has shown measurable reversal of epigenetic clock estimates in some studies. By limiting energy intake, caloric restriction slows age-related changes in DNA methylation and chromatin, reducing the methylation-predicted biological age of tissues relative to chronological age. These findings indicate that biological age is malleable and have made epigenetic clocks standard endpoints in longevity research and intervention trials.
context_zh_TW: 熱量限制是最有特色的延長壽命的干預措施，在一些研究中表明表觀遺傳時鐘估計出現了可測量的逆轉。透過限制能量攝入，熱量限制可以減緩 DNA 甲基化和染色質中與年齡相關的變化，從而降低甲基化預測的組織相對於實際年齡的生物年齡。這些發現表明生物年齡是可塑的，並使表觀遺傳時鐘成為長壽研究和乾預試驗的標準終點。

context_zh_TW: Cancer 使用 Integrins。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 Integrins 是將細胞外基質連接到細胞骨架和細胞內生存激酶的跨膜受體。這種關係是有方向的，Cancer 充當 Integrins 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: is_downregulated_in
context: Caspase-10 is downregulated in Cancer. Caspase-10 is an initiator caspase related to caspase-8 that amplifies death-receptor signaling and is frequently silenced in tumors. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward Caspase-10, so Cancer is the active agent and Caspase-10 the recipient of the effect. This altered abundance or activity is a recurring feature of malignancy that can serve as a diagnostic, prognostic, or predictive biomarker and sometimes as a therapeutic target.
context_zh_TW: Caspase-10 在 Cancer 中下調。 Caspase-10 是一種與 caspase-8 相關的起始 caspase，可放大死亡受體訊號傳導，並且在腫瘤中經常被沉默。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 向 Caspase-10，因此 Cancer 是活性劑，Caspase-10 是效果的接受者。這種豐度或活性的改變是惡性腫瘤的一個反覆出現的特徵，可以作為診斷、預後或預測生物標記物，有時還可以作為治療標靶。

label: is_phosphorylated_by
context: Caspase-2 is phosphorylated by CDK1. Caspase-2 is an ancient initiator caspase activated by the PIDDosome in response to DNA damage and mitotic catastrophe. CDK1 in complex with cyclin B1 drives mitotic entry and can phosphorylate and regulate apical caspases such as caspase-2. The directionality runs from CDK1 toward Caspase-2, so CDK1 is the active agent and Caspase-2 the recipient of the effect. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context_zh_TW: Caspase-2 被 CDK1 磷酸化。 Caspase-2 是一種古老的起始半胱天冬酶，由 PIDDosome 響應 DNA Damage 和有絲分裂災難而激活。 CDK1 與細胞週期蛋白 B1 形成複合物，可驅動有絲分裂進入，並可磷酸化和調節頂端 caspase，例如 caspase-2。方向性從 CDK1 朝向 Caspase-2，因此 CDK1 是活性劑，Caspase-2 是效果的接受者。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: is_phosphorylated_by
context: Caspase-2 is phosphorylated by CaMKII. Caspase-2 is an ancient initiator caspase activated by the PIDDosome in response to DNA damage and mitotic catastrophe. CaMKII is a calcium/calmodulin-dependent kinase that, among other roles, phosphorylates caspase-2 in response to calcium fluxes. The directionality runs from CaMKII toward Caspase-2, so CaMKII is the active agent and Caspase-2 the recipient of the effect. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context_zh_TW: Caspase-2 被 CaMKII 磷酸化。 Caspase-2 是一種古老的起始半胱天冬酶，由 PIDDosome 響應 DNA Damage 和有絲分裂災難而激活。 CaMKII 是一種鈣/鈣調蛋白依賴性激酶，除其他作用外，它還響應鈣流而磷酸化 caspase-2。方向性從 CaMKII 朝向 Caspase-2，因此 CaMKII 是主動主體，Caspase-2 是效果的接受者。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: is_enhanced_by
context: Caspase-3 is enhanced by PKCδ. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. PKCδ is a protein kinase C isoform that can both enhance caspase-3 activity and, in some contexts, promote apoptotic signaling. The directionality runs from PKCδ toward Caspase-3, so PKCδ is the active agent and Caspase-3 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: Caspase-3 被 PKCδ 增強。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。 PKCδ 是一種蛋白激酶 C 同工型，既可以增強 caspase-3 活性，也可以在某些情況下促進細胞凋亡訊號傳導。方向性從 PKCδ 朝向 Caspase-3，因此 PKCδ 是主動主體，Caspase-3 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: is_induced_by
context: Caspase-3 is induced by Ivermectin. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. The directionality runs from Ivermectin toward Caspase-3, so Ivermectin is the active agent and Caspase-3 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: Caspase-3 由 Ivermectin 誘發。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。方向性從 Ivermectin 朝向 Caspase-3，因此 Ivermectin 是活性劑，Caspase-3 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: is_induced_by
context: Caspase-3 is induced by melittin. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. The directionality runs from melittin toward Caspase-3, so melittin is the active agent and Caspase-3 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: Caspase-3 由 melittin 誘導。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。蜂毒肽是蜜蜂毒液的主要勝肽，可透化膜並抑制致癌受體和檢查點。方向性從 melittin 朝向 Caspase-3，因此 melittin 是主動主體，Caspase-3 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: is_suppressed_by
context: Caspase-3 is suppressed by p38 MAPK. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. p38 MAPK is a stress-activated kinase that can both promote and suppress apoptosis depending on context, including by phosphorylating caspases. The directionality runs from p38 MAPK toward Caspase-3, so p38 MAPK is the active agent and Caspase-3 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context_zh_TW: Caspase-3 被 p38 MAPK 抑制。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。 p38 MAPK 是一種壓力激活激酶，可根據具體情況促進和抑制細胞凋亡，包括透過磷酸化半胱天冬酶。方向性從 p38 MAPK 朝向 Caspase-3，因此 p38 MAPK 是主動主體，Caspase-3 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: is_inhibited_by
context: Caspase-8 is inhibited by LYN. Caspase-8 is the initiator caspase of the extrinsic pathway and also gates the intrinsic pathway through Bid cleavage. The directionality runs from LYN toward Caspase-8, so LYN is the active agent and Caspase-8 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.

label: is_activated_by
context: Caspase-9 is activated by c-ABL. The directionality runs from c-ABL toward Caspase-9, so c-ABL is the active agent and Caspase-9 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: Caspase-9 由 c-ABL 活化。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。 c-ABL 是一種酪胺酸激酶，在基因毒性壓力下，可以磷酸化並活化 caspase-9 以促進細胞凋亡。方向性從 c-ABL 朝向 Caspase-9，因此 c-ABL 是主動主體，Caspase-9 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

The directionality runs from ERK toward Caspase-9, so ERK is the active agent and Caspase-9 the recipient of the effect. context_zh_TW: Caspase-9 被 ERK 抑制。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。 ERK1/2 是 RAS-RAF-MEK 級聯的末端效應子，磷酸化細胞核和細胞質標靶以驅動分裂。方向性從 ERK 朝向 Caspase-9，因此 ERK 是主動主體，Caspase-9 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: prevents_formation_of
context: Catalase, along with superoxide dismutase and azide, inhibits the oxidation of adrenaline to adrenochrome in stimulated-neutrophil experiments, confirming that reactive oxygen species mediate the conversion. Catalase scavenges hydrogen peroxide, which both is a reactive oxygen species in its own right and serves as the substrate for myeloperoxidase. Because hydrogen peroxide and myeloperoxidase-driven oxidation contribute to catecholamine oxidation alongside superoxide, catalase-mediated inhibition demonstrates that the full ROS cascade, not a single species, drives adrenaline-to-adrenochrome conversion in this system.
context_zh_TW: Catalase與superoxide dismutase及azide一同，在stimulated-neutrophil experiments中inhibits adrenaline oxidation to adrenochrome，confirming that reactive oxygen species mediate the conversion。Catalase scavenges hydrogen peroxide，而hydrogen peroxide本身既是一種reactive oxygen species，亦作為myeloperoxidase的substrate。由於hydrogen peroxide與myeloperoxidase-driven oxidation與superoxide一同contribute to catecholamine oxidation，catalase-mediated inhibition demonstrates that在此system中驅動adrenaline-to-adrenochrome conversion的是完整的ROS cascade，而非single species。

label: causes
context: Chemical memory causes Addiction by acting as the upstream trigger whose downstream consequence is the second entity's appearance or dysfunction. The mechanism typically involves oxidative, mitochondrial, or proteotoxic injury in the case of neurotoxins and pigments, or receptor blockade and cell loss in pharmacological and degenerative contexts. This causal relationship is clinically significant because it models or explains features of Parkinson's disease pathology and guides therapeutic targeting. A caveat is that in many of these links the causal claim is experimental, partial, or operates within a broader network of cofactors rather than as an isolated linear event.
context_zh_TW: Chemical memory 透過充當上游觸發器來導致 Addiction，其下游結果是第二個實體的出現或功能障礙。此機制通常涉及氧化、mitochondria1或neurotoxin和色素情況下的蛋白毒性損傷，或藥理學和退化環境中的受體阻斷和細胞損失。這種因果關係具有臨床意義，因為它模擬或解釋了 Parkinson's disease 病理特徵並指導治療目標。需要注意的是，在許多這些連結中，因果關係的主張是實驗性的、部分的，或是在更廣泛的輔助因子網絡中運作的，而不是作為一個孤立的線性事件。

label: contribute_to
context: Chronic SASP-driven MDSC expansion contributes to age-related inflammation by altering myeloid homeostasis and sustaining an immunosuppressive yet inflammatory milieu. While MDSCs are classically suppressive, their recruitment by SASP cytokines feeds the chronic activation characteristic of inflammaging. The relationship is part of the complex senescence-immune axis in which suppressive and inflammatory programs coexist. Confidence is moderate given the dual suppressive and pro-inflammatory nature of MDSCs, and further studies are needed to define their net contribution to age-related inflammation.
context_zh_TW: 慢性 SASP 驅動的 MDSC 擴張透過改變骨髓生成稳态並維持免疫抑制卻發炎的微環境，貢獻年齡相關發炎。儘管 MDSC 典型為抑制作用，其被 SASP 細胞激素招募餵養了 inflammaging 特徵的慢性活化。此貢獻將 SASP 連結到骨髓生成失衡，其中免疫抑制與發炎並存，加深年齡相關無菌發炎。它是衰老—免疫—發炎軸中的關鍵節點。

label: downregulates
context: Creatine down-regulates the expression of toll-like receptors, including TLR-2, TLR-3, TLR-4, and TLR-7, in a mouse macrophage cell line (RAW 254.7). This downregulation could reduce the ability to sense some infections in immunocompromised individuals, but TLR-4 downregulation may also alter Parkinson's disease pathology and inhibit neuronal death as the disease progresses. Creatine's influence on toll-like receptors is one component of its broader immunomodulatory effects, which also include altering cytokine production, possibly through the NF-kB signaling pathway, thereby affecting cytokines, receptors, and growth factors that shape immune responses and inflammation.
context_zh_TW: 肌酸會在小鼠巨噬細胞株（RAW 254.7）中下調toll-like受體的表現，包括TLR-2、TLR-3、TLR-4與TLR-7。此下調可能降低免疫功能低下個體感知某些感染的能力，但TLR-4的下調也可能改變帕金森氏症的病程，並在疾病進展過程中抑制神經元死亡。肌酸對toll-like受體的影響是其更廣泛免疫調節效應的組成部分之一；這些效應還包括改變細胞激素的產生（可能經由NF-kB訊息傳導途徑），從而影響塑造免疫反應與發炎的細胞激素、受體與生長因子。

label: decreases
context: Creatine supplementation has been reported to lower plasma homocysteine, an effect that may reduce cardiovascular disease risk. Because homocysteine is methylated back to methionine by enzymes that require the same methyl-donor pool (S-adenosyl methionine) used for creatine synthesis, supplying exogenous creatine spares methyl groups that would otherwise be consumed in endogenous creatine formation, thereby lowering homocysteine production. Studies in individuals adhering to vegan diets (who tend to have elevated homocysteine) reported that creatine supplementation reduced homocysteine levels and improved systemic microvascular endothelial function, supporting creatine's role in cardiovascular health beyond its direct effects on muscle bioenergetics.
context_zh_TW: 據報導，肌酸補充可降低血漿同半胱胺酸（homocysteine），此效果可能降低心血管疾病風險。由於同半胱胺酸需由酵素甲基化轉回甲硫胺酸（methionine），而這些酵素所需的甲基供體池（S-腺苷甲硫胺酸）與肌酸合成所用者相同，補充外源性肌酸可節省否則將消耗於內源性肌酸形成的甲基，從而降低同半胱胺酸的產生。針對遵循純素飲食（其同半胱胺酸往往較高）之個體的研究報告指出，肌酸補充可降低同半胱胺酸濃度並改善全身微血管內皮功能，支持肌酸在肌肉生物能量學直接效應之外對心血管健康的貢獻。

label: partially_regulates
context: DAF-2, the C. elegans insulin/IGF-1 receptor ortholog, partially regulates MXL-3 expression such that impaired insulin signaling leads to modest repression of mxl-3 transcription. This places MXL-3 downstream of the insulin-signaling axis that broadly controls metabolism and longevity in worms. The partial effect indicates that additional nutrient and developmental inputs also govern mxl-3, consistent with its role as a multifactorial repressor. The linkage reinforces the canonical insulin→autophagy/lipid regulatory cascade.
context_zh_TW: DAF-2 是線蟲的胰島素/IGF-1 受體同源物，部分調節 MXL-3 表現，使得胰島素信號受損會導致 mxl-3 轉錄的適度抑制。這將 MXL-3 置於廣泛控制線蟲代謝和長壽的胰島素信號軸下游。此部分效應表明額外的營養和發育輸入也控制 mxl-3，與其作為多因子抑制因子的角色一致。此連結強化了典型的胰島素→自噬/脂質調節級聯。

label: degrades_damaged
context: Damaged or dysfunctional peroxisomes are selectively targeted for autophagic degradation: they are tagged with specific ubiquitin chains (notably Lys48-linked), recognized by autophagic machinery including LC3-interacting proteins and ESCRT components, sealed into autophagosomes, and delivered to lysosomes for breakdown and recycling. This continuous turnover maintains a healthy peroxisome pool.
context_zh_TW: 受損或功能失常的過氧化物體會被選擇性地標記以進行自噬降解：先被特定泛素鏈（尤其是 Lys48 鏈）標記，再由含 LC3 交互作用蛋白與 ESCRT 成分的自噬機制辨識，包入自噬體後送至溶酶體分解回收。此持續週轉維持了健康的過氧化物體儲備。

label: binds_to
context: Dopamine binds to Neuromelanin through physicochemical affinity, forming a complex that modulates the local concentration or activity of the bound species. Mechanistically, Dopamine acts as the ligand or matrix and Neuromelanin as the binding partner, with the interaction often driven by catechol, quinone, or charge complementarity. This binding is significant because it can sequester toxins or metals, buffer neurotransmitters, or localize damage within pigmented neurons. A caveat is that the physiological magnitude, reversibility, and functional sequelae of the binding in vivo are not always fully quantified and may differ between intracellular and extracellular contexts.
context_zh_TW: Dopamine 透過物理化學親和力與 Neuromelanin 結合，形成複合物，調節結合物質的局部濃度或活性。從機制上講，Dopamine 作為配體或基質，Neuromelanin 作為結合伴侶，相互作用通常由兒茶酚、醌或電荷互補性驅動。這種結合很重要，因為它可以隔離毒素或金屬、緩衝 neurotransmitters 或定位色素神經元內的損傷。需要注意的是，體內結合的生理程度、可逆性和功能後遺症並不總是完全量化的，並且在細胞內和細胞外環境之間可能有所不同。

label: is_inhibited_by
context: EMT is inhibited by Ivermectin. Epithelial-mesenchymal transition is a developmental program co-opted by carcinomas to lose polarity, gain motility, and acquire stem-like properties for invasion. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. The directionality runs from Ivermectin toward EMT, so Ivermectin is the active agent and EMT the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context_zh_TW: EMT 被 Ivermectin 抑制。上皮-間質轉化是癌組織選擇的發育程序，可以失去極性、獲得運動性並獲得類似幹細胞的侵襲特性。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。方向性從 Ivermectin 朝向 EMT，因此 Ivermectin 是活性劑，EMT 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: stabilizes
context: ERK1_2 stabilizes Mcl-1. ERK1/2 are the terminal effectors of the RAS-RAF-MEK cascade that phosphorylate nuclear and cytoplasmic targets to drive division. Mcl-1 is a labile anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family protein whose rapid turnover makes it a frequent, difficult-to-target resistance determinant in cancer. The relationship is directional, with ERK1_2 acting as the operative agent upon Mcl-1 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: ERK1_2 穩定 Mcl-1。 ERK1/2 是 RAS-RAF-MEK 級聯的末端效應子，磷酸化細胞核和細胞質標靶以驅動分裂。 Mcl-1 是一種不穩定的抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 蛋白，其快速週轉使其成為癌症中常見的、難以靶向的抗藥性決定因素。這種關係是有方向的，ERK1_2 充當 Mcl-1 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: phosphorylates
context: ERK2 phosphorylates Bmf. ERK2 is the predominant isoform of the ERK1/2 MAPK pair that transduces RAS-RAF-MEK output to nuclear and cytoplasmic targets. Bmf is a cytoskeleton-sequestered BH3-only protein that enforces anoikis and restrains dissemination of detached cells. The relationship is directional, with ERK2 acting as the operative agent upon Bmf rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context_zh_TW: ERK2磷酸化Bmf。 ERK2 是 ERK1/2 MAPK 對的主要亞型，可將 RAS-RAF-MEK 輸出轉導至核子和細胞質標靶。 Bmf 是一種細胞骨架隔離的 BH3 蛋白，可增強失巢凋亡並抑制脫落細胞的傳播。這種關係是有方向的，ERK2 充當 Bmf 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: synergizes_with
context: Effective-resistance and PPR analyses place Ivermectin closest to the Cancer hub (R_eff 0.066, z −1.81; PPR at Cancer ranks Ivermectin #2); its synergy with Cisplatin (and Docetaxel, Paclitaxel) is recorded in the resistance-reversal out-star, though all drug claims carry low confidence (0.65–0.8) versus 0.95+ ontology edges.
context_zh_TW: 有效電阻與 PPR 分析把 Ivermectin 置於最接近 Cancer 樞紐（R_eff 0.066, z −1.81；Cancer 種子 PPR 把 Ivermectin 排 #2）；與 Cisplatin（及 Docetaxel、Paclitaxel）的協同記錄在抗藥性反轉出向之星，但所有藥物主張只帶低信度（0.65–0.8），而本體邊為 0.95 以上。

label: is_associated_with
context: Epidemiological studies reveal a significant and reciprocal association between melanoma and Parkinson's disease, with each disorder increasing the risk of the other. This reflects shared biology of pigment cells and genetic overlap in pigmentation genes. Melanocytes and neuromelanin-containing dopaminergic neurons share the melanogenesis enzyme toolkit and vulnerability to oxidative damage.
context_zh_TW: 流行病學研究顯示黑色素瘤與帕金森氏症之間存在顯著且互惠的關聯，每一種疾病都會增加另一種疾病的風險。這反映了色素細胞的共同生物學以及色素沉著基因的遺傳重疊。黑色素細胞與含神經黑色素的多巴胺神經元共享黑色素生成酶工具組，並對氧化損傷具有共同脆弱性。

label: activates
context: Fenbendazole activates p53. Fenbendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic under investigation for anticancer effects via microtubule interference, glycolysis suppression, and p53 activation. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. The relationship is directional, with Fenbendazole acting as the operative agent upon p53 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: Fenbendazole 激活 p53。 Fenbendazole 是一種苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，正在研究透過微管幹擾、糖酵解抑制和 p53 活化來發揮抗癌作用。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。這種關係是有方向的，Fenbendazole 充當 p53 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: induces
context: Fenbendazole induces Apoptosis. Fenbendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic under investigation for anticancer effects via microtubule interference, glycolysis suppression, and p53 activation. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The relationship is directional, with Fenbendazole acting as the operative agent upon Apoptosis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: Fenbendazole 誘發 Apoptosis。 Fenbendazole 是一種苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，正在研究透過微管幹擾、糖酵解抑制和 p53 活化來發揮抗癌作用。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。這種關係是有方向的，Fenbendazole 充當 Apoptosis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: interferes_with
context: Fenbendazole interferes with Microtubule. Fenbendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic under investigation for anticancer effects via microtubule interference, glycolysis suppression, and p53 activation. Microtubules are dynamic cytoskeletal polymers essential for mitosis and targeted by taxanes and benzimidazoles in cancer therapy. The relationship is directional, with Fenbendazole acting as the operative agent upon Microtubule rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context_zh_TW: Fenbendazole 幹擾 Microtubule。 Fenbendazole 是一種苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，正在研究透過微管幹擾、糖酵解抑制和 p53 活化來發揮抗癌作用。 Microtubules 是有絲分裂所必需的動態細胞骨架聚合物，是癌症治療中紫杉烷類和苯並咪唑類藥物的標靶。這種關係是有方向的，Fenbendazole 充當Microtubule 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: suppresses
context: Fenbendazole suppresses Glycolysis. Fenbendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic under investigation for anticancer effects via microtubule interference, glycolysis suppression, and p53 activation. Glycolysis is the cytosolic catabolism of glucose to pyruvate and, under the Warburg phenotype, onward to lactate, yielding rapid ATP and biosynthetic intermediates. The relationship is directional, with Fenbendazole acting as the operative agent upon Glycolysis rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context_zh_TW: Fenbendazole 抑制 Glycolysis。 Fenbendazole 是一種苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，正在研究透過微管幹擾、糖酵解抑制和 p53 活化來發揮抗癌作用。 Glycolysis 是葡萄糖到丙酮酸的胞質分解代謝，並在 Warburg 表型下進一步分解為乳酸，快速產生 ATP 和生物合成中間體。這種關係是有方向的，Fenbendazole 充當 Glycolysis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: activates
context: Fisetin increases the catalytic activity of human SIRT1 at least in vitro, one of several reported pleiotropic activities (alongside PI3K/Akt/mTOR inhibition and topoisomerase inhibition) that may contribute to its healthspan effects beyond senescent-cell clearance.
context_zh_TW: 至少在體外實驗中，Fisetin 能提升人類 SIRT1 的催化活性。這是其多效性作用之一（與抑制 PI3K/Akt/mTOR 及 topoisomerase 並列），可能在清除衰老細胞之外，對健康壽命的延長有所貢獻。

label: activates_via_k_type
context: Fisetin, a flavonol, activates SIRT1 via the K-type allosteric mechanism and is also a well-characterized senolytic in the wiki; it increases yeast replicative lifespan by ~33% in the source literature. Its SIRT1 activation is part of the natural-polyphenol STAC cluster.
context_zh_TW: Fisetin 是一種黄酮醇，透過 K 型別構機制活化 SIRT1，同時也是 wiki 中特徵明確的 senolytic；在來源文獻中可將酵母複製壽命延長約 33%。其 SIRT1 活化屬於天然多酚類 STAC 群集。

label: binds
context: Gossypol binds Bcl-2. Gossypol is a natural BH3-mimetic derived from cottonseed that, unusually, also engages Mcl-1. Bcl-2 is the founding anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family member that preserves mitochondrial outer-membrane integrity and was the first apoptosis regulator linked to cancer. The relationship is directional, with Gossypol acting as the operative agent upon Bcl-2 rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context_zh_TW: Gossypol 綁定 Bcl-2。 Gossypol 是一種從棉籽中提取的天然 BH3 模擬物，不同尋常的是，它也參與 Mcl-1。 Bcl-2 是第一個抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 成員，可保護粒線體外膜的完整性，並且是第一個與癌症相關的細胞凋亡調節因子。這種關係是有方向的，Gossypol 充當 Bcl-2 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: binds
context: Gossypol binds Mcl-1. Gossypol is a natural BH3-mimetic derived from cottonseed that, unusually, also engages Mcl-1. Mcl-1 is a labile anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family protein whose rapid turnover makes it a frequent, difficult-to-target resistance determinant in cancer. The relationship is directional, with Gossypol acting as the operative agent upon Mcl-1 rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context_zh_TW: Gossypol 綁定 Mcl-1。 Gossypol 是一種從棉籽中提取的天然 BH3 模擬物，不同尋常的是，它也參與 Mcl-1。 Mcl-1 是一種不穩定的抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 蛋白，其快速週轉使其成為癌症中常見的、難以靶向的抗藥性決定因素。這種關係是有方向的，Gossypol 充當 Mcl-1 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: restores
context: Gossypol restores Apoptosis. Gossypol is a natural BH3-mimetic derived from cottonseed that, unusually, also engages Mcl-1. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The relationship is directional, with Gossypol acting as the operative agent upon Apoptosis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: Gossypol 恢復 Apoptosis。 Gossypol 是一種從棉籽中提取的天然 BH3 模擬物，不同尋常的是，它也參與 Mcl-1。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。這種關係是有方向的，Gossypol 充當 Apoptosis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: is_targeted_by
context: HER2 is targeted by melittin. HER2 (ERBB2) is a receptor tyrosine kinase that, when amplified, drives aggressive breast cancer and is the target of trastuzumab. Melittin is the principal peptide of honeybee venom that permeabilizes membranes and suppresses oncogenic receptors and checkpoints. The directionality runs from melittin toward HER2, so melittin is the active agent and HER2 the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
context_zh_TW: HER2 是 melittin 的目標。 HER2 (ERBB2) 是一種受體酪胺酸激酶，在擴增時會驅動攻擊性 Breast Cancer，並且是 trastuzumab 的目標。蜂毒肽是蜜蜂毒液的主要勝肽，可透化膜並抑制致癌受體和檢查點。方向性從 melittin 向 HER2，因此 melittin 是活性劑，HER2 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

label: catalyzes_oxidation_of
context: Hemoglobin, which is abundant in erythrocytes, can catalyze the oxidation of epinephrine to adrenochrome in blood. This is more of a chemical reaction occurring in the presence of oxygen or radicals than active production by red blood cells themselves, and it involves hemoglobin-catalyzed peroxidation/oxidation processes. As a result, adrenochrome can form in blood as a reactant or byproduct, but red blood cells do not actively produce it, since erythrocytes lack the organelles and major oxidative enzymes found in neutrophils or adrenal cells.
context_zh_TW: Hemoglobin在erythrocytes中含量豐富，能在血液中催化epinephrine氧化為adrenochrome。這更像是在氧氣或自由基存在下發生的化學反應，而非red blood cells本身主動生成的產物，且涉及hemoglobin所催化的peroxidation/oxidation過程。因此，adrenochrome可在血液中作為反應物或副產物形成，但red blood cells並不主動生成它，因為erythrocytes缺乏neutrophils或adrenal cells所具有的胞器與主要氧化酶。

label: phosphorylates
context: IKK phosphorylates Bad. IKK is the kinase complex that phosphorylates I-kappaB to free NF-kappaB, linking upstream inflammatory signals to survival transcription. Bad is a BH3-only protein whose survival-factor-responsive phosphorylation controls its binding to Bcl-xL/Bcl-w and thereby the death threshold. The relationship is directional, with IKK acting as the operative agent upon Bad rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context_zh_TW: IKK 磷酸化Bad。 IKK 是將 I-kappaB 磷酸化為遊離 NF-kappaB 的激酶複合物，將上游發炎訊號與生存轉錄聯繫起來。 Bad 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，其生存因子反應性磷酸化控制其與 Bcl-xL/Bcl-w 的結合，從而控制死亡閾值。這種關係是有方向的，IKK 充當 Bad 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: phosphorylates
context: IKK phosphorylates Puma. IKK is the kinase complex that phosphorylates I-kappaB to free NF-kappaB, linking upstream inflammatory signals to survival transcription. Puma is a p53-inducible BH3-only protein that binds and neutralizes essentially all anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 relatives to license mitochondrial death. The relationship is directional, with IKK acting as the operative agent upon Puma rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context_zh_TW: IKK 磷酸化Puma。 IKK 是將 I-kappaB 磷酸化為遊離 NF-kappaB 的激酶複合物，將上游發炎訊號與生存轉錄聯繫起來。 Puma 是一種 p53 誘導型 BH3 蛋白，可結合並中和幾乎所有抗凋亡 Bcl-2 相關蛋白，從而允許粒線體死亡。這種關係是有方向的，IKK 充當 Puma 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: associated_with
context: In Parkinson's Disease, altered neuromelanin quality rather than quantity may reflect shifted melanogenic enzyme activity, contributing to Oxidative Stress and Alpha-Synuclein Aggregation. Genetic variation and expression of tyrosinase-family enzymes influence pigmentation phenotypes and the melanoma-PD association. The enzyme is a reference point for comparing cutaneous and neural melanin.
context_zh_TW: 在 Parkinson's Disease 中，neuromelanin 品質的改變（而非數量）可能反映了黑色素生成酶活性的偏移，導致 Oxidative Stress 和 Alpha-Synuclein Aggregation。tyrosinase 家族酶的遺傳變異和表達影響色素表現型以及黑色素瘤-PD 的關聯。該酶是比較皮膚和神經黑色素的參考點。

label: promotes
context: In cancer, IKKepsilon overexpression promotes proliferation and epithelial-mesenchymal transition through NF-kB- and IRF-dependent target genes. It is frequently amplified or overexpressed in subsets of breast, ovarian, and lung tumors. IKKepsilon-driven EMT supports the invasive and metastatic phenotype.
context_zh_TW: 在癌症中，IKKepsilon 的過度表現透過 NF-kB 與 IRF 依賴的目標基因促進增殖與上皮間質轉化。它在乳癌、卵巢癌與肺癌亞型中常被擴增或過度表現。IKKepsilon 驅動的 EMT 支持侵襲與轉移性表型。

label: is_associated_with
context: In cancer, MKP-3 can be co-opted to sustain Bcl-2 abundance, contributing to cancer cell survival under stress and evasion of chemotherapy-induced apoptosis. MKP-3 expression is explored as a biomarker of MAPK pathway activity and treatment response. The context-dependent role of MKP-3 makes it a relevant oncology target.
context_zh_TW: 在癌症中，MKP-3 可能被利用以維持 Bcl-2 的豐度，促成癌細胞在壓力下的存活與逃避化療誘導的細胞凋亡。MKP-3 表現被探索作為 MAPK 途徑活性與治療反應的生物標記。MKP-3 的情境依賴角色使其成為相關的腫瘤學靶點。

label: inhibits_sirt1_from_deacetylating
context: In hepatocarcinoma, p33ING1b binds SIRT1 and blocks its ability to deacetylate p53, thereby preserving p53's transcriptional activity, including repression of α-fetoprotein (AFP). This relieves SIRT1-mediated inhibition of p53 tumor suppression, restoring the p53-dependent checkpoint in liver cancer cells. Directionally, p33ING1b antagonizes SIRT1 at the p53 node. The interaction reveals a tissue-specific brake on SIRT1's pro-survival, potentially oncogenic action, and is consistent with p33ING1b's function as a tumor suppressor that cooperates with p53, highlighting how accessory proteins can redirect sirtuin activity toward anti-tumor outcomes.

label: suppresses
context: In lung and colon cancer models, deletion or silencing of ASK1 accelerates KRAS-driven tumorigenesis, supporting a tumor-suppressive function. The relationship is context-dependent, since persistent ASK1 activation may also drive inflammation-associated tumor promotion.

label: restores
context: In mitochondria-depleted senescent cells, acetate supplementation is converted into acetyl-CoA by ACSS2, restoring histone acetylation (including H3K27ac) and partially rescuing the mitochondrial-dependent SASP programme (IL6, IL8, IL1B, CCL2) without affecting p16/p21 cell-cycle regulators. This activation contributes to the reported healing and neuroprotective effects of ketogenic regimens in epilepsy, neurodegeneration, and metabolic disease. The diet thus provides a non-fasting nutritional strategy to recruit autophagic clearance.
context_zh_TW: 生酮飲食以高脂肪、極低碳水化合物攝取為特徵，透過降低胰島素和葡萄糖、同時升高酮體和 AMPK 活性來活化自噬。朝脂肪酸氧化和輕度能量壓力的代謝轉移模擬了熱量限制的某些層面，運用了自噬機械。此活化促成生酮飲食在癲癇、神經退化和代謝疾病中報告的修復和神經保護效應。因此此飲食提供了一種非禁食的營養策略，以招募自噬性清除。

label: is_inhibited_by
context: Lung Cancer is inhibited by Ivermectin. Lung cancer, especially non-small-cell lung cancer, is the leading cause of cancer death and is frequently driven by EGFR or KRAS alterations. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. The directionality runs from Ivermectin toward Lung Cancer, so Ivermectin is the active agent and Lung Cancer the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context_zh_TW: Lung Cancer 被 Ivermectin 抑制。 Lung Cancer，尤其是非小細胞Lung Cancer，是癌症死亡的主要原因，並且經常由EGFR或KRAS改變驅動。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。方向性從 Ivermectin 朝向 Lung Cancer，因此 Ivermectin 是活性劑，Lung Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: biogenesis_regulated_by
context: Lysosome biogenesis is regulated by CDK4/6 such that inhibition of these kinases leads to nuclear retention of TFEB and enhanced expression of lysosomal genes. During active proliferation, CDK4/6-mediated phosphorylation of TFEB restrains lysosomal expansion; when CDK4/6 is blocked, the degradative network is unleashed. This regulation connects cell-cycle control to organelle homeostasis and may contribute to the metabolic effects of CDK4/6 inhibitors used in cancer therapy. It reveals lysosomal biogenesis as a cell-cycle-responsive process.
context_zh_TW: 溶酶體生物發生受 CDK4/6 調節：抑制這些激酶會導致 TFEB 的核保留以及溶酶體基因表現增強。在活躍增殖期間，CDK4/6 介導的 TFEB 磷酸化約束溶酶體擴張；當 CDK4/6 被阻斷時，降解網絡隨之釋放。此調節將細胞週期控制連結到胞器恆定性，並可能促成用於癌症治療的 CDK4/6 抑制劑的代謝效應。它揭示溶酶體生物發生是一種對細胞週期有反應的過程。

label: promotes
context: MC1R agonists such as alpha-MSH analogs and Melanocortins are being explored preclinically for Neuroprotection. They reduce microglial activation and improve mitochondrial function. MC1R signaling is therefore a therapeutic target in neurodegeneration.
context_zh_TW: MC1R 致效劑（例如 alpha-MSH 類似物和 Melanocortins）正在臨床前階段被探索用於 Neuroprotection。它們減少 microglial 活化並改善粒線體功能。因此 MC1R 信號傳導是神經退化中的治療靶點。

label: is_downregulated_by
context: MDM2 is downregulated by Fenbendazole. MDM2 is the principal E3 ubiquitin ligase and transcriptional antagonist that keeps p53 quiescent in unstressed cells. Fenbendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic under investigation for anticancer effects via microtubule interference, glycolysis suppression, and p53 activation. The directionality runs from Fenbendazole toward MDM2, so Fenbendazole is the active agent and MDM2 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context_zh_TW: MDM2 被 Fenbendazole 下調。 MDM2 是主要的 E3 泛素連接酶和轉錄拮抗劑，可使 p53 在未受壓力的細胞中保持靜止狀態。 Fenbendazole 是一種苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，正在研究透過微管幹擾、糖酵解抑制和 p53 活化來發揮抗癌作用。方向性從 Fenbendazole 向 MDM2，因此 Fenbendazole 是活性劑，MDM2 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: is_associated_with
context: MITF amplification drives proliferation in melanoma, and MITF-M, an isoform enriched in melanoma, correlates strongly with expression of lysosomal genes containing CLEAR elements. MITF is a lineage-defining transcription factor for melanocytes. It contributes to the proliferative and lysosomal program of melanoma cells.
context_zh_TW: MITF 擴增驅動黑色素瘤中的增殖，而富含於黑色素瘤的 MITF-M 異構體與含有 CLEAR 元件的溶酶體基因表現密切相關。MITF 是黑色素細胞的譜系定義轉錄因子。它促成黑色素瘤細胞的增殖與溶酶體程式。

label: promotes
context: MMP promotes Angiogenesis. Matrix metalloproteinases degrade extracellular-matrix components and thereby enable invasion, angiogenesis, and microenvironment remodeling. Angiogenesis is the sprouting of new vessels from preexisting vasculature that tumors must recruit to grow beyond a few millimeters and to metastasize. The relationship is directional, with MMP acting as the operative agent upon Angiogenesis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: MMP 促進 Angiogenesis。基質金屬蛋白酶降解細胞外基質成分，從而實現侵襲、血管生成和微環境重塑。是指從先前存在的脈管系統長出新血管，腫瘤必須招募新血管才能生長超過幾毫米並發生轉移。這種關係是有方向的，MMP 充當 Angiogenesis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: is_inhibited_by
context: Melittin exerts antitumoral effects in ovarian cancer cells by inhibiting the JAK2/STAT3 axis. This natural-product agent is studied to overcome resistance and re-sensitize tumors to standard cytotoxic therapy. Melittin thereby represents a candidate repurposed agent against ovarian cancer.
context_zh_TW: Melittin 透過抑制 JAK2/STAT3 軸，在卵巢癌細胞中發揮抗腫瘤效應。這種天然產物製劑被研究用於克服抗性並使腫瘤對標準細胞毒性療法重新敏感化。因此 Melittin 是對抗卵巢癌的候選再利用製劑。

label: is_inhibited_by
context: Melittin, a component of honeybee venom, has demonstrated antitumoral effects in melanoma by inhibiting the MAPK signaling pathway. It shows higher cytotoxic potency in cancer cells than in normal cells. Melittin is therefore studied as a natural-product agent against melanoma.
context_zh_TW: Melittin 是蜂毒的一種成分，透過抑制 MAPK 訊號傳導途徑，在黑色素瘤中顯示出抗腫瘤效應。它對癌細胞的細胞毒性效力高於正常細胞。因此 Melittin 被研究作為對抗黑色素瘤的天然產物製劑。

label: is_inhibited_by
context: Metabolic Reprogramming is inhibited by Fenbendazole. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. Fenbendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic under investigation for anticancer effects via microtubule interference, glycolysis suppression, and p53 activation. The directionality runs from Fenbendazole toward Metabolic Reprogramming, so Fenbendazole is the active agent and Metabolic Reprogramming the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context_zh_TW: Metabolic Reprogramming 被 Fenbendazole 抑制。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。 Fenbendazole 是一種苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，正在研究透過微管幹擾、糖酵解抑制和 p53 活化來發揮抗癌作用。方向性從 Fenbendazole 朝向 Metabolic Reprogramming，因此 Fenbendazole 是主動主體，Metabolic Reprogramming 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: reverses
context: Metformin reverses the pro-inflammatory Th17 CD4+ T cell profile toward a more juvenile, balanced phenotype, an effect attributed to enhancement of autophagic flux within lymphocytes. By activating AMPK and inducing autophagy, metformin reduces the mitochondrial and metabolic perturbations that favor pathogenic Th17 differentiation. This phenotypic rebalancing may contribute to the drug's anti-inflammatory and immune-modulatory benefits beyond glycemic control. The observation links metformin's autophagy-inducing capacity to attenuation of age- and inflammation-associated T cell skewing.
context_zh_TW: Metformin 將促發炎的 Th17 CD4+ T 細胞譜系逆轉為更年輕、平衡的表型，此效應歸因於淋巴細胞內自噬流的增強。透過活化 AMPK 和誘導自噬，metformin 減少有利於致病性 Th17 分化的粒線體和代謝擾動。這種表型再平衡可能有助於該藥物超越血糖控制之外的抗發炎和免疫調節益處。此觀察將 metformin 誘導自噬的能力與減緩年齡和發炎相關的 T 細胞偏移聯繫起來。

label: reverses
context: Metformin, a widely used anti-diabetic drug, has shown measurable reversal of epigenetic clock estimates in some studies, reducing the DNA methylation-predicted age of tissues relative to chronological age. By demonstrating that biological age, as measured by the methylation state of selected CpG sites, can decrease in response to intervention, these findings support the notion that biological aging is modifiable. Epigenetic clocks have consequently become standard endpoints for evaluating longevity interventions such as metformin in clinical trials.
context_zh_TW: Metformin 是一種廣泛使用的抗糖尿病藥物，在一些研究中顯示出可測量的表觀遺傳時鐘估計逆轉，降低了 DNA 甲基化預測的組織相對於實際年齡的年齡。透過證明生物年齡（透過選定 CpG 位點的甲基化狀態測量）可以響應幹預而降低，這些發現支持了生物老化是可改變的觀點。因此，表觀遺傳時鐘已成為評估臨床試驗中二甲雙胍等長壽幹預措施的標準終點。

label: is_driven_by
context: Multidrug Resistance is driven by Akt. Multidrug resistance is the cross-resistance of tumors to structurally unrelated drugs, most classically mediated by ATP-dependent efflux pumps. Akt is a serine/threonine kinase that phosphorylates a broad panel of substrates to promote growth, glycolysis, and suppression of apoptosis. The directionality runs from Akt toward Multidrug Resistance, so Akt is the active agent and Multidrug Resistance the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: Multidrug Resistance 由 Akt 驅動。 Multidrug Resistance是腫瘤對結構上不相關的藥物的交叉抗藥性，最經典的是由ATP依賴性外排泵介導的。 Akt 是一種絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶，可磷酸化多種底物，以促進生長、糖解和抑制細胞凋亡。方向性從 Akt 向 Multidrug Resistance 延伸，因此 Akt 是活性劑，Multidrug Resistance 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: is_driven_by
context: Multidrug Resistance is driven by EGFR. Multidrug resistance is the cross-resistance of tumors to structurally unrelated drugs, most classically mediated by ATP-dependent efflux pumps. EGFR is a receptor tyrosine kinase whose activating mutations and overexpression couple extracellular cues to proliferative and survival signaling. The directionality runs from EGFR toward Multidrug Resistance, so EGFR is the active agent and Multidrug Resistance the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: Multidrug Resistance由EGFR驅動。 Multidrug Resistance是腫瘤對結構上不相關的藥物的交叉抗藥性，最經典的是由ATP依賴性外排泵介導的。 EGFR 是一種受體酪胺酸激酶，其活化突變和過度表現將細胞外訊號與增殖和生存訊號傳導結合。方向性從 EGFR 延伸到 Multidrug Resistance，因此 EGFR 是活性劑，Multidrug Resistance是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: is_driven_by
context: Multidrug Resistance is driven by NFκB. Multidrug resistance is the cross-resistance of tumors to structurally unrelated drugs, most classically mediated by ATP-dependent efflux pumps. NF-kappaB is a pleiotropic transcription factor that, when constitutively active, drives proliferation, survival, inflammation, and therapy resistance. The directionality runs from NFκB toward Multidrug Resistance, so NFκB is the active agent and Multidrug Resistance the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: Multidrug Resistance由NFκB驅動。 Multidrug Resistance是腫瘤對結構上不相關的藥物的交叉抗藥性，最經典的是由ATP依賴性外排泵介導的。 NF-kappaB 是一種多效性轉錄因子，當其持續活躍時，可驅動增殖、存活、發炎和治療抵抗。其方向性是從NFκB向Multidrug Resistance延伸，因此NFκB是活性劑，也是效應的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: is_reversed_by
context: Multidrug Resistance is reversed by Ivermectin. Multidrug resistance is the cross-resistance of tumors to structurally unrelated drugs, most classically mediated by ATP-dependent efflux pumps. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. The directionality runs from Ivermectin toward Multidrug Resistance, so Ivermectin is the active agent and Multidrug Resistance the recipient of the effect.
