This anti-apoptotic action complements honokiol's mitochondrial preservation and pro-survival Akt signaling, contributing to its broad neuroprotective profile against amyloid toxicity and other neurodegenerative insults.
context_zh_TW: 厚朴酚抑制 caspase-3 活性，是其對抗 β-類澱粉誘發之神經元死亡的保護作用之一。在以 Aβ 刺激的 PC12 神經元培養中，厚朴酚的神經保護作用與活性氧物質產生減少、細胞內鈣離子升高受抑制，以及執行型 caspase-3 受抑制相關，因而限制細胞凋亡性死亡。此抗凋亡作用與厚朴酚的粒線體保存及促存活 Akt 訊息傳導相輔相成，共同構成其對類澱粉毒性及其他神經退化性傷害的廣泛神經保護特性。

label: inhibits
context: Honokiol inhibits cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) expression, contributing to its anti-inflammatory activity. In RAW264.7 macrophage-like cells stimulated with Porphyromonas gingivalis fimbriae, honokiol reduced COX-2 expression alongside inhibition of NF-kappaB activation, and it is generally more potent in this regard than the structurally related eugenol and bis-eugenol. By limiting COX-2-driven prostanoid production, honokiol dampens inflammation and inflammatory pain signaling, complementing its inhibition of TNF-alpha, nitric oxide, and NF-kappaB.
context_zh_TW: 厚朴酚抑制環氧合酶-2（COX-2）的表現，構成其抗發炎活性的一部分。在以牙齦紫單胞菌（Porphyromonas gingivalis）菌毛刺激的 RAW264.7 巨噬細胞樣細胞中，厚朴酚在抑制 NF-kappaB 活化的同時降低了 COX-2 表現，且在這方面通常比結構相關的丁香酚與雙丁香酚更有效。藉由限制 COX-2 驅動的前列腺素類產生，厚朴酚能抑制發炎與發炎性疼痛訊號，並與其對 TNF-alpha、一氧化氮及 NF-kappaB 的抑制作用相輔相成。

label: inhibits
context: Honokiol inhibits neutrophil infiltration and reactive oxygen species production after cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury, as measured by luminol-amplified chemiluminescence in neutrophils. By reducing the accumulation and oxidative burst of neutrophils at the site of ischemic injury, honokiol limits secondary tissue damage following stroke. This anti-inflammatory action is complemented by inhibition of glial NF-kappaB activation and cytokine production, together contributing to honokiol's ability to reduce infarct volume in focal cerebral ischemia-reperfusion models.
context_zh_TW: 厚朴酚抑制腦缺血再灌注損傷後的中性球浸潤與活性氧物質產生（以嗜中性球的魯米諾增強化學發光測定）。透過減少缺血損傷部位中性球的累積與氧化爆發，厚朴酚限制了中風後的繼發性組織損傷。此抗發炎作用與膠質細胞 NF-kappaB 活化及細胞激素產生的抑制相輔相成，共同促成厚朴酚在局部腦缺血再灌注模型中縮小梗塞體積的能力。

label: inhibits
context: Honokiol is a potent inhibitor of arterial thrombosis, acting through endothelial cell protection and stimulation of prostacyclin production. This antithrombotic effect is a safety consideration: caution is advised in coagulopathic patients, those with hemorrhagic stroke or hemorrhagic transformation after ischemic stroke, patients on warfarin or low-molecular-weight heparin, and individuals with clotting disorders such as hemophilia or von Willebrand's deficiency. The bleeding risk must be weighed against honokiol's neuroprotective and anti-inflammatory benefits before clinical use.
context_zh_TW: 厚朴酚是動脈血栓的強效抑制劑，其作用機制為保護內皮細胞並刺激前列環素生成。此抗血栓作用是安全考量點：凝血功能異常病患、出血性中風或缺血性中風後出血性轉化的病患、服用華法林或低分子量肝素的病患，以及患有血友病或 von Willebrand 因子缺乏等凝血疾病者，均應謹慎使用。臨床使用前必須權衡出血風險與厚朴酚的神經保護及抗發炎效益。

label: inhibits
context: Honokiol is reported to inhibit mTOR signaling, contributing to its anti-proliferative and pro-autophagic effects. This complements its other mechanisms including GABA-A modulation, NMDA inhibition, and NF-kB suppression.
context_zh_TW: 據報導 Honokiol 會抑制 mTOR 信號，有助於其抗增殖和促自噬作用。這與其 GABA-A 調節、NMDA 抑制和 NF-kB 抑制等其他機制互補。

label: preserves
context: Honokiol preserves mitochondrial function as part of its neuroprotective mechanism. In preclinical ischemia models, honokiol maintained enzymatic mitochondrial function alongside Na+/K+-ATPase activity, and it protects neurons by preventing glucose- and ROS-mediated damage while preserving mitochondrial integrity. Honokiol also reduces beta-amyloid-induced neuronal death through decreased ROS production, suppressed intracellular calcium elevation, and inhibition of caspase-3 activity. These effects collectively position mitochondrial preservation and reduced oxidative stress as core components of honokiol's cytoprotective profile.
context_zh_TW: 厚朴酚維持粒線體功能，此為其神經保護機制的一部分。在臨床前缺血模型中，厚朴酚在維持 Na+/K+-ATPase 活性的同時保持了粒線體的酶功能，並透過防止葡萄糖及 ROS 介導的損傷、同時維持粒線體完整性來保護神經元。厚朴酚也透過降低 ROS 產生、抑制細胞內鈣離子升高及抑制 caspase-3 活性，減少 β-類澱粉誘發的神經元死亡。這些效應共同使粒線體保存與氧化壓力降低成為厚朴酚細胞保護特性的核心組成。

label: damages
context: Hypochlorous acid (HOCl) is a potent antimicrobial oxidant produced by myeloperoxidase in the neutrophil halogenation cycle. It damages microbial proteins, lipids, and DNA, and it is central to the oxidative burst that kills pathogens in phagosomes. When HOCl is released in excess at sites of inflammation, it also oxidizes host biomolecules, generating markers such as 3-chlorotyrosine and 3-nitrotyrosine, and modifying lipids and lipoproteins, which links MPO activity to tissue injury, atherosclerosis, and chronic inflammatory disease.
context_zh_TW: Hypochlorous acid（HOCl）是myeloperoxidase在neutrophil halogenation cycle中產生的potent antimicrobial oxidant。它damages microbial proteins、lipids與DNA，並是kill pathogens in phagosomes的oxidative burst核心。當HOCl在inflammation部位excess released時，它亦oxidizes host biomolecules，generating markers such as 3-chlorotyrosine與3-nitrotyrosine，並modifying lipids與lipoproteins，這將MPO activity與tissue injury、atherosclerosis及chronic inflammatory disease聯繫起來。

label: mediates_degradation_of
context: IDO1 is controlled post-translationally: phosphorylation of its ITIM motifs recruits SOCS3, leading to ubiquitination and degradation of IDO1 as a negative feedback mechanism. This degradation pathway limits IDO1 activity and terminates its immunosuppressive effects, representing a key regulatory checkpoint. IDO1 can also mediate non-enzymatic signaling such as PI3K activation. IDO2 may compete for heme and act as a negative regulator in some settings. These regulatory layers are important for therapeutic targeting of IDO1, as they influence the durability and magnitude of tryptophan depletion and kynurenine production in the tumor microenvironment.
context_zh_TW: IDO1在翻譯後被控制：其ITIM基序的磷酸化招募SOCS3，導致IDO1的泛素化和降解，作為負反饋機制。這種降解途徑限制IDO1活性並終止其免疫抑製作用，代表一個關鍵的調節檢查點。IDO1還可以介導非酶信號，如PI3K激活。IDO2可能在某些情況下競爭血紅素並作為負調節因子。這些調節層對於IDO1的治療靶向很重要，因為它們影響腫瘤微環境中色氨酸耗竭和犬尿氨酸產生的持久性和幅度。

label: is_composed_of
context: IKKbeta (IKK2) is the principal catalytic subunit of the IKK complex activated by inflammatory stimuli such as TNF-alpha and IL-1. It is phosphorylated by TAK1 at Ser177/Ser181 during canonical activation. IKKbeta is frequently required for tumor initiation and maintenance in cancer models.
context_zh_TW: IKKbeta（IKK2）是 IKK 複合體的主要催化亞基，由 TNF-alpha 和 IL-1 等發炎刺激激活。在經典激活期間，它會被 TAK1 在 Ser177/Ser181 磷酸化。IKKbeta 在癌症模型中常為腫瘤起始與維持所需。

label: is_associated_with
context: IKKepsilon is closely related to TBK1, its closest paralog, with which it shares overlapping substrates in the type I interferon response including IRF3 and IRF7. Both kinases contribute to innate antiviral immunity and oncogenic signaling. Their overlapping functions make them jointly attractive therapeutic targets.
context_zh_TW: IKKepsilon 與其最接近的旁系同源基因 TBK1 密切相關，兩者在第一型干擾素反應中共享重疊的受質，包括 IRF3 和 IRF7。兩種激酶都參與先天抗病毒免疫與致癌性訊號傳導。其重疊功能使它們共同成為具吸引力的治療靶點。

label: phosphorylates
context: IKKepsilon phosphorylates the inhibitor of apoptosis protein XIAP, marking it for degradation. This relieves caspase suppression and lowers the threshold for apoptosis. The XIAP-degradation function couples antiviral death signaling to tumor cell vulnerability.
context_zh_TW: IKKepsilon 磷酸化凋亡抑制蛋白 XIAP，標記其進行降解。這會解除對半胱天冬酶的抑制，並降低細胞凋亡的閾值。XIAP 降解功能將抗病毒死亡訊號與腫瘤細胞的脆弱性連結起來。

label: shortens
context: In a study of three groups of mice fed a caloric restriction (CR) diet, a regular diet, or a CR diet high in AGEs, CR mice lived longer than regular or CR-high mice, with median and maximal survival increased by 13.2% and 6%, respectively. Survival in CR-high mice was shorter than in regular-fed mice, and the CR-high group showed significantly increased oxidative stress and accelerated aging-related cardiovascular and renal disease. High dietary AGEs thus compete with the benefits of caloric restriction, indicating that the AGE content of the diet modulates lifespan.
context_zh_TW: 在一項針對三組小鼠的研究中，分別餵食熱量限制（CR）飲食、一般飲食或高 AGE 的 CR 飲食，CR 小鼠比一般或 CR-高 AGE 小鼠活得更久，中位與最大存活分別增加 13.2% 與 6%。CR-高 AGE 小鼠的存活短於一般飲食小鼠，且 CR-高 AGE 組顯示氧化壓力顯著增加與加速老化的心血管及腎臟疾病。因此，高飲食性 AGE 與熱量限制的好處相抗衡，顯示飲食的 AGE 含量會調節壽命。

label: induces_caspase_independent_death_in
context: In anucleate platelets, AGK2 (with sirtinol and EX-527) induces apoptosis-like changes including phosphatidylserine exposure, ROS generation, and mitochondrial depolarization, driven by the p53-Bax axis and calpain with no caspase-3 activation. This highlights that sirtuin inhibition triggers caspase-independent death in some cell types.
context_zh_TW: 在無核的血小板中，AGK2（連同 sirtinol 和 EX-527）誘導凋亡樣變化，包括磷脂醯絲胺酸暴露、ROS 生成和粒線體去極化，由 p53–Bax 軸和 calpain 驅動，且無 caspase-3 活化。這凸顯 sirtuin 抑制在某些細胞類型中會觸發不依賴 caspase 的死亡。

label: is_pro_survival_in
context: In established tumors, autophagy acts as a survival mechanism allowing cancer cells to survive nutrient-poor and hypoxic conditions. This is the majority view supported by multiple clinical trials using HCQ.
context_zh_TW: 在既成的腫瘤中，自噬作為一種存活機制，使癌細胞能在營養貧乏與缺氧條件下存活。這是以多項使用 HCQ 的臨床試驗為支持的普遍觀點。

label: activates
context: In response to oxidative stress, SIRT6 mono-ADP-ribosylates K521 of PARP-1, increasing its activity and facilitating DNA repair via NHEJ and HR. SIRT6 also poly-ADP-ribosylates proteins near DNA breaks, promoting recruitment of repair enzymes.
context_zh_TW: 在氧化壓力反應中，SIRT6 對 PARP-1 的 K521 進行單 ADP-核糖基化，提高其活性並透過 NHEJ 和 HR 促進 DNA 修復。SIRT6 還對 DNA 斷裂附近的蛋白進行多 ADP-核糖基化，促進修復酶的招募。

label: is_associated_with
context: In senescent hepatic stellate cells, accumulation of cytoplasmic DNA activates the cGAS-STING pathway, which drives transcription of SASP factors via NF-kB and IRF3. Knocking out STING in mouse models attenuated obesity-associated HCC. The cGAS-STING pathway is therefore a driver of HCC-associated SASP.
context_zh_TW: 在衰老的肝星狀細胞中，細胞質 DNA 的累積激活 cGAS-STING 途徑，該途徑經由 NF-kB 和 IRF3 驅動 SASP 因子的轉錄。在小鼠模型中敲除 STING 可減弱肥胖相關 HCC。因此 cGAS-STING 途徑是 HCC 相關 SASP 的驅動因子。

label: represses
context: In several models of cardiac injuries and heart failure, the NAMPT enzyme is repressed while Nmrk2 expression is robustly upregulated, a shift also observed in human failing hearts in models of cardiomyopathy. Since NAMPT is the rate-limiting enzyme that converts nicotinamide to NMN and normally sustains NAD+ synthesis, its repression contributes to the disrupted NAD+ homeostasis central to cardiac hypertrophy and heart failure. The compensatory upregulation of the NMRK2 pathway, through which nicotinamide riboside is converted to NMN using only a single ATP, is an energy-sparing adaptive mechanism, and it supports the rationale for NR supplementation to preserve cardiac function and
context_zh_TW: 在數種心臟損傷與心衰竭模型中，NAMPT 酵素受到抑制，而 Nmrk2 表現則顯著上調，此一轉變亦見於心肌病模型中的人類衰竭心臟。由於 NAMPT 是將菸鹼醯胺轉化為 NMN 並正常維持 NAD+ 合成的限速酵素，其受抑導致 NAD+ 恆定失調，而此失調正是心臟肥大與心衰竭的核心。NMRK2 路徑的代償性上調（透過此路徑，菸鹼醯胺核糖僅需單一 ATP 即可轉化為 NMN）是一種節能的適應性機制，並支持了以 NR 補充來維持心臟功能及

label: correlates_with
context: In the Women's Health and Aging Study I, serum carboxymethyl-lysine (CML), the soluble receptor for advanced glycation end products (sRAGE), endogenous secretory RAGE (esRAGE), and grip strength were measured in 559 moderately to severely disabled women aged 65 and older. Women with higher concentrations of CML had less grip strength than women with lower CML concentrations, leading the authors to conclude that women with higher AGEs have more muscle weakness. These findings support a role for AGE accumulation in age-related muscle weakness and sarcopenia, although the studies are not conclusive of a causal relationship.
context_zh_TW: 在女性健康與老化研究 I（Women's Health and Aging Study I）中，於 559 名 65 歲及以上、中度至重度失能的女性中測量了血清羧甲基賴氨酸（CML）、晚期糖化終產物之可溶性受體（sRAGE）、內源性分泌型 RAGE（esRAGE）與握力。CML 濃度較高的女性比 CML 濃度較低的女性握力較差，使作者得出結論：AGE 較高的女性有較多的肌肉無力。這些發現支持 AGE 堆積在年齡相關肌肉無力與肌少症中的角色，儘管這些研究尚無法確立因果關係。

label: represses
context: In the context of vascular and cartilage aging, miR-378 is reported among microRNAs that suppress SIRT1 translation via 3'-UTR binding. This contributes to reduced deacetylase activity and reinforces the pro-inflammatory SIRT1-NF-kB axis.
context_zh_TW: 在血管和軟骨老化的背景下，miR-378 被報導為透過 3'-UTR 結合抑制 SIRT1 轉譯的微 RNA 之一。這導致去乙醯化酶活性降低，並強化促發炎的 SIRT1-NF-kB 軸。

label: remodel
context: In the extracellular matrix, matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs) such as MMP-1 and MMP-2 are involved in remodeling collagen and elastin that have been stiffened by glycation. Because AGE crosslinks make these long-lived structural proteins resistant to normal turnover, MMP-mediated remodeling helps manage matrix that has accumulated glycation damage, though MMP activity can become dysregulated under high-AGE conditions. MMPs thereby act as a degradative countermeasure to AGE-induced matrix stiffening, balancing crosslink formation and matrix turnover in vascular and connective tissue, although excessive or dysregulated MMP activity contributes to matrix destruction.
context_zh_TW: 在細胞外基質中，基質金屬蛋白酶（MMPs），如 MMP-1 與 MMP-2，參與重塑因糖化而變僵硬的膠原蛋白與彈力蛋白。由於 AGE 交聯使這些長壽結構蛋白對正常更新產生抗性，MMP 介導的重塑有助於處理已累積糖化損傷的基質，儘管在高 AGE 條件下 MMP 活性可能失調。因此，MMPs 作為對抗 AGE 誘發基質僵硬的降解性對策，在血管與結締組織中平衡交聯形成與基質更新，儘管過度或失調的 MMP 活性會導致基質破壞。

label: deacetylates
context: In the liver, SIRT1 deacetylates PGC-1alpha and amplifies the expression of the circadian transcription factors BMAL1 and CLOCK in the suprachiasmatic nucleus of the hypothalamus. These core circadian regulators in turn drive NAMPT, generating circadian NAD+ oscillations and rhythmic SIRT1 activity.
context_zh_TW: 在肝臟中，SIRT1 去乙醯化 PGC-1α 並放大下視丘視交叉上核中晝夜節律轉錄因子 BMAL1 和 CLOCK 的表達。這些核心晝夜調節因子反過來驅動 NAMPT，產生晝夜 NAD+ 震盪和節律性的 SIRT1 活性。

label: prevents
context: In transgenic models predisposed to Alzheimer's disease-like pathology, rapamycin prevented memory deficits and reduced cognitive decline, and inhibition of mTOR by rapamycin abolished cognitive deficits and reduced amyloid-beta levels in a mouse model of Alzheimer's disease. These robust neurological effects contrast with a systematic review finding that rapamycin and its derivatives improved immune, cardiovascular, and integumentary systems in humans but not neurological systems.
context_zh_TW: 在易患阿爾茨海默病樣病理的轉基因模型中，rapamycin預防了記憶缺陷並減少了認知能力下降，rapamycin對mTOR的抑製消除了認知缺陷並降低了阿爾茨海默病小鼠模型中的β-澱粉樣蛋白水平。這些強大的神經系統效應與一項系統評價形成對比，該評價發現rapamycin及其衍生物改善了人類的免疫、心血管和皮膚系統，但未改善神經系統。

label: suppresses
context: In triple-negative breast cancer the MUC1-C/xCT(SLC7A11)/CD44v complex sustains glutathione and suppresses ferroptosis; inhibiting MUC1-C kills TNBC cells or reduces self-renewal — one documented route by which tumors defend the lipid-peroxidation shield.
context_zh_TW: 在三陰性乳癌中 MUC1-C/xCT(SLC7A11)/CD44v 複合物維持 glutathione 並抑制鐵死亡；抑制 MUC1-C 可殺死 TNBC 細胞或降低自我更新——這是腫瘤防禦脂質過氧化護盾的紀錄在案路徑。

label: regulates
context: In yeast, the mitochondrial dysfunction caused by expression of a mutant form of the adenine nucleotide translocase Aac2p results in massive cytosolic accumulation of mitochondrial precursors, triggering a form of cell death termed mitochondrial precursor over-accumulation stress (mPOS). A genetic screen for suppressors of mPOS-mediated cell death revealed numerous hits, with the majority modulating cytosolic protein chaperoning/degradation, mRNA silencing, ribosomal function, transfer RNA methylation, or target of rapamycin (TOR) signaling, reflecting a complex wiring between mitochondrial function and cytosolic proteostasis with implications for mitochondrial diseases, protein aggregation diseases, and normal aging.
context_zh_TW: 在酵母中，由突變形式的腺嘌呤核苷酸轉運酶 Aac2p 表達引起的粒線體功能障礙，導致粒線體前體在細胞質中大量積累，觸發一種稱為粒線體前體過度積累壓力（mPOS）的細胞死亡形式。對 mPOS 介導的細胞死亡抑制子的遺傳篩選揭示了許多靶點，大多數調節細胞質蛋白質伴護/降解、mRNA 沉默、核糖體功能、tRNA 甲基化或雷帕霉素靶蛋白（TOR）訊號，反映了粒線體功能與細胞質蛋白質體恆定性之間複雜的聯繫，對粒線體疾病、蛋白質聚集疾病和正常衰老具有影響。

label: is_associated_with
context: Infection with Helicobacter pylori drives chronic inflammation that is the dominant etiological factor in gastric carcinogenesis. A metaplasia-dysplasia-carcinoma sequence driven by inflammation and oxidative DNA damage underlies intestinal-type tumors. Inflammation is therefore a central precursor of gastric cancer.
context_zh_TW: Helicobacter pylori 感染驅動的慢性發炎是胃癌發生的主要病因因素。由發炎與氧化性 DNA 損傷驅動的化生–異生–癌序列是腸型腫瘤的基礎。因此發炎是胃癌的核心前驅因素。

label: is_a_type_of
context: Inflammasomes are cytosolic supramolecular complexes of the innate immune system that assemble in response to pathogens or sterile danger signals to activate inflammatory caspases. They are not antibodies (immune complexes) but rather multiprotein scaffolds; the original classification here as an immune complex is loose, though inflammasomes are innate immune signaling platforms. They serve as a key intersection between senescence, DAMPs, and inflammation. Their activation links cellular damage to IL-1 family cytokine release.
context_zh_TW: 發炎體是先天免疫系統的胞質超分子複合體，組裝以回應病原體或無菌危險訊號，活化發炎性 caspase。它們不是抗體（免疫複合體）而是多重蛋白支架；此處歸類為免疫複合體鬆散，儘管發炎體是先天免疫訊號平台。它們作為衰老、DAMP 與發炎間的關鍵交會點。其活化將細胞損傷連結到 IL-1 家族細胞激素釋放。

label: crosstalks_with
context: Integrins crosstalk with growth-factor receptors including c-Met and EGFR to amplify mitogenic signaling. Intracellular signals from c-Met and Rho-family GTPases propagate through talin and kindlin to increase integrin ligand affinity (inside-out signaling).
context_zh_TW: Integrin 與包括 c-Met 和 EGFR 在內的生長因子受體交叉對話，以放大促有絲分裂訊號。來自 c-Met 和 Rho 家族 GTPase 的細胞內訊號透過 talin 和 kindlin 傳播，提高 integrin 的配體親和力（由內而外訊號）。

label: reduces
context: Intervention studies in mice show that reduced dietary AGEs attenuate insulin resistance, increase prevention of diabetes, and, in diabetic mice, reduce diabetic vascular and renal complications and improve impaired wound healing. The positive outcomes of caloric restriction in mice may be explained in part by a decrease in AGE intake and a concomitant decrease in oxidative stress. These findings indicate that the glycation load of the diet is not merely a bystander but can modulate insulin sensitivity and metabolic health, reinforcing the idea that dietary AGE restriction is a viable intervention against metabolic dysfunction.
context_zh_TW: 小鼠的介入研究顯示，減少飲食性 AGE 可減緩胰島素抗性、增加糖尿病預防，且在糖尿病小鼠中減少糖尿病血管與腎臟併發症並改善受損傷口癒合。小鼠中熱量限制（caloric restriction）的正面結果可能部分可由 AGE 攝取減少與伴隨的氧化壓力下降來解釋。這些發現指出，飲食的糖化負載不只是旁觀者，而是能調節胰島素敏感度與代謝健康，強化了飲食 AGE 限制是對抗代謝功能障礙之可行介入手段的觀念。

label: mediates
context: Intracellular androgen receptors (iARs) are expressed in both male and female thymus, in thymic stromal cells and in all thymocyte subsets. Studies by Olsen and colleagues suggest that the significant enlargement of the thymus seen in castrated rodents is mediated by androgen receptor signaling: the AR pathway transduces the pro-involutionary effects of sex steroids on the thymus. Thymic regeneration following castration is reversed in a dose-dependent manner by administration of testosterone or estrogen, consistent with receptor-mediated suppression of thymopoiesis.
context_zh_TW: 細胞內類固醇受體 (iARs) 在雄性和雌性均表達於胸腺，在胸腺 stromal 細胞和所有胸腺細胞亞群中。奧爾森及其同事的研究表明，絕育老鼠中胸腺顯著增大是由類固醇受體信號傳導作用所介導的：AR 通路傳導性激素對胸腺的促退化作用。絕育後胸腺的再生以對睪固酮或雌激素劑量的依賴性方式被逆轉，這與受體介導的胸腺造血抑制一致。

label: induces_autophagy_via
context: Ivermectin inhibits the PAK1/Akt/mTOR axis, allowing calcineurin to dephosphorylate TFEB (Ser142/211) and drive its nuclear translocation to the CLEAR network, inducing lysosomal biogenesis and autophagic flux. This is the same axis rapamycin, metformin, spermidine, and CR use for healthspan, independent of Yamanaka factors.
context_zh_TW: Ivermectin 抑制 PAK1/Akt/mTOR 軸，使 calcineurin 能去磷酸化 TFEB（Ser142/211）並驅動其核轉位至 CLEAR 網絡，誘發溶酶體生成與自噬流。這與 rapamycin、metformin、spermidine 與 CR 用於健康壽命的同一軸，獨立於 Yamanaka 因子。

label: suppresses
context: Ivermectin promotes proteasomal degradation of PAK1, which in turn suppresses STAT3. This damps IL-6 transcription, Th17 inflammaging in aging CD4+ T cells, and the OCT4/NANOG/SOX2 stemness loop — entering the same inflammaging/SASP axis that metformin targets, but via PAK1 rather than AMPK.
context_zh_TW: Ivermectin 促進 PAK1 的蛋白酶體降解，後者進而抑制 STAT3。這減弱 IL-6 轉錄、老化 CD4+ T 細胞中的 Th17 發炎性老化，以及 OCT4/NANOG/SOX2 幹性迴路——進入 metformin 標靶的相同發炎性老化／SASP 軸，但經由 PAK1 而非 AMPK。

label: induces_release_of
context: Ivermectin triggers immunogenic cell death in tumor cells with extracellular release of HMGB1 (and ATP, calreticulin), alerting T cells (Tang et al., 2020; PMID 32971268).
context_zh_TW: Ivermectin 在腫瘤細胞中觸發免疫原性細胞死亡，細胞外釋放 HMGB1（以及 ATP、calreticulin），警示 T 細胞（Tang 等，2020；PMID 32971268）。

label: shares_targets_with
context: Jaccard(Fenbendazole, Mebendazole) = 0.421 — shared Tubulin, Microtubule, Benzimidazole, Glycolysis, Apoptosis — marking the benzimidazoles as a bonded twin-pair whose mechanism claims should be presumed portable until dissociated; Ivermectin is mechanistically distinct (Jaccard 0.178, shared sets mostly indications).
context_zh_TW: Jaccard(Fenbendazole, Mebendazole) ＝ 0.421——共享 Tubulin、Microtubule、Benzimidazole、Glycolysis、Apoptosis——把苯並咪唑類標記為鍵合雙胞胎對，機制主張應推定可互通直到被區分；Ivermectin 機制上截然不同（Jaccard 0.178，共享集合多為適應症）。

label: inhibits
context: Kaempferol is a flavonoid polyphenol reported to possess anti-glycation properties. Along with other flavonoids such as genistein, quercitrin, and quercetin, kaempferol inhibits the glycation process in vitro, and several herbal polyphenols have anti-glycation activities similar to or stronger than aminoguanidine. These compounds act partly through their antioxidant capacity, which reduces the ROS-driven acceleration of protein glycation. Flavonoid-rich herbs and dietary plants are therefore considered promising, relatively safe agents for the prevention of glycation and AGE formation during aging.
context_zh_TW: Kaempferol 是一種類黃酮多酚，據報導具有抗糖化特性。與其他類黃酮如 genistein、quercitrin 和 quercetin 一樣，Kaempferol 在體外抑制糖化過程，且數種草本多酚具有與 aminoguanidine 相似或更強的抗糖化活性。這些化合物部分透過其抗氧化能力發揮作用，進而減少 ROS 驅動的蛋白質糖化加速。因此，富含類黃酮的草本植物與食用植物被視為在老化過程中預防糖化與 AGE 形成的具潛力且相對安全的物質。

label: redox_cycles_at
context: Literature adjudication (Genova et al. 2006, PMID 16487923; Bindoli et al. 1990): Complex I reduces adrenochrome to its semiquinone, which auto-oxidizes to superoxide — a redox cycle that amplifies ROS. Adrenochrome is therefore an electron acceptor at Complex I ('redox_cycles_at', conf 0.9).
context_zh_TW: 文獻裁決（Genova et al. 2006, PMID 16487923；Bindoli et al. 1990）：Complex I 把 adrenochrome 還原成半醌，半醌自氧化成超氧化物——一個放大 ROS 的氧化還原循環。因此 adrenochrome 是 Complex I 的電子受體（「redox_cycles_at」，conf 0.9）。

label: oxidize
context: Liver microsomes are subcellular fractions of hepatic endoplasmic reticulum enriched in oxidative enzymes. In the presence of NADPH and oxygen, hepatic microsomal enzymes can oxidize epinephrine to adrenochrome, and the rate is modulated by high oxygen tension or inhibitors such as cyanide. This demonstrates that hepatic microsomal oxidases contribute to adrenaline oxidation alongside the well-known neutrophil and myocardial routes. The microsomal pathway represents an enzymatic or semi-enzymatic route of catecholamine oxidation that may be more relevant when oxidative stress or drug-induced enzyme activity is elevated, though it remains a minor pathway relative to COMT- and MAO-mediated metabolism.
context_zh_TW: 肝微粒體是富含氧化酶的肝內質網次細胞分馏物。在 NADPH 與氧氣存在下，肝微粒體酶可將 epinephrine 氧化為 adrenochrome，且其速率受高氧張力或氰化物等抑制劑調節。這證明肝微粒體氧化酶與眾所周知的中性球與心肌途徑並行，共同促成 adrenaline 氧化。微粒體途徑代表一種兒茶酚胺氧化的酶性或半酶性途徑，在氧化壓力或藥物誘導酶活性升高時可能更為相關，儘管相對於 COMT 與 MAO 介導的代謝，它仍是次要途徑。

label: triggered_by
context: Loss of RB1 derepresses E2F, driving unscheduled S-phase entry that, without compensatory checkpoints, culminates in replication stress and senescence. RB1 is among the most frequently lost tumor suppressors in TLS.
context_zh_TW: RB1 缺失去抑制 E2F，驅動非預期的 S 期進入；在沒有代償性檢查點的情況下，最終導致複製壓力和衰老。RB1 是 TLS 中最常缺失的腫瘤抑制因子之一。

label: is_driven_by
context: Loss of p53 function abolishes DNA damage checkpoints and apoptosis, permitting the final transition to invasive carcinoma in the adenoma-carcinoma sequence. p53 is mutated or lost in about 60% of colon cancers. p53 loss is therefore a late and decisive event in colon tumorigenesis.
context_zh_TW: p53 功能喪失會廢除 DNA 損傷檢查點與細胞凋亡，允許腺瘤–癌序列中向侵襲性癌的最終轉變。p53 在約 60% 的結腸癌中發生突變或缺失。因此 p53 缺失是結腸腫瘤發生中晚期且具決定性的事件。

label: promotes
context: MET-driven tumors show heightened tumorigenicity in xenograft models, and MET status is used as a biomarker for patient selection. Aberrant MET activation cooperates with p53 loss and RB1 pathway alterations during tumor evolution.
context_zh_TW: MET 驅動的腫瘤在異種移植模型中表現出更高的致瘤性，且 MET 狀態被用作患者篩選的生物標記。MET 的異常活化在腫瘤演化期間與 p53 缺失和 RB1 途徑改變協同作用。

label: is_resistant_to
context: MGMT expression confers temozolomide resistance in a subset of GBM.
context_zh_TW: MGMT 表達在部分 GBM 中賦予 temozolomide 抗藥性。

label: dephosphorylates
context: MKP-3 binds Bcl-2 and removes phosphate groups at Thr56, Thr74, and Ser87, which normally prime Bcl-2 for ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation. By dephosphorylating Bcl-2, MKP-3 prevents its turnover and elevates cellular Bcl-2 levels. This is the non-canonical apoptosis-relevant function of MKP-3.
context_zh_TW: MKP-3 結合 Bcl-2，並移除 Thr56、Thr74 和 Ser87 上的磷酸基團，這些位點的磷酸化通常會使 Bcl-2 準備進行泛素化與蛋白酶體降解。透過去磷酸化 Bcl-2，MKP-3 防止其周轉並提升細胞內 Bcl-2 水平。這是 MKP-3 與細胞凋亡相關的非經典功能。

label: dephosphorylates
context: MKP-3 inactivates ERK by hydrolyzing the phosphothreonine and phosphotyrosine residues of its activation loop. This provides a negative feedback brake on proliferative RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK signaling. ERK1/2 is the canonical MAPK substrate of MKP-3.
context_zh_TW: MKP-3 透過水解 ERK 激活環上的磷酸蘇氨酸與磷酸酪氨酸殘基，使 ERK 失活。這為增殖性 RAS–RAF–MEK–ERK 訊號傳導提供了負回饋煞車。ERK1/2 是 MKP-3 的經典 MAPK 受質。

label: is_regulated_by
context: MMP-7 (matrilysin) is a secreted metalloproteinase that degrades ECM components and mediates EMT and tissue remodeling. SIRT3 deacetylates beta-catenin, influencing MMP-7 and PAI-1 expression, two mediators implicated in ECM remodeling via EMT induction in renal fibrosis.
context_zh_TW: MMP-7（基質溶解素）是一種分泌性金屬蛋白酶，降解 ECM 成分並介導 EMT 和組織重塑。SIRT3 去乙醯化 β-catenin，影響 MMP-7 和 PAI-1 的表達，這兩種介導因子透過 EMT 誘導參與腎纖維化中的 ECM 重塑。

label: is_associated_with
context: MYC family amplification (MYC, MYCN, MYCL) is a frequent secondary event in small-cell lung cancer, driving proliferation and contributing to the aggressive phenotype. MYC amplification is a hallmark of SCLC biology. It represents a relevant oncogenic driver in SCLC.
context_zh_TW: MYC 家族擴增（MYC、MYCN、MYCL）是 Small-cell lung cancer 中常見的繼發事件，驅動增殖並促成侵襲性表型。MYC 擴增是 SCLC 生物學的標誌。它代表 SCLC 中的相關致癌驅動因子。

label: is_associated_with
context: Melanoma has a high propensity for early metastasis and accounts for the majority of skin-cancer deaths through metastatic spread. Metastatic colonization is an oxidative-stress-sensitive process dependent on FTSJ1/Um34-driven selenoprotein translation. Oxidative stress inhibits the ability of melanoma cells to colonize distant sites.
context_zh_TW: Melanoma 具有早期轉移的高度傾向，並透過轉移擴散造成大多數皮膚癌死亡。轉移性定殖是一個對氧化壓力敏感的過程，依賴 FTSJ1/Um34 驅動的硒蛋白轉譯。氧化壓力會抑制黑色素瘤細胞定殖遠處部位的能力。

label: is_promoted_by
context: Melanoma is promoted by SASP. Senescent melanocytes in nevi are held in check by oncogene-induced senescence driven by BRAF V600E, but the SASP they produce—particularly IL-8 and GROα—can stimulate the proliferation of rare premalignant cells that escaped senescence, potentially driving melanoma development.
context_zh_TW: 黑色素瘤（Melanoma）受 SASP 促進。痣中的衰老黑色素細胞受 BRAF V600E 驅動的致癌基因誘導衰老（OIS）所抑制，但它們所產生的 SASP——尤其是 IL-8 與 GROα——可刺激已逃脫衰老的罕見癌前細胞增殖，可能驅動黑色素瘤的發展。

label: reduces
context: Metformin has been shown to decrease circulating advanced glycation end products in patients with diabetes, as well as to decrease the activity of NF-kB. In a study of 22 women with polycystic ovary disease, six months of metformin therapy resulted in a reduction of serum AGEs. As a widely used anti-diabetic drug, metformin's ability to lower circulating AGEs offers an additional explanation for some of its beneficial metabolic and vascular effects beyond glycemic control. These observations position metformin among pharmacological agents studied as blockers of AGE formation or action.
context_zh_TW: Metformin 已被證實能降低糖尿病患者的循環晚期糖化終產物，並降低 NF-kB 的活性。在一項針對 22 名多囊性卵巢疾病（polycystic ovary disease）女性的研究中，六個月的 metformin 治療導致血清 AGE 下降。作為廣泛使用的抗糖尿病藥物，metformin 降低循環 AGE 的能力為其部分有益的代謝與血管效應提供了超越血糖控制之外的額外解釋。這些觀察將 metformin 定位於被研究作為 AGE 形成或作用阻斷劑的藥理藥物之中。

label: inhibits
context: Metformin is believed to exert its anti-diabetic effects through inhibition of complex I of the mitochondrial respiratory chain, a mild perturbation of mitochondrial function that may generate a hormetic (mitohormetic) signal. In mice and lower organisms, metformin treatment induces increased oxidant defenses and extends lifespan, suggesting that gentle inhibition of mitochondrial function can trigger beneficial adaptive stress responses. This positions metformin as a potential prototype for drugs that exploit mitohormesis to treat age-related disease.
context_zh_TW: Metformin被認為通過抑制粒線體呼吸鏈的複合物I來發揮其抗糖尿病作用，這是對粒線體功能的輕微干擾，可能產生hormetic（mitohormetic）信號。在小鼠和低等生物中，metformin治療誘導氧化防禦增加並延長壽命，表明輕度抑制粒線體功能可以觸發有益的適應性壓力反應。這使得metformin成為利用mitohormesis治療與年齡相關疾病的藥物潛在原型。

label: suppresses
context: Metformin, a widely used antidiabetic drug and repurposable agent, reduces the SASP without causing substantial cytotoxicity to senescent cells, holding potential as a senomorphic agent. In this study, metformin-involving assays phenocopied those derived from apigenin: metformin lowered cancer cell malignancy by downregulating the activity of senescent stromal cell conditioned medium, indicating a common pattern shared by both agents. This supports the broader concept that pharmacologically targeting SASP development with senomorphic agents can deprive cancer cells of stroma-conferred gain-of-function phenotypes, specifically chemoresistance, and suggests strategies to improve the...
context_zh_TW: Metformin是一種廣泛使用的抗糖尿病藥物和可重新利用的藥物，它減少SASP而不對衰老細胞造成實質性細胞毒性，具有作為senomorphic藥物的潛力。在本研究中，涉及metformin的測定複製了從apigenin得出的表型：metformin通過下調衰老基質細胞條件培養基的活性來降低癌細胞惡性度，表明兩種藥物共享一種共同模式。這支持了更廣泛的概念，即通過senomorphic藥物在藥理學上靶向SASP發展可以剝奪癌細胞由基質賦予的功能獲得性表型，特別是化療抗性，並提出了改善...的策略

label: causes
context: Methemoglobinemia is a condition in which elevated levels of methemoglobin reduce oxygen delivery to tissues. Because methemoglobin cannot transport oxygen and left-shifts the oxygen-dissociation curve of remaining hemoglobin, affected patients develop a functional anemia and tissue hypoxia even with normal total hemoglobin. Symptom thresholds scale with methemoglobin percentage: levels of 30-50% cause dizziness, confusion, tachycardia and tachypnea, 50-70% cause coma, seizures, arrhythmias and acidosis, and levels above 70% are life-threatening with a high risk of death if untreated.
context_zh_TW: Methemoglobinemia is a condition in which elevated levels of methemoglobin reduce oxygen delivery to tissues。Because methemoglobin cannot transport oxygen and left-shifts the oxygen-dissociation curve of remaining hemoglobin, affected patients develop a functional anemia and tissue hypoxia even with normal total hemoglobin。Symptom thresholds scale with methemoglobin percentage: levels of 30-50% cause dizziness, confusion, tachycardia and tachypnea, 50-70% cause coma, seizures, arrhythmias and acidosis, and levels above 70% are life-threatening with a high risk of death if untreated。

label: are_regenerated_by
context: Methyl groups, the one-carbon units transferred by methylation reactions, are regenerated by the Methylation Cycle: after SAMe donates a methyl group (e.g., to COMT for catechol inactivation), the resulting homocysteine is remethylated back to methionine using Methylfolate and MethylB12, so the methyl-donor pool is continuously replenished. The Methylation Cycle is therefore the metabolic engine that sustains methyl-group supply for COMT and other methyltransferases.
context_zh_TW: Methyl groups 是甲基化反應所轉移的一碳單元，由 Methylation Cycle 再生：SAMe 捐出甲基（例如給 COMT 用於 catechol 去活化）後，產生的 homocysteine 會藉由 Methylfolate 與 MethylB12 再甲基化回 methionine，使甲基供體池持續補充。因此 Methylation Cycle 是維持 COMT 及其他甲基轉移酶甲基供應的代謝引擎。

label: supports
context: MethylB12 (methylcobalamin) supports the Methylation Cycle as the methyl-group carrier for methionine synthase: it provides the methyl group that remethylates homocysteine to methionine, regenerating the SAMe pool that the cycle distributes to methyltransferases such as COMT. Together with Methylfolate, methylB12 is one of the two B-vitamin cofactors that keep homocysteine remethylation, and therefore SAMe-dependent catecholamine clearance, running efficiently.
context_zh_TW: MethylB12（甲基鈷胺）作為 methionine synthase 的甲基載體支持 Methylation Cycle：它提供將 homocysteine 再甲基化為 methionine 所需的甲基，再生該循環分配給 COMT 等甲基轉移酶的 SAMe 池。與 Methylfolate 一樣，methylB12 是維持 homocysteine 再甲基化（以及依賴 SAMe 的兒茶酚胺清除）順暢運作的兩種 B 群維生素輔因子之一。

label: is_neuroprotective_in
context: Methylene blue (MB) is neuroprotective in rodent models of stroke, reducing infarct volume and preserving neurological function. MB enhances cellular oxygen consumption in vivo and provides protection against hypoxia-induced injury, including in primary hepatocyte cultures. Its mechanism is distinct from conventional antioxidants: by acting as an alternative electron-transfer carrier that bypasses Complexes I-III and by upregulating complex IV activity and expression, MB sustains mitochondrial bioenergetics in ischemic tissue where electron transport is compromised.
context_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)在中風的囓齒類模型中具有神經保護作用，減少梗塞體積並保留神經功能。MB在體內增強細胞氧氣消耗，並提供對缺氧誘導損傷的保護，包括在原代肝細胞培養中。其機制與傳統抗氧化劑不同：通過作為繞過複合物I-III的替代電子轉運載體，並通過上調複合物IV活性和表達，MB在電子傳輸受損的缺血組織中維持粒線體生物能量學。

label: increases
context: Methylene blue increases synaptic serotonin by inhibiting monoamine oxidase enzymes, which normally break down serotonin, dopamine, and norepinephrine. Inhibiting these enzymes means more of these neurotransmitters remain in the synapse, which is how antidepressants like phenelzine work. This mechanism provides methylene blue's mild mood-lifting and anxiolytic effects at 0.5-2 mg doses, but it is also the source of its most serious safety concern: combining methylene blue with SSRIs, SNRIs, tricyclic antidepressants, or other serotonergic drugs can raise serotonin to dangerous levels and potentially trigger serotonin syndrome - a documented case-report-level interaction requiring physician involvement.
context_zh_TW: Methylene blue通過抑制單胺氧化酶酶來增加突觸血清素，這些酶通常分解血清素、多巴胺和去甲腎上腺素。抑制這些酶意味著更多這些神經遞質留在突觸中，這就是phenelzine等抗抑鬱藥的作用方式。這種機制在0.5-2毫克劑量下提供methylene blue的輕度情緒提升和抗焦慮作用，但這也是其最嚴重安全問題的來源：將methylene blue與SSRIs、SNRIs、三環類抗抑鬱藥或其他血清素能藥物結合使用可能將血清素提升至危險水平，並可能引發血清素症候群——這是一種已記錄的病例報告級別的相互作用，需要醫師參與。

label: induces
context: Methylene blue induces oxidative stress (conf 0.88) and causes hemolysis (conf 0.94) at higher doses, coupling to the adrenochrome module through shared redox/injury bridges (Complex I, Oxidative Stress, Hemolysis) rather than direct chemistry.
context_zh_TW: Methylene blue 在高劑量誘發氧化壓力（conf 0.88）並造成溶血（conf 0.94），透過共享氧化還原／損傷橋樑（Complex I、Oxidative Stress、Hemolysis）而非直接化學作用耦合到 adrenochrome 模組。

label: maintains
context: Methylene blue maintains ATP production by acting as a redox cycling agent in mitochondria, donating and accepting electrons to keep the mitochondrial electron transport chain running efficiently. It can bypass dysfunctional Complex I and Complex III, rerouting electron flow to sustain ATP synthesis when normal pathways are impaired - essentially a backup generator for cellular energy production. The dose range that shows this effect in cellular and animal studies is consistently in the sub-1 mg/kg range (1-4 mg per dose for most adults). These mitochondrial effects are the mechanistic basis for proposed cognitive and energy benefits, though most supporting evidence comes from cell cultures and rodents rather than human trials.
context_zh_TW: Methylene blue通過在粒線體內作為氧化還原循環劑發揮作用來維持ATP產生，捐贈和接受電子以使粒線體電子傳遞鏈有效運行。它可以繞過功能障礙的複合物I和III，在正常路徑受損時重新引導電子流以維持ATP合成——本質上是細胞能量產生的備用發電機。在細胞和動物研究中顯示這種效果的劑量範圍始終在低於1 mg/kg的範圍內（大多數成人每次1-4毫克）。這些粒線體效應是提出的認知和能量益處的機制基礎，儘管大多數支持證據來自細胞培養和囓齒類動物而不是人體試驗。

label: promotes
context: Mitochondrial TXNRD2 inhibition by auranofin compromises redox defense and bioenergetics, promoting ferroptosis in sensitive cells. Ferroptosis is one of the cell-death modalities engaged in auranofin-sensitive cancers.
context_zh_TW: Auranofin 對粒線體 TXNRD2 的抑制會損害氧化還原防禦與能量代謝，並在敏感細胞中促成鐵依賴性細胞死亡（ferroptosis）。Ferroptosis 是 Auranofin 敏感癌症中所引發的細胞死亡模式之一。

label: activates
context: Mitochondrial oxidants participate in numerous signaling pathways, including the activation of macroautophagy. Reactive oxygen species are essential for autophagy and specifically regulate the activity of Atg4, a protease that processes the autophagy protein Atg8/LC3. Beyond autophagy, mitochondrial ROS also modulate hypoxic signaling and regulate cytosolic stress kinases, and they serve as central signaling mediators in mitohormesis, where a controlled increase in mitochondrial oxidant production triggers adaptive cytoprotective programs that extend lifespan.
context_zh_TW: 粒線體氧化劑參與多種訊號傳導途徑，包括巨自噬的活化。活性氧類（ROS）對自噬至關重要，並特異性調節 Atg4 的活性，Atg4 是一種加工自噬蛋白 Atg8/LC3 的蛋白酶。除了自噬外，粒線體 ROS 也調節缺氧訊號並調節細胞質壓力激酶，它們在粒線體促效應（mitohormesis）中作為核心訊號介體，其中粒線體氧化劑產出的控制性增加會觸發適應性細胞保護程式，從而延長壽命。

label: reduces_susceptibility_to
context: Mitohormesis reduces susceptibility to disease and age-related pathology. By inducing a broad cytoprotective state - augmented antioxidant defenses, chaperone expression, xenobiotic detoxification, and metabolic reconfiguration - the hormetic response protects organisms from subsequent larger stresses. Individual variation in the mitohormesis response has been proposed to explain why only some obese individuals develop clinically apparent diabetes despite increased nutrient-driven mitochondrial ROS, and a fuller understanding may provide a unifying hypothesis for why we age.
context_zh_TW: 粒線體促效應降低了對疾病和與年齡相關的病理學的易感性。透過誘導廣泛的細胞保護狀態——增強的抗氧化防禦、分子伴護表達、異生物质解毒和代謝重構——促效應反應保護生物體免受後續較大壓力的影響。粒線體促效應反應的個體差異已被提出用於解釋為何只有某些肥胖個體在營養驅動的粒線體 ROS 增加的情況下發展出臨床明顯的糖尿病，更全面的理解可能提供為何我們會衰老的統一假說。

label: reduces
context: MnSOD (manganese superoxide dismutase) is the mitochondrial antioxidant enzyme that eliminates superoxide generated during respiration. Its activity is regulated by acetylation, with SIRT3-mediated deacetylation increasing MnSOD activity. When NR raises NAD+ and activates SIRT3, MnSOD acetylation decreases, mitochondrial MnSOD activity rises, and mitochondrial reactive oxygen species levels fall. This reduced mitochondrial ROS burden lessens oxidative damage and supports mitochondrial quality control, contributing to NR's protective effects against oxidative stress, inflammasome activation, and age-related mitochondrial dysfunction in tissues such as the myocardium, skeletal muscle, and neurons.
context_zh_TW: MnSOD（錳超氧化物歧化酶）是在呼吸過程中消除所產生的超氧化物的粒線體抗氧化酶。其活性受乙醯化調控，其中 SIRT3 介導的去乙醯化會增加 MnSOD 活性。當 NR 提升 NAD+ 並活化 SIRT3 時，MnSOD 乙醯化下降，粒線體 MnSOD 活性上升，粒線體活性氧物種水平降低。這種減少的粒線體 ROS 負擔減輕了氧化損傷並支持粒線體品質控制，有助於 NR 對氧化壓力、發炎體活化以及心肌、骨骼肌和神經元等組織中與年齡相關的粒線體功能障礙的保護作用。

label: couples_with
context: MnSOD and mitochondrial thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) are functionally coupled within the shared matrix peroxide-relay: MnSOD converts superoxide to H2O2, which peroxiredoxin 3 scavenges, and Trx2 regenerates peroxiredoxin 3 to keep that arm running. Their coupling is metabolic (through the peroxide stream) rather than a direct protein-protein interaction. Together they buffer mitochondrial ROS and determine whether MnSOD-derived H2O2 is detoxified to water or released as a hormetic signal.
context_zh_TW: MnSOD 與粒線體 thioredoxin-2（Trx2）在共享的基質過氧化物接力中功能性地耦合：MnSOD 將超氧化物轉化為 H2O2，後者由 peroxiredoxin 3 清除，而 Trx2 再生 peroxiredoxin 3 以維持該分支運作。此耦合是代謝性的（透過過氧化物流），而非直接的蛋白質-蛋白質交互作用。兩者共同緩衝粒線體 ROS，並決定 MnSOD 衍生的 H2O2 是被解毒為水，還是被釋放為激效訊號。

label: supplies hydrogen peroxide to
context: MnSOD produces hydrogen peroxide that Peroxiredoxin 3, the principal matrix H2O2 scavenger, consumes. MnSOD and peroxiredoxin 3 form the two coupled halves of the mitochondrial peroxide-relay.
context_zh_TW: MnSOD 產生過氧化氫，由基質中主要的 H2O2 清除者 Peroxiredoxin 3 加以消耗。MnSOD 與 peroxiredoxin 3 構成粒線體過氧化物接力反應的兩端。

label: downregulates
context: MuRF1 (muscle-specific RING finger protein 1) is a muscle-specific E3 ubiquitin ligase that, together with Atrogin-1, marks muscle proteins for ubiquitin-proteasome degradation during atrophy. Studies have shown that urolithin A can regulate muscle protein synthesis and degradation by inhibiting the activity of mTORC1 and the expression of Atrogin-1/MuRF1, thereby reducing muscle protein degradation and supporting the maintenance of muscle mass under catabolic conditions. Suppressing this E3 ligase reduces ubiquitination of muscle proteins and complements urolithin A's anabolic effects on protein synthesis.
context_zh_TW: MuRF1 (muscle-specific RING finger protein 1) 是一種肌肉特異性 E3 泛素連接酶，與 Atrogin-1 共同在萎縮期間標記肌肉蛋白以供泛素-蛋白酶體降解。研究顯示 urolithin A 可透過抑制 mTORC1 的活性與 Atrogin-1/MuRF1 的表現，來調節肌肉蛋白合成與降解，從而減少肌肉蛋白降解，並在分解代謝條件下支持肌肉量的維持。抑制此 E3 連接酶可減少肌肉蛋白的泛素化，並補足 urolithin A 對蛋白質合成的合成代謝效應。

label: localized_to
context: Myeloperoxidase (MPO) is a heme-containing enzyme stored primarily in the azurophilic granules of neutrophils, and to a lesser extent in monocytes and macrophages. It plays a central role in the oxidative burst during innate immune responses, producing hypochlorous acid and other oxidants that kill pathogens in phagosomes. On release during inflammation, MPO can also oxidize host biomolecules and catecholamines such as epinephrine, and its products contribute to both antimicrobial defense and, in excess, to tissue damage and cardiovascular pathology.
context_zh_TW: Myeloperoxidase（MPO）是一種主要儲存於neutrophils azurophilic granules中、較少量存在於monocytes與macrophages的heme-containing enzyme。它在innate immune responses的oxidative burst中扮演central role，產生hypochlorous acid及其他oxidants以kill pathogens in phagosomes。在inflammation期間released時，MPO亦能oxidize host biomolecules及如epinephrine等catecholamines，其products既contribute to antimicrobial defense，在excess時也會導致tissue damage與cardiovascular pathology。

label: uses
context: Myeloperoxidase (MPO), a heme-containing enzyme stored primarily in the azurophilic granules of neutrophils, uses hydrogen peroxide (H2O2, generated by NADPH oxidase) as its substrate. In its halogenation cycle, MPO catalyzes the two-electron oxidation of chloride to hypochlorous acid, and in its peroxidase cycle it performs one-electron oxidations of organic substrates such as catecholamines, tyrosine, urate, ascorbate, and nitrite. The hydrogen peroxide substrate thus links NADPH oxidase activity to MPO-driven oxidation, and both contribute to the conversion of adrenaline to adrenochrome in activated neutrophils.
context_zh_TW: Myeloperoxidase（MPO）是一種主要儲存於neutrophils azurophilic granules中的heme-containing enzyme，以hydrogen peroxide（H2O2，由NADPH oxidase生成）作為其substrate。在其halogenation cycle中，MPO催化chloride的two-electron oxidation生成hypochlorous acid；在其peroxidase cycle中，它對catecholamines、tyrosine、urate、ascorbate及nitrite等有機substrates進行one-electron oxidations。因此，hydrogen peroxide substrate將NADPH oxidase activity與MPO-driven oxidation連結起來，兩者皆contribute to activated neutrophils中adrenaline轉化為adrenochrome。

label: predicts
context: N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine (CML), a predominant advanced glycation end product, can serve as a predictor of cardiovascular mortality. Semba and colleagues studied 559 women aged 65 and older from the Women's Health and Aging Study I for 4.5 years, during which 22% died, 43.9% from cardiovascular disease; women in the highest quartiles of CML had the highest risk of dying from cardiovascular disease. CML, the most abundant AGE both in vivo and in foods, is therefore used as a circulating biomarker of AGE burden and an indicator of cardiovascular risk in older populations.
context_zh_TW: N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine（CML）是一種predominant advanced glycation end product，可作為cardiovascular mortality的predictor。Semba及其colleagues studied 559 women aged 65 and older from the Women's Health and Aging Study I for 4.5 years，期間22% died，43.9% from cardiovascular disease；CML處於highest quartiles的女性died from cardiovascular disease的risk最高。CML是in vivo與in foods中最abundant的AGE，因此被used as a circulating biomarker of AGE burden與an indicator of cardiovascular risk in older populations。

label: produces
context: NADPH oxidase is the enzyme system in activated neutrophils that generates superoxide radicals, the primary oxidants driving adrenaline oxidation to adrenochrome. The superoxide and derived reactive oxygen species produced by this system account for over 80% of adrenaline oxidation in the presence of stimulated neutrophils at low micromolar adrenaline concentrations, making it the major catabolic route for adrenaline under these inflammatory conditions. Hydrogen peroxide generated by NADPH oxidase also serves as the substrate for myeloperoxidase, which can further contribute to catecholamine oxidation.
context_zh_TW: NADPH oxidase是activated neutrophils中生成superoxide radicals的enzyme system，而superoxide radicals是驅動adrenaline oxidation to adrenochrome的主要oxidants。在低micromolar adrenaline concentrations下，此system產生的superoxide及其derived reactive oxygen species佔stimulated neutrophils存在時adrenaline oxidation的80%以上，使其成為這些inflammatory conditions下adrenaline的主要catabolic route。NADPH oxidase生成的hydrogen peroxide亦作為myeloperoxidase的substrate，可進一步促進catecholamine oxidation。

label: reduces
context: NADPH-cytochrome P450 reductase performs the one-electron reduction of aminochrome ortho-quinones such as adrenochrome, generating highly unstable semiquinone radicals. These radicals rapidly transfer their electron to molecular oxygen, producing superoxide anion and regenerating the parent quinone in a redox cycle. This enzyme-initiated reduction is the entry point for aminochrome-driven oxidative stress that is hypothesized to selectively push already-ROS-elevated senescent cells into apoptosis.
context_zh_TW: NADPH-細胞色素P450還原酶執行氨基色素鄰醌如腎上腺素色素的單電子還原，產生高度不穩定的半醌自由基。這些自由基迅速將其電子轉移到分子氧，產生超氧陰離子並在氧化還原循環中再生母體醌。此酶啟動的還原是氨基色素驅動的氧化應激的入口點，假定選擇性地將已ROS升高的衰老細胞推入凋亡。

label: activates
context: NAMPT is the rate-limiting enzyme of the NAD+ salvage pathway, and the NAD+ it produces drives circadian SIRT3 activity rhythms. Temporal NAD+ biosynthesis by NAMPT thus activates SIRT3.
context_zh_TW: NAMPT 是 NAD+ 回收途徑的速率限制酶，其所產生的 NAD+ 驅動 SIRT3 活性的晝夜節律。因此 NAMPT 的時序性 NAD+ 生物合成會活化 SIRT3。

label: suppresses
context: NF-kB can decrease SIRT1 activity by modulating miR-34a expression, mirroring the p53-miR-34a-SIRT1 loop. Directionally, NF-kB engagement of the miR-34a arm suppresses SIRT1 translation. This provides a route by which chronic inflammatory signaling blunts sirtuin activity during ageing.
context_zh_TW: NF-κB 可以透過調節 miR-34a 的表現來降低 SIRT1 活性，反映了 p53-miR-34a-SIRT1 迴路。方向性上 NF-κB 透過 miR-34a 臂抑制 SIRT1 的翻譯。這提供了慢性發炎訊號在老化過程中削弱 sirtuin 活性的路徑。

label: is_inhibited_by
context: NF-kB is inhibited by nutlin 3a indirectly: nutlin 3a stabilizes p53 by inhibiting MDM2, and p53 in turn restrains NF-kB-driven pro-inflammatory SASP. This leverages the tumor-suppressor rheostat to dampen inflammation rather than broadly blocking the pathway, and it is consistent with the finding that p53 loss dramatically amplifies the secretome. The effect is mechanistically sound but nutlin 3a is primarily a research compound with limited clinical development. Its action illustrates the p53-NF-kB counterbalance in SASP control.
context_zh_TW: Nutlin 3a 間接抑制 NF-κB：nutlin 3a 透過抑制 MDM2 穩定 p53，而 p53 反過來抑制 NF-κB 驅動的促發炎性 SASP。這利用腫瘤抑制變阻器減弱發炎而非廣泛阻斷路徑，且與 p53 缺失大幅放大分泌組的發現一致。此效應在機制上健全，但 nutlin 3a 主要是研究化合物、臨床開發有限。其作用說明 SASP 控制中 p53-NF-κB 的平衡。

label: mediates
context: NRF2 (nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor) is a leucine zipper transcription factor that is clearly activated by oxidative stress and participates in the hormetic induction of increased stress resistance. It regulates the expression of a host of gene products that help mediate resistance to oxidative stress. Its worm homolog SKN-1 directly binds mitochondria and is required to mediate the longevity benefits associated with mitochondrial oxidant release, establishing NRF2/SKN-1 as a key effector of the mitochondrial ROS-driven hormetic response.
context_zh_TW: NRF2（紅細胞核因子2相關因子）是一種亮氨酸拉鏈轉錄因子，明顯被氧化應激激活，並參與壓力抗性增強的興奮性誘導。它調節一系列有助於介導氧化抗性的基因產物的表達。其線蟲同源物SKN-1直接結合粒線體，是介導與粒線體氧化劑釋放相關的長壽益處所必需的，確立NRF2/SKN-1為粒線體ROS驅動興奮反應的關鍵效應器。

label: generate
context: Neutrophils, as part of the innate immune response, generate reactive oxygen species (ROS) including superoxide radicals through their NADPH oxidase system, with myeloperoxidase contributing additional oxidants such as hypochlorous acid. These ROS serve a key antimicrobial function, but they also oxidize nearby biomolecules, including catecholamines such as epinephrine, converting them to oxidation products like adrenochrome. This ROS-driven chemistry is most prominent locally at sites of inflammation, infection, or tissue damage where neutrophils accumulate, and it links immune activation to oxidative stress and catecholamine metabolism.
context_zh_TW: Neutrophils, as part of the innate immune response, generate reactive oxygen species (ROS) including superoxide radicals through their NADPH oxidase system, with myeloperoxidase contributing additional oxidants such as hypochlorous acid。These ROS serve a key antimicrobial function, but they also oxidize nearby biomolecules, including catecholamines such as epinephrine, converting them to oxidation products like adrenochrome。This ROS-driven chemistry is most prominent locally at sites of inflammation, infection, or tissue damage where neutrophils accumulate, and it links immune activation to oxidative stress and catecholamine metabolism。

label: protects_against
context: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) derived from the gut microbiota ameliorates acute pancreatitis injury. In acute pancreatitis mouse models, NMN increased NAD+ levels and activated the SIRT3-PRDX5 pathway, mitigating pancreatic mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative damage, and inflammation in a partially SIRT3-dependent manner. Acute pancreatitis is exacerbated by gut microbiota dysbiosis, and normobiotic fecal microbiota transplantation induced higher serum NMN levels, enhancing NAD+ biosynthesis in the pancreas. This makes NMN an important mediator of the protective effects of fecal microbiota transplantation and highlights the role of gut microbiota-produced NAD+ precursors in pathological outcomes of the host.
context_zh_TW: 源自腸道菌叢的菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）改善急性胰臟炎損傷。在急性胰臟炎小鼠模型中，NMN 提升 NAD+ 水平並活化 SIRT3-PRDX5 路徑，以部分依賴 SIRT3 的方式減輕胰臟粒線體功能障礙、氧化損傷與發炎。急性胰臟炎會因腸道菌叢失調而惡化，而正常菌叢糞便微生物移植誘導了較高的血清 NMN 水平，增強胰臟中的 NAD+ 生合成。這使 NMN 成為糞便微生物移植保護效應的重要介導者，並凸顯腸道菌叢產生的 NAD+ 前驅物在宿主病理結果中的作用。

label: improves
context: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) enhances aerobic capacity, as demonstrated in a randomized, double-blind study in amateur runners. NMN also improves mitochondrial function and energy metabolism: long-term administration in drinking water at 100 or 300 mg/kg/day for 12 months increased mitochondrial respiratory ability in skeletal muscle and reversed age-associated gene expression changes in a tissue-specific manner in aged mice. These mitochondrial and aerobic benefits are attributed to NMN raising NAD+ levels, which activates sirtuins and supports oxidative metabolism, energy expenditure, and oxygen consumption, positioning NMN as a performance- and healthspan-enhancing NAD+ precursor.
context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）增強有氧能力，此點已在一項針對業餘跑者的隨機雙盲研究中獲證實。NMN 也改善粒線體功能與能量代謝：在飲用水中以 100 或 300 mg/kg/天長期給藥 12 個月，增加了骨骼肌的粒線體呼吸能力，並以組織特異性方式逆轉老化小鼠中與年齡相關的基因表現變化。這些粒線體與有氧益處歸因於 NMN 提升 NAD+ 水平，進而活化去乙醯酶並支持氧化代謝、能量消耗與氧氣消耗，使 NMN 成為增進表現與健康壽命的 NAD+ 前驅物。

label: protects_against
context: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) improves features of Alzheimer's disease by raising NAD+ levels and supporting sirtuin activity. It protects neuronal cells from oxidative stress, prevents beta-amyloid oligomer-induced cognitive impairment and neuronal death, and inhibits JNK activation to reverse Alzheimer's disease pathology in experimental models. NMN is proposed as a nutraceutical to prevent age-related physiological decline and has demonstrated cardio- and vasoprotective actions as well. Alongside nicotinamide riboside, which reduces neuroinflammation, phosphorylated Tau, DNA damage, and hippocampal neuron apoptosis while increasing neurogenesis, NMN represents a dietary NAD+ precursor strategy against neurodegenerative and age-related diseases.
context_zh_TW: Nicotinamide mononucleotide（NMN）透過提升 NAD+ 濃度並支持 sirtuin 活性，改善 Alzheimer's disease 的特徵。它能保護神經元細胞免受氧化壓力，防止 beta-amyloid 寡聚體誘發的認知障礙與神經元死亡，並抑制 JNK 活化以逆轉實驗模型中 Alzheimer's disease 的病理變化。NMN 被提議作為一種營養保健品，以預防與年齡相關的生理衰退，並且也已展現出心臟與血管保護作用。與 nicotinamide riboside 並用，後者能減少神經發炎、磷酸化 Tau、DNA 損傷與海馬神經元凋亡，同時增加神經生成，NMN 代表一種針對神經退化性與年齡相關疾病的飲食性 NAD+ 前驅物策略。

label: improves
context: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) improves intestinal barrier function, which is important for preventing translocation of harmful bacteria and toxins from the gut into the bloodstream. In colitis models, NMN increased the expression of tight-junction proteins and improved mucus secretion, attenuating intestinal mucosal permeability. Long-term NMN treatment also increased the number of goblet cells, mucus thickness, and tight junction protein expression, maintaining the integrity of the intestinal epithelium. NMN and NR share this gut-protective property alongside selective stimulation of beneficial bacteria, and NAD+-precursor-activated sirtuins also protect intestinal endothelial cells against oxidative injury, collectively reinforcing the gut barrier.
context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）改善腸道屏障功能，這對於防止有害細菌與毒素從腸道移位至血流中相當重要。在結腸炎模型中，NMN 增加緊密連接蛋白的表現並改善黏液分泌，減輕腸黏膜通透性。長期 NMN 處理也增加杯狀細胞數量、黏液厚度與緊密連接蛋白表現，維持腸上皮的完整性。NMN 和 NR 共享此腸道保護特性，加上對有益細菌的選擇性刺激，且 NAD+ 前驅物活化的去乙醯酶也保護腸道內皮細胞免受氧化損傷，共同強化腸道屏障。

label: suppresses
context: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) suppresses NF-kB signaling as part of its anti-inflammatory mechanism. In LPS-activated macrophages, proteomics analysis identified that NMN downregulated COX-2 expression and suppressed inflammation-related pathways including prostanoid biosynthesis, LPS/IL-1-mediated inhibition of RXR function, and IL-6 and NF-kB signaling. This downregulation of NF-kB and related pathways decreased extracellular secretion of IL-6 and IL-1beta and lowered prostaglandin E2 levels, alleviating LPS-induced inflammation and oxidative stress. These effects complement the sirtuin-mediated suppression of NF-kB, positioning NMN as a dietary agent that restrains the master pro-inflammatory transcription factor.
context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）抑制 NF-kB 訊息傳導，作為其抗發炎機制的一部分。在 LPS 活化的巨噬細胞中，蛋白質體學分析發現 NMN 下調 COX-2 表現並抑制與發炎相關的路徑，包括類前列腺素生合成、LPS/IL-1 介導的 RXR 功能抑制，以及 IL-6 和 NF-kB 訊息傳導。此 NF-kB 及相關路徑的下調降低了 IL-6 和 IL-1beta 的細胞外分泌並降低前列腺素 E2 水平，緩解 LPS 誘發的發炎與氧化壓力。這些效應補充了去乙醯酶介導的 NF-kB 抑制，使 NMN 成為一種能抑制主要促發炎轉錄因子的膳食性物質。

label: delays
context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) delays axon degeneration and demyelination in a facial nerve axotomy model. Intraperitoneal injection of NR at 400 mg/kg once daily for 1 week prior to facial nerve axotomy delayed axon degeneration and demyelination and significantly increased NAD+ levels in the facial nucleus and facial nerve of wild-type mice, mimicking the protective effect of CD38 knockdown. Because the age-related increase in CD38 activity degrades NMN and NAD+ and alters precursor pharmacokinetics, NR-mediated NAD+ replenishment helps maintain axonal integrity after injury, supporting NR as a candidate intervention for neurodegeneration.
context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）在面神經軸突切斷模型中延遲軸突退化與脫髓鞘。在面神經軸突切斷前，以 400 mg/kg 的 NR 每日一次腹腔注射、持續 1 週，延遲了軸突退化與脫髓鞘，並顯著提升野生型小鼠面神經核與面神經中的 NAD+ 濃度，模擬了 CD38 敲低的保護作用。由於隨年齡增加的 CD38 活性會降解 NMN 與 NAD+，並改變前驅物的藥物動力學，NR 介導的 NAD+ 補充有助於在受傷後維持軸突完整性，支持 NR 作為神經退化性疾病的候選介入手段。

label: promotes
context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) promotes mitochondrial fusion, particularly in the diabetic heart. Daily oral gavage of NR at 400 mg/kg/day for 4 weeks alleviated diabetes-induced cardiomyopathy and improved cardiac function in diabetic mice by elevating myocardium NAD+ content and promoting mitofusin 2-mediated mitochondrial fusion. This action occurs via the SIRT1-PGC1alpha-PPARalpha pathway and suppresses oxidative stress and cell apoptosis. By restoring balanced mitochondrial dynamics in a disease state characterized by mitochondrial fragmentation and dysfunction, NR supports cardiomyocyte survival and cardiac bioenergetics.
context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）促進粒線體融合，特別是在糖尿病心臟中。每天以 400 mg/kg/天 NR 口服灌胃 4 週，透過提升心肌 NAD+ 含量並促進 mitofusin 2 介導的粒線體融合，減輕糖尿病誘發的心肌病並改善糖尿病小鼠的心臟功能。此作用透過 SIRT1-PGC1alpha-PPARalpha 路徑發生，並抑制氧化壓力與細胞凋亡。透過在粒線體碎裂與功能障礙為特徵的疾病狀態中恢復平衡的粒線體動態，NR 支持心肌細胞存活與心臟生物能量學。

label: protects_against
context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) protects against alcohol-induced depression-like behaviors in mice by altering gut microbiota composition. Dietary supplementation with NR for 10 weeks at 400 mg/kg daily reduced both pro- and anti-inflammatory cytokine levels, inhibited microglial activation, and provided protection against alcohol-induced depression-like behaviors. The effect was attributed to NR's ability to upregulate brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) through microbiota changes: brain BDNF levels correlated positively with bacteria enriched in the NR group such as Barnesiella, Alloprevotella, Prevotella, Alistipes, and Mucispirillum. Fecal microbiota transplantation from NR-treated donors reproduced the protective features in germ-free recipients, demonstrating a gut-microbiota-gut-brain axis mechanism.
context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）透過改變腸道菌叢組成，保護小鼠免於酒精誘發的類憂鬱行為。以每天 400 mg/kg NR 飲食補充 10 週，降低了促發炎與抗發炎細胞激素水平，抑制小膠質細胞活化，並提供對酒精誘發類憂鬱行為的保護。此效應歸因於 NR 透過菌叢改變上調腦源性神經營養因子（BDNF）的能力：腦部 BDNF 水平與 NR 組中富集的細菌如 Barnesiella、Alloprevotella、Prevotella、Alistipes 和 Mucispirillum 呈正相關。來自 NR 處理供體的糞便微生物移植在無菌受體中重現了保護特徵，證明了腸道菌叢—腸—腦軸機制。

label: induces
context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) reduces fat accumulation in the liver through a mechanism that involves induction of the mitochondrial unfolded protein response (UPRmt), which is elicited by NAD+ repletion and reverses fatty liver disease in mice. Through this pathway, as well as through activation of SIRT1 and factors associated with cholesterol homeostasis, NR can reduce cholesterol levels and improve liver health. In regenerating liver, NR reduces lipid accumulation, promotes hepatocyte replication, and increases hepatic ATP content, leading to faster recovery of liver weight.
context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）透過涉及誘導粒線體未摺疊蛋白反應（UPRmt）的機制減少肝臟中的脂肪堆積，此反應由 NAD+ 補充所引發，並在小鼠中逆轉脂肪肝疾病。透過此路徑，以及透過活化 SIRT1 與膽固醇恆定相關的因子，NR 能降低膽固醇水平並改善肝臟健康。在再生肝臟中，NR 減少脂質堆積、促進肝細胞複製，並增加肝臟 ATP 含量，導致肝臟重量更快恢復。

label: reduces
context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) reduces lipid accumulation and liver steatosis in mouse models, effects that are mediated through induction of the mitochondrial unfolded protein response and through SIRT1 activation, which promotes fatty acid oxidation and inhibits lipogenesis, protecting the liver from steatosis. NR also restores hepatic NADP+ and NADPH in prediabetic and type 2 diabetic mice and reduces cholesterol levels via SIRT1 and cholesterol-homeostasis factors. Sirtuins are downregulated in patients with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), a hepatic manifestation of metabolic syndrome associated with type 2 diabetes, obesity, and insulin resistance, so raising NAD+ with NR
context_zh_TW: 煙酰胺核糖（NR）在小鼠模型中減少脂質堆積與肝臟脂肪變性，這些效應是透過誘導粒線體未摺疊蛋白反應以及透過 SIRT1 活化所介導，後者促進脂肪酸氧化並抑制脂肪生成，保護肝臟免於脂肪變性。NR 也會在糖尿病前期與第二型糖尿病小鼠中恢復肝臟的 NADP+ 與 NADPH，並透過 SIRT1 與膽固醇恆定因子降低膽固醇水平。Sirtuins 在非酒精性脂肪肝病（NAFLD）患者中表現下調，NAFLD 是與第二型糖尿病、肥胖和胰島素抵抗相關的代謝症候群的肝臟表現，因此以 NR 提升 NAD+

label: reduces
context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation reduces aortic stiffness and systolic blood pressure, both clinically important risk indicators of cardiovascular function and health. These NR-induced effects may occur via nuclear and cytosolic SIRT1 activation, because NAD+ is an obligate substrate for the deacetylase SIRT1, which maintains healthy vascular function and promotes endothelium-dependent vascular relaxation through endothelial nitric oxide synthase. Arterial stiffness reduction aligns with the broader cardiovascular benefits of NR, which normalizes the myocardial NAD+/NADH ratio and preserves cardiac function in models of heart failure and dilated cardiomyopathy, supporting the
context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）補充可降低主動脈僵硬與收縮壓，兩者皆為心血管功能與健康的臨床重要風險指標。這些由 NR 誘發的效應可能透過核內與胞質 SIRT1 活化而產生，因為 NAD+ 是去乙醯酶 SIRT1 的必需受質，而 SIRT1 可維持健康血管功能並透過 endothelial nitric oxide synthase 促進內皮依賴性血管舒張。動脈僵硬的降低與 NR 更廣泛的心血管益處一致，NR 可將心肌 NAD+/NADH 比值正常化，並在心力衰竭與擴張型心肌病模型中維持心臟功能，支持

label: reduces
context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation reduces systolic blood pressure (SBP) and aortic stiffness, two clinically important risk indicators of cardiovascular function and health. These effects may occur through nuclear and cytosolic SIRT1 activation, since NAD+ is an obligate substrate for the deacetylase SIRT1, which has been implicated in the maintenance of healthy vascular function, including endothelium-dependent vascular relaxation. In mouse models, NR-induced reduction of SBP and aortic stiffness was documented alongside improved NAD+ homeostasis.
context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）補充可降低收縮壓（SBP）與主動脈僵硬程度，這兩者是心血管功能與健康的臨床重要風險指標。這些效應可能經由核內與胞質中的 SIRT1 活化而發生，因為 NAD+ 是去乙醯酶 SIRT1 的必需受質，而 SIRT1 已被認為參與維持健康的血管功能，包括內皮依賴性血管舒張。在小鼠模型中，NR 誘發的 SBP 與主動脈僵硬程度降低，伴隨 NAD+ 恆定性的改善而被記錄下來。

label: upregulates
context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) upregulates brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) by altering gut microbiota composition. In a mouse model of alcohol-induced depression, 10 weeks of NR supplementation reduced pro- and anti-inflammatory cytokines, inhibited microglial activation, and protected against depression-like behaviors, with the protective effect attributed to NR-driven increases in BDNF. Brain BDNF levels were positively correlated with bacteria abundant in NR-treated mice, such as Barnesiella and Alloprevotella, whereas brain inflammatory cytokines correlated with bacteria enriched in the depression model group. This BDNF upregulation via microbiota remodeling links NR intake to improved emotional behavior and neural plasticity.
context_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）透過改變腸道菌叢組成上調腦源性神經營養因子（BDNF）。在酒精誘發憂鬱的小鼠模型中，10 週 NR 補充降低了促發炎與抗發炎細胞激素，抑制小膠質細胞活化，並保護免於類憂鬱行為，其保護效應歸因於 NR 驅動的 BDNF 增加。腦部 BDNF 水平與 NR 處理小鼠中豐富的細菌如 Barnesiella 和 Alloprevotella 呈正相關，而腦部發炎細胞激素則與憂鬱模型組中富集的細菌相關。這種透過菌叢重塑的 BDNF 上調將 NR 攝取與改善情緒行為及神經可塑性連結起來。

label: reduces
context: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) was found to improve muscular function and heart pathology in mdx mouse models of Duchenne's muscular dystrophy (DMD) and to decrease PARylation, inflammation, and fibrosis. DMD is characterized by increased PARP activity, fibrosis, and muscular degeneration, and decreased NAD+ levels and Nampt expression are also observed in this condition. By improving muscular strength, rejuvenating senescent muscle stem cells, and reducing levels of inflammation and fibrosis, NR could be effective in managing the progression of muscular dystrophy and degeneration. These findings support the use of NR for the human condition of DMD.
context_zh_TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）被發現能改善 Duchenne 肌肉營養不良（DMD）mdx 小鼠模型中的肌肉功能與心臟病理，並降低 PARylation、發炎與纖維化。DMD 的特徵為 PARP 活性增加、纖維化與肌肉退化，且在此疾病中亦觀察到 NAD+ 水平與 Nampt 表現降低。透過改善肌肉力量、使衰老的肌肉幹細胞年輕化，以及降低發炎與纖維化程度，NR 可能有效管理肌肉營養不良與退化的進程。這些發現支持將 NR 用於人類 DMD 病症。

label: damages
context: Nitrative stress damages DNA primarily through the formation of 8-nitroguanine from the reaction of reactive nitrogen species with guanine residues. Unlike the stable oxidative lesion 8-oxo-dG, 8-nitroguanine is chemically unstable and spontaneously depurinates to form apurinic/apyrimidinic sites, causing mutations and strand breaks. It can also adduct to histone lysines to generate DNA-protein crosslinks that disrupt chromatin structure.
context_zh_TW: Nitrative stress 主要透過 reactive nitrogen species 與鳥嘌呤殘基反應形成 8-nitroguanine 來損傷 DNA。與穩定的氧化損傷 8-oxo-dG 不同，8-nitroguanine 化學性質不穩定，會自發性去嘌呤形成無嘌呤/無嘧啶位點，造成突變與鏈斷裂。它也能加成至組蛋白離胺酸，產生破壞染色質結構的 DNA-蛋白質交聯。

label: impairs
context: Nitrative stress impairs mitochondria because they are both sources and targets of reactive nitrogen and oxygen species. Peroxynitrite formed in the mitochondrial matrix inactivates MnSOD and aconitase and nitrates Complex I subunits, impairing both the TCA cycle and antioxidant defenses. Opening of the permeability transition pore in response to this damage triggers cytochrome c release and apoptosis.
context_zh_TW: Nitrative stress 損害 mitochondria，因為粒線體既是 reactive nitrogen 與 oxygen species 的來源也是標靶。在粒線體基質中形成的 peroxynitrite 會使 MnSOD 與 aconitase 失活並硝化 Complex I 次單元，同時損害 TCA 循環與抗氧化防禦。針對此損傷而開啟的 permeability transition pore 會觸發 cytochrome c 釋放與 apoptosis。

label: mediates
context: Nitrative stress is a primary mediator of ischemia-reperfusion injury, where the abrupt reintroduction of oxygen generates a burst of both ROS and RNS that overwhelms matrix defenses. Mitochondrial nitrative stress cascades trigger permeability transition, cytochrome c release, and cardiomyocyte apoptosis during early reperfusion. This makes nitrative stress a central mechanism in reperfusion damage across organs.
context_zh_TW: Nitrative stress 是 ischemia-reperfusion injury 的主要介導者，在此過程中，氧氣的突然重新導入會產生 ROS 與 RNS 的爆發，壓垮基質防禦。粒線體的 nitrative stress 級聯在再灌注早期觸發 permeability transition、cytochrome c 釋放與心肌細胞 apoptosis。這使 nitrative stress 成為跨器官再灌注損傷的核心機制。

label: promotes
context: Nitrative stress promotes apoptosis through peroxynitrite-induced protein nitration and lipid peroxidation that open the mitochondrial permeability transition pore. This leads to cytochrome c release and activation of the intrinsic apoptotic cascade. In cytochrome c itself, nitration of Tyr-74 inhibits electron transfer and promotes apoptosome formation.
context_zh_TW: Nitrative stress 透過 peroxynitrite 誘導的蛋白質硝化與脂質過氧化開啟粒線體 permeability transition pore，從而促進 apoptosis。這導致 cytochrome c 釋放並活化內源性凋亡級聯。在 cytochrome c 本身，Tyr-74 的硝化會抑制電子傳遞並促進凋亡體形成。

label: also_functions_as
context: Not every CxxC sequence is redox-active: CxxC-type zinc-binding modules, such as the CFP1/MLL1 DNA-binding domains, coordinate zinc and recognize unmethylated CpG in chromatin and DNA recognition rather than catalyzing thiol-disulfide exchange. The variable residues between the cysteines tune the motif's redox potential and substrate selectivity.
context_zh_TW: 並非每個 CxxC 序列都具有氧化還原活性：CxxC 型鋅結合模組（如 CFP1/MLL1 的 DNA 結合域）配位鋅並辨識未甲基化的 CpG，用於染色質與 DNA 辨識，而非催化硫醇-雙硫交換。兩個半胱氨酸之間的變異殘基會調整基序的氧化還原電位與受質選擇性。

label: is_cleared_by
context: OIS cells in benign/premalignant lesions are vulnerable to Navitoclax-class senolytics. Eliminating them may paradoxically promote tumor growth by removing a cell-autonomous cancer barrier — the senolytic paradox — so retaining certain benign tumors is functionally protective against cancer.
context_zh_TW: 良性／癌前病灶中的 OIS 細胞易受 Navitoclax 類去衰老藥物攻擊。清除它們可能矛盾地透過移除細胞自主的癌症屏障而促進腫瘤生長——即去衰老悖論——因此保留某些良性腫瘤在功能上對抗癌症具保護性。

label: caused_by
context: Oculocutaneous Albinism type 3 (OCA3), also called rufous or red albinism, is due to mutations in TYRP1 (9p23) encoding Tyrosinase-related protein-1. This melanosomal enzyme is involved in eumelanin synthesis. It is most common in individuals of African or Puerto Rican descent.
context_zh_TW: Oculocutaneous Albinism 第 3 型（OCA3），也稱為紅褐色或紅色白化症，由編碼 Tyrosinase-related protein-1 的 TYRP1（9p23）突變引起。這種 melanosomal 酶參與 eumelanin 合成。它在非洲或波多黎各裔人群中最常見。

label: caused_by
context: Oculocutaneous Albinism type 6 (OCA6) results from mutations in DCT (13q32.2), encoding Dopachrome tautomerase (TYRP2). This melanosomal enzyme is involved in melanin synthesis. Defects in DCT produce hypopigmentation within the OCA spectrum.
context_zh_TW: Oculocutaneous Albinism 第 6 型（OCA6）由 DCT（13q32.2）突變引起，該基因編碼 Dopachrome tautomerase（TYRP2）。這種 melanosomal 酶參與黑色素合成。DCT 的缺陷會在 OCA 譜系內產生色素減退。

label: extends_lifespan_in
context: Only when targeted to mitochondria (mCAT) does catalase overexpression extend median mouse lifespan (~20%, Schriner et al. 2005) and attenuate pressure-overload heart failure; cytosolic/peroxisomal catalase overexpression shows no lifespan effect (Pérez et al. 2009) — the 'catalase paradox' demonstrating that compartment, not enzyme identity, is determinative.
context_zh_TW: catalase 只有在靶向粒線體（mCAT）時過度表現才能延長小鼠中位壽命（約 20%，Schriner et al. 2005）並減輕壓力負荷心衰竭；胞質／過氧化酶體 catalase 過度表現則無延壽效果（Pérez et al. 2009）——「catalase 悖論」顯示決定因素是區室而非酵素身份。

label: reduces
context: Orlistat, a lipase inhibitor, reduced serum AGEs after a high-AGE meal in 21 women with polycystic ovary disease compared with 15 women without PCOS, by decreasing AGE absorption. A six-month study evaluating the effect of calorie restriction and orlistat found serum AGE reductions in both PCOS and obese groups, independent of changes in body mass index. By interfering with lipid absorption, orlistat also reduces the absorption of fat-associated dietary AGEs, since foods rich in protein and fat have the highest AGE content. Orlistat therefore illustrates how modulating intestinal absorption can lower postprandial glycation load.
context_zh_TW: Orlistat 是一種脂解酶抑制劑（lipase inhibitor），在 21 名多囊性卵巢疾病女性與 15 名無 PCOS 女性相比，於高 AGE 餐後降低了血清 AGE，方式是減少 AGE 吸收。一項評估熱量限制與 orlistat 效果為期六個月的研究發現，PCOS 與肥胖組的血清 AGE 均下降，且獨立於身體質量指數的變化。透過干擾脂質吸收，orlistat 也減少與脂肪相關的飲食性 AGE 吸收，因為富含蛋白質與脂肪的食物 AGE 含量最高。因此，orlistat 說明了調節腸道吸收如何能降低餐後糖化負載。

label: is_treated_by
context: Osteoarthritis is treated by senolytics in clinical trials (e.g., NCT04210986) aimed at reducing joint pain and improving function by clearing senescent chondrocytes and synovial cells that accumulate in degenerating joints. Preclinical studies show senolytics alleviate osteoarthritis pathology and improve cartilage integrity by reducing SASP-driven cartilage degradation and inflammation. Because senescent cells in joint tissue secrete proteases and inflammatory cytokines that erode cartilage, their elimination is considered a leading musculoskeletal application of senolytic therapy. Results have been promising enough to support continued clinical investigation in osteoarthritis.
context_zh_TW: 骨關節炎在臨床試驗中被 senolytics 治療（如 NCT04210986），旨在透過清除退化關節中累積的衰老軟骨細胞與滑膜細胞減輕關節疼痛並改善功能。臨床前研究顯示 senolytics 減輕骨關節炎病理並透過減少 SASP 驅動的軟骨降解與發炎改善軟骨完整性。由於關節組織中衰老細胞分泌侵蝕軟骨的蛋白酶與發炎細胞激素，其消除被視為 senolytic 療法領先的肌肉骨骼應用。結果已足夠前景以支持骨關節炎的持續臨床研究。

label: is_associated_with
context: Ovarian cancer is characterized by late presentation with widespread peritoneal metastasis, which defines advanced disease. Peritoneal spread and acquired resistance to platinum-taxane chemotherapy drive poor long-term survival. Metastasis is therefore central to ovarian cancer lethality.
context_zh_TW: 卵巢癌以晚期表現並伴有廣泛腹膜轉移為特徵，這定義了晚期疾病。腹膜擴散與對鉑類–紫杉烷化療的後天抗性導致長期存活率不佳。因此轉移對卵巢癌的致死性至關重要。

label: inhibits
context: P66shc inhibits the activity of the FOXO3a transcription factor, blunting a key stress-resistance and antioxidant program. Directionally, P66shc suppresses FOXO3a output. Because SIRT1 represses P66shc, sirtuin activity indirectly unleashes FOXO3a-dependent defense pathways.
context_zh_TW: P66shc 抑制 FOXO3a 轉錄因子的活性，削弱了關鍵的抗壓力和抗氧化程序。方向性上 P66shc 抑制 FOXO3a 的輸出。由於 SIRT1 抑制 P66shc，sirtuin 活性間接釋放了 FOXO3a 依賴的防禦途徑。

label: suppresses
context: PAK1 facilitates NF-kB nuclear activation; ivermectin's PAK1 degradation therefore dampens NF-kB signaling. Because NF-kB is the master transcriptional regulator of the SASP, this overlaps with the senomorphic strategy — targeting SASP production without killing senescent cells.
context_zh_TW: PAK1 促進 NF-kB 核活化；ivermectin 的 PAK1 降解因此減弱 NF-kB 訊號。由於 NF-kB 是 SASP 的主控轉錄調節因子，這與 senomorphic 策略——標靶 SASP 產生而不殺死衰老細胞——重疊。

label: prevents
context: PARK7 (DJ-1) functions as a glutathione-independent glyoxalase that detoxifies free methylglyoxal and glyoxal directly into L-lactate and glycolic acid, thereby preventing these reactive dicarbonyl species from forming irreversible AGE crosslinks on cysteine, lysine, and arginine residues. Because dicarbonyls are generated continuously during glycolysis and lipid peroxidation, PARK7 activity helps keep AGE formation in check. Mutations or loss of PARK7 lead to significant tissue-specific accumulation of novel AGEs. PARK7 therefore complements the glyoxalase system as a second line of defense against endogenous glycation.
context_zh_TW: PARK7（DJ-1）作為一種不依賴麩胱甘肽的乙二醛酶，將游離甲基乙二醛與乙二醛直接解毒為 L-乳酸與乙醇酸，從而防止這些反應性二羰基物種在半胱氨酸、賴氨酸與精氨酸殘基上形成不可逆的 AGE 交聯。由於二羰基物在糖解與脂質過氧化過程中持續生成，PARK7 活性有助於控制 AGE 形成。PARK7 的突變或缺失會導致顯著的組織特異性新型 AGE 堆積。因此，PARK7 補充乙二醛酶系統，作為對抗內生性糖化的第二道防線。

label: detoxifies
context: PARK7 (DJ-1), historically characterized as a protein deglycase, is now understood from biochemical evidence to function primarily as a glutathione-independent glyoxalase. It stereospecifically detoxifies free methylglyoxal and glyoxal directly into L-lactate and glycolic acid, preventing these reactive species from forming irreversible AGE crosslinks on cysteine, lysine, and arginine residues. Mutations or loss of PARK7 lead to significant tissue-specific accumulation of novel AGEs. PARK7 therefore provides a second, glutathione-independent layer of protection against dicarbonyl stress in addition to the classical glyoxalase system.
context_zh_TW: PARK7（DJ-1）歷來被表徵為一種蛋白質去糖化酶（protein deglycase），但現在根據生化證據被理解為主要作為一種不依賴麩胱甘肽的乙二醛酶。它立體特異性地將游離甲基乙二醛與乙二醛直接解毒為 L-乳酸（L-lactate）與乙醇酸（glycolic acid），防止這些反應性物種在半胱氨酸、賴氨酸與精氨酸殘基上形成不可逆的 AGE 交聯。PARK7 的突變或缺失會導致顯著的組織特異性新型 AGE 堆積。因此，PARK7 除了經典的乙二醛酶系統外，提供了第二層不依賴麩胱甘肽的二羰基壓力保護。

label: inhibits
context: PARPs play a critical antiviral role by inhibiting the translation of viral transcripts through ADP-ribosylation of the viral genome, a process requiring NAD+. However, several viral families including SARS-CoV encode a macrodomain protein that hydrolyses the ADPR units from proteins and nucleic acids, inhibiting this PARP protective effect and facilitating replication and virulence. Excessive PARP activation then occurs to compensate for ADPR hydrolysis, accompanied by NAD+ consumption. This suggests that increasing NAD+ levels may restore the antiviral functions of PARPs to support immunity against SARS-CoV-2, providing a rationale for NAD+ precursor supplementation in COVID-19.
context_zh_TW: PARPs 透過對病毒基因組進行 ADP-核糖基化以抑制病毒轉錄本的轉譯，發揮關鍵的抗病毒作用，此過程需要 NAD+。然而，包括 SARS-CoV 在內的數個病毒家族編碼一種 macrodomain 蛋白，可水解蛋白質與核酸上的 ADPR 單元，抑制此 PARP 保護效應並促進複製與毒力。隨後發生過度的 PARP 活化以補償 ADPR 水解，伴隨 NAD+ 消耗。這顯示提升 NAD+ 水平可能恢復 PARPs 的抗病毒功能以支持對抗 SARS-CoV-2 的免疫力，為 COVID-19 中 NAD+ 前驅物補充提供了理據。

label: activates
context: PGAM5 activates the GTP-binding fission protein Drp1, which translocates to mitochondria to drive the fission that both segregates damaged mitochondria for PINK1/Parkin mitophagy and, under severe RIPK3 activation, contributes to necroptotic mitochondrial rupture. The RIPK3-PGAM5-Drp1 route is thus a shared conduit: mild damage routes it to mitophagy, severe damage to necroptosis. Some studies contest the importance of PGAM5 in Drp1 activation, so the exact mechanism remains under investigation.
context_zh_TW: PGAM5 會活化 GTP 結合的分裂蛋白 Drp1，使其轉位至粒線體驅動分裂——此過程既能隔離受損粒線體供 PINK1/Parkin 粒線體自噬之用，在強烈 RIPK3 活化下也促成程序性壞死的粒線體破裂。RIPK3-PGAM5-Drp1 路徑因此是共享通道：輕度損傷導向粒線體自噬，嚴重損傷導向程序性壞死。部分研究質疑 PGAM5 在 Drp1 活化中的重要性，其確切機制仍在研究中。

label: activates
context: PGC-1alpha-driven TFEB activation rescues Huntington's disease proteotoxicity: TFEB is the master transcription factor for autophagic/lysosomal biogenesis, and PGC-1alpha (downregulated by mutant huntingtin) is the metabolic co-activator that sustains it — restoring both is the HD therapeutic bet.
context_zh_TW: PGC-1alpha 驅動的 TFEB 活化能救回亨廷頓舞蹈症的蛋白毒性：TFEB 是自噬／溶酶體新生的主轉錄因子，而 PGC-1alpha（受突變 huntingtin 下調）是維持它的代謝共活化子——恢復兩者是 HD 的治療下注。

label: promotes
context: PPARγ is a transcription factor involved in adipocyte differentiation, glucose metabolism, and cholesterol metabolism, among other processes. Urolithin A increases PPARγ expression and the transcription of its downstream target genes, thereby promoting fatty acid oxidation, improving insulin sensitivity, and reducing cholesterol synthesis and absorption. PPARγ signaling thus contributes to the metabolic regulatory effects attributed to urolithin A, complementing its activation of the AMPK pathway in supporting muscle energy metabolism.
context_zh_TW: PPARγ 是參與脂肪細胞分化、葡萄糖代謝與膽固醇代謝等過程的轉錄因子。Urolithin A 提升 PPARγ 表現及其下游標的基因轉錄，從而促進脂肪酸氧化、改善胰島素敏感性，並降低膽固醇合成與吸收。因此，PPARγ 訊號有助於歸因於 urolithin A 的代謝調節效應，補足其對 AMPK 路徑的活化以支援肌肉能量代謝。

label: is_treated_with
context: Paclitaxel is a taxane used in the platinum/taxane first-line chemotherapy for ovarian cancer. Ivermectin enhances the efficacy of paclitaxel in ovarian cancer models. Paclitaxel is therefore central to ovarian cancer treatment.
context_zh_TW: Paclitaxel 是用於卵巢癌鉑類/紫杉烷一線化療的紫杉烷類藥物。Ivermectin 在卵巢癌模型中增強 paclitaxel 的療效。因此 Paclitaxel 對卵巢癌治療至關重要。

label: activates
context: Pentose phosphate pathway flux toward NADPH/G6P promotes SIRT1 activity toward 14-3-3-zeta; G6P supplementation in Xenopus egg extract enhanced 14-3-3-zeta-directed sirtuin activity and caspase-2/14-3-3-zeta binding. Declining PPP activity leads to 14-3-3-zeta acetylation, its release, and caspase-2 activation.
context_zh_TW: 磷酸戊糖途徑朝向 NADPH/G6P 的通量促進 SIRT1 對 14-3-3ζ 的活性；在非洲爪蟾卵提取物中補充 G6P 增強了針對 14-3-3ζ 的 sirtuin 活性以及 caspase-2/14-3-3ζ 結合。PPP 活性下降導致 14-3-3ζ 乙醯化、其釋放和 caspase-2 活化。

label: trains
context: Per the 'Old Friends' hypothesis, commensal bacteria, saprophytic mycobacteria and helminths calibrate immune tolerance by inducing regulatory T cells (Tregs); farm exposure and gut Bacteroides/Clostridium pools promote tolerogenic dendritic cells → Treg differentiation, so removing microbial training signals is linked to rising allergy and autoimmunity.
context_zh_TW: 依「老友」假說，共生菌、腐生分枝桿菌與蠕蟲透過誘導調節性 T 細胞（Tregs）校準免疫耐受；農場暴露與腸道 Bacteroides/Clostridium 族群促進耐受性樹突細胞 → Treg 分化，因此移除微生物訓練訊號與過敏及自體免疫增加相關。

label: is_induced_by
context: Peroxiredoxin 3 (PRDX3) expression is induced by the transcription factor NRF2 and is frequently up-regulated in cancer and stressed tissues as part of an antioxidant program. Its selective mitochondrial localization makes it a central node linking redox homeostasis to mitochondrial quality control and longevity.
context_zh_TW: 過氧化還原酶 3（PRDX3）的表現由轉錄因子 NRF2 誘導，並在癌症與受壓力的組織中作為抗氧化計畫的一部分而常被上調。其選擇性的粒線體定位使其成為連結氧化還原恆定與粒線體品質控制及長壽的關鍵節點。

label: contributes_to
context: Peroxynitrite contributes to atherosclerosis by depleting nitric oxide and impairing endothelium-dependent vasodilation, a hallmark of endothelial dysfunction. 3-Nitrotyrosine is elevated in human atherosclerotic plaques, and plasma nitrotyrosine levels independently predict cardiovascular events. This positions peroxynitrite as a central player in the earliest stage of atherosclerosis.
context_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 透過耗竭 nitric oxide 並損害內皮依賴性血管舒張（endothelial dysfunction 的特徵）來促成 atherosclerosis。3-Nitrotyrosine 在人體動脈粥狀硬化斑塊中升高，且血漿 nitrotyrosine 水平可獨立預測心血管事件。這使 peroxynitrite 成為 atherosclerosis 最早階段的核心角色。

label: damages
context: Peroxynitrite damages DNA mainly through guanine oxidation and the formation of 8-nitroguanine, a specific nitrative lesion that rapidly depurinates to generate abasic sites. 8-nitroguanine is also mutagenic, inducing G-to-T transversions, and has been detected in infected gastric epithelium and cholangiocarcinoma tissues. This links peroxynitrite to infection-associated carcinogenesis.
context_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 主要透過鳥嘌呤氧化與形成 8-nitroguanine 來損傷 DNA，後者是一種特異性的硝化損傷，會迅速去嘌呤產生無嘌呤位點。8-nitroguanine 也具有致突變性，誘導 G 至 T 的顛換，並已在受感染的胃上皮與 cholangiocarcinoma 組織中檢測到。這將 peroxynitrite 與感染相關的致癌作用連結起來。

label: induces
context: Peroxynitrite induces apoptosis by oxidizing mitochondrial components including thioredoxin 2 and the permeability transition pore, triggering mitochondrial swelling and cytochrome c release. The resultant opening of the permeability transition pore commits the cell to intrinsic apoptosis. This is prominent in ischemia-reperfusion injury and neurodegeneration.
context_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 透過氧化粒線體成分（包括 thioredoxin 2 與 permeability transition pore）誘導 apoptosis，觸發粒線體腫脹與 cytochrome c 釋放。由此造成的 permeability transition pore 開啟使細胞走向內源性凋亡。這在 ischemia-reperfusion injury 與神經退化中尤為明顯。

label: initiates
