context: Peroxynitrite initiates lipid peroxidation by abstracting hydrogen atoms from polyunsaturated fatty acids in cell membranes. The resulting lipid peroxyl radicals propagate chain reactions that generate malondialdehyde and 4-hydroxynonenal. This membrane damage is a key mechanism of peroxynitrite toxicity.
context_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 透過從細胞膜中的 polyunsaturated fatty acids 提取氫原子來啟動 lipid peroxidation。由此產生的脂質過氧化自由基傳播連鎖反應，生成 malondialdehyde 與 4-hydroxynonenal。這種膜損傷是 peroxynitrite 毒性的關鍵機制。

label: is_inactivated_by
context: Peroxynitrite oxidizes and inactivates Thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) along with mitochondrial permeability transition pore components. This oxidation contributes to mitochondrial swelling and apoptosis, linking nitrative stress to mitochondrial dysfunction.
context_zh_TW: 過氧亞硝酸鹽會與粒線體通透性轉換孔組成一起氧化並使 Thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) 失活。此氧化作用會促成粒線體腫脹與細胞凋亡，將硝化壓力與粒線體功能障礙連結起來。

label: oxidizes
context: Peroxynitrite oxidizes glutathione (GSH), which is the dominant cellular defense against this oxidant. The reaction converts GSH to sulfenic and sulfinic derivatives and glutathione disulfide, with a rate constant that makes GSH a kinetically relevant scavenger at millimolar concentrations. Depleting glutathione therefore increases susceptibility to peroxynitrite damage.
context_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 氧化 glutathione（GSH），後者是對抗此氧化劑的主要細胞防禦。此反應將 GSH 轉化為亞磺酸/次磺酸衍生物及 glutathione 二硫化物，其速率常數使 GSH 在毫莫耳濃度下成為動力學上相關的清除劑。因此耗竭 glutathione 會增加對 peroxynitrite 損傷的易感性。

label: is_phosphorylated_by
context: Protein kinase C beta (PKCbeta) phosphorylates TFEB at S466 and the cluster S461/S462 and S468, promoting its stability (PMID 23599343). Phosphorylation at S466 is shared with AMPK, which phosphorylates the same site to enhance transcriptional activity, while PKCbeta-mediated phosphorylation stabilizes the TFEB protein. By stabilizing TFEB, PKCbeta signaling can raise the cellular pool of the transcription factor available for nuclear translocation when other activating signals arrive. This illustrates how post-translational phosphorylation by multiple kinases converges on TFEB to control its abundance, localization, and activity, integrating diverse cellular signaling inputs into the regulation of lysosomal and autophagic gene expression.
context_zh_TW: 蛋白激酶 C beta（PKCbeta）在 S466 以及 S461/S462 和 S468 群簇上磷酸化 TFEB，促進其穩定性（PMID 23599343）。S466 的磷酸化與 AMPK 共享，AMPK 磷酸化同一部位以增強轉錄活性，而 PKCbeta 介導的磷酸化穩定 TFEB 蛋白。通過穩定 TFEB，PKCbeta 信號可以增加細胞中可用於核轉位的轉錄因子池，當其他啟動信號到達時。這說明多重激酶的翻譯後磷酸化如何匯聚在 TFEB 上，控制其豐度、定位和活性，將多樣的細胞信號輸入整合到溶酶體和自噬基因表達的調節中。

label: reduces
context: Protein restriction blunts age-associated increases in frailty, a state of vulnerability increasing risk of dependency, falls, hospitalization, and mortality. In mice, PR reduced frailty while extending lifespan (34.9% increase in males on a 21% vs 7% protein diet), and isoleucine and valine restriction likewise reduce frailty and extend healthspan. The relationship between protein and frailty is complex: some observational studies associate higher protein intake with reduced frailty risk, but a British twin study showed more protein is associated with increased sarcopenia risk, while a low-protein Mediterranean diet was associated with increased muscle mass and strength, and plant but not animal protein is associated with reduced frailty risk. Exercise can largely offset lean mass loss on low-protein diets.
context_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制減弱與年齡相關的虛弱增加，虛弱是增加依賴、跌倒、住院和死亡風險的脆弱狀態。在小鼠中，PR在延長壽命的同時減少虛弱（21%對7%蛋白質飲食的雄性小鼠壽命增加34.9%），異亮氨酸和纈氨酸限制同樣減少虛弱並延長健康span。蛋白質和虛弱的關係很複雜：一些觀察性研究將較高的蛋白質攝入與降低的虛弱風險相關聯，但一項英國雙胞胎研究顯示較多蛋白質與增加的肌肉減少症風險相關，而低蛋白地中海飲食與增加的肌肉質量和力量相關，植物蛋白而非動物蛋白與降低的虛弱風險相關。運動可以 largely offset 低蛋白飲食中的瘦體組織損失。

label: improves
context: Protein restriction improves glucose homeostasis and insulin sensitivity in both rodents and humans. In young and aged rodents, PR reduces body weight and fat mass, increases energy expenditure, and improves glucose handling even when initiated late in life. Randomized controlled trials in humans show low-protein diets reduce body weight, fat mass, and fasting blood glucose, improve insulin sensitivity, and lower hemoglobin A1C and kidney disease outcomes in diabetic patients. BCAA restriction similarly improves insulin sensitivity and glucose/insulin homeostasis in humans, and methionine restriction improves glucose homeostasis in humans on strict vegan diets. These metabolic benefits contrast with high-protein diets associated with increased diabetes risk.
context_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制改善囓齒動物和人類的葡萄糖恆定性和胰島素敏感性。在年輕和年老的囓齒動物中，PR減少體重和脂肪量，增加能量消耗，並改善葡萄糖處理，即使在生命晚期開始。人類的隨機對照試驗顯示低蛋白飲食減少體重、脂肪量和空腹血糖，改善胰島素敏感性，並降低糖尿病患者的血紅素A1C和腎臟疾病結果。BCAA限制同樣改善人類的胰島素敏感性和葡萄糖/胰島素恆定性，甲硫氨酸限制改善嚴格素食者的人類葡萄糖恆定性。這些代謝益處與與糖尿病風險增加相關的高蛋白飲食形成對比。

label: reduces
context: Protein restriction reduces cellular senescence, one of its six defined hallmarks. High-protein diets increase hepatic senescence and SASP, increase inflammation and senescence in white adipose tissue (reduced by PR through an FGF21-dependent mechanism), and promote senescent cell accumulation in the kidney, whereas PR reduces these burdens. FGF21 itself suppresses senescence in cultured cells, reducing drug-induced senescence and pro-inflammatory SASP markers. Isoleucine and valine restriction likewise reduce hepatic senescence and SASP. Because senescent cells drive tissue dysfunction and accelerate aging, PR's suppression of senescence represents a core mechanism linking dietary protein intake to healthspan.
context_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制減少細胞衰老，這是其六個定義標誌之一。高蛋白飲食增加肝臟衰老和SASP，增加白色脂肪組織的發炎和衰老（透過FGF21依賴的機制被PR減少），並促進腎臟中衰老細胞的累積，而PR減少這些負擔。FGF21本身抑制培養細胞的衰老，減少藥物誘導的衰老和促發炎SASP標誌物。異亮氨酸和纈氨酸限制同樣減少肝臟衰老和SASP。由於衰老細胞驅動組織功能障礙並加速老化，PR對衰老的抑制代表了一個核心機制，將飲食蛋白質攝入與健康span聯繫起來。

label: upregulates
context: Pyrimidine starvation induced by Cyclopentenyl cytosine activates DNA damage responses that include p53-associated checkpoints. Stabilization of p53 couples the metabolic perturbation to cell cycle arrest and the senescent phenotype.
context_zh_TW: Cyclopentenyl cytosine 誘導的嘧啶缺乏會活化包含 p53 相關檢查點的 DNA 損傷反應。p53 的穩定化將代謝擾動與細胞週期停滯及衰老表型連結起來。

label: is_activated_by
context: Pyroptosis is initiated by the assembly of inflammasomes containing a pattern recognition receptor, ASC, and pro-caspase-1, which activates Caspase-1. Active Caspase-1 cleaves pro-IL-1beta and pro-IL-18 into mature forms and cleaves Gasdermin D to execute pyroptosis. Caspase-1 is therefore the central executor protease of pyroptosis.
context_zh_TW: Pyroptosis 由含有模式識別受體、ASC 和 pro-caspase-1 的發炎小體組裝所啟動，並激活 Caspase-1。活化的 Caspase-1 將 pro-IL-1beta 和 pro-IL-18 裂解為成熟形式，並裂解 Gasdermin D 以執行細胞焦亡。因此 Caspase-1 是細胞焦亡的核心執行蛋白酶。

label: inhibits
context: Quercetin is a flavonoid polyphenol with reported anti-glycation properties. Along with kaempferol, genistein, and quercitrin, quercetin inhibits the glycation process in vitro, and the anti-glycation activities of several polyphenols are similar to or even stronger than the reference inhibitor aminoguanidine. These flavonoids act partly through high antioxidant capacity, which counteracts the ROS that accelerate glycation. Because naturally occurring phytochemicals are relatively safe and available in oral forms, flavonoid-rich herbs are promising agents for the prevention of glycation and AGE formation.
context_zh_TW: Quercetin 是一種據報導具有抗糖化特性的類黃酮多酚。與 kaempferol、genistein 和 quercitrin 一起，quercetin 在體外抑制糖化過程，且數種多酚的抗糖化活性類似於或甚至強於參考抑制劑 aminoguanidine。這些類黃酮部分透過高抗氧化能力作用，抵消加速糖化的 ROS。由於天然存在的植物化學物質相對安全且可供口服形式，富含類黃酮的草藥是用於預防糖化與 AGE 形成的極具潛力物質。

label: activates
context: RAGE activates mTOR through the PI3K/Akt pathway upon ligand engagement, which in turn inhibits autophagy and promotes inflammatory gene expression. This places RAGE upstream of a major metabolic and pro-inflammatory signaling node. The PI3K/Akt-mTOR arm is one of several RAGE-triggered cascades, alongside NF-kB, MAPK, and JAK/STAT signaling.
context_zh_TW: RAGE 在配體結合時透過 PI3K/Akt 途徑活化 mTOR，後者進而抑制 autophagy 並促進發炎基因表現。這使 RAGE 位於主要代謝與促發炎訊號節點的上游。PI3K/Akt-mTOR 臂是 RAGE 觸發的幾個級聯之一，此外還有 NF-kB、MAPK 與 JAK/STAT 訊號。

label: contributes_to
context: RAGE contributes to atherosclerosis through AGE-driven inflammatory signaling and its role in diabetic vasculopathy. RAGE activation upregulates NF-kB target genes including COX-2 and iNOS, amplifying oxidative stress and vascular injury. Recombinant sRAGE attenuates disease progression in preclinical models of atherosclerosis and diabetic vasculopathy.
context_zh_TW: RAGE 透過 AGE 驅動的發炎訊號及其在糖尿病血管病變中的角色，促成 atherosclerosis。RAGE 活化會上調包括 COX-2 與 iNOS 在內的 NF-kB 標靶基因，放大氧化壓力與血管損傷。重組 sRAGE 在 atherosclerosis 與糖尿病血管病變的臨床前模型中能減緩疾病進展。

label: inhibits
context: RAGE inhibits autophagy through activation of the PI3K/Akt pathway and mTOR, shifting cells from autophagic clearance toward sustained inflammatory signaling. This inhibition may impair clearance of aminochrome-damaged mitochondria in the adrenochrome pathway. Prolonged RAGE activation thereby promotes a pro-inflammatory and pro-fibrotic state.
context_zh_TW: RAGE 透過活化 PI3K/Akt 途徑與 mTOR 抑制 autophagy，使細胞從自噬清除轉向持續的發炎訊號。此抑制作用可能損害 adrenochrome 途徑中受 aminochrome 損傷粒線體的清除。因此，長期 RAGE 活化會促進促發炎與促纖維化狀態。

label: is_cleaved_by
context: RAGE is cleaved by the metalloprotease ADAM10 (and by MMP9), generating soluble RAGE (sRAGE) that lacks the transmembrane and intracellular domains. sRAGE functions as a decoy receptor, sequestering RAGE ligands and preventing membrane-bound RAGE activation. Low serum sRAGE levels are a biomarker for increased disease risk.
context_zh_TW: RAGE 會被金屬蛋白酶 ADAM10（以及 MMP9）裂解，產生缺乏跨膜與胞內結構域的 soluble RAGE（sRAGE）。sRAGE 作為誘餌受體，隔離 RAGE 配體並阻止膜結合 RAGE 的活化。低血清 sRAGE 水平是疾病風險增加的生物標記。

label: promotes
context: RAGE promotes insulin resistance in diabetes, where chronic hyperglycemia drives AGE formation that engages RAGE. RAGE signaling contributes to endothelial dysfunction, podocyte injury, and atherosclerosis underlying diabetic complications. This makes RAGE a key mediator linking chronic hyperglycemia to metabolic and vascular pathology.
context_zh_TW: RAGE 在 diabetes 中促進 insulin resistance，其中慢性高血糖驅動 AGE 形成並啟動 RAGE。RAGE 訊號促成 endothelial dysfunction、足細胞損傷與 atherosclerosis，這些是糖尿病併發症的基礎。這使 RAGE 成為連結慢性高血糖與代謝及血管病理的關鍵介導者。

label: is_overexpressed_in
context: RRM2 is overexpressed in many tumor types and correlates with poor prognosis and chemoresistance. Because normal quiescent tissues have low RRM2, blocking it preferentially hurts proliferating tumor and leukemic cells.
context_zh_TW: RRM2 在許多腫瘤類型中被過度表現，並與不良預後及化學抗藥性相關。由於正常靜止組織的 RRM2 濃度低，阻斷 RRM2 會優先傷害增殖中的腫瘤與白血病細胞。

label: supports
context: Rapamycin's geroprotective effects are often attributed to autophagy induction, yet autophagy has dual, context-dependent roles in cancer: while it may suppress tumor initiation by clearing damaged cellular components, it can also support the survival and growth of established tumors by providing substrates for metabolism and clearing damage that would otherwise be lethal. Thus enhancing autophagy in aging populations with elevated cancer risks and an unknown genetic background may inadvertently promote oncogenesis.
context_zh_TW: 雷帕黴素的老年保護（geroprotective）效果常歸因於自噬的誘導，然而自噬在癌症中具有雙重且依賴情境的角色：一方面，它可透過清除受損的細胞成分來抑制腫瘤起始；另一方面，它也能透過提供代謝受質、清除否則將致死的損傷，來支持已形成腫瘤的存活與生長。因此，在癌症風險升高且遺傳背景未知的衰老族群中增強自噬，可能無意間促進腫瘤發生。

label: is_driven_by
context: Recurrent mutations in the DNA methyltransferase DNMT3a occur in approximately 20% of acute myeloid leukemia cases, with the R882H hotspot most frequent. These mutations reduce methyltransferase activity and disrupt DNA methylation at regulatory regions controlling stem cell behavior. This epigenetic dysregulation cooperates with other mutations to drive leukemogenesis.
context_zh_TW: DNA 甲基轉移酶 DNMT3a 的反覆突變發生在約 20% 的急性骨髓性白血病病例中，其中 R882H 熱點最常見。這些突變降低甲基轉移酶活性，並擾亂控制幹細胞行為的調控區域之 DNA 甲基化。這種表觀遺傳失調與其他突變合作驅動白血病發生。

label: depletes
context: Redox cycling of adrenochrome generates reactive oxygen species and depletes cellular antioxidants such as glutathione under physiological conditions, contributing to its cardiotoxicity. Glutathione is the major cellular thiol antioxidant and also the cofactor for glyoxalase-mediated dicarbonyl detoxification, so its depletion by adrenochrome would compound both oxidative and glycation stress. This is why free adrenochrome is considered highly unstable and hazardous, and why stable conjugates like adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine were developed. The balance between redox-modulating benefit and glutathione-depleting toxicity is central to evaluating adrenochrome-derived compounds.
context_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 的氧化還原循環在生理條件下產生活性氧物種並耗竭麩胱甘肽等細胞抗氧化劑，促成其心臟毒性。麩胱甘肽是主要的細胞硫醇抗氧化劑，也是 glyoxalase 介導二羰基解毒的輔因子，因此 adrenochrome 對其的耗竭會同時加劇氧化與糖化壓力。這就是為何游離 adrenochrome 被視為極不穩定且危險，以及為何開發出如 adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine 等穩定共軛物。氧化還原調節的益處與耗竭麩胱甘肽的毒性之間的平衡，是評估 adrenochrome 衍生化合物的核心。

label: is_decreased_in
context: Reduced SIRT6 expression contributes to COPD through insufficient autophagy and cellular senescence during cigarette-smoke exposure, while SIRT6 overexpression weakens autophagy via the IGF-Akt-mTOR axis. SIRT3 inhibits airway epithelial mitochondrial oxidative stress to attenuate COPD progression, and SIRT1 is substantially decreased in COPD and emphysema lungs.
context_zh_TW: SIRT6 表現減少透過香菸煙霧暴露期間自噬不足與細胞衰老促成 COPD，而 SIRT6 過度表現經由 IGF-Akt-mTOR 軸減弱自噬。SIRT3 抑制氣道上皮粒線體氧化壓力以減緩 COPD 進展，且 SIRT1 在 COPD 與肺氣腫肺中大幅減少。

label: is_inhibited_by
context: Reduced Thioredoxin-1 binds the N-terminal domain of ASK1, maintaining the kinase in an inactive monomeric state. Oxidation of Thioredoxin-1 during oxidative stress releases ASK1 from this inhibition. Thioredoxin-1 thus functions as a key redox-sensitive inhibitor of ASK1 activity.
context_zh_TW: 還原態的 Thioredoxin-1 與 ASK1 的 N 端結構域結合，使激酶維持在不活化的單體狀態。在氧化壓力期間，Thioredoxin-1 的氧化會使 ASK1 脫離此抑制。因此 Thioredoxin-1 是 ASK1 活性的關鍵氧化還原敏感性抑制因子。

label: erases
context: Reprogramming is the proof that aging is substantially epigenetic: information loss (epigenetic drift) rather than pure damage accumulation. The ICE mouse experiments and reprogramming share this mechanistic frame, with aging positioned as a reversible epigenetic state.
context_zh_TW: Reprogramming 證明年齡在很大程度上是表觀遺傳性的：是資訊流失（表觀遺傳漂移）而非單純的損害累積。ICE 小鼠實驗和重編程共享此機制框架，將老化定位為可逆的表觀遺傳狀態。

label: activates
context: Resveratrol is a SIRT1-activating compound (STAC) evaluated clinically with mixed results and now largely a research/nutraceutical. As a SIRT1 activator it improves insulin sensitivity and opposes several age-related diseases, though in bulk-phase physiology it protects the epigenome without inhibiting COMT.
context_zh_TW: Resveratrol 是一種 SIRT1 活化化合物（STAC），臨床評估結果好壞參半，現在主要為研究／營養保健品。作為 SIRT1 活化劑，它改善胰島素敏感性並對抗多種年齡相關疾病，儘管在整體相（bulk-phase）生理學中它保護表觀基因組而不抑制 COMT。

label: accelerates
context: Rifampicin is a hepatic enzyme inducer that can increase the activity of certain metabolic enzymes in the liver, potentially accelerating the metabolism of urolithin A and reducing its half-life in the body. This illustrates the broader principle that drugs interacting with cytochrome P450 enzymes in the liver can competitively inhibit or induce these enzymes, thereby disrupting the metabolism and clearance of urolithin A and altering its systemic exposure. Common antibiotics, antifungal drugs, and anticancer drugs have been reported to interact with CYP450 enzymes in this way.
context_zh_TW: Rifampicin 是一種肝臟酶誘導劑，可提升肝臟中某些代謝酶的活性，可能加速 urolithin A 的代謝並縮短其在體內的半衰期。這說明了更廣泛的原則：與肝臟中 cytochrome P450 酶交互作用的藥物，可競爭性抑制或誘導這些酶，從而干擾 urolithin A 的代謝與清除，並改變其全身暴露量。常見的抗生素、抗真菌藥物與抗癌藥物皆曾被報導以這種方式與 CYP450 酶交互作用。

label: is_a_type_of
context: SADS (senescence-associated distal satellite) is a form of heterochromatin decompaction in senescent cells, specifically the relaxation of constitutive pericentromeric and pericentrosomal satellite heterochromatin. Unlike SAHF (which compacts facultative heterochromatin), SADS decompacts constitutive repeats. This structural change alters the nuclear architecture and chromatin accessibility of repetitive regions. SADS represents a distinct, counterintuitive chromatin reorganization during senescence.
context_zh_TW: SADS（senescence-associated distal satellite，衰老相關遠端衛星）是衰老細胞中異染色質去緻密化的一種形式，具體為組成性著絲粒周與中心體周衛星異染色質的鬆弛。不同於 SAHF（緻密化兼性異染色質），SADS 去緻密化組成性重複序列。此結構改變改變重複區域的核架構與染色質可及性。SADS 代表衰老期間一種獨特、違反直覺的染色質重組。

label: uses
context: SARM1 is a NAD+-consuming enzyme, grouped with CD38 and CD157 as an NAD+ glycohydrolase that degrades the coenzyme in signaling and stress pathways. Alongside ADP-ribosyl transferases, poly-ADP polymerases, and sirtuins, SARM1 mediates essential NAD+-dependent processes such as DNA repair, apoptosis, cell survival, lifespan regulation, and metabolic adjustments. Its NAD+ consumption contributes to the constant synthesis-catabolism-recycling cycle that sustains NAD+ levels, and disturbances that shift this balance, such as aging or infection, can reduce NAD+ availability. Dietary precursors like NMN and NR counter this by replenishing the NAD+ pool consumed by these signaling enzymes.
context_zh_TW: SARM1 是一種消耗 NAD+ 的酵素，與 CD38 和 CD157 同屬 NAD+ 糖苷水解酶，在訊號傳導與壓力路徑中降解此輔酶。與 ADP-ribosyl transferases、poly-ADP polymerases 和 sirtuins 一起，SARM1 介導 DNA 修復、凋亡、細胞存活、壽命調控與代謝調整等必需的 NAD+ 依賴性過程。其 NAD+ 消耗作用有助於維持 NAD+ 濃度恆定的合成—分解—再循環週期，而老化或感染等使此平衡偏移的擾動，會降低 NAD+ 的可利用性。NMN 與 NR 等膳食前驅物透過補充這些訊號酵素所消耗的 NAD+ 庫存來對抗此現象。

label: is_neuroprotective_in
context: SIRT1 ameliorates the autophagic degradation of alpha-synuclein by deacetylating LC3 and improves motor defects in Parkinson's disease. This connects sirtuin activity directly to clearance of the pathological protein aggregate central to PD. SIRT1's pro-autophagy action here contrasts with SIRT2, which mediates exacerbation of alpha-synuclein toxicity.
context_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 LC3 改善 alpha-synuclein 的自噬降解，並改善帕金森氏症的運動缺陷。這將 sirtuin 活性直接連結至 PD 核心病理蛋白聚集體的清除。SIRT1 此處的促自噬作用與介導加劇 alpha-synuclein 毒性的 SIRT2 形成對比。

label: participates in
context: SIRT1 and caspases form a reciprocal crosstalk in which caspases cleave SIRT1, converting it into a pro-apoptotic death promoter. This axis runs backwards from the SIRT1-to-caspase suppression loop as a caspase-to-SIRT1 cleavage switch during apoptosis.
context_zh_TW: SIRT1 與 caspase 形成相互作用的串聯關係，其中 caspase 裂解 SIRT1，使其轉變為促凋亡的死亡促進者。此軸向在細胞凋亡中，從 SIRT1 抑制 caspase 的迴路反轉為 caspase 裂解 SIRT1 的開關。

label: suppresses
context: SIRT1 can also act as a tumor suppressor by inhibiting beta-catenin and NF-kB signaling, in contrast to its oncogenic role of deacetylating and inactivating p53. This context-dependent duality is why SIRT1 is described as a molecular 'shapeshifter' whose actions demand biomarker-guided strategies for clinical translation.
context_zh_TW: SIRT1 也可透過抑制 β-catenin 和 NF-kB 信號作為腫瘤抑制因子，與其去乙醯化並使 p53 失活的致癌角色形成對比。這種依賴情境的雙重性，是 SIRT1 被描述為分子「變形者」、其作用需要生物標記引導策略才能臨床轉化的原因。

label: triggers
context: SIRT1 cleavage and ubiquitination-mediated degradation are not unique to DNA damage — they also occur during mitosis. Synchronized cells (double-thymidine block, nocodazole) lose SIRT1 as they enter M phase in an MG132-sensitive, Boc-D-FMK-sensitive, transcription-independent manner, with TRIM28-SIRT1 colocalization peaking in prometaphase/metaphase. ATM phosphorylates TRIM28 Ser824 in mitosis as well, dislodging it from heterochromatin — so the same destruction axis runs in dividing cells.
context_zh_TW: SIRT1 的切割與泛素化降解並非 DNA 損傷所獨有——在有絲分裂期間也會發生。同步化細胞（雙重胸腺嘧啶阻斷、nocodazole）進入 M 期時會以 MG132 敏感、Boc-D-FMK 敏感且不依賴轉錄的方式失去 SIRT1，TRIM28-SIRT1 的共定位在前/中期達到高峰。ATM 在有絲分裂中同樣會將 TRIM28 Ser824 磷酸化，使其脫離異染色質——因此同一破壞軸也在分裂細胞中運作。

label: deacetylates
context: SIRT1 deacetylates IRS-2, enabling efficient tyrosine phosphorylation and PI3K-Akt insulin signaling. This supports SIRT1's insulin-sensitizing effects and its role in metabolic homeostasis.
context_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化 IRS-2，使其能有效進行酪胺酸磷酸化和 PI3K–Akt 胰島素信號傳導。這支持 SIRT1 的胰島素增敏作用及其在代謝恆定中的角色。

label: deacetylates
context: SIRT1 deacetylates Smad7 at Lys60/Lys70, promoting ubiquitin-dependent proteasomal degradation via Smurf1. This protects glomerular mesangial cells from TGF-beta-dependent apoptosis.
context_zh_TW: SIRT1 在 Lys60/Lys70 去乙醯化 Smad7，透過 Smurf1 促進依賴泛素的蛋白酶體降解。這保護腎小球系膜細胞免受依賴 TGF-β 的凋亡。

label: deacetylates
context: SIRT1 enhances beneficial autophagy in Alzheimer's disease by deacetylating Beclin-1, and in Parkinson's disease it ameliorates LC3-deacetylation-mediated autophagic degradation of alpha-synuclein to improve motor defects. Pro-autophagic SIRT1 action thereby helps clear pathological protein aggregates in neurodegeneration.
context_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 Beclin-1 增強阿茲海默症中的有益自噬，且在帕金森氏症中改善 LC3 去乙醯化介導的 alpha-synuclein 自噬降解以改進運動缺陷。促自噬的 SIRT1 作用因此有助清除神經退化中的病理蛋白聚集體。

label: nullifies
context: SIRT1 is overexpressed in HPV-infected cervical cancer cells and nullifies AIM2 inflammasome-mediated immunity, correlating with poor clinical outcomes. This immunosuppressive action allows cervical cancer cells to evade inflammasome-driven clearance, positioning SIRT1 as an oncogenic factor in HPV-driven cervical cancer.
context_zh_TW: SIRT1 在 HPV 感染的子宮頸癌細胞中過度表現，並使 AIM2 發炎體介導的免疫失效，與不良臨床結果相關。此免疫抑制作用使子宮頸癌細胞逃避免炎體驅動的清除，將 SIRT1 定位為 HPV 驅動子宮頸癌中的致癌因子。

label: is_protective_in
context: SIRT1 is protective in acute pancreatitis via deacetylation of p53 and HSF1, dampening acinar-cell damage. In chronic pancreatitis, however, SIRT1 is upregulated and drives inflammation-induced EMT through the miR-278 axis, illustrating a context-dependent switch from protection to pathogenesis within the same organ.
context_zh_TW: SIRT1 在急性胰臟炎中透過 p53 與 HSF1 去乙醯化具有保護性，減弱腺泡細胞損傷。然而在慢性胰臟炎中，SIRT1 上調並透過 miR-278 軸驅動發炎誘發的 EMT，體現同一器官內從保護到致病的情境依賴轉換。

label: is_protective_in
context: SIRT1 is protective in diabetic kidney disease by deacetylating p53 and activating FoxO3a and Nrf2, and resveratrol promotes resistance to diabetic renal fibrosis via Nrf2. These antioxidant and anti-apoptotic actions defend podocytes and the renal tubulointerstitium against hyperglycemic damage.
context_zh_TW: SIRT1 在糖尿病腎臟疾病中具保護性，透過去乙醯化 p53 並活化 FoxO3a 與 Nrf2，且 resveratrol 透過 Nrf2 促進對糖尿病腎纖維化的抗性。這些抗氧化與抗凋亡作用防禦足細胞與腎小管間質免於高血糖損傷。

label: is_protective_in
context: SIRT1 is protective in osteoarthritis by reducing chondrocyte apoptosis and ECM degradation via Wnt/beta-catenin signaling, reversing homocysteine-induced changes through the PGC-1alpha/PPAR-gamma cascade, inhibiting EGFR ubiquitination, and inhibiting chondrocyte senescence. SIRT1 therefore maintains cartilage homeostasis on multiple axes.
context_zh_TW: SIRT1 在骨關節炎中具保護性，透過 Wnt/beta-catenin 訊號減少軟骨細胞凋亡與 ECM 降解，經由 PGC-1alpha/PPAR-gamma 級聯逆轉同半胱氨酸誘發的變化，抑制 EGFR 泛素化，並抑制軟骨細胞衰老。SIRT1 因此在多軸線上維持軟骨穩態。

label: is_protective_in
context: SIRT1 is protective in osteoporosis: SIRT1 knockout mice have low bone mass, SIRT1 increases osteoblast osteogenesis via FoxO3a, and it deacetylates sclerostin to promote Wnt/beta-catenin signaling. Resveratrol restores alkaline phosphatase and osteocalcin via NF-kB. SIRT1 thus supports bone formation and opposes age-related bone loss.
context_zh_TW: SIRT1 在骨質疏鬆症中具保護性：SIRT1 基因敲除小鼠骨量低，SIRT1 透過 FoxO3a 增加造骨細胞成骨，且去乙醯化 sclerostin 以促進 Wnt/beta-catenin 訊號。Resveratrol 透過 NF-kB 恢復鹼性磷酸酶與骨鈣素。SIRT1 因此支持骨形成並對抗年齡相關骨流失。

label: is_decreased_in
context: SIRT1 is reduced in degenerative nucleus pulposus tissues with severity, and inhibits NF-kB transcriptional activity while suppressing c-Fos/c-Jun phosphorylation. SIRT2 reverses IL-1beta action by inhibiting the p53/p21 pathway, SIRT3 maintains nucleus pulposus cell homeostasis, and SIRT6 inhibits inflammatory responses and senescence via NF-kB in IDD.
context_zh_TW: SIRT1 在退行性髓核組織中隨嚴重程度減少，並抑制 NF-kB 轉錄活性同時抑制 c-Fos/c-Jun 磷酸化。SIRT2 透過抑制 p53/p21 路徑逆轉 IL-1beta 作用，SIRT3 維持髓核細胞穩態，且 SIRT6 在 IDD 中透過 NF-kB 抑制發炎反應與衰老。

label: is_protective_in
context: SIRT1 overexpression abolishes TGF-beta1-induced apoptosis and fibrosis through CTGF suppression, and SRT1720 attenuates UUO fibrosis, while SIRT1 represses HIF2alpha. However, SIRT1 downregulation may also inhibit fibroblast activation via EGFR/PDGFR-beta, creating therapeutic ambiguity. The dominant role is renoprotective, opposing tubulointerstitial fibrosis.
context_zh_TW: SIRT1 過度表現透過抑制 CTGF 廢除 TGF-beta1 誘發的凋亡與纖維化，且 SRT1720 減弱 UUO 纖維化，而 SIRT1 抑制 HIF2alpha。然而，SIRT1 下調亦可經由 EGFR/PDGFR-beta 抑制纖維母細胞活化，造成治療上的曖昧。其優勢角色為腎保護，對抗小管間質纖維化。

label: is_protective_in
context: SIRT1 overexpression prevents capillary cell apoptosis and degenerative capillary formation in diabetic retinopathy, reduces DM-induced retinal inflammation, and improves visual function. In diabetic cardiomyopathy SIRT1 activation inhibits ROS-induced oxidative stress and fibrosis, while SIRT3 regulates fibrosis, inflammation, apoptosis, and oxidative stress in the diabetic myocardium.
context_zh_TW: SIRT1 過度表現防止糖尿病視網膜病變中的微血管細胞凋亡與退行性微血管形成，減少 DM 誘發的視網膜發炎，並改善視覺功能。在糖尿病性心肌病中，SIRT1 活化抑制 ROS 誘發的氧化壓力與纖維化，而 SIRT3 調節糖尿病心肌中的纖維化、發炎、凋亡與氧化壓力。

label: deacetylates
context: SIRT1 promotes T-ALL progression by deacetylating CDK2, which drives p27 phosphorylation and degradation, and SIRT1 knockdown sensitizes AML to tyrosine kinase inhibitor treatment. SIRT2 activation by NAMPT reduces proliferation and induces apoptosis in AML blasts via the Akt/GSK-3beta/beta-catenin axis, showing opposing leukemic roles for the two sirtuins.
context_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 CDK2 促進 T-ALL 進展，後者驅動 p27 磷酸化與降解，且 SIRT1 敲低使 AML 對酪胺酸激酶抑制劑治療敏感。SIRT2 經由 NAMPT 活化透過 Akt/GSK-3beta/beta-catenin 軸減少增生並誘發 AML 母細胞凋亡，顯示兩個 sirtuin 相反的白血病角色。

label: protects against
context: SIRT1 reduces Abeta-induced senescence and mitochondrial dysfunction, reduces tau O-GlcNAcylation via CREB, and enhances Beclin-1 deacetylation for beneficial autophagy in Alzheimer's disease. Inverse serum and saliva SIRT1 levels with AD suggest noninvasive diagnostic potential.
context_zh_TW: 在阿茲海默症中，SIRT1 可減少 β-澱粉樣蛋白誘導的衰老與粒線體功能障礙、透過 CREB 減少 tau 的 O-GlcNAc 修飾，並增強 Beclin-1 去乙醯化以促進有益自噬。血清與唾液 SIRT1 濃度與 AD 呈反向關係，具有非侵入性診斷潛力。

label: reduces
context: SIRT1 reduces O-GlcNAcylation of tau via CREB in Alzheimer's disease, and SIRT3 plays a role in tau acetylation as a potential therapy target. SIRT2 affects tau phosphorylation and autophagic flux, and nuclear SIRT2 is hyperactivated in AD where FoxO1 recruits it to Fzd1/Fzd7 promoters to reduce H4K16ac.
context_zh_TW: SIRT1 在阿茲海默症中透過 CREB 減少 tau 的 O-GlcNAcylation，且 SIRT3 在 tau 乙醯化中扮演角色，作為潛在治療標的。SIRT2 影響 tau 磷酸化與自噬流，核 SIRT2 在 AD 中過度活化，其中 FoxO1 將其招募至 Fzd1/Fzd7 啟動子以降低 H4K16ac。

label: deacetylates
context: SIRT1 restores SERCA2a activity in failing hearts via deacetylation at K492, recovering calcium handling and contractility. SIRT1 is decreased in advanced heart failure, and its loss attenuates the anti-oxidative, anti-apoptotic defenses mediated by MnSOD, thioredoxin 1, Bcl-xL, and FoxO1 nuclear translocation.
context_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過在 K492 去乙醯化恢復衰竭心臟中 SERCA2a 活性，恢復鈣處理與收縮性。SIRT1 在晚期心臟衰竭中減少，其缺失減弱由 MnSOD、thioredoxin 1、Bcl-xL 與 FoxO1 核轉位介導的抗氧化、抗凋亡防禦。

label: suppresses
context: SIRT1 suppresses Caspase-1 (pyroptosis) via the NRF2/PGC-1alpha axis, and suppresses Caspase-3/Caspase-7 via FOXO4, establishing sirtuins as upstream brakes on both apoptotic and pyroptotic execution; SIRT2 is the exception that promotes apoptosis.
context_zh_TW: SIRT1 經由 NRF2/PGC-1alpha 軸抑制 Caspase-1（細胞焦亡），並經由 FOXO4 抑制 Caspase-3/Caspase-7，使 sirtuins 成為細胞凋亡與焦亡執行的上游煞車；SIRT2 是特例，會促進細胞凋亡。

label: is_protective_in
context: SIRT1 suppresses intestinal epithelial ROS accumulation and apoptosis after ischemia-reperfusion, and resveratrol protects through the SIRT1-NF-kB-iNOS-NO pathway. SIRT3 alleviates mitochondrial oxidative damage and apoptosis via peroxiredoxin 3 deacetylation, while SIRT6 downregulation by miR-351-5p aggravates intestinal IRI injury.
context_zh_TW: SIRT1 抑制缺血—再灌流後的腸上皮 ROS 累積與凋亡，且 resveratrol 透過 SIRT1-NF-kB-iNOS-NO 路徑保護。SIRT3 經由 peroxiredoxin 3 去乙醯化減輕粒線體氧化損傷與凋亡，而 SIRT6 經由 miR-351-5p 下調加劇腸 IRI 損傷。

label: deacetylates
context: SIRT1-mediated deacetylation of TRIM28 stabilizes its interaction with 53BP1 and enhances non-homologous end-joining (NHEJ) repair, prior to its role as the damage-induced E3 for SIRT1. This reciprocal relationship places SIRT1 and TRIM28 in a coordinated DNA-damage-response axis.
context_zh_TW: SIRT1 介導的 TRIM28 去乙醯化穩定其與 53BP1 的相互作用並增強非同源末端接合（NHEJ）修復，這發生在 TRIM28 作為損傷誘導的 SIRT1 E3 連接酶之前。這種互惠關係使 SIRT1 和 TRIM28 處於協調的 DNA 損傷反應軸中。

label: promotes
context: SIRT2 enhances allergic asthmatic inflammation: pharmacologic ablation attenuates the phenotype while genetic overexpression exaggerates it, and SIRT2 aggravates asthma through Th2 responses and macrophage polarization. Unlike the protective SIRT1 and SIRT3 in asthma, SIRT2 is harmful, exemplifying the counter-regulatory relationship between SIRT2 and the protective sirtuins in allergic airway disease.
context_zh_TW: SIRT2 增強過敏性氣喘發炎：藥理去除減弱表型，而基因過度表現誇大之，且 SIRT2 透過 Th2 反應與巨噬細胞極化加劇氣喘。不同於氣喘中保護性的 SIRT1 與 SIRT3，SIRT2 是有害的，體現了過敏性氣道疾病中 SIRT2 與保護性 sirtuin 之間的相反調節關係。

label: is_harmful_in
context: SIRT2 is detrimental in liver ischemia-reperfusion injury: it deacetylates MAPK phosphatase-1 to activate MAPK and augment inflammatory responses and cell death, whereas SIRT1 and SIRT3 are protective. SIRT1 is decreased after IRI and its high levels predict superior survival in human liver transplants via suppression of mitochondrial dysfunction through MFN2.
context_zh_TW: SIRT2 在肝缺血—再灌流損傷中是有害的：它去乙醯化 MAPK 磷酸酶-1 以活化 MAPK 並加劇發炎反應與細胞死亡，而 SIRT1 與 SIRT3 具保護性。SIRT1 在 IRI 後減少，且其高水平透過 MFN2 抑制粒線體功能障礙預測人類肝移植的優越存活。

label: is_protective_in
context: SIRT2 is protective in osteoarthritis by preventing p65 acetylation to inhibit ECM degradation, and SIRT6 inhibits chondrocyte senescence by negatively regulating NF-kB-mediated inflammatory responses. SIRT1 reduces chondrocyte apoptosis and ECM degradation via Wnt/beta-catenin, while SIRT3 has a dual role dependent on SOD2 acetylation status.
context_zh_TW: SIRT2 在骨關節炎中具保護性，透過防止 p65 乙醯化以抑制 ECM 降解，且 SIRT6 透過負調節 NF-kB 介導的發炎反應抑制軟骨細胞衰老。SIRT1 透過 Wnt/beta-catenin 減少軟骨細胞凋亡與 ECM 降解，而 SIRT3 具有依賴 SOD2 乙醯化狀態的雙重角色。

label: is_harmful_in
context: SIRT2 mediates exacerbation of alpha-synuclein toxicity in Parkinson's disease, and SIRT2 deletion is protective. NAD+ metabolism alterations activate SIRT2, which decreases acetylated alpha-tubulin and contributes to cytoskeletal dysfunction. This is the rationale behind testing SIRT2 inhibitors such as AK-7 and SirReal2 for PD, although results remain preclinical.
context_zh_TW: SIRT2 介導帕金森氏症中 alpha-synuclein 毒性的加劇，且 SIRT2 缺失具保護性。NAD+ 代謝改變活化 SIRT2，後者降低乙醯化 alpha-tubulin 並促成細胞骨架功能障礙。這是在 PD 中測試 SIRT2 抑制劑（如 AK-7 與 SirReal2）的理據，儘管結果仍處於臨床前階段。

label: prevents
context: SIRT2 prevents NAFLD by deacetylating hepatocyte nuclear factor 4 alpha, but is deleterious in hepatic fibrosis through the SIRT2/ERK/c-Myc axis. SIRT4 upregulation inhibits high-fat-diet-induced lipid accumulation, inflammation, and fibrogenesis via the SIRT4/Smad4 axis, though SIRT4 is harmful in NAFLD by destabilizing mitochondrial trifunctional protein alpha.
context_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化肝細胞核因子 4 alpha 防止 NAFLD，但在肝纖維化中透過 SIRT2/ERK/c-Myc 軸是有害的。SIRT4 上調透過 SIRT4/Smad4 軸抑制高脂飲食誘發的脂質堆積、發炎與纖維生成，儘管 SIRT4 在 NAFLD 中因不穩定粒線體三功能蛋白質 alpha 而有害。

label: deacetylates
context: SIRT2 promotes tumor glycolysis in some settings by deacetylating phosphoglycerate mutase at Lys100, channeling carbon into NADPH production and accelerating tumor growth in lung cancer. This illustrates SIRT2's context-dependent, often harmful, metabolic face versus the protective SIRT1/3/6 axis.
context_zh_TW: SIRT2 在某些情境下透過在 Lys100 去乙醯化 phosphoglycerate mutase 促進腫瘤糖解，將碳引導至 NADPH 生成並加速肺癌中的腫瘤生長。這體現 SIRT2 相對於保護性 SIRT1/3/6 軸、常為有害的、情境依賴的代謝面貌。

label: is_harmful_in
context: SIRT2 suppression alleviates amyloid-beta pathology and cognitive deficits in Alzheimer's disease by inhibiting beta-secretase 1 (BACE1) via reticulon 4B deacetylation. Nuclear SIRT2 is hyperactivated in AD, recruited by FoxO1 to the Fzd1 and Fzd7 promoters to reduce H4K16ac, and SIRT2 inhibition recovers microtubule stabilization and autophagic flux. SIRT2 is thus a harmful, druggable target in AD, opposing protective SIRT1 and SIRT3.
context_zh_TW: SIRT2 抑制透過網狀蛋白 4B（reticulon 4B）去乙醯化抑制 beta-secretase 1（BACE1），減輕阿茲海默症的類澱粉-beta 病理與認知缺陷。核 SIRT2 在 AD 中過度活化，被 FoxO1 招募至 Fzd1 與 Fzd7 啟動子以降低 H4K16ac，且 SIRT2 抑制可恢復微管穩定與自噬流。SIRT2 因此是 AD 中一個有害、可藥物化的標的，對抗保護性的 SIRT1 與 SIRT3。

label: drives
context: SIRT3 couples the glycolysis-to-OXPHOS switch to the redox setpoint, conferring metabolic plasticity in a tumor-type-, stage- and microenvironment-dependent manner. This makes SIRT3 a context-dependent tumor suppressor or oncogene.
context_zh_TW: SIRT3 將糖解作用至氧化磷酸化的轉換與氧化還原設定點相耦合，賦予代謝可塑性，且此作用依腫瘤類型、分期與微環境而定。這使 SIRT3 成為依情境而異的腫瘤抑制子或致癌基因。

label: deacetylates
context: SIRT3 deacetylates OPA1 at Lys926/Lys931 to activate mitochondrial fusion. The mechanism of mtSIRTs on autophagy is still unclear.
context_zh_TW: SIRT3 在 Lys926/Lys931 去乙醯化 OPA1 以活化粒線體融合。mtSIRT 對自噬的作用機制仍不明確。

label: correlates_with
context: SIRT3 deacetylates and activates MnSOD (SOD2); the SIRT3/SIRT4 ratio therefore reflects mitochondrial ROS-buffering capacity and links the ratio node to its MnSOD substrate.
context_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化並活化 MnSOD（SOD2）；因此 SIRT3/SIRT4 比例反映粒線體 ROS 緩衝能力，並將比例節點連結至其 MnSOD 基質。

label: deacetylates
context: SIRT3 deacetylates and stabilizes the mitochondrial glutamate transporter SLC25A22 at K83, preventing its ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation and sustaining mitochondrial glutathione supply. This protects lung adenocarcinoma from ferroptosis, a microenvironment- and redox-dependent survival role.
context_zh_TW: SIRT3 在 K83 去乙醯化並穩定粒線體穀氨酸轉運蛋白 SLC25A22，防止其泛素化和蛋白酶體降解，並維持粒線體麩胱甘肽供應。這保護肺腺癌免受鐵死亡，是一項依賴微環境和氧化還原的存活作用。

label: is_protective_in
context: SIRT3 deficiency causes lamina-associated domain detachment, increased chromatin accessibility, and aberrant repetitive-sequence transcription leading to senescence of human MSCs. SIRT1 activation of La Ribonucleoprotein 7 dampens p53 and NF-kB p65 transcriptional activity to ameliorate cellular senescence, while SIRT6 preserves telomere integrity and deacetylates Pol-beta for DNA-damage resistance.
context_zh_TW: SIRT3 缺失造成板層相關域脫離、染色質可及性增加與異常重複序列轉錄，導致人類 MSC 的衰老。SIRT1 活化 La Ribonucleoprotein 7 減弱 p53 與 NF-kB p65 轉錄活性以改善細胞衰老，而 SIRT6 維持端粒完整性並去乙醯化 Pol-beta 以賦予 DNA 損傷抗性。

label: is_protective_in
context: SIRT3 deficiency exacerbates myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury, and SIRT3 protects the heart through mitochondrial quality control and oxidative-stress defense. As the primary mitochondrial deacetylase it sustains OXPHOS and antioxidant enzymes such as SOD2, so its loss amplifies reperfusion damage. This makes SIRT3 a key mitochondrial cardioprotective factor.
context_zh_TW: SIRT3 缺失加劇心肌缺血—再灌流損傷，且 SIRT3 透過粒線體品質控制與氧化壓力防禦保護心臟。作為主要的粒線體去乙醯酶，它維持 OXPHOS 與 SOD2 等抗氧化酵素，因此其缺失放大再灌流損傷。這使 SIRT3 成為關鍵的粒線體心臟保護因子。

label: is_protective_in
context: SIRT3 is a prosurvival factor protective in ischemic stroke through HIF-1alpha/VEGF signaling in astrocytes, and it is downregulated in cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury where enhancing SIRT3 with Wnt/beta-catenin is proposed as a therapeutic target. This extends SIRT3's mitochondrial protective axis to the neurovascular unit.
context_zh_TW: SIRT3 在缺血性腦中風中是透過星形細胞中 HIF-1alpha/VEGF 訊號的促存活保護因子，且其在腦缺血—再灌流損傷中下調，其中提議以 Wnt/beta-catenin 增強 SIRT3 作為治療標的。這將 SIRT3 的粒線體保護軸延伸至神經血管單元。

label: deacetylates
context: SIRT3 is the primary mitochondrial NAD+-dependent deacetylase, and among its targets is MnSOD (manganese superoxide dismutase). When NR raises NAD+ and activates SIRT3, the acetylation of MnSOD is reduced, increasing mitochondrial MnSOD activity and thereby lowering mitochondrial reactive oxygen species. SIRT3 also deacetylates isocitrate dehydrogenase 2, enhancing mitochondrial antioxidant capacity and quality control. This SIRT3-MnSOD axis is central to NR's protective effects against oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, and NLRP3 inflammasome activation, and it also mediates the benefit of gut-microbiota-derived NMN in acute pancreatitis, where the SIRT3-PRDX5 pathway is engaged.
context_zh_TW: SIRT3 是主要的粒線體 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶，其標靶之一為 MnSOD（錳超氧化物歧化酶）。當 NR 提升 NAD+ 並活化 SIRT3 時，MnSOD 的乙醯化程度降低，進而增加粒線體 MnSOD 活性，從而降低粒線體活性氧。SIRT3 也會去乙醯化 isocitrate dehydrogenase 2，增強粒線體抗氧化能力與品質控制。此 SIRT3-MnSOD 軸線是 NR 對抗氧化壓力、粒線體功能障礙與 NLRP3 發炎體活化的保護作用之核心，並且也介導了腸道菌叢來源的 NMN 在急性胰腺炎中的益處，其中 SIRT3-PRDX5 路徑被啟動。

label: is_protective_in
context: SIRT3 knockout mice are susceptible to severe kidney fibrosis due to PDH E1alpha hyperacetylation at K385, and SIRT6 proximal-tubule knockout aggravates UUO fibrosis with the MDL-800 activator mitigating it. SIRT1 overexpression abolishes TGF-beta1-induced apoptosis and fibrosis through CTGF suppression, and SRT1720 attenuates UUO-induced fibrosis.
context_zh_TW: SIRT3 基因敲除小鼠因 PDH E1alpha 在 K385 過乙醯化而易罹嚴重腎纖維化，且 SIRT6 近曲小管敲除加劇 UUO 纖維化，而 MDL-800 活化劑減輕之。SIRT1 過度表現透過 CTGF 抑制廢除 TGF-beta1 誘發的凋亡與纖維化，且 SRT1720 減弱 UUO 誘發的纖維化。

label: suppresses
context: SIRT3 overexpression suppresses ovarian cancer metastasis via Twist-downregulation-driven EMT inhibition. In contrast SIRT3 promotes viability in glioma by stabilizing the Ku70-Bax interaction, and in cervical cancer it promotes invasion and metastasis by reprogramming fatty acid synthesis through ACC1 upregulation. The metastatic effect of SIRT3 is therefore tumor-type dependent.
context_zh_TW: SIRT3 過度表現透過 Twist 下調驅動的 EMT 抑制，抑制卵巢癌轉移。相對地，SIRT3 在膠質瘤中透過穩定 Ku70-Bax 交互作用促進存活，而在子宮頸癌中透過 ACC1 上調重編程脂肪酸合成來促進侵犯與轉移。因此 SIRT3 的轉移效應依腫瘤類型而異。

label: is_protective_in
context: SIRT3 promotes MnSOD expression to protect against hyperoxia-induced acute lung injury, and SIRT3-deficient mice develop more severe ALI through NLRP3 activation in macrophages. SIRT3 therefore defends the lung epithelium against oxidative and inflammatory damage by sustaining mitochondrial antioxidant capacity.
context_zh_TW: SIRT3 促進 MnSOD 表現以對抗高氧誘發的急性肺損傷，且 SIRT3 缺失小鼠透過巨噬細胞中 NLRP3 活化發展更嚴重的 ALI。SIRT3 因此透過維持粒線體抗氧化能力，防禦肺上皮免於氧化與發炎損傷。

label: is_protective_in
context: SIRT3 protects against amyloid-beta pathology and excitotoxicity in Alzheimer's disease, and its dysfunction leads to mitochondrial and neuronal damage. Intermittent food deprivation is beneficial in a SIRT3-dependent manner, and SIRT3 is upregulated in the AD temporal neocortex mirroring amyloid-beta deposition. SIRT3 thereby links mitochondrial quality control to AD neuroprotection.
context_zh_TW: SIRT3 保護對抗阿茲海默症中的類澱粉-beta 病理與興奮毒性，其功能不全導致粒線體與神經元損傷。間歇性禁食以 SIRT3 依賴的方式有益，且 SIRT3 在 AD 顳葉新皮質中上調，反映類澱粉-beta 沉積。SIRT3 因此將粒線體品質控制與 AD 神經保護連結。

label: protects against
context: SIRT3 protects against diabetic cardiomyopathy by maintaining mitochondrial function and redox balance in the diabetic heart. SIRT3 deficiency exacerbates hyperglycemia-induced mitochondrial dysfunction and injury.
context_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過維持糖尿病心臟的粒線體功能與氧化還原平衡，保護免受糖尿病心肌病變。SIRT3 缺乏會加劇高血糖誘導的粒線體功能障礙與損傷。

label: is_protective_in
context: SIRT3 protects against liver ischemia-reperfusion injury: systemic GPCR5 knockout suppresses SIRT3, driving proinflammatory macrophages and exacerbated injury. As the dominant mitochondrial sirtuin, SIRT3 sustains mitochondrial function in hepatocytes during reperfusion stress. This protective role parallels SIRT3's cardioprotective function in myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury.
context_zh_TW: SIRT3 保護對抗肝缺血—再灌流損傷：全身性 GPCR5 基因敲除抑制 SIRT3，驅動促發炎巨噬細胞與加劇的損傷。作為優勢的粒線體 sirtuin，SIRT3 在再灌流壓力下維持肝細胞的粒線體功能。此保護角色平行於 SIRT3 在心肌缺血—再灌流損傷中的心臟保護功能。

label: delactylates
context: SIRT3 removes K352 lactylation from the mitochondrial malic enzyme ME2, inhibiting ME2 and disrupting tumor redox balance by raising ROS and the NADP+/NADPH ratio, thereby suppressing colorectal cancer growth. This is a non-canonical delactylase action of SIRT3 on the metabolic-plasticity/redox interface.
context_zh_TW: SIRT3 從粒線體蘋果酸酶 ME2 移除 K352 乳醯化，抑制 ME2 並透過提高 ROS 和 NADP+/NADPH 比值來破壞腫瘤氧化還原平衡，從而抑制結直腸癌生長。這是 SIRT3 在代謝可塑性/氧化還原界面上的一種非典型去乳醯化作用。

label: suppresses
context: SIRT3 suppresses obesity by activating macroautophagy through the AMPK-ULK1 pathway to produce smaller lipid droplets, and by inducing the perilipin-1-Hsc71-LAMP2 complex to drive chaperone-mediated autophagy. These mitochondrial-autophagy actions promote lipid catabolism and energy expenditure, opposing adipose accumulation.
context_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過 AMPK-ULK1 路徑活化巨自噬以產生較小的脂滴，並誘發 perilipin-1-Hsc71-LAMP2 複合體以驅動伴侶介導的自噬，從而抑制肥胖。這些粒線體—自噬作用促進脂質分解與能量消耗，對抗脂肪堆積。

label: promotes
context: SIRT4 overexpression aggravates angiotensin II-induced cardiac hypertrophy by inhibiting MnSOD activity, and global SIRT4 knockout confers resistance to angiotensin II infusion with reduced cardiac fibrosis. SIRT4 is therefore the sirtuin most clearly associated with adverse cardiac effects, unlike the protective mitochondrial roles of SIRT3. This cardiac-harmful action is unusual among sirtuins.
context_zh_TW: SIRT4 過度表現透過抑制 MnSOD 活性加劇血管張力素 II 誘發的心臟肥大，且全球性 SIRT4 基因敲除賦予對血管張力素 II 灌注的抗性，伴隨心臟纖維化減少。因此 SIRT4 是與不良心臟效應最明確相關的 sirtuin，不同於 SIRT3 的保護性粒線體角色。此心臟有害作用在 sirtuin 中十分少見。

label: inhibits
context: SIRT4 overexpression leads to dyslipidemia, lipogenesis, and decreased fatty acid oxidation while deactivating AMPK and inhibiting insulin secretion, yet is described as protective against diabetes mellitus progression. SIRT5 promotes DM progression by negatively regulating PDX1 transcription, and SIRT6 protects by inducing PGC-1alpha acetylation to suppress hepatic glucose production.
context_zh_TW: SIRT4 過度表現導致血脂異常、脂肪生成與脂肪酸氧化減少，同時使 AMPK 失活並抑制胰島素分泌，然而被描述為對抗糖尿病 mellitus 進展的保護性。SIRT5 透過負調節 PDX1 轉錄促進 DM 進展，且 SIRT6 透過誘發 PGC-1alpha 乙醯化抑制肝臟葡萄糖生成而保護。

label: deacetylates
context: SIRT5 deacetylates cytochrome c, the mitochondrial intermembrane protein central to oxidative metabolism and apoptosis initiation. SIRT5 overexpression ameliorates cytochrome c leakage into the cytoplasm and the resulting caspase-3 activation, alleviating apoptosis. Together with SIRT4's restraint of procaspase processing, this places the mitochondrial sirtuins directly on the cytochrome c/apoptosome entry point of the caspase cascade rather than only on transcriptional or redox arms.
context_zh_TW: SIRT5 會去乙醯化 cytochrome c——這個位於粒線體膜間腔、對氧化代謝與細胞凋亡起始至關重要的蛋白。SIRT5 的過表達能改善 cytochrome c 洩漏至細胞質及其後續的 Caspase-3 活化，從而減輕細胞凋亡。與 SIRT4 對 pro-caspase 加工的抑制並列，這使粒線體 sirtuins 不只作用於轉錄或氧化還原臂，而是直接作用於 caspase 級聯的 cytochrome c/凋亡體入口。

label: desuccinylates
context: SIRT5 desuccinylates superoxide dismutase 1 (SOD1), increasing its activity and thereby enhancing cytosolic antioxidant defense. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically activates SOD1. This extends sirtuin control of antioxidant enzymes beyond SIRT3's activation of mitochondrial MnSOD/IDH2.
context_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀醯基化超氧化物歧化酶 1（SOD1），增加其活性，從而增強細胞質抗氧化防禦。方向性上 SIRT5 以酵素方式活化 SIRT1。這將 sirtuin 對抗氧化酵素的控制從 SIRT3 對粒線體 MnSOD/IDH2 的活化延伸到更廣泛的範圍。

label: enhances
context: SIRT5 enhances glutaminolysis in colorectal cancer in a deglutarylation-dependent manner to drive colorectal carcinogenesis, and it deacetylates lactate dehydrogenase B to induce hyperactive autophagy and tumorigenesis. SIRT5 overexpression is associated with poor prognosis in CRC, contrasting with protective SIRT6.
context_zh_TW: SIRT5 以去戊二醯化依賴的方式增強大腸癌中的麩醯胺分解，驅動大腸癌發生，且去乙醯化 lactate dehydrogenase B 以誘發過度活化的自噬與腫瘤發生。SIRT5 過度表現與 CRC 不良預後相關，與保護性 SIRT6 形成對比。

label: desuccinylates
context: SIRT5 is protumorigenic in CRC, HCC, and NSCLC by reprogramming metabolism toward glycolysis and glutaminolysis; it desuccinylates lactate dehydrogenase B (LDHB) to hyperactivate autophagy, feeding cancer cells recycled nutrients. SIRT5 is a desuccinylase largely resistant to nicotinamide inhibition.
context_zh_TW: SIRT5 在 CRC、HCC 與 NSCLC 中透過將代謝重編程為糖解與麩醯胺分解而促腫瘤；它去琥珀醯化 lactate dehydrogenase B（LDHB）以過度活化自噬，供養癌細胞回收的營養。SIRT5 是主要對菸鹼醯胺抑制具抗性的去琥珀醯酶。

label: is_harmful_in
context: SIRT5 mediates ischemia-reperfusion-induced brain damage by increasing blood-brain barrier permeability through occludin degradation, whereas SIRT1 and SIRT3 are neuroprotective in ischemic stroke. Serum SIRT2 is increased in acute ischemic stroke patients as a risk and prognosis marker, and SIRT2 inhibition is neuroprotective via downregulation of Akt/FoxO3a and MAPK.
context_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過 occludin 降解增加血腦屏障通透性介導缺血—再灌流誘發的腦損傷，而 SIRT1 與 SIRT3 在缺血性中風中具有神經保護性。血清 SIRT2 在急性缺血性中風患者中上升作為風險與預後標記，且 SIRT2 抑制透過下調 Akt/FoxO3a 與 MAPK 具神經保護性。

label: promotes_resistance_to
context: SIRT5 promotes cisplatin resistance in ovarian cancer via Nrf2/HO-1-mediated ROS-dependent DNA-damage suppression, while SIRT2 overexpression enhances cisplatin sensitivity in resistant ovarian cancer cells. High SIRT5 expression in ovarian cancer is nonetheless associated with favorable survival.
context_zh_TW: SIRT5 在卵巢癌中透過 Nrf2/HO-1 介導的 ROS 依賴 DNA 損傷抑制促進 cisplatin 抗性，而 SIRT2 過度表現在抗性卵巢癌細胞中增強 cisplatin 敏感性。儘管如此，卵巢癌中高 SIRT5 表現與有利存活相關。

label: is_protective_in
context: SIRT5 protects against acute kidney injury by regulating the balance between mitochondrial and peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation in proximal tubular epithelial cells, and SIRT6 inhibits LPS-induced apoptosis while promoting autophagy in HK-2 cells. SIRT7-deficient mice are protected against AKI, indicating SIRT7 promotes tubular damage and kidney inflammation.
context_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過調節近曲小管上皮細胞中粒線體與過氧化體脂肪酸氧化的平衡保護對抗急性腎損傷，且 SIRT6 抑制 LPS 誘發的凋亡同時在 HK-2 細胞中促進自噬。SIRT7 缺失小鼠免受 AKI 保護，顯示 SIRT7 促進小管損傷與腎臟發炎。

label: inactivates
context: SIRT6 inactivates TGF-beta1/Smad2 signaling to prevent myofibroblast differentiation, inhibits TGF-beta-induced cellular senescence, and blocks EMT during IPF through TGF-beta1/Smad3. SIRT6 is thus a master suppressor of the fibrotic cascade in lung fibrosis, whereas SIRT7 decline has a profibrotic effect via Smad3 changes.
context_zh_TW: SIRT6 使 TGF-beta1/Smad2 訊號失效以阻止肌纖維母細胞分化，抑制 TGF-beta 誘發的細胞衰老，並在 IPF 中透過 TGF-beta1/Smad3 阻斷 EMT。SIRT6 因此是肺纖維化中纖維化級聯的主抑制因子，而 SIRT7 下降透過 Smad3 變化具有促纖維化效應。

label: inactivates
context: SIRT6 inactivates TGF-beta1/Smad2 signaling to prevent myofibroblast differentiation, inhibits TGF-beta-induced cellular senescence, and blocks EMT during IPF through TGF-beta1/Smad3. SIRT6 is thus a master suppressor of the fibrotic cascade in lung fibrosis, whereas SIRT7 decline has a profibrotic effect via Smad3 changes.
context_zh_TW: SIRT6 使 TGF-beta1/Smad2 訊號失效以阻止肌纖維母細胞分化，抑制 TGF-beta 誘發的細胞衰老，並在 IPF 中透過 TGF-beta1/Smad3 阻斷 EMT。SIRT6 因此是肺纖維化中纖維化級聯的主抑制因子，而 SIRT7 下降透過 Smad3 變化具有促纖維化效應。

label: has_a_dual_role_in
context: SIRT6 is anticarcinogenic in lung cancer through CHD4 coordination that enables chromatin relaxation and DNA repair, but pro-carcinogenic via snail-dependent transrepression of KLF4 that drives EMT and metastasis. SIRT6 also inhibits glycolysis to enhance radiosensitivity, so its overall effect depends on the EMT/metabolic state of the tumor.
context_zh_TW: SIRT6 在肺癌中透過 CHD4 協調（使染色質鬆弛與 DNA 修復成為可能）而抗癌，但透過 snail 依賴的 KLF4 轉錄抑制（驅動 EMT 與轉移）而促癌。SIRT6 亦抑制糖解以增強放射敏感性，因此其整體效應取決於腫瘤的 EMT／代謝狀態。

label: is_protective_in
context: SIRT6 is decreased in chronic heart failure, and its overexpression increases survival after TAC-induced heart failure via telomerase activation involving TERT and TRF1. SIRT6 therefore connects telomere maintenance and genomic stability to cardiac resilience under pressure overload, making it a candidate target for heart-failure therapy.
context_zh_TW: SIRT6 在慢性心臟衰竭中下降，其過度表現透過涉及 TERT 與 TRF1 的端粒酶活化，增加 TAC 誘發心臟衰竭後的存活。SIRT6 因此將端粒維護與基因體穩定性連結至壓力超負荷下的心臟韌性，使其成為心臟衰竭治療的候選標的。

label: is_protective_in
context: SIRT6 is markedly downregulated in chronic kidney disease and vascular calcification patients, and it suppresses osteogenic transdifferentiation of vascular smooth muscle cells via runt-related transcription factor 2. MSC exosomes inhibit high-phosphate aortic calcification through SIRT6-HMGB1 deacetylation, and proximal tubule-specific SIRT6 knockout aggravates UUO fibrosis. SIRT6 thereby protects the kidney and vasculature in CKD.
context_zh_TW: SIRT6 在慢性腎病與血管鈣化患者中明顯下調，且它透過 runt-related transcription factor 2 抑制血管平滑肌細胞的成骨轉分化。MSC 外泌體透過 SIRT6-HMGB1 去乙醯化抑制高磷酸血 aortic 鈣化，且近曲小管專一性 SIRT6 基因敲除加劇 UUO 纖維化。SIRT6 因此保護 CKD 中的腎臟與血管。

label: is_protective_in
context: SIRT6 is protective in diabetes mellitus by inducing PGC-1alpha acetylation and suppressing hepatic glucose production, and by cooperating with p53 to deacetylate FoxO1 and suppress gluconeogenic genes. Through these transcriptional controls SIRT6 reduces the pathological hepatic glucose output that drives hyperglycemia.
context_zh_TW: SIRT6 在糖尿病 mellitus 中具有保護性，透過誘發 PGC-1alpha 乙醯化並抑制肝臟葡萄糖生成，且透過與 p53 合作去乙醯化 FoxO1 並抑制糖質新生基因。透過這些轉錄控制，SIRT6 減少驅動高血糖的病理性肝臟葡萄糖輸出。

label: deacetylates
context: SIRT7 ameliorates stress-induced cardiac hypertrophy by deacetylating the transcription factor GATA4. This protective action contrasts with SIRT7's pro-fibrotic role in cardiac fibrosis, where enhanced expression promotes fibrosis via Smad2/ERK signaling. The same nucleolar sirtuin therefore has divergent, context-dependent cardiovascular effects.
context_zh_TW: SIRT7 透過去乙醯化轉錄因子 GATA4 改善壓力誘發的心臟肥大。此保護作用與 SIRT7 在心臟纖維化中的促纖維化角色形成對比，後者中增強的表現透過 Smad2/ERK 訊號促進纖維化。同一核仁 sirtuin 因此具有分歧、情境依賴的心血管效應。

label: deacetylates
context: SIRT7 deacetylates histones, in particular H3K18, whose deacetylation is associated with repression of tumor suppressor genes. SIRT7 can therefore support a cancer phenotype by inhibiting expression of tumor suppressors, though it is required only to sustain, not initiate, oncogenic transformation.
context_zh_TW: SIRT7 去乙醯化組蛋白，尤其是 H3K18，其去乙醯化與腫瘤抑制基因的抑制相關。因此 SIRT7 可透過抑制腫瘤抑制因子的表達來支持癌症表型，但僅用於維持而非啟動致癌轉化。

label: activates
context: SIRT7 drives ribosome biogenesis by activating RNA Pol I at rDNA and suppresses p21 via H3K18 deacetylation, fueling the biosynthetic capacity tumors need; it is overexpressed in breast, thyroid, and HCC. This proliferative, biosynthetic driver role makes SIRT7 an oncogenic sirtuin.
context_zh_TW: SIRT7 透過在 rDNA 活化 RNA Pol I 並經由 H3K18 去乙醯化抑制 p21，驅動核糖體生成，供應腫瘤所需的生物合成能力；它在乳癌、甲狀腺與 HCC 中過度表現。此增生性、生物合成驅動角色使 SIRT7 成為致癌 sirtuin。

label: activates
context: SRT1460 is a potent, chemically diverse second-generation sirtuin-activating compound reported alongside SRT1720 and SRT2183 as more effective activators than the polyphenolic STACs. Most compounds of this class were also reported to have anticancer activity. A major caveat is that the mechanism of SRT1460 action remains unclear: activation could frequently only be demonstrated with fluorescently tagged substrates, and the metabolic effects may reflect indirect actions (e.g., via the cAMP-Epac1-AMPK axis) rather than direct SIRT1 binding. Directionally, SRT1460 enhances SIRT1 activity in assay systems, but interpretation of in vivo effects requires caution.
context_zh_TW: SRT1460 是一種強效的、化學結構多樣的第二代 sirtuin 活化化合物，與 SRT1720 和 SRT2183 一起被報導為比多酚類 STAC 更有效的活化劑。此類化合物大多據報導具有抗癌活性。主要的注意事項是 SRT1460 的作用機制仍不清楚：活化經常只能透過螢光標記的受質來驗證，且代謝效果可能反映間接作用（例如透過 cAMP-Epac1-AMPK 軸線）而非直接 SIRT1 結合。方向性上 SRT1460 在試驗系統中增強 SIRT1 活性，但對體內效果的詮釋需要謹慎。

label: is_a
context: SRT1460 is a second-generation synthetic sirtuin-activating compound (STAC) of the imidazothiazole class, developed with SRT1720 and SRT2183 as chemically diverse and more potent activators than the initial polyphenolic STACs. These compounds were reported to have anticancer activity, but their mechanism is controversial: activation could frequently only be demonstrated with fluorescently tagged substrates, and in vivo effects may be indirect (e.g., via the cAMP-Epac1-AMPK pathway) rather than direct SIRT1 binding. Directionally, SRT1460 belongs to the synthetic STAC class whose biology underlies the ongoing debate about STAC-mediated SIRT1 activation.
context_zh_TW: SRT1460 是一種咪唑噻唑類的第二代合成 sirtuin 活化化合物（STAC），與 SRT1720 和 SRT2183 一起作為化學結構多樣且比初始多酚類 STAC 更強效的活化劑而開發。這些化合物據報導具有抗癌活性，但其機制存在爭議：活化經常只能透過螢光標記的受質驗證，且體內效果可能是間接的（例如透過 cAMP-Epac1-AMPK 途徑）而非直接 SIRT1 結合。方向性上 SRT1460 屬於合成 STAC 類別，其生物學構成了關於 STAC 介導的 SIRT1 活化的持續爭論。

label: activates
context: SRT2183 is a potent second-generation sirtuin-activating compound identified with SRT1720 and SRT1460 as chemically diverse, more potent activators than the initial polyphenolic STACs. These compounds were reported to have anticancer activity, but their mechanism is controversial: activation was frequently demonstrable only with fluorescently tagged substrates, and metabolic effects may be indirect (cAMP-Epac1-AMPK pathway) rather than direct SIRT1 activation. Directionally, SRT2183 stimulates SIRT1 deacetylase activity in biochemical assays. These caveats frame the ongoing debate about the physiological relevance of STAC-mediated SIRT1 activation.
context_zh_TW: SRT2183 是一種強效的第二代 sirtuin 活化化合物，與 SRT1720 和 SRT1460 一起被鑑定為化學結構多樣、比初始多酚類 STAC 更強效的活化劑。這些化合物據報導具有抗癌活性，但其機制存在爭議：活化經常只能在螢光標記的受質下驗證，且代謝益處可能反映間接作用（cAMP-Epac1-AMPK 途徑）而非直接 SIRT1 活化。方向性上 SRT2183 在生化試驗中刺激 SIRT1 去乙醯酶活性。這些注意事項構成了關於 STAC 介導的 SIRT1 活化生理相關性的持續爭論。

label: is_a
context: SRT2183 is a second-generation synthetic sirtuin-activating compound (STAC) identified alongside SRT1720 and SRT1460 as a chemically diverse, potent SIRT1 activator that followed the polyphenolic STACs resveratrol, piceatannol, butein, quercetin, and myricetin. These compounds were reported to have anticancer activity, but their activation mechanism is debated because activity was frequently only demonstrable with fluorescently tagged substrates, and metabolic benefits may reflect indirect actions (cAMP-Epac1-AMPK) rather than direct SIRT1 binding. Directionally, SRT2183 belongs to the synthetic STAC class whose mechanism remains an open question.
context_zh_TW: SRT2183 是一種第二代合成 sirtuin 活化化合物（STAC），與 SRT1720 和 SRT1460 一起被鑑定為化學結構多樣的強效 SIRT1 活化劑，繼承了多酚類 STAC resveratrol、piceatannol、butein、quercetin 和 myricetin。這些化合物據報導具有抗癌活性，但其活化機制存在爭議，因為活性經常只能在螢光標記的受質下驗證，且代謝益處可能反映間接作用（cAMP-Epac1-AMPK）而非直接 SIRT1 結合。方向性上 SRT2183 屬於合成 STAC 類別，其機制仍是一個開放性問題。

label: contribute_to
context: Sarcopenia, the age-related loss of muscle mass and strength, has a multifactorial pathogenesis that includes hormonal changes, increased oxidative stress and inflammation, vascular changes, and inactivity, and AGEs may contribute by increasing oxidative stress and inflammation. Studies in older populations found that serum carboxymethyl-lysine (CML) concentrations were higher in those with less grip strength, and that tissue pentosidine concentrations were roughly 200% higher in older compared with younger individuals. These associations suggest that AGE accumulation contributes to the decline of muscular function observed in aging, although the relationship is not yet conclusive.
context_zh_TW: Sarcopenia是與age-related的muscle mass與strength loss，其multifactorial pathogenesis包括hormonal changes、increased oxidative stress與inflammation、vascular changes及inactivity，而AGEs可能透過increasing oxidative stress與inflammation而contribute。在older populations的studies found，serum carboxymethyl-lysine（CML）concentrations在那些with less grip strength者中較高，且tissue pentosidine concentrations在older compared with younger individuals約高出200%。這些associations suggest that AGE accumulation contributes to aging中所observed的muscular function decline，儘管此relationship尚未conclusive。

label: increases
context: Sebekova and colleagues found that long-term consumption of advanced glycation end products in rats leads to a dose-dependent increase in proteinuria that over time could induce renal damage. High long-term consumption of AGEs has also been associated with higher levels of fasting glucose, insulin, and serum AGEs, as well as increased AGE localization and RAGE staining in the ovarian tissue of rats. These results show that chronic dietary AGE excess can reproduce in animals some of the renal and metabolic features seen in aging and diabetes, supporting the toxicity of a high-AGE diet.
context_zh_TW: Sebekova 及其同事發現，大鼠長期攝取晚期糖化終產物會導致蛋白尿呈劑量依賴性增加，隨時間可能誘發腎損傷。長期高量攝取 AGE 也與較高的空腹血糖、胰島素與血清 AGE 濃度，以及大鼠卵巢組織中 AGE 定位與 RAGE 染色增加有關。這些結果顯示，慢性飲食性 AGE 過量能在動物中重現老化與糖尿病中見到的部分腎臟與代謝特徵，支持高 AGE 飲食的毒性。

label: associated_with
context: Semba and colleagues demonstrated in an older population of 1008 men and women aged 64 and older participating in the InCHIANTI study that elevated circulating AGEs were an independent predictor of renal function decline. Elevated plasma concentrations of CML were independently associated with chronic kidney disease and with the estimated glomerular filtration rate at baseline and after three and six years of follow-up. These findings suggest that the adverse effects of AGEs on the kidney apply to the general population of older community-dwelling adults, and that high CML levels may predict decreased renal function in the elderly.
context_zh_TW: Semba 及其同事在參與 InCHIANTI 研究的 1008 名 64 歲及以上老年男女性族群中證明，循環中升高的 AGE 是腎功能下降的獨立預測因子。升高的血漿 CML 濃度與慢性腎臟病以及基線時、三年與六年追蹤後的估計腎小球過濾率（estimated glomerular filtration rate）獨立相關。這些發現顯示，AGE 對腎臟的不良影響適用於一般社區居住的老年族群，且高 CML 濃度可能預測老年人的腎功能下降。

label: is_suppressed_by
context: Senescence acts as a barrier to tumorigenesis by permanently arresting the proliferation of pre-malignant cells. This is mediated by oncogene-induced senescence triggered by oncogenic insults. Senescence thereby restrains the development of cancer.
context_zh_TW: Senescence 透過永久停止癌前細胞的增殖，作為腫瘤發生的屏障。這由致癌性傷害觸發的致癌基因誘導衰老所介導。因此衰老限制了癌症的發展。

label: secretes
context: Senescent cells - often called 'zombie' cells - are a hallmark of aging: they do not completely die but also are not quite alive, and while sometimes harmless, they release harmful factors called the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) into surrounding tissues. This secretory phenotype is pro-inflammatory and can promote the development of diseases or disorders, including cancer, and accelerates aging by driving tissue dysfunction. Because senescent cells are linked to many age-related conditions including arthritis, poor wound healing, and neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's and Parkinson's, clearing them - as proposed through acid ceramidase-mediated ferroptosis sensitization - is a major strategy for extending healthspan.
context_zh_TW: 衰老細胞——常被稱為「殭屍」細胞——是衰老的特徵之一：它們不會完全死亡，卻也不完全活著；雖然有時無害，它們會將稱為衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）的有害因子釋放到周圍組織。這種分泌表型具促發炎性，可促進包括癌症在內的疾病或障礙發展，並透過驅動組織功能障礙而加速衰老。由於衰老細胞與許多年齡相關疾病有關，包括關節炎、傷口癒合不良，以及阿茲海默症與帕金森氏症等神經退化性疾病，清除它們——如透過酸性神經醯胺酶介導的鐵依賴性細胞死亡敏感化所提出——是延長健康壽命的主要策略。

label: is_associated_with
context: Senescent hepatic stellate cells produce SASP factors that drive obesity-associated hepatocellular carcinoma. HSC senescence, induced by deoxycholic acid from altered gut microbiota, creates a pro-inflammatory microenvironment. Hepatic stellate cells are therefore central to obesity-associated HCC.
context_zh_TW: 衰老的肝星狀細胞產生驅動肥胖相關肝細胞癌的 SASP 因子。由改變的腸道微生物群產生的脫氧膽酸誘導 HSC 衰老，創造促發炎微環境。因此肝星狀細胞對肥胖相關 HCC 至關重要。

label: is_tested_for
context: Senolytic therapy is being tested for osteoarthritis (e.g., NCT04210986) to reduce pain and improve joint function by clearing senescent chondrocytes and synovial cells. Preclinical studies show senolytics alleviate OA pathology and improve cartilage integrity, and the SASP from senescent joint cells is implicated in cartilage degradation and synovial inflammation through cytokines and MMPs. This represents a leading musculoskeletal application of senolytics, with multiple early trials underway. Targeting the local senescent burden in the joint is viewed as a promising disease-modifying approach in an area with few effective treatments.
context_zh_TW: Senolytic 療法正被測試用於骨關節炎（如 NCT04210986），以透過清除衰老軟骨細胞與滑膜細胞減輕疼痛並改善關節功能。臨床前研究顯示 senolytics 緩解 OA 病理並改善軟骨完整性，且衰老關節細胞的 SASP 經由細胞激素與 MMPs 涉及軟骨降解與滑膜發炎。這代表 senolytics 一項領先的肌肉骨骼應用，多項早期試驗進行中。標靶關節中的局部衰老負擔被視為在治療選擇有限領域中一種有前景的疾病修飾方法。

label: uses
context: Senomorphic therapy uses nutlin 3a, an MDM2 inhibitor that stabilizes p53 and thereby suppresses the pro-inflammatory SASP arm, since p53 restrains NF-kB-driven SASP factor expression. This approach leverages the tumor-suppressor rheostat rather than broadly blocking inflammation, and it is consistent with the finding that loss of p53 dramatically amplifies secretome output. Nutlin 3a is primarily a research tool with limited clinical development. Mechanistically its SASP-suppressive action is well grounded, though translational use remains limited.
context_zh_TW: Senomorphic 療法使用 nutlin 3a，一種穩定 p53 而抑制促發炎性 SASP 臂的 MDM2 抑制劑，因 p53 抑制 NF-κB 驅動的 SASP 因子表現。此途徑利用腫瘤抑制變阻器而非廣泛阻斷發炎，且與 p53 缺失大幅放大分泌組輸出的發現一致。Nutlin 3a 主要是研究工具，臨床開發有限。在機制上其 SASP 抑制作用根基牢固，但轉譯使用仍有限。

label: is_associated_with
context: Serum SIRT3 levels are associated with clinical outcome and prognosis in COVID-19, being markedly lower in severe patients. This positions serum SIRT3 as a potential prognostic biomarker that reflects mitochondrial health and antioxidant reserve during systemic viral inflammation, analogous to its diagnostic value in lung cancer.
context_zh_TW: 血清 SIRT3 水平與 COVID-19 的臨床結果和預後相關，在重症患者中明顯較低。這將血清 SIRT3 定位為潛在預後生物標記，反映全身性病毒性發炎期間的粒線體健康與抗氧化儲備，類似其在肺癌中的診斷價值。

label: counteracts
context: Several enzymes, including glyoxalase I, glyoxalase II, and carbonyl reductase, together with the receptor AGER1, have been shown to be part of a detoxification and counterregulation system against the prooxidant effects of glycation. AGER1 helps oppose the pro-inflammatory actions of advanced glycation end products, functioning as an endogenous check on AGE-mediated signaling. With aging and in some pathological conditions, there is an imbalance in this steady state, due to increased endogenous production or increased exogenous intake combined with lower renal AGE clearance, leading to the AGE accumulation observed in older populations.
context_zh_TW: 數種酵素，包括 glyoxalase I、glyoxalase II 與 carbonyl reductase，以及受體 AGER1，已被證實是對抗糖化促氧化效應之解毒與反向調節系統的一部分。AGER1 有助於對抗晚期糖化終產物的促發炎作用，作為 AGE 介導訊號的內生性制衡。隨著老化與在某些病理狀況下，此恆定狀態出現失衡，起因於內生性產生增加或外源性攝取增加，加上腎臟 AGE 清除率下降，導致在老年族群中觀察到的 AGE 堆積。

label: induces
context: Severe or prolonged replication stress from hydroxyurea can activate ATR and ATM signaling and push cells into apoptosis. This is a possible outcome of the DNA damage response triggered by stalled replication forks.
context_zh_TW: Hydroxyurea 引起的嚴重或長期複製壓力可活化 ATR 和 ATM 訊號並將細胞推向凋亡。這是受阻複製叉觸發 DNA 損傷反應後的可能結果。

label: attenuates
context: Silybin is the principal flavonolignan of milk thistle. It attenuates cisplatin-induced nephrotoxicity by preserving renal tubular integrity and mitochondrial bioenergetics, likely via SIRT3-mediated mechanisms, placing it among natural compounds engaging the mitochondrial deacetylase axis in kidney injury.
context_zh_TW: Silybin 是水飛薊的主要黃酮木脂素。它透過維護腎小管完整性和粒線體生物能學，可能透過 SIRT3 介導的機制，減輕 Cisplatin 誘導的腎毒性，將其定位為在腎損傷中參與粒線體去乙醯酶軸線的天然化合物之一。

label: is_associated_with
context: Small-cell lung cancer is classified as a high-grade neuroendocrine carcinoma expressing neuroendocrine markers including Synaptophysin, Chromogranin A, and CD56. These markers are used in SCLC diagnosis. The neuroendocrine phenotype defines SCLC biology.
context_zh_TW: Small-cell lung cancer 被歸類為高惡性度神經內分泌癌，表現包括 Synaptophysin、Chromogranin A 和 CD56 在內的神經內分泌標記。這些標記用於 SCLC 診斷。神經內分泌表型定義了 SCLC 的生物學。

label: elevates
context: Smoking elevates circulating catecholamines, including adrenaline and noradrenaline, through sympathetic nervous system activation and the effects of nicotine. Nicotine stimulates the adrenal medulla and sympathetic nerve endings, increasing catecholamine release and turnover. Higher local and circulating concentrations of adrenaline provide more substrate for oxidation to adrenochrome, especially under the oxidative conditions created by smoke-derived free radicals. Together with smoking-induced oxidative stress, the elevated catecholamine pool increases the potential for adrenochrome formation and aminochrome-related oxidative damage.
context_zh_TW: 吸菸透過交感神經系統活化與尼古丁的效應，升高包括 adrenaline 與 noradrenaline 在內的循環兒茶酚胺。尼古丁刺激腎上腺髓質與交感神經末梢，增加兒茶酚胺釋放與週轉。較高的局部與循環 adrenaline 濃度提供了更多氧化為 adrenochrome 的受質，特別是在菸草衍生自由基所創造的氧化條件下。與吸菸誘發的氧化壓力一起，升高的兒茶酚胺庫增加了 adrenochrome 形成與 aminochrome 相關氧化損傷的潛力。

label: stabilizes
context: Sodium metabisulfite, a sulfite antioxidant, is a common stabilizer added to epinephrine formulations to prevent oxidative degradation. It protects epinephrine against autoxidation driven by oxygen, light, heat, and higher pH, though it has limitations: sulfites can undergo synergistic degradation with adrenochrome under light, and trace metal ions catalyze epinephrine oxidation. Newer formulations explore sulfite-free options such as cysteine or thioglycerol, while chelating agents reduce metal-catalyzed oxidation. Epinephrine is a vital medication used for anaphylaxis and cardiac arrest, so maintaining its stability is clinically important.
context_zh_TW: Sodium metabisulfite，一種 sulfite antioxidant，是 common stabilizer added to epinephrine formulations 以 prevent oxidative degradation。它 protects epinephrine against autoxidation driven by oxygen, light, heat, and higher pH，though it has limitations: sulfites can undergo synergistic degradation with adrenochrome under light，and trace metal ions catalyze epinephrine oxidation。Newer formulations explore sulfite-free options such as cysteine or thioglycerol，while chelating agents reduce metal-catalyzed oxidation。Epinephrine is a vital medication used for anaphylaxis and cardiac arrest，so maintaining its stability is clinically important。

label: causes
context: Sodium nitrite is a chemical that can trigger acquired methemoglobinemia, seen in suicide attempts, contaminated food, and industrial exposures. Nitrites and nitrates oxidize hemoglobin's heme iron to the ferric state, overwhelming the body's reducing capacity. Related nitrite and nitrate sources include amyl nitrite and isobutyl nitrite ('poppers'), aniline dyes, nitrobenzene, and well-water nitrates that cause 'blue baby syndrome' in infants. Acquired methemoglobinemia from such agents can be acute and severe, particularly with high-dose or combined exposures, and recent trends show increases in nitrite-related cases from recreational use or intentional ingestion.
context_zh_TW: Sodium nitrite is a chemical that can trigger acquired methemoglobinemia, seen in suicide attempts, contaminated food, and industrial exposures。Nitrites and nitrates oxidize hemoglobin's heme iron to the ferric state, overwhelming the body's reducing capacity。Related nitrite and nitrate sources include amyl nitrite and isobutyl nitrite ('poppers'), aniline dyes, nitrobenzene, and well-water nitrates that cause 'blue baby syndrome' in infants。Acquired methemoglobinemia from such agents can be acute and severe, particularly with high-dose or combined exposures, and recent trends show increases in nitrite-related cases from recreational use or intentional ingestion。

label: is_induced_by
context: Sulfiredoxin expression is induced by oxidative stress through the transcription factor Nrf2, forming a feed-forward repair loop that reinforces antioxidant defense. This allows the peroxiredoxin system to recover after oxidative bursts rather than being permanently disabled.
context_zh_TW: Sulfiredoxin 的表現由氧化壓力經轉錄因子 Nrf2 誘導，形成強化抗氧化防禦的正回饋修復循環。這使過氧化還原酶系統能在氧化爆發後恢復，而非永久失能。

label: upregulates
context: Sulfiredoxin is Nrf2-induced, creating a feed-forward loop: low-grade oxidative stress activates NRF2, which raises Srx expression, which rescues hyperoxidized Prx — the execution arm that translates mild stress into greater buffering capacity (hormetic memory).
context_zh_TW: Sulfiredoxin 受 Nrf2 誘導，形成前饋迴路：低度氧化壓力活化 NRF2，使其提高 Srx 表現，Srx 再救回過度氧化的 Prx——這是把溫和壓力轉譯為更強緩衝能力（荷爾蒙記憶）的執行臂。

label: release
context: Sympathetic nerve endings co-release ATP as a cotransmitter alongside norepinephrine, particularly at higher stimulation frequencies. Along with neuropeptide Y, ATP augments and prolongs the vasoconstrictor response. The contribution of ATP to sympathetic signaling depends on firing frequency and the target organ.
context_zh_TW: Sympathetic nerve endings 與 norepinephrine 一起共同釋放 ATP 作為共遞質，尤其是在較高的刺激頻率下。與 neuropeptide Y 一起，ATP 增強並延長血管收縮反應。ATP 對交感神經訊號的貢獻取決於放電頻率與靶器官。

label: can_form
context: Sympathetic nerve endings represent a significant site of potential adrenochrome formation, as the norepinephrine and epinephrine stored in their varicosities are susceptible to autoxidation and metal-catalyzed oxidation. This process is accelerated by oxidative stress, high catecholamine turnover, and reduced antioxidant capacity. The resulting aminochromes can exert local cytotoxic effects through redox cycling and protein modification.
context_zh_TW: Sympathetic nerve endings 是 adrenochrome 潛在形成的重要位點，因為儲存在其膨體中的 norepinephrine 與 epinephrine 容易發生自氧化與金屬催化氧化。此過程在氧化壓力、高兒茶酚胺周轉與抗氧化能力降低下會加速。由此產生的 aminochromes 可透過 redox cycling 與蛋白質修飾發揮局部細胞毒性效應。

label: extends_lifespan_in
context: Systemic Thioredoxin-1 overexpression extends the early portion of mouse lifespan (Mitsui 2002; Pérez et al. 2011 male earlier-life only), whereas MnSOD/SOD/catalase/GPx overexpression does not (Pérez et al., Aging Cell 2009). Trx1's extra signaling roles (ASK1, mTOR) explain the asymmetry.
context_zh_TW: 全身性 Thioredoxin-1 過度表現可延長小鼠壽命早期部分（Mitsui 2002；Pérez et al. 2011 僅雄性早年期），而 MnSOD/SOD/catalase/GPx 過度表現則不能（Pérez et al., Aging Cell 2009）。Trx1 額外的訊息傳遞角色（ASK1、mTOR）解釋了這項不對稱。

label: regulates
context: TFE3 targets include ATF4, an essential master regulator of the integrated stress response, in addition to autophagic and lysosomal genes. ChIP-seq analysis revealed a high overlap between genes regulated by TFE3 under starvation and ER stress. TFE3 thereby integrates cooperation between different cellular stress pathways. This positions TFE3 as a broad regulator linking the lysosomal program to the integrated stress response.
context_zh_TW: TFE3 的標的包括 ATF4（整合性壓力反應的必要主調控因子），以及自噬和溶酶體基因。ChIP-seq 分析顯示 TFE3 在飢餓和 ER 壓力下調節的基因高度重疊。因此 TFE3 整合不同細胞壓力途徑之間的合作。這將 TFE3 定位為連結溶酶體程序與整合性壓力反應的廣泛調節者。

label: interacts_with
context: TFEB binds Rag GTPases as part of the amino acid-sensing machinery at the lysosomal surface, and this interaction is modulated by post-translational modification: oxidation of cysteine 212 inhibits TFEB's binding to Rag GTPases (PMID 31826695). The Rag GTPase complex is central to nutrient sensing, recruiting mTORC1 and its substrate machinery to the lysosome when amino acids are abundant, and TFEB's association with this complex links TFEB localization to nutrient availability. Oxidation at C212, by disrupting this binding, represents a redox-responsive mechanism that influences TFEB's cellular localization and activity, coupling oxidative stress to the regulation of the autophagy-lysosome pathway.
context_zh_TW: TFEB作為溶酶體表面氨基酸感應機制的一部分與Rag GTPases結合，並且這種相互作用受翻譯後修飾調節：半胱氨酸212的氧化抑製TFEB與Rag GTPases的結合（PMID 31826695）。Rag GTPase复合物是營養感應的核心，當氨基酸充足時將mTORC1及其底物機制招募到溶酶體，TFEB與該复合物的關聯將TFEB定位與營養可用性聯繫起來。C212處的氧化通過破壞這種結合，代表了一種氧化還原響應機制，影響TFEB的細胞定位和活性，將氧化應激與自噬-溶酶體途徑的調節聯繫起來。

label: activated_in
context: TFEB is activated in aneuploid cells as a cellular response to lysosomal stress following lysosomal accumulation of undegraded autophagic cargo. This activation occurs through an mTORC1-independent mechanism involving TFEB nuclear translocation and upregulation of its downstream targets. The response appears wired to stimulate autophagosomal rather than lysosomal biogenesis in these cells. It represents an adaptive mechanism by which aneuploid cells cope with proteotoxicity.
context_zh_TW: TFEB 在非整倍體細胞中被活化，作為對溶酶體累積未降解自噬貨物後之溶酶體壓力的細胞反應。此活化透過不依賴 mTORC1 的機制發生，涉及 TFEB 核轉位及其下游標靶的上調。此反應似乎被設計為刺激這些細胞的自噬體而非溶酶體生物發生。它代表非整倍體細胞應對蛋白毒性的適應機制。

label: is_an_antigen_of
context: TRP-2 is also a melanoma antigen, linking pigment enzymes to immune recognition. This makes the enzyme relevant to tumor immunology as well as pigment biology. Its expression in melanoma has implications for immune-based therapies.
context_zh_TW: TRP-2 也是一種黑色素瘤抗原，將色素酶與免疫識別聯繫起來。這使得該酶與腫瘤免疫學以及色素生物學都相關。它在黑色素瘤中的表達對基於免疫的療法具有意義。

label: is_composed_of
context: The IKK complex contains the catalytic subunits IKKalpha (IKK1) and IKKbeta (IKK2) along with the regulatory scaffold IKKgamma/NEMO. IKKalpha contributes to alternative (non-canonical) NF-kB activation through phosphorylation of the p100 precursor. It is a structural and functional component of the IKK signalosome.
context_zh_TW: IKK 複合體含有催化亞基 IKKalpha（IKK1）和 IKKbeta（IKK2），以及調控支架 IKKgamma/NEMO。IKKalpha 透過磷酸化 p100 前驅物，參與替代性（非經典）NF-kB 激活。它是 IKK 訊號體的结构與功能組成部分。

label: is_primed_by
context: The NLRP3 inflammasome, a large protein complex whose assembly is triggered by stimuli including uric acid and lipopolysaccharide, is primed by mitochondrial reactive oxygen species. Mitochondrial ROS inhibitors block priming, but not activation, of the NLRP3 inflammasome. Activation of the inflammasome results in enzymatic activation of caspase-1 and subsequent proteolytic cleavage of pro-interleukin-1beta into its mature, secreted form, linking mitochondrial oxidant signaling to the innate immune inflammatory response.
context_zh_TW: NLRP3炎症小體是一個大型蛋白質複合物，其組裝由包括尿酸和脂多糖在內的刺激觸發，並由粒線體活性氧種啟動。粒線體ROS抑制劑阻斷NLRP3炎症小體的啟動，但不阻斷其激活。炎症小體的激活導致caspase-1的酶活化，隨後將pro-interleukin-1beta蛋白水解裂解為其成熟的分泌形式，將粒線體氧化劑信號與先天免疫炎症反應聯繫起來。

label: inhibits
context: The SARS-CoV-2 macrodomain is a viral protein that hydrolyses the ADP-ribose (ADPR) units added by PARPs to proteins and nucleic acids, thereby inhibiting the protective antiviral effect of PARPs and facilitating viral replication and virulence. Because PARPs require NAD+ to ADP-ribosylate viral transcripts, this counteraction leads to excessive PARP activation and NAD+ consumption during infection, dysregulating the NAD+ metabolome. Restoring NAD+ levels with precursors may therefore restore PARP antiviral function and support innate immunity to SARS-CoV-2, connecting NAD+ metabolism directly to COVID-19 severity and immune defense.
context_zh_TW: SARS-CoV-2 macrodomain 是一種病毒蛋白，可水解 PARPs 加到蛋白質與核酸上的 ADP-核糖（ADPR）單元，從而抑制 PARPs 的保護性抗病毒效應並促進病毒複製與毒力。由於 PARPs 需要 NAD+ 來對病毒轉錄本進行 ADP-核糖基化，此對抗作用導致感染期間過度的 PARP 活化與 NAD+ 消耗，使 NAD+ 代謝組失調。因此，以前驅物恢復 NAD+ 水平可能恢復 PARP 抗病毒功能並支持對 SARS-CoV-2 的先天免疫，將 NAD+ 代謝直接連結到 COVID-19 嚴重程度與免疫防禦。

label: induces
context: The SASP induces endothelial dysfunction through the chemokine CXCL12, which is the most highly upregulated SASP factor in senescent endothelial cells with vascular aging. CXCL12 causally drives endothelial dysfunction by suppressing nitric oxide, promoting mitochondrial ROS, and inducing endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition. The senolytic fisetin normalizes CXCL12 to rescue vascular function.
context_zh_TW: SASP 透過趨化因子 CXCL12 誘導 endothelial dysfunction，在血管老化中，CXCL12 是衰老內皮細胞中上調幅度最高的 SASP 因子。CXCL12 透過抑制 nitric oxide、促進粒線體 ROS 並誘導 endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition，因果性地驅動 endothelial dysfunction。Senolytic fisetin 能使 CXCL12 正常化以挽救血管功能。

label: modulates
context: The SASP interacts with apoptosis in a complex, bidirectional manner: senescent cells resist apoptosis through senescent cell anti-apoptotic pathways (SCAPs), while SASP-derived signals can modulate apoptosis in neighboring cells, contributing to tissue remodeling and clearance of damaged cells.
context_zh_TW: SASP 與細胞凋亡以複雜的雙向方式互動：衰老細胞透過衰老細胞抗凋亡路徑（SCAPs）抵抗凋亡，而 SASP 衍生訊號可調控鄰近細胞的凋亡，參與組織重塑與受損細胞清除。

label: is_composed_of
context: The SASP is composed of growth-differentiation factor 15 (GDF15), a growth factor secreted by senescent cells. GDF15 contributes to colon carcinogenesis and promotes osteoarthritis from senescent chondrocytes, and its serum level is highly correlated with age and sex in individuals with age-related frailty. It is also proposed as a component of SASP biomarker panels.
context_zh_TW: SASP 由 growth-differentiation factor 15（GDF15）組成，這是衰老細胞分泌的一種生長因子。GDF15 促成結腸致癌，並由衰老軟骨細胞促成 osteoarthritis，且在年齡相關衰弱個體中，其血清水平與年齡和性別高度相關。它也被提議作為 SASP 生物標記組合的組成之一。

label: is_composed_of
context: The SASP is composed of hepatocyte growth factor (HGF), which is secreted by senescent fibroblasts. HGF inhibits cell competition-mediated cancer suppression mechanisms, thereby promoting cancer cell proliferation. This makes HGF a pro-tumorigenic component of the SASP.
context_zh_TW: SASP 由 hepatocyte growth factor（HGF）組成，它由衰老纖維母細胞分泌。HGF 抑制細胞競爭介導的癌症抑制機制，從而促進癌細胞增殖。這使 HGF 成為 SASP 的促腫瘤組成之一。

label: is_composed_of
context: The SASP is composed of the chemokine CXCL10, which is secreted by ROS-induced senescent hepatocytes. CXCL10 enhances natural killer cell activity by binding to CXCR3. This positions CXCL10 as a SASP factor that links cellular senescence to innate immune surveillance.
context_zh_TW: SASP 由趨化因子 CXCL10 組成，它由 ROS 誘導的衰老肝細胞分泌。CXCL10 透過與 CXCR3 結合增強自然殺手細胞活性。這使 CXCL10 成為將 cellular senescence 與先天免疫監視連結起來的 SASP 因子。

label: is_suppressed_by
context: The SASP is suppressed by glucocorticoids, which block the pro-inflammatory SASP by impairing IL-1alpha-mediated NF-kB activity. This senomorphic action modulates senescence-associated properties without cytotoxicity. Glucocorticoids thus represent a class of senomorphic therapy targeting the inflammatory arm of the SASP.
context_zh_TW: SASP 會被 glucocorticoids 抑制，它們透過損害 IL-1alpha 介導的 NF-kB 活性來阻斷促發炎性 SASP。這種 senomorphic 作用在不具細胞毒性的情況下調節衰老相關特性。因此 glucocorticoids 代表一類針對 SASP 發炎臂的 senomorphic 療法。

label: recruits
context: The SASP recruits T cells along with macrophages, natural killer cells, and neutrophils to the tissue microenvironment. This immune-cell recruitment is beneficial for limiting tumorigenesis by promoting immune clearance of senescent cells. However, excessive SASP factors can also suppress clearance by impairing macrophage phagocytosis.
context_zh_TW: SASP 招募 T cells，以及巨噬細胞、自然殺手細胞與嗜中性球至組織微環境。這種免疫細胞招募透過促進衰老細胞的免疫清除，有利於限制腫瘤發生。然而，過量的 SASP 因子也可能透過損害巨噬細胞吞噬作用來抑制清除。

label: requires
context: The SASP requires acetyl-CoA supplied by mitochondrial pyruvate metabolism for H3K27ac deposition at SASP loci. Mitochondrial pyruvate enters via MPC and feeds citrate synthesis; exported citrate is converted by ACLY to regenerate the acetyl-CoA pool. Inhibiting the mitochondrial citrate carrier SLC25A1 depletes this pool, removes H3K27ac from SASP enhancers, and selectively suppresses the SASP without killing senescent cells.
context_zh_TW: SASP 需要由粒線體丙酮酸代謝供應的 acetyl-CoA，用於在 SASP 基因座進行 H3K27ac 沉積。粒線體丙酮酸經 MPC 進入並供應檸檬酸合成；被輸出的檸檬酸由 ACLY 轉化以再生成 acetyl-CoA 池。抑制粒線體檸檬酸載體 SLC25A1 會耗竭此池、從 SASP 增強子移除 H3K27ac，並在不殺死衰老細胞的情況下選擇性抑制 SASP。

label: is_associated_with
context: The Wnt signaling pathway is nearly universally dysregulated in rectal cancer, alongside a higher frequency of APC mutations. Aberrant Wnt signaling drives rectal carcinogenesis. Wnt pathway dysregulation is therefore a defining molecular feature of rectal cancer.
context_zh_TW: Wnt 訊號傳導途徑在直腸癌中近乎普遍失調，同時 APC 突變頻率也較高。異常的 Wnt 訊號傳導驅動直腸癌發生。因此 Wnt 途徑失調是直腸癌的定義性分子特徵。

label: associates_with
context: The adrenochrome hypothesis is a theory proposed by Abram Hoffer and Humphry Osmond in the 1950s linking endogenous epinephrine oxidation to schizophrenia. The hypothesis proposed that adrenochrome, formed from the oxidation of epinephrine, might be a psychotomimetic agent and that an imbalance in this oxidation could contribute to the etiology of schizophrenia. Although it drove substantial research into catecholamine metabolism and oxidative stress pathways, it was largely superseded by the dopamine hypothesis of schizophrenia, and no convincing evidence has substantiated adrenochrome as a causal agent in schizophrenia.
context_zh_TW: The adrenochrome hypothesis is a theory proposed by Abram Hoffer and Humphry Osmond in the 1950s linking endogenous epinephrine oxidation to schizophrenia。The hypothesis proposed that adrenochrome, formed from the oxidation of epinephrine, might be a psychotomimetic agent and that an imbalance in this oxidation could contribute to the etiology of schizophrenia。Although it drove substantial research into catecholamine metabolism and oxidative stress pathways, it was largely superseded by the dopamine hypothesis of schizophrenia, and no convincing evidence has substantiated adrenochrome as a causal agent in schizophrenia。

label: buffers
context: The aqueous reaction medium for adrenochrome synthesis is maintained at a pH from 4 to 8, preferably with a buffer such as sodium hydrogencarbonate, sodium dihydrogenphosphate, disodium hydrogenphosphate, potassium acetate, or sodium acetate, with sodium hydrogencarbonate being preferred.
