This is one of the five dietary and supplement options recommended for improving methylation cycle function without high-dose methyl donor supplements.
context_zh_TW: 人體中約 40% 的 methyl groups 用於合成 creatine。以低劑量補充 creatine 可能有助於透過減少這種競爭性需求來減輕 methylation 途徑的負擔。這是為改善 methylation cycle 功能而不使用高劑量甲基供體補充劑而推薦的五種飲食和補充選項之一。

label: proposed
context: Abram Hoffer, together with Humphry Osmond, proposed the adrenochrome hypothesis of schizophrenia in the 1950s. They suggested that adrenochrome, the oxidation product of epinephrine, might be a psychotomimetic (hallucinogenic) agent formed endogenously, and they hypothesized that an imbalance in the oxidation of epinephrine into adrenochrome could contribute to the etiology of schizophrenia. While the hypothesis triggered extensive research into catecholamine metabolism and how catecholamine metabolites interact with neurological receptors, it was largely superseded by the dopamine hypothesis of schizophrenia in later decades.
context_zh_TW: Abram Hoffer 與 Humphry Osmond 在 1950s 提出了 adrenochrome hypothesis of schizophrenia。They suggested that adrenochrome, the oxidation product of epinephrine, might be a psychotomimetic (hallucinogenic) agent formed endogenously, and they hypothesized that an imbalance in the oxidation of epinephrine into adrenochrome could contribute to the etiology of schizophrenia。While the hypothesis triggered extensive research into catecholamine metabolism and how catecholamine metabolites interact with neurological receptors, it was largely superseded by the dopamine hypothesis of schizophrenia in later decades。

label: distributes_to
context: Absorbed silver distributes throughout the body in the blood, with particular accumulation in the liver. Hepatic sequestration reflects the binding of silver to sulfhydryl and amino groups of plasma and tissue proteins, which concentrates the metal in reticuloendothelial organs and other tissues with high protein turnover. Liver accumulation is a feature of chronic silver exposure, and together with deposition in the skin, eyes, and mucous membranes it underlies the systemic pigmentation and organ-level changes associated with argyria, which is permanent though not otherwise harmful.
context_zh_TW: 吸收的銀通過血液分布至全身，特別在肝臟積累。肝臟隔離反映了銀與血漿和組織蛋白質的硫氫基和氨基結合，將金屬濃縮在網狀內皮器官和其他蛋白質周轉率高的組織中。肝臟積累是慢性銀暴露的特徵，與皮膚、眼睛和黏膜中的沉積一起，構成了與argyria相關的系統性色素沉著和器官水平變化，雖然永久但無其他危害。

label: promotes
context: Accumulating evidence suggests that urolithin A may promote muscle protein synthesis and muscle growth through various pathways. It can increase the rate of protein synthesis within muscle cells while inhibiting protein degradation processes, allowing muscle cells to more effectively synthesize new proteins and maintain muscle mass. This anabolic action, combined with enhanced mitochondrial function and energy metabolism, supports muscle hypertrophy, the maintenance of muscle mass, and improved recovery after exercise.
context_zh_TW: 累積證據顯示 urolithin A 可能透過多種路徑促進肌肉蛋白合成與肌肉生長。它可提升肌肉細胞內蛋白質合成速率，同時抑制蛋白降解過程，使肌肉細胞能更有效地合成新蛋白並維持肌肉量。此合成代謝作用，結合增強的粒線體功能與能量代謝，支持肌肉肥大、肌肉量的維持，以及運動後更佳的恢復。

label: dissociates_from
context: Acetylation of 14-3-3-zeta triggers its dissociation from the initiator caspase-2, allowing caspase-2 activation. In contrast, SIRT1-mediated deacetylation of 14-3-3-zeta at K49 maintains its binding and keeps caspase-2 suppressed, so 14-3-3-zeta acetylation state controls apoptotic sensitivity.
context_zh_TW: 14-3-3ζ 的乙醯化觸發其與起始型 caspase-2 的解離，允許 caspase-2 活化。相反，SIRT1 在 K49 介導的 14-3-3ζ 去乙醯化維持其結合並使 caspase-2 保持受抑制，因此 14-3-3ζ 的乙醯化狀態控制凋亡敏感性。

label: exhibits
context: Acetylation of MnSOD at Lys68 destabilizes the homotetramer, shifting it to a monomeric form that gains roughly 40-fold increased peroxidase activity instead of dismutase activity. This Lys68-acetylation switch converts MnSOD from a superoxide scavenger into a pro-oxidant that generates H2O2 via peroxidase chemistry, driving HIF2-alpha stabilization and cancer stemness.
context_zh_TW: MnSOD 在 Lys68 的乙醯化會破壞同源四聚體，使其轉變為單體形式，獲得約 40 倍的過氧化酶活性而非歧化酶活性。此 Lys68 乙醯化開關將 MnSOD 從超氧陰離子清除劑轉變為透過過氧化酶化學生成 H2O2 的促氧化劑，驅動 HIF2-alpha 穩定化和癌症幹性。

label: is_induced_by
context: Acid ceramidase (ACase) expression is induced in neighboring proliferative cells by paracrine senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) signaling. Proliferative cells co-cultured with senescent cells (without direct contact) showed a significant time-dependent increase in ACase expression, while ACSL4 was unaffected, and the same effect was observed after incubating proliferative cells with recombinant IL-6/IL-8 (2:1 ratio). This ACase induction by the SASP cytokine IL-6 sensitizes bystander proliferative cells to ferroptosis, providing a mechanism for how senescent cells spread ferroptotic vulnerability through tissue.
context_zh_TW: 酸陶瓷酶 (ACase) 表現被鄰近增殖細胞通過旁分泌衰老相關分泌型表型 (SASP) 訊號誘導。在沒有直接接觸的情況下，與老化的細胞共培養的增殖細胞顯示出顯著的時間相關的 ACase 表現升高，而 ACSL4 不受影響，並且在孵育增殖細胞時使用重組人 IL-6/IL-8 (2:1) 比例的重組蛋白也觀察到相同的效果。這種由 SASP 促效素 IL-6 誘導的 ACase 表現使旁觀的增殖細胞對焦蛋白死亡敏感，為衰老細胞如何透過組織傳播焦蛋白死亡的脆弱性提供了機制。

label: acts_independently_of
context: Acid ceramidase (ACase) inhibition reduces PL-PUFA levels and lipid peroxidation without altering expression of ACSL4, the acyl-CoA synthetase that canonically drives PUFA incorporation into phospholipids during ferroptosis. After ACase knockdown, ACSL4 protein remained high, indicating that the decrease in PL-PUFAs is driven by reduced supply of saturated/monounsaturated fatty acids for Lands-cycle exchange (due to decreased ceramide lipolysis) rather than by changes in ACSL4. Both ACase and ACSL4 knockdown protect senescent cells against RSL3, but through supply-side versus incorporation-side mechanisms respectively.
context_zh_TW: 酸性膽鹼酯酶 (ACase) 抑制降低 PL-PUFA 水平和脂質過氧化而不改變 ACSL4 的表達，ACSᒪ4 是一種 canonically 驅動 PUFA 整合到磷脂中的 acyl-CoA  합성 효소。在 ACase 下調後，ACSL4 蛋白仍然很高，表明 PL-PUFAs 的減少是由飽和/單不飽和脂肪酸的供應減少（由於肌醇酯水解減少）所驅動，而不是由 ACSᒪ4 的變化所引起。ACase 和 ACSᒪ4 下調均能保護衰老細胞免受 RSL3 的影響，但分別通過供應側和整合側機制。

label: increases
context: Acid ceramidase (ACase) over-expression increases the polyunsaturated fatty acid (PUFA) content of membrane phospholipids, promoting a pro-ferroptotic lipid profile. Mechanistically, ACase-mediated ceramide breakdown releases free saturated and monounsaturated fatty acids that, via the Lands cycle, are exchanged into sn-2 PUFA-containing phospholipids (PL-PUFAs) - the substrates of lipid peroxidation. ACase knockdown in senescent cells decreased the most abundant PL-PUFA species (including PC-AA, PG-DHA, PG-DPA), thereby reducing the lipid peroxidation substrate pool and conferring ferroptosis resistance.
context_zh_TW: 酸陶瓷酶 (ACase) 過表達增加了膜磷脂中的不飽和脂肪酸 (PUFA) 含量，促進了促進焦蛋白死亡的脂類型態。從機制上講，ACase 介導的絲胺類分解釋放了自由飽和和一元飽和脂肪酸，透過 Lands 循環轉化為 sn-2 PUFA 含有磷脂 (PL-PUFAs) - 這是脂質過氧化反應的底物。在老化的細胞中，ACase 下調降低了最豐富的 PL-PUFA 物種（包括 PC-AA、PG-DHA、PG-DPA），從而降低了脂質過氧化反應底物池，並賦予了焦蛋白死亡的抵抗力。

label: produces
context: Acid ceramidase catalyzes the breakdown of ceramides into sphingosine and free fatty acids, directly producing sphingosine in the cell. This enzymatic hydrolysis is a key branch point in sphingolipid metabolism, and in senescent cells the resulting reshaping of membrane lipid composition pushes membranes toward a pro-ferroptotic profile rich in polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs), the preferred substrates for lipid peroxidation. Because the excess sphingosine and free fatty acids generated by elevated acid ceramidase feed the lipid-peroxidation cascade, the enzyme serves as a mechanistic link between the cellular programs of senescence and ferroptosis, and its removal protects cells from ferroptotic death.
context_zh_TW: 酸陶瓷酶催化絲胺類分解成腎上腺素和自由脂肪酸，直接在細胞中產生腎上腺素。這種酶促水解是腎上腺素脂質代謝中的一個關鍵分支點，在老化的細胞中，由此重塑的膜脂類組成推動膜朝向富含不飽和脂肪酸 (PUFAs) 的促進焦蛋白死亡的型態 - 這是脂質過氧化反應的理想底物。因為過量的腎上腺素和由升高後的酸陶瓷酶產生的自由脂肪酸餵養了脂質過氧化反應的過程，因此這種酶作為細胞衰老和焦蛋白死亡兩個程序之間的機制聯繫，並且去除這種酶可以保護細胞免受焦蛋白死亡的死亡。

label: inhibits
context: Acidic conditions strongly slow or prevent the cyclization step of adrenochrome formation, because at low pH the side-chain amine of the oxidized epinephrine intermediate is protonated and reduced in nucleophilicity, so it cannot easily attack the quinone ring. In highly acidic solutions the open-chain quinone form is favored and more stable, while neutral-to-alkaline pH accelerates cyclization and oxidation. This pH dependence explains why pharmaceutical epinephrine solutions are kept acidic (pH 3-5) with antioxidants to minimize oxidation and adrenochrome formation, and it is the most important factor in controlling the reaction rate.
context_zh_TW: 酸性條件會強烈減緩或阻止 adrenochrome 形成的 cyclization 步驟，因為在低 pH 下，氧化 epinephrine 中間產物的 side-chain amine 會被質子化且 nucleophilicity 降低，因此無法輕易攻擊 quinone ring。在強酸性溶液中，open-chain quinone 形式較受青睞且更穩定，而中性至鹼性 pH 則加速 cyclization 與氧化。這種 pH dependence 解釋了為何藥用 epinephrine 溶液需保持酸性（pH 3-5）並添加 antioxidants，以最小化氧化與 adrenochrome 形成，且這是控制反應速率最重要的因素。

label: phosphorylates
context: Activated ATM phosphorylates the checkpoint kinase CHK2, which propagates the DNA-damage checkpoint signal. This cascade initiates cell-cycle arrest and coordinates the damage response. CHK2 is thus a direct downstream substrate of ATM.
context_zh_TW: 激活的 ATM 磷酸化檢查點激酶 CHK2，進而傳播 DNA 損傷檢查點訊號。此級聯啟動細胞週期停滯並協調損傷反應。因此 CHK2 是 ATM 的直接下游受質。

label: promotes
context: Activation of AMPK promotes fatty acid oxidation and insulin sensitivity while reducing fatty acid synthesis and gluconeogenesis, and it can also increase mitochondrial biogenesis and glycogen synthesis. Through AMPK-dependent signaling, urolithin A improves muscle energy supply and metabolism. AMPK is therefore a central node connecting cellular energy status to muscle metabolic adaptation, endurance, and overall muscle performance, and its activation is a key mechanism underlying the metabolic effects attributed to urolithin A.
context_zh_TW: AMPK 的活化促進脂肪酸氧化與胰島素敏感性，同時降低脂肪酸合成與糖質新生，並可增加粒線體生成與肝醣合成。透過依賴 AMPK 的訊號，urolithin A 改善肌肉能量供應與代謝。因此，AMPK 是連結細胞能量狀態與肌肉代謝適應、耐力及整體肌肉表現的中央節點，而其活化是歸因於 urolithin A 的代謝效應的關鍵機制。

label: induces
context: Activation of ATM by DNA double-strand breaks initiates cell-cycle arrest, a principal functional output of the kinase. Through CHK2 and p53, ATM enforces arrest that provides time for repair. This makes ATM a master coordinator of the damage checkpoint.
context_zh_TW: ATM 因 DNA 雙股斷裂而激活，進而啟動細胞週期停滯，這是該激酶的主要功能性輸出。透過 CHK2 和 p53，ATM 強制實施停滯，為修復爭取時間。這使 ATM 成為損傷檢查點的主要協調者。

label: mediates
context: Activation of GluCls in nematodes and arthropods drives Cl- influx, membrane hyperpolarization, flaccid paralysis and death.
context_zh_TW: 線蟲和節肢動物中 GluCl 的活化會導致 Cl 流入、膜超極化、弛緩性麻痺和死亡。

label: extends
context: Activation of the mitochondrial unfolded protein response (UPRmt) is an important determinant of lifespan in C. elegans. Knockdown of the mitochondrial ribosomal protein mrps-5 constitutively activates UPRmt and extends lifespan, and genetic inhibition of UPRmt abrogates this longevity benefit; restoration of NAD+ levels also extends longevity through a UPRmt-dependent pathway. Remarkably, tissue-specific knockdown of the cytochrome c oxidase component cco-1 in the brain activates UPRmt in distal tissues via mitokines and increases whole-organism lifespan, demonstrating cell-non-autonomous regulation of longevity.
context_zh_TW: 粒線體未折疊蛋白反應（UPRmt）的活化是 C. elegans 壽命的重要決定因素。粒線體核糖體蛋白 mrps-5 的敲低會持續活化 UPRmt 並延長壽命，而 UPRmt 的基因抑制則會消除這種長壽益處；NAD+ 水平的恢復也透過 UPRmt 依賴性途徑延長壽命。值得注意的是，腦中細胞色素 c 氧化酶成分 cco-1 的組織特異性敲低，會透過粒線體因子（mitokines）在遠端組織活化 UPRmt，並增加整體生物的壽命，展示了壽命的細胞非自主性調節。

label: recruits
context: Active IRAK4 phosphorylates IRAK1, which then recruits TRAF6 through its C-terminal TRAF6-binding motifs, extending the myddosome signaling complex. This step connects the receptor-proximal kinases to E3 ubiquitin ligase activity and TAK1 activation, ultimately driving NF-kB and MAPK signaling. In senescence, IRAK1 is required for full SASP establishment, linking the IL-1R pathway to the secretome. The relationship is a standard component of IL-1R/TLR signal propagation and is well validated biochemically.
context_zh_TW: MyD88 招募 IRAK1，其與 IRAK4 協作磷酸化並活化 TRAF6 以傳播 NF-κB 與 MAPK 訊號。此步驟在 Myddosome 內組裝下游發炎級聯，將 IL-1R 感知連結到 SASP 基因轉錄。IRAK1 參與使其成為 MyD88 依賴衰老發炎中的功能性節點，且其在旁分泌衰老中的角色支持 MyD88—IRAK—TRAF6 軸的因果貢獻。它是慢性 SASP 輸出維持的組成。

label: cleaves
context: Active caspase-4/5/11 cleave gasdermin D between its N-terminal pore-forming domain and C-terminal inhibitory domain, releasing the N-terminal fragment to form plasma-membrane pores. This drives inflammatory cell death (pyroptosis) and IL-1alpha release in senescent and responding cells, and the pores also permit release of IL-1beta and IL-18 prior to membrane rupture. The relationship is the canonical execution step of noncanonical inflammasome signaling and links the pathway to both cell death and SASP amplification, creating a feed-forward inflammatory loop in senescent tissue.
context_zh_TW: 活化的 caspase-4/5/11 切割 gasdermin D 其 N 端成孔域與 C 端抑制域之間，釋放 N 端片段形成質膜孔洞。這驅動發炎性細胞死亡（pyroptosis）與衰老及反應細胞中的 IL-1alpha 釋放，且孔洞允許 DAMPs 與細胞激素外逸以放大發炎。透過將非典型發炎體連結到膜透化，此切割將細胞死亡形態與 SASP 耦合，影響衰老細胞存留與免疫清除。

label: is_a_component_of
context: Activin A is a TGF-beta family ligand component of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype that mediates paracrine senescence by inducing cell-cycle inhibitors in neighboring cells. As part of the secretome, it contributes to the arrest-spreading and immune-modulatory functions of senescent cells. Its inclusion marks the SASP as carrying both inflammatory and TGFbeta-family arrest signals, broadening the communicative repertoire of senescence beyond classic cytokines such as IL-6 and IL-8. The presence of structurally diverse ligands reflects the functional complexity of the senescent secretome.
context_zh_TW: Activin A 是介導旁分泌衰老、透過誘發鄰近細胞細胞週期抑制因子將衰老相關分泌表型成分化的 TGF-beta 家族配體。作為分泌組的一部分，它貢獻衰老細胞的停滯擴散與免疫調節功能。其納入標記 SASP 攜帶發炎與 TGFbeta 家族停滯訊號兩者，拓寬超越 IL-6 與 IL-8 等經典細胞激素的衰老溝通庫。結構多樣配體的存在反映衰老分泌組的功能複雜性。

label: phosphorylates
context: Adenosine kinase (ADK) acts as an NRH kinase in a recently discovered novel biosynthetic route of NAD+ from NRH (the reduced form of nicotinamide riboside) through the NMNH intermediate, providing a NMRK-independent pathway for the NRH-induced NAD+ increase. NRH is more stable than nicotinamide riboside (NR), which degrades to nicotinamide in the blood, and NRH increases NAD+ in both cultured cells (5-10-fold above the baseline) and mice, in a more potent and faster manner than NR. Endogenous NRH was detected in the liver of mouse models, establishing NRH as a valid natural precursor of NAD+.
context_zh_TW: adenosine kinase（ADK，腺苷激酶）在近期發現的從 NRH（nicotinamide riboside 的還原型）經由 NMNH 中間產物生成 NAD+ 的新穎生物合成路徑中作為 NRH 激酶，提供了 NRH 誘發 NAD+ 增加的 NMRK 非依賴性路徑。NRH 比 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）更穩定，後者在血液中降解為 nicotinamide，且 NRH 以比 NR 更強效且更快速的方式提升培養細胞（高於基線 5-10 倍）與小鼠中的 NAD+。小鼠模型肝臟中偵測到內源性 NRH，確立了 NRH 作為 NAD+ 的有效天然前驅物。

label: reduces_levels_of
context: Administration of AGK2 confers significant neuroprotection under ischemic and hypoxic conditions by suppressing the apoptotic cascade, downregulating phosphorylated JNK (phospho-JNK) and FOXO3a, the direct downstream target of SIRT2. This ultimately prevents Bim activation and subsequent caspase-3 cleavage.
context_zh_TW: 在缺血和缺氧條件下，給予 AGK2 透過抑制凋亡級聯、下調磷酸化 JNK（phospho-JNK）和 FOXO3a（SIRT2 的直接下游靶標）來提供顯著的神經保護。這最終阻止 Bim 活化和隨後的 caspase-3 裂解。

label: cyclizes_to
context: Adrenaline-quinone, formed by oxidation of epinephrine, undergoes intramolecular cyclization to yield leuco-adrenochrome, the 'white' or reduced form of the aminochrome system. Leuco-adrenochrome is (S)-1-Methylindoline-3,5,6-triol, an unstable and highly reactive redox intermediate within the body's catecholamine pathways. This cyclization step is the link between open-chain quinone formation and the ring-closed indole structures that subsequently oxidize into the red/pink colored adrenochrome, and it is a key step in the oxidative degradation of epinephrine in both biological systems and pharmaceutical formulations.
context_zh_TW: Adrenaline-quinone，由 epinephrine oxidation 形成， undergoes intramolecular cyclization to yield leuco-adrenochrome，即 aminochrome system 的 'white' 或 reduced form。Leuco-adrenochrome 是 (S)-1-Methylindoline-3,5,6-triol，一種 unstable 且 highly reactive redox intermediate，存在於 body's catecholamine pathways 中。此 cyclization step 是 open-chain quinone formation 與 ring-closed indole structures 之間的 link，後者 subsequently oxidize into the red/pink colored adrenochrome，且是 biological systems 和 pharmaceutical formulations 中 epinephrine oxidative degradation 的 key step。

label: oxidizes
context: Adrenochrome has been commercially prepared by oxidizing adrenaline or its salts with potassium ferricyanide in an aqueous medium. This process is uneconomical because of the large quantities of potassium ferricyanide needed, the ensuing effluent disposal problems, and variability in product quality. The patent presents a bismuth-catalyzed persulfate process as a superior alternative that precludes these problems and yields less-colored carbazochrome and adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine products.
context_zh_TW: 腎上腺紅的商業製備一直是於水相介質中以鐵氰化鉀氧化腎上腺素或其鹽類。此製程不具經濟效益，因為需要大量鐵氰化鉀、隨之產生廢液處理問題，且產品品質不穩定。該專利提出一種鉍催化過硫酸鹽製程作為更優的替代方案，可避免這些問題，並產生色澤較淺的carbazochrome和腎上腺紅單胺基胍產物。

label: causes
context: Adrenochrome has been shown to be cardiotoxic, and its toxicity is central to the hypothesis that the adrenochrome pathway contributes to stress-induced heart disease. In experimental systems, adrenochrome administration causes cardiac damage characterized by cell necrosis, arrhythmias, and coronary artery constriction, effects that mirror the pathology seen in the hearts of patients after myocardial infarction or severe stress. The proposed mechanism connects the molecule's reactivity as an electrophilic quinone, which forms adducts with cellular proteins, to injury of heart muscle. Because adrenochrome is produced when oxygen radicals from stimulated neutrophils oxidize adrenaline, the pathway offers a link between inflammation, oxidant stress, and catecholamine-driven cardiac damage, even though the clinical significance of adrenochrome remains debated due to the difficulty of detecting the compound in vivo.
context_zh_TW: 腎上腺素已被證實具有心臟毒性，其毒性是腎上腺素途徑促成壓力引發心臟疾病之假說的核心。在實驗系統中，腎上腺素的投予會造成心臟損傷，其特徵包括細胞壞死、心律不整和冠狀動脈收縮，這些效應反映了心肌梗塞或嚴重壓力後患者心臟中所見的病理變化。所提出的機制將該分子作為親電性醌的反應性——可與細胞蛋白質形成加合物——與心肌損傷聯繫起來。由於腎上腺素是在活化的嗜中性白血球產生的氧自由基氧化腎上腺素時所生成的，該途徑提供了發炎、氧化壓力與兒茶酚胺驅動的心臟損傷之間的關聯，儘管腎上腺素的臨床意義仍具爭議，因為在體內檢測該化合物相當困難。

label: causes
context: Adrenochrome has been shown to be cardiotoxic, and one of its documented cardiovascular effects is constriction of the coronary arteries. Along with cell necrosis and arrhythmias, coronary artery constriction links adrenochrome to impaired blood supply to the heart muscle and thereby to the pathology of stress-induced heart disease. The vasoconstrictive action of this adrenaline oxidation product is consistent with the broader biology of catecholamine oxidation, where reactive quinone species exert direct effects on vascular smooth muscle. These findings are significant in the context of the adrenochrome pathway because oxygen radicals produced by stimulated neutrophils infiltrating the myocardium can drive adrenaline oxidation to adrenochrome, potentially converting an elevated catecholamine state into a vasoconstrictive, cardiotoxic insult during infarction and inflammation.
context_zh_TW: 已知 Adrenochrome 具有心臟毒性，其已記錄的心血管作用之一是冠狀動脈收縮。除了細胞壞死和心律不整外，冠狀動脈收縮將 Adrenochrome 與心肌血液供應受損連結起來，進而與壓力性心臟疾病的病理相關。這種 adrenaline 氧化產物的血管收縮作用與 catecholamine 氧化的更廣泛生物學一致，其中活性醌類物種對血管平滑肌產生直接作用。這些發現在 Adrenochrome 途徑的背景下具有重要意義，因為浸潤心肌的活化嗜中性白血球產生的氧自由基可驅動 adrenaline 氧化為 Adrenochrome， potentially converting an elevated catecholamine state into a vasoconstrictive, cardiotoxic insult during infarction and inflammation.

label: induces
context: Adrenochrome has been shown to be cardiotoxic, causing arrhythmias among its effects on the heart. The capacity of this oxidation product of adrenaline to disturb cardiac electrical activity, together with its induction of cell necrosis and coronary artery constriction, has made it a candidate mediator of stress-induced heart disease. Arrhythmias are proposed to arise because adrenochrome, as a reactive quinone, modifies cardiac proteins and disrupts the ionic and signaling machinery of cardiomyocytes. These effects are relevant to the hypothesis that when stimulated neutrophils produce oxygen radicals that oxidize adrenaline through the adrenochrome pathway, the resulting cardiotoxic products could contribute to the electrical instability observed after myocardial infarction, although the in vivo significance remains controversial because adrenochrome has never been detected in biological fluids.
context_zh_TW: Adrenochrome已被證實具有心臟毒性，其對心臟的影響包括心律不齊。這種腎上腺素氧化產物干擾心臟電活動的能力，加上其誘發細胞壞死和冠狀動脈收縮的作用，使其成為壓力性心臟病的候選介導因子。心律不齊的產生被認為是因為adrenochrome作為一種活性醌類，修飾心臟蛋白並破壞心肌細胞的離子與訊號傳導機制。這些效應與以下假說相關：當受刺激的中性白血球產生氧自由基，透過adrenochrome pathway氧化腎上腺素時，所產生的心臟毒性產物可能促成心肌梗塞後觀察到的電不穩定性，但其體內意義仍具爭議性，因為adrenochrome從未在生物液體中被偵測到。

label: causes
context: Adrenochrome has been shown to be cardiotoxic, causing cell necrosis as one of its principal effects on cardiac tissue. Alongside arrhythmias and coronary artery constriction, the induction of cell necrosis demonstrates that adrenochrome is not merely an inert pigment but a cytologically damaging oxidation product of adrenaline. The necrotic cell death it triggers is consistent with its behavior as a reactive electrophilic quinone that forms covalent adducts with proteins and DNA, disrupting cellular function. These toxic effects provide the rationale for investigating the adrenochrome pathway in stress-induced heart disease, where oxygen radicals produced by stimulated neutrophils infiltrating the myocardium can drive adrenaline oxidation, potentially converting an excess of the catecholamine into a locally necrotizing species in the heart.
context_zh_TW: Adrenochrome已知具有心臟毒性，導致細胞壞死為其對心臟組織的主要效應之一。除心律不齊和冠狀動脈收縮外，細胞壞死的誘導表明adrenochrome不僅僅是一種惰性色素，而是腎上腺素的細胞毒性氧化產物。其觸發的壞死性細胞死亡與其作為活性親電醌的行為一致，該醌可與蛋白質和DNA形成共價加合物，擾亂細胞功能。這些毒性效應提供了研究adrenochrome途徑在壓力誘發之心臟疾病中的依據，其中浸潤心肌的活化嗜中性球所產生的氧自由基可驅動腎上腺素氧化， potentially將過量的兒茶酚胺轉化為心臟局部壞死性物種。

label: is_a
context: Adrenochrome is a highly reactive electrophile, an electron-poor species that seeks electrons from other molecules. As a quinone, its electron-deficient carbonyl system readily bonds with nucleophilic sites on proteins, DNA, and other cellular structures, forming covalent adducts, and this reactivity is why the molecule is considered toxic to cells. The electrophilic character also drives adrenochrome's self-reactivity: it rapidly polymerizes into melanin pigments rather than persisting in solution. This electron-poor nature is the mechanistic basis for adrenochrome's reported cardiotoxic effects, including cell necrosis, arrhythmias, and coronary artery constriction, because covalent modification of cellular macromolecules disrupts their function. Electrophilicity therefore unifies adrenochrome's instability, its adduct-forming toxicity, and its position as the central reactive intermediate of the adrenaline oxidation pathway.
context_zh_TW: 腎上腺素紅是一種高活性的親電體，一種電子缺乏的物質，會從其他分子中尋求電子。作為一種醌類，其電子缺乏的羰基系統容易與蛋白質、DNA 及其他細胞結構上的親核位點結合，形成共價加合物，而這種反應活性正是該分子被認為對細胞具有毒性的原因。其親電特性也驅動了腎上腺素紅的自我反應性：它會迅速聚合形成黑色素顏料，而非在溶液中持續存在。這種電子缺乏的特性是腎上腺素紅所報告的心臟毒性效應的機制基礎，包括細胞壞死、心律不整和冠狀動脈收縮，因為對細胞大分子的共價修飾會破壞其功能。因此，親電性將腎上腺素紅的不穩定性、其形成加合物的毒性，以及其作為腎上腺素氧化途徑中核心反應中間體的地位統一起來。

label: is_a
context: Adrenochrome is a pigment obtained by the oxidation of epinephrine, exhibiting a characteristic pink-to-red color in aqueous solution that has been recognized since its first description in 1856. The pink color results from the conjugated indoline-5,6-dione chromophore that forms when the catecholamine ring is oxidized and cyclized. As a pigment, adrenochrome is an intermediate in the melanin pathway, because its further polymerization produces dark brown and black melanin pigments; the visible reddening of adrenaline solutions left exposed to air is the classic demonstration of this chemistry. Beyond its color, the pigment identity connects adrenochrome to histochemical and forensic contexts, where oxidation products of catecholamines are used as stains, and to pathology, where it represents an oxidative transformation of adrenaline linked to cellular damage.
context_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 是一種通過腎上腺素氧化獲得的色素，在水溶液中呈現特徵性的粉紅至紅色，自 1856 年首次描述以來已被認識。粉紅色源於共軛的 indoline-5,6-dione 發色團，該發色團在兒茶酚胺環氧化和環化時形成。作為色素，adrenochrome 是黑色素途徑中的中間體，因為其進一步聚合產生深棕色和黑色黑色素；暴露於空氣中的腎上腺素溶液可見的變紅是這種化學反應的經典演示。除了顏色之外，色素身份將 adrenochrome 與組織化學和法醫學背景聯繫起來，在那裡兒茶酚胺的氧化產物用作染色劑，並與病理學聯繫起來，在那裡它代表與細胞損傷相關的腎上腺素氧化轉化。

label: binds
context: Adrenochrome is a reactive electrophilic quinone that readily bonds with DNA as well as proteins, forming covalent adducts that contribute to its cellular toxicity. Because the molecule is small and water soluble, it can reach nuclear material and modify nucleophilic sites on DNA bases. Such adduct formation can promote mutagenesis, genotoxic stress, and cell death, and it places adrenochrome among the oxidative metabolites of catecholamines with genotoxic potential. The DNA reactivity complements adrenochrome's protein-binding behavior and its reported cardiotoxicity, including cell necrosis, in stressed heart tissue. Because adrenochrome's half-life in aqueous solution is short, DNA damage from this pathway would be expected to occur rapidly after formation, emphasizing that the toxic window is brief but potentially severe.
context_zh_TW: 腎上腺素紅（Adrenochrome）是一種活性親電醌類物質，容易與DNA及蛋白質結合，形成共價加合物，進而造成細胞毒性。由於該分子體積小且具水溶性，可到達核物質並修飾DNA鹼基上的親核位點。此類加合物的形成可促進致突變作用、基因毒性應激及細胞死亡，使腎上腺素紅被歸類為具有基因毒性的兒茶酚胺氧化代謝物。DNA反應性與腎上腺素紅的蛋白質結合特性及其報導的心臟毒性（包括受損心臟組織中的細胞壞死）形成互補。由於腎上腺素紅在水溶液中的半衰期較短，此途徑造成的DNA損傷預期在形成後迅速發生，強調其毒性窗口雖短暫但潛在嚴重性高。

label: derives_from
context: Adrenochrome is an oxidation product of epinephrine (adrenaline), formed when the catecholamine is oxidized to its ortho-quinone and cyclizes. Because epinephrine is released during stress and ischemia, adrenochrome can accumulate locally under oxidative conditions. Historically, systemic administration or localized accumulation of adrenochrome has been associated with myocardial damage, coronary spasms, intracellular calcium overload, and severe arrhythmias, the cardiotoxicity that constrains any therapeutic use.
context_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 是 epinephrine (adrenaline) 的氧化產物，當 catecholamine 被氧化為其 ortho-quinone 並環化時形成。由於 epinephrine 在壓力和缺血期間釋放，adrenochrome 可在氧化條件下局部積累。歷史上，系統性給藥或局部積累的 adrenochrome 與心肌損傷、冠狀動脈痙攣、細胞內鈣超載和嚴重心律失常有關，這些心臟毒性限制了任何治療用途。

label: contains
context: Adrenochrome is an oxidation product of epinephrine built around an indoline-dione core. Indoline-dione and isatin-like structures are recognized privileged scaffolds in medicinal chemistry, often showing antioxidant, neuroprotective, and enzymatic inhibitory activities. This redox-active core provides the oxidative-modulation arm of adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine, while free adrenochrome is unstable and cardiotoxic through redox cycling that generates reactive oxygen species. The scaffold therefore underpins both the potential therapeutic utility and the inherent toxicity of adrenochrome-based compounds, motivating conjugation strategies that stabilize the reactive dione.
context_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 是圍繞 indoline-dione 核心建構的腎上腺素氧化產物。Indoline-dione 與 isatin-like 結構被公認為藥物化學中的特權骨架，常展現抗氧化、神經保護與酶抑制活性。此具氧化還原活性的核心提供了 adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine 的氧化調節臂，而游離 adrenochrome 則因產生活性氧物種的氧化還原循環而不穩定且具有心臟毒性。因此，此骨架同時支撐了 adrenochrome 類化合物的潛在治療效用與固有毒性，促使人們採用能穩定反應性二酮的共軛策略。

label: is_formed_from
context: Adrenochrome is an oxidation product of epinephrine that contains an indoline-5,6-dione core. Free, non-conjugated adrenochrome is highly unstable and known to be cardiotoxic, because its redox cycling can generate reactive oxygen species and deplete cellular antioxidants such as glutathione under physiological conditions. Because of this instability and toxicity, adrenochrome is typically studied in conjugated forms. Its indoline-dione scaffold belongs to a family of privileged scaffolds in medicinal chemistry that often show antioxidant, neuroprotective, and enzymatic inhibitory activities, which motivated the design of aminoguanidine-based conjugates.
context_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 是含 indoline-5,6-dione 核心的腎上腺素氧化產物。游離、未共軛的 adrenochrome 極不穩定且已知具有心臟毒性，因為其氧化還原循環可在生理條件下產生活性氧物種並耗竭麩胱甘肽等細胞抗氧化劑。由於此不穩定性與毒性，adrenochrome 通常以共軛形式被研究。其 indoline-dione 骨架屬於藥物化學中一類常具抗氧化、神經保護與酶抑制活性的特權骨架，這促成了以 aminoguanidine 為基礎的共軛物設計。

label: causes
context: Adrenochrome is classified under the Globally Harmonized System (GHS) with hazard statement H302, meaning it is harmful if swallowed, with acute oral toxicity category 4 (Acute Tox. 4, 100% of notifications). The signal word is Warning with an irritant pictogram. This regulatory classification reflects experimental evidence that ingestion of adrenochrome can produce adverse effects, complementing mechanistic studies showing that adrenochrome, as an electrophilic quinone, readily forms covalent adducts with proteins and DNA and is cardiotoxic, capable of causing cell necrosis, arrhythmias, and coronary artery constriction. The GHS designation provides a formal toxicological endpoint that supports the view of adrenochrome as a biologically reactive molecule rather than an inert pigment, though its clinical significance in human disease remains debated.
context_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 根據全球統一分類系統 (GHS) 被分類，具有危險性說明 H302，意味著吞食有害，具有急性口服毒性類別 4（急性毒性 4，100% 通知）。信號詞為警告，帶有刺激性象形圖。這種監管分類反映了攝入 adrenochrome 可能產生不良反應的實驗證據，補充了機制研究，表明 adrenochrome 作為親電醌易於與蛋白質和 DNA 形成共價加合物，並具有心臟毒性，可導致細胞壞死、心律失常和冠狀動脈收縮。GHS 指定提供了一個正式的毒理學終點，支持將 adrenochrome 視為生物反應性分子而非惰性色素的觀點，儘管其在人類疾病中的臨床意義仍有爭議。

label: is_unstable_in
context: Adrenochrome is highly unstable in aqueous solutions at physiological pH, rapidly polymerizing into neuromelanin-like compounds. This chemical instability is a critical translational challenge because it makes formulating adrenochrome or its derivatives to achieve a controlled, targeted therapeutic window in vivo extremely difficult. The rapid polymerization also means that observed biological effects of adrenochrome preparations may be confounded by the presence of its polymeric breakdown products, complicating both mechanistic studies and any proposed use as a senotherapeutic agent.
context_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 在生理 pH 的水溶液中高度不穩定，會快速聚合形成類似 neuromelanin 的化合物。這種化學不穩定性是一個關鍵的轉譯挑戰，因為它使得製劑 adrenochrome 或其衍生物以在體內實現受控、靶向的治療窗口極其困難。快速聚合也意味著 adrenochrome 製劑觀察到的生物效應可能因其聚合分解產物的存在而混淆，使機制研究和任何擬議作為 senotherapeutic agent 的用途變得複雜。

label: polymerizes_to
context: Adrenochrome is inherently very unstable and, as a highly reactive electrophile, rapidly undergoes further reactions once formed. Chief among these is polymerization: adrenochrome molecules condense together to produce melanins, the black and brown pigments responsible for the darkening of oxidized adrenaline solutions and related to the pigment chemistry of skin and hair. This polymerization is part of why adrenochrome has only a fleeting existence in aqueous solution, with a half-life ranging from minutes to hours depending on temperature, pH, and the presence of nucleophiles. The melanin-forming instability also means that adrenochrome sits on the oxidative pathway connecting catecholamines to the pigment melanin, linking adrenaline oxidation to pigmentation biochemistry and to the tissue discoloration seen in oxidized catecholamine environments.
context_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 本質上非常不穩定，作為高活性親電體，一旦形成便迅速進行進一步反應。其中最主要的是聚合反應：Adrenochrome 分子相互凝縮產生 melanin（黑色素），這是導致氧化 adrenaline 溶液變黑變棕的色素，與皮膚和毛髮的色素化學相關。這種聚合反應是 adrenochrome 在水溶液中僅能短暫存在的原因之一，其半衰期依溫度、pH 值及親核試體的存在與否，從數分鐘到數小時不等。形成 melanin 的不穩定性也意味著 adrenochrome 位於連接 catecholamine 與色素 melanin 的氧化途徑上，將 adrenaline 的氧化與色素生成生物化學，以及在氧化 catecholamine 環境中所見的組織變色連結起來。

label: converts_to
context: Adrenochrome is unstable and undergoes further conversion to adrenolutin, particularly under alkaline conditions, as well as to semiquinone radicals and melanin-like polymers. These downstream transformations occur both in vitro and in vivo and contribute to the difficulty of detecting adrenochrome directly at significant levels in healthy tissues. Adrenolutin and other adrenochrome-derived products are among the oxidized metabolites implicated in oxidative stress and pigment accumulation, and adrenochrome can also participate in redox cycling to generate superoxide before or alongside these conversions.
context_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 不穩定，會進一步轉化為 adrenolutin，尤其在鹼性條件下，也會轉化為 semiquinone radicals 與 melanin-like polymers。這些 downstream transformations 在體外與體內都會發生，並導致難以在健康組織中直接偵測到顯著水平的 adrenochrome。Adrenolutin 與其他 adrenochrome-derived products 是涉及 oxidative stress 與色素堆積的 oxidized metabolites 之一，且 adrenochrome 也可在這些轉化之前或同時參與 redox cycling 以產生 superoxide。

label: stabilizes
context: Adrenochrome is very unstable due to its ortho-quinoid structure and is therefore usually stabilized by conventional derivatization with hydrazines, e.g., aminoguanidine, semicarbazide, phenylhydrazine, o-nitrophenylhydrazine, p-nitrophenylhydrazine, and 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine. These hydrazine derivatives serve both for the stabilization of adrenochrome and for the preparation of useful medicines such as hemostatics. The stabilization treatment is generally conducted for 30 minutes to 3 hours at a temperature of 0 to 15 degrees C.
context_zh_TW: 腎上腺紅因其鄰醌式結構而極不穩定，因此通常透過與肼類（如胺基胍、氨基硫脲、苯肼、鄰硝基苯肼、對硝基苯肼和2,4-二硝基苯肼）的常規衍生化來穩定。這些肼衍生物既用於穩定腎上腺紅，也用於製備如止血劑等實用藥物。穩定化處理通常在0至15°C下進行30分鐘至3小時。

label: contains
context: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine (AMM) contains an aminoguanidine moiety, one of the most thoroughly studied prototype inhibitors of AGE formation. Aminoguanidine typically acts as a nucleophilic trap for highly reactive dicarbonyl intermediates such as methylglyoxal and glyoxal before they can react with lysine or arginine residues on proteins to form irreversible crosslinks. In AMM, however, the primary hydrazine group of aminoguanidine is consumed to form the hydrazone bond with the indoline core, so the compound's dicarbonyl-scavenging capacity depends on remaining guanidine nitrogens, prodrug hydrolysis, or alternative pathways such as metal chelation.
context_zh_TW: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine（AMM）含有一個 aminoguanidine 基團，這是最被深入研究、作為 AGE 形成原型抑制劑之一的物質。Aminoguanidine 通常在高反應性二羰基中間體（如 methylglyoxal 與 glyoxal）與蛋白質上的離胺酸或精胺酸殘基反應形成不可逆交聯之前，充當其親核性陷阱。然而，在 AMM 中，aminoguanidine 的主要肼基已被消耗以與 indoline 核心形成腙鍵，因此該化合物的二羰基清除能力取決於剩餘的胍氮、前藥水解，或金屬螯合等替代途徑。

label: is_a
context: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine (AMM), historically known as S-Adchnon or adrenochrome guanylhydrazone, is formed by reacting adrenochrome, an oxidation product of epinephrine containing an indoline-5,6-dione core, with aminoguanidine, a nucleophilic hydrazine derivative. The reaction forms a stable guanylhydrazone linkage at one of the carbonyl groups of the dione structure. AMM therefore combines a redox-active indoline core with an established anti-glycation agent, providing a dual-action glyco-oxidative modulator designed to simultaneously target oxidative stress and protein crosslinking by advanced glycation end products.
context_zh_TW: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine（AMM），歷史上稱為 S-Adchnon 或 adrenochrome guanylhydrazone，是由含 indoline-5,6-dione 核心的腎上腺素氧化產物 adrenochrome，與親核性肼衍生物 aminoguanidine 反應形成。該反應在二酮結構的其中一個羰基上形成穩定的 guanylhydrazone 連結。因此，AMM 將具氧化還原活性的 indoline 核心與既有的抗糖化劑結合，提供一種雙重作用的糖氧化調節劑，旨在同時標靶氧化壓力與晚期糖化終產物所引發的蛋白質交聯。

label: is_synthesized_from
context: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine is synthesized by reacting adrenochrome, an oxidation product of epinephrine containing an indoline-5,6-dione core, with aminoguanidine, a nucleophilic hydrazine derivative. The reaction forms a stable guanylhydrazone linkage at one of the carbonyl groups of the dione. Adrenochrome itself is highly unstable and cardiotoxic, but the stable guanylhydrazone conjugate mitigates this toxicity, making the molecule safe enough for historical clinical use. The hybrid compound is proposed as a dual-action glyco-oxidative modulator that targets both oxidative stress and advanced glycation end product-mediated protein crosslinking.
context_zh_TW: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine 是由含 indoline-5,6-dione 核心的腎上腺素氧化產物 adrenochrome，與親核性肼衍生物 aminoguanidine 反應合成。該反應在二酮的其中一個羰基上形成穩定的 guanylhydrazone 連結。Adrenochrome 本身極不穩定且具有心臟毒性，但穩定的 guanylhydrazone 共軛物減緩了此毒性，使該分子足以安全用於歷史上的臨床用途。此雜合化合物被提議作為一種雙重作用的糖氧化調節劑，同時標靶氧化壓力與晚期糖化終產物介導的蛋白質交聯。

label: acts_as
context: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine was historically developed and used clinically, primarily in Japan, as a hemostatic capillary stabilizer and a radioprotective agent. Its hemostatic action reflects its ability to stabilize capillaries and reduce bleeding, and its radioprotective effects are believed to stem from protection of cell membranes and hematopoietic progenitor cells from radiation-induced oxidative damage. This historical clinical use demonstrates that the guanylhydrazone conjugate is stable and tolerated in vivo, in contrast to free adrenochrome. It also indicates that systematic evaluation of AMM in modern long-term aging and glycation models is currently lacking.
context_zh_TW: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine 在歷史上被開發並主要於日本臨床用於作為止血性毛細血管穩定劑與放射防護劑。其止血作用反映其穩定毛細血管並減少出血的能力，而其放射防護效果被認為源於保護細胞膜與造血祖細胞免受輻射誘發的氧化損傷。此歷史臨床用途證明 guanylhydrazone 共軛物在體內穩定且可耐受，與游離 adrenochrome 形成對比。它也顯示目前缺乏在現代長期衰老與糖化模型中對 AMM 的系統性評估。

label: stimulates
context: Adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) released from the anterior pituitary under hypothalamic CRH stimulation binds the adrenal cortex to drive cortisol synthesis and release, forming the effector arm of the HPA-axis stress response. Chronic ACTH–cortisol activation suppresses heart-rate variability and impairs mitochondrial biogenesis.
context_zh_TW: 促腎上腺皮質激素（ACTH）在下視丘 CRH 刺激下由腦下垂體前葉釋放，作用於腎上腺皮質以驅動 cortisol 的合成與釋放，構成 HPA 軸壓力反應的效應臂。慢性的 ACTH–cortisol 活化會抑制心率變異度並損害粒線體生合成。

label: contribute_to
context: Advanced glycation end products accumulate in tissues and organs during diabetes and contribute to the pathogenesis of diabetic complications. AGE formation and accumulation in diabetic patients results in vascular alterations leading to diabetic vasculopathy, and glycation is implicated in diabetic renal, retinal, and neural complications. Because the glycation reaction is accelerated by hyperglycemia and oxidative stress, poor glycemic control exacerbates AGE burden. AGE inhibitors such as aminoguanidine were shown to prevent diabetic complications by inhibiting AGE formation, supporting the causal role of glycation in diabetic pathology.
context_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products 在 diabetes 期間堆積於組織與器官，並促成 diabetic complications 的 pathogenesis。Diabetic patients 中 AGE formation 與 accumulation 導致 vascular alterations，引發 diabetic vasculopathy，而 glycation 涉及 diabetic renal、retinal 與 neural complications。由於 glycation reaction 受 hyperglycemia 與 oxidative stress 加速，poor glycemic control 會加劇 AGE burden。Aminoguanidine 等 AGE inhibitors 已被證實能透過抑制 AGE formation 來預防 diabetic complications，支持了 glycation 在 diabetic pathology 中的因果角色。

label: contribute_to
context: Advanced glycation end products accumulate in tissues over time and are associated with atherosclerotic plaque formation. Microvascular and macrovascular damage seen in diabetes is attributed to AGE accumulation in tissues, but it is also associated with atherosclerosis in the general aging population. Mechanistically, glycation of LDL reduces its uptake by cell receptors, glycated LDL becomes more susceptible to crosslinking with collagen on the arterial wall, and macrophage uptake of these modified lipoproteins leads to foam cell formation and atheroma development. AGEs also impair nitric oxide bioavailability, further promoting the vascular dysfunction that underlies atherogenesis.
context_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products accumulate in tissues over time並are associated with atherosclerotic plaque formation。Diabetes中所見的microvascular與macrovascular damage歸因於tissues中AGE accumulation，但它也與general aging population的atherosclerosis相關。在mechanistically，glycation of LDL reduces其uptake by cell receptors，glycated LDL becomes more susceptible to crosslinking with collagen on the arterial wall，而macrophage uptake of these modified lipoproteins leads to foam cell formation與atheroma development。AGEs亦impair nitric oxide bioavailability，further promoting the vascular dysfunction that underlies atherogenesis。

label: accumulate_in
context: Advanced glycation end products accumulate within the extracellular matrix (ECM), such as in collagen and elastic fibers, and cross-link with ECM components. This accumulation and cross-linking cause a decrease in connective tissue elasticity, alter ECM structure and function, and impair vascular function, facilitating plaque formation and basement membrane hyperplasia. AGE accumulation in the ECM is one of the three major mechanisms by which AGEs contribute to aging, alongside intracellular glycation and RAGE-mediated signaling. ECM glycation is strongly implicated in arterial stiffening, skin aging, and age-related stiffness of tendons and cartilage.
context_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products 堆積於 extracellular matrix（ECM，如 collagen 與 elastic fibers）內，並與 ECM components 交聯。此 accumulation 與 cross-linking 導致 connective tissue 彈性下降、改變 ECM structure 與 function，並損害 vascular function，促進 plaque formation 與 basement membrane hyperplasia。ECM 中的 AGE accumulation 是 AGEs 促成 aging 的三大主要機制之一，另外兩者為 intracellular glycation 與 RAGE-mediated signaling。ECM glycation 與 arterial stiffening、skin aging 以及 tendons 與 cartilage 的年齡相關 stiffness 密切相關。

label: cross_link
context: Advanced glycation end products accumulate within the extracellular matrix and cross-link elastic fibers as well as collagen. This cross-linking of extracellular proteins reduces the elasticity of connective tissues such as blood vessels, skin, and tendons, affecting especially vascular function. Glycated modifications alter the balance between ECM synthesis and degradation, accelerating skin aging and increasing skin stiffness. AGE-elastin cross-linking is one of the three major mechanisms by which AGEs injure tissues, alongside intracellular glycation and RAGE-mediated inflammatory signaling.
context_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products 堆積於 extracellular matrix（ECM）內，並使 elastic fibers 與 collagen 交聯。這種 extracellular proteins 的交聯降低了 blood vessels、skin 與 tendons 等結締組織的彈性，尤其影響 vascular function。Glycated modifications 改變 ECM synthesis 與 degradation 之間的平衡，加速 skin aging 並增加皮膚僵硬。AGE-elastin cross-linking 是 AGEs 傷害組織的三大主要機制之一，另外兩者為 intracellular glycation 與 RAGE-mediated inflammatory signaling。

label: accelerate
context: Advanced glycation end products are toxic glycated adducts that accumulate in tissues during aging and in numerous age-related degenerative diseases. Numerous publications have demonstrated acceleration of the aging process by AGEs, which injure the extracellular matrix and cells through ECM cross-linking, modification of intracellular proteins, and RAGE-mediated inflammatory signaling. AGE accumulation in tissues such as heart, lung collagen, skin, tendon, cartilage, and vitreous body increases with age, and inhibiting AGE formation and accumulation is proposed to increase lifespan. Exogenous dietary AGEs also trigger organ dysfunction and tissue aging.
context_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products 是有毒的 glycated adducts，會在 aging 以及眾多 age-related degenerative diseases 期間堆積於組織中。大量文獻已證實 AGEs 加速 aging process，其透過 ECM cross-linking、intracellular proteins 修飾與 RAGE-mediated inflammatory signaling 來傷害 extracellular matrix 與細胞。Heart、lung collagen、skin、tendon、cartilage 與 vitreous body 等組織中的 AGE accumulation 隨年齡增加，而抑制 AGE formation 與 accumulation 被提議可 increase lifespan。Exogenous dietary AGEs 也會引發 organ dysfunction 與 tissue aging。

label: inhibit
context: Advanced glycation end products can modify intracellular antioxidant enzymes and reduce their activity. Glycated modifications lower the activity of catalase, glutathione peroxidase, and glutathione reductase, and these alterations increase cellular oxidative stress. Because catalase normally decomposes hydrogen peroxide, its inhibition by glycation weakens cellular antioxidant defense and perpetuates oxidative damage. This glycation of antioxidant enzymes exemplifies how intracellular AGE modification of proteins impairs cellular function and contributes to the oxidative stress that characterizes aging and diabetes.
context_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products 可修飾 intracellular antioxidant enzymes 並降低其活性。Glycated modifications 降低 catalase、glutathione peroxidase 與 glutathione reductase 的活性，這些 alterations 增加細胞 oxidative stress。由於 catalase 通常 decomposes hydrogen peroxide，其受 glycation 抑制會削弱細胞 antioxidant defense 並使 oxidative damage 持續。這種 antioxidant enzymes 的 glycation 說明了蛋白質的 intracellular AGE modification 如何 impairs cellular function，並促成 aging 與 diabetes 特徵性的 oxidative stress。

label: glycate
context: Advanced glycation end products damage the cardiovascular system in part by glycating low-density lipoproteins (LDL) on both the apolipoprotein B and phospholipid components of the particle. Glycated LDL is more susceptible to crosslinking with collagen on the arterial wall than non-glycated LDL, and it is not taken up into cells through the normal receptor pathway, so it accumulates in the vessel wall. Macrophage uptake of these modified LDL particles leads to foam cell formation and the development of atheroma. This glycoxidative modification of LDL is thus a direct route through which AGEs promote atherosclerosis.
context_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products部分透過對low-density lipoproteins（LDL）顆粒上的apolipoprotein B與phospholipid components進行glycating，來damages the cardiovascular system。Glycated LDL比non-glycated LDL更susceptible to crosslinking with collagen on the arterial wall，且它not taken up into cells through the normal receptor pathway，因此accumulates in the vessel wall。Macrophage uptake of these modified LDL particles leads to foam cell formation與atheroma的development。因此，此glycoxidative modification of LDL是AGEs promote atherosclerosis的direct route。

label: impair
context: Advanced glycation end products reduce nitric oxide activity, a vasodilator whose biosynthesis in the endothelium counteracts mechanisms of atherosclerosis. One proposed mechanism is that AGEs reduce the half-life of endothelial nitric oxide synthase (eNOS) in the endothelium; Xu and colleagues found decreased eNOS activity after exposure to CML, and a reversible inhibition of endothelium- and NO-dependent vascular responses after 30 minutes of exposure to CML-albumin, both in vivo and in vitro. By impairing eNOS, AGEs blunt nitric oxide-mediated vasodilation, contributing to the endothelial dysfunction and elevated vascular tone that characterize aging and diabetic vasculature.
context_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products reduce nitric oxide activity——nitric oxide是一種vasodilator，其在endothelium中的biosynthesis counteracts mechanisms of atherosclerosis。One proposed mechanism是AGEs reduce the half-life of endothelial nitric oxide synthase（eNOS）in the endothelium；Xu及其colleagues found decreased eNOS activity after exposure to CML，且exposure to CML-albumin 30 minutes後，endothelium-與NO-dependent vascular responses出現reversible inhibition，此現象in vivo與in vitro皆然。By impairing eNOS，AGEs blunt nitric oxide-mediated vasodilation，contributing to the endothelial dysfunction與elevated vascular tone that characterize aging與diabetic vasculature。

label: induces
context: After 12–36 h fasting the brain switches from glucose to beta-hydroxybutyrate (BHB) as fuel; BHB induces BDNF expression via histone deacetylase inhibition, enhancing hippocampal neurogenesis and synaptic plasticity (Seidler & Barrow, 2022) — a neurotrophic arm of fasting hormesis.
context_zh_TW: 禁食 12–36 小時後大腦從葡萄糖切換至 β-羥基丁酸（BHB）作為燃料；BHB 透過抑制組蛋白去乙醯酶誘導 BDNF 表現，增強海馬神經新生與突觸可塑性（Seidler & Barrow, 2022）——這是禁食荷爾蒙的神經營養臂。

label: is_regenerated_by
context: After thioredoxins catalyze substrate reduction, their oxidized CxxC motif is regenerated by thioredoxin reductase using NADPH, while glutaredoxins are recycled by reduced glutathione. Electrons thus flow from NADPH or GSH through the CxxC motif to protein disulfide substrates.
context_zh_TW: 在硫氧還蛋白催化受質還原後，其被氧化的 CxxC 基序由硫氧還蛋白還原酶利用 NADPH 再生成，而 glutaredoxin 則由還原態麩胱甘肽回收。因此電子從 NADPH 或 GSH 經 CxxC 基序流向蛋白質雙硫受質。

label: is_reduced_in
context: Aged mouse oocytes show sharply reduced SIRT1 (together with SIRT2 and SIRT3); maintaining SIRT1 expression reduces postovulatory oocyte ageing in vitro and in vivo. Directionally, SIRT1 decline contributes to oocyte ageing. This positions SIRT1 among the sirtuins guarding oocyte redox state and female fertility.
context_zh_TW: 老化的小鼠卵母細胞表現出 SIRT1（連同 SIRT2 和 SIRT3）的急劇下降；維持 SIRT1 表現可在體外和體內減少排卵後卵母細胞老化。方向性上 SIRT1 的下降導致卵母細胞老化。這將 SIRT3 定位為保護卵母細胞氧化還原狀態和女性生育力的 sirtuin 之一。

label: is_phosphorylated_by
context: Akt phosphorylates TFEB at serine 467, resulting in cytoplasmic retention of the transcription factor (PMID 28165011). This places TFEB downstream of PI3K/Akt signaling, so growth factor and insulin signals can restrain TFEB's nuclear translocation and thus suppress the lysosomal/autophagic transcriptional program. The S467 site is shared with AMPK, which phosphorylates the same residue to produce the opposite outcome - enhanced transcriptional activity - illustrating how different kinases can converge on a single phosphorylation site to generate context-dependent regulation of TFEB. Akt-mediated cytoplasmic retention keeps TFEB inactive in the cytosol until activating signals relieve the phosphorylation.
context_zh_TW: Akt 在絲氨酸 467 上磷酸化 TFEB，導致該轉錄因子的胞質保留（PMID 28165011）。這使 TFEB 位於 PI3K/Akt 信號通路的下游，因此生長因子和胰島素信號可以抑制 TFEB 的核轉位，從而抑制溶酶體/自噬轉錄程序。S467 位點與 AMPK 共享，AMPK 磷酸化同一殘基產生相反結果——增強轉錄活性——說明不同的激酶如何匯聚在同一磷酸化位點上，根據語境產生 TFEB 的差異調節。Akt 介導的胞質保留使 TFEB 在細胞質中保持非活性狀態，直到啟動信號解除其磷酸化。

label: inhibited_by
context: Akt signaling is associated with inhibition of SIRT2-dependent cell-cycle and stress outputs (e.g., cyclin E-CDK2 phosphorylates SIRT2 at Ser331 to reduce its deacetylase activity), placing AKT signaling among negative regulators of the SIRT2 pathway (Pandithage et al., 2008, J Cell Biol, PMID 18504304).
context_zh_TW: Akt 信號與 SIRT2 依賴性的細胞週期和壓力輸出的抑制相關（例如 cyclin E-CDK2 在 Ser331 處磷酸化 SIRT2 以降低其去乙醯酶活性），將 AKT 信號列為 SIRT2 通路的負向調節因子（Pandithage et al., 2008, J Cell Biol, PMID 18504304）。

label: cleaves
context: Alagebrium is an AGE breaker developed to destroy preformed AGE-derived protein cross-links, following the first AGE breaker N-phenacylthiazolium bromide, which was unstable in vitro and clinically unsuccessful. Alagebrium could reverse AGE accumulation in vivo, and AGE breakers of this class restored large artery properties in experimental diabetes. However, clinical studies on these compounds were terminated, and none of the known AGE breakers are currently in clinical use. AGE breakers represent a complementary therapeutic strategy to AGE inhibitors, targeting existing cross-links rather than preventing new AGE formation.
context_zh_TW: Alagebrium 是一種 AGE breaker，開發用於 destroy preformed AGE-derived protein cross-links，繼首個 AGE breaker N-phenacylthiazolium bromide 之後，後者在體外 unstable 且 clinically unsuccessful。Alagebrium 能在體內 reverse AGE accumulation，且此類 AGE breakers 在 experimental diabetes 中 restored large artery properties。然而，針對這些 compounds 的 clinical studies 已 terminated，且目前已知的所有 AGE breakers 均無 clinical use。AGE breakers 代表了與 AGE inhibitors 互補的 therapeutic strategy，針對 existing cross-links 而非 preventing new AGE formation。

label: inhibits
context: Although nicotinamide (NAM) effectively increases NAD+ in tissues, it also exerts an inhibitory effect on sirtuins and PARP activity, a property that distinguishes it from the other precursors NMN and NR. At high doses, NAM is methylated by nicotinamide N-methyltransferase to generate N1-methylnicotinamide for elimination in urine, which can lower the cellular methyl pool over time. This depletion could reduce DNA and protein methylation and alter gene expression patterns and protein activity, since DNA methylation in gene promoter regions is typically associated with transcriptional repression. These effects may explain why NR administration raises NAD+ levels more than NAM treatment in some studies.
context_zh_TW: 儘管菸鹼醯胺（NAM）能有效提升組織中的 NAD+，它同時對去乙醯酶與 PARP 活性產生抑制作用，此特性使其有別於其他前驅物 NMN 和 NR。在高劑量下，NAM 被菸鹼醯胺 N-甲基轉移酶甲基化，生成 N1-甲基菸鹼醯胺以經尿液排出，這可能隨時間降低細胞甲基池。此耗竭可能減少 DNA 與蛋白質甲基化並改變基因表現模式與蛋白質活性，因為基因啟動子區域的 DNA 甲基化通常與轉錄抑制相關。這些效應可能解釋為何在部分研究中 NR 給藥比 NAM 處理更能提升 NAD+ 水平。

label: polymerizes_into
context: Aminochrome is the cyclized, oxidized form of dopamine that can polymerize into the protective pigment neuromelanin. It is a pivotal branch-point intermediate whose normal polymerization builds neuromelanin while aberrant reactions form neurotoxic species.
context_zh_TW: Aminochrome 是多巴胺環化氧化後的產物，可聚合形成具保護性的色素 neuromelanin。它是關鍵的分支中間物，正常聚合時建構 neuromelanin，異常反應時則形成神經毒性物質。

label: undergoes
context: Aminochromes are strong electrophiles capable of reacting with nucleophilic sulfhydryl (cysteine) groups on cellular proteins via Michael addition. This covalent modification is the proposed senomorphic mechanism: by alkylating critical cysteine residues on regulators such as IKK and the p65 subunit of NF-κB, adrenochrome could permanently inhibit NF-κB signaling and blunt transcription of SASP factors like IL-6 and IL-8. The same thiol-reactivity underlies aminochrome toxicity through adduct formation with proteins such as alpha-synuclein.
context_zh_TW: 氨基色素是強親電體，能通過麥克爾加成與細胞蛋白質上的親核硫氫基（半胱氨酸）反應。這種共價修飾是假定的衰老模仿機制：通過烷基化調節因子如IKK和NF-κB的p65亞基上的關鍵半胱氨酸殘基，腎上腺素色素可能永久抑制NF-κB信號並削弱IL-6和IL-8等SASP因子的轉錄。相同的硫醇反應性奠定了氨基色素通過與α-突觸核蛋白等蛋白質形成加合物的毒性。

label: undergoes
context: Aminochromes such as adrenochrome undergo one-electron reduction by enzymes like NADPH-cytochrome P450 reductase to form unstable semiquinone radicals, which transfer electrons to molecular oxygen, generating superoxide anion and regenerating the parent quinone. This catalytic redox cycling continuously fuels oxidative stress. Because the quinone is regenerated, even small amounts of aminochrome can generate large amounts of reactive oxygen, the proposed basis for selective killing of oxidatively stressed senescent cells.
context_zh_TW: 氨基色素如腎上腺素色素經由NADPH-細胞色素P450還原酶等酶進行單電子還原，形成不穩定的半醌自由基，這些自由基將電子轉移到分子氧，產生超氧陰離子並再生母體醌。此催化氧化還原循環持續 fuel 氧化應激。由於醌被再生，即使少量氨基色素也能產生大量活性氧，這是選擇性殺死氧化應激衰老細胞的假定基礎。

label: is_a
context: Aminochromes, including adrenochrome, are ortho-quinones (o-quinones), a structural class of strong electrophiles that participate in one- and two-electron redox reactions. As an o-quinone, adrenochrome can be reduced to a semiquinone radical and can undergo Michael addition with nucleophilic thiols on proteins. The o-quinone character is the chemical basis for both the proposed senotherapeutic effects, ROS generation and NF-κB modification, and the toxic adduct formation implicated in neurodegeneration.
context_zh_TW: 氨基色素，包括腎上腺素色素，是鄰醌（o-quinones），一類參與單電子和雙電子氧化還原反應的強親電體結構類。作為鄰醌，腎上腺素色素可被還原為半醌自由基，並可與蛋白質上的親核硫醇進行麥克爾加成。鄰醌特性是所提出的衰老治療效應（ROS產生和NF-κB修飾）以及與神經退行性疾病相關的毒性加合物形成的化學基礎。

label: is_a
context: Aminoguanidine (CH6N4, PubChem CID 2146, molecular weight 74.09 g/mol) is a one-carbon compound formally classified as a member of the guanidines. Its compact scaffold, which can be viewed as a derivative of hydrazine, guanidine, or formamide, gives it both nucleophilic and carbonyl-reactive chemistry. One-carbon compounds serve as minimal scaffolds in drug design, and here the nitrogen-dense core endows the molecule with the enzyme-inhibitory and advanced glycation end product-blocking activities for which aminoguanidine, also known as pimagedine, is studied in diabetic complications research.
context_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine (CH6N4, PubChem CID 2146, molecular weight 74.09 g/mol) 是一種一碳化合物，正式歸類為胍類化合物的一員。其緊湊的骨架可被視為肼、胍或甲醯胺的衍生物，賦予其親核性和羰基反應性化學特性。一碳化合物在藥物設計中充當最小骨架，此處富含氮的核心賦予該分子酶抑制和晚期糖基化終產物阻斷活性，因此 aminoguanidine（亦稱為 pimagedine）在糖尿病併發症研究中受到關注。

label: treats
context: Aminoguanidine (pimagedine) manages diabetic nephropathy and is beneficial in treating patients with the condition, either alone or in combination with other therapies. Diabetic nephropathy is the progressive kidney damage driven by hyperglycemia, advanced glycation end product accumulation, and hemodynamic stress. By inhibiting AGE formation and, to a lesser extent, aldose reductase and nitric oxide synthase, aminoguanidine targets several pathways implicated in the renal injury of diabetes, which is why it was developed and clinically investigated for diabetic kidney disease.
context_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine (pimagedine) 用於治療糖尿病腎病變，對患有此病症的患者有益，可單獨使用或與其他療法結合使用。糖尿病腎病變是由高血糖、晚期糖化終產物積累和血液動力學壓力所導致的進行性腎損傷。通過抑制 AGE 形成，以及較少程度地抑制醛糖還原酶和一氧化氮合酶，aminoguanidine 針對多種與糖尿病腎損傷相關的通路，這就是為什麼它被開發並臨床研究用於糖尿病腎病。

label: blocks_production_of
context: Aminoguanidine blocks the synthesis of nitric oxide by selectively inhibiting the inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS) enzyme, acting upstream of NO signaling in the NO-cGMP vasodilation cascade. While methylene blue blocks NO action downstream at soluble guanylyl cyclase, aminoguanidine prevents the overproduction of NO from the start, during inflammation, injury, or shock. Because it spares the endothelial form of NOS (eNOS), it is considered a theoretical way to halt the inflammatory cascade without shutting down normal blood pressure regulation.
context_zh_TW: 氨基胍抑制诱导型一氧化氮合酶 (iNOS) 酶的合成，在 NO 信号通路上上游作用，参与 NO-cGMP 血管舒张的级联反应。 亚硝酰青色素则在可溶性一氧化氮合酶 (sGC) 处阻断 NO 作用，而氨基胍则从一开始阻止 NO 过度产生，在炎症、损伤或休克期间。 由于它保留了内皮型 NOS (eNOS) 的活性，因此被认为是无需关闭正常血压调节即可阻止炎症级联反应的一种理论方法。

label: scavenges
context: Aminoguanidine is a scavenger of alpha-dicarbonyls and showed promising results in some studies as an inhibitor of advanced glycation end product formation. In long-term animal studies, administration of aminoguanidine for 24-30 weeks prevented age-related cardiac hypertrophy and arterial stiffness, consistent with protection against AGE-driven cardiovascular remodeling. However, a clinical trial in diabetic patients was stopped due to safety concerns and lack of efficacy, with side effects including gastrointestinal disturbance, abnormal liver function tests, and flu-like symptoms. Aminoguanidine remains a reference compound for anti-glycation drug development.
context_zh_TW: 氨基胍（Aminoguanidine）是α-二羰基化合物的清除劑，在部分研究中作為晚期糖化終產物形成的抑制劑展現出有希望的結果。在長期動物研究中，給予氨基胍 24-30 週可預防年齡相關的心肌肥大與動脈僵硬，與對抗 AGE 驅動的心血管重塑之保護作用一致。然而，一項針對糖尿病患者的臨床試驗因安全性疑慮與缺乏療效而中止，副作用包括胃腸道不適、肝功能檢驗異常與類流感症狀。氨基胍仍是抗糖化藥物開發的參考化合物。

label: causes
context: Aminoguanidine is a strong inhibitor of diamine oxidase (DAO), the enzyme that breaks down histamine in the gut. By blocking intestinal DAO, oral aminoguanidine can dramatically increase sensitivity to dietary histamine, potentially triggering severe acute histamine intolerance; consuming normal amounts of histamine-rich foods - aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented foods - may cause headaches, flushing, hives, and tachycardia. This is a major safety consideration for oral aminoguanidine use in supplement or experimental settings.
context_zh_TW: 氨基胍是一種強大的二胺氧化酶 (DAO) 抑制劑，該酶在腸道中分解組胺。通過阻斷腸道 DAO，口服氨基胍可顯著增加對膳食組胺的敏感度，可能觸發嚴重的急性組胺不耐受症；食用正常量的富含組胺食物（如陳酪、 cured meats、發酵食品）可能導致頭痛、潮紅、蕁麻疹和心悸。這對於口服氨基胍在補充劑或實驗設定中使用來說是一個主要安全考量。

label: traps
context: Aminoguanidine is an AGE inhibitor that acts as a carbonyl trap, interacting with highly reactive carbonyl species and preventing them from reacting with proteins. These reactive carbonyls include dicarbonyls such as methylglyoxal, glyoxal, and 3-deoxyglucosone, which are key intermediates in AGE formation. By trapping these dicarbonyl species, aminoguanidine blocks AGE accumulation and the downstream glycation damage. This mechanism is shared with other AGE inhibitors such as pyridoxamine, and underpins aminoguanidine's ability to prevent diabetic complications in animal models.
context_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 是一種 AGE inhibitor，作為 carbonyl trap，與 highly reactive carbonyl species 交互作用並防止其與蛋白質反應。這些 reactive carbonyls 包括 methylglyoxal、glyoxal 與 3-deoxyglucosone 等 dicarbonyls，它們是 AGE formation 的關鍵 intermediates。透過 trapping 這些 dicarbonyl species，aminoguanidine 阻斷 AGE accumulation 與 downstream glycation damage。此 mechanism 與 pyridoxamine 等其他 AGE inhibitors 共享，並構成 aminoguanidine 在 animal models 中預防 diabetic complications 能力的基礎。

label: inhibits
context: Aminoguanidine is an EC 1.4.3.4 (monoamine oxidase) inhibitor. Monoamine oxidase is the flavin-dependent mitochondrial enzyme that degrades catecholamines and other biogenic amines, and its inhibition can raise amine concentrations and alter cellular redox balance. Because aminoguanidine is a hydrazine derivative, its MAO inhibition parallels the mechanism of classic hydrazine-based MAO inhibitors, a property relevant both to its pharmacology and to off-target effects when the compound is used experimentally in catecholamine or adrenochrome research.
context_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 是一種 EC 1.4.3.4（monoamine oxidase）抑制劑。Monoamine oxidase 是降解兒茶酚胺和其他生物胺的黃素依賴型粒線體酵素，其抑制可升高胺濃度並改變細胞氧化還原平衡。由於 aminoguanidine 是肼衍生物，其 MAO 抑制作用與經典基於肼的 MAO 抑制劑機制相似，此性質既與其藥理學相關，也與該化合物在兒茶酚胺或 adrenochrome 研究中實驗使用時的脫靶效應相關。

label: is_a
context: Aminoguanidine is classified under the MeSH pharmacological class of enzyme inhibitors, defined as compounds or agents that combine with an enzyme in such a manner as to prevent the normal substrate-enzyme combination and the catalytic reaction. Aminoguanidine fits this class through multiple activities: it inhibits monoamine oxidase, nitric oxide synthase, diamine oxidase, and aldose reductase. The enzyme-inhibitor classification captures the mechanism by which this small hydrazine derivative exerts both its therapeutic AGE-modulating effects and its broader off-target pharmacology.
context_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 被歸類於 MeSH 藥理學類別中的酵素抑制劑（enzyme inhibitors），其定義為與酵素結合以阻止正常底物-酵素結合及催化反應的化合物或試劑。Aminoguanidine 透過多種活性符合此分類：它可抑制 monoamine oxidase、nitric oxide synthase、diamine oxidase 及 aldose reductase。此酵素抑制劑分類捕捉了這類小型 hydrazine 衍生物發揮其治療性 AGE 調節效應及其更廣泛的脫靶藥理學的機制。

label: is_a
context: Aminoguanidine is formally a member of the guanidines, a chemical family built around the guanidinium group that is highly basic and forms strong bidentate hydrogen bonds with biological anions. Membership in this class is pharmacologically meaningful because guanidines frequently appear in drugs that interact with amine-handling enzymes and ion channels. In aminoguanidine the guanidine scaffold supplies the positively charged center that contributes to binding and enzyme inhibition relevant to its application as a diamine oxidase, monoamine oxidase, and nitric oxide synthase inhibitor in diabetic complications research.
context_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine formally belongs to the guanidines, a chemical family built around the guanidinium group, which is highly basic and can form strong bidentate hydrogen bonds with biological anions. Membership in this class is pharmacologically meaningful because guanidines frequently appear in drugs that interact with amine-handling enzymes and ion channels. In aminoguanidine, the guanidine scaffold supplies the positively charged center that contributes to binding and enzyme inhibition relevant to its application as a diamine oxidase, monoamine oxidase, and nitric oxide synthase inhibitor in diabetic complications research.

label: reacts_with
context: Aminoguanidine is the tightest-coupled exogenous protocol agent to the adrenochrome trigger: direct chemical edge 'reacts_with' (conf 0.9, PPR #4 seeded at Adrenochrome) originating from the US4501923A adrenochrome-preparation patent document in the vault.
context_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 是與 adrenochrome 觸發器耦合最緊密的外源協定劑：直接化學邊「reacts_with」（conf 0.9，以 Adrenochrome 為種子時 PPR #4），源自庫中的 US4501923A adrenochrome 製備專利文件。

label: prevents
context: Aminoguanidine was the first AGE inhibitor and has been shown in previous reports to prevent diabetic renal, retinal, and neural complications through the inhibition of AGE formation. It was also shown to prevent diabetes-induced arterial wall protein cross-linking. However, aminoguanidine cannot be used clinically due to safety concerns including pro-oxidant activities and inhibition of nitric oxide synthase. Its efficacy in animal models established the concept that blocking glycation can prevent diabetic complications and validated AGEs as a therapeutic target.
context_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 是首個 AGE inhibitor，先前報告已證實其透過抑制 AGE formation 來預防 diabetic renal、retinal 與 neural complications。它也被證實能預防 diabetes-induced arterial wall protein cross-linking。然而，由於包括 pro-oxidant activities 與抑制 nitric oxide synthase 在內的 safety concerns，aminoguanidine 無法臨床使用。其在 animal models 中的 efficacy 確立了 blocking glycation 可預防 diabetic complications 的概念，並 validated AGEs 作為 therapeutic target。

label: investigated_for
context: Aminoguanidine's drug indication is diabetic kidney disease, and it is investigated for use and treatment in this condition. Diabetic nephropathy is a major cause of end-stage renal disease and is closely tied to hyperglycemia-driven accumulation of advanced glycation end products in the glomerulus. The investigational status reflects clinical interest in AGE inhibition as a renoprotective strategy, with aminoguanidine serving as the prototypical agent in that class despite its development not reaching an approved, marketed product.
context_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 的藥物適應症為糖尿病腎病，目前正針對此適應症進行研究與治療探索。糖尿病腎病變是末期腎病的主要致因，與高血糖驅動的晚期糖化終產物（AGE）在腎小球中的蓄積密切相關。其研究狀態反映出臨床界對 AGE 抑制作為腎臟保護策略的興趣，Aminoguanidine 作為該類藥物的原型代表，儘管其開發尚未達到獲准上市的階段。

label: inhibits
context: Aminoguanidine, the first AGE inhibitor, has a safety concern related to its inhibition of nitric oxide synthase. By blocking NOS, aminoguanidine can reduce nitric oxide production, which together with its pro-oxidant activities prevented its clinical use. This NOS inhibition is one of the adverse effects that emerged during evaluation of aminoguanidine as a therapeutic agent. Despite these limitations, aminoguanidine remains a key research compound that established the concept of AGE inhibition for preventing diabetic complications.
context_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 作為首個 AGE inhibitor，其 safety concern 與抑制 nitric oxide synthase（NOS）有關。透過 blocking NOS，aminoguanidine 可減少 nitric oxide production，這與其 pro-oxidant activities 一起阻止了其 clinical use。此 NOS inhibition 是在評估 aminoguanidine 作為 therapeutic agent 期間出現的 adverse effects 之一。儘管有這些 limitations，aminoguanidine 仍是確立 AGE inhibition 以預防 diabetic complications 概念的關鍵 research compound。

label: regenerates
context: Among the three precursors nicotinic acid (NA), nicotinamide (NAM), and nicotinamide riboside (NR), only NR could prolong survival and induce hematopoietic stem cell regeneration, as documented in a study with mice treated with irradiation. This implies advantages of the NR precursor for potential use in cancer patients undergoing chemo- or radiotherapy, and orally administered NR was also found to improve resistance to and reversal of chemotherapeutic neuropathy. NR's ability to rejuvenate stem cells appears to be a general phenomenon during treatment and has been suggested to underlie a small but significant extension of lifespan in mice.
context_zh_TW: 在三種前驅物 nicotinic acid（NA）、nicotinamide（NAM）與 nicotinamide riboside（NR）之中，唯有 NR 能延長存活並誘發造血幹細胞再生，此記載於一項以照射處理小鼠的研究中。這暗示了 NR 前驅物在癌症患者接受化療或放療時潛在使用的優勢，且口服 NR 亦被發現能改善對化療神經病變的抵抗力與其逆轉。NR 使幹細胞年輕化的能力似乎為治療期間的普遍現象，並被認為是小鼠中微小但顯著的壽命延長的基礎。

label: prevents
context: Among three tested NAD+ precursors (nicotinic acid, nicotinamide, and nicotinamide riboside) including NAD+ itself, only NR could prevent axonal degeneration by altering the local NR metabolism within the axon. Axonal degeneration is an early event in acute cerebral injury and in chronic neurodegenerative diseases including Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases, and it is caused by excitotoxicity, which induces strong NAD+ depletion in neurons. NR prevented nuclear condensation and axonal degeneration in neurons of Nmrk2-KO mice by inducing Nmrk1, suggesting that Nmrk1 is a key mediator of the neuroprotective activity of NR.
context_zh_TW: 在測試的三種 NAD+ 前驅物（nicotinic acid、nicotinamide 與 nicotinamide riboside）以及 NAD+ 本身之中，唯有 NR 能透過改變軸突內局部的 NR 代謝來預防軸突退化。軸突退化是急性腦損傷以及包括阿茲海默症與帕金森氏症在內的慢性神經退化性疾病的早期事件，且由興奮毒性所引起，後者會誘發神經元中強烈的 NAD+ 耗竭。NR 透過誘導 Nmrk1 預防了 Nmrk2-KO 小鼠神經元的核濃縮與軸突退化，顯示 Nmrk1 是 NR 神經保護活性的關鍵介導者。

label: produces
context: An additional well-studied mechanism of AGE formation is the polyol pathway, in which glucose is converted to sorbitol by the enzyme aldose reductase and then to fructose by the action of sorbitol dehydrogenase. Because fructose is a more reactive reducing sugar than glucose, its production feeds additional glycation reactions. This pathway becomes especially active under hyperglycemic conditions, linking poorly controlled diabetes with accelerated accumulation of advanced glycation end products. The polyol pathway therefore represents a non-Maillard route through which elevated glucose contributes to protein glycation and the tissue damage seen in diabetic complications.
context_zh_TW: An additional well-studied mechanism of AGE formation是polyol pathway，其中glucose經由enzyme aldose reductase轉化為sorbitol，再經sorbitol dehydrogenase作用轉化為fructose。由於fructose是比glucose更reactive的reducing sugar，其production feeds additional glycation reactions。此pathway在hyperglycemic conditions下especially active，linking poorly controlled diabetes與accelerated accumulation of advanced glycation end products。因此，polyol pathway represents a non-Maillard route，經由它elevated glucose contributes to protein glycation與diabetic complications中所見的tissue damage。

label: may_not_increase
context: An important conclusion of the Speakman review is that exercise does not reliably increase appetite, and that in many individuals appetite is suppressed both during and for a period after exercise, an effect that can persist for up to 24 hours in some protocols. This is counter to the common belief that increased exercise necessarily drives increased food intake. When exercise does raise energy intake, the increase is generally smaller than the energy cost of the exercise, so a net negative energy balance is usually achieved. These findings support the view that exercise contributes to weight control by raising expenditure without a fully compensatory increase in intake.
context_zh_TW: Speakman綜述的一項重要結論是，運動並不會可靠地增加食慾，而且在許多個體中，食慾在運動期間及運動後一段時間內受到抑制，在某些實驗方案中此效應可持續長達24小時。這與「增加運動必然驅動更多食物攝取」的常見信念相反。當運動確實提高能量攝取時，其增加量通常小於運動的能量成本，因此通常可達到淨負能量平衡。這些發現支持以下觀點：運動透過提高消耗、而無完全補償性的攝取增加，來促進體重控制。

label: inhibited_by
context: Anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 inhibits apoptosis, thereby opposing SIRT5's pro-survival species; in Table 3 Bcl-2 is listed among negative regulators of the SIRT5 pathway in contexts where SIRT5's effects depend on cell survival/Apoptosis signaling.
context_zh_TW: 抗凋亡 Bcl-2 抑制凋亡，因此拮抗 SIRT5 的促存活作用；在表 3 中，Bcl-2 被列為 SIRT5 通路在 SIRT5 效果依賴於細胞存活/凋亡信號環境中的負向調節因子。

label: is_blocked_by
context: Apigenin blocks the transition of the ASAP toward the SASP by disrupting ATM-HSPA8 and HSPA8-p38 MAPK crosstalk, preventing maturation of the secretome. As a flavonoid it also binds PRDX6 to inhibit its iPLA2 activity, further gatekeeping the transition between acute stress response and chronic secretion. This early intervention contrasts with agents that only suppress the established SASP, positioning apigenin as a candidate preventive senomorphic that acts at the ASAP stage. The mechanism highlights HSPA8 and PRDX6 as druggable nodes in senescence initiation.
context_zh_TW: Apigenin 透過破壞 ATM-HSPA8 與 HSPA8-p38 MAPK 交互作用阻斷 ASAP 朝向 SASP 的轉變，防止分泌組成熟。作為類黃酮它也結合 PRDX6 抑制其 iPLA2 活性，進一步守門急性壓力反應與慢性分泌間的轉變。此早期介入不同於僅抑制已建立 SASP 的藥劑，將 apigenin 定位為作用於 ASAP 階段的候選預防性 senomorphic。此機制凸顯 HSPA8 與 PRDX6 作為衰老起始中可藥物化的節點。

label: inhibits
context: Apigenin modulates the MAPK cascade, inducing dose-dependent phosphorylation of ERK and p38 while having little effect on JNK phosphorylation in colon carcinoma and keratinocyte models. It also suppresses MEKK1-driven activation of ERK, JNK, and p38 in bladder smooth-muscle cells, thereby inhibiting cell migration and actin polymerization. In thyroid cancer cells apigenin disrupted EGFR tyrosine auto-phosphorylation and downstream MAPK signaling. Its net effect on the MAPK axis contributes to its chemopreventive activity by restraining proliferation, migration, and invasion across multiple cancer types.
context_zh_TW: 阿皮ゲ寧調節 MAPK 級聯反應，誘導 ERK 和 p38 的劑量相關磷酸化，同時對 JNK 磷酸化影響不大，在結直腸癌和角質形成細胞模型中均有效。它還抑制 MEKK1 驅動的 ERK、JNK 和 p38 活化，從而抑制細胞遷移和焦磷酸鹽聚合。在甲狀腺癌細胞中，阿皮ゲ寧擾亂了 EGFR 酪氨酸自磷酸化和下游 MAPK 訊號傳導。它對 MAPK 軸的淨效應有助於其抗癌前列腺活性，藉由抑制多種癌症類型中的增殖、遷移和侵襲。

label: blocks_transition_to
context: Apigenin prevents progression of the acute stress-associated phenotype (ASAP) into the chronic, pro-inflammatory SASP. The ASAP is the immediate cellular reaction to genotoxic or environmental insult, characterized by ATM phosphorylation and nucleus-to-cytoplasm translocation, TRAF6 auto-ubiquitination and TAK1 activation, occurring before senescence markers become evident. Under bleomycin stress, TAK1 phosphorylation and subsequent p38 MAPK activation and PI3K/Akt/mTOR engagement normally sustain the secretory phenotype. Apigenin leaves ATM and TAK1 phosphorylation largely intact but blocks downstream transduction through HSPA8, halting the ASAP-to-SASP switch.
context_zh_TW: 阿皮ゲ寧可預防急性壓力相關表型 (ASAP) 轉化為慢性、促發炎的 SASP。 ASAP 是對基因毒性或環境刺激的即時細胞反應，其特徵是 ATM 磷酸化和核到細胞質的轉位、TRAF6 自體二聚化和 TAK1 活化，在衰老標誌物出現之前發生。 在 Bleomycin 壓力下， TAK1 磷酸化和隨後的 p38 MAPK 活化和 PI3K/Akt/mTOR 參與，通常維持分泌表型。 阿皮ゲ寧 讓 ATM 和 TAK1 磷酸化 largely intact，但卻阻斷通過 HSPA8 的下游轉導，從而阻止 ASAP 轉化為 SASP。

label: inhibits
context: Apoptotic caspases-3 and -7 cleave active gasdermin D (GSDMD) at the non-canonical aspartate-88 site, inactivating its pore-forming N-terminal fragment and thereby suppressing pyroptosis. Because these apoptotic caspases activate more slowly than caspase-1, this acts as a delayed negative-feedback brake: the inflammasome initiates pyroptosis, and the slower apoptotic arm damps it to prevent excessive inflammation. The nature of the death ultimately produced depends on which gasdermin substrate is available — GSDMD (inhibited by caspase-3/-7) versus GSDME (activated by caspase-3).
context_zh_TW: 凋亡性的 Caspase-3 與 Caspase-7 會在非典型天門冬胺酸-88 位點切割活化的 gasdermin D（GSDMD），使其成孔的 N 端片段失活，從而抑制焦亡。由於這些凋亡 caspases 的活化比 Caspase-1 慢，這形成延遲的負回饋剎車：發炎體啟動焦亡，而較慢的凋亡臂則抑制過度發炎。最終產生的死亡型態取決於可用的 gasdermin 受質——GSDMD（被 Caspase-3/-7 抑制）或 GSDME（被 Caspase-3 活化）。

label: causes
context: Argyria results in a blue-grayish pigmentation of the skin, eyes, and mucous membranes, caused by deposition of silver in body tissues after large doses of silver or its compounds are absorbed into the circulatory system. Argyria is rare, and although, so far as known, the condition does not otherwise harm a person's health, it is disfiguring and usually permanent. Mild forms of argyria are sometimes mistaken for cyanosis, which is clinically relevant because cyanosis signals hypoxemia while argyria simply reflects lifelong silver deposition.
context_zh_TW: Argyria導致皮膚、眼睛和黏膜的藍灰色色素沉著，由大劑量銀或其化合物吸收進入循環系統後在體組織中沉積引起。Argyria罕見，雖然據目前所知，該病變對健康無其他損害，但它會毀容且通常永久。輕度argyria有時被誤認為發紺，這在臨床上相關，因為發紺表示低氧血症，而argyria僅反映終身銀沉積。

label: activated_by
context: As a class III NAD+-dependent deacetylase, SIRT2 activity is directly governed by NAD+ availability; NAD+ precursors (e.g., NMN, NR) boost SIRT2 activity in mitosis and metabolism, linking NAD+ decline in aging to reduced SIRT2 function (source review).
context_zh_TW: 作為第三類 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶，SIRT2 的活性直接受 NAD+ 可用性控制；NAD+ 前體（例如 NMN、NR）在有絲分裂和代謝中增強 SIRT2 活性，將衰老中 NAD+ 的下降與 SIRT2 功能減弱聯繫起來（文獻綜述）。

label: activates
context: As a direct NAD+ precursor, NMN raises NAD+ which supplies the obligate co-substrate for all seven sirtuins, indirectly activating them systemically.
context_zh_TW: 作為直接 NAD+ 前體，NMN 提升 NAD+，提供全部七種 sirtuin 必需的共用受質，進而在全身間接活化它們。

label: downregulates
context: As a downstream target of SIRT2, FOXO3a is downregulated following AGK2-mediated SIRT2 inhibition in ischemic stroke models. This reduction of FOXO3a, along with phospho-JNK, suppresses the apoptotic cascade and protects cell viability.
context_zh_TW: 作為 SIRT2 的下游靶標，FOXO3a 在缺血性中風模型中經 AGK2 介導的 SIRT2 抑制後被下調。FOXO3a 連同 phospho-JNK 的減少抑制了凋亡級聯並保護細胞存活。

label: inhibits
context: Ascorbic acid (vitamin C) acts as an antioxidant and reducing agent that inhibits the oxidation of epinephrine to adrenochrome. It scavenges reactive oxygen species that drive catechol oxidation and reduces oxidized intermediates back to epinephrine, effectively reversing the early steps of the reaction. In laboratory settings vitamin C has been shown to inhibit the pink-to-red discoloration of adrenaline solutions caused by adrenochrome formation, and it is used as a stabilizing agent in pharmaceutical epinephrine preparations. Antioxidants such as ascorbic acid therefore represent a natural brake on the adrenochrome pathway in both formulations and biological systems.
context_zh_TW: Ascorbic acid（維生素 C）作為 antioxidant 與 reducing agent，抑制 epinephrine 氧化成 adrenochrome。它清除驅動兒茶酚氧化的 reactive oxygen species，並將氧化的中間產物還原回 epinephrine，有效逆轉反應的早期步驟。在實驗室環境中，維生素 C 已被證實能抑制 adrenaline 溶液因 adrenochrome 形成而產生的粉紅至紅色變色，並被用作藥用 epinephrine 製劑中的 stabilizing agent。因此，ascorbic acid 等 antioxidants 在製劑與生物系統中，都代表了對 adrenochrome pathway 的天然制動作用。

label: reduces
context: Ascorbic acid (vitamin C) is a reducing agent that acts as an electron donor to prevent catecholamine oxidation. If a molecule of epinephrine starts to oxidize into a quinone, ascorbic acid immediately donates an electron, converting the o-quinone intermediate back into stable epinephrine and thereby preventing the intramolecular cyclization that would produce adrenochrome. This is why ascorbic acid can block or delay the reddening of adrenaline solutions exposed to air. Alongside glutathione and sodium metabisulfite, ascorbic acid is a classic example of a sacrificial antioxidant that intercepts the quinone intermediate at the earliest step of the adrenochrome pathway. The reversibility of the catechol-quinone redox couple is what makes electron-donating agents so effective at suppressing this oxidative transformation.
context_zh_TW: 抗壞血酸（維生素 C）是一種還原劑，作為電子供體防止兒茶酚胺氧化。如果一分子腎上腺素開始氧化成醌，抗壞血酸立即捐贈一個電子，將鄰苯醌中間體轉化回穩定的腎上腺素，從而防止會產生 adrenochrome 的分子內環化。這就是為什麼抗壞血酸可以阻斷或延遲暴露於空氣中的腎上腺素溶液變紅。與穀胱甘肽和偏重亞硫酸鈉一起，抗壞血酸是犧牲性抗氧化劑的典型例子，在 adrenochrome 途徑的最早步驟截獲醌中間體。兒茶酚-醌氧化還原對的可逆性是電子供體藥物如此有效抑制這種氧化轉化的原因。

label: competes_with
context: At high supplemental doses, rutin can competitively inhibit COMT, slowing the methylation and clearance of endogenous catechols such as dopamine, epinephrine, and norepinephrine. This places rutin among the COMT-inhibiting flavonoids relevant to slow-COMT individuals. Its COMT interaction is a consideration when combining high-dose flavonoid supplements with methyl-donor regimens.
context_zh_TW: 在高補充劑量下，rutin 可競爭性抑制 COMT，減緩 dopamine、epinephrine 和 norepinephrine 等內源性兒茶酚的甲基化和清除。這使 rutin 屬於與緩慢-COMT 個體相關的 COMT 抑制類黃酮。其 COMT 交互作用是將高劑量類黃酮補充劑與甲基供體方案合併時的考量點。

label: enhances
context: At very low doses, methylene blue acts as a redox cycling agent inside mitochondria, essentially donating and accepting electrons to keep the mitochondrial electron transport chain running more efficiently. It can bypass dysfunctional Complex I and Complex III, rerouting electron flow to maintain ATP production when normal pathways are impaired, and this is the mechanism driving the most excitement in longevity circles. The dose range that shows this effect in cellular and animal studies is consistently in the sub-1 mg/kg range (1-4 mg per dose for most adults). However, too much redox cycling flips the mechanism, and at higher doses methylene blue starts generating oxidative stress instead of reducing it.
context_zh_TW: 在非常低的劑量下，methylene blue在粒線體內作為氧化還原循環劑發揮作用，本質上是捐贈和接受電子以使粒線體電子傳遞鏈更有效地運行。它可以繞過功能障礙的複合物I和III，在正常路徑受損時重新引導電子流以維持ATP產生，這是推動長壽圈最興奮的機制。在細胞和動物研究中顯示這種效果的劑量範圍始終在低於1 mg/kg的範圍內（大多數成人每次1-4毫克）。然而，過多的氧化還原循環會翻轉機制，在較高劑量下，methylene blue開始產生氧化應激而不是減少它。

label: promotes_fusion_with
