Cross-linking of the proteins that make up the human body plays a role in the human aging process and may be responsible for many problems of old age, including senile cataract, thickening of the arteries, some cancers and damage to the immune system. All the body's proteins deteriorate with advancing age and more so in diabetes, and glycation inhibitors may help alleviate or prevent senile cataract, arterial thickening, kidney failure, thinning bones, osteoarthritis and skin wrinkles.
context_zh_TW: 衰老與心臟擴大和血管僵硬有關，一種理論認為這是由於與年齡相關的先進糖基化終產品（AGEs）積累所致。人體構成蛋白質的交聯作用在人類衰老過程中發揮作用，可能對許多老年問題負責，包括白內障、血管增厚、某些癌症和免疫系統損傷。隨著年齡增長，人體的所有蛋白質都會退化，尤其是在糖尿病中，而糖基化抑制劑可能有助於緩解或預防白內障、血管增厚、腎衰竭、骨質流失、骨關節炎和皮膚皺紋。

label: reduces
context: Aging is associated with weakened immunity and chronic inflammation, and the mTOR pathway plays a key role in these processes. Rapamycin reduces lymphocyte overactivation and production of pro-inflammatory cytokines including IL-4 and TNFalpha while increasing the number of regulatory T cells. Inhibition of mTORC1 reduces chronic inflammation by decreasing the activity of the NF-kappaB pathway and the NLRP3 inflammasome complex, resulting in reduced production of IL-1beta and IL-18 cytokines and reduced leukocyte infiltration. The immune effect is dose-dependent: lower doses are immunostimulatory while higher doses lead to immunosuppression.
context_zh_TW: 老化與免疫力減弱和慢性炎症相關，mTOR通路在這些過程中起關鍵作用。Rapamycin減少淋巴細胞過度激活和促炎細胞因子（包括IL-4和TNFα）的產生，同時增加調節性T細胞的數量。mTORC1的抑製通過降低NF-κB通路和NLRP3炎性小體复合物的活性來減少慢性炎症，從而減少IL-1β和IL-18細胞因子的產生並減少白細胞浸潤。免疫效應是劑量依賴性的：較低劑量具有免疫刺激作用，而較高劑量導致免疫抑制。

label: did_not_extend
context: Antioxidants did not extend lifespan in any clinical trials and were detrimental in some: in two very large randomized controlled trials, antioxidants increased the incidence of cancer, especially lung cancer in smokers, and increased all-cause mortality, leading both trials to be stopped earlier than planned. Antioxidants also accelerate cancer progression and promote metastasis. The idea that free radicals cause aging was based on circumstantial evidence, and although excessive ROS can shorten lifespan, organisms normally die from mTOR-driven age-related diseases before ROS can kill them, so antioxidant supplementation is described as worse than useless for life extension.
context_zh_TW: 抗氧化劑在任何臨床試驗中均未延長壽命，並且在某些試驗中表現出有害作用：在兩項非常大型的隨機對照試驗中，抗氧化劑增加了癌症發病率，尤其是在吸煙者中增加了肺癌發病率，並增加了所有原因死亡率，導致兩項試驗提前停止，超過原定計劃。抗氧化劑還會加速癌症進展並促進轉移。關於自由基導致衰老的觀點是基於 circumstantial 的證據，儘管過量的 ROS 會縮短壽命，但生物體通常死於由 mTOR 驅動的與年齡相關的疾病之前，ROS 能夠殺死它們，因此抗氧化劑補充劑被描述為毫無用處，甚至比毫無用處。

label: has_low
context: Apigenin has inherently poor bioavailability that restricts its clinical translation. It is unstable, poorly soluble in water and organic solvents, and after oral intake is rapidly metabolized via UDP-glucuronosyltransferase (UGT1A1) into glucuronide and sulfate conjugates that are quickly transported in blood and excreted in bile or urine, so plasma apigenin levels are often unmeasurable. In rats, radiolabeled apigenin distributed widely with only 51 percent of radioactivity recovered in urine, and blood levels showed a long elimination half-time of 91.8 hours. This slow pharmacokinetics may permit tissue accumulation for chemopreventive effects, and nano-formulations and beta-glycoside forms are being explored to improve delivery.
context_zh_TW: 阿皮ゲ寧具有固有的生物利用度低，限制了其臨床應用。它不穩定，在水和有機溶劑中溶解度差，口服後迅速通過UDP-葡糖苷轉移酶 (UGT1A1) 轉化為葡糖苷和硫酸酯，這些轉化產物迅速在血液中運輸並在膽汁或尿液中排出，因此血漿阿皮ゲ寧濃度通常無法測量。在大鼠中，放射標記的阿皮ゲ寧在體內廣泛分布，僅回收 51% 的放射性在尿液中，血液濃度顯示出 91.8 小時的長期消除半衰期。這種緩慢的藥物動力學可能允許組織積累以產生抗癌預防效果，目前正在探索納米製劑和β-糖苷形式以改善其傳送。

label: inhibits
context: Apigenin is a well-characterized inhibitor of the PI3K/Akt survival pathway across multiple cancer types. It directly blocks PI3K activity, which in turn inhibits Akt function, and this is particularly consequential in HER2-overexpressing breast cancer cells where PI3K/Akt signaling sustains cell survival. Downstream consequences of PI3K/Akt suppression by apigenin include reduced p-Akt (Ser473 and Thr308), activation of FOXO3a leading to increased BIM and p27/Kip1, decreased VEGF expression, and restored sensitivity to apoptosis, contributing to both growth inhibition and anti-metastatic effects in prostate, lung, ovarian, and pancreatic models.
context_zh_TW: 阿皮ゲ寧是一種廣泛研究的PI3K/Akt存活通路抑制劑，在多種癌症類型中均有效。它直接阻斷PI3K活性，進而抑制Akt功能，尤其在HER2表達過多的乳癌細胞中具有重要意義，因為PI3K/Akt信號傳導維持細胞存活。阿皮ゲ寧抑制PI3K/Akt通路後，產生的後續影響包括降低p-Akt（Ser473和Thr308）、激活FOXO3a以增加BIM和p27/Kip1、VEGF表達降低以及恢復對凋亡的敏感性，在攝護腺、肺、卵巢和胰腺模型中，有助於抑制生長和抗轉移效果。

label: improves
context: At anti-aging doses rapamycin eliminates hyperimmunity rather than suppressing immunity, or more figuratively rejuvenates immunity, enabling rapamycin and everolimus to act as immunostimulators that improve immunity in cancer patients and the elderly. Rapamycin reduces the risk of CMV infection in organ transplant patients, improves antipathogen and anticancer immunity in mice, prolongs lifespan in infection-prone mice and protects aged mice against pneumonia. Rapamycin also inhibits viral replication, including replication of the 1918 flu virus by 100-fold, and protects against lethal influenza infection when administered during vaccination.
context_zh_TW: 在抗老化劑量下，rapamycin消除過度免疫而非抑制免疫，或者更形象地說使免疫系統年輕化，使rapamycin和everolimus能够作為免疫刺激劑，改善癌症患者和老年人的免疫功能。Rapamycin降低器官移植患者CMV感染的風險，改善小鼠的抗病原體和抗癌免疫力，延長易感染小鼠的壽命，並保護老年小鼠免受肺炎。Rapamycin還抑制病毒複製，包括將1918年流感病毒的複製減少100倍，並在接種疫苗期間給藥時保護免受致命流感感染。

label: decreases
context: At high doses rapamycin and everolimus slow cell proliferation, which decreases blood cell counts and results in mild and reversible thrombocytopenia, anemia and leukopenia as their most common side effects. A mild reduction of platelets may actually be beneficial, since one of the intended effects of aspirin is a decrease in platelet function. These reversible side effects contrast with the irreversible and inevitable effects of aging such as cancer, stroke, infarction, blindness and premature death, and can be avoided by intermittent scheduling or low-dose administration.
context_zh_TW: 在高劑量下，rapamycin和everolimus減緩細胞增殖，導致血細胞計數減少，並產生輕微且可逆的血小板減少症、貧血和白血球減少症作為其最常見的副作用。血小板的輕微減少實際上可能是有益的，因為aspirin的其中一個預期效果是減少血小板功能。這些可逆的副作用與老化的不可逆和不可避免的效應形成對比，如癌症、中風、梗塞、失明和過早死亡，可以透過間歇性安排或低劑量給藥來避免。

label: bypasses
context: At the cellular level, methylene blue can bypass dysfunctional components of the mitochondrial electron transport chain by shuttling electrons from NADH, in the presence of Complex I, and donating them directly to cytochrome c, effectively bypassing complexes I through III. This alternative electron transfer pathway enhances mitochondrial respiration, increases oxygen consumption, reduces mitochondrial superoxide production, and mitigates oxidative stress. These mechanisms underlie the neuroprotective effects of methylene blue in conditions such as Alzheimer disease, Parkinson disease, traumatic brain injury, and ischemic stroke.
context_zh_TW: 在細胞水平，methylene blue可以通過在複合物I存在下從NADH穿梭電子，並直接將其捐贈給細胞色素c，有效地繞過複合物I至III，從而繞過粒線體電子傳遞鏈中功能障礙的組件。這種替代電子轉運路徑增強粒線體呼吸，增加氧氣消耗，減少粒線體超氧化物產生，並減輕氧化應激。這些機制是methylene blue在阿茲海默病、帕金森病、創傷性腦缺血和缺血性中風等疾病中發揮神經保護作用的基礎。

label: has
context: Berberine exerts potent anti-inflammatory effects through multiple molecular pathways, including inhibition of NF-kappaB signaling, downregulation of pro-inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha and IL-6, and activation of AMPK that improves metabolic and inflammatory status. These actions contribute to its benefits in metabolic syndrome, insulin resistance, type 2 diabetes, and gastrointestinal inflammation, and extend to modulation of the gut microbiota. Because its anti-inflammatory activity is independent of the methylation cycle, it does not add methyl burden or inhibit COMT. This makes it a versatile and relatively safe adjunct in inflammation management.
context_zh_TW: Berberine 透過多種分子途徑發揮有效的 anti-inflammatory effects 作用，包括抑制 NF-kappaB 訊號傳導、下調促發炎細胞因子（如 TNF-α 和 IL-6）以及活化 AMPK，進而改善代謝和發炎狀態。這些作用有助於其治療代謝症候群、胰島素抗性、2 型糖尿病和胃腸道炎症，並延伸至腸道微生物群的調節。由於其抗發炎活性獨立於 methylation cycle，因此不會增加甲基負荷或抑制 COMT。這使其成為發炎管理中多功能且相對安全的輔助手段。

label: supports
context: Betaine supports SAMe (S-adenosylmethionine) production by supplying methionine via BHMT-catalyzed remethylation of homocysteine, and methionine is then adenosylated to form SAMe, the principal methyl donor for COMT and other methyltransferases. By lowering homocysteine and raising methionine availability, betaine indirectly bolsters the methyl pool available to COMT, thereby sustaining catecholamine O-methylation capacity. This linkage means betaine status and supplementation can influence how efficiently catecholamines are inactivated. The relationship is indirect but metabolically important for maintaining the substrate supply that COMT consumes.
context_zh_TW: Betaine 透過 BHMT 催化的同型半胱氨酸再甲基化提供蛋氨酸來支持 SAMe (S-adenosylmethionine) 的生產，然後蛋氨酸被腺苷化形成 SAMe，即 COMT 和其他甲基轉移酶的主要 methyl donor。透過降低同型半胱氨酸和提高蛋氨酸的可用性，甜菜鹼間接增強 COMT 可用的甲基庫，從而維持兒茶酚胺 O-甲基化能力。這種關聯意味著甜菜鹼的狀態和補充可以影響 catecholamines 的滅活效率。這種關係是間接的，但對於維持 COMT 消耗的底物供應在代謝上很重要。

label: is_characterized_by
context: Bipolar II Disorder is characterized by the occurrence of at least one hypomanic episode and at least one major depressive episode, with hypomania representing a less severe form of mania that does not cause marked functional impairment or psychosis and does not require hospitalization. The depressive phases typically predominate in duration and disability, making depression the major source of impairment. Genetic variants including COMT and MTHFR have been explored as contributors to susceptibility through effects on catecholamine and methyl metabolism, though the associations are modest. The disorder is distinguished from Bipolar I by the absence of full manic episodes.
context_zh_TW: Bipolar II Disorder的特徵是發生至少一次輕躁症發作和至少一次重度憂鬱發作，輕躁症代表一種不太嚴重的躁狂形式，不會引起明顯的功能障礙或精神病，並且不需要住院治療。憂鬱階段通常在持續時間和殘疾方面占主導地位，這使得憂鬱症成為損害的主要來源。包括 COMT 和 MTHFR 在內的遺傳變異已被探索為透過影響兒茶酚胺和甲基代謝而導致易感性的因素，儘管這種關聯性不大。此疾病與 I 型雙極性情感疾患的差異在於不存在完全的躁症發作。

label: extends
context: Caloric restriction (CR) and intermittent fasting extend both lifespan and healthspan in diverse species, but CR is of little benefit when started in old age and fasting inhibits the mTOR pathway in young but not old mice. By contrast, rapamycin strongly inhibits mTORC1 at any age and extends lifespan whether started late or early in life. The beneficial effects of rapamycin and CR may be additive since they are exerted through overlapping but distinct mechanisms, and intermittent rapamycin and CR can be combined, with exercise potentially most beneficial immediately after rapamycin use.
context_zh_TW: 熱量限制（CR）與間歇性斷食可延長多種物種的壽命與健康壽命，但CR若在老年才開始則益處有限；斷食可抑制年輕小鼠的mTOR途徑，對老年小鼠則否。相對地，雷帕黴素在任何年齡都能強力抑制mTORC1，無論晚年或早年開始使用都能延長壽命。由於雷帕黴素與CR透過重疊但不同的機制發揮作用，兩者的益處可能是加成的；間歇性使用雷帕黴素可與CR合併，而運動在雷帕黴素使用後立即進行可能最為有益。

label: drives
context: Chronic SASP secretion from accumulated senescent cells is a principal driver of inflammaging, the sterile, low-grade inflammation that rises with age. By continuously releasing IL-6, IL-1α, TNFalpha, and chemokines, senescent cells maintain a pro-inflammatory tissue milieu that disrupts homeostasis and promotes age-related disease. The relationship is causal and bidirectional with aging: inflammaging further impairs clearance mechanisms. Senolytics and senomorphics both reduce inflammaging by targeting either the source cells or their secretome.
context_zh_TW: 來自累積衰老細胞的慢性 SASP 分泌是 inflammaging（隨年齡上升的無菌、低程度發炎）的主要驅動者。透過持續釋放 IL-6、IL-1α、TNFalpha 與趨化因子，衰老細胞維持促發炎組織環境，破壞體內恆定並促進年齡相關疾病。其關係與老化因果且雙向：inflammaging 進一步損害清除機制。Senolytics 與 senomorphics 皆透過標靶來源細胞或其分泌組來降低 inflammaging。

label: is_imbalanced_in
context: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) pathogenesis involves mitochondrial dynamic imbalance manifested as enhanced fission and reduced fusion. Cigarette smoke extract induces mitochondrial fragmentation by decreasing MFN2 and increasing DRP1 in A549 alveolar epithelial cells, and promotes DRP1 Ser616 phosphorylation, mitochondrial translocation and tetramerization while downregulating MFN2 in pulmonary microvascular endothelial cells. Similar profiles of reduced fusion and enhanced fission occur in asthma, pulmonary fibrosis and acute lung injury, making restoration of dynamic equilibrium a therapeutic target in lung disease.
context_zh_TW: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) pathogenesis involves mitochondrial dynamic imbalance manifested as enhanced fission and reduced fusion。Cigarette smoke extract induces mitochondrial fragmentation by decreasing MFN2 and increasing DRP1 in A549 alveolar epithelial cells，and promotes DRP1 Ser616 phosphorylation, mitochondrial translocation and tetramerization while downregulating MFN2 in pulmonary microvascular endothelial cells。Similar profiles of reduced fusion and enhanced fission occur in asthma, pulmonary fibrosis and acute lung injury，making restoration of dynamic equilibrium a therapeutic target in lung disease。

label: is_induced_by
context: Constitutively active BRAF V600E induces OIS in melanocytes and is the hallmark of benign melanocytic nevi, where senescence arrests the proliferative potential of mutated cells. The MAPK hyperactivation drives replication stress and the DNA-damage response, engaging the senescence program and forming prominent SAHF. The relationship is a classic example of oncogene-induced arrest in a human lesion and is well supported clinically and experimentally. It demonstrates that senescence serves as an in vivo barrier against melanoma.
context_zh_TW: 組成型活化 BRAF V600E 在黑色素細胞中誘發 OIS，是良性黑色素細胞痣的特徵，其中衰老封鎖突變細胞的增殖潛力。MAPK 過度活化驅動複製壓力與 DNA 損傷反應，最終導致停滯。此誘發例示 OIS 如何在體內隔離癌前細胞，且痣是衰老作為癌症屏障的人類例證。它是致癌基因誘發腫瘤抑制的經典模型。

label: accelerates
context: Diabetes mellitus is often seen as a form of accelerated aging, and the levels of cross-linking products in diabetics are two to three times those of their equivalent normal non-diabetics. Advanced glycation end products are increased in diabetes and play an important role in the development of diabetic complications. Aminoguanidine acts to bind to sugars, preventing them from binding to the lysine groups of proteins, and diabetic clinical trials with humans have highlighted its ability to prevent oxidative modification of LDL, inhibit atherosclerotic plaque formation, reduce albuminuria and delay end-stage renal disease.
context_zh_TW: 糖尿病常被視為一種加速老化的形式，而糖尿病患者體內的交聯產物濃度是年齡相當的正常非糖尿病者的二至三倍。晚期糖化終產物在糖尿病中增加，並在糖尿病併發症的發展中扮演重要角色。胺基胍的作用是與糖結合，防止糖與蛋白質的離胺酸基團結合；人體糖尿病臨床試驗已突顯其預防 LDL 氧化修飾、抑制動脈粥狀硬化斑塊形成、減少白蛋白尿並延緩末期腎病的能力。

label: include
context: Epinephrine is a catecholamine and direct COMT substrate whose catechol ring is methylated to metanephrine. Impaired COMT activity, whether genetic or pharmacological, prolongs epinephrine signaling and allows the parent compound to accumulate. This underlies the rise in epinephrine when COMT is blocked.
context_zh_TW: Epinephrine 是兒茶酚胺，也是 COMT 的直接受質，其兒茶酚環會被甲基化為變腎上腺素。無論是遺傳性或藥理學上的 COMT activity 受損，都會延長腎上腺素訊號傳導並使母體化合物累積。這正是 COMT 被阻斷時腎上腺素升高的基礎。

label: accounts_for
context: Excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), also known as the afterburn effect, is the elevated oxygen consumption that persists after an exercise session and represents the energy expended in excess of resting values during recovery. EPOC accounts for a portion of the total energy cost of exercise beyond the exercise itself, typically contributing an additional 7-15 percent of the exercise energy cost depending on intensity and duration. Because EPOC elevates the metabolic rate for hours after training, it is often cited to justify high-intensity training for weight management, although Speakman's analysis argues that the quantitative contribution to total daily expenditure is smaller than commonly claimed.
context_zh_TW: 運動後過量耗氧（EPOC），又稱後燃效應（afterburn effect），是指運動結束後持續存在的升高耗氧量，代表恢復期間超過靜止值的能量消耗。EPOC佔運動總能量成本中運動本身之外的一部分，依強度與持續時間不同，通常額外貢獻運動能量成本的7–15%。由於EPOC在訓練後數小時內會提升代謝率，常被引用來支持以高強度訓練進行體重管理，儘管Speakman的分析主張其對每日總能量消耗的量化貢獻比常見宣稱來得小。

label: increases
context: Exercise causes a transient but significant elevation of resting metabolic rate that outlasts the exercise bout itself. A number of studies show RMR is increased for at least 24-48 hours following vigorous exercise, and residual increases are detectable even up to 3 days after a single session in some protocols. The elevation appears largely independent of the intensity of the exercise, with high-intensity interval exercise providing comparable post-exercise energy expenditure to continuous moderate exercise when matched for work. This post-exercise elevation is one mechanism by which physical activity raises daily energy expenditure beyond the direct cost of the exercise itself.
context_zh_TW: 運動會引起短暫但顯著的靜止代謝率升高，且持續時間超過運動本身。多項研究顯示，劇烈運動後至少24–48小時內RMR會升高，在某些實驗方案中，單次運動後殘餘升高甚至可偵測至3天。此升高似乎大致與運動強度無關，在總作功量匹配下，高強度間歇運動與連續中等強度運動所提供的運動後能量消耗相當。這種運動後升高是身體活動在運動本身直接成本之外提高每日能量消耗的機制之一。

label: is_the_major_determinant_of
context: Fat free mass (FFM) is the single best predictor of resting metabolic rate (RMR), explaining the majority of inter-individual variation in energy expenditure at rest. In the doubly labelled water and metabolic chamber studies reviewed by Speakman, FFM correlates with RMR with correlations typically above 0.7, with lean tissue contributing proportionally more than fat mass. The relationship reflects the high metabolic activity of lean tissues, especially the brain, liver, and skeletal muscle at rest. Consequently, any intervention that changes FFM, such as resistance training, is expected to alter RMR in proportion, though adaptive changes in metabolic efficiency can partially blunt this effect.
context_zh_TW: 去脂體重（FFM）是靜止代謝率（RMR）的最佳單一預測因子，可解釋靜止狀態下能量消耗的大部分個體間差異。在Speakman回顧的雙標水與代謝艙研究中，FFM與RMR的相關性通常高於0.7，且瘦肉組織的貢獻比例上高於脂肪量。此關係反映了瘦肉組織（尤其是腦、肝臟與骨骼肌）在靜止時的高代謝活性。因此，任何改變FFM的介入（如阻力訓練）預期會成比例地改變RMR，儘管代謝效率的適應性改變可能部分削弱此效應。

label: is_a
context: Fisetin belongs to the pharmacological class of senolytics, agents that selectively kill senescent cells. Senolytics, exemplified by fisetin and dasatinib plus quercetin, exploit the reliance of senescent cells on anti-apoptotic survival networks. Fisetin's senolytic profile was identified in screening studies and validated in mouse models where it cleared senescent cells in adipose tissue, bone marrow, and other organs and extended healthspan. Because senescent cell accumulation drives tissue dysfunction and age-related disease, fisetin is now being evaluated in human trials, and its classification as a senolytic frames the therapeutic rationale for improving its bioavailability.
context_zh_TW: Fisetin屬於senolytic（衰老細胞清除劑）藥理學類別，即選擇性殺死衰老細胞的藥物。以fisetin及dasatinib加quercetin為代表的senolytic，利用衰老細胞對抗凋亡存活網絡的依賴。Fisetin的senolytic特性在篩選研究中被識別，並在小鼠模型中獲得驗證：它清除脂肪組織、骨髓及其他器官中的衰老細胞，並延長健康壽命。由於衰老細胞累積驅動組織功能失調與年齡相關疾病，fisetin目前正在人體試驗中評估，而其作為senolytic的分類也為改善其生體可用率的治療學理提供框架。

label: has
context: Fisetin has extremely low water solubility, reported in the range of a few micrograms per milliliter, which classifies it as a Biopharmaceutics Classification System (BCS) class II or IV drug. The low solubility, combined with poor permeability in some assessments and extensive intestinal and hepatic first-pass metabolism, results in low and erratic oral bioavailability. Because dissolution is the rate-limiting step for oral absorption, much of the formulation research described in the review aims to increase the dissolution rate and apparent solubility of fisetin, using approaches such as solid dispersions, cyclodextrin inclusion complexes, and nanocrystals.
context_zh_TW: Fisetin的水溶性極低，報告值約為每毫升數微克，使其被歸類為生物藥劑學分類系統（BCS）第II類或第IV類藥物。低溶解度加上部分評估中較差的通透性，以及廣泛的腸道與肝臟首次通過代謝，導致低且不穩定的口服生體可用率。由於溶離是口服吸收的速率決定步驟，該綜述所述的大部分配方研究旨在提高fisetin的溶離速率與表觀溶解度，使用固體分散、環糊精包合物與奈米晶體等方法。

label: exhibits
context: Fisetin is among the most extensively studied naturally occurring senolytics. It selectively eliminates senescent cells by inhibiting key pro-survival pathways, including the PI3K/Akt and Bcl-xL pathways that senescent cells depend on to resist apoptosis. In aged mice, a short course of oral fisetin reduced senescent cell burden in multiple tissues, extended healthspan and median lifespan, and alleviated age-related dysfunction. This senolytic activity distinguishes fisetin from many flavonoids and has driven its evaluation in human clinical trials for osteoarthritis, frailty, and other age-related conditions, though pharmacokinetic limitations remain a central obstacle.
context_zh_TW: Fisetin是研究最廣泛的天然衰老細胞清除劑（senolytic）之一。它透過抑制衰老細胞賴以抵抗凋亡的關鍵促存活途徑（包括PI3K/Akt與Bcl-xL途徑），選擇性地清除衰老細胞。在老年小鼠中，短期口服fisetin可降低多種組織中的衰老細胞負擔、延長健康壽命（healthspan）與中位壽命，並緩解年齡相關的功能失調。此senolytic活性使fisetin有別於許多黃酮類化合物，並驅動其進入針對骨關節炎、衰弱及其他年齡相關疾病的人類臨床試驗，儘管藥代動力學限制仍是核心障礙。

label: is_converted_to
context: Folinic acid (5-formyltetrahydrofolate) is converted by folinic acid isomerase to 5,10-methenyltetrahydrofolate and then to 5-methyltetrahydrofolate (methylfolate) downstream. It therefore enters the folate pathway midstream, bypassing the MTHFR enzyme for initial activation. This lets the body titrate actual methyl donation according to need.
context_zh_TW: Folinic acid（5-甲醯四氫葉酸）由葉酸異構酶轉化為 5,10-甲烯基四氫葉酸，然後在下游轉化為 5-甲基四氫葉酸（methylfolate）。因此它在葉酸途徑中段進入，繞過 MTHFR 酶進行初始活化。這使人體能依需求調整實際的甲基供給。

label: supports
context: Folinic acid supports the methylation cycle by contributing one-carbon units that enable remethylation of homocysteine to methionine and production of SAMe. Because it is not delivered as the fully methylated end product, it provides folate capacity without an immediate methyl hit. This makes it a gentler option than methylfolate for slow COMT individuals.
context_zh_TW: Folinic acid 透過提供一碳單位來支援 methylation cycle，這些一碳單位使同型半胱氨酸再甲基化為蛋氨酸並產生 SAMe。由於它並非以完全甲基化的終產物形式提供，因此能在沒有立即甲基衝擊的情況下提供葉酸能力。這使其成為緩慢 COMT 個體比 methylfolate 更溫和的選擇。

label: causes
context: Hemolysis may occur during the treatment of methemoglobinemia with methylene blue, mechanistically linked to its oxidative properties which can overwhelm erythrocyte antioxidant defenses, particularly in susceptible individuals. Laboratory findings can include Heinz bodies, elevated indirect bilirubin, decreased haptoglobin, and a negative direct antiglobulin test, with anemia developing one or more days after administration. The American Heart Association emphasizes that patients with G6PD deficiency are at markedly increased risk, as impaired NADPH generation limits glutathione regeneration, rendering red blood cells unable to counteract oxidative stress and predisposing to rapid hemolysis and worsening anemia.
context_zh_TW: 在治療methemoglobinemia時使用methylene blue可能發生溶血，這在機制上與其氧化特性有關，這些特性可能壓倒紅血球的抗氧化防禦，特別是在易感個體中。實驗室結果可能包括Heinz小體、間接膽紅素升高、結合珠蛋白降低和直接抗球蛋白試驗陰性，貧血在給藥後一天或更長時間後發生。美國心臟協會強調，G6PD缺乏症患者的風險顯著增加，因為NADPH生成受損限制了谷胱甘肽再生，使紅血球無法對抗氧化應激，從而易於快速溶血和貧血惡化。

label: accelerates
context: Human growth hormone (HGH) is widely used for rejuvenation and longevity, yet it actually accelerates aging and shortens lifespan. Growth hormone is a pro-aging hormone because it indirectly activates mTOR, and the hype around growth hormone is based on a single publication that misinterpreted its acute effects. Unlike HGH, the anti-aging effects of rapamycin are not based on a single paper or a wild guess but on the work of thousands of scientists studying mTOR and its inhibitors in diverse organisms from yeast to humans.
context_zh_TW: 人類生長激素（HGH）被廣泛用於回春與長壽，但它實際上會加速衰老並縮短壽命。生長激素是促衰老激素，因為它會間接活化 mTOR；而生長激素的炒作源於單一出版物誤解了其急性效應。與 HGH 不同，雷帕黴素的抗衰老效果並非基於單一論文或隨意猜測，而是基於數千名科學家從酵母菌到人類等各種生物中研究 mTOR 及其抑制劑的成果。

label: binds
context: Humanin was cloned by a third group as a binding partner of Bax, a central pro-apoptotic protein that translocates to the mitochondria to initiate a cell death signal. The humanin-Bax complex is retained in the cytoplasm and this interaction protects cells from apoptosis. Humanin also prevents Bax translocation and activation in response to staurosporine, preventing the subsequent release of cytochrome c into the cytoplasm, and binds to Bax-like BH3 proteins Bid and BimEL, inhibiting their pro-apoptotic activity. Endogenous humanin suppresses tBID- and BimEL-induced apoptosis in vitro.
context_zh_TW: Humanin 由第三個團隊作為 Bax 的結合夥伴被選殖，Bax 是核心促凋亡蛋白，會轉位至粒線體以啟動細胞死亡訊號。humanin-Bax 複合物保留在細胞質中，此交互作用保護細胞免於凋亡。Humanin 也阻止 Bax 在星形孢菌素刺激下的轉位與活化，防止隨後細胞色素 c 釋放至細胞質，並可結合 Bax 類 BH3 蛋白 Bid 與 BimEL，抑制其促凋亡活性。內源性 humanin 在體外抑制 tBID 與 BimEL 誘導的凋亡。

label: is
context: Hydroxocobalamin is a precursor to the two active coenzyme forms of vitamin B12, methylcobalamin and adenosylcobalamin, being intracellularly reduced and alkylated to whichever coenzyme is required. This makes it a versatile B12 source that supports both the methylation cycle, via methylcobalamin for methionine synthase, and mitochondrial energy metabolism, via adenosylcobalamin for methylmalonyl-CoA mutase. Its precursor status distinguishes it from the directly active methyl-donating form, allowing physiological regulation of coenzyme production. This flexibility underlies its clinical use in B12 repletion.
context_zh_TW: Hydroxocobalamin 是兩種活性輔酶形式維生素 B12（甲基鈷胺素和腺苷鈷胺素）的前體，在細胞內還原並烷基化為所需的輔酶。這使其成為多功能 B12 來源，可透過甲硫胺酸合成酶的甲基鈷胺素支持 methylation cycle，並透過甲基丙二酸單醯輔酶 A 變位酶的腺苷鈷胺素支持粒線體能量代謝。其前驅狀態使其有別於直接活性的甲基供體形式，從而可以對輔酶產生進行生理調節。這種靈活性是其在補充 B12 方面的臨床應用的基礎。

label: is_alternative_for
context: Hydroxocobalamin serves as an alternative to methylcobalamin for individuals sensitive to methyl-donating B12, because as a non-methylated precursor it avoids acute increases in methyl burden that can trigger mood side effects in slow COMT individuals. It still ultimately supports methylation once converted to methylcobalamin, but in a titratable, demand-driven manner rather than by direct donation. This makes it a preferred B12 form in personalized protocols for slow COMT and in general B12 supplementation. It also provides adenosylcobalamin for mitochondrial function.
context_zh_TW: 對於對甲基供體 B12 敏感的個體，Hydroxocobalamin 可作為甲基鈷胺素的替代品，因為作為非甲基化前體，它可以避免可能觸發 mood side effects in slow COMT 個體的甲基負荷急劇增加。一旦轉化為甲鈷胺，它最終仍然支持甲基化，但以可滴定的、需求驅動的方式，而不是直接捐贈。這使其成為慢速 COMT 個人化方案和一般 B12 補充中的首選 B12 形式。它還為粒線體功能提供腺苷鈷胺素。

label: is_a_type_of
context: IDO1 belongs to the family of heme-dependent dioxygenases (EC 1.13.11.52), distinct from but functionally related to tryptophan 2,3-dioxygenase (TDO, mainly hepatic) and IDO2 (a less active paralog). It is a monomeric cytosolic protein of about 45 kDa encoded by the IDO1 gene on human chromosome 8p11.21. Crystal structures (e.g., PDB 2D0T, 5EK2) reveal a large domain with a deep heme-binding pocket and a smaller domain, and the active site shows plasticity that allows inhibitor and substrate binding. This structural information underpins the design of IDO1 inhibitors for immuno-oncology.
context_zh_TW: IDO1 屬於依賴血基質的雙加氧酶家族（EC 1.13.11.52），與色胺酸 2,3-雙加氧酶（TDO，主要位於肝臟）及 IDO2（活性較低的旁系同源物）有別但功能相關。它是由人類第 8 號染色體 8p11.21 上的 IDO1 基因編碼、約 45 kDa 的單體胞質蛋白。晶體結構（例如 PDB 2D0T、5EK2）顯示一個帶有深血基質結合口袋的大結構域與一個較小結構域，且活性位點展現容許抑制劑與受質結合的可塑性。此結構資訊支撐了用於免疫腫瘤學的 IDO1 抑制劑設計。

label: correlates_with
context: In human tissues (muscle, heart, hippocampus and kidney; GTEx), expression of the mitochondrial citrate transporter gene SLC25A1 positively correlates with a mitochondrial-dependent SASP gene signature and with canonical senescence markers p16 and p21, whereas chronological age alone shows little or no association. This links mitochondrial citrate metabolism to senescence-associated inflammatory programmes across diverse human tissues. The finding supports SLC25A1 inhibition as a therapeutic target that modulates the inflammatory output of senescent cells through metabolic-epigenetic coupling rather than through senescent cell elimination.
context_zh_TW: 在人類組織（肌肉、心臟、海馬和腎臟；GTEx）中，線粒體枸櫞酸轉運蛋白基因SLC25A1的表達與線粒體依賴性SASP基因特徵和經典衰老標誌物p16和p21呈正相關，而僅chronological age顯示很少或沒有關聯。這將線粒體枸櫞酸代謝與跨多種人類組織的衰老相關炎症程序聯繫起來。該發現支持SLC25A1抑製作為通過代謝-表觀遺傳耦合而非通過衰老細胞消除來調節衰老細胞炎症輸出的治療靶點。

label: extends
context: In model organisms, mild mitochondrial stress eliciting mitohormesis consistently translates into longer lifespan. Examples include activation of the retrograde response in yeast, UPRmt activation in C. elegans via knockdown of the mitochondrial ribosomal protein mrps-5 or the cytochrome c oxidase subunit cco-1, respiratory-chain inhibition in worms, flies, and mice, and glucose restriction. In each case the hormetic, cytoprotective response - chaperones, detoxification, antioxidant defenses - appears required for the lifespan extension.
context_zh_TW: 在模式生物中，引發粒線體促效應的輕度粒線體壓力會一致地轉化為更長的壽命。例子包括酵母中逆行反應的活化、透過敲低粒線體核糖體蛋白 mrps-5 或細胞色素 c 氧化酶亞基 cco-1 在 C. elegans 中活化 UPRmt、在蠕蟲、果蠅和小鼠中抑制呼吸鏈，以及限制葡萄糖。在每種情況下，促效應、細胞保護反應——分子伴護、解毒作用、抗氧化防禦——似乎都是延長壽命所必需的。

label: compensates_for
context: In the prefrontal cortex, where the dopamine transporter is sparsely expressed, NET assumes an outsized role by clearing a substantial fraction of extracellular dopamine in addition to norepinephrine. This makes NET a critical determinant of catecholamine tone in the frontal lobes. The complementary actions of NET and COMT define prefrontal dopamine dynamics.
context_zh_TW: 在前額葉皮質，多巴胺轉運蛋白表達稀疏，NET 除了清除 norepinephrine 外還清除大量細胞外 dopamine，因此承擔了超乎尋常的角色。這使 NET 成為額葉兒茶酚胺張力的關鍵決定因素。NET 和 COMT 的互補作用定義了前額葉多巴胺動力學。

label: is_driven_by
context: Inflammaging, the age-related sterile, low-grade inflammation, is driven substantially by the chronic SASP from accumulated senescent cells. Continuous release of IL-6, IL-1a, TNFalpha, and chemokines maintains a pro-inflammatory tissue milieu that disrupts homeostasis, and the SASP is a principal, mechanistically supported driver of this phenomenon. Reducing senescent burden with senolytics or suppressing the SASP with senomorphics lowers inflammaging markers, confirming the causal relationship. The SASP therefore represents both a biomarker and a driver of age-related inflammation.
context_zh_TW: Inflammaging（年齡相關無菌、低程度發炎）大幅由累積衰老細胞的慢性 SASP 驅動。持續釋放 IL-6、IL-1α、TNFalpha 與趨化因子維持破壞體內恆定的促發炎組織環境，且 SASP 是此現象主要、機制支持的驅動者。以 senolytics 減少衰老負擔或以 senomorphics 抑制 SASP 可降低 inflammaging 標記，確認因果關係。SASP 因此同時是年齡相關發炎的生物標記與驅動者。

label: extends
context: Metformin extends lifespan not only in mice but also in worms, which do not suffer from human diseases, making it a conventional drug that can be viewed as somewhat anti-aging. It is indicated to treat type 2 diabetes as well as pre-diabetes, obesity, metabolic syndrome, cancer and polycystic ovary syndrome, and metformin may counteract rapamycin-induced hyperglycemia. The anti-aging formula can combine metformin, aspirin, ACE inhibitors, angiotensin receptor blockers and PDE5 inhibitors, each of which prevents or treats more than one age-related disease.
context_zh_TW: Metformin不僅在小鼠中延長壽命，在線蟲中也是如此，而線蟲不會患人類疾病，這使得它成為一種可被視為具有抗衰老作用的傳統藥物。它適用於治療第二型糖尿病以及糖尿病前期、肥胖、代謝症候群、癌症和多囊性卵巢症候群，而且metformin可能抵消rapamycin引起的高血糖。抗衰老配方可以結合metformin、aspirin、ACE抑制劑、血管張力素受體阻斷劑和PDE5抑制劑，每一種都能預防或治療多種與年齡相關的疾病。

label: are_supplied_by
context: MethylB12 acts as the methyl carrier for methionine synthase, which remethylates homocysteine to methionine using a methyl group supplied by methylfolate. This supports the production of SAMe, the universal methyl donor consumed by COMT. MethylB12 thus contributes to the methyl-group supply that sustains catecholamine methylation.
context_zh_TW: MethylB12 充當 methionine synthase 的甲基載體，後者使用 methylfolate 提供的甲基將同型半胱氨酸再甲基化為蛋氨酸。這支持 COMT 消耗的通用 methyl donor SAMe 的產生。因此 MethylB12 有助於維持兒茶酚胺甲基化的甲基供應。

label: converts
context: Methylation converts the neurotransmitter serotonin into the hormone melatonin via N-acetyltransferase- and methyltransferase (ASMT/HIOMT)-catalyzed steps in the pineal gland, with the methyl group donated by SAMe. This reaction is the final biosynthetic step producing melatonin, which regulates circadian rhythm and sleep. The process exemplifies SAMe-dependent methylation outside the catechol system and links methyl donor status to sleep-wake physiology. It highlights the broad metabolic reach of the methylation cycle.
context_zh_TW: Methylation 透過松果體中的 N-乙醯轉移酶和甲基轉移酶 (ASMT/HIOMT) 催化步驟將神經傳導物質血清素轉化為褪黑激素，甲基基團由 SAMe 提供。此反應是產生褪黑激素的最後生物合成步驟，褪黑激素調節晝夜節律和睡眠。此過程例證了兒茶酚系統外 SAMe 依賴性甲基化，並將 methyl donor 狀態與睡眠-覺醒生理學連結起來。它凸顯了 methylation cycle 廣泛的代謝範圍。

label: enhances
context: Methylene blue (MB) increases cellular oxygen consumption (OCR) through its role as an alternative electron-transfer carrier. In Seahorse XF24 flux analysis of HT-22 cells, MB significantly elevated OCR at baseline and under oligomycin (ATP-synthase inhibitor) and FCCP (uncoupler) conditions, and partially maintained OCR even in the presence of the complex I inhibitor rotenone. MB had no effect on oxygen consumption in the absence of cells, confirming a mitochondrial, cell-dependent mechanism. Enhanced OCR is mirrored by a corresponding decrease in anaerobic glycolysis and lactate production.
context_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)通過其作為替代電子轉運載體的作用增加細胞氧氣消耗（OCR）。在HT-22細胞的Seahorse XF24通量分析中，MB在基線以及在寡黴素（ATP合成酶抑制劑）和FCCP（解偶聯劑）條件下顯著升高了OCR，並且即使在複合物I抑制劑rotenone存在下也部分維持了OCR。在沒有細胞的情況下，MB對氧氣消耗沒有影響，證實了一種粒線體、細胞依賴的機制。增強的OCR與無氧糖酵解和乳酸產生的相應減少相呼應。

label: protects_against
context: Methylene blue (MB) protects HT-22 cells against rotenone-induced neurotoxicity. Rotenone inhibits mitochondrial complex I (NADH oxidase), reducing oxidative phosphorylation and generating excess ROS. When HT-22 cells were exposed to 5 uM rotenone for 24 hours, MB increased cell viability at concentrations from 10 nM to 10 uM, and MB-treated groups maintained significantly higher oxygen consumption even under rotenone challenge. This protection reflects MB's alternative electron-transfer shunt that bypasses the rotenone-blocked complex I, preserving electron flow to cytochrome c.
context_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍 (MB) 可保護 HT-22 細胞免受魚藤酮誘導的神經毒性。魚藤酮抑制線粒體複合體 I（NADH 氧化酶），減少氧化磷酸化並產生過多的 ROS。當 HT-22 細胞暴露於 5 uM 魚藤酮 24 小時，MB 在 10 nM 至 10 uM 濃度下可提高細胞存活率，且 MB 處理組即使在魚藤酮挑戰下仍維持較高的氧氣消耗。這種保護作用反映了 MB 的替代電子傳遞旁路，可繞過被魚藤酮阻斷的複合體 I，維持電子流向細胞色素 c。

label: is_a
context: Mitochondria communicate back to the cell through processes collectively referred to as retrograde signaling, and traditionally described means include Ca2+, cytochrome c, and ROS. Mitochondrial-derived peptides such as humanin are recently identified retrograde signals that are unique in that they are encoded within the mitochondrial genome sequences, unlike other retrograde molecules which are nuclear-encoded. Humanin functions as both an endocrine factor and an intracellular survival factor with several biological roles regulating cell survival and metabolism, and retrograde signaling is a biological process well conserved from simple yeast to humans.
context_zh_TW: 粒線體透過統稱為逆向訊號（retrograde signaling）的過程與細胞溝通，傳統上已知的媒介包括 Ca2+、細胞色素 c 與 ROS。粒線體衍生胜肽（如 humanin）是近期發現的逆向訊號，其獨特之處在於編碼於粒線體基因組序列內，不像其他逆向訊號分子由核基因組編碼。Humanin 同時作為內分泌因子與胞內存活因子，具有多種調節細胞存活與代謝的生物功能，而逆向訊號是從簡單酵母到人類皆高度保守的生物過程。

label: regulates
context: Mitochondrial dynamics, the balance of fusion and fission, is a central component of mitochondrial quality control. Through fission, damaged portions of the network are segregated into smaller units; through fusion, functional mitochondria exchange and dilute damaged components; and through the interplay of these processes, mitochondria destined for mitophagy are identified and eliminated. The degradation of damaged mitochondria by mitophagy, and the biogenesis of new mitochondria through PGC-1alpha-driven pathways, complete a quality-control cycle that maintains a healthy mitochondrial population. Disruption of any step, as in Parkinson's disease with PINK1 and Parkin mutations, leads to accumulation of dysfunctional mitochondria and cellular damage.
context_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dynamics, the balance of fusion and fission, is a central component of mitochondrial quality control。Through fission, damaged portions of the network are segregated into smaller units；through fusion, functional mitochondria exchange and dilute damaged components；and through the interplay of these processes, mitochondria destined for mitophagy are identified and eliminated。The degradation of damaged mitochondria by mitophagy, and the biogenesis of new mitochondria through PGC-1alpha-driven pathways, complete a quality-control cycle that maintains a healthy mitochondrial population。Disruption of any step, as in Parkinson's disease with PINK1 and Parkin mutations, leads to accumulation of dysfunctional mitochondria and cellular damage。

label: works_alongside
context: NET and COMT govern local catechol concentrations in a complementary manner, with NET performing uptake and COMT performing enzymatic inactivation. In the prefrontal cortex, NET clears dopamine that escapes reuptake while COMT methylates the remainder. Genetic variation in COMT shifts the balance between these two clearance routes.
context_zh_TW: NET 和 COMT 以互補方式調控局部兒茶酚濃度，NET 執行再攝取而 COMT 執行酶促失活。在前額葉皮質，NET 清除逃過再攝取的 dopamine，而 COMT 甲基化其餘部分。COMT 的遺傳變異改變這兩種清除途徑之間的平衡。

label: cleaves
context: OMA1 is a mitochondrial protease whose activity is markedly elevated following mitochondrial stress. Upon stress, OMA1 catalyzes the cleavage of DELE1 during the stage of mitochondrial protein import and processing, producing a smaller cytosolic form (DELE1-S) that accumulates in the cytosol. The OMA1-dependent cleavage is required for subsequent ISR activation. Notably, perturbations of protein import across the inner mitochondrial membrane produce cytosolic DELE1 accumulation independent of OMA1, and iron deficiency causes full-length DELE1 (DELE1-L) accumulation on the outer mitochondrial membrane that activates HRI without OMA1-mediated cleavage.
context_zh_TW: OMA1是一種粒線體蛋白酶，其活性在粒線體壓力後顯著升高。壓力下，OMA1在粒線體蛋白質輸入和加工階段催化DELE1裂解，產生一個較小的細胞質形式（DELE1-S），該形式在細胞質中積累。OMA1依賴性裂解是後續ISR啟動所必需的。值得注意的是，內粒線體膜蛋白質輸入的干擾會產生OMA1非依賴性的細胞質DELE1積累，而鐵缺乏導致全长DELE1（DELE1-L）在外粒線體膜上積累，在沒有OMA1介導裂解的情況下激活HRI。

label: counteracts
context: PP2A (protein phosphatase 2A) is the main phosphatase that counteracts the effect of mTORC1 in the activation of S6K1/2 within the mass-action model of the mTOR-PI3K pathway. It is one of the two key phosphatases in the cascade, alongside PTEN which indirectly inactivates PI3K. The signaling pathway is designed as a chain of kinase-phosphatase opposing pairs, and the balance between these antagonistic reactions at key nodes is a structural feature that shapes the dose-response behavior of the network under rapamycin inhibition.
context_zh_TW: PP2A（protein phosphatase 2A）是主要的磷酸酶，在mTOR-PI3K路徑的質量作用模型中抵消mTORC1對S6K1/2活化的影響。它是級聯反應中兩個關鍵磷酸酶之一，與間接使PI3K失活的PTEN並列。該訊號路徑設計為激酶-磷酸酶對抗對的鏈，這些拮抗反應在關鍵節點的平衡是一個結構特徵，塑造了網路在rapamycin抑制下的劑量反應行為。

label: ubiquitinates
context: Parkin is the mitophagy effector recruited by PINK1 to depolarized mitochondria; it drives ubiquitination of outer membrane proteins, tagging dysfunctional organelles for autophagic clearance. Aging compromises this pathway through inefficient PINK1 stabilization, defective autophagosome formation, and reduced lysosomal clearance, allowing damaged mitochondria to persist. In stem cell compartments, impaired Parkin-mediated mitophagy is linked to loss of quiescence, reduced self-renewal, and premature functional exhaustion.
context_zh_TW: Parkin是被PINK1招募至去極化粒線體的線粒體自噬效應器；它驅動外膜蛋白的泛素化，標記功能異常的細胞器以進行自噬清除。衰老透過PINK1穩定效率低下、自噬體形成缺陷和溶酶體清除減少損害此通路，允許受損粒線體持續存在。在幹細胞 compartment 中，Parkin介導的線粒體自噬受損與靜止喪失、自我更新減少和過早功能耗竭有關。

label: is_a_member_of
context: Peroxiredoxin 6 is a unique 1-Cys member of the peroxiredoxin family, which comprises six highly conserved antioxidant enzymes (PRDX1-PRDX6) featuring a cysteine residue involved in peroxide reduction. Uniquely among peroxiredoxins, PRDX6 possesses three activities: peroxidase, acidic calcium-independent phospholipase A2 (aiPLA2), and lysophosphatidylcholine acyltransferase (LPCAT). It is important for lipid peroxidation repair, inflammatory signaling, and antioxidant damage responses, and it is extensively studied in brain disorders such as Alzheimer's disease and Parkinson's disease.
context_zh_TW: Peroxiredoxin 6是peroxiredoxin家族中獨特的1-Cys成員，該家族包含六個高度保守的抗氧化酶（PRDX1-PRDX6），具有參與過氧化物還原的半胱氨酸殘基。在peroxiredoxins中，PRDX6獨特地具有三種活性：過氧化物酶、酸性鈣非依賴性磷脂酶A2（aiPLA2）和溶血磷脂醯膽鹼醯基轉移酶（LPCAT）。它對脂質過氧化修復、發炎訊號和抗氧化損傷反應很重要，在阿茲海默症和帕金森氏症等腦部疾病中被廣泛研究。

label: improves
context: Protein restriction extends both lifespan and healthspan across species and blunts age-associated increases in frailty, a state of vulnerability that raises the risk of dependency, falls, hospitalization, and mortality. PR reduces adiposity, increases energy expenditure, and improves glucose homeostasis even when initiated late in life (18-20 months of age in rodents). In Drosophila, PR increases resilience during aging, improving responses to starvation, bacterial infection, and heat stress. Randomized controlled trials in humans show low-protein diets reduce body weight, fat mass, and fasting blood glucose, improve insulin sensitivity, and reduce inflammation, supporting PR as a practical alternative to calorie restriction for healthy aging.
context_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制延長跨物種的壽命和健康span，並減弱與年齡相關的虛弱增加，虛弱是一種增加依賴、跌倒、住院和死亡風險的脆弱狀態。PR減少脂肪量，增加能量消耗，並改善葡萄糖恆定性，即使在生命晚期開始（囓齒動物18-20個月大）。在黑腹果蠅中，PR增加老化過程中的韌性，改善對飢餓、細菌感染和熱應激的反應。人類的隨機對照試驗顯示低蛋白飲食減少體重、脂肪量和空腹血糖，改善胰島素敏感性並減少發炎，支持PR作為健康老化的實用熱量限制替代方案。

label: are_targeted_by
context: SCAPs are targeted by senolytics, which neutralize anti-apoptotic BCL-2 family members and survival kinases (PI3K/Akt) to push senescent cells into apoptosis. This targeted disabling exploits the differential dependence of senescent versus healthy cells on SCAPs, providing the therapeutic selectivity that makes senolysis feasible. Agents such as navitoclax (BCL-2/BCL-XL) and the dasatinib-plus-quercetin combination act through this axis, with BAX/BAK-mediated MOMP unleashing the intrinsic death pathway. Targeting SCAPs is the core mechanistic principle of senolytic therapy.
context_zh_TW: SCAPs 被 senolytics 標靶，senolytics 中和抗凋亡 BCL-2 家族成員與存活激酶（PI3K/Akt）以將衰老細胞推入凋亡。此標靶性失能利用衰老相對健康細胞對 SCAPs 的差異依賴，提供使 senolysis 可行的治療選擇性。如 navitoclax（BCL-2/BCL-XL）與 dasatinib 合併 quercetin 組合等藥劑經由此軸作用，BAX/BAK 介導的 MOMP 釋放內在死亡路徑。標靶 SCAPs 是 senolytic 療法的核心機制原理。

label: suppresses
context: SIRT1 metabolically suppresses the apical caspase-2 through the 14-3-3ζ axis. SIRT1 inhibition in cancer cell lines — where the deacetylase is primarily cytoplasmic — sensitizes cells to caspase-2-dependent death and overrides the anti-apoptotic effect of nutrient abundance. In a breast tumor panel, SIRT1 inhibition caused rapid dissociation of caspase-2 from 14-3-3ζ and markedly enhanced paclitaxel sensitivity, positioning the SIRT1-14-3-3ζ-caspase-2 route as a chemotherapy-relevant death switch that operates during mitotic arrest when transcription is not ongoing.
context_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過 14-3-3ζ 軸線在代謝層面抑制頂端半胱天冬酶-2。在癌細胞株（此去乙醯酶主要位於細胞質）中抑制 SIRT1，會使細胞對 caspase-2 依賴性死亡敏感，並凌駕養分充足所帶來的抗凋亡效果。在乳腺癌細胞面板實驗中，抑制 SIRT1 造成 caspase-2 迅速脫離 14-3-3ζ 並顯著增強 paclitaxel 敏感性，使 SIRT1-14-3-3ζ-Caspase-2 路徑成為在轉錄停止的有絲分裂阻斷期間仍能運作的化療相關死亡開關。

label: is_modulated_by
context: Senescence is modulated by senomorphics, compounds that suppress the deleterious SASP without killing the senescent cell itself. By targeting upstream SASP regulators (mTOR, NF-κB, JAK-STAT3, p38 MAPK, BRD4), senomorphics dampen the paracrine and inflammatory consequences of senescence. This is conceptually complementary to senolytics, which remove the cell rather than its output. Senomorphics preserve potentially beneficial acute-senescence functions (e.g., wound healing, tumor suppression) while mitigating chronic harm.
context_zh_TW: 衰老受 senomorphics 調控，senomorphics 是抑制有害 SASP 而不殺死衰老細胞本身的化合物。透過標靶上游 SASP 調節者（mTOR、NF-κB、JAK-STAT3、p38 MAPK、BRD4），senomorphics 減弱衰老的旁分泌與發炎後果。這在概念上與 senolytics 互補，後者移除細胞而非其輸出。Senomorphics 保留潛在有益的急性衰老功能（如傷口癒合、腫瘤抑制），同時減輕慢性危害。

label: clears
context: Senescence surveillance is the immune-mediated clearance of senescent cells, serving as a fail-safe tumor-suppression and tissue-homeostasis mechanism. It is initiated by SASP find-me and activate-me signals that recruit NK cells, macrophages, and T cells to recognize and eliminate arrested cells, with NK cells killing via NKG2D ligands and macrophages phagocytosing recruited cells. Effective surveillance removes potentially harmful senescent cells before they accumulate, preventing SASP-driven pathology. Its decline with age permits senescent-cell burden to rise, linking immune aging to senescence pathology.
context_zh_TW: 衰老監視是衰老細胞的免疫介導清除，作為失效安全的腫瘤抑制與組織恆定機制。它由 SASP 的 find-me 與 activate-me 訊號啟動，招募 NK 細胞、巨噬細胞與 T 細胞辨識並排除停滯細胞，其中 NK 細胞經由 NKG2D 配體殺死，巨噬細胞吞噬被招募的細胞。有效的監視在有害衰老細胞累積前將其移除，預防 SASP 驅動的病理。其隨年齡下降允許衰老細胞負擔上升，將免疫老化連結到衰老病理。

label: are_cleared_by
context: Senescent cells are cleared by senolytics, agents that selectively induce apoptosis in them by disabling their SCAP network. Unlike healthy proliferating or quiescent cells, senescent cells are primed for death once anti-apoptotic defenses are neutralized, making the therapeutic window possible. Examples include BCL-2/BCL-XL inhibitors (navitoclax) and kinase inhibitors (dasatinib) combined with flavonoids (quercetin, fisetin). The clearance reduces SASP burden and alleviates age-related dysfunction in model organisms.
context_zh_TW: 衰老細胞被 senolytics 清除，senolytics 是透過失能其 SCAP 網絡、選擇性誘發凋亡的藥劑。不同於健康增殖或靜止細胞，衰老細胞一旦抗凋亡防禦被中和便準備好死亡，使治療窗口成為可能。例子包括 BCL-2/BCL-XL 抑制劑（navitoclax）與激酶抑制劑（dasatinib）合併類黃酮（quercetin、fisetin）。此清除降低 SASP 負擔並在模式生物中緩解年齡相關功能障礙。

label: target
context: Senolytics target SCAPs (senescence-cell anti-apoptotic pathways), the pro-survival network -- including BCL-2 family proteins and PI3K/Akt signaling -- that sustains senescent cells and renders them apoptosis-resistant. By disabling these defenses, senolytics push the cells across the apoptotic threshold. This selective vulnerability arises because senescent cells are primed for death relative to normal cells. The strategy underlies agents such as navitoclax (BCL-2/BCL-XL) and dasatinib+quercetin (D+Q).
context_zh_TW: Senolytics 標靶 SCAPs（senescence-cell anti-apoptotic pathways，衰老細胞抗凋亡路徑），即包含 BCL-2 家族蛋白與 PI3K/Akt 訊號、維持衰老細胞並使其抗凋亡的促存活網絡。透過失能這些防禦，senolytics 將細胞推過凋亡閾值。此選擇性脆弱源於衰老細胞相對正常細胞已準備好死亡。此策略是 navitoclax（BCL-2/BCL-XL）與 dasatinib+quercetin（D+Q）等藥劑的基礎。

label: encompasses
context: Senotherapy encompasses senolytics, the cell-elimination arm that selectively induces apoptosis in senescent cells by disabling SCAPs. This is one of the two principal divisions of senotherapy, the other being senomorphics, and the term captures the spectrum of interventions aimed at the senescent cell. Encompassing senolytics underscores the elimination-based strategy's centrality to the field, given its strong preclinical and early clinical evidence. Senolytic agents range from navitoclax to the D+Q combination and fisetin.
context_zh_TW: Senotherapy 涵蓋 senolytics，即透過失能 SCAPs 選擇性誘發衰老細胞凋亡的細胞消除臂。這是 senotherapy 兩個主要分支之一，另一為 senomorphics，且此詞涵蓋針對衰老細胞的介入光譜。涵蓋 senolytics 強調消除為本策略對該領域的中心性，考量其強健的臨床前與早期臨床證據。Senolytic 藥劑從 navitoclax 到 D+Q 組合與 fisetin 皆有。

label: encompasses
context: Senotherapy encompasses senomorphics, the SASP-suppression arm that modulates senescent cells without killing them. Together with senolytics, senomorphics form the two complementary pillars of senotherapy, reflecting the field's recognition that both removing and taming senescent cells are viable strategies. This inclusive definition unifies the therapeutic landscape against senescence and accommodates agents that suppress inflammation while preserving arrest. Senomorphics such as rapamycin, metformin, and ruxolitinib exemplify this modulation-based approach.
context_zh_TW: Senotherapy 涵蓋 senomorphics，即在不殺死細胞下調節衰老細胞的 SASP 抑制臂。與 senolytics 一起，senomorphics 構成 senotherapy 兩個互補支柱，反映該領域認知到移除與馴服衰老細胞皆為可行策略。此包容性定義統一對抗衰老的治療景觀，並容納抑制發炎同時保留停滯的藥劑。Senomorphics 如 rapamycin、metformin 與 ruxolitinib 例示此以調節為本的途徑。

label: reduces
context: Studies conducted at the University of Milan over 25 years showed that aminoguanidine reduces the ability of very low density lipoprotein (VLDL), the bad form of cholesterol, to bind itself to blood vessel walls, in tests on animals. In turn, blood platelets are less likely to coagulate and form dangerous clots. Aminoguanidine's role in reducing VLDL cholesterol and its ability to stabilize glucose metabolism indicate it has a wide-reaching ability to help prevent and treat a number of aging disorders.
context_zh_TW: 米蘭大學二十五年來的研究表明，氨基胍降低非常低密度脂蛋白 (VLDL)，即壞膽固醇的形式，與血管壁結合的能力，在動物實驗中有效。 此外，血小板更不活躍，也更不容易形成危險血栓。 氨基胍在降低 VLDL 膽固醇和穩定葡萄糖代謝方面的作用，以及其穩定代謝的能力，表明它具有廣泛的抗衰老和治療多種衰老疾病的能力。

label: accompanies
context: Symmetrical mitochondrial fission is closely orchestrated with the cell cycle to promote equal segregation of two functional daughter mitochondria during cell division, known as replicative fission. Mitochondria and cytoskeletal components work together to promote cell dichotomy and equal mitochondrial separation, including cytosolic contents and mtDNA, into the two daughter cells. Proliferation of vascular smooth muscle cells, myofibroblasts and pulmonary artery smooth muscle cells is inhibited by loss of DRP1, and fission defects lead to abnormally enlarged mtDNA nucleoids clustering in fused mitochondria.
context_zh_TW: Symmetrical mitochondrial fission is closely orchestrated with the cell cycle to promote equal segregation of two functional daughter mitochondria during cell division，known as replicative fission。Mitochondria and cytoskeletal components work together to promote cell dichotomy and equal mitochondrial separation, including cytosolic contents and mtDNA, into the two daughter cells。Proliferation of vascular smooth muscle cells, myofibroblasts and pulmonary artery smooth muscle cells is inhibited by loss of DRP1, and fission defects lead to abnormally enlarged mtDNA nucleoids clustering in fused mitochondria。

label: is_highly_expressed_in
context: The D2 receptor is highly expressed in the striatum, particularly on medium spiny neurons of the indirect pathway, where it dampens neuronal excitability and contributes to motor control. Its density in the striatum exceeds that in most other brain regions, making the striatum the primary locus of D2-mediated dopamine action and the main site of antipsychotic binding. This distribution underlies D2's centrality in movement disorders such as Parkinson's disease and in the therapeutic and side effects of antipsychotics. The receptor's abundance here shapes how dopamine tone translates into behavior.
context_zh_TW: D2 receptor 在紋狀體中高度表達，特別是在間接路徑的中型多棘神經元上，它抑制神經元的興奮性並有助於 motor control。它在紋狀體中的密度超過大多數其他 brain 區域，使紋狀體成為 D2 介導的多巴胺作用的主要場所和抗精神病藥物結合的主要位點。這種分佈是 D2 在 movement 疾病（例如帕金森氏症）以及抗精神病藥物的治療和副作用的中心地位的基礎。此處受體的豐度決定了多巴胺張力如何轉化為行為。

label: modulates
context: The D2 receptor modulates movement by inhibiting striatal medium spiny neurons of the indirect pathway, which normally suppresses thalamocortical motor output; reduced D2 tone releases this suppression and produces hyperactivity, whereas excess activation suppresses movement. Dopamine acting on D2 thus finely calibrates motor initiation, smoothness, and sequencing. This mechanism is central to the hypokinesia of Parkinson's disease and to antipsychotic-induced movement disorders. The direct and indirect pathway balance determines net motor output.
context_zh_TW: D2 receptor 透過抑制間接途徑的紋狀體中棘神經元來調節 movement，此間接途徑通常抑制丘腦皮質運動輸出；減少的 D2 音調會釋放這種抑制並產生過動症，而過度的活化會抑制 movement。 Dopamine 作用於 D2，從而精細地校準馬達啟動、平滑度和排序。這種機制對於帕金森氏症的運動功能減退和抗精神病藥物引起的 movement 疾病至關重要。直接和間接途徑的平衡決定了淨運動輸出。

label: increases
context: The Val158Met (Val) allele is associated with increased risk for schizophrenia in numerous case-control and meta-analytic studies, consistent with a role for prefrontal dopaminergic dysregulation in psychosis. The effect is modest in absolute terms and modified by ethnicity, sex, and other genetic and environmental factors, reflecting the polygenic nature of the disorder. Because COMT controls prefrontal dopamine clearance, the faster Val variant plausibly disrupts the dopamine balance implicated in schizophrenia. It remains one of the most investigated candidate variants in psychiatric genetics.
context_zh_TW: 在許多病例對照和統合分析研究中，Val158Met (Val) 等位基因與精神分裂症風險增加有關，這與前額葉多巴胺能失調在精神病中的作用一致。從絕對值來看，這種影響是適度的，並且會受到種族、性別以及其他遺傳和環境因素的影響，反映了疾病的多基因性質。由於 COMT 控制前額葉多巴胺清除，因此更快的 Val 變體可能會破壞與精神分裂症相關的多巴胺平衡。它仍然是精神遺傳學中研究最多的候選變異之一。

label: accumulates_with
context: The burden of senescent cells rises in multiple tissues with age, with some estimates suggesting an exponential increase, and this accumulation correlates strongly with age-related functional decline. Chronically accrued senescent cells and their SASP drive low-grade sterile inflammation (inflammaging) and tissue dysfunction across organs. The relationship is bidirectional in effect: aging promotes senescence (via telomere shortening, damage, and stem-cell exhaustion) while senescence accelerates aging phenotypes. This makes senescent-cell clearance a leading intervention strategy for alleviating age-related disease.
context_zh_TW: 衰老細胞的負擔隨年齡在多種組織中上升，部分估計顯示呈指數增加，且此累積與年齡相關的功能衰退強烈相關。慢性累積的衰老細胞及其 SASP 驅動低程度無菌性發炎（inflammaging）與跨器官的組織功能障礙。此關係在效應上是雙向的：老化促進衰老（透過端粒縮短、損傷與幹細胞耗竭），而衰老加速老化表型。這使清除衰老細胞成為緩解年齡相關疾病的一項領先介入策略。

label: is_regulated_by
context: The cGAS-STING innate immune pathway is a key driver of the SASP, activated by cytoplasmic nucleic acids including mtDNA released via minority MOMP and chromatin from cytoplasmic chromatin fragments. cGAS senses cytosolic DNA, producing cGAMP that activates STING, which in turn drives type-I interferon and NF-κB signaling to amplify SASP factor production. This linkage connects mitochondrial dysfunction and genomic stress directly to inflammatory senescence output. Importantly, cGAS-STING also enhances immune surveillance, giving the pathway both pro- and anti-tumor consequences.
context_zh_TW: cGAS-STING 先天免疫路徑是 SASP 的關鍵驅動者，由胞質核酸活化，包括經少數 MOMP 釋放的 mtDNA 以及來自胞質染色質片段的染色質。cGAS 感知胞質 DNA，產生 cGAMP 活化 STING，後者進而驅動第一型干擾素與 NF-κB 訊號以放大 SASP 因子產生。此連結將粒線體功能障礙與基因組壓力直接連到發炎性衰老輸出。重要的是，cGAS-STING 也增強免疫監視，使此路徑同時具促與抗腫瘤的後果。

label: is_sparse_in
context: The dopamine transporter is sparse in the prefrontal cortex compared with the striatum, meaning dopamine clearance there relies far more on diffusion, extracellular enzymatic O-methylation by COMT, and uptake by the norepinephrine transporter. This anatomical fact is the reason COMT genotype so strongly influences prefrontal dopamine and cognition, since DAT cannot rapidly buffer synaptic dopamine. Reduced DAT expression shifts the burden of inactivation to COMT and NET. It is a cornerstone of the regional dopamine regulation model.
context_zh_TW: 與紋狀體相比，前額葉皮質中的多巴胺轉運蛋白稀疏，這意味著那裡的多巴胺清除更依賴擴散、COMT 的細胞外酶促 O-甲基化以及 norepinephrine 轉運蛋白的攝取。這項解剖事實是 COMT genotype 如此強烈影響前額葉多巴胺和認知的原因，因為 DAT 無法快速緩衝突觸多巴胺。減少的 DAT expression 將失活的負擔轉移到 COMT 和 NET。它是區域多巴胺調節模型的基石。

label: centers_on
context: The hormesis exhibited by rapamycin is proposed to arise from a network topology that resembles an incoherent bivalent motif centered in its target mTORC1. In this architecture mTORC1 has a dual role: it is the target of rapamycin inhibition and simultaneously feeds an indirect activating path (via IRS1/S6K negative feedback and PI3K) toward the output mTORC2, yielding two net-opposite influences over the output. This topology induces biphasic dose-responses with high probability, and the backward reaction of the motif has a low Michaelis-Menten constant, consistent with the general rules identified in the coarse-grained screening.
context_zh_TW: 雷帕黴素（rapamycin）所展現的毒物興奮效應（hormesis）被提出源自一種網絡拓撲結構，類似以其標靶 mTORC1 為中心的不一致雙價基序（incoherent bivalent motif）。在此架構中，mTORC1 具有雙重角色：它是雷帕黴素抑制的標靶，同時透過間接活化路徑（經由 IRS1/S6K 負回饋與 PI3K）饋入輸出端 mTORC2，對輸出產生兩個淨效應相反的影響。此拓撲以高機率誘導雙相劑量反應，且該基序的逆向反應具有低 Michaelis-Menten 常數，與粗篩中辨識出的一般規則一致。

label: models
context: The kinetic equations of the model are defined as three coupled ODEs where interactions between Input, Target and Output nodes are computed following a Michaelis-Menten approach of activation-deactivation. The Michaelis-Menten constant K21 of the backward interaction from the Target to the Input node is the key parameter that distinguishes hormetic from monotonic responses, acting as an effective non-linear threshold that buffers the indirect pathway. The main limitation of this approach is that it implicitly assumes enzyme-substrate complex dissociation is basically instantaneous, which may not apply to all steps of a signaling pathway.
context_zh_TW: 模型的 kinetic equations 定義為三個 coupled ODEs，其中 Input、Target 和 Output 節點之間的交互作用按照 Michaelis-Menten 方法計算 activation-deactivation。Michaelis-Menten 常數 K21 是從 Target 到 Input 節點 backward interaction 的 key parameter，區分 hormetic 和 monotonic responses，作為 effective non-linear threshold 緩衝 indirect pathway。此方法的 main limitation 是它隱含假設 enzyme-substrate complex dissociation 基本上是 instantaneous，這可能不適用於 signaling pathway 的所有步驟。

label: improves
context: The mTORC1 pathway controls mRNA translation, and its overactivity increases the rate of protein synthesis at the expense of protein quality. Inhibition of mTORC1 by rapamycin reduces translation, improves its accuracy, and promotes longer life by reducing genetic code reading errors and the accumulation of abnormal proteins, a mechanism confirmed in Drosophila and C. elegans models. Rapamycin also inhibits cap-dependent translation of mRNA, supporting alternative stress-resistant translation that increases production of stress-response and mitochondrial-protection proteins such as HSP70 and TFAM, and by activating ATF4 and producing hydrogen sulfide it increases resistance to oxidative stress.
context_zh_TW: mTORC1途徑控制mRNA翻譯，其過度活化以蛋白質質量為代價增加蛋白質合成速率。Rapamycin對mTORC1的抑制減少翻譯，提高其準確性，並透過減少遺傳密碼讀取錯誤和異常蛋白質的累積來促進更長壽命，這一機制在黑腹果蠅和秀丽隱桿線蟲模型中得到證實。Rapamycin還抑制mRNA的帽依賴性翻譯，支持替代性抗壓力翻譯，增加壓力反應和粒線體保護蛋白如HSP70和TFAM的產生，並透過活化ATF4和產生硫化氫來增加對氧化壓力的抵抗力。

label: are_supplied_by
context: The methylation cycle supplies SAMe using methyl groups derived from methylfolate (5-methyl-THF), which donates its methyl group to homocysteine via methionine synthase. Methylfolate therefore sits upstream of the methyl-group pool that COMT consumes. Nutritional status of methylfolate indirectly modulates COMT throughput and prefrontal dopaminergic tone.
context_zh_TW: methylation cycle 使用來自 methylfolate（5-甲基-THF）的 methyl groups 供應 SAMe，後者透過 methionine synthase 將其甲基捐贈給同型半胱氨酸。因此 Methylfolate 位於 COMT 消耗的甲基群池上游。methylfolate 的營養狀態間接調節 COMT 通量和前額葉多巴胺能張力。

label: is
context: The norepinephrine transporter (NET) is a sodium- and chloride-dependent symporter of the SLC6 family encoded by SLC6A2. It couples the inward transport of one norepinephrine molecule with the co-transport of one Na+ and one Cl-. NET is the target of many antidepressants such as reboxetine and of psychostimulants.
context_zh_TW: Norepinephrine transporter (NET) 是 SLC6 家族的鈉和氯依賴性共同轉運體，由 SLC6A2 編碼。它將一個 norepinephrine 分子的向內運輸與一個 Na+ 和一個 Cl- 的共同運輸耦合。NET 是許多抗憂鬱藥（如 reboxetine）和精神興奮劑的靶點。

label: increases
context: The parasympathetic nervous system is the rest, digest, and repair branch of the autonomic nervous system, controlled heavily by the vagus nerve. When active, it signals the body to calm down, digest food, and repair cells, allowing for more fluctuation between heartbeats and thereby raising HRV. A high HRV indicates strong vagal tone, meaning the parasympathetic system can quickly hit the brakes on stress. HRV reflects the tug-of-war between the sympathetic and parasympathetic systems, and recovery after stressors allows the parasympathetic branch to rebound and push HRV back to or above baseline.
context_zh_TW: 副交感神經系統是自主神經系統的休息、消化和修復分支，主要受迷走神經控制。活躍時，它向身體發出信號以平靜下來、消化食物和修復細胞，允許心跳之間有更多波動，從而提高心率變異性（HRV）。高HRV表示迷走神經張力強，意味著副交感系統能快速對壓力踩剎車。HRV反映了交感和副交感系統之間的拉鋸戰，壓力後的恢復允許副交感分支反彈並將HRV推回或高於基線。

label: relies_on
context: The prefrontal cortex relies on the norepinephrine transporter (NET) to clear dopamine in this region because the dopamine transporter (DAT) is sparse. NET takes up both norepinephrine and a substantial fraction of extracellular dopamine. This makes NET a critical determinant of catecholamine tone in the frontal lobes.
context_zh_TW: 由於多巴胺轉運蛋白 (DAT) 稀疏，前額葉皮質依賴 norepinephrine transporter (NET) 清除該區域的 dopamine。NET 同時攝取 norepinephrine 和大量細胞外 dopamine。這使 NET 成為額葉兒茶酚胺張力的關鍵決定因素。

label: increases_with
context: The probability of a network topology producing a hormetic (non-monotonic) dose-response curve increases with network complexity: the highest number of hormetic topologies contain six or seven links, and normalized by topology count the probability of exhibiting hormesis increases as the number of active links increases, indicating that hormesis depends on network density and complexity. More than 500 of the 5346 possible three-node topologies tested show clear non-monotonic dose-response curves, and hormesis is favored in networks with a high number of repressing interactions on average.
context_zh_TW: 網路拓撲產生荷爾米希（非單調）劑量反應曲線的機率隨網路複雜度增加而上升：荷爾米希拓撲數量最多者含六或七條連結，且依拓撲數量標準化後，荷爾米希反應的機率隨活性連結數量增加而上升，顯示荷爾米希取決於網路密度與複雜度。在測試的 5346 種三節點拓撲中，超過 500 種展現明確的非單調劑量反應曲線，且荷爾米希在平均抑制性交互作用數量較高的網路中更易出現。

label: is_required_for
context: The progressive decline in NAD+ levels during aging is a central metabolic bottleneck compromising sirtuin-dependent resilience. Reduced NAD+ availability compromises SIRT1 and SIRT3 activity, which regulate PGC-1α, FOXO, and NRF1 transcriptional programs governing antioxidant defenses, mitochondrial biogenesis and stress adaptation. NAD+ decline arises from both reduced biosynthetic capacity and increased degradation via CD38, PARP1 and SARM1. Restoration of NAD+ enhances UPRmt activity, and PARP inhibition can promote mitonuclear communication and UPRmt activation.
context_zh_TW: 衰老過程中NAD+水平的進行性下降是損害sirtuin依賴性恢復力的 central 代謝瓶頸。NAD+可用性降低損害SIRT1和SIRT3活性，它們調節PGC-1α、FOXO和NRF1轉錄程序， govern 抗氧化防禦、粒線體生物合成和壓力適應。NAD+下降源於生物合成能力降低以及透過CD38、PARP1和SARM1的降解增加。恢復NAD+增強UPRmt活性，而PARP抑制可促進粒線核通訊和UPRmt激活。

label: is_favored_by
context: The study screened 5346 possible three-node network topologies of a coarse-grained signaling cascade model using a high-throughput computational approach, with 5000 parameter sets and 30 inhibitor concentrations per topology. More than 500 topologies show clear non-monotonic dose-response curves, and hormesis is favored in networks with a high number of repressing interactions on average, with the highest fraction of hormetic parameter sets in a topology composed of four repressing interactions. The probability of hormesis increases as the network becomes more complex, indicating it depends on the density and complexity of the network.
context_zh_TW: 該研究以高通量計算方法篩檢了粗略顆粒化訊息傳導級聯模型的 5346 種可能三節點網路拓撲，每種拓撲使用 5000 組參數與 30 種抑制劑濃度。超過 500 種拓撲展現明確的非單調劑量反應曲線，且荷爾米希在平均抑制性交互作用數量較高的網路中更受青睞，其中由四條抑制性交互作用組成的拓撲擁有最高比例的荷爾米希參數組。荷爾米希的機率隨網路複雜度增加而上升，顯示其取決於網路的密度與複雜度。

label: decreases
context: The sympathetic nervous system is the fight, flight, or freeze branch of the autonomic nervous system. It releases adrenaline and cortisol to prepare the body for action during events such as a HIIT workout, cold plunge, or fasting. When the SNS is active, it forces the heart to beat faster and more rhythmically, thereby lowering HRV. Chronic sympathetic dominance keeps the system stuck in the on position, producing a chronically depressed HRV that signals under-recovery and overtraining rather than adaptation.
context_zh_TW: 交感神經系統是自主神經系統的戰鬥、逃跑或凍結分支。它釋放腎上腺素和皮質醇，使身體在HIIT鍛煉、冷水浸泡或禁食等事件期間準備行動。當SNS活躍時，它迫使心臟跳動更快、更規律，從而降低HRV。慢性交感神經主導地位使系統卡在開啟位置，產生慢性抑鬱的HRV，表示恢復不足和過度訓練而非適應。

label: support
context: Thymic epithelial cells (TECs) in the cortex and medulla form a complex network that supports T cell differentiation, providing the essential microenvironment for productive thymopoiesis. The thymus consists of cells of stromal and hematopoietic origin, including TECs, mesenchymal cells (fibroblasts), endothelial cells and dendritic cells. Differentiating thymocytes migrate from the cortico-medullary junction through the cortex and back to the medulla, encountering functionally distinct microenvironments that regulate positive and negative selection.
context_zh_TW: 皮質和髓質中的胸腺上皮細胞（TECs）形成一個複雜的網絡，支持 T 細胞分化，為 productive thymopoiesis 提供必要的微環境。胸腺由基質和造血來源的細胞組成，包括 TECs、間充質細胞（成纖維細胞）、內皮細胞和樹突狀細胞。分化中的胸腺細胞從皮髓交界處遷移穿過皮質再回到髓質，遇到功能不同的微環境，調節陽性和陰性選擇。

label: improves
context: Two randomized placebo-controlled clinical trials tested rapalogs among the elderly for immunomodulation. Treatment with everolimus monotherapy or everolimus in combination with RTB101 for six weeks resulted in a better response to influenza vaccine and fewer infections over the next year compared to placebo. The proposed mechanism is an increase in autophagy through inhibition of mTOR along with increased expression of antiviral proteins. The observation that immune function improves after a single six-week period of mTORC1 inhibition has important clinical implications, since elderly patients are particularly at risk of dying from influenza.
context_zh_TW: 兩項隨機、安慰劑對照的臨床試驗在老年族群中測試了rapalog的免疫調節作用。與安慰劑相比，單用everolimus或以everolimus合併RTB101治療六週，可獲得較佳的流感疫苗反應，並在接下來一年內減少感染次數。其提出的機制是透過抑制mTOR來增加自噬（autophagy），同時增加抗病毒蛋白的表現。僅單次六週的mTORC1抑制即可改善免疫功能，此觀察具有重要的臨床意義，因為老年患者特別容易因流感而死亡。

label: impacts
context: Val158Met impacts cognitive performance by setting prefrontal dopamine availability through its effect on COMT activity, with the inverted-U model predicting better stability and working memory in Met carriers and better stress processing in Val carriers. Meta-analyses confirm small-to-moderate, task-dependent effects on executive function and working memory, moderated by sex, age, and environment. The variant is a leading model for gene-cognition association. Its effects are most apparent under cognitive load and stress.
context_zh_TW: Val158Met 透過對 COMT activity 的影響來設定前額多巴胺的可用性，從而影響 cognitive performance，倒 U 模型預測 Met 攜帶者有更好的穩定性和工作記憶，Val 攜帶者有更好的壓力處理。統合分析證實對 executive function 和工作記憶有小到中度的任務依賴性影響，並受到性別、年齡和環境的調節。該變異是基因認知關聯的領先模型。它的影響在認知負荷和壓力下最為明顯。

label: is_inhibited_by
context: mTOR is inhibited by rapamycin, which suppresses the SASP by blocking mTOR-dependent translation of SASP factors and by interfering with the p38 MAPK-IL-1a-NF-kB cascade. As a cornerstone senomorphic mechanism, this reduces inflammatory secretome output, and the drug's action is direct, via FKBP12-rapamycin binding to mTORC1, and well characterized. The inhibition also engages autophagy, limiting mitochondrial DAMP release. It underlies many of rapamycin's longevity and anti-inflammatory effects across model organisms.
context_zh_TW: mTOR 被 rapamycin 抑制，rapamycin 透過阻斷 mTOR 依賴的 SASP 因子轉譯並干擾 p38 MAPK-IL-1α-NF-κB 級聯抑制 SASP。作為 senomorphic 機制的基石，這減少發炎性分泌組輸出，且該藥作用直接，經由 FKBP12-rapamycin 結合 mTORC1，並已良好表徵。此抑制也啟動自噬，限制粒線體 DAMP 釋放。它構成 rapamycin 許多延壽與抗發炎效應的基礎。

label: regulates
context: mTORC2 is the downstream readout of the rapamycin model since it drives cell cycle progression and survival via AKT, and also regulates mitochondrial physiology, metabolism and integrity. mTORC2 activity has been shown to increase with age, and its elimination has been shown to alleviate aging progression. In the simulations, the typical dose-response curve shows a clear decrease in mTORC2 activity at intermediate rapamycin concentrations, followed by reduced sensitivity at higher doses, while short-term rapamycin exposure increases mTORC2 activity and long-term exposure obstructs its assembly.
context_zh_TW: mTORC2是雷帕霉素模型的下游讀出，因為它透過AKT驅動細胞週期進展和存活，同時也調節粒線體生理、代謝和完整性。mTORC2活性已被證明隨年齡增長而增加，且其消除可減緩衰老進展。在模擬中，典型的劑量反應曲線顯示在中等雷帕霉素濃度下mTORC2活性明顯降低，隨後在更高劑量下敏感性降低，而短期雷帕霉素暴露增加mTORC2活性，長期暴露則阻碍其組裝。

label: maintains
context: p15INK4b maintains Rb in its hypophosphorylated, growth-suppressive state by inhibiting CDK4/6, thereby keeping Rb bound to and repressing E2F target genes. This sustains the G1 arrest that defines the senescent phenotype and locks cells out of the cell cycle. Along with p16, p15 provides durable CDK inhibition that reinforces the Rb-E2F checkpoint, a central node of senescence enforcement. The relationship is a standard INK4-Rb axis fact and explains how CDK inhibition translates into stable growth arrest.
context_zh_TW: p15INK4b 透過抑制 CDK4/6 維持 Rb 於其低磷酸化、生長抑制狀態，從而保持 Rb 結合並抑制 E2F 標的基因。這維持定義衰老表型的 G1 停滯並將細胞鎖出細胞週期。與 p16 一起，p15 提供持久 CDK 抑制以強化 Rb-E2F 檢查點，這是衰老執行的中心節點。此關係是標準的 INK4-Rb 軸事實，並解釋 CDK 抑制如何轉化為穩定生長停滯。

label: is_activated_by
context: 2-APQC (2-acetylphenolquinone congener) is a novel pharmacological agonist of SIRT3 that significantly alleviates isoproterenol-induced pathological cardiac hypertrophy and fibrotic progression, with efficacy completely lost in SIRT3-knockout models and markedly attenuated by the SIRT3 inhibitor nicotinamide, confirming SIRT3 as its primary molecular target. Mechanistically it suppresses AKT/mTOR/p70S6K and JNK/TGF-beta/Smad3 signaling.
context_zh_TW: 2-APQC（2-乙醯苯基醌同源物）是一種新型 SIRT3 藥理學激動劑，顯著緩解異丙腎上腺素誘導的病理性心臟肥厚和纖維化進展，在 SIRT3 基因敲除模型中療效完全喪失，並被 SIRT3 抑制劑尼可醯胺顯著削弱，確認 SIRT3 是其主要的分子靶標。機制上它抑制 AKT/mTOR/p70S6K 和 JNK/TGF-beta/Smad3 訊號。

label: activates
context: 2-APQC is a novel pharmacological agonist of SIRT3 that alleviates isoproterenol-induced pathological cardiac hypertrophy and fibrosis; efficacy is lost in SIRT3-knockout models and attenuated by nicotinamide, confirming SIRT3 as its primary target, via suppression of AKT/mTOR/p70S6K and JNK/TGF-beta/Smad3 signaling.
context_zh_TW: 2-APQC 是一種新型 SIRT3 藥理學激動劑，緩解異丙腎上腺素誘導的病理性心臟肥厚和纖維化；在 SIRT3 基因敲除模型中療效喪失，並被尼可醯胺削弱，確認 SIRT3 為其主要靶標，透過抑制 AKT/mTOR/p70S6K 和 JNK/TGF-beta/Smad3 訊號實現。

label: is_a_biomarker_for
context: 3-nitrotyrosine is a biomarker for nitrative stress, reflecting peroxynitrite- or myeloperoxidase-mediated nitration of protein tyrosines. It is elevated across many inflammatory and neurodegenerative conditions. The directionality is nitrative insult to stable protein modification. A caveat is that 3-nitrotyrosine can arise from multiple nitrating pathways and can be repaired or degraded, so it indicates historical rather than instantaneous nitrative load. Quantification in plasma, CSF, and tissue by mass spectrometry or immunoassay has made 3-NT a standard endpoint in redox biomarker studies.
context_zh_TW: 3-nitrotyrosine 是 nitrative stress 的生物標記物，反映 peroxynitrite 或 myeloperoxidase 介導的蛋白質 tyrosines 硝化。它會導致許多發炎和神經退化性疾病。方向性是對穩定蛋白質修飾的硝化損害。需要注意的是，3-nitrotyrosine 可以由多種硝化途徑產生，並且可以修復或降解，因此它表示歷史硝化負荷而不是瞬時硝化負荷。透過質譜或免疫分析對血漿、腦脊髓液和組織進行定量，使 3-NT 成為氧化還原生物標記研究的標準終點。

label: is_the_most_characteristic_modification_of
context: 3-nitrotyrosine is the most characteristic modification of nitrative stress, elevated in over fifty human pathologies as a stable footprint of protein tyrosine nitration. Its presence is used experimentally to infer peroxynitrite or related RNS activity. The directionality is nitrative insult to stable adduct. A caveat is that 3-nitrotyrosine can be generated by multiple nitrating pathways and can be repaired or turned over, so it marks historical rather than acute stress. Detection in exhaled breath condensate and urine is increasingly used to monitor nitrative burden non-invasively in lung and systemic disease.
context_zh_TW: 3-nitrotyrosine 是 nitrative stress 最具特徵性的修飾，在 50 多種人類病理中作為蛋白質 tyrosine 硝化的穩定足跡而升高。它的存在被實驗性地用來推論 peroxynitrite 或相關的 RNS 活性。方向性是對穩定加合物的硝化損害。需要注意的是，3-nitrotyrosine 可以透過多種硝化途徑產生，並且可以修復或翻轉，因此它標誌著歷史壓力，而不是急性壓力。呼出氣冷凝物和尿液的檢測越來越多地用於非侵入性監測肺部和全身疾病的硝態負荷。

label: promotes
context: 4-hydroxynonenal promotes tau oligomerization by forming covalent Michael adducts with tau cysteine and lysine residues, altering its conformation and seeding oligomers. As a major lipid-peroxidation aldehyde, 4-HNE thus couples membrane oxidation to protein misfolding. The directionality is aldehyde adduct to tau aggregation propensity. A caveat is that 4-HNE at low levels can also induce adaptive responses, and other aldehydes (MDA, acrolein) modify tau similarly. Elevated 4-HNE and tau adducts colocalize in Alzheimer's disease brain, linking lipid peroxidation to neurofibrillary pathology.
context_zh_TW: 4-hydroxynonenal 透過與 tau 半胱胺酸和離胺酸殘基形成共價邁克爾加合物，改變其構象並播種寡聚物來促進 tau oligomerization。作为一种主要的脂质过氧化醛，4-HNE 将膜氧化与蛋白质错误折叠结合起来。方向性是醛加合物對tau聚集的傾向。需要注意的是，低水平的 4-HNE 也可以誘導適應性反應，其他醛（MDA、丙烯醛）也會類似地修飾 tau。升高的 4-HNE 和 tau 加合物共定位於阿茲海默症大腦中，將 lipid peroxidation 與神經纖維病理聯繫起來。

label: bidirectionally_linked_with
context: 5,6-indolequinone and Neuromelanin are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically 5,6-indolequinone and Neuromelanin may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
context_zh_TW: 5,6-indolequinone 和 Neuromelanin 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，5,6-indolequinone 和 Neuromelanin 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: converts_to
context: 5,6-indolequinone is biochemically converted into Neuromelanin through a defined reaction step in catecholamine pigment or neurotransmitter metabolism. Mechanistically, 5,6-indolequinone acts as the substrate and Neuromelanin as the product, often via oxidation, cyclization, or enzymatic decarboxylation. This conversion is biologically significant because it channels labile intermediates into stable products or active transmitters, with implications for neuromelanin accumulation and neuronal health. A caveat is that the precise stoichiometry and subcellular conditions governing the step are not fully resolved and may depend on local iron, pH, and antioxidant capacity.
context_zh_TW: 5,6-indolequinone 透過兒茶酚胺色素或神經傳導物質代謝中的特定反應步驟生化轉化為 Neuromelanin。從機制上講，5,6-indolequinone 作為底物，Neuromelanin 作為產物，通常透過 oxidation、環化或酶促脫羧作用。這種轉化具有重要的生物學意義，因為它將不穩定的中間體轉化為穩定的產物或活性遞質，對 neuromelanin 累積和神經元健康產生影響。需要注意的是，控制該步驟的精確化學計量和亞細胞條件尚未完全解決，可能取決於局部 iron、pH 和抗氧化能力。

label: inhibits
context: 5-Azacytidine inhibits DNMT1, the maintenance DNA methyltransferase that copies methylation patterns onto daughter strands during DNA replication. As a cytidine analog, 5-azacytidine is incorporated into DNA, where it covalently traps DNMT1 and depletes the enzyme, causing passive loss of methylation on newly synthesized strands. This demethylation reactivates silenced genes, including tumor suppressors, and underlies its clinical use in myelodysplastic syndromes and acute myeloid leukemia. It is also studied for its capacity to modulate senescence and reactivate silenced developmental programs.
context_zh_TW: 5-Azacytidine 抑制 DNMT1，這是一種維持 DNA 甲基轉移酶，在 DNA 複製過程中將甲基化模式複製到子鏈上。作為胞苷類似物，5-氮雜胞苷摻入 DNA 中，共價捕獲 DNMT1 並耗盡該酶，導致新合成鏈上的甲基化被動喪失。这种去甲基化重新激活了沉默的基因，包括肿瘤抑制基因，这是其在骨髓增生异常综合征和急性髓系白血病中的临床应用的基础。人們也研究了它調節衰老和重新激活沉默的發育程序的能力。

label: is_a_type_of
context: 5-Azacytidine is classified as an epigenetic modifier, specifically a DNA methyltransferase (DNMT) inhibitor, and it is among the first epigenetic drugs used in the clinic. As a cytidine analog, it is incorporated into DNA during replication, where it covalently traps DNMT enzymes and causes passive loss of DNA methylation, reactivating silenced genes such as tumor suppressors. This mechanism underlies its use in myelodysplastic syndromes and leukemia and its application in research on gene silencing, development, and aging.
context_zh_TW: 5-Azacytidine被歸類為表觀遺傳修飾劑，特別是DNA甲基轉移酶（DNMT）抑制劑，是第一批應用於臨床的表觀遺傳藥物之一。作為胞苷類似物，它在複製過程中摻入 DNA，共價捕獲 DNMT 酶並導致 DNA 甲基化被動丟失，從而重新激活腫瘤抑制基因等沉默基因。這種機制是其在骨髓增生異常綜合症和白血病中的應用及其在基因沉默、發育和老化研究中的應用的基礎。

label: bidirectionally_linked_with
context: 6-hydroxydopamine and Parkinson's Disease are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically 6-hydroxydopamine and Parkinson's Disease may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
context_zh_TW: 6-hydroxydopamine 和 Parkinson's Disease 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，6-hydroxydopamine 和 Parkinson's Disease 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: causes
context: 6-hydroxydopamine causes Parkinson's Disease by acting as the upstream trigger whose downstream consequence is the second entity's appearance or dysfunction. The mechanism typically involves oxidative, mitochondrial, or proteotoxic injury in the case of neurotoxins and pigments, or receptor blockade and cell loss in pharmacological and degenerative contexts. This causal relationship is clinically significant because it models or explains features of Parkinson's disease pathology and guides therapeutic targeting. A caveat is that in many of these links the causal claim is experimental, partial, or operates within a broader network of cofactors rather than as an isolated linear event.
context_zh_TW: 6-hydroxydopamine 透過充當上游觸發器來導致 Parkinson's Disease，其下游結果是第二個實體的出現或功能障礙。此機制通常涉及氧化、mitochondria1或neurotoxin和色素情況下的蛋白毒性損傷，或藥理學和退化環境中的受體阻斷和細胞損失。這種因果關係具有臨床意義，因為它模擬或解釋了 Parkinson's disease 病理特徵並指導治療目標。需要注意的是，在許多這些連結中，因果關係的主張是實驗性的、部分的，或是在更廣泛的輔助因子網絡中運作的，而不是作為一個孤立的線性事件。

label: induces
context: 7-ketocholesterol induces apoptosis through ROS-dependent mitochondrial permeabilization and activation of caspase-3, contributing to death of macrophage foam cells in plaques. As a major oxysterol in oxidized LDL, it is implicated in plaque necrosis. The directionality is oxysterol to programmed cell death. A caveat is that 7-ketocholesterol effects are concentration-dependent and can also trigger inflammatory and autophagic responses before death. Plasma and lesion 7-KC levels correlate with plaque vulnerability, and its toxicity to vascular cells is a recognized contributor to plaque necrosis.
context_zh_TW: 7-ketocholesterol透過ROS依賴性mitochondria1透化和caspase-3的活化誘導apoptosis，導致斑塊中巨噬細胞泡沫細胞死亡。作為 oxidized LDL 中的主要氧甾醇，它與噬菌斑 necrosis 有關。方向性是氧甾醇到程序性細胞死亡。需要注意的是，7-ketocholesterol 的作用具有濃度依賴性，也可能在死亡前引發發炎和自噬反應。血漿和病變 7-KC 水平與斑塊脆弱性相關，其對血管細胞的毒性是斑塊 necQrosis 的公認貢獻者。

label: restores
context: 78c indirectly boosts SIRT1 and SIRT3 by maintaining NAD+ co-substrate availability, restoring their deacetylase function in aged tissue. Directionally, NAD+ preservation sits upstream of sirtuin reactivation. This is an indirect pan-sirtuin approach distinct from direct STACs, and it links CD38 pharmacology to longevity pathways. By preventing NAD+ consumption, 78c ensures that sirtuins have the co-substrate they require, effectively restoring the NAD+-dependent regulation that declines with age. This strategy is complementary to NAD+ precursor supplementation, and the two approaches are often combined.
context_zh_TW: 78c 透過維護 NAD+ 共同底物的可用性間接增強 SIRT1 和 SIRT3，恢復其在老年組織中的去乙醯酶功能。在方向性上，NAD+ 保存位於 sirtuin 重新活化的上游。這是與直接 STAC 不同的間接全 sirtuin 方法，將 CD38 藥理學與長壽途徑聯繫起來。透過防止 NAD+ 消耗，78c 確保 sirtuin 擁有所需的共同底物，有效恢復隨年齡下降的 NAD+ 依賴性調控。此策略與 NAD+ 前驅物補充互補，兩種方法經常結合使用。

label: inhibits
context: 78c is a highly potent, selective, orally bioavailable small-molecule inhibitor of CD38 NAD+-glycohydrolase activity. Directionally, 78c sits upstream of CD38 blockade. By stopping NAD+ consumption, it spares the co-substrate for sirtuins and other NAD+-dependent enzymes, and it is a leading age-reversal NAD+-preservation strategy. 78c's potency and oral bioavailability make it suitable for chronic in vivo studies, and its administration to aged mice restores NAD+ levels and sirtuin activity. These properties positioned 78c as the key pharmacological tool for validating CD38 as a longevity target.
