This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.

label: cleaves
context: Caspase-3 cleaves ICAD. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. The relationship is directional, with Caspase-3 acting as the operative agent upon ICAD rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.

The relationship is directional, with Caspase-3 acting as the operative agent upon Lamins rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.

label: cleaves
context: Caspase-3 cleaves PARP1 at the DEVD↓G site during apoptosis, inactivating its DNA-repair capacity and conserving ATP for the death program. Directionally, caspase-3 sits upstream of PARP1 inactivation. This marks the point of irreversible commitment to apoptosis and is a classic biochemical marker of apoptotic execution. Because PARP1 is a major NAD+ consumer, its cleavage during apoptosis also spares NAD+ from repair-dependent depletion. The cleavage of PARP1 is widely used experimentally to detect apoptosis, and its regulation is relevant to both normal cell turnover and cancer therapy.
context_zh_TW: Caspase-3 在凋亡期間在 DEVD↓G 位點切割 PARP1，使其 DNA 修復能力失活並將 ATP 節省給死亡程式。在方向性上，caspase-3 位於 PARP1 失活的上游。這標誌著不可逆凋亡承諾的時點，是凋亡執行的經典生化標誌。由於 PARP1 是主要的 NAD+ 消耗者，其在凋亡期間的切割也節省了 NAD+ 免於修復依賴性的耗竭。PARP1 的切割在實驗中被廣泛用於檢測凋亡，其調控與正常細胞更新和癌症治療都相關。

label: is_activated_at
context: Caspase-8 is activated at DISC. Caspase-8 is the initiator caspase of the extrinsic pathway and also gates the intrinsic pathway through Bid cleavage. The death-inducing signaling complex assembles on ligand-bound death receptors and converts procaspase-8/10 into active initiator caspases. The directionality runs from DISC toward Caspase-8, so DISC is the active agent and Caspase-8 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.

label: is_inhibited_by
context: Caspase-8 is inhibited by SRC kinase. Caspase-8 is the initiator caspase of the extrinsic pathway and also gates the intrinsic pathway through Bid cleavage. The directionality runs from SRC kinase toward Caspase-8, so SRC kinase is the active agent and Caspase-8 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.

The directionality runs from SHP1 toward Caspase-8, so SHP1 is the active agent and Caspase-8 the recipient of the effect. The directionality runs from Akt toward Caspase-9, so Akt is the active agent and Caspase-9 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context_zh_TW: Caspase-9 被 Akt 抑制。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。 Akt 是一種絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶，可磷酸化多種底物，以促進生長、糖解和抑制細胞凋亡。方向性從 Akt 向 Caspase-9，因此 Akt 是主動主體，Caspase-9 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: is_inhibited_by
context: Caspase-9 is inhibited by XIAP. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. The directionality runs from XIAP toward Caspase-9, so XIAP is the active agent and Caspase-9 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context_zh_TW: Caspase-9 被 XIAP 抑制。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。方向性從 XIAP 朝向 Caspase-9，因此 XIAP 是主動主體，Caspase-9 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: activates
context: Caspase-9, activated within the apoptosome, cleaves and activates executioner caspase-3 in the intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptosis pathway. Directionally, caspase-9 sits upstream of caspase-3 activation. This propagates the death signal following mitochondrial outer-membrane permeabilization, when cytochrome c is released to assemble the apoptosome. It is central to the intrinsic apoptotic cascade, which is regulated by the Bcl-2 family and by sirtuins that modulate pro- and anti-apoptotic proteins. The intrinsic pathway is the primary target of many cancer chemotherapies and of cytoprotective interventions.
context_zh_TW: Caspase-9 在凋亡體中被活化，在內源性（粒線體）凋亡途徑中切割並活化效應型 caspase-3。在方向性上，caspase-9 位於 caspase-3 活化的上游。這在粒線體外膜通透化後傳播死亡訊號，此時細胞色素 c 被釋放以組裝凋亡體。這是內源性凋亡級聯的核心，由 Bcl-2 家族和調節促凋亡及抗凋亡蛋白的 sirtuin 所調控。內源性途徑是許多癌症化療藥物和細胞保護干預措施的主要靶標。

label: causes
context: Catalase deficiency causes acatalasemia (Takahara's disease), a rare autosomal recessive disorder in which near-absent catalase activity leads to oral mucosal ulcers and periodontal destruction from accumulated H2O2. The pathology arises because bacterial metabolism in the mouth produces H2O2 that cannot be degraded, fostering gangrene-prone infections. The directionality is enzyme loss to local oxidative injury. A caveat is that many acatalasemic individuals are surprisingly asymptomatic, indicating redundancy from other peroxide-removing systems.
context_zh_TW: Catalase deficiency 會導致 acatalasemia（高原氏症），這是一種罕見的體染色體隱性遺傳疾病，幾乎不存在 catalase 活性，導致口腔黏膜潰瘍和累積的 H2O2 造成牙周破壞。這種病理現象的產生是因為口腔中的細菌代謝產生無法降解的 H2O2，促進壞疽感染。方向性是酵素損失導致局部氧化損傷。需要注意的是，許多 acatalasemic 個體出乎意料地沒有症狀，這表明其他過氧化物去除系統存在冗餘。

label: contributes_to
context: Catalase downregulation contributes to cancer because reduced H2O2 clearance permits sustained oxidative stress that can drive DNA damage, genomic instability, and altered redox signaling favoring proliferation. Catalase is frequently downregulated in breast, prostate, and hepatocellular carcinomas relative to normal tissue. The directionality is loss-of-defense promoting tumorigenic oxidative damage. A caveat is that many tumors also exploit moderate ROS for survival signaling, so catalase levels represent a context-dependent balance rather than a simple tumor suppressor.
context_zh_TW: Catalase downregulation 有助於 cancer，因為減少的 H2O2 清除允許持續的 oxidative stress，從而驅動 DNA damage、基因組不穩定性和有利於增殖的氧化還原訊號傳導改變。相對於正常組織，Catalase 在乳癌、prostate 和肝細胞癌中經常下調。方向性是防禦喪失促進致瘤性氧化損傷。需要注意的是，許多腫瘤也利用適度的 ROS 來發出生存訊號，因此 catalase 水平代表了情境依賴性平衡，而不是簡單的腫瘤抑制因子。

label: is_localized_in
context: Catalase is localized predominantly in peroxisomes, organelles that host numerous H2O2-generating oxidases involved in lipid beta-oxidation and purine catabolism. Concentrating catalase here minimizes leakage of peroxide into the cytosol and nucleus. The directionality reflects compartmentalization of both source and sink of H2O2. A caveat is that a minority of catalase activity also exists in cytosol and mitochondria in some tissues, providing additional but lesser protection. This compartmentalization is functionally important: peroxisomal beta-oxidation of very-long-chain fatty acids generates substantial H2O2, and catalase prevents that peroxide from spilling into the cytosol.
context_zh_TW: Catalase 主要位於 peroxisomes 細胞器中，該細胞器含有大量參與脂質 β 氧化和嘌呤分解代謝的產生 H2O2 的氧化酶。在此濃縮 catalase 可最大程度地減少過氧化物洩漏到細胞質和細胞核。方向性反映了 H2O2 源和彙的劃分。需要注意的是，少數 catalase 活性也存在於某些組織的細胞質和 mitochondria 中，提供額外但較少的保護。這種區室化在功能上很重要：極長鏈脂肪酸的過氧化物酶體 β 氧化會產生大量 H2O2，而 catalase 可以防止過氧化物溢出到細胞質中。

label: protects_against
context: Catalase protects against oxidative stress by eliminating hydrogen peroxide before it can be converted by transition metals into the damaging hydroxyl radical. Its peroxisomal localization places it near H2O2-generating oxidases, intercepting peroxide at source. The directionality is preventive detoxification upstream of Fenton chemistry. A caveat is that catalase alone cannot handle the full cellular H2O2 burden, so its protective role is shared with glutathione peroxidase and peroxiredoxins. Because it requires no cofactors and works at very high catalytic rates, catalase is especially effective at clearing the large peroxide bursts produced during infection and ischemia-reperfusion.
context_zh_TW: Catalase 透過在 hydrogen peroxide 被過渡金屬轉化為 damaging 羥基自由基之前消除 oxidative stress 來防止 oxidative stress。它的過氧化物酶體定位使其靠近產生 H2O2 的氧化酶，從源頭攔截過氧化物。方向性是芬頓化學上游的預防性解毒。需要注意的是，catalase 本身無法處理全部細胞 H2O2 負擔，因此其保護作用與 glutathione peroxidase 和過氧化還原蛋白共享。由於 catalase 不需要輔因子且催化速率非常高，因此它在清除感染和缺血再灌注過程中產生的大量過氧化物特別有效。

label: decomposes
context: Catalase, constitutively present in the peroxisomal matrix, decomposes hydrogen peroxide — a toxic byproduct of peroxisomal oxidase reactions — into water and oxygen (2 H2O2 -> 2 H2O + O2). This makes peroxisomes central to cellular detoxification of reactive oxygen species.
context_zh_TW: Catalase 恆定存在於過氧化體基質中，可將過氧化氫（過氧化物體氧化酶反應產生的毒性副產物）分解為水與氧（2 H2O2 -> 2 H2O + O2）。這使過氧化物體成為細胞解毒活性氧族群的核心場所。

label: methylates
context: Catechol-O-methyltransferase (COMT) is a primary enzyme in catecholamine metabolism that methylates one of the catechol hydroxyl groups of epinephrine, converting it to metanephrine using S-adenosylmethionine as the methyl donor. COMT-mediated methylation is one of the two dominant routes for terminating adrenaline signaling and preparing it for excretion, alongside MAO-mediated oxidative deamination. Because COMT clears adrenaline rapidly, the oxidation of epinephrine to adrenochrome remains a minor side pathway under normal conditions. Inhibiting COMT raises catecholamine levels and can shift a greater proportion of epinephrine toward oxidative conversion to adrenochrome.
context_zh_TW: Catechol-O-methyltransferase（COMT）是兒茶酚胺代謝中的主要酶，它甲基化 epinephrine 的其中一個兒茶酚羥基，使用 S-adenosylmethionine 作為甲基供體將其轉化為 metanephrine。COMT 介導的甲基化是終止 adrenaline 訊號並為其排泄做準備的兩大主要途徑之一，與 MAO 介導的氧化脫胺並行。由於 COMT 迅速清除 adrenaline，epinephrine 氧化為 adrenochrome 在正常條件下仍是次要的旁路。抑制 COMT 會升高兒茶酚胺濃度，並可使更大比例的 epinephrine 轉向氧化轉化為 adrenochrome。

label: uses
context: Catechol-O-methyltransferase (COMT) methylates the catechol ring of catecholamines using S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) as the methyl donor. In this reaction SAM transfers a methyl group to one of the adjacent hydroxyl groups of epinephrine, producing metanephrine and S-adenosylhomocysteine. COMT-mediated methylation is one of the dominant routes for terminating adrenaline and dopamine signaling. COMT inhibition can raise SAM levels while MAO inhibition may lower them, and the balance of these effects depends on the specific inhibitors used. This methylation pathway keeps adrenochrome formation a minor route under normal metabolic conditions.
context_zh_TW: Catechol-O-methyltransferase（COMT）使用 S-adenosylmethionine（SAM）作為甲基供體，甲基化兒茶酚胺的兒茶酚環。在此反應中，SAM 將一個甲基轉移至 epinephrine 的相鄰羥基之一，產生 metanephrine 與 S-adenosylhomocysteine。COMT 介導的甲基化是終止 adrenaline 與多巴胺訊號的主要途徑之一。COMT 抑制可升高 SAM 濃度，而 MAO 抑制可能降低之，這些效應的平衡取決於所使用的特定抑制劑。此甲基化途徑在正常代謝條件下使 adrenochrome 形成維持為次要路線。

label: bidirectionally_linked_with
context: Catecholamines and Dopamine are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Catecholamines and Dopamine may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
context_zh_TW: Catecholamines 和 Dopamine 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Catecholamines 和 Dopamine 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: are_metabolized_by
context: Catechols are the primary substrates for COMT (catechol-O-methyltransferase), which transfers a methyl group from SAMe to one hydroxyl of the catechol ring to yield a less reactive, more excretable O-methylated metabolite. This O-methylation is a major inactivation and detoxification route in the liver and brain for endogenous catecholamines and exogenous catechol compounds. Because COMT activity is genetically variable via the Val158Met polymorphism, the rate of catechol clearance differs across individuals.
context_zh_TW: Catechols 是 COMT（兒茶酚-O-甲基轉移酶）的主要受質，該酶將甲基從 SAMe 轉移至兒茶酚環上的一個羥基，產生反應性較低、更容易排泄的 O-甲基化代謝物。此 O-甲基化是肝臟和 brain 中內源性兒茶酚胺和外源性兒茶酚化合物代謝與解毒的主要途徑。由於 COMT activity 會因 Val158Met 多態性而具有遺傳變異，因此不同個體間兒茶酚清除速率有所差異。

label: include
context: Catechols include the catecholamine neurotransmitters dopamine, epinephrine, and norepinephrine, which are the body's principal sympathoadrenergic messengers. Each of these is in part terminated by COMT-mediated O-methylation to metanephrines and normetanephrines. This makes the catechol class central to both endogenous signaling and xenobiotic metabolism.
context_zh_TW: Catechols 包含兒茶酚胺神經傳導物質多巴胺、腎上腺素和去甲腎上腺素，它們是人體主要的交感腎上腺能訊息傳遞者。每一種都部分透過 COMT 介導的 O-甲基化終止為間甲腎上腺素和去甲變腎上腺素。這使得兒茶酚類在內源性訊號傳導和異生物質代謝中都至關重要。

label: bidirectionally_linked_with
context: Caudate Nucleus and Nigrostriatal System are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Caudate Nucleus and Nigrostriatal System may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
context_zh_TW: Caudate Nucleus 和 Nigrostriatal System 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Caudate Nucleus 和 Nigrostriatal System 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: controls
context: CeTOR, the C. elegans ortholog of mTOR, controls HLH-30 at the transcriptional level; inactivation of CeTOR induces hlh-30 expression, increasing the abundance of the master degradative transcription factor. This upstream control parallels mammalian mTORC1's post-translational repression of TFEB, adding a transcriptional layer in worms. By inducing HLH-30, CeTOR inhibition engages the full lysosomal-autophagic and lipolytic program. The relationship confirms mTOR as an evolutionarily conserved suppressor of the TFEB/HLH-30 axis.
context_zh_TW: CeTOR（線蟲的 mTOR 同源物）在轉錄層次控制 HLH-30；CeTOR 失活會誘發 hlh-30 表現，增加這個主降解轉錄因子的豐度。此上游控制類似於哺乳動物 mTORC1 對 TFEB 的轉譯後抑制，在線蟲中增添了轉錄層次。透過誘發 HLH-30，CeTOR 抑制啟動了完整的溶酶體—自噬性和脂解性程序。此關係確認了 mTOR 是 TFEB/HLH-30 軸演化上保守的抑制者。

label: erases
context: Cellular reprogramming erases somatic DNA methylation and other epigenetic marks to reset the cell to a pluripotent state. During iPSC generation, the Yamanaka factors promote active and passive demethylation of pluripotency gene promoters while somatic gene methylation is lost, and this global epigenetic reset is required for establishing the pluripotency gene network. The erasure of DNA methylation is a defining feature of the stochastic and deterministic phases of reprogramming. This epigenetic reset is what enables a differentiated cell to regain full developmental potential.
context_zh_TW: 細胞重編程會消除體細胞 DNA 甲基化和其他表觀遺傳標記，從而將細胞重置為多能狀態。在 iPSC 生成過程中，山中因子促進多能性基因啟動子主動和被動去甲基化，同時體細胞基因甲基化丟失，這種全局表觀遺傳重置是建立多能性基因網絡所必需的。 DNA 甲基化的消除是重編程隨機階段和確定性階段的決定性特徵。這種表觀遺傳重置使分化細胞能夠重新獲得全部發育潛力。

label: requires
context: Cellular reprogramming is fundamentally an epigenetic remodeling process that erases somatic memory and installs a new cellular identity. Reprogramming requires global erasure of somatic DNA methylation, reconfiguration of histone marks, and resetting of the chromatin landscape at pluripotency loci, driven by pioneer factors and chromatin remodelers. The process proceeds through defined phases, including a mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition, and culminates in the establishment of a stable pluripotent state in induced pluripotent stem cells.
context_zh_TW: 細胞重編程從根本上來說是一種表觀遺傳重塑過程，它會消除體細胞記憶並安裝新的細胞身份。重編程需要在先鋒因子和染色質重塑因子的驅動下，全面消除體細胞 DNA 甲基化、重新配置組蛋白標記以及重置多能性位點的染色質景觀。這個過程經歷確定的階段，包括間質到上皮的轉變，並最終在誘導多能幹細胞中建立穩定的多能狀態。

label: characterized_by
context: Cellular senescence is characterized by the SASP, the secretion of a complex mixture of pro-inflammatory cytokines, chemokines, growth factors, and proteases. Together with irreversible cell cycle arrest and the formation of senescence-associated heterochromatin foci, the SASP defines the senescent phenotype and mediates its effects on the tissue environment. The SASP is a double-edged sword, promoting tumor surveillance and wound healing when acute but driving inflammation and tissue dysfunction when senescent cells accumulate.
context_zh_TW: 細胞老化的特徵是 SASP，即促發炎細胞因子、趨化因子、生長因子和蛋白酶的複雜混合物的分泌。與不可逆的細胞週期停滯和衰老相關異染色質灶的形成一起，SASP 定義了衰老表型並介導其對組織環境的影響。 SASP 是一把雙面刃，在急性時促進腫瘤監測和傷口癒合，但在老化細胞累積時引發發炎和組織功能障礙。

label: confer_resistance_to
context: Centenarian SIRT6 variants ameliorate multiple aging phenotypes in progerin-expressing hMSCs, including higher Ki67, reduced SA-β-gal, decreased p16/p21, reduced IL-6, and increased Lamin B1. Directionally, CentSIRT6 sits upstream of progerin-stress resistance. This shows the variant buffers premature-aging pathology and ties SIRT6 to laminopathy resilience. By maintaining proliferation, reducing senescence markers, and lowering inflammatory output in progerin-stressed cells, the variants counteract key features of Hutchinson-Gilford progeria. These findings support SIRT6-boosting strategies for laminopathy and related premature-aging conditions.
context_zh_TW: 百歲人瑞 SIRT6 變異體改善了表達 progerin 的 hMSC 的多種衰老表型，包括較高的 Ki67、較低的 SA-β-gal、減少的 p16/p21、降低的 IL-6 和增加的 Lamin B1。在方向性上，CentSIRT6 位於抗 progerin 壓力的上游。這表明變異體緩衝早衰病理並將 SIRT6 與核纖層蛋白病抗性聯繫起來。透過在 progerin 壓力下的細胞中維護增殖、減少衰老標誌物和降低發炎輸出，變異體對抗了 Hutchinson-Gilford 早衰症的關鍵特徵。這些發現支持提升 SIRT6 的策略用於核纖層蛋白病和相關早衰疾病。

label: elevate
context: Centenarian-associated SIRT6 variants (N308K/A313S) elevate endogenous SIRT6 protein through a weakened interaction with vimentin, independent of mRNA changes. Directionally, the variant reduces vimentin binding, which raises SIRT6. This suggests protein stability, not expression, drives the longevity phenotype, and it links a human genetic finding to SIRT6 abundance. By escaping vimentin-mediated degradation, variant SIRT6 accumulates to higher levels in cells. This mechanism explains how a subtle coding change can increase SIRT6 output and is consistent with the variants' association with exceptional longevity.
context_zh_TW: 與百歲人瑞相關的 SIRT6 變異體（N308K/A313S）透過與 vimentin 的弱化相互作用（獨立於 mRNA 變化）提高內源性 SIRT6 蛋白水平。在方向性上，變異體減少 vimentin 結合，從而提高 SIRT6。這表明蛋白穩定性（而非表達）驅動長壽表型，並將人類遺傳學發現與 SIRT6 豐度聯繫起來。透過逃避 vimentin 介導的降解，變異體 SIRT6 在細胞中積累到更高水平。此機制解釋了微妙的編碼變化如何能增加 SIRT6 產出，與該變異體和非凡長壽的關聯一致。

label: has_types
context: Chaperone-mediated autophagy (CMA) is a selective form of lysosomal degradation in which individual soluble cytosolic proteins bearing a pentapeptide KFERQ-like targeting motif are recognized by the cytosolic chaperone HSC70. The substrate-chaperone complex is then delivered to the lysosomal membrane, where the receptor LAMP-2A monomers translocate the unfolded substrate across the membrane into the lumen for degradation. Unlike macro- and microautophagy, CMA degrades one protein at a time and does not require membrane engulfment or autophagosome formation. CMA activity declines with age and is implicated in neurodegeneration and cancer, and it is subject to regulation by mTORC2 and other signaling nodes.
context_zh_TW: 伴護蛋白介導的自噬（CMA）是一種選擇性的溶酶體降解形式，其中帶有五肽KFERQ樣標靶基序的個別可溶性細胞質蛋白被細胞質伴護蛋白HSC70辨識。隨後受質—伴護蛋白複合體被遞送至溶酶體膜，由受體LAMP-2A單體將未折疊的受質跨膜轉運至腔內進行降解。不同於巨自噬和微自噬，CMA一次降解一個蛋白質，且不需要膜吞噬或自噬體形成。CMA活性隨年齡下降，並與神經退化和癌症有關，且受mTORC2和其他訊號節點的調控。

label: bidirectionally_linked_with
context: Chemical memory and Synaptic plasticity are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Chemical memory and Synaptic plasticity may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
context_zh_TW: Chemical memory 和 Synaptic plasticity 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Chemical memory 和 Synaptic plasticity 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: is_oxidized_by
context: Cholesterol is oxidized by reactive oxygen species through non-enzymatic chemistry that yields more than 30 oxysterol species. These oxidized products have distinct biological activities compared with native cholesterol. The directionality is ROS to sterol oxidation. A caveat is that many oxysterols are also formed enzymatically by cytochrome P450s, so not all oxysterols indicate oxidative stress. Examples include 7-ketocholesterol and 7beta-hydroxycholesterol, which are cytotoxic and pro-inflammatory and accumulate in atherosclerotic plaques and oxidized LDL.
context_zh_TW: Cholesterol 被 reactive oxygen species 經由非酵素化學氧化，產生 30 多種氧甾醇。這些氧化產物與天然cholesterol相比具有明顯的生物活性。方向性是ROS至甾醇氧化。需要注意的是，許多 oxysterols 也是由細胞色素 P450 酶促形成的，因此並非所有 oxysterols 都表示 oxidative stress。例子包括7-ketocholesterol和7β-羥基cholesterol，它們具有細胞毒性和促炎性，並在atheros硬化斑塊和oxidized LDL中積聚。

label: produce
context: Chromaffin cells of the adrenal medulla produce and store epinephrine (adrenaline), the hormone whose oxidation generates adrenochrome. This is the classic biological source of adrenochrome, noted since the 19th century when extracts from suprarenal (adrenal) glands turned reddish due to oxidation of the catecholamine upon exposure to air or oxidants. Oxidation of epinephrine can form adrenochrome in these cells upon release or exposure to oxidants, and the same chemistry occurs wherever epinephrine is present and oxidized, including sympathetic nerve endings, endothelial cells, and inflamed tissues.
context_zh_TW: Chromaffin cells of the adrenal medulla produce and store epinephrine (adrenaline), the hormone whose oxidation generates adrenochrome。This is the classic biological source of adrenochrome, noted since the 19th century when extracts from suprarenal (adrenal) glands turned reddish due to oxidation of the catecholamine upon exposure to air or oxidants。Oxidation of epinephrine can form adrenochrome in these cells upon release or exposure to oxidants, and the same chemistry occurs wherever epinephrine is present and oxidized, including sympathetic nerve endings, endothelial cells, and inflamed tissues。

label: composed_of
context: Chromatin is composed of nucleosomes, the repeating structural units that package the genome within the nucleus. Each nucleosome consists of a histone octamer, with two copies each of H2A, H2B, H3, and H4, wrapped by approximately 147 base pairs of DNA. Nucleosomes are arranged along the DNA in a beads-on-a-string fashion and further compact into higher-order fibers, with their positioning and modification determining whether underlying DNA is accessible for transcription, replication, and repair.
context_zh_TW: Chromatin 由核小體組成，核小體是將基因組包裝在細胞核內的重複結構單元。每個核小體由一個組蛋白八聚體組成，其中 H2A、H2B、H3 和 H4 各有兩個拷貝，由大約 147 個鹼基對的 DNA 包裹。核小體以串珠的方式沿著 DNA 排列，並進一步壓縮成高級纖維，其定位和修飾決定了底層 DNA 是否可用於轉錄、複製和修復。

label: relocalize_to
context: Chromatin modifiers including sirtuins like SIRT1 and SIRT6, as well as HDAC1 and PARP1, normally sit at specific genomic loci to maintain proper gene expression patterns that define cell identity. When DNA damage, especially double-strand breaks, occurs, these proteins are recruited to damage sites to assist in repair. This temporarily disrupts their original positions, altering local gene expression, and repeated relocalization over a lifetime contributes to the progressive loss of epigenetic information.
context_zh_TW: 包括 SIRT1 和 SIRT6 等 sirtuins 在內的染色質修飾因子，以及 HDAC1 和 PARP1，通常位於特定的基因組位點以維持定義細胞身分的正確基因表達模式。當 DNA 損傷（特別是雙股斷裂）發生時，這些蛋白質被招募到損傷位點以協助修復。這暫時破壞了它們的原始位置，改變局部基因表達，而在一生中反覆的再定位則導致表觀遺傳資訊的漸進性喪失。

label: is_suppressed_by
context: Chronic hyperglycemia suppresses SIRT3 expression in the hippocampus, contributing to cognitive deficits through mitochondrial Ca2+ overload and neuronal apoptosis. SIRT3 is also consistently downregulated in clinical diabetic tissues, where its deficiency correlates with insulin resistance, and in skeletal muscle its deficiency impairs insulin-stimulated glucose translocation, aggravating peripheral insulin resistance in type 2 diabetes.
context_zh_TW: 慢性高血糖抑制海馬體中的 SIRT3 表現，透過粒線體 Ca2+ 超載和神經元凋亡導致認知缺陷。SIRT3 在臨床糖尿病組織中也持續被下調，其缺乏與胰島素阻抗相關，在骨骼肌中其缺乏損害胰島素刺激的葡萄糖轉運，加重第 2 型糖尿病的周邊胰島素阻抗。

label: inhibits
context: Chronic hyperglycemia suppresses SIRT3 expression in the hippocampus, contributing to cognitive deficits through mitochondrial Ca2+ overload and neuronal apoptosis. SIRT3 overexpression mitigates neuronal injury by inhibiting the VDAC1/GRP75/IP3R complex, thereby reducing mitochondria-associated endoplasmic reticulum membrane (MAM) formation and protecting neurons from metabolic stress-induced apoptosis in diabetic encephalopathy.
context_zh_TW: 慢性高血糖抑制海馬體中的 SIRT3 表現，透過粒線體 Ca2+ 超載和神經元凋亡導致認知缺陷。SIRT3 的過量表現透過抑制 VDAC1/GRP75/IP3R 複合物減輕神經元損傷，從而減少粒線體相關內質網膜（MAM）形成，保護神經元免受代謝壓力誘導的凋亡，在糖尿病腦病變中發揮保護作用。

label: is_characterized_by
context: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease is characterized by persistent airway inflammation and poorly reversible airflow limitation driven by neutrophilic and macrophage inflammation. Oxidant-antioxidant imbalance in the lungs fuels this chronic inflammatory state. The directionality is inflammatory airway disease to oxidative burden. A caveat is that COPD heterogeneity means not all patients show the same oxidant signature, and smoking-independent forms exist. This inflammation is sustained by an oxidant-antioxidant imbalance that inactivates antiproteases and perpetuates tissue destruction.
context_zh_TW: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease 的特徵是持續的 airway inflammation 和由中性粒細胞和巨噬細胞發炎驅動的可逆性差的氣流受限。肺部的氧化劑-抗氧化劑失衡加劇了這種慢性發炎狀態。方向性是發炎性氣道疾病對氧化負擔的影響。需要注意的是，COPD 異質性意味著並非所有患者都表現出相同的氧化劑特徵，並且存在 smoking 獨立形式。這種發炎是由氧化劑-抗氧化劑失衡所維持的，這種失衡會使抗蛋白酶失去活性並使組織破壞永久化。

label: contains
context: Cigarette smoke contains free radicals, including semiquinone radicals, hydroxyl radicals, and nitric oxide, plus a large burden of gaseous and particulate oxidants. These directly and indirectly raise lung oxidant load. The directionality is smoke-derived radicals to tissue oxidation. A caveat is that the tar-phase semiquinones can redox-cycle and generate sustained ROS long after exposure, so the effect outlasts the inhaled puff. Both the gas phase and tar phase carry oxidants, and the balance between oxidant load and lung antioxidant capacity determines tissue damage.
context_zh_TW: Cigarette smoke 包含 free radicals，包括半醌自由基、hydroxyl radicals 和 nitric oxide，以及大量氣態和顆粒氧化劑。這些直接和間接地增加了肺的氧化負荷。方向性是煙霧衍生的自由基對組織的氧化。需要注意的是，焦油相半醌在暴露後很長一段時間內可以進行氧化還原循環並產生持續的 ROS，因此其效果比吸入的煙霧更持久。氣相和焦油相均攜帶氧化劑，氧化劑負荷與肺抗氧化能力之間的平衡決定了組織損傷。

label: increases
context: Cigarette, cigar, and wood smoke contain enormous amounts of free radicals and oxidants (cigarette smoke alone carries on the order of 10^17 oxidant molecules per puff). These external oxidants directly increase reactive oxygen species, deplete antioxidants such as vitamin C and glutathione, and cause systemic oxidative stress. Smoke also activates sympathetic nervous system responses and inflammation, further raising endogenous ROS production. This oxidative environment promotes the oxidation of adrenaline to adrenochrome and supports the redox cycle by which adrenochrome generates more superoxide, linking smoking to increased catecholamine oxidation and oxidative damage.
context_zh_TW: 香菸、雪茄與木柴煙霧含有大量自由基與氧化劑（單是香菸煙霧每口就帶有約 10^17 個氧化劑分子）。這些外部氧化劑直接增加活性氧物種、耗竭維生素 C 與麩胱甘肽等抗氧化劑，並造成全身性氧化壓力。煙霧也活化交感神經系統反應與發炎，進一步升高內源性 ROS 生成。此氧化環境促進 adrenaline 氧化為 adrenochrome，並支持 adrenochrome 藉以產生更多超氧陰離子的氧化還原循環，將吸菸與增加的兒茶酚胺氧化及氧化損傷連結起來。

label: induces
context: Cisplatin induces premature senescence via DNA intrastrand cross-links. Mechanism involves p53-p21 pathway activation and ROS-dependent signaling.
context_zh_TW: Cisplatin 透過 DNA 鏈內交聯誘發早衰。其機制涉及 p53-p21 路徑活化與 ROS 依賴的訊號傳遞。

label: efficacy_enhanced_by
context: Cisplatin is a platinum-based chemotherapeutic whose efficacy is augmented when combined with intermittent fasting in both cellular and animal models. Fasting generates a differential stress resistance in which normal cells enter a protective, autophagy-dependent quiescent state while many tumor cells remain vulnerable to platinum-DNA adduct formation. The improved therapeutic window reduces chemotherapy-associated toxicity while slowing tumor growth, suggesting a combinatorial strategy. These findings support IF as an adjunct to sensitize tumors and protect host tissue during cisplatin-based regimens.
context_zh_TW: Cisplatin是一種鉑類化療藥，在細胞和動物模型中與間歇性斷食合併使用時其療效增強。斷食產生一種差異性壓力抵抗，其中正常細胞進入保護性的、依賴自噬的靜止狀態，而許多腫瘤細胞仍易受鉑—DNA加合物形成的影響。改善的治療窗口在減緩腫瘤生長的同時降低化療相關毒性，提示一種組合策略。這些發現支持將IF作為輔助手段，在以cisplatin為基礎的療程中增敏腫瘤並保護宿主組織。

label: is_approved_for
context: Clofarabine received FDA accelerated approval in December 2004 for pediatric patients (ages 1-21) with relapsed or refractory acute lymphoblastic leukemia after at least two prior regimens. It was the first new drug approved for pediatric leukemia in over a decade.
context_zh_TW: Clofarabine 於 2004 年 12 月獲得 FDA 加速核准，用於至少接受過兩種先前療程後復發或難治型急性淋巴性白血病的兒童患者（1-21 歲）。它是十多年來第一個獲核准用於兒童白血病的藥物。

label: inhibits
context: Clofarabine's diphosphate inhibits ribonucleotide reductase (IC50 about 65 nM), depleting dNTP pools and further starving DNA synthesis. This direct RNR inhibition is complemented by DNA polymerase inhibition and chain termination by the incorporated triphosphate.
context_zh_TW: Clofarabine 的二磷酸形式抑制核醣核苷酸還原酶（IC50 約 65 nM），耗竭 dNTP 池並進一步使 DNA 合成匱乏。此直接的 RNR 抑制與嵌入的三磷酸所造成的 DNA 聚合酶抑制及鏈終止相互補。

label: binds
context: Co-crystallization of suramin with human SIRT5 revealed that suramin binds by occupying the nicotinamide ribose pocket (B-pocket), the nicotinamide pocket (C-pocket), and part of the substrate-binding site. This structural insight explains suramin's broad, high-affinity inhibition of multiple sirtuins and informed the design of more selective derivatives such as NF675. Directionally, suramin is the ligand and the SIRT5 catalytic cleft the receptor. The structure also illustrates general principles governing small-molecule engagement of the sirtuin NAD+/substrate channel.
context_zh_TW: Suramin 與人類 SIRT5 的共晶體結構揭示 Suramin 透過占据尼可醯胺核糖口袋（B 口袋）、尼可醯胺口袋（C 口袋）和部分受質結合位點進行結合。此結構見解解釋了 Suramin 對多種 sirtuin 的廣泛高親和力抑制作用，並為設計更具選擇性的衍生物如 NF675 提供了依據。方向性上 Suramin 是配體，SIRT5 催化溝槽是受體。此結構也闡明了小分子與 sirtuin NAD+/受質通道結合的一般原則。

label: are_preserved_by
context: Cochlear hair cells are mechanosensory receptors that cannot regenerate once lost. Under caloric restriction, SIRT3-driven IDH2 activation boosts mitochondrial NADPH and ROS clearance, preserving cochlear hair cell integrity — protection completely lost in SIRT3-deficient mice.
context_zh_TW: 耳蝸毛細胞是機械感測受體，一旦喪失無法再生。在熱量限制下，SIRT3 驅動的 IDH2 活化促進粒線體 NADPH 和活性氧清除，維護耳蝸毛細胞完整性——這種保護在 SIRT3 缺陷小鼠中完全喪失。

label: protects_against
context: Coenzyme Q10 protects against lipid peroxidation because ubiquinol reduces lipid peroxyl radicals in the bilayer, terminating chain reactions similarly to vitamin E. Its high concentration in membranes makes it a front-line chain breaker. The directionality is reduced CoQ10 to peroxyl radical termination. A caveat is that ubiquinol is rapidly consumed and must be regenerated enzymatically, so its protective capacity depends on the redox state of the CoQ pool. CoQ10 levels decline with age and in some pathologies, and supplementation is often used to restore membrane redox protection.
context_zh_TW: Coenzyme Q10 可防止 lipid peroxidation，因為泛醇可減少雙層中的脂質過氧自由基，從而終止與 vitamin E 類似的鍊式反應。它在膜中的高濃度使其成為一線的鏈條破壞者。方向性是 CoQ10 還原為過氧自由基終止。需要注意的是，泛醇會迅速消耗，必須透過酵素再生，因此其保護能力取決於 CoQ 池的氧化還原狀態。 CoQ10 水平隨著年齡的增長和某些疾病而下降，補充通常用於恢復膜的氧化還原保護。

label: reduces
context: Coenzyme Q10 reduces heart-failure morbidity and mortality, as suggested by the Q-SYMBIO trial showing a substantial reduction in major adverse cardiovascular events with supplementation in chronic heart failure. Its benefit is attributed to improved mitochondrial bioenergetics and reduced oxidative stress. The directionality is supplementation to improved cardiac outcomes. A caveat is that trial results are mixed and effect sizes vary, so CoQ10 is adjunctive rather than replacement therapy. Improved mitochondrial ATP production and endothelial function are also invoked to explain the cardiac benefit, though larger confirmatory trials are still needed.
context_zh_TW: Q-SYMBIO 試驗表明，Coenzyme Q10 可以降低心臟衰竭的發病率和死亡率，該試驗顯示，補充慢性 heart failure 後，主要不良反應 cardiovascular events 大幅減少。其益處歸因於改進的mitochondria1生物能學和減少的oxidative stress。方向性是改善心臟結果的補充。需要注意的是，試驗結果參差不齊，效果大小也各不相同，因此 CoQ10 是輔助療法，而不是替代療法。儘管仍需要更大規模的驗證性試驗，但改善的mitochondria1 ATP產生和內皮功能也被用來解釋心臟益處。

label: regenerates
context: Coenzyme Q10 regenerates vitamin E by reducing the alpha-tocopheroxyl radical back to alpha-tocopherol, extending the chain-breaking lifetime of vitamin E in membranes. This places CoQ10 upstream of vitamin E in the antioxidant network. The directionality is ubiquinol to tocopherol recycling. A caveat is that this regeneration competes with CoQ10's own peroxyl-radical scavenging, and the net effect depends on local ratios. The recycling interaction places CoQ10 and vitamin E as partners in a lipid-phase antioxidant network that also involves vitamin C at the membrane interface.
context_zh_TW: Coenzyme Q10 透過將 α-生育酚自由基還原回 α-生育醇來再生 vitamin E，從而延長了 vitamin E 在膜中的斷鏈壽命。這使得 CoQ10 在抗氧化網路中位於 vitamin E 的上游。方向性是泛醇到生育醇的回收。需要注意的是，這種再生與 CoQ10 自身的過氧自由基清除作用相競爭，淨效應取決於局部比率。這種回收相互作用將 CoQ10 和 vitamin E 作為脂相抗氧化網絡中的合作夥伴，該網絡還涉及膜界面上的維生素 C。

label: transfers_electrons_between
context: Coenzyme Q10 transfers electrons between mitochondrial Complex I (or II) and Complex III as a mobile lipophilic carrier in the inner membrane, shuttling single electrons and buffering the pool. In its reduced form (ubiquinol) it also acts as an antioxidant. The directionality is electron transport coupled to redox buffering. A caveat is that CoQ10's electron-transfer role is distinct from its antioxidant role, and statin-mediated depletion can affect both. CoQ10 is synthesized endogenously via the mevalonate pathway and is also a potent lipophilic antioxidant in both its ubiquinol and ubiquinone forms.
context_zh_TW: Coenzyme Q10 作為內膜中的移動親脂載體在 mitochondrial Complex I（或 II）和複合物 III 之間轉移電子，穿梭單一電子並緩衝池。其還原形式（泛醇）也可作為抗氧化劑。方向性是與氧化還原緩衝耦合的電子傳遞。需要注意的是，CoQ10 的電子轉移作用與其抗氧化作用不同，而他汀類藥物介導的耗竭會影響這兩者。 CoQ10 透過甲羥戊酸途徑內源合成，其泛醇和泛醌形式也是一種有效的親脂性抗氧化劑。

label: induced_by
context: Cold exposure induces SIRT3 in brown adipose tissue, where it promotes expression of mitochondrial genes and supports thermogenic programs. The induction enhances oxidative metabolism and uncoupled respiration needed for heat production, with SIRT3 acting upstream of UCP1-dependent thermogenesis. Directionally, a cold stimulus triggers SIRT3 upregulation, which in turn drives thermogenic mitochondrial biogenesis. This ties SIRT3 to adaptive thermogenesis and the metabolic benefits of cold exposure, and conversely SIRT3 is reduced in brown adipose tissue of obese mice, linking obesity to impaired thermogenic capacity and blunted cold-induced mitochondrial function.
context_zh_TW: 冷暴露在棕色脂肪組織中誘導 SIRT3，促進粒線體基因表達並支持產熱程序。這種誘導增強了產生熱量所需的氧化代謝和解偶聯呼吸，SIRT3 在 UCP1 依賴性產熱的上游作用。在方向性上，冷刺激觸發 SIRT3 上調，進而驅動產熱性粒線體生物合成。這將 SIRT3 與適應性產熱和冷暴露的代謝益處聯繫起來，相反，肥胖小鼠棕色脂肪組織中 SIRT3 減少，將肥胖與受損的產熱能力和遲鈍的冷誘導粒線體功能聯繫起來。

label: is_a_type_of
context: Colon cancer is a malignancy of the large intestine (colon) and represents a major subset of colorectal cancer. It is the third most commonly diagnosed cancer worldwide. Colon cancer shares the colorectal continuum with rectal cancer but is managed distinctly.
context_zh_TW: 結腸癌是大腸（結腸）的惡性腫瘤，代表結直腸癌的一個主要亞群。它是全球第三大最常被診斷的癌症。結腸癌與直腸癌共享結直腸連續體，但治療方式不同。

label: accelerates
context: Compared to healthy cells, SIRT6 overexpression significantly accelerates apoptosis in tumour cells. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of tumour cell death, preferentially killing cancer cells while sparing healthy cells. This tumour-selective pro-apoptotic activity supports SIRT6 activation as a potential therapeutic strategy against cancers that retain SIRT6 expression.
context_zh_TW: 與健康細胞相比，SIRT6過表達顯著加速腫瘤細胞的凋亡。方向上，SIRT6位於腫瘤細胞死亡的上游，優先殺傷癌細胞同時保護健康細胞。這種腫瘤選擇性的促凋亡活性支持SIRT6活化作為對抗保留SIRT6表達的癌症的潛在治療策略。

label: have_reduced_activity_in
context: Complex I and Complex IV have reduced activity in multiple sclerosis, and the resulting electron leakage increases superoxide generation in affected CNS tissue. This bioenergetic defect is observed in lesions and normal-appearing white matter. The directionality is enzyme deficiency to increased mitochondrial ROS. A caveat is that reduced activity may be secondary to inflammation and demyelination as well as a primary driver, so causality is bidirectional. These defects are most pronounced in chronically demyelinated tissue and correlate with axonal loss and disability progression.
context_zh_TW: Complex I and Complex IV 降低了 multiple sclerosis 的活性，由此产生的电子泄漏增加了受影响中枢神经系统组织中超氧化物的生成。这种生物能缺陷在病变和正常的白质中观察到。方向性是酵素缺乏導致mitochondrial ROS增加。需要注意的是，活动减少可能是炎症和脱髓鞘的继发因素，也是主要驱动因素，因此因果关系是双向的。这些缺陷在慢性脱髓鞘组织中最为明显，并与轴突损失和残疾进展相关。

label: bidirectionally_linked_with
context: Complex I and Mitochondrial Dysfunction are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Complex I and Mitochondrial Dysfunction may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
context_zh_TW: Complex I 和 Mitochondrial Dysfunction 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Complex I 和 Mitochondrial Dysfunction 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: impairs
context: Complex I impairs Mitochondrial Dysfunction when its deficiency or dysfunction weakens the target pathway. Mechanistically, reduced flux through the impaired system permits aggregate and organelle buildup that drives degeneration. This is significant because impairment of degradative or energetic pathways is a core feature of Parkinson's disease pathogenesis. A caveat is that the phrasing can be misread; it is the loss or dysfunction of the first entity that is harmful, and excessive activity can also be detrimental.
context_zh_TW: 當 Complex I 的缺陷或功能障礙削弱目標途徑時，Complex I 就會損害 Mitochondrial Dysfunction。從機制上講，通過受損系統的通量減少會導致聚集體和細胞器積聚，從而導致退化。這很重要，因為降解或能量途徑的損害是 Parkinson's disease 發病機制的核心特徵。需要注意的是，措辭可能會被誤讀。第一個實體的喪失或功能障礙是有害的，過度的活動也可能是有害的。

label: regenerates
context: Creatine kinase (CK) is the enzyme at the core of the creatine/phosphocreatine energy system. It catalyzes the reversible transfer of a phosphate group between creatine and ADP, using the free energy released from phosphocreatine breakdown (approximately 10.3 kcal) to resynthesize ATP from ADP and inorganic phosphate. This provides a rapid means of replenishing depleted ATP during high-energy-demand states such as intense exercise or conditions where energy production is impaired (ischemia, hypoxia) or insufficient due to increased demand (mental fatigue, disease states). Cytosolic, glycolytic, and mitochondrial CK isoforms cooperate to buffer ATP/ADP ratios and shuttle high-energy phosphate from mitochondria to sites of ATP consumption.
context_zh_TW: 肌酸激酶（CK）是肌酸/磷酸肌酸能量系統核心的酶。它催化磷酸基團在肌酸與 ADP 之間的可逆轉移，利用磷酸肌酸分解所釋放的自由能（約 10.3 千卡），從 ADP 與無機磷酸再合成 ATP。這提供了在高能量需求狀態下快速補充耗竭 ATP 的手段，例如劇烈運動，或能量產生受損（缺血、缺氧）或因需求增加而不足（精神疲勞、疾病狀態）的情況。細胞質、糖解與粒線體 CK 異構型協同作用，以緩衝 ATP/ADP 比值，並將高能磷酸從粒線體穿梭至 ATP 消耗的位置。

label: activates
context: Cyanidin, a natural anthocyanidin from red berries, increases SIRT6 activity by over 50-fold in certain in vitro assays, making it one of the most powerful natural SIRT6 activators identified. Directionally, cyanidin sits upstream of SIRT6 stimulation. Its potency suggests strong binding to the SIRT6 activation pocket, and it is particularly abundant in elderberries, which provide roughly 350-450 mg of cyanidin-3-glucoside per 100 g of fresh fruit. This links berry polyphenols to SIRT6-dependent metabolic and anti-aging effects, and positions dietary anthocyanins as a practical means of engaging SIRT6 biology.
context_zh_TW: 花青素（Cyanidin）是一種來自紅色漿果的天然花青素，在某些體外試驗中將 SIRT6 活性提高 50 倍以上，使其成為已鑑定的最強效天然 SIRT6 活化因子之一。在方向性上，花青素位於 SIRT6 刺激的上游。其效力表明與 SIRT6 活化口袋的強結合，且在接骨木漿果中特別豐富，每 100 克新鮮水果含有約 350-450 毫克 cyanidin-3-glucoside。這將漿果多酚與 SIRT6 依賴性的代謝和抗衰老效應聯繫起來，並將飲食中的花青素定位為參與 SIRT6 生物學的實際手段。

label: phosphorylates
context: Cyclin-dependent kinases 4 and 6 (CDK4/6), central drivers of G1 cell-cycle progression, phosphorylate TFEB at serine 142 and promote its nuclear export through a CRM1-dependent mechanism. This action sequesters TFEB in the cytoplasm during phases of active proliferation, when degradative programs are downregulated. Conversely, pharmacological CDK4/6 inhibition permits TFEB nuclear retention and enhances lysosome biogenesis and autophagy. The CDK4/6-TFEB link couples cell-cycle state to the metabolic and degradative status of the cell.
context_zh_TW: 細胞週期蛋白依賴型激酶 4 和 6（CDK4/6）是 G1 細胞週期進展的核心驅動者，於 serine 142 磷酸化 TFEB，並透過 CRM1 依賴機制促進其核輸出。此作用在降解程序下調的主動增殖階段，將 TFEB 隔離於細胞質中。相反地，藥理 CDK4/6 抑制允許 TFEB 核保留並增強溶酶體生物發生和自噬。CDK4/6-TFEB 連結將細胞週期狀態耦合到細胞的代謝和降解狀態。

label: activates
context: Cytochrome c released through BAX/BAK-permeabilized mitochondria binds Apaf-1 (apoptotic protease activating factor-1), which together with procaspase-9 assembles the heptameric apoptosome. Within this platform procaspase-9 is activated and in turn cleaves caspase-3, committing the cell to intrinsic apoptosis. The apoptosome is therefore the router that converts mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization into caspase-9 activation, and it is the very complex whose additional components (such as SIRT1 after caspase cleavage) reshape cell fate.
context_zh_TW: 經由 BAX/BAK 通透化的粒線體所釋出的 Cytochrome c 會結合 Apaf-1（凋亡蛋白酶活化因子-1），並與 pro-Caspase-9 共同組裝成七聚體凋亡體（apoptosome）。在此平台上 pro-Caspase-9 被活化，進而切割 Caspase-3，使細胞走向內在凋亡。凋亡體因此是將粒線體外膜通透化轉換為 Caspase-9 活化的路由器，也正是 SIRT1（在 caspase 切割後）重塑細胞命運時所處的複合體。

label: activates
context: Cytoplasmic chromatin fragments activate the cGAS-STING pathway, the innate immune DNA-sensing cascade that links nuclear DNA damage to inflammation. During senescence, ruptures of the nuclear envelope release chromatin into the cytoplasm, where the DNA sensor cGAS binds this self-DNA and activates STING, driving NF-kB-dependent expression of SASP genes. This cGAS-STING signaling through cytoplasmic chromatin is a major mechanism coupling genomic instability to the inflammatory senescent phenotype.
context_zh_TW: 細胞質染色質片段會活化 cGAS-STING 通路，這是一種將核 DNA 損傷與發炎聯繫起來的先天免疫 DNA 感測級聯反應。在老化過程中，核膜的破裂將染色質釋放到細胞質中，其中 DNA 感測器 cGAS 結合這種自身 DNA 並活化 STING，驅動 SASP 基因的 NF-kB 依賴性表達。這種透過細胞質染色質的 cGAS-STING 訊號傳導是將基因組不穩定性與發炎老化表型耦合的主要機制。

label: activates
context: DHM activates AMPK, which synergistically raises NAD+ via NAMPT upregulation and thereby further potentiates SIRT3 activity. Directionally, DHM activates AMPK, which increases NAD+ to boost SIRT3. This dual SIRT3/AMPK engagement amplifies mitochondrial and metabolic defenses, protecting the liver and other tissues from metabolic and oxidative injury. It mirrors the indirect resveratrol cascade, suggesting convergent circuitry among polyphenols, and it illustrates how natural compounds often activate multiple, reinforcing pathways rather than a single target—an important consideration for interpreting their biological effects.
context_zh_TW: DHM 活化 AMPK，AMPK 協同性地通過 NAMPT 上調提高 NAD+，進而進一步增強 SIRT3 活性。在方向性上，DHM 活化 AMPK，AMPK 增加 NAD+ 以提升 SIRT3。這種 SIRT3/AMPK 的雙重參與放大粒線體和代謝防禦，保護肝臟和其他組織免受代謝和氧化損傷。它反映了白藜蘆醇的間接級聯反應，提示多酚之間的趨同電路，並說明天然化合物通常活化多個強化的通路而非單一靶點——這是解釋其生物學效應時的重要考量。

label: activates
context: DISC activates Caspase-8. The death-inducing signaling complex assembles on ligand-bound death receptors and converts procaspase-8/10 into active initiator caspases. Caspase-8 is the initiator caspase of the extrinsic pathway and also gates the intrinsic pathway through Bid cleavage. The relationship is directional, with DISC acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-8 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: DISC 啟動 Caspase-8。死亡誘導訊號複合物在配體結合的死亡受體上組裝，並將 procaspase-8/10 轉化為活性起始 caspase。 Caspase-8 是 Extrinsic Pathway 的起始半胱天冬酶，也透過 Bid 裂解對 Intrinsic Pathway 進行門控。這種關係是有方向的，DISC 充當 Caspase-8 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: is_formed_by
context: DISC is formed by DR4. The death-inducing signaling complex assembles on ligand-bound death receptors and converts procaspase-8/10 into active initiator caspases. DR4 (TRAIL-R1) is a death receptor that binds TRAIL and nucleates the DISC to initiate extrinsic apoptosis. The directionality runs from DR4 toward DISC, so DR4 is the active agent and DISC the recipient of the effect. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context_zh_TW: DISC 由 DR4 組成。死亡誘導訊號複合物在配體結合的死亡受體上組裝，並將 procaspase-8/10 轉化為活性起始 caspase。 DR4 (TRAIL-R1) 是一種死亡受體，可結合 TRAIL 並使 DISC 成核以啟動外源性細胞凋亡。方向性從 DR4 向 DISC，因此 DR4 是活性劑，DISC 是效果的接受者。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: is_formed_by

The directionality runs from DR5 toward DISC, so DR5 is the active agent and DISC the recipient of the effect. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.

label: uses
context: DISC uses FADD. The death-inducing signaling complex assembles on ligand-bound death receptors and converts procaspase-8/10 into active initiator caspases. The relationship is directional, with DISC acting as the operative agent upon FADD rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.

label: detoxifies
context: DJ-1 is a glutathione-independent glyoxalase that stereospecifically detoxifies methylglyoxal into L-lactate, bypassing the glutathione requirement of the canonical glyoxalase system.

label: stabilizes
context: DJ-1 stabilizes Nrf2 by blocking KEAP1, driving GLO1/GLO2 transcription for enhanced dicarbonyl clearance and HO-1/NQO1 for antioxidant defense.
