context: Glutaredoxins use electrons from reduced glutathione (GSH) instead of thioredoxin reductase, passing them through a dithiol or monothiol mechanism to reduce protein disulfides and reverse protein S-glutathionylation. This makes glutaredoxin the GSH-coupled half of the cellular disulfide-reducing system.
context_zh_TW: Glutaredoxin 使用來自還原態麩胱甘肽（GSH）的電子而非硫氧還蛋白還原酶，透過雙硫醇或單硫醇機制還原蛋白質雙硫鍵並逆轉蛋白質的 S-麩胱甘肽化。這使 Glutaredoxin 成為細胞雙硫還原系統中與 GSH 偶聯的一半。

label: determines
context: Glutathione determines T cell polarization because the GSH/GSSG redox state tunes the balance between pro-inflammatory Th1/Th17 and anti-inflammatory Th2/Treg responses. Oxidized extracellular glutathione can itself act as a danger signal influencing differentiation. The directionality is thiol redox to immune phenotype. A caveat is that glutathione is one of several metabolic and cytokine inputs to T-cell fate, so it biases rather than dictates polarization. Redox modulation of T cells is therefore being investigated as an adjunctive target in autoimmunity and chronic inflammation.
context_zh_TW: Glutathione 決定 T cell polarization，因為 GSH/GSSG 氧化還原狀態調節促發炎 Th1/Th17 和抗發炎 Th2/Treg 反應之間的平衡。氧化的細胞外glutathione本身可以作為影響分化的危險訊號。方向性是硫醇氧化還原至免疫表型。需要注意的是，glutathione 是 T 細胞命運的幾種代謝和細胞激素輸入之一，因此它會產生偏見，而不是決定極化。因此，T 細胞的氧化還原調節正在作為自體免疫和慢性發炎的輔助標靶進行研究。

label: is_depleted_in
context: Glutathione is depleted in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, with epithelial lining fluid GSH reduced by 40 to 60 percent, weakening the first-line antioxidant defense of the airways. This depletion impairs detoxification of H2O2 and HOCl. The directionality is disease to lowered thiol buffer. A caveat is that systemic GSH may be maintained or even altered differently, and depletion is most marked in the epithelial fluid compartment. N-acetylcysteine and other GSH precursors have shown modest benefit in reducing exacerbations, supporting the relevance of thiol depletion.
context_zh_TW: chronic obstructive pulmonary disease 中的 Glutathione 被耗盡，上皮內層液 GSH 減少 40% 至 60%，削弱了氣道的一線抗氧化防禦。這種消耗會損害 H2O2 和 HOCl 的解毒作用。方向性是降低硫醇緩衝液的疾病。需要注意的是，全身穀胱甘肽可能會以不同的方式維持甚至改變，並且上皮液室中的消耗最為明顯。 N-乙醯半胱氨酸和其他穀胱甘肽前體在減少病情惡化方面顯示出一定的益處，支持硫醇消耗的相關性。

label: is_a_cofactor_for
context: Glutathione is the reducing cofactor for glutathione peroxidase, being oxidized from GSH to GSSG during the catalytic reduction of hydrogen peroxide and lipid hydroperoxides. Maintenance of a high GSH/GSSG ratio is therefore critical for sustained peroxidase activity and overall redox buffering. The directionality is cofactor consumption driving the antioxidant cycle. A caveat is that glutathione also serves many other roles (conjugation, thiol buffering, immune function), so its depletion has effects beyond peroxidase support.
context_zh_TW: Glutathione 是 glutathione peroxidase 的還原輔助因子，在 hydrogen peroxide 和脂質氫過氧化物的催化還原過程中從 GSH 氧化為 GSSG。因此，維持高 GSH/GSSG 比率對於持續的過氧化物酶活性和整體氧化還原緩衝至關重要。方向性是驅動抗氧化劑循環的輔因子消耗。需要注意的是，glutathione 還具有許多其他作用（結合、硫醇緩衝、免疫功能），因此它的耗盡具有過氧化物酶支持以外的影響。

label: is_complementary_to
context: Glutathione peroxidase is complementary to catalase because the two enzymes remove hydrogen peroxide with different kinetic profiles: GPx has higher affinity (Km approximately 1 to 10 uM) suited to low physiological H2O2, whereas catalase has a higher Vmax suited to burst conditions. Together they cover the dynamic range of intracellular peroxide concentrations. The directionality is cooperative detoxification rather than redundancy alone. A caveat is that peroxiredoxins now appear to handle much of the low-level H2O2 signaling pool, with GPx and catalase managing bulk removal.
context_zh_TW: Glutathione peroxidase 與 catalase 互補，因為這兩種酶以不同的動力學曲線去除 hydrogen peroxide：GPx 具有適合低生理 H2O2 的更高親和力（Km 大約 1 至 10 uM），而 catalase 具有適合突發條件的更高 Vmax。它們共同涵蓋了細胞內過氧化物濃度的動態範圍。方向性是合作解毒，而不是單純的冗餘。需要注意的是，過氧化還原蛋白現在似乎可以處理大部分低水平的 H2O2 訊號池，其中 GPx 和 catalase managing 被大量去除。

label: reduces
context: Glutathione peroxidase reduces hydrogen peroxide to water using reduced glutathione (GSH) as the electron donor, oxidizing two GSH molecules to glutathione disulfide (GSSG) per H2O2. This selenium-dependent enzyme thus couples peroxide removal to the cellular thiol redox buffer. The directionality is peroxide to water with coordinated thiol oxidation. A caveat is that GPx activity depends on GSH recycling by glutathione reductase and NADPH, so its capacity is gated by cellular redox and energy status.
context_zh_TW: Glutathione peroxidase 使用還原的 glutathione (GSH) 作為電子供體將 hydrogen peroxide 還原為水，每個 H2O2 將兩個 GSH 分子氧化為 glutathione 二硫化物 (GSSG)。因此，這種 selenium 依賴性酶將過氧化物去除與細胞硫醇氧化還原緩衝液耦合。方向性是過氧化物到水並協調硫醇氧化。需要注意的是，GPx 活性取決於 glutathione 還原酶和 NADPH 的 GSH 回收，因此其容量受到細胞氧化還原和能量狀態的控制。

label: requires
context: Glutathione peroxidase requires selenium in the form of a catalytic selenocysteine residue at its active site, which is essential for the redox chemistry of peroxide reduction. Dietary selenium deficiency lowers GPx activity and leaves cells more vulnerable to oxidative injury. The directionality is nutrient to enzyme function. A caveat is that excess selenium is toxic and does not further increase activity, so there is a narrow optimal range for antioxidant benefit. Selenocysteine is incorporated into GPx during translation at a recoded UGA codon, and selenium status tracks circulating GPx activity closely, making the enzyme a sensitive functional marker of selenium nutrition.
context_zh_TW: Glutathione peroxidase 需要 selenium 在其活性位點以催化硒半胱氨酸殘基的形式存在，這對於過氧化物還原的氧化還原化學至關重要。飲食中的 selenium deficiency 會降低 GPx 活性，使細胞更容易受到氧化損傷。方向性是營養物質對酵素功能的影響。需要注意的是，過量的 selenium 是有毒的，並且不會進一步增加活性，因此抗氧化功效的最佳範圍很窄。硒代半胱氨酸在翻譯過程中在重新編碼的 UGA 密碼子處摻入 GPx，並且 selenium 狀態密切追蹤循環 GPx 活性，使該酶成為 selenium 營養的敏感功能標記。

label: combines
context: GlyNAC combines glycine and N-acetylcysteine (NAC) to jointly support glutathione synthesis, overcoming the dual glycine-and-cysteine limitation that limits NAC alone.
context_zh_TW: GlyNAC 由甘胺酸與 N-乙醯半胱胺酸（NAC）組成，共同支持穀胱甘肽合成，克服單用 NAC 時甘胺酸與半胱胺酸雙重限制的問題。

label: degraded_by
context: Glycated proteins are normally removed from cells via ubiquitin-dependent 20S proteasome-mediated proteolysis, an important quality control pathway for damaged proteins. AGE modifications can disturb this proteolytic degradation, contributing to a further increase in the cellular content of glycated proteins. The resulting accumulation of glycated proteins is a hallmark of aging and is associated with loss of cellular function. Proteasomal degradation of glycated proteins is thus a key cellular defense against glycation stress, and its impairment creates a feed-forward loop of AGE accumulation.
context_zh_TW: Glycated proteins 通常經由 ubiquitin-dependent 20S proteasome-mediated proteolysis 從細胞中移除，這是 damaged proteins 的重要 quality control pathway。AGE modifications 會 disturb 此 proteolytic degradation，導致細胞內 glycated proteins 含量進一步增加。由此產生的 glycated proteins accumulation 是 aging 的標誌，並與 loss of cellular function 相關。因此，glycated proteins 的 proteasomal degradation 是對抗 glycation stress 的關鍵細胞防禦，而其 impairment 會創造 AGE accumulation 的 feed-forward loop。

label: forms
context: Glycation is a spontaneous non-enzymatic reaction of free reducing sugars with free amino groups of proteins, DNA, and lipids. It is initiated by the attack of a reactive carbonyl group of a sugar or aldehyde on a nucleophilic free amino group, rapidly forming an unstable Schiff base that rearranges into a more stable Amadori product. Amadori products then undergo irreversible dehydration, oxidation, polymerization, and cross-linking reactions over days to weeks, yielding advanced glycation end products. Glycation causes loss of protein function and impaired tissue elasticity, is accelerated by hyperglycemia and oxidative stress, and is implicated in diabetic complications and aging.
context_zh_TW: Glycation 是游離 reducing sugars 與蛋白質、DNA 和脂質的游離 amino groups 自發性非酵素反應。它由糖或 aldehyde 的 reactive carbonyl group 攻擊 nucleophilic 游離 amino group 所啟動，迅速形成不穩定的 Schiff base，再重排為更穩定的 Amadori product。Amadori products 隨後在數天至數週內經歷不可逆的 dehydration、oxidation、polymerization 與 cross-linking 反應，產生 advanced glycation end products。Glycation 導致蛋白質功能喪失與組織彈性受損，受 hyperglycemia 與 oxidative stress 加速，並涉及 diabetic complications 與 aging。

label: is_precursor_for
context: Glycine is the third residue of the gamma-glutamyl-cysteinyl-glycine tripeptide and becomes rate-limiting for glutathione synthesis under metabolic stress, aging, and methylglyoxal overload.
context_zh_TW: 甘胺酸是 γ-麩胺醯-半胱胺醯-甘胺酸三肽的第三個殘基，在代謝壓力、老化與甲基乙二醛過載下成為穀胱甘肽合成的限速因子。

label: phosphorylates
context: Glycogen synthase kinase 3 beta (GSK3β) phosphorylates TFEB at serines 134 and 138, residues that influence its subcellular localization and association with lysosomal membranes. These phosphorylations contribute to the regulated shuttling of TFEB and modulate its activity in response to Wnt and growth-factor signaling contexts. Because GSK3β activity is itself controlled by Akt and by nutrient state, this modification embeds TFEB within the broader insulin/PI3K signaling network. The sites complement the better-characterized S211 mark in fine-tuning TFEB localization.
context_zh_TW: 糖原合成酶激酶 3 beta（GSK3β）於 serine 134 和 138 磷酸化 TFEB，這些殘基影響其亞細胞定位和與溶酶體膜的關聯。這些磷酸化有助於 TFEB 的調節性穿梭，並在 Wnt 和生長因子信號背景下調節其活性。由於 GSK3β 活性本身受 Akt 和營養狀態控制，此修飾將 TFEB 嵌入更廣泛的胰島素／PI3K 信號網絡。這些位點補充了特徵更清楚的 S211 標記，以微調 TFEB 定位。

label: contains
context: Green tea is rich in polyphenols, especially the catechin epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG), which constitutes a major fraction of its antioxidant and bioactive content. EGCG is subsequently metabolized by COMT, linking green tea consumption to COMT-dependent pharmacokinetics, with slow genotypes clearing it more slowly. The high EGCG content is the basis for many of green tea's studied health effects, including antioxidant, metabolic, and neuroprotective actions. At dietary intake levels it does not significantly inhibit COMT in humans.
context_zh_TW: Green tea 富含多酚，尤其是兒茶素表沒食子兒茶素沒食子酸酯 (EGCG)，它構成了其抗氧化劑和生物活性成分的主要部分。 EGCG 隨後被 COMT 代謝，將綠茶攝取與 COMT 依賴性藥物動力學聯繫起來，而慢基因型清除它的速度更慢。 EGCG 的高含量是綠茶許多健康功效研究的基礎，包括抗氧化、代謝和神經保護作用。在飲食攝取量下，它不會顯著抑制 COMT in humans。

label: represses
context: H19 is a long non-coding RNA whose expression changes with age, and it functions to repress IGF-1 signaling. H19 associates with MBD1, a methyl-CpG-binding domain protein, to repress the expression of longevity genes including insulin-like growth factor 1, and loss of H19-dependent IGF-1 silencing may contribute to cellular senescence. Because IGF-1 signaling is a conserved regulator of the insulin/IGF-1 pathway that influences lifespan, the age-related deregulation of H19 has implications for both senescence and longevity.
context_zh_TW: H19 是一種長鏈非編碼 RNA，其表現隨年齡而變化，其功能是抑制 IGF-1 訊號傳導。 H19 與 MBD1（一種甲基 CpG 結合域蛋白）結合，抑制包括類胰島素生長因子 1 在內的長壽基因的表達，H19 依賴性 IGF-1 沉默的喪失可能導致細胞老化。由於 IGF-1 訊號傳導是影響壽命的胰島素/IGF-1 路徑的保守調節因子，因此 H19 與年齡相關的失調對老化和長壽都有影響。

label: silences
context: H3K27me3 is a repressive histone modification that silences SASP genes when present at their loci. Depleting or inhibiting EZH2, the methyltransferase that deposits this mark, removes H3K27me3 from SASP gene loci and derepresses the SASP program, enabling expression of the inflammatory secretome. Thus the maintenance of H3K27me3 at SASP loci keeps the senescence-associated secretory phenotype in check until senescence entry triggers its removal. Understanding this repressive control is important for designing senomorphic drugs that limit harmful inflammation.
context_zh_TW: H3K27me3 是一種抑制性組蛋白修飾，當 SASP 基因存在於其位點時，它會沉默該基因。耗盡或抑制 EZH2（沉積此標記的甲基轉移酶），可以從 SASP 基因位點中去除 H3K27me3，並解除 SASP 程序的抑制，從而實現炎症分泌蛋白組的表達。因此，SASP 基因座上 H3K27me3 的維持使衰老相關的分泌表型保持在檢查狀態，直到衰老進入觸發其去除。了解這種抑制控制對於設計限制有害發炎的senomorphic藥物非常重要。

label: decreases_with
context: H3K9me3 globally decreases with aging, reflecting the progressive loss of constitutive heterochromatin. Reduced H3K9me3 is observed in aging flies, in progeria patient fibroblasts, and in aged mouse and human tissues, and it is accompanied by reduced HP1 and heterochromatin decompaction. This decline in the repressive mark permits derepression of transposable elements and aberrant gene expression, contributing to genomic instability and inflammation during aging. Restoring H3K9me3 levels is investigated as a means to stabilize the aging genome.
context_zh_TW: H3K9me3 隨著年齡的增長而整體下降，反映了組成型異染色質的逐漸喪失。在衰老果蠅、早衰症患者成纖維細胞以及衰老小鼠和人體組織中觀察到 H3K9me3 減少，並且伴隨著 HP1 減少和異染色質解壓縮。抑制標記的下降允許轉座元件和異常 gene expression 的去抑制，從而導致老化過程中基因組不穩定和發炎。研究恢復 H3K9me3 水平作為穩定老化基因組的一種方法。

label: marks
context: H3K9me3, the trimethylation of histone H3 at lysine 9, is a defining mark of constitutive heterochromatin and stable gene silencing. The mark is deposited by the SUV39H, SETDB1, and G9a/GLP methyltransferases and is recognized by the chromodomain of HP1 proteins, which oligomerize to compact and spread silent chromatin. H3K9me3 is globally reduced with age and in progeria, contributing to heterochromatin loss, retrotransposon derepression, and genomic instability. Loss of this mark is thus coupled to the heterochromatin decompaction seen in aged cells.
context_zh_TW: H3K9me3 是組蛋白 H3 在賴氨酸 9 處的三甲基化，是組成型異染色質和穩定基因沉默的定義標記。該標記由 SUV39H、SETDB1 和 G9a/GLP 甲基轉移酶沉積，並被 HP1 蛋白的染色質結構域識別，該蛋白寡聚化以壓縮和擴散沉默染色質。 H3K9me3 隨著年齡的增長和早衰症而整體減少，導致異染色質丟失、逆轉錄轉座子去抑制和基因組不穩定。因此，該標記的丟失與衰老細胞中觀察到的異染色質解壓縮有關。

label: is_abbreviation_for
context: HAT is the standard abbreviation for histone acetyltransferase, a family of enzymes that transfer acetyl groups from acetyl-CoA to lysine residues on histone tails. These enzymes are grouped into families such as the GNAT, MYST, and p300/CBP families, and their activity is central to epigenetic control of gene expression. HATs oppose the action of histone deacetylases and are frequently deregulated in cancer and aging, where changes in acetylation contribute to aberrant gene silencing and loss of transcriptional fidelity.
context_zh_TW: HAT 是組蛋白乙醯轉移酶的標準縮寫，該酶是將乙醯基從乙醯輔酶 A 轉移到組蛋白尾部賴氨酸殘基的酶家族。這些酵素分為 GNAT、MYST 和 p300/CBP 等家族，它們的活性對於 gene expression 的表觀遺傳控制至關重要。 HAT 對抗組蛋白去乙醯化酶的作用，並且在癌症和老化過程中經常失調，其中乙醯化的變化會導致異常基因沉默和轉錄保真度喪失。

label: is_abbreviation_for
context: HDAC stands for histone deacetylase, a family of enzymes that remove acetyl groups from lysine residues on histone tails, counteracting the activity of histone acetyltransferases. By deacetylating histones, HDACs promote chromatin compaction and generally repress transcription, and they also regulate numerous non-histone proteins. They are divided into classes I, II, III (sirtuins), and IV, and HDAC inhibitors are widely studied as tools to reactivate silenced genes and as candidate therapeutic agents in cancer, inflammation, and aging.
context_zh_TW: HDAC 代表組蛋白去乙醯化酶，這是一個酶家族，可去除組蛋白尾部賴氨酸殘基上的乙醯基，從而抵消組蛋白乙醯轉移酶的活性。透過組蛋白去乙醯化，HDAC 促進染色質壓縮並通常抑制轉錄，並且它們還調節許多非組蛋白。它們分為 I、II、III（sirtuins）和 IV 類，HDAC 抑制劑作為重新激活沉默基因的工具以及作為癌症、發炎和老化的候選治療劑而被廣泛研究。

label: degraded_during
context: HDAC4 is degraded upon entry into senescence, an event that unleashes the AP-1-mediated senescence transcriptional program. Under normal conditions, HDAC4, a class IIa histone deacetylase that acts as an epigenetic reader, monitors H3K27 acetylation at AP-1-regulated super-enhancers and buffers the senescence program, keeping SASP gene expression repressed. Its degradation removes this brake, allowing the widespread activation of senescence-associated genes that drives the SASP. This proteolytic switch is one of the triggers that converts a buffered state into a full-blown senescent secretome.
context_zh_TW: HDAC4 在進入老化時被降解，這一事件釋放了 AP-1 介導的衰老轉錄程序。在正常情況下，HDAC4（一種 IIa 類組蛋白去乙醯酶，可作為表觀遺傳讀取器）可監測 AP-1 調節的超級增強子上的 H3K27 乙醯化並緩衝老化程序，從而保持 SASP gene expression 受到抑制。它的降解消除了這種制動，從而使驅動 SASP 的衰老相關基因廣泛激活。這種蛋白水解開關是將緩衝狀態轉化為成熟的衰老分泌蛋白組的觸發器之一。

label: sumoylates
context: HDAC4 possesses SUMO E3 ligase activity and sumoylates MEF2D at Lys424, locking it into an inactive, transcription-repressing state. Directionally, HDAC4 sits upstream of MEF2D inactivation. This regulates muscle-gene expression independently of sirtuins, and it is included as a parallel chromatin regulatory mechanism contextualizing SIRT1's muscle actions. By sumoylating MEF2D, HDAC4 represses its transcriptional activity and the muscle genes it controls. This regulation is distinct from the acetylation-deacetylation balance that sirtuins influence, illustrating the diversity of muscle-gene control.
context_zh_TW: HDAC4 具有 SUMO E3 連接酶活性，在 Lys424 位點 SUMO 化 MEF2D，將其鎖定在不活化的轉錄抑制狀態。在方向性上，HDAC4 位於 MEF2D 失活的上游。這獨立於 sirtuin 調控肌肉基因表達，被納入作為將 SIRT1 肌肉作用置於背景中的平行染色質調控機制。透過 SUMO 化 MEF2D，HDAC4 抑制其轉錄活性和它所控制的肌肉基因。此調控不同於 sirtuin 影響的乙醯化-去乙醯化平衡，說明了肌肉基因控制的多樣性。

label: monitors
context: HDAC4, a class IIa histone deacetylase that is catalytically inactive and acts as an epigenetic reader, monitors H3K27ac, the acetylation mark at active enhancers. It is swiftly recruited to H3K27ac loci and, through interaction with the class I deacetylase HDAC3, oversees the acetylation status of AP-1-regulated super-enhancers. This buffering function keeps senescence-associated gene expression in check until HDAC4 degradation upon senescence entry unleashes the SASP program. This monitoring role links HDAC4 to the chromatin changes that set the threshold for SASP activation.
context_zh_TW: HDAC4 是一種 IIa 類組蛋白去乙醯化酶，無催化活性，可作為表觀遺傳讀取器，監測活性增強子處的乙醯化標記 H3K27ac。它迅速被招募到 H3K27ac 基因座，並透過與 I 型去乙醯酶 HDAC3 相互作用，監督 AP-1 調節的超級增強子的乙醯化狀態。這種緩衝功能使與老化相關的 gene expression 保持在檢查狀態，直到老化進入時 HDAC4 降解釋放 SASP 程序。這種監測作用將 HDAC4 與染色質變化聯繫起來，從而設定 SASP 活化的閾值。

label: drives
context: HER2 drives Breast Cancer. HER2 (ERBB2) is a receptor tyrosine kinase that, when amplified, drives aggressive breast cancer and is the target of trastuzumab. Breast cancer is a heterogeneous malignancy in which molecular subtypes (luminal, HER2-enriched, basal/triple-negative) dictate targeted therapy choice. The relationship is directional, with HER2 acting as the operative agent upon Breast Cancer rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: HER2 驅動 Breast Cancer。 HER2 (ERBB2) 是一種受體酪胺酸激酶，在擴增時會驅動攻擊性 Breast Cancer，並且是 trastuzumab 的目標。 Breast Cancer 是一種異質性惡性腫瘤，其分子亞型（管腔型、HER2富集型、基礎/三陰性）決定了標靶治療的選擇。這種關係是有方向的，HER2 充當 Breast Cancer 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: is_targeted_by
context: HER2 is targeted by trastuzumab. HER2 (ERBB2) is a receptor tyrosine kinase that, when amplified, drives aggressive breast cancer and is the target of trastuzumab. Trastuzumab is a monoclonal antibody against HER2 that inhibits signaling and recruits immune effector mechanisms in HER2-positive breast cancer. The directionality runs from trastuzumab toward HER2, so trastuzumab is the active agent and HER2 the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
context_zh_TW: HER2 是 trastuzumab 的目標。 HER2 (ERBB2) 是一種受體酪胺酸激酶，在擴增時會驅動攻擊性 Breast Cancer，並且是 trastuzumab 的目標。曲妥珠單抗是一種針對 HER2 的單株抗體，可抑制訊號傳導並在 HER2 陽性 Breast Cancer 中招募免疫效應機制。方向性從 trastuzumab 向 HER2，因此 trastuzumab 是活性劑，HER2 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

label: represses
context: HIC1 (hypermethylated in cancer 1) is a tumor suppressor that binds the SIRT1 promoter via its POZ domain and directly represses SIRT1 transcription. Because p53 transactivates HIC1, a negative feedback loop exists: p53 induces HIC1, which then restrains SIRT1, preventing excessive p53 deacetylation and preserving p53 tumor-suppressive capacity. The directionality is HIC1 → SIRT1 repression, upstream of SIRT1's inhibition of p53. Disruption of this loop in cancer can unleash SIRT1 to silence p53.
context_zh_TW: HIC1（hypermethylated in cancer 1）是一種腫瘤抑制因子，通過其 POZ 結構域結合 SIRT1 啟動子並直接抑制 SIRT1 轉錄。由於 p53 反式活化 HIC1，存在一個負回饋迴路：p53 誘導 HIC1，HIC1 反過來限制 SIRT1，防止過度的 p53 去乙醯化並維持 p53 的腫瘤抑制能力。其方向性為 HIC1 → SIRT1 抑制，位於 SIRT1 對 p53 的抑制上游。此迴路在癌症中的中斷可以釋放 SIRT1 來沉默 p53。

label: required_for
context: HLH-30 is required for survival during prolonged starvation; hlh-30 mutant animals die prematurely under nutrient-deprived conditions due to their inability to mount sufficient autophagy, lysosomal biogenesis, and lipid mobilization. By activating the clearance and energy-mobilization programs, HLH-30 enables worms to withstand food absence. This essential role mirrors the dependence of mammalian cells on TFEB for stress resilience. The phenotype establishes HLH-30 as a critical effector of adaptive starvation responses.
context_zh_TW: HLH-30 在長期飢餓期間的存活是必需的；hlh-30 突變動物在營養剝奪條件下過早死亡，因為它們無法啟動足夠的自噬、溶酶體生物發生和脂質動員。透過活化清除和能量動員程序，HLH-30 使線蟲能夠承受食物缺失。此必要角色反映了哺乳動物細胞對 TFEB 在壓力韌性上的依賴。該表型確立了 HLH-30 作為適應性飢餓反應的關鍵效應物。

label: prevents
context: HLH-30 prevents aging and extends lifespan in C. elegans; hlh-30 mutants are short-lived, and loss of hlh-30 suppresses the longevity conferred by mxl-3 deletion. By driving autophagy, lysosomal biogenesis, and lipid mobilization, HLH-30 preserves proteostasis and metabolic homeostasis that decline with age. Its activity embodies the conserved mechanism by which enhanced clearance promotes longevity across species. The epistasis with mxl-3 places HLH-30 downstream as the effector of the pro-longevity program.
context_zh_TW: HLH-30 在線蟲中防止老化並延長壽命；hlh-30 突變體壽命短，且 hlh-30 的缺失抑制了 mxl-3 缺失所賦予的長壽。透過驅動自噬、溶酶體生物發生和脂質動員，HLH-30 維持了隨年齡衰退的蛋白質穩態和代謝恆定性。其活性體現了增強清除能跨越物種促進長壽的保守機制。與 mxl-3 的遺傳上位性將 HLH-30 置於下游，作為促長壽程序的效應物。

label: regulates
context: HLH-30 regulates longevity in C. elegans, as its overexpression extends lifespan while loss of hlh-30 shortens it and suppresses the longevity of other mutants. By inducing autophagy, lysosomal biogenesis, and lipid mobilization, HLH-30 preserves proteostasis and metabolic homeostasis that decline with age. Its activity integrates insulin, mTOR, and dietary signals into a pro-longevity transcriptional program. The worm findings provide a conserved model for how TFEB orthologs promote healthspan in higher organisms.
context_zh_TW: HLH-30 在線蟲中調節壽命，因為其過度表現可延長壽命，而 hlh-30 的缺失會縮短壽命並抑制其他突變體的長壽。透過誘發自噬、溶酶體生物發生和脂質動員，HLH-30 維持了隨年齡衰退的蛋白質穩態和代謝恆定性。其活性將胰島素、mTOR 和飲食信號整合進促長壽的轉錄程序。線蟲的發現為 TFEB 同源物如何在高等生物中促進健康壽命提供了保守模型。

label: translocates_to
context: HLH-30 translocates to and accumulates in intestinal nuclei of fasted C. elegans, where it activates the lysosomal, autophagic, and lipolytic transcriptional programs. This nuclear enrichment mirrors the starvation-induced nuclear entry of mammalian TFEB/TFE3 and is essential for the organism's adaptive response to food deprivation. The translocation is opposed by insulin/IGF and CeTOR signaling that retain HLH-30 cytoplasmically when food is available. Its nuclear localization thus serves as a key determinant of fasting-induced longevity.
context_zh_TW: HLH-30 轉位至禁食線蟲的腸道細胞核中並在其中累積，於此活化溶酶體、自噬性和脂解性的轉錄程序。此核富集反映了哺乳動物 TFEB/TFE3 在飢餓誘發的核進入，並對生物適應食物剝奪的反應至為必要。此轉位受到胰島素/IGF 和 CeTOR 信號的拮抗，後者在食物可得時將 HLH-30 保留於細胞質。因此其核定位作為禁食誘發長壽的關鍵決定因子。

label: induces
context: HLH-30, the C. elegans ortholog of mammalian TFEB, induces expression of the lysosomal lipase genes (lipl-1, lipl-2, lipl-3, lipl-5) in response to fasting, promoting mobilization of stored lipids. This transcriptional activation mirrors TFEB's induction of lipolytic and autophagic programs in mammals during nutrient scarcity. The HLH-30–lipase axis provides a molecular explanation for fasting-induced lipophagy and lifespan extension in worms. It demonstrates deep conservation of the MiT/TFE nutrient-response program.
context_zh_TW: HLH-30 是哺乳動物 TFEB 在線蟲中的同源物，在回應禁食時誘發溶酶體脂肪酶基因（lipl-1、lipl-2、lipl-3、lipl-5）的表現，促進儲存脂質的動員。此轉錄活化反映了哺乳動物 TFEB 在營養匱乏時對脂解和自噬程序的誘發。HLH-30–脂肪酶軸為禁食誘發的脂噬和線蟲壽命延長提供了分子解釋。它展示了 MiT/TFE 營養反應程序的高度保守性。

label: is_a
context: HMGB1 is a chromatin protein released as a damage-associated molecular pattern (DAMP) from dying or stressed cells.
context_zh_TW: HMGB1 是一種染色質蛋白，從死亡或受壓細胞中以損傷相關分子模式（DAMP）的形式釋放。

label: protects
context: HMGB2 is a chromatin-bound high mobility group box protein that protects SASP gene loci from silencing during oncogene-induced senescence. When chromatin-bound, HMGB2 binds to SASP gene loci and prevents the spread of repressive heterochromatin into them, keeping SASP genes out of senescence-associated heterochromatin foci and thereby preserving their expression. Depletion of HMGB2 is associated with the derepression of SASP genes, and HMGB2 knockdown can prevent the emergence of SASP while leaving cell cycle arrest unaffected.
context_zh_TW: HMGB2 是一種染色質結合的高遷移率族盒蛋白，可保護 SASP 基因位點在癌基因誘導的衰老過程中免於沉默。當染色質結合時，HMGB2 與 SASP 基因位點結合，防止抑制性異染色質擴散到其中，使 SASP 基因遠離衰老相關的異染色質灶，從而保留其表達。 HMGB2 的耗盡與 SASP 基因的去抑制有關，HMGB2 敲低可以阻止 SASP 的出現，同時使細胞週期停滯不受影響。

label: depleted_in
context: HMGB2 is depleted in senescent cells and aging tissues, a change that accompanies the loss of ordered three-dimensional genome architecture. This depletion shifts the balance between constitutive and facultative heterochromatin and is linked to increased expression of SASP genes in replicative senescence. HMGB2 loss upon senescence entry disrupts genomic organization and induces CTCF clustering, contributing to the widespread chromatin remodeling that characterizes the senescent state. Its loss is one of the earliest markers of the senescent chromatin phenotype.
context_zh_TW: HMGB2 在老化細胞和老化組織中被耗盡，這種變化伴隨著有序三維基因組結構的喪失。這種耗竭改變了組成型和兼性異染色質之間的平衡，並與複製老化中 SASP 基因表現的增加有關。進入老化時 HMGB2 的缺失會破壞基因組組織並誘導 CTCF 聚類，從而導致廣泛的染色質重塑，從而表徵衰老狀態。它的流失是衰老染色質表型的最早標誌之一。

label: bidirectionally_linked_with
context: HPP+ and Haloperidol are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically HPP+ and Haloperidol may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
context_zh_TW: HPP+ 和 Haloperidol 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，HPP+ 和 Haloperidol 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: bidirectionally_linked_with
context: Haloperidol and HPP+ are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Haloperidol and HPP+ may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
context_zh_TW: Haloperidol 和 HPP+ 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Haloperidol 和 HPP+ 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: causes
context: Haloperidol causes Parkinson's Disease by acting as the upstream trigger whose downstream consequence is the second entity's appearance or dysfunction. The mechanism typically involves oxidative, mitochondrial, or proteotoxic injury in the case of neurotoxins and pigments, or receptor blockade and cell loss in pharmacological and degenerative contexts. This causal relationship is clinically significant because it models or explains features of Parkinson's disease pathology and guides therapeutic targeting. A caveat is that in many of these links the causal claim is experimental, partial, or operates within a broader network of cofactors rather than as an isolated linear event.
context_zh_TW: Haloperidol 透過充當上游觸發器來導致 Parkinson's Disease，其下游結果是第二個實體的出現或功能障礙。此機制通常涉及氧化、mitochondria1或neurotoxin和色素情況下的蛋白毒性損傷，或藥理學和退化環境中的受體阻斷和細胞損失。這種因果關係具有臨床意義，因為它模擬或解釋了 Parkinson's disease 病理特徵並指導治療目標。需要注意的是，在許多這些連結中，因果關係的主張是實驗性的、部分的，或是在更廣泛的輔助因子網絡中運作的，而不是作為一個孤立的線性事件。

label: is_a
context: Hemoglobin A1c is the most widely recognized early glycation product, an Amadori product formed when glucose attaches non-enzymatically to the amino terminus of hemoglobin in red blood cells. It is used clinically as an indicator of blood glucose management in people with diabetes because its level reflects average glycemia over the preceding weeks. As an Amadori product, hemoglobin A1c is a reversible early intermediate on the pathway to irreversible advanced glycation end products. Its clinical utility demonstrates that even early, reversible glycation products are valuable biomarkers of glycation burden.
context_zh_TW: 糖化血色素 A1c（Hemoglobin A1c）是最廣為人知的早期糖化產物，是一種當葡萄糖非酵素性地附著於紅血球中血紅素的胺基端時所形成的阿馬多里產物（Amadori product）。它在臨床上用作糖尿病患者血糖控制的指標，因為其濃度反映前幾週的平均血糖狀態。作為一種阿馬多里產物，糖化血色素 A1c 是通往不可逆晚期糖化終產物路徑上的一個可逆早期中間產物。其臨床效用證明，即使是早期、可逆的糖化產物也是糖化負擔的有價值生物標記。

label: is_metabolized_by
context: Hepatic cytochrome P450 enzymes contribute to resveratrol catabolism, alongside phase-II conjugation, determining its metabolic fate. Directionally, CYP enzymes sit upstream of resveratrol clearance. This hepatic handling caps bioavailability, and it is relevant to drug-drug interactions and dosing, since resveratrol both is metabolized by and inhibits cytochrome P450 activity. The combination of rapid conjugation and CYP-mediated oxidation explains resveratrol's short half-life. Because resveratrol can both be metabolized by and inhibit CYP enzymes, co-administered drugs may see altered clearance, a clinically important consideration for supplementation.
context_zh_TW: 肝臟細胞色素 P450 酶參與 resveratrol 的分解代謝，與第二相結合作用共同決定其代謝命運。在方向性上，CYP 酶位於 resveratrol 清除的上游。這種肝臟處理限制了生物利用度，與藥物-藥物相互作用和劑量相關，因為 resveratrol 既被細胞色素 P450 代謝也抑制其活性。快速結合作用與 CYP 介導的氧化的結合解釋了 resveratrol 的短半衰期。由於 resveratrol 可以既被 CYP 酶代謝又抑制其活性，合併用藥可能看到清除率改變，這是補充劑使用中臨床重要的考量。

label: is
context: Hesperidin is classified as a flavanone, a subclass of flavonoids characterized by a saturated C-ring and the absence of the catechol motif, distinguishing it from catechol flavonoids such as quercetin or luteolin. This structural class determines its metabolic fate and its lack of interaction with COMT, since it cannot serve as a substrate or inhibitor of the enzyme. Its glycosidic form is abundant in citrus peels and juices, where it contributes to antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activity. The absence of vicinal hydroxyl groups is the key to its COMT neutrality.
context_zh_TW: Hesperidin 被歸類為 flavanone，是類黃酮的亞類，其特徵是具有飽和的 C 環且不存在兒茶酚基序，從而將其與槲皮素或木犀草素等兒茶酚類黃酮區分開來。這種結構類別決定了它的代謝命運以及它與 COMT 相互作用的缺乏，因為它不能充當酶的底物或抑制劑。它的糖苷形式在柑橘皮和果汁中含量豐富，有助於抗氧化和抗炎活性。鄰位羥基的缺失是其 COMT 中性的關鍵。

label: decreases_with
context: Heterochromatin decreases with aging, with global loss of the compacted, transcriptionally silent chromatin domains that maintain genome stability. Age-related heterochromatin loss is associated with reduced HP1 and H3K9me3, altered lamin A, and reduced histone abundance, and it is accelerated in progeria syndromes such as Hutchinson-Gilford progeria. Loss of heterochromatin decompacts the genome, promoting transposable element activation, aberrant gene expression, and genomic instability as recognized hallmarks of aging.
context_zh_TW: Heterochromatin 隨著年齡的增長而減少，維持基因組穩定性的緊密、轉錄沉默的染色質結構域全面喪失。年齡相關的異染色質缺失與 HP1 和 H3K9me3 減少、核纖層蛋白 A 改變以及組蛋白豐度減少有關，並且在早衰症（例如 Hutchinson-Gilford 早衰症）中加速。異染色質的流失會使基因組解壓縮，促進轉座元件活化、gene expression 異常和基因組不穩定，這些都是公認的老化標誌。

label: induces
context: High (12.5-fold) cardiac SIRT1 overexpression induced cardiomyopathy with increased apoptosis, hypertrophy, and oxidative stress, reduced ATP, citrate synthase, and mitochondrial biogenesis (about 50% PGC-1alpha loss), and possible NAD+ depletion. This is the canonical example of a hormetic dose window for cardiac SIRT1.
context_zh_TW: 高（12.5 倍）心臟 SIRT1 過表達誘導心肌病，伴隨凋亡、肥大和氧化壓力增加，ATP、檸檬酸合成酶和粒線體生物合成減少（PGC-1α 損失約 50%），並可能消耗 NAD+。這是心臟 SIRT1 毒物興奮效應劑量窗口的典型例子。

label: activates
context: High intracellular cAMP activates Epac1 (Exchange Protein directly Activated by cAMP), a guanine-nucleotide-exchange factor that triggers downstream signaling independent of PKA. Directionally, cAMP sits upstream of Epac1 activation. Epac1 then stimulates calcium release from the endoplasmic reticulum, linking cAMP to Ca2+-dependent kinases and propagating a metabolic signal. This step is pivotal in resveratrol's indirect SIRT1-activation cascade, bridging the PDE4/cAMP arm to AMPK and NAD+ metabolism. The pathway illustrates how a polyphenol can activate sirtuins through classical second-messenger signaling rather than direct enzyme binding alone.
context_zh_TW: 高濃度的細胞內 cAMP 活化 Epac1（直接被 cAMP 活化的交換蛋白），這是一種鳥嘌呤核苷酸交換因子，觸發不依賴 PKA 的下游信號。在方向性上，cAMP 位於 Epac1 活化的上游。Epac1 然後刺激內質網的鈣離子釋放，將 cAMP 與 Ca2+ 依賴性激酶聯繫起來並傳播代謝信號。這一步是白藜蘆醇間接 SIRT1 活化級聯中的關鍵樞紐，將 PDE4/cAMP 臂橋接到 AMPK 和 NAD+ 代謝。此通路說明了一種多酚如何通過經典的第二信使信號而非僅靠直接酶結合來活化 sirtuin。

label: leads_to
context: High levels of DNA methylation in promoter regions, often concentrated in CpG islands, are strongly associated with gene silencing. Methylated promoters recruit methyl-CpG-binding domain (MBD) proteins and inhibit the binding of transcription factors, converting active promoters into transcriptionally inert chromatin. This repressive mechanism is used physiologically for imprinting and for silencing transposable elements, and its aberrant targeting of tumor suppressor gene promoters is a hallmark of cancer.
context_zh_TW: 啟動子區域的高水平 DNA 甲基化（通常集中在 CpG 島）與基因沉默密切相關。甲基化啟動子招募甲基 CpG 結合域 (MBD) 蛋白並抑制轉錄因子的結合，將活性啟動子轉化為轉錄惰性染色質。這種抑制機制在生理學上用於印記和沈默轉座元件，其對腫瘤抑制基因啟動子的異常靶向性是癌症的標誌。

label: opens
context: Histone acetylation opens chromatin by neutralizing the positive charge of lysine residues on histone tails, weakening their electrostatic interaction with the negatively charged DNA backbone. This relaxes nucleosome compaction and increases the accessibility of DNA to transcription factors and other regulatory proteins, promoting gene expression. Acetylation is dynamically deposited by histone acetyltransferases and removed by histone deacetylases, and the balance between these activities tunes chromatin structure across the genome.
context_zh_TW: Histone 乙醯化透過中和組蛋白尾部離胺酸殘基的正電荷來打開染色質，削弱它們與帶負電的 DNA 主鏈的靜電相互作用。這放鬆了核小體的壓縮並增加了 DNA 與轉錄因子和其他調節蛋白的可及性，從而促進了 gene expression。乙醯化由組蛋白乙醯轉移酶動態沉積並由組蛋白去乙醯酶去除，這些活性之間的平衡調節整個基因組的染色質結構。

label: promotes
context: Histone acetylation promotes the formation of euchromatin, the open, transcriptionally permissive form of chromatin. Acetylation neutralizes the positive charge of lysine residues on histone tails, reducing their affinity for the negatively charged DNA backbone and loosening the nucleosome structure. This relaxed conformation allows transcription factors and RNA polymerase to access regulatory sequences, and acetylated lysines also serve as docking sites for bromodomain-containing reader proteins that further stimulate transcription.
context_zh_TW: Histone 乙醯化促進常染色質的形成，常染色質是開放的、轉錄允許的染色質形式。乙醯化會中和組蛋白尾部賴氨酸殘基的正電荷，降低其與帶負電荷的 DNA 主鏈的親和力，並鬆開核小體結構。這種鬆弛的構象允許轉錄因子和 RNA 聚合酶存取調控序列，乙醯化離胺酸也可作為含溴結構域讀取蛋白的對接位點，進一步刺激轉錄。

label: opposes
context: Histone acetyltransferases (HATs) act in dynamic opposition to histone deacetylases (HDACs) to control the steady-state acetylation of histones. HATs deposit acetyl groups that open chromatin and promote gene activation, whereas HDACs remove them to restore a compact, repressive state. Signal-dependent recruitment of HATs couples extracellular cues to gene activation, and the antagonism between these enzyme families is disrupted in aging, neurodegeneration, and cancer, where restoring the balance is explored as a therapeutic strategy.
context_zh_TW: Histone 乙醯轉移酶 (HAT) 與組蛋白去乙醯化酶 (HDAC) 動態對抗，以控制組蛋白的穩態乙醯化。 HAT 沉積乙醯基，打開染色質並促進基因激活，而 HDAC 則去除乙醯基以恢復緊湊的抑制狀態。 HAT 的訊號依賴性募集將細胞外訊號與基因活化結合起來，這些酵素家族之間的拮抗作用在老化、神經退化性疾病和癌症中被破壞，恢復平衡被探索作為一種治療策略。

label: catalyzes
context: Histone acetyltransferases (HATs) catalyze the transfer of acetyl groups from acetyl-CoA to specific lysine residues on histone tails, a key step in epigenetic regulation. Acetylation neutralizes the positive charge of the lysine side chains, weakening histone-DNA interactions and opening the chromatin for transcription. HAT activity is opposed by histone deacetylases, and the balance between these opposing enzymes determines the acetylation state of chromatin and hence its transcriptional activity.
context_zh_TW: Histone 乙醯轉移酶 (HAT) 催化乙醯基從乙醯輔酶 A 轉移到組蛋白尾部的特定離胺酸殘基，這是表觀遺傳調控的關鍵步驟。乙醯化會中和賴氨酸側鏈的正電荷，削弱組蛋白-DNA 相互作用並打開染色質進行轉錄。 HAT 的活性與組蛋白去乙醯化酶相反，這些相反酶之間的平衡決定了染色質的乙醯化狀態，從而決定了其轉錄活性。

label: uses_substrate
context: Histone acetyltransferases (HATs) use acetyl-CoA as the acetyl donor, transferring an acetyl group from acetyl-CoA to specific lysine residues on histone tails. The reaction converts a positively charged lysine into a neutral acetylated lysine, changing histone-DNA interactions and the overall charge distribution of the nucleosome. Because acetyl-CoA levels reflect the cellular metabolic state, HAT activity directly links metabolism to chromatin regulation and gene expression, allowing nutrient availability to influence the accessibility of genes to the transcriptional machinery.
context_zh_TW: Histone 乙醯轉移酶 (HAT) 使用乙醯輔酶 A 作為乙醯供體，將乙醯基從乙醯輔酶 A 轉移到組蛋白尾部的特定離胺酸殘基上。此反應將帶正電荷的賴氨酸轉化為中性乙醯化賴氨酸，改變組蛋白-DNA 相互作用和核小體的整體電荷分佈。由於乙醯輔酶 A 水平反映了細胞代謝狀態，因此 HAT 活性將代謝與染色質調節和 gene expression 直接聯繫起來，從而使營養物質的可用性影響基因對轉錄機制的可及性。

label: catalyzes
context: Histone deacetylases (HDACs) remove acetyl groups from epsilon-N-acetyl-lysine residues on histone tails, restoring the positive charge of lysine side chains. This increases the affinity of histones for DNA, allowing chromatin to wrap more tightly and generally repressing transcription. HDACs are grouped into classes, with class I and II enzymes using zinc-dependent catalysis and class III sirtuins using NAD+ as a cofactor, and HDAC inhibitors are widely used experimentally to reactivate gene expression.
context_zh_TW: Histone 去乙醯化酶 (HDAC) 可去除組蛋白尾部 ε-N-乙醯基-賴氨酸殘基上的乙醯基，恢復離胺酸側鏈的正電荷。這增加了組蛋白與 DNA 的親和力，使染色質包裹得更緊，從而抑制轉錄。 HDAC 分為幾類，其中 I 類和 II 類酶使用鋅依賴性催化，III 類去乙醯化酶使用 NAD+ 作為輔因子，HDAC 抑制劑在實驗中廣泛用於重新激活 gene expression。

label: condenses
context: Histone deacetylation condenses chromatin by restoring the positive charge of lysine residues on histone tails, strengthening their electrostatic interaction with DNA and promoting nucleosome compaction. This condenses the chromatin fiber, reducing the accessibility of DNA to transcription factors and repressing gene expression. Deacetylation is catalyzed by histone deacetylases, which counterbalance the chromatin-opening effects of histone acetyltransferases and are targets of HDAC-inhibitor drugs.
context_zh_TW: Histone 去乙醯化透過恢復組蛋白尾部離胺酸殘基的正電荷來濃縮染色質，加強其與 DNA 的靜電相互作用並促進核小體壓縮。這會壓縮染色質纖維，降低 DNA 對轉錄因子的可及性並抑制 gene expression。 Deacetylation 由組蛋白去乙醯化酶催化，可抵消組蛋白乙醯轉移酶的染色質打開作用，並且是 HDAC 抑制劑藥物的標靶。

label: is_mechanism_of
context: Histone modification is a core epigenetic mechanism operating through covalent marks on the N-terminal tails of histone proteins, including acetylation, methylation, phosphorylation, ubiquitination, and SUMOylation. These modifications alter chromatin structure and recruit reader proteins that modulate gene expression; acetylation neutralizes lysine charge to open chromatin, whereas methylation at H3K9 or H3K27 typically condenses it into repressive heterochromatin. The marks are written, erased, and read by families of enzymes such as acetyltransferases, deacetylases, and methyltransferases, and their dynamic balance shapes gene expression and becomes progressively dysregulated with age.
context_zh_TW: Histone 修飾是一種核心表觀遺傳機制，透過組蛋白 N 端尾部的共價標記進行操作，包括乙醯化、甲基化、磷酸化、泛素化和 SUMO 化。這些修飾改變染色質結構並招募調節 gene expression 的讀取蛋白；乙醯化會中和賴氨酸電荷以打開染色質，而 H3K9 或 H3K27 的甲基化通常會將其凝結成抑制性異染色質。這些標記由乙醯轉移酶、去乙醯酶和甲基轉移酶等酵素家族書寫、擦除和讀取，它們的動態平衡塑造了 gene expression，並隨著年齡的增長而逐漸失調。

label: is_required_for
context: Honokiol (HKL), a bisphenolic lignan from Magnolia officinalis, upregulates SIRT3 while augmenting its enzymatic activity, and shRNA-induced SIRT3 knockdown significantly attenuates HKL's cytoprotective effects on mitochondrial biogenesis, OXPHOS capacity, and bioenergetic output. HKL protects the brain from ischemia-reperfusion injury, ameliorates intracerebral hemorrhage-induced apoptosis and mitochondrial fission, and inhibits ferroptosis, all via SIRT3 activation.
context_zh_TW: Honokiol（HKL）是來自厚朴的雙酚木脂素，上調 SIRT3 並增強其酵素活性，而 shRNA 誘導的 SIRT3 敲減顯著削弱 HKL 對粒線體生成、氧化磷酸化能力和生物能輸出的細胞保護作用。HKL 保護大腦免受缺血再灌注損傷，改善腦出血誘導的凋亡和粒線體分裂，並抑制鐵死亡，所有這些都透過 SIRT3 活化實現。

label: is_a_positive_allosteric_modulator_of
context: Honokiol is a positive allosteric modulator (PAM) of the GABA-A receptor, including both synaptic and extrasynaptic receptors, acting at the benzodiazepine site. It shows higher efficacy at delta-subunit-containing receptors and its anxiolytic effect is blocked by the antagonist bicuculline and by flumazenil.
context_zh_TW: Honokiol 是 GABA-A 受體的正面異位調節劑（PAM），涵蓋突觸和突觸外受體，作用於苯二氮平類藥物位點。它在含 δ 亞基的受體上表現出更高效能，其抗焦慮作用會被拮抗劑 bicuculline 和 flumazenil 阻斷。

label: positively_modulates
context: Honokiol is a positive allosteric modulator of both synaptic and extrasynaptic GABA-A receptors, a known target of benzodiazepines and other anxiolytics. It shows markedly higher efficacy at receptors containing the delta subunit (900-1100% response) compared with alpha-beta-gamma-only receptors (300-500%), and it allosterically increases the affinity of low-affinity sites, increasing [3H]muscimol binding about three-fold. This GABA-A modulation underpins honokiol's anxiolytic, hypnotic, and anticonvulsant properties and is the basis of its sleep-promoting effects via the benzodiazepine site.
context_zh_TW: 厚朴酚是突觸型與突觸外 GABA-A 受體（苯二氮平類及其他抗焦慮藥物的已知靶點）的正向異位調節劑。在含 delta 亞基的受體上，其效力明顯更高（反應為 900-1100%），相較於僅含 alpha-beta-gamma 的受體（300-500%）；它並以異位方式提高低親和力位點的親和力，使 [3H]muscimol 結合增加約三倍。這種 GABA-A 調節構成了厚朴酚抗焦慮、催眠與抗驚厥特性的基礎，也是其經由苯二氮平作用位點產生促睡眠效果的機制。

label: is_poorly_soluble_in
context: Honokiol is highly lipophilic with very poor water solubility, so hot-water tea extraction is inefficient and ethanol tinctures or supercritical CO2 extracts are needed for therapeutic dosing. Directionally, the physicochemical property sits upstream of formulation requirement. Its lipophilicity also aids cell and mitochondrial membrane penetration, supporting SIRT3 engagement and explaining its potency despite poor aqueous solubility. This is a practical caveat for honokiol use, since the delivery vehicle determines both absorption and bioavailability. Nanoparticle and other advanced formulations are being explored to improve honokiol's pharmacokinetics.
context_zh_TW: 和厚朴酚（Honokiol）具有高度親脂性和極差的水溶性，因此熱水茶提取效率低，需要乙醇酊劑或超臨界 CO2 萃取物才能達到治療劑量。在方向性上，此物理化學性質位於製劑需求的上游。其親脂性也有助於細胞和粒線體膜穿透，支持 SIRT3 的結合並解釋了其儘管水溶性差仍具有高效力的原因。這是和厚朴酚使用的實際注意事項，因為遞送載體決定了吸收和生物利用度。正在探索奈米粒子和其他先進製劑以改善和厚朴酚的藥動學。

label: suppresses
context: Honokiol suppresses renal tubulointerstitial fibrosis by activating SIRT3, which inhibits the NF-κB/TGF-β1 pathway and limits fibrogenic signaling in kidney tubules. Directionally, honokiol activates SIRT3 to drive antifibrotic transcription. This reduces collagen deposition and inflammatory infiltrate, protecting renal architecture during injury. It illustrates SIRT3's broad tissue-protective role beyond the heart, and it is consistent with the general antifibrotic action of mitochondrial sirtuins. Given that tubulointerstitial fibrosis is the common final pathway of chronic kidney disease, SIRT3 activation represents a promising strategy to slow renal decline.
context_zh_TW: 厚朴酚通過活化 SIRT3 抑制腎小管間質纖維化，SIRT3 抑制 NF-κB/TGF-β1 通路並限制腎小管中的纖維化信號。在方向性上，厚朴酚活化 SIRT3 以驅動抗纖維化轉錄。這減少膠原蛋白沉積和發炎浸潤，在損傷期間保護腎臟結構。它說明了 SIRT3 超越心臟的廣泛組織保護作用，與粒線體 sirtuin 的一般抗纖維化作用一致。鑑於小管間質纖維化是慢性腎病的共同最終通路，SIRT3 活化代表了一種延緩腎臟退化的有前景策略。

label: crosses
context: Honokiol's small, aromatic, lipophilic structure allows it to cross the blood-brain barrier, enabling its CNS actions. This property underpins its neuroprotective, anxiolytic, and sleep-promoting effects and allows it to inhibit CNS tumor growth.
context_zh_TW: Honokiol 的小型芳香親脂結構使其能穿越血腦屏障，實現其中樞神經系統作用。此特性支撐其神經保護、抗焦慮和促進睡眠的作用，並使其能抑制中樞神經系統腫瘤生長。

label: activates
context: Honokiol, a biphenolic lignan from Magnolia bark, physically interacts with SIRT3, increasing its deacetylase activity and upregulating SIRT3 protein expression. Directionally, honokiol sits upstream of SIRT3 activation. This engagement yields downstream deacetylation of mitochondrial antioxidant and metabolic targets, including MnSOD and OSCP. Honokiol thereby mimics caloric-restriction benefits specifically within mitochondria, and its effects are lost when SIRT3 is knocked down, confirming SIRT3 dependence. Because honokiol is lipophilic and poorly water-soluble, its formulation and delivery are practical considerations for therapeutic use.
context_zh_TW: 厚朴酚（Honokiol）是一種來自厚朴樹皮的雙酚木脂素，與 SIRT3 物理相互作用，增加其去乙醯酶活性並上調 SIRT3 蛋白表達。在方向性上，厚朴酚位於 SIRT3 活化的上游。這種結合產生對粒線體抗氧化和代謝靶標的下游去乙醯化，包括 MnSOD 和 OSCP。厚朴酚因此在粒線體內特異性地模擬熱量限制的益處，其效應在 SIRT3 被敲低時消失，確認了 SIRT3 依賴性。由於厚朴酚是疏水性的且水溶性差，其製劑和遞送是治療應用的實際考量。

label: deacetylates
context: Honokiol-activated SIRT3 deacetylates MnSOD at Lys68 and Lys122, markedly increasing its superoxide-scavenging activity in the mitochondrial matrix. Directionally, SIRT3 enzymatically activates MnSOD. Enhanced MnSOD lowers mitochondrial ROS and protects against oxidative injury in the heart, kidney, and brain. This is a principal mechanism for honokiol's cardiorenal and neuroprotective effects, and it parallels SIRT3's regulation of the same enzyme during caloric restriction and fasting. Because mitochondrial superoxide is a key trigger of damage and inflammasome activation, MnSOD activation by SIRT3 is central to mitochondrial stress resistance.
context_zh_TW: 被厚朴酚活化的 SIRT3 在 Lys68 和 Lys122 處去乙醯化 MnSOD，顯著增加其在粒線體基質中的超氧自由基清除活性。在方向性上，SIRT3 在酶學上活化 MnSOD。增強的 MnSOD 降低粒線體 ROS 並保護心臟、腎臟和大腦免受氧化損傷。這是厚朴酚心腎和神經保護效應的主要機制，與 SIRT3 在熱量限制和禁食期間對同一酶的調節平行。由於粒線體超氧自由基是損傷和炎症小體活化的關鍵觸發因子，SIRT3 對 MnSOD 的活化是粒線體壓力抗性的核心。

label: deacetylates
context: Honokiol-activated SIRT3 deacetylates OSCP, a subunit of the mitochondrial F1Fo-ATP synthase, optimizing coupling of proton flux to ATP synthesis. Directionally, SIRT3 enzymatically tunes ATP synthase function. Improved coupling boosts cellular energy output while limiting proton-leak-associated ROS, enhancing mitochondrial efficiency. This contributes to honokiol's metabolic and cardioprotective actions, and it shows that SIRT3 regulates not only antioxidant enzymes but also the core machinery of ATP production. By improving the efficiency and integrity of oxidative phosphorylation, SIRT3 supports the bioenergetic capacity that declines with age and metabolic disease.
context_zh_TW: 被厚朴酚活化的 SIRT3 去乙醯化 OSCP（粒線體 F1Fo-ATP 合酶的一個亞基），優化質子流與 ATP 合成的偶聯。在方向性上，SIRT3 在酶學上調節 ATP 合酶功能。改善的偶聯在限制質子洩漏相關 ROS 的同時提升細胞能量輸出，增強粒線體效率。這有助於厚朴酚的代謝和心臟保護作用，並表明 SIRT3 不僅調節抗氧化酶，還調節 ATP 產生的核心機制。通過改善氧化磷酸化的效率和完整性，SIRT3 支持隨年齡和代謝疾病下降的生物能量能力。

label: activates
context: Human endogenous retroviruses activate the cGAS-STING pathway when their expression is derepressed during aging and senescence. Age-related loss of DNA methylation and heterochromatin permits HERV transcription, and the resulting HERV RNA is reverse transcribed into cDNA that is sensed by cGAS, triggering STING-dependent upregulation of type I interferons and SASP factors. HERV-driven innate immune signaling contributes to inflammaging and the paracrine spread of senescence. Suppressing HERV expression or reverse transcription therefore reduces this senescence-driving inflammatory signal.
context_zh_TW: 當人類內源性逆轉錄病毒的表達在老化和老化過程中被抑制時，它們會活化 cGAS-STING 路徑。與年齡相關的 DNA 甲基化和異染色質缺失允許 HERV 轉錄，並且所得的 HERV RNA 被逆轉錄為 cGAS 感知的 cDNA，觸發 I 型乾擾素和 SASP 因子的 STING 依賴性上調。 HERV 驅動的先天免疫訊號傳導有助於發炎和老化的旁分泌擴散。因此，抑制 HERV 表達或逆轉錄可以減少這種老化驅動的發炎訊號。

label: caused_by
context: Hutchinson-Gilford progeria syndrome is a rare premature aging disorder caused by mutations in the LMNA gene, which encodes lamin A. A silent point mutation (c.1824C>T) activates a cryptic splice site that produces progerin, a permanently farnesylated, toxic form of lamin A that accumulates at the nuclear membrane. Progerin causes nuclear blebbing, loss of heterochromatin, genomic instability, and premature senescence, producing the accelerated aging features of the disease. The disease demonstrates how defective nuclear envelope proteins disrupt chromatin organization and accelerate aging.
context_zh_TW: Hutchinson-Gilford 早衰症是一種罕見的過早老化疾病，由編碼核纖層蛋白 A 的 LMNA 基因突變引起。沉默點突變 (c.1824C>T) 會活化一個神秘的剪接位點，產生早老素，這是核纖層蛋白 A 的一種永久法呢基化的有毒形式，在核膜上積聚。早老蛋白會導致核起泡、異染色質流失、基因組不穩定和過早衰老，從而產生該疾病的加速衰老特徵。這種疾病顯示了有缺陷的核膜蛋白如何破壞染色質組織並加速老化。

label: acts_as
context: Hydrogen peroxide acts as a signaling molecule, functioning as a second messenger in insulin signaling, growth-factor pathways, and immune responses. Its relatively long half-life and membrane permeability allow it to diffuse and oxidize specific targets reversibly. The directionality is H2O2 from enzyme or leak to signal propagation. A caveat is that the same molecule is toxic at higher concentrations, so concentration and compartmentalization determine whether H2O2 signals or damages. Reversible oxidation of target cysteines, such as those in PTP1B and PTEN, allows H2O2 to propagate kinase-dependent responses.
context_zh_TW: Hydrogen peroxide 作為訊號分子，在胰島素訊號、生長因子途徑和免疫反應中充當第二信使。其相對較長的半衰期和膜滲透性使其能夠可逆地擴散和氧化特定標靶。方向性是 H2O2 從酵素或洩漏到訊號傳播。需要注意的是，相同的分子在較高濃度下是有毒的，因此濃度和區室化決定了 H2O2 是否發出訊號或造成損害。目標半胱氨酸（例如 PTP1B 和 PTEN 中的半胱氨酸）的可逆氧化使 H2O2 能夠傳播激酶依賴性反應。

label: oxidizes
context: Hydrogen peroxide oxidizes cysteine thiols, transducing signals through reversible oxidation to sulfenic acid, disulfide, or higher oxides that alter protein activity. This post-translational modification is a core mechanism by which oxidants regulate phosphatases, kinases, and transcription factors. The directionality is oxidant to thiol modification to functional change. A caveat is that excessive or irreversible over-oxidation (sulfinic/sulfonic acid) leads to loss of function and damage rather than signaling.
context_zh_TW: Hydrogen peroxide 氧化 cysteine thiols，透過可逆氧化將訊號轉化成次磺酸、二硫化物或改變蛋白質活性的高級氧化物。這種翻譯後修飾是氧化劑調節磷酸酶、激酶和轉錄因子的核心機制。方向性是氧化劑到硫醇修飾到功能變化。需要注意的是，過度或不可逆的過度氧化（亞磺酸/磺酸）會導致功能喪失和損傷，而不是訊號傳導。

label: are_the_most_reactive
context: Hydroxyl radicals (OH*) are the most reactive and indiscriminately damaging members of the reactive oxygen species family, reacting at near diffusion-limited rates with almost every class of biomolecule. They are not stored or transported but arise locally and instantaneously from hydrogen peroxide via Fenton or Haber-Weiss chemistry in the presence of reduced transition metals. Their directionality is terminal and destructive; they cannot be enzymatically scavenged once formed because they react before diffusing. A caveat is that their extreme reactivity means damage is confined to the site of generation, implicating metal localization as the critical determinant of target selectivity.
context_zh_TW: Hydroxyl radicals (OH*) 是 reactive oxygen species 家族中反應性最強且不加區別的 damaging 成員，幾乎與每一類生物分子都以接近擴散極限的速率發生反應。它們不會被儲存或運輸，而是在還原的過渡金屬存在下透過芬頓或哈伯-韋斯化學從 hydrogen peroxide 本地即時產生。它們的方向性是終極的、具破壞性的；它們一旦形成就不能被酵素清除，因為它們在擴散之前發生反應。需要注意的是，它們的極端反應性意味著損傷僅限於產生部位，這意味著金屬定位是目標選擇性的關鍵決定因素。

label: are_formed_from
context: Hydroxyl radicals are formed from hydrogen peroxide through the Fenton reaction, in which Fe2+ (or Cu+) reduces H2O2 to OH* while being oxidized to Fe3+. This metal-dependent chemistry explains why intracellular free iron is tightly sequestered by ferritin and transferrin. The directionality is from a relatively stable oxidant to the most reactive radical. A caveat is that H2O2 is not intrinsically harmful in the absence of free redox-active metal, so iron availability gates hydroxyl-radical formation.
context_zh_TW: Hydroxyl radicals由hydrogen peroxide透過Fenton reaction形成，其中Fe2+（或Cu+）將H2O2還原為OH*，同時被氧化為Fe3+。這種金屬依賴性化學反應解釋了為什麼細胞內 free iron 被 ferritin 和轉鐵蛋白緊密隔離。方向性是從相對穩定的氧化劑到最具反應性的自由基。需要注意的是，在沒有遊離氧化還原活性金屬的情況下，H2O2 本質上並不有害，因此 iron 的可用性會阻止羥基自由基的形成。

label: causes
context: Hydroxyl radicals cause DNA damage by abstracting hydrogen from the sugar-phosphate backbone, yielding strand breaks, and by adding to bases such as guanine to form 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine. Because they react at the site of generation, damage is tightly localized to where iron and H2O2 coincide, including chromatin-bound iron. The directionality is direct and irreversible without repair. A caveat is that many such lesions are normally repaired efficiently by base-excision repair, so pathology emerges only when damage rate exceeds repair capacity.
context_zh_TW: Hydroxyl radicals 透過從糖-磷酸主鏈中提取氫，產生鏈斷裂，並透過添加鹼基（例如鳥嘌呤）形成 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine 來產生 DNA damage。因為它們在生成位點發生反應，所以損傷緊密位於 iron 和 H2O2 重合的位置，包括染色質結合的 iron。方向性是直接的，不可逆，無需修復。需要注意的是，許多此類損傷通常可以透過鹼基切除修復有效修復，因此只有當損傷率超過修復能力時才會出現病理。

label: causes
context: Hydroxyl radicals cause protein carbonylation, an irreversible oxidative modification introduced when the radical attacks susceptible amino-acid side chains (notably Lys, Arg, Pro, Thr) or when lipid-peroxidation products adduct to proteins. Carbonylated proteins lose function and are targeted for degradation by the 20S proteasome. The directionality is from radical insult to stable, diagnostically useful protein modification. A caveat is that carbonylation is a downstream and cumulative marker rather than an acute, quantitative readout of hydroxyl-radical flux.
context_zh_TW: Hydroxyl radicals 導致 protein carbonylation，這是一種不可逆的氧化修飾，當自由基攻擊易受影響的氨基酸側鏈（特別是 Lys、Arg、Pro、Thr）或脂質過氧化產物加成 proteins 時引入。 Carbonylated proteins 失去功能，成為 20S proteasome 降級的目標。方向性是從徹底的損傷到穩定的、診斷上有用的蛋白質修飾。需要注意的是，羰基化是下游和累積標記，而不是羥基自由基通量的精確定量讀數。

label: contributes_to
context: Hydroxyl radicals contribute to neurodegenerative diseases because redox-active iron accumulates in vulnerable regions such as the substantia nigra, where Fenton chemistry generates hydroxyl radicals locally. This regional iron burden correlates with oxidative damage to dopaminergic neurons and alpha-synuclein nitration and aggregation. The directionality is metal-catalyzed radical formation driving neuronal injury. A caveat is that oxidative damage is one component of a multifactorial degenerative process and may be downstream of protein misfolding and mitochondrial failure rather than solely initiating them.
context_zh_TW: Hydroxyl radicals 對 neurodegenerative diseases 有貢獻，因為氧化還原活性 iron 積聚在黑質等脆弱區域，芬頓化學在黑質中局部生成 hydroxyl radicals。這種區域性 iron 負擔與 dopaminergic 神經元的氧化損傷以及 alpha-synuclein 硝化和聚集有關。方向性是金屬催化的自由基形成驅動神經元損傷。需要注意的是，氧化損傷是多因素退化過程的一個組成部分，並且可能是蛋白質錯誤折疊和 mitochondria1 失敗的下游，而不是僅僅引發它們。

label: initiates
context: Hydroxyl radicals initiate lipid peroxidation by abstracting a hydrogen atom from the bis-allylic methylene of polyunsaturated fatty acids, seeding the radical chain that destroys cell membranes. Once a lipid radical forms, propagation proceeds autocatalytically even after the initiating hydroxyl radical is gone. The directionality is from a locally generated radical to rapid, spreading membrane damage. A caveat is that membrane vitamin E and CoQ10 can terminate the chain, so outcome depends on the local antioxidant milieu.
context_zh_TW: Hydroxyl radicals 透過從 polyunsaturated fatty acids 的雙烯丙基亞甲基中提取一個氫原子來啟動 lipid peroxidation，播下破壞細胞膜的自由基鏈。一旦脂質自由基形成，即使在引發的羥基自由基消失後，傳播也會自動進行。方向性是從局部產生的自由基到快速擴散的膜損傷。需要注意的是，膜 vitamin E 和 CoQ10 可以終止該鏈，因此結果取決於局部抗氧化環境。

label: inhibits
context: Hydroxyurea acts as a free radical scavenger that quenches the tyrosyl radical in the R2 subunit of ribonucleotide reductase, preventing conversion of ribonucleoside diphosphates to deoxyribonucleoside diphosphates. This causes rapid depletion of intracellular dNTP pools.
context_zh_TW: Hydroxyurea 作為自由基清除劑，淬滅 ribonucleotide reductase R2 亞基中的酪氨酰自由基，阻止核糖核苷二磷酸轉化為去氧核糖核苷二磷酸。這造成細胞內 dNTP 池的快速耗竭。

label: is_inhibited_by
context: Hydroxyurea is a radical scavenger that reduces or quenches the tyrosyl radical in RRM2, inactivating ribonucleotide reductase. This is the basis of its use in myeloproliferative neoplasms and as an experimental inducer of DNA replication stress and senescence.
context_zh_TW: Hydroxyurea 是自由基清除劑，會還原或淬滅 RRM2 中的酪胺醯自由基，使核醣核苷酸還原酶失活。這是其在骨髓增生性腫瘤中使用、以及作為 DNA 複製壓力與衰老實驗性誘導劑的基礎。

label: is_inhibited_by
context: Hydroxyurea quenches the tyrosyl radical in the RRM2 small subunit of ribonucleotide reductase, inactivating the enzyme. It is used clinically in myeloproliferative neoplasms and is a canonical inducer of DNA replication stress and senescence.
context_zh_TW: Hydroxyurea 會淬滅核醣核苷酸還原酶 RRM2 小次單元中的酪胺醯自由基，使酵素失活。它在臨床上用於骨髓增生性腫瘤，並是 DNA 複製壓力與衰老的典型誘導劑。

label: represses_transcription_of
context: Hyperactivated SMAD3 binds the 3'-UTR of the TFEB gene and inhibits its transcription, reducing lysosomal biogenesis and autophagic flux during fibrosis. Directionally, SMAD3 sits upstream of TFEB repression. This links TGF-β1 signaling to impaired autophagy and waste clearance, contributing to the accumulation of damaged components in fibrotic tissue. Sirtuin modulation of SMAD3 can therefore influence TFEB-dependent homeostasis, and sirtuins such as SIRT6 and SIRT7 that restrain SMAD3 may indirectly preserve TFEB expression. This connection between TGF-β signaling and autophagic capacity is relevant to both fibrosis and aging.
context_zh_TW: 過度活化的 SMAD3 結合 TFEB 基因的 3'-UTR 並抑制其轉錄，在纖維化期間減少溶酶體生物合成和自噬通量。在方向性上，SMAD3 位於 TFEB 抑制的上游。這將 TGF-β1 訊號與自噬和廢物清除受損聯繫起來，導致纖維化組織中受損組件的積累。因此 sirtuin 對 SMAD3 的調控可以影響 TFEB 依賴性的恆定性，而如 SIRT6 和 SIRT7 等抑制 SMAD3 的 sirtuin 可能間接維護 TFEB 表達。TGF-β 訊號和自噬能力之間的這種聯繫與纖維化和衰老都相關。

label: increases
context: Hyperglycemia increases the glycation process, which is especially apparent in insulin-independent tissues such as red blood cells, peripheral nerve tissue cells, endothelial cells, eye lens cells, and kidney cells. Elevated glucose concentrations accelerate the first step of the Maillard reaction, and accumulation of advanced glycation end products is higher during high glucose conditions. Glycation of proteolytic enzymes in diabetes may also reduce their efficiency, resulting in greater build-up of glycated end products. This glucose-driven acceleration of glycation helps explain why AGE levels rise in poorly controlled diabetes and why AGEs are linked to diabetic complications.
context_zh_TW: 高血糖會增加糖化過程，此現象在胰島素非依賴性組織中特別明顯，例如紅血球、周邊神經組織細胞、內皮細胞、水晶體細胞與腎細胞。升高的葡萄糖濃度會加速梅納反應（Maillard reaction）的第一步，且晚期糖化終產物的堆積在高葡萄糖條件下更高。糖尿病中蛋白水解酶的糖化也可能降低其效率，導致糖化終產物更大量堆積。這種葡萄糖驅動的糖化加速有助於解釋為何 AGE 濃度在控制不良的糖尿病中上升，以及為何 AGE 與糖尿病併發症相關。

label: accelerates
context: Hyperglycemia strongly accelerates the non-enzymatic glycation of proteins, because higher glucose concentrations drive the reaction of sugar carbonyl groups with protein amino groups. The glycation reaction is highly accelerated in the presence of hyperglycemia and tissue oxidative stress, which is why AGE formation is a hallmark of diabetes and its complications. AGEs form in hyperglycemic conditions and/or during the natural process of aging, and high glucose environments such as 40 mM glucose in C. elegans shorten lifespan while increasing AGE content. Glycemic control through diet or exercise is therefore a key strategy for limiting AGE accumulation.
context_zh_TW: Hyperglycemia 強烈加速蛋白質的非酵素 glycation，因為較高的 glucose concentrations 驅動 sugar carbonyl groups 與蛋白質 amino groups 的反應。Glycation reaction 在 hyperglycemia 與組織 oxidative stress 存在下大幅加速，這就是為何 AGE formation 是 diabetes 及其 complications 的標誌。AGEs 在 hyperglycemic conditions 和/或自然 aging 過程中形成，而 high glucose environments（如 C. elegans 中的 40 mM glucose）會縮短壽命同時增加 AGE content。因此，透過 diet 或 exercise 控制血糖是限制 AGE accumulation 的關鍵策略。

label: chlorinates
context: Hypochlorous acid chlorinates tyrosine to form 3-chlorotyrosine, a stable adduct that is a specific biomarker of myeloperoxidase activity in vivo. Its presence marks HOCl exposure in inflamed tissues. The directionality is HOCl to chlorinated protein residue. A caveat is that 3-chlorotyrosine reflects historical MPO activity and can be turned over with protein degradation, so it is an integrative rather than instantaneous marker. 3-chlorotyrosine levels rise in atherosclerotic plaques, pneumonia, and other inflammatory conditions, supporting its use as a clinical research biomarker.
context_zh_TW: Hypochlorous acid 氯化 tyrosine 形成 3-chlorotyrosine，這是一種穩定的加合物，是體內 myeloperoxidase 活性的特定生物標記。它的存在標誌著發炎組織中的次氯酸暴露。方向性是 HOCl 到氯化蛋白質殘基。需要注意的是，3-chlorotyrosine 反映了歷史 MPO 活性，並且可以隨著蛋白質降解而翻轉，因此它是一個綜合標記，而不是瞬時標記。 3-chlorotyrosine 水平在 atheros 硬化斑塊、肺炎和其他發炎性疾病中升高，支持其用作臨床研究生物標記。

label: depletes
context: Hypochlorous acid depletes glutathione because GSH is rapidly oxidized by HOCl to glutathione sulfonamide and disulfides, consuming the major cellular antioxidant. This leaves cells vulnerable to further oxidative insult. The directionality is HOCl to thiol consumption. A caveat is that other oxidants also drain GSH, and the disulfide products can be partially recycled by the thioredoxin and glutaredoxin systems. Because GSH is a major target, HOCl exposure rapidly overwhelms the thiol redox buffer and sensitizes cells to secondary oxidative injury.
context_zh_TW: Hypochlorous acid 會消耗 glutathione，因為 GSH 被 HOCl 快速氧化為 glutathione 磺酰胺和二硫化物，消耗主要的細胞抗氧化劑。這使得細胞容易受到進一步的氧化損傷。方向性是 HOCl 到硫醇的消耗。需要注意的是，其他氧化劑也會消耗穀胱甘肽，而二硫化物產物可以被硫氧還蛋白和穀氧還蛋白系統部分回收。由於 GSH 是主要目標，HOCl 暴露會迅速淹沒硫醇氧化還原緩衝液，並使細胞對繼發性氧化損傷敏感。

label: inactivates
context: Hypochlorous acid inactivates alpha-1 antitrypsin by oxidizing critical residues, especially methionine, abolishing its ability to inhibit neutrophil elastase. In COPD and similar conditions this unleashes unopposed proteolysis that destroys lung matrix. The directionality is HOCl to serpin inactivation to tissue damage. A caveat is that cigarette smoke and other oxidants also inactivate alpha-1 antitrypsin, so HOCl is one of several mechanisms. The same oxidative inactivation contributes to emphysema in cigarette smokers, where neutrophil-derived HOCl meets a poorly protected lung interstitium.
context_zh_TW: Hypochlorous acid 透過氧化關鍵殘基（尤其是蛋胺酸）使 alpha-1 antitrypsin 失去活性，從而消除其抑制嗜中性球彈性蛋白酶的能力。在慢性阻塞性肺病和類似的情況下，這會釋放出不受對抗的蛋白質分解作用，從而破壞肺基質。方向性是 HOCl 至絲胺酸蛋白酶抑制劑失活至組織損傷。需要注意的是，cigarette smoke 和其他氧化劑也會使 alpha-1 antitrypsin 失活，因此 HOCl 是多種機制之一。同樣的氧化失活會導致 cigarette smokers 中的肺氣腫，其中中性粒細胞衍生的次氯酸與保護不良的肺間質相遇。

label: is_generated_by
context: Hypochlorous acid is generated by myeloperoxidase, which uses H2O2 and chloride to produce HOCl in activated neutrophils and monocytes. This reaction concentrates a potent oxidant at infection and inflammatory sites. The directionality is MPO catalysis to HOCl formation. A caveat is that MPO can also use bromide and other halides, so related hypohalous acids are produced alongside HOCl. Because HOCl is produced only in proximity to MPO, the appearance of its chlorinated products such as 3-chlorotyrosine is a highly specific footprint of MPO activity in vivo.
context_zh_TW: Hypochlorous acid 由 myeloperoxidase 生成，myeloperoxidase 使用 H2O2 和氯化物在活化的嗜中性球和單核球產生 HOCl。此反應在感染和發炎部位濃縮了強效氧化劑。方向性是 MPO 催化 HOCl 的形成。要注意的是，MPO 還可以使用溴化物和其他鹵化物，因此相關的次鹵酸會與 HOCl 一起產生。由於 HOCl 僅在 MPO 附近產生，因此其氯化產物（例如 3-chlorotyrosine）的出現是 MPO 體內活性的高度特異性足跡。

label: is_the_primary_microbicidal_oxidant_of
context: Hypochlorous acid is the primary microbicidal oxidant of the innate immune system, killing pathogens through widespread oxidation of thiols, amines, and proteins in microbes. Its potency makes it central to neutrophil host defense. The directionality is HOCl to microbial killing. A caveat is that HOCl is non-selective and, when extrapolated beyond the phagolysosome, damages host tissues and proteins, contributing to inflammatory injury. Defects in MPO impair HOCl production and, although compensated in most patients, illustrate the enzyme's central role in oxidant-mediated killing.
context_zh_TW: Hypochlorous acid 是 innate immune system 的主要殺菌氧化劑，透過微生物中硫醇、胺和 proteins 的廣泛氧化來殺死病原體。它的效力使其成為中性粒細胞宿主防禦的核心。方向性是次氯酸對微生物的殺滅作用。需要注意的是，HOCl 是非選擇性的，當外推到吞噬溶小體之外時，會損害宿主組織和 proteins，導致發炎損傷。 MPO 的缺陷會損害 HOCl 的產生，儘管在大多數患者中得到補償，但說明了該酶在氧化劑介導的殺傷中的核心作用。

label: produces
context: Hypoxia-reoxygenation produces a ROS burst in rheumatoid arthritis synovium analogous to ischemia-reperfusion, as restored oxygen fuels mitochondrial and enzymatic ROS after hypoxic epochs. This oxidant surge perpetuates synovial inflammation and joint damage. The directionality is reoxygenation to ROS burst in joint tissue. A caveat is that RA synovium is also hypoxic because of high metabolic and infiltrating-cell demand, so the cycle is sustained rather than episodic. This mechanism may explain the vulnerability of the inflamed joint to intermittent blood flow and oxidative injury.
context_zh_TW: Hypoxia-reoxygenation 在類風濕性關節炎滑膜中產生 ROS 爆發，類似於缺血再灌注，因為缺氧時期後恢復的氧氣為 mitochondria1 和酶促 ROS 提供燃料。這種氧化劑激增會導致滑膜發炎和關節損傷持續存在。方向性是關節組織中ROS爆發的再氧合。需要注意的是，由於高代謝和浸潤細胞的需求，RA 滑膜也會缺氧，因此循環是持續的而不是間歇性的。這種機制可以解釋發炎關節對間歇性血流和氧化損傷的脆弱性。

label: introduces
context: I-PpoI recognizes and cleaves a specific 15-20 base-pair sequence within rRNA gene repeats, generating sequence-specific double-strand breaks. Directionally, I-PpoI sits upstream of targeted double-strand-break formation. Its specificity makes it ideal for the ICE Mouse's controlled damage, and this enables reproducible epigenetic-aging studies. Because I-PpoI cleaves at a defined sequence, researchers can induce breaks at known genomic loci in a controlled manner. This precision distinguishes the ICE Mouse from treatments that cause random DNA damage, allowing the isolation of repair-driven effects.
context_zh_TW: I-PpoI 識別並切割 rRNA 基因重複序列中的特定 15-20 基鹼對序列，產生序列特異性的雙鏈斷裂。在方向性上，I-PpoI 位於靶向雙鏈斷裂形成的上游。其特異性使其成為 ICE 小鼠受控損傷的理想工具，實現可重複的表觀遺傳衰老研究。由於 I-PpoI 在確定的序列處切割，研究人員可以在已知的基因組位點以受控方式誘導斷裂。這種精確性區別了 ICE 小鼠與造成隨機 DNA 損傷的處理，允許分離修復驅動的效應。

label: mutated_in
context: ICF syndrome (Immunodeficiency, Centromere instability, and Facial anomalies) is a rare autosomal recessive disorder caused by mutations in the DNMT3B gene. Loss of DNMT3b activity leads to hypomethylation of pericentromeric satellite repeats and juxtacentromeric regions, resulting in centromeric decondensation, chromosome instability, and characteristic chromosomal abnormalities in stimulated lymphocytes. The disease manifests as combined immunodeficiency with reduced immunoglobulin levels, facial dysmorphism, and developmental delay.
context_zh_TW: ICF 症候群（免疫缺陷、著絲粒不穩定和臉部異常）是一種罕見的體染色體隱性遺傳疾病，由 DNMT3B 基因突變引起。 DNMT3b 活性的喪失會導致著絲粒周圍衛星重複序列和近著絲粒區域的低甲基化，從而導致著絲粒脫縮、染色體不穩定以及受刺激的淋巴細胞中的特徵性染色體異常。此疾病表現為聯合免疫缺陷，伴隨免疫球蛋白水平降低、臉部畸形和發育遲緩。

label: activates
context: IKK activates NFκB. IKK is the kinase complex that phosphorylates I-kappaB to free NF-kappaB, linking upstream inflammatory signals to survival transcription. NF-kappaB is a pleiotropic transcription factor that, when constitutively active, drives proliferation, survival, inflammation, and therapy resistance. The relationship is directional, with IKK acting as the operative agent upon NFκB rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: IKK 活化 NFκB。 IKK 是將 I-kappaB 磷酸化為遊離 NF-kappaB 的激酶複合物，將上游發炎訊號與生存轉錄聯繫起來。 NF-kappaB 是一種多效性轉錄因子，當其持續活躍時，可驅動增殖、存活、發炎和治療抵抗。這種關係是定向的，IKK 充當 NFκB 的操作劑，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: is_activated_in
context: IKK is activated in Cancer. IKK is the kinase complex that phosphorylates I-kappaB to free NF-kappaB, linking upstream inflammatory signals to survival transcription. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward IKK, so Cancer is the active agent and IKK the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: IKK 在 Cancer 中活化。 IKK 是將 I-kappaB 磷酸化為遊離 NF-kappaB 的激酶複合物，將上游發炎訊號與生存轉錄聯繫起來。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 向 IKK，因此 Cancer 是活性劑，IKK 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: amplifies
context: IL-1a is an apical SASP amplifier that sits at the top of the inflammatory cascade, and its cleavage by caspase-5 or calpain is essential for full SASP regulatory function. Cell-surface and secreted IL-1a engage IL-1R, activating MyD88-NF-kB signaling that sustains the SASP and induces paracrine senescence, and it also induces downstream factors such as CCL20 and Activin A. It is thus a master initiator rather than merely a component of the secretome. Its centrality makes IL-1a a key mechanistic and therapeutic node in senescence-associated inflammation.
context_zh_TW: IL-1α 是位於發炎級聯頂端的頂層 SASP 放大器，其經 caspase-5 或 calpain 的切割對完整 SASP 調節功能必要。細胞表面與分泌的 IL-1α 接合 IL-1R，活化 MyD88-NF-κB 訊號，維持 SASP 並誘發旁分泌衰老，且也誘發 CCL20 與 Activin A 等下游因子。因此它視為主要啟動者而非僅分泌組成分。其中心性使 IL-1α 成為衰老相關發炎的關鍵機制與治療節點。

label: is_composed_of
context: IL-1a is an apical SASP amplifier that sits at the top of the inflammatory cascade, and its proteolytic cleavage (by caspase-5 or calpain) is essential for full SASP regulatory function. Cell-surface and secreted IL-1a engage IL-1R on neighboring cells, activating MyD88-dependent NF-kB signaling that both sustains the SASP in the sender and induces paracrine senescence in recipients. As a master initiator rather than a passive component, IL-1a integrates with the noncanonical inflammasome, whose caspase-5 cleavage licenses the secretome. Its centrality makes IL-1a a key mechanistic and therapeutic node.
context_zh_TW: IL-1α 是位於發炎級聯頂端的頂層 SASP 放大器，其蛋白水解切割（由 caspase-5 或 calpain）對完整 SASP 調節功能不可或缺。細胞表面與分泌的 IL-1α 接合鄰近細胞的 IL-1R，活化 MyD88 依賴的 NF-κB 訊號，既維持傳送者的 SASP 又誘發受體者的旁分泌衰老。作為主要啟動者而非被動組成，IL-1α 與非典型發炎體整合，後者的 caspase-5 切割許可分泌組。其中心性使 IL-1α 成為關鍵的機制與治療節點。

label: activates
context: IL-1beta activates NF-kappaB via MyD88-dependent signaling upon binding its receptor IL-1R1, amplifying expression of inflammatory genes. This places IL-1beta upstream of a central inflammatory transcription factor. The directionality is cytokine to NF-kappaB activation. A caveat is that IL-1beta itself is an NF-kappaB target, so the loop is reinforcing rather than linear, and IL-1ra can dampen it. The resulting amplification loop is a target of anti-inflammatory biologics and explains the broad effects of IL-1 blockade in chronic disease.
context_zh_TW: IL-1beta 在結合其受體 IL-1R1 後，透過 MyD88 依賴性訊號傳導活化 NF-kappaB，從而放大發炎基因的表達。這將 IL-1beta 置於中央發炎轉錄因子的上游。方向性是細胞激素對 NF-κB 活化的影響。需要注意的是，IL-1beta 本身是 NF-kappaB 靶標，因此環是增強的而不是線性的，而 IL-1ra 可以抑制它。由此產生的放大環是抗發炎生物製劑的目標，並解釋了 IL-1 阻斷在慢性疾病中的廣泛影響。

label: reduces
context: IL-1beta inhibition with canakinumab reduces cardiovascular events, as the CANTOS trial showed fewer recurrent myocardial infarction, stroke, and cardiovascular death independent of lipid lowering. This validated inflammation (not just LDL) as a treatment target. The directionality is IL-1beta blockade to lower CVD events. A caveat is that the trial also showed increased infection risk and that not all patients benefited, indicating a selected responder population. The results of CANTOS established the inflammatory hypothesis of atherosclerosis and opened the door to targeted immunomodulation for CVD.
context_zh_TW: 卡那奴單抗抑制 IL-1beta 會降低 cardiovascular events，因為 CANTOS 試驗顯示，與降血脂無關的複發性心肌梗塞、中風和心血管死亡較少。這驗證了發炎（不僅僅是低密度脂蛋白）作為治療目標。方向性是IL-1beta封鎖以降低CVD事件。需要注意的是，該試驗還顯示感染風險增加，並且並非所有患者都受益，這表明特定的反應族群。 CANTOS的結果建立了atherosclerosis的發炎假說，為CVD的標靶免疫調節打開了大門。

label: is_upregulated_in
context: IL6 is a representative SASP gene whose expression is suppressed upon mitochondrial clearance, with coordinated decreases in chromatin acetylation at its locus and mRNA expression. Acetate supplementation induces expression of IL6 alongside IL8, IL1B and CCL2, while MPC1 deletion or SLC25A1 inhibition reduces these factors. In aged mice, CTPI2 treatment reduces expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines including Il6 and Il1b in skeletal muscle, and their expression negatively correlates with muscle strength, indicating that mitochondrial acetyl-CoA-dependent histone acetylation gates the secretion of IL-6 as part of the senescent inflammatory programme.
context_zh_TW: IL6 是具代表性的 SASP 基因，其表現會隨粒線體清除而受到抑制，其基因座上的染色質乙醯化與 mRNA 表現同步下降。乙酸補充會誘導 IL6 與 IL8、IL1B 及 CCL2 一同表現，而 MPC1 缺失或 SLC25A1 抑制則會降低這些因子。在老年小鼠中，CTPI2 治療降低骨骼肌中包括 Il6 與 Il1b 在內的促發炎細胞激素表現，且其表現與肌肉力量呈負相關，顯示粒線體乙醯-CoA 依賴的組蛋白乙醯化調控著 IL-6 作為衰老發炎程式一部分的分泌。

label: includes
context: Immune Checkpoint includes PD-L1. Immune checkpoints are physiological brakes on lymphocyte responses that cancers hijack to avoid immune destruction. PD-L1 is an immune-checkpoint ligand expressed by tumor and stromal cells that engages PD-1 on T cells to suppress antitumor immunity. The relationship is directional, with Immune Checkpoint acting as the operative agent upon PD-L1 rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context_zh_TW: Immune Checkpoint 包括PD-L1。這是對淋巴細胞反應的生理制動，癌症劫持淋巴細胞反應以避免免疫破壞。 PD-L1 是一種由腫瘤和基質細胞表達的免疫檢查點配體，可與 T 細胞上的 PD-1 結合以抑制抗腫瘤免疫。這種關係是有方向的，Immune Checkpoint 充當 PD-L1 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: is_co_opted_by
context: Immune Checkpoint is co-opted by Cancer. Immune checkpoints are physiological brakes on lymphocyte responses that cancers hijack to avoid immune destruction. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward Immune Checkpoint, so Cancer is the active agent and Immune Checkpoint the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: Immune Checkpoint 被 Cancer 增選。這是對淋巴細胞反應的生理制動，癌症劫持淋巴細胞反應以避免免疫破壞。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 向 Immune Checkpoint，因此 Cancer 是活性劑，Immune Checkpoint 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: is_targeted_by
context: Immune Checkpoint is targeted by Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors. Immune checkpoints are physiological brakes on lymphocyte responses that cancers hijack to avoid immune destruction. Immune checkpoint inhibitors are antibodies that release the brakes on T cells by blocking PD-1/PD-L1 or CTLA-4 interactions. The directionality runs from Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors toward Immune Checkpoint, so Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors is the active agent and Immune Checkpoint the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
context_zh_TW: Immune Checkpoint 是 Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors 的目標。這是對淋巴細胞反應的生理制動，癌症劫持淋巴細胞反應以避免免疫破壞。 Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors 是透過阻斷 PD-1/PD-L1 或 CTLA-4 交互作用來釋放 T 細胞煞車作用的抗體。方向性從 Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors 向 Immune Checkpoint 延伸，因此 Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors 是活性劑，Immune Checkpoint 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

label: bidirectionally_linked_with
context: Immunoglobulin G and Neuromelanin are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Immunoglobulin G and Neuromelanin may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
context_zh_TW: Immunoglobulin G 和 Neuromelanin 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Immunoglobulin G 和 Neuromelanin 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: impaired_in
context: Impaired mitophagy is a common feature of several neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, ALS, and Huntington's disease. In these disorders, the accumulation of damaged mitochondria exacerbates oxidative stress, metabolic disruption, and neuronal death. Defects can arise from mutations in PINK1 or Parkin, from tau or amyloid-beta pathology, or from disrupted transport of autophagosomes. Restoring mitophagy is therefore a major therapeutic goal for neuroprotection.
context_zh_TW: Mitophagy 受損是多種神經退化性疾病的常見特徵，包括阿茲海默症、帕金森氏症、ALS 和亨丁頓氏症。在這些疾病中，受損粒線體的累積加劇氧化壓力、代謝紊亂和神經元死亡。缺陷可源於 PINK1 或 Parkin 突變、tau 或 amyloid-beta 病理，或自噬體運輸受擾。因此恢復 mitophagy 是神經保護的主要治療目標。

label: contributes_to
context: Impairment of mitochondrial dynamics contributes to various cardiovascular pathologies, including cardiac hypertrophy, heart failure, ischemia-reperfusion injury, and metabolic and genetic cardiomyopathy. In heart failure, mitochondrial fragmentation, vacuolar degeneration with decreased mitochondrial size and crista destruction are detected by electron microscopy alongside increased expression of DRP1, FIS1 and BNIP3 and decreased MFN1, MFN2 and OPA1. Excessive mitochondrial division with insufficient fusion is a common disease pattern, yet conflicting evidence exists, such as DRP1-knockout exacerbating myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury.
context_zh_TW: Impairment of mitochondrial dynamics contributes to various cardiovascular pathologies, including cardiac hypertrophy, heart failure, ischemia-reperfusion injury, and metabolic and genetic cardiomyopathy。In heart failure, mitochondrial fragmentation, vacuolar degeneration with decreased mitochondrial size and crista destruction are detected by electron microscopy alongside increased expression of DRP1, FIS1 and BNIP3 and decreased MFN1, MFN2 and OPA1。Excessive mitochondrial division with insufficient fusion is a common disease pattern, yet conflicting evidence exists, such as DRP1-knockout exacerbating myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury。

label: discovered
context: In 2003, Sinclair showed resveratrol extends yeast lifespan via Sir2 and later demonstrated parallel effects in higher organisms, discovering it as the first STAC. Directionally, the discovery sits upstream of the STAC concept. This catalyzed decades of sirtuin-drug development, and it remains a seminal finding in geroscience. By identifying a natural compound that activates sirtuins, Sinclair provided the prototype for pharmacologically engaging longevity pathways. The STAC concept has since driven the search for more potent and specific sirtuin activators for therapeutic use.
context_zh_TW: 2003 年，Sinclair 展示 resveratrol 透過 Sir2 延長酵母壽命，後來在高等生物中展示了類似效應，將其發現為第一個 STAC。在方向性上，此發現位於 STAC 概念的上游。這催化了數十年的 sirtuin 藥物開發，至今仍是老年科學的開創性發現。透過鑑定一種活化 sirtuin 的天然化合物，Sinclair 為藥理學地介入長壽途徑提供了原型。STAC 概念自那以後推動了尋找更強效和更具選擇性的 sirtuin 活化劑用於治療。

label: deacetylates
context: In Alzheimer's disease, SIRT3 enhances mitochondrial bioenergetics disrupted by amyloid-beta toxicity, partially through deacetylation of mitochondrial p53 at Lys320, a modification crucial for maintaining energy homeostasis and neuronal survival.
