label: regulates
context: MC1R regulates the melanogenic pathway by switching Melanocytes from pheomelanin to eumelanin synthesis. Upon binding alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone, MC1R signals via Gs to stimulate adenylyl cyclase and cAMP, activating the eumelanogenic program in Melanogenesis. Loss-of-function variants reduce signaling and shift synthesis toward Pheomelanin.
context_zh_TW: MC1R 透過將 Melanocytes 從 pheomelanin 合成切換為 eumelanin 合成來調節黑色素生成途徑。在結合 alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone 後，MC1R 透過 Gs 發出信號以刺激 adenylyl cyclase 和 cAMP，啟動 Melanogenesis 中的 eumelanogenic 程序。功能缺失變異會降低信號傳導並使合成轉向 Pheomelanin。

label: promotes_expression_of
context: MCPIP1 (monocyte chemoattractant protein-induced protein 1), an RNase, alleviates inflammatory responses by promoting SIRT1 expression through modulation of miR-9. Directionally, MCPIP1 sits upstream of increased SIRT1. Higher SIRT1 then suppresses NF-κB-driven inflammation, creating an anti-inflammatory circuit centered on SIRT1 induction. MCPIP1's RNase activity degrades specific microRNAs and mRNAs, and its regulation of the miR-9/SIRT1 axis illustrates how RNA-binding proteins can control sirtuin abundance. This pathway is relevant to chronic inflammation, where MCPIP1 levels are altered in macrophages and other immune cells.
context_zh_TW: MCPIP1（單核細胞趨化蛋白誘導蛋白 1）是一種 RNase，通過調節 miR-9 來促進 SIRT1 表達，從而減輕發炎反應。在方向性上，MCPIP1 位於增加的 SIRT1 上游。更高的 SIRT1 然後抑制 NF-κB 驅動的發炎，形成一個以 SIRT1 誘導為中心的抗發炎電路。MCPIP1 的 RNase 活性降解特定的微小 RNA 和 mRNA，其對 miR-9/SIRT1 軸的調節說明了 RNA 結合蛋白如何控制 sirtuin 表達量。此通路與慢性發炎相關，在巨噬細胞和其他免疫細胞中 MCPIP1 水平發生改變。

label: activates
context: MDL-800 is a bis-benzenesulfonamide prodrug and potent, selective SIRT6 activator, with an EC50 of 10.3 μM, that stimulates SIRT6 deacetylase activity. Directionally, MDL-800 allosterically activates SIRT6. It mirrors UBCS039 but with greater potency and cell permeability, mitigating kidney fibrosis and tumor glycolysis in preclinical models. It is a lead chemical tool for SIRT6 biology, and its improved potency and selectivity make it well suited for in vivo studies of SIRT6 activation, supporting the therapeutic potential of pharmacologic SIRT6 engagement.
context_zh_TW: MDL-800 是一種雙苯磺酰胺前藥和強效選擇性 SIRT6 活化因子，EC50 為 10.3 μM，刺激 SIRT6 去乙醯酶活性。在方向性上，MDL-800 變構活化 SIRT6。它類似於 UBCS039 但具有更高的效力和細胞滲透性，在臨床前模型中減輕腎纖維化和腫瘤糖解。它是 SIRT6 生物學的先導化學工具，其改善的效力和選擇性使其非常適合 SIRT6 活化的體內研究，支持藥理性 SIRT6 參與的治療潛力。

label: activates_allosteric
context: MDL-801 is a potent, cell-permeable synthetic allosteric activator of SIRT6 that binds the hydrophobic pocket and stimulates its deacetylase activity with an EC50 of approximately 10.3 μM. Directionally, MDL-801 sits upstream of SIRT6 activation. It mirrors UBCS039 but with greater potency and cell permeability, and it mitigates kidney fibrosis while suppressing glycolytic, tumor-promoting metabolism. Its improved properties make it a valuable tool for studying SIRT6-dependent pathways in vivo, and it supports the broader thesis that pharmacologic SIRT6 activation can reproduce the metabolic and genome-protective benefits of SIRT6 overexpression.
context_zh_TW: MDL-801 是一種強效的、細胞可滲透的合成 SIRT6 變構活化因子，結合疏水口袋並以約 10.3 μM 的 EC50 刺激其去乙醯酶活性。在方向性上，MDL-801 位於 SIRT6 活化的上游。它類似於 UBCS039 但具有更高的效力和細胞滲透性，在抑制糖解、促腫瘤代謝的同時減輕腎纖維化。其改善的特性使其成為在體內研究 SIRT6 依賴性通路的有價值工具，並支持藥理性 SIRT6 活化可以重現 SIRT6 過量表達的代謝和基因組保護益處的更廣泛論點。

label: blocks
context: MDM2 blocks p53. MDM2 is the principal E3 ubiquitin ligase and transcriptional antagonist that keeps p53 quiescent in unstressed cells. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. The relationship is directional, with MDM2 acting as the operative agent upon p53 rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context_zh_TW: MDM2塊p53。 MDM2 是主要的 E3 泛素連接酶和轉錄拮抗劑，可使 p53 在未受壓力的細胞中保持靜止狀態。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。這種關係是有方向的，MDM2 充當 p53 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: is_amplified_in
context: MDM2 is amplified in Cancer. MDM2 is the principal E3 ubiquitin ligase and transcriptional antagonist that keeps p53 quiescent in unstressed cells. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward MDM2, so Cancer is the active agent and MDM2 the recipient of the effect. This altered abundance or activity is a recurring feature of malignancy that can serve as a diagnostic, prognostic, or predictive biomarker and sometimes as a therapeutic target.
context_zh_TW: MDM2 在 Cancer 中被放大。 MDM2 是主要的 E3 泛素連接酶和轉錄拮抗劑，可使 p53 在未受壓力的細胞中保持靜止狀態。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 向 MDM2，因此 Cancer 是活性劑，MDM2 是效果的接受者。這種豐度或活性的改變是惡性腫瘤的一個反覆出現的特徵，可以作為診斷、預後或預測生物標記物，有時還可以作為治療標靶。

label: is_inhibited_by
context: MDM2 is inhibited by Nutlins. MDM2 is the principal E3 ubiquitin ligase and transcriptional antagonist that keeps p53 quiescent in unstressed cells. Nutlins are cis-imidazoline small molecules that block the MDM2-p53 interface, stabilizing p53 to enforce arrest or apoptosis. The directionality runs from Nutlins toward MDM2, so Nutlins is the active agent and MDM2 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context_zh_TW: MDM2 被 Nutlins 抑制。 MDM2 是主要的 E3 泛素連接酶和轉錄拮抗劑，可使 p53 在未受壓力的細胞中保持靜止狀態。 Nutlins 是順式咪唑啉小分子，可阻斷 MDM2-p53 界面，穩定 p53 強制抑製或凋亡。方向性從 Nutlins 朝向 MDM2，因此 Nutlins 是活性劑，MDM2 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: degrades
context: MDM2 relates to p53 through the relation degrades. MDM2 is the principal E3 ubiquitin ligase and transcriptional antagonist that keeps p53 quiescent in unstressed cells. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context_zh_TW: MDM2 透過關係降級與 p53 相關。 MDM2 是主要的 E3 泛素連接酶和轉錄拮抗劑，可使 p53 在未受壓力的細胞中保持靜止狀態。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

label: catalyzes
context: METTL3 is the catalytic subunit of the methyltransferase complex that deposits N6-methyladenosine (m6A), the most abundant internal modification of messenger RNA in mammalian cells. Together with the adaptor protein METTL14, METTL3 methylates the N6 position of adenosine in mRNA, and the resulting m6A mark regulates RNA stability, splicing, translation, and export. Beyond its RNA-methylation role, the METTL3-METTL14 complex also facilitates senescence-associated enhancer-promoter contacts and SASP expression in oncogene-induced senescence.
context_zh_TW: METTL3 是甲基轉移酶複合物的催化亞基，可沉積 N6-methyladenosine (m6A)，N6-methyladenosine (m6A) 是哺乳動物細胞中最豐富的信使 RNA 內部修飾。 METTL3 與接頭蛋白 METTL14 一起甲基化 mRNA 中腺苷的 N6 位點，產生的 m6A 標記可調節 RNA 穩定性、剪接、翻譯和輸出。除了其 RNA 甲基化作用外，METTL3-METTL14 複合物還促進衰老相關的增強子-啟動子接觸以及癌基因誘導衰老中的 SASP 表達。

label: promotes
context: METTL3 promotes the senescence-associated secretory phenotype through its role in the METTL3-METTL14 complex, which redistributes across the genome during oncogene-induced senescence. Despite being best known for depositing the m6A RNA modification, the complex promotes SASP expression through chromatin looping and enhancer-promoter contacts in an enzymatic activity-independent manner. This redistribution facilitates the hyper-connected enhancer-promoter network that drives robust expression of SASP genes, linking RNA-modifying proteins to the chromatin changes of senescence.
context_zh_TW: METTL3 透過其在 METTL3-METTL14 複合物中的作用促進衰老相關的分泌表型，該複合物在癌基因誘導的衰老過程中在基因組中重新分佈。儘管該複合物以沉積 m6A RNA 修飾而聞名，但該複合物透過染色質環和增強子-啟動子接觸以獨立於酶活性的方式促進 SASP 表達。這種重新分佈促進了超連接的增強子-啟動子網絡，驅動 SASP 基因的穩健表達，將 RNA 修飾蛋白與老化的染色質變化聯繫起來。

label: negatively_regulates
context: METTL3, the catalytic subunit of the m6A methyltransferase complex, methylates TFEB mRNA at N6-methyladenosine residues, a mark that targets the transcript for destabilization and degradation. By reducing TFEB mRNA stability, METTL3 negatively regulates TFEB protein abundance and consequently the autophagy-lysosomal program. This epitranscriptomic control links RNA methylation to degradative pathway output. The finding situates TFEB within the expanding regulatory influence of m6A modification on stress-response genes.
context_zh_TW: METTL3 是 m6A 甲基轉移酶複合體的催化次單元，於 N6-甲基腺苷殘基甲基化 TFEB mRNA，此標記將轉錄本標定為不穩定和降解。透過降低 TFEB mRNA 穩定性，METTL3 負向調節 TFEB 蛋白豐度，進而影響自噬—溶酶體程序。此表觀轉錄組控制將 RNA 甲基化連結到降解途徑的輸出。此發現將 TFEB 置於 m6A 修飾對壓力反應基因日益擴大的調節影響中。

label: promotes
context: MFF (mitochondrial fission factor) is an outer mitochondrial membrane adaptor protein that recruits DRP1 to the mitochondria to initiate fission. Its role is relatively simple: MFF overexpression enhances mitochondrial fragmentation, whereas low MFF expression inhibits DRP1 anchoring to the mitochondria and results in elongated mitochondria. MFF physically interacts with the MID proteins within a DRP1 complex, and MFF appears uniquely related to symmetrical mitochondrial fission, whereas FIS1 is involved in asymmetrical fission. MFF is upregulated in heart failure and pulmonary diseases where excessive fission predominates.
context_zh_TW: MFF（線粒體分裂因子）是一種外線粒體膜接頭蛋白，可招募 DRP1 到線粒體以啟動分裂。其作用相對簡單：MFF 過表達增強線粒體 fragment，而低 MFF 表達抑制 DRP1 錨定到線粒體，導致線粒體 elongated。MFF 與 DRP1 複合體中的 MID 蛋白 physically interacts，且 MFF 似乎 uniquely related to symmetrical mitochondrial fission，而 FIS1 參與 asymmetrical fission。MFF 在 heart failure 和 pulmonary diseases 中 upregulated，其中 excessive fission predominates。

label: is_mediated_by
context: MFN2 is one of the two mitofusin GTPases that drive outer mitochondrial membrane fusion and, together with MFN1, is essential for tethering and merging adjacent mitochondria. Unlike MFN1, MFN2 additionally localizes to the endoplasmic reticulum, where it participates in tethering mitochondria to the ER and may play a role in lipid exchange. Mutations in MFN2 cause the peripheral neuropathy Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2A, underscoring its physiological importance. MFN2 expression is regulated by PGC-1alpha and transcriptional co-activators, so changes in MFN2 levels couple mitochondrial fusion capacity to cellular metabolic demand.
context_zh_TW: MFN2 是兩個驅動粒線體外膜融合的 mitofusin GTP 酶之一，與 MFN1 一起對於栓繫和融合相鄰粒線體至關重要。與 MFN1 不同，MFN2 還定位於內質網，參與將粒線體栓繫到內質網，並可能在脂質交換中扮演角色。MFN2 突變會導致周圍神經病變 Charcot-Marie-Tooth 病 type 2A，突顯其生理重要性。MFN2 表達受 PGC-1alpha 和轉錄共激活因子調節，因此 MFN2 水平的變化將粒線體融合能力與細胞代謝需求相連結。

label: exerts_antitumor_activity_against_oc_cells_by_blocking
context: MHY2245, a new SIRT1 inhibitor, exerts antitumor activity against ovarian cancer cells by blocking the pyruvate kinase M2/mTOR pathway. Directionally, MHY2245 sits upstream of suppressed PKM2/mTOR signaling and reduced ovarian cancer cell survival. By inhibiting SIRT1 and consequently the PKM2/mTOR pathway, MHY2245 curbs tumor-cell metabolism and growth. This supports SIRT1 inhibition as a therapeutic strategy in ovarian cancer, where SIRT1 inhibition of HMGB1 also suppresses metastasis and angiogenesis.
context_zh_TW: MHY2245是一種新型SIRT1抑制劑，透過阻斷丙酮酸激酶M2/mTOR通路對卵巢癌細胞發揮抗腫瘤活性。方向上，MHY2245位於PKM2/mTOR訊號抑制和卵巢癌細胞存活降低的上游。透過抑制SIRT1及隨後的PKM2/mTOR通路，MHY2245限制腫瘤細胞的代謝和生長。這支持SIRT1抑制作為卵巢癌的治療策略，其中SIRT1對HMGB1的抑制也抑制了轉移和血管新生。

label: inhibits
context: ML385 binds the NRF2 bZIP domain, blocking its heterodimerization with small Maf proteins and preventing ARE-driven antioxidant transcription. Directionally, ML385 sits upstream of NRF2 inhibition. Because SIRT1 activates NRF2, ML385 can be used to disrupt that axis experimentally, and it is a tool to dissect NRF2-dependent cytoprotection. By preventing NRF2 from binding antioxidant-response elements, ML385 reduces the expression of the protective enzyme battery. Its selectivity for NRF2 over other bZIP factors makes it a valuable pharmacological probe in oxidative-stress research.
context_zh_TW: ML385 結合 NRF2 bZIP 域，阻斷其與小 Maf 蛋白的異源二聚化並阻止 ARE 驅動的抗氧化轉錄。在方向性上，ML385 位於 NRF2 抑制的上游。由於 SIRT1 活化 NRF2，ML385 可用於實驗性地破壞該軸線，是剖析 NRF2 依賴性細胞保護的工具。透過阻止 NRF2 結合抗氧化反應元件，ML385 減少保護性酶組的表達。其對 NRF2 相較於其他 bZIP 因子的選擇性使其成為氧化壓力研究中有價值的藥理學探針。

label: is_a_component_of
context: MMP is a component of SASP. Matrix metalloproteinases degrade extracellular-matrix components and thereby enable invasion, angiogenesis, and microenvironment remodeling. The senescence-associated secretory phenotype is the pro-inflammatory secretome of senescent cells that can both restrain and, chronically, promote tumors. The directionality runs from SASP toward MMP, so SASP is the active agent and MMP the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context_zh_TW: MMP 是 SASP 的組成。基質金屬蛋白酶降解細胞外基質成分，從而實現侵襲、血管生成和微環境重塑。老化相關的分泌表型是衰老細胞的促發炎分泌組，它既可以抑制腫瘤，也可以長期促進腫瘤。方向性從 SASP 向 MMP，因此 SASP 是活性劑，MMP 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: promotes
context: MMP promotes Metastasis. Matrix metalloproteinases degrade extracellular-matrix components and thereby enable invasion, angiogenesis, and microenvironment remodeling. Metastasis is the multistep dissemination of tumor cells to distant organs and the principal cause of cancer mortality. The relationship is directional, with MMP acting as the operative agent upon Metastasis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: MMP 促進Metastasis。基質金屬蛋白酶降解細胞外基質成分，從而實現侵襲、血管生成和微環境重塑。 Metastasis 是腫瘤細胞向遠端器官的多步驟傳播，也是癌症死亡的主要原因。這種關係是有方向的，MMP 充當 Metastasis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: remodels
context: MMP remodels Tumor Microenvironment. Matrix metalloproteinases degrade extracellular-matrix components and thereby enable invasion, angiogenesis, and microenvironment remodeling. The tumor microenvironment is the constellation of stromal, immune, vascular, and extracellular elements that nurture or restrain the malignant clone. The relationship is directional, with MMP acting as the operative agent upon Tumor Microenvironment rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: MMP改造Tumor Microenvironment。基質金屬蛋白酶降解細胞外基質成分，從而實現侵襲、血管生成和微環境重塑。 Tumor Microenvironment 是培育或抑制惡性克隆的基質、免疫、血管和細胞外元素的集合。這種關係是有方向的，MMP 充當 Tumor Microenvironment 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: contributes_to
context: MOMP contributes to Cancer. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The relationship is directional, with MOMP acting as the operative agent upon Cancer rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: MOMP 對 Cancer 有貢獻。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。這種關係是有方向的，MOMP 充當 Cancer 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: is_driven_by
context: MOMP is driven by Bak. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. Bak is a pro-apoptotic Bcl-2 effector anchored at the mitochondrial outer membrane that cooperates with Bax to execute MOMP. The directionality runs from Bak toward MOMP, so Bak is the active agent and MOMP the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: MOMP 由Bak 驅動。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 Bak 是一種促凋亡 Bcl-2 效應子，錨定在粒線體外膜上，與 Bax 合作執行 MOMP。方向性從 Bak 向 MOMP，因此 Bak 是活性劑，MOMP 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: is_driven_by
context: MOMP is driven by Bax. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. Bax is a pro-apoptotic Bcl-2 effector that, upon activation, oligomerizes to form the pores that permeabilize the mitochondrial outer membrane. The directionality runs from Bax toward MOMP, so Bax is the active agent and MOMP the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: MOMP 由Bax 驅動。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 Bax 是一種促凋亡 Bcl-2 效應子，活化後會寡聚形成使粒線體外膜通透的孔。方向性從 Bax 朝向 MOMP，因此 Bax 是活性劑，MOMP 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: is_inhibited_by
context: MOMP is inhibited by Bcl-2. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. Bcl-2 is the founding anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family member that preserves mitochondrial outer-membrane integrity and was the first apoptosis regulator linked to cancer. The directionality runs from Bcl-2 toward MOMP, so Bcl-2 is the active agent and MOMP the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context_zh_TW: MOMP 被 Bcl-2 抑制。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 Bcl-2 是第一個抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 成員，可保護粒線體外膜的完整性，並且是第一個與癌症相關的細胞凋亡調節因子。方向性從 Bcl-2 朝向 MOMP，因此 Bcl-2 是活性劑，MOMP 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: is_inhibited_by
context: MOMP is inhibited by Bcl-xL. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. Bcl-xL is an anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family protein that maintains mitochondrial integrity and is essential for platelet and many tumor-cell survival. The directionality runs from Bcl-xL toward MOMP, so Bcl-xL is the active agent and MOMP the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context_zh_TW: MOMP 被 Bcl-xL 抑制。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 Bcl-xL 是一種抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 蛋白，可維持粒線體完整性，對於血小板和許多腫瘤細胞的存活至關重要。方向性從 Bcl-xL 朝向 MOMP，因此 Bcl-xL 是主動主體，MOMP 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: is_inhibited_by
context: MOMP is inhibited by Bid. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. Bid is a BH3-only protein cleaved by caspase-8 into truncated Bid, physically linking the extrinsic and intrinsic apoptotic routes. The directionality runs from Bid toward MOMP, so Bid is the active agent and MOMP the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context_zh_TW: MOMP 被 Bid 抑制。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 Bid 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，被 caspase-8 切割成截短的 Bid，在物理上連接外源性和內源性細胞凋亡途徑。方向性從 Bid 朝向 MOMP，因此 Bid 是活性劑，MOMP 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: is_inhibited_by
context: MOMP is inhibited by Bim. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. Bim is a sentinel BH3-only protein sequestered at microtubules that is released by stress to directly activate Bax/Bak. The directionality runs from Bim toward MOMP, so Bim is the active agent and MOMP the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context_zh_TW: MOMP 被 Bim 抑制。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 Bim 是一種隔離在微管中的前哨 BH3 蛋白，壓力釋放時可直接活化 Bax/Bak。方向性從 Bim 向 MOMP，因此 Bim 是活性劑，MOMP 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: is_inhibited_by
context: MOMP is inhibited by Mcl-1. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. Mcl-1 is a labile anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family protein whose rapid turnover makes it a frequent, difficult-to-target resistance determinant in cancer. The directionality runs from Mcl-1 toward MOMP, so Mcl-1 is the active agent and MOMP the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context_zh_TW: MOMP 被 Mcl-1 抑制。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 Mcl-1 是一種不穩定的抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 蛋白，其快速週轉使其成為癌症中常見的、難以靶向的抗藥性決定因素。方向性從 Mcl-1 朝向 MOMP，因此 Mcl-1 是活性劑，MOMP 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: is_regulated_by
context: MOMP is regulated by p53. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. The directionality runs from p53 toward MOMP, so p53 is the active agent and MOMP the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: MOMP 受p53 調節。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。方向性從 p53 向 MOMP，因此 p53 是活性劑，MOMP 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: is_restored_by
context: MOMP is restored by BH3 mimetics. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. BH3 mimetics are small molecules that occupy the hydrophobic groove of anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 proteins, freeing Bax/Bak to kill tumor cells. The directionality runs from BH3 mimetics toward MOMP, so BH3 mimetics is the active agent and MOMP the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: MOMP 由 BH3 mimetics 恢復。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 BH3 mimetics 是佔據抗凋亡 Bcl-2 蛋白疏水溝的小分子，釋放 Bax/Bak 來殺死腫瘤細胞。方向性從 BH3 mimetics 朝向 MOMP，因此 BH3 mimetics 是活性劑，MOMP 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: releases
context: MOMP releases Cytochrome c. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. Cytochrome c is an electron-carrier of the respiratory chain that, once released to the cytosol, nucleates apoptosome assembly. The relationship is directional, with MOMP acting as the operative agent upon Cytochrome c rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: MOMP 釋放 Cytochrome c。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 Cytochrome c 是呼吸鏈的電子載體，一旦釋放到細胞質中，就會使凋亡體組裝成核。這種關係是有方向的，MOMP 充當 Cytochrome c 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: releases
context: MOMP releases Smac-DIABLO. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. Smac/DIABLO is released from mitochondria during MOMP and unleashes caspases by binding the BIR domains of IAPs. The relationship is directional, with MOMP acting as the operative agent upon Smac-DIABLO rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context_zh_TW: MOMP 發布 Smac-DIABLO。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 Smac/DIABLO 在 MOMP 期間從粒線體釋放，並透過結合 IAP 的 BIR 結構域釋放半胱天冬酶。這種關係是有方向的，MOMP 充當 Smac-DIABLO 的操作代理，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: bidirectionally_linked_with
context: MPP+ and MPTP are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically MPP+ and MPTP may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
context_zh_TW: MPP+ 和 MPTP 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，MPP+ 和 MPTP 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: binds_to
context: MPP+ binds to Neuromelanin through physicochemical affinity, forming a complex that modulates the local concentration or activity of the bound species. Mechanistically, MPP+ acts as the ligand or matrix and Neuromelanin as the binding partner, with the interaction often driven by catechol, quinone, or charge complementarity. This binding is significant because it can sequester toxins or metals, buffer neurotransmitters, or localize damage within pigmented neurons. A caveat is that the physiological magnitude, reversibility, and functional sequelae of the binding in vivo are not always fully quantified and may differ between intracellular and extracellular contexts.
context_zh_TW: MPP+ 透過物理化學親和力與 Neuromelanin 結合，形成複合物，調節結合物質的局部濃度或活性。從機制上講，MPP+ 作為配體或基質，Neuromelanin 作為結合伴侶，相互作用通常由兒茶酚、醌或電荷互補性驅動。這種結合很重要，因為它可以隔離毒素或金屬、緩衝 neurotransmitters 或定位色素神經元內的損傷。需要注意的是，體內結合的生理程度、可逆性和功能後遺症並不總是完全量化的，並且在細胞內和細胞外環境之間可能有所不同。

label: causes
context: MPP+ causes Mitochondrial Dysfunction by acting as the upstream trigger whose downstream consequence is the second entity's appearance or dysfunction. The mechanism typically involves oxidative, mitochondrial, or proteotoxic injury in the case of neurotoxins and pigments, or receptor blockade and cell loss in pharmacological and degenerative contexts. This causal relationship is clinically significant because it models or explains features of Parkinson's disease pathology and guides therapeutic targeting. A caveat is that in many of these links the causal claim is experimental, partial, or operates within a broader network of cofactors rather than as an isolated linear event.
context_zh_TW: MPP+ 透過充當上游觸發器來導致 Mitochondrial Dysfunction，其下游結果是第二個實體的出現或功能障礙。此機制通常涉及氧化、mitochondria1或neurotoxin和色素情況下的蛋白毒性損傷，或藥理學和退化環境中的受體阻斷和細胞損失。這種因果關係具有臨床意義，因為它模擬或解釋了 Parkinson's disease 病理特徵並指導治療目標。需要注意的是，在許多這些連結中，因果關係的主張是實驗性的、部分的，或是在更廣泛的輔助因子網絡中運作的，而不是作為一個孤立的線性事件。

context_zh_TW: MPTP 透過充當上游觸發器來導致 Parkinson's Disease，其下游結果是第二個實體的出現或功能障礙。此機制通常涉及氧化、mitochondria1或neurotoxin和色素情況下的蛋白毒性損傷，或藥理學和退化環境中的受體阻斷和細胞損失。這種因果關係具有臨床意義，因為它模擬或解釋了 Parkinson's disease 病理特徵並指導治療目標。需要注意的是，在許多這些連結中，因果關係的主張是實驗性的、部分的，或是在更廣泛的輔助因子網絡中運作的，而不是作為一個孤立的線性事件。

label: prevents
context: MTH1 prevents 8-oxo-dGTP incorporation by hydrolyzing the oxidized nucleotide triphosphate to 8-oxo-dGMP, sanitizing the dNTP pool before DNA polymerase can insert it. This provides a front-line defense that complements OGG1's post-replicative repair. The directionality is sanitization to mutation prevention. A caveat is that MTH1 knockout is tolerated in many contexts because backup repair exists, though cancer cells can become dependent on it (synthetic lethal vulnerability). Because DNA polymerases preferentially misinsert the oxidized nucleotide opposite adenine, MTH1 action is essential for maintaining replication fidelity in oxidatively stressed cells.
context_zh_TW: MTH1 透過將氧化的核苷酸三磷酸水解為 8-oxo-dGMP 來防止 8-oxo-dGTP incorporation，在 DNA 聚合酶插入之前對 dNTP 池進行消毒。這提供了前線防禦，補充了OGG1的複製後修復。方向性是淨化到突變預防。需要注意的是，由於存在備份修復，MTH1 敲除在許多情況下都是可以容忍的，儘管 cancer 細胞可能會依賴它（合成致命漏洞）。由於 DNA 聚合酶優先錯誤地將氧化核苷酸插入腺嘌呤對面，因此 MTH1 作用對於維持氧化壓力細胞中的複製保真度至關重要。

label: is
context: MTHFR C677T is a functional SNP that substitutes cysteine for alanine at codon 677, producing a thermolabile enzyme with reduced methylenetetrahydrofolate reductase activity, particularly when homozygous (TT). This impairs generation of 5-methyl-THF, lowering SAMe and raising homocysteine, which can secondarily affect COMT substrate supply and catechol methylation. It is among the most clinically characterized folate-cycle variants and is frequently studied together with COMT. Its effects are modifiable by folate, B12, and betaine status.
context_zh_TW: MTHFR C677T 是一種功能性 SNP，它在密碼子 677 處以半胱氨酸取代丙氨酸，產生亞甲基四氫葉酸還原酶活性降低的耐熱酶，特別是純合子 (TT) 時。這會損害 5-甲基-THF 的生成，降低 SAMe 並提高同型半胱胺酸，進而影響 COMT 底物供應和兒茶酚甲基化。它是最具臨床特徵的 folate 循環變體之一，經常與 COMT 一起研究。其作用可藉由 folate、B12 和甜菜鹼狀態來改變。

label: promotes
context: MXL-3 promotes aging under abundant food conditions; worms lacking mxl-3 are long-lived, indicating that its repressive activity on lysosomal and lipolytic genes accelerates age-related decline. By maintaining a storage-oriented, low-autophagy state when nutrients are plentiful, MXL-3 limits the clearance and metabolic flexibility that promote longevity. This pro-aging effect is consistent with the broader principle that reduced nutrient signaling extends lifespan. The phenotype positions MXL-3 as a negative regulator of the pro-longevity degradative program.
context_zh_TW: MXL-3 在食物充裕的條件下促進老化；缺乏 mxl-3 的線蟲壽命較長，表明其對溶酶體和脂解基因的抑制性活性加速了與年齡相關的衰退。透過在營養豐富時維持以儲存為導向、低自噬的狀態，MXL-3 限制了促進長壽的清除和代謝靈活性。此促老化效應與「降低營養信號可延長壽命」的更廣泛原則一致。該表型將 MXL-3 定位為促長壽降解程序的負向調節者。

label: represses
context: MYC antagonizes TFEB and TFE3 transcriptional activities at lysosomal gene promoters, thereby repressing lysosome biogenesis in proliferating cells. Through direct competition for CLEAR elements and broader chromatin effects, MYC suppresses the degradative capacity that would otherwise constrain growth. This repression aligns cellular resources toward biosynthesis rather than turnover during oncogenic drive. The MYC-lysosome antagonism is a key axis by which cancer cells reshape their degradative landscape.
context_zh_TW: MYC 在溶酶體基因啟動子處拮抗 TFEB 和 TFE3 的轉錄活性，從而在增殖細胞中抑制溶酶體生物發生。透過對 CLEAR 元件的直接競爭以及更廣泛的染色質效應，MYC 抑制了本會限制生長的降解能力。此抑制將細胞資源在致癌驅動下導向生物合成而非更新。MYC-溶酶體拮抗作用是癌細胞重塑其降解景觀的關鍵軸。

label: has_types
context: Macroautophagy (commonly termed autophagy) is the best-characterized form, in which a de novo formed double-membrane structure called the phagophore expands to engulf cytoplasmic cargo and seals into an autophagosome. The autophagosome then fuses with a lysosome, forming an autolysosome where luminal contents are degraded by acidic hydrolases. This bulk and selective degradative route is orchestrated by the conserved ATG machinery, including the ULK1 initiation complex and the PI3K III/Beclin 1 nucleation complex. Macroautophagy is the dominant pathway induced by starvation, stress, and many pharmacological interventions and is the primary focus of most therapeutic autophagy modulation.
context_zh_TW: 巨自噬（通常稱為自噬）是特徵最清楚的形式，其中一種稱為吞噬泡、從頭形成的雙層膜結構擴展以吞噬細胞質貨物並封閉成自噬體。自噬體隨後與溶酶體融合，形成自噬溶酶體，其腔內容物被酸性水解酶降解。此種大規模且選擇性的降解途徑由保守的ATG機制協調，包括ULK1起始複合體和PI3K III/Beclin 1成核複合體。巨自噬是由飢餓、壓力和許多藥理介入所誘導的主要途徑，也是大多數治療性自噬調控的主要焦點。

label: detects
context: Magnetic Resonance Imaging detects Neuromelanin using physical or chemical contrast properties specific to the pigment. Mechanistically, the technique reads signal generated by iron content, paramagnetism, or tracer binding to the pigment. This is significant because it enables non-invasive assessment of pigmented neuron integrity in health and Parkinson's disease. A caveat is that the signal is influenced by field strength, sequence, and confounders such as iron, requiring careful quantification.
context_zh_TW: Magnetic Resonance Imaging 使用顏料特有的物理或化學對比特性來檢測 Neuromelanin。從機制上講，該技術讀取由 iron 內容、順磁性或與顏料結合的示踪劑產生的訊號。這很重要，因為它可以對健康和 Parkinson's disease 中的色素神經元完整性進行非侵入性評估。需要注意的是，訊號受到場強、序列和 iron 等混雜因素的影響，需要仔細量化。

label: bidirectionally_linked_with

Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Major histocompatibility complex class I and Neuromelanin may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
context_zh_TW: Major histocompatibility complex class I 和 Neuromelanin 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Major histocompatibility complex class I 和 Neuromelanin 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: extends_lifespan_by_inhibiting
context: Male SIRT6 transgenics have lower serum IGF-1 and reduced downstream insulin/IGF-1-like signaling (AKT, pAKT); reduced insulin/IGF-1-like signaling is strongly associated with increased longevity in model organisms, providing the leading explanation for SIRT6's male-specific lifespan extension. Directionally, SIRT6-mediated inhibition of IGF-1 signaling sits upstream of lifespan extension. By suppressing the growth-promoting IGF-AKT axis, SIRT6 may recapitulate the longevity benefits of reduced insulin/IGF signaling. This mechanism connects SIRT6 to one of the most conserved longevity pathways across species.
context_zh_TW: 雄性SIRT6轉基因小鼠具有較低的血清IGF-1和減少的下游胰島素/IGF-1類訊號（AKT、pAKT）；胰島素/IGF-1類訊號的減少與模式生物中壽命的增加強烈相關，為SIRT6雄性特異性壽命延長提供了首要解釋。方向上，SIRT6介導的IGF-1訊號抑制位於壽命延長的上游。透過抑制促生長的IGF-AKT軸，SIRT6可能重現了降低胰島素/IGF訊號的長壽益處。此機制將SIRT6與物種間最保守的長壽通路之一聯繫起來。

label: forms_adducts_with
context: Malondialdehyde forms adducts with DNA, most notably the M1dG lesion with deoxyguanosine, which mispairs with adenine during replication and induces G to T transversions. Such mutations in oncogenes or tumor suppressors can promote carcinogenesis. The directionality is lipid-peroxidation product to genotoxic lesion. A caveat is that M1dG is only one of several DNA adducts from lipid peroxidation, and repair pathways partially mitigate its mutagenic potential. Beyond M1dG, MDA also generates cross-links between DNA and proteins, expanding the spectrum of genotoxic damage it can inflict.
context_zh_TW: Malondialdehyde 與 DNA 形成加合物，最顯著的是 M1dG 與脫氧鳥苷的損傷，脫氧鳥苷在複製過程中與腺嘌呤錯配並誘導 G 到 T 顛換。癌基因或腫瘤抑制基因的此類突變可以促進癌症發生。其方向性是脂質過氧化產物對遺傳毒性損傷的作用。需要注意的是，M1dG 只是 lipid peroxidation 的幾種 DNA 加合物之一，修復途徑部分減輕了其致突變潛力。除了 M1dG 之外，MDA 還產生 DNA 和 proteins 之間的 cross 鏈​​接，擴大了它可能造成的基因毒性損害的範圍。

label: is_a_biomarker_for
context: Malondialdehyde is a biomarker for lipid peroxidation, widely measured in plasma, urine, and tissue as a marker of chronic oxidative stress. Its levels reflect the integrated burden of polyunsaturated fatty-acid peroxidation across membranes and lipoproteins. The directionality is damage to measurable product. A caveat is that MDA is also influenced by diet and exogenous sources, and assay specificity (e.g., TBARS) can be confounded by other carbonyls. MDA levels in plasma and tissue rise steeply when antioxidant defenses are overwhelmed, making it a convenient correlate of ongoing membrane oxidation.
context_zh_TW: Malondialdehyde 是 lipid peroxidation 的生物標記物，在血漿、尿液和組織中廣泛測量，作為慢性 oxidative stress 的標記。其水平反映了多元不飽和脂肪酸過氧化 across 膜和 lipoproteins 的綜合負擔。方向性是對可測量產品的損害。需要注意的是，MDA 也受到飲食和外源的影響，並且測定特異性（例如 TBARS）可能會受到其他羰基的影響。當抗氧化防禦被壓倒時，血漿和組織中的 MDA 水平急劇上升，使其成為正在進行的膜氧化的便捷關聯。

label: modifies
context: Malondialdehyde modifies cholesterol by forming MDA-lysine adducts on LDL apolipoproteins, creating MDA-LDL that is recognized by macrophage scavenger receptors. This modification enhances unregulated uptake and foam-cell formation in the arterial wall. The directionality is peroxidation product to LDL modification to atherogenic uptake. A caveat is that other aldehydes (4-HNE, acrolein) modify LDL similarly, so MDA-LDL is a representative but not exclusive epitope. MDA-modified LDL is pro-inflammatory and immunogenic, and its accumulation in plaques is used as a marker of oxidative modification of lipoproteins.
context_zh_TW: Malondialdehyde 透過在 LDL apolipoproteins 上形成 MDA-賴氨酸加合物來修飾 cholesterol，從而產生可被巨噬細胞清道夫受體辨識的 MDA-LDL。這種修飾增強了動脈壁中不受調節的吸收和泡沫細胞的形成。方向性是過氧化產物到低密度脂蛋白修飾到致動脈粥狀硬化的攝取。需要注意的是，其他醛（4-HNE、丙烯醛）也會類似地修飾 LDL，因此 MDA-LDL 是代表性表位，但不是唯一的表位。 MDA 修飾的 LDL 具有促發炎性和免疫原性，其在斑塊中的累積可用作 lipoproteins 氧化修飾的標記物。

label: has_subunit
context: Mammalian ribonucleotide reductase (RNR) assembles as an alpha2beta2 heterotetramer in which RRM1 provides the large catalytic (alpha) subunit carrying the active site and the allosteric specificity/activity sites. RRM1 assembles with either the RRM2 or RRM2B small subunit to form the active holoenzyme.
context_zh_TW: 哺乳類核醣核苷酸還原酶（RNR）組裝為 alpha2beta2 異四聚體，其中 RRM1 提供大型催化（alpha）次單元，帶有活性位點以及別構特異性/活性位點。RRM1 與 RRM2 或 RRM2B 小次單元組裝形成活性全酶。

label: has_subunit
context: Mammalian ribonucleotide reductase assembles as an alpha2beta2 heterotetramer in which RRM2 provides the small (beta) subunit housing the diferric-tyrosyl radical cofactor. RRM2 is S-phase restricted and the primary target of hydroxyurea and triapine.
context_zh_TW: 哺乳類核醣核苷酸還原酶組裝為 alpha2beta2 異四聚體，其中 RRM2 提供容納雙鐵-酪胺醯自由基輔因子的（beta）小次單元。RRM2 局限於 S 期表現，並是 hydroxyurea 與 triapine 的主要靶點。

label: has_subunit
context: Mammalian ribonucleotide reductase assembles as an alpha2beta2 heterotetramer in which RRM2B (p53R2) provides a p53-inducible small (beta-prime) subunit that partners with RRM1 to provision dNTPs for DNA repair and mitochondrial DNA synthesis. RRM2B mutations cause mitochondrial DNA depletion syndromes.
context_zh_TW: 哺乳類核醣核苷酸還原酶組裝為 alpha2beta2 異四聚體，其中 RRM2B（p53R2）提供受 p53 誘導的（beta-prime）小次單元，與 RRM1 配對以供應 DNA 修復與粒線體 DNA 合成所需的 dNTP。RRM2B 突變會導致粒線體 DNA 耗竭症候群。

label: bidirectionally_linked_with
context: Manganese and Manganism are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Manganese and Manganism may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
context_zh_TW: Manganese 和 Manganism 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Manganese 和 Manganism 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: activates
context: Many synthetic STACs that are chemically unrelated to resveratrol, such as those with an imidazo[1,2-b]thiazole core including SRT1720, activate SIRT1 substantially more potently than resveratrol. Directionally, SRT1720 sits upstream of enhanced SIRT1 activity, with higher potency than natural activators. These synthetic activators have been used in numerous studies to demonstrate their effect on SIRT1 and are being developed for therapeutic applications.
context_zh_TW: 許多與白藜蘆醇在化學結構上不相關的合成 STACs，例如含有咪唑並[1,2-b]噻唑核心結構的 SRT1720，活化 SIRT1 的效力顯著高於白藜蘆醇。從作用方向而言，SRT1720 位於增強 SIRT1 活性的上游，其效力高於天然活化劑。這些合成活化劑已被用於大量研究中，以證明其對 SIRT1 的作用效果，目前正在開發用於治療應用。

label: activates
context: Matrine is a quinolizidine alkaloid from Sophora flavescens. It protects against cisplatin-induced AKI by modulating mitochondrial membrane dynamics through the SIRT3/OPA1 pathway and confers cardiovascular benefits via the SIRT3/AMPK pathway, preserving cardiomyocyte viability and limiting cell death.
context_zh_TW: Matrine 是來自苦參的喹諾里西啶生物鹼。它透過 SIRT3/OPA1 途徑調節粒線體膜動態對抗 Cisplatin 誘導的 AKI 發揮保護作用，並透過 SIRT3/AMPK 途徑賦予心血管益處，維護心肌細胞存活率並限制細胞死亡。

label: is_structurally_related_to
context: Mebendazole and fenbendazole are structurally related benzimidazole anthelmintics with overlapping anticancer mechanisms.
context_zh_TW: Mebendazole和芬苯達唑是結構相關的苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，具有重疊的抗癌機制。

label: binds
context: Mebendazole binds beta-tubulin at the colchicine site, inhibiting microtubule assembly (Sasaki et al., Mol Cancer Ther 2002).
context_zh_TW: Mebendazole 在秋水仙鹼位點結合 β-微管蛋白，抑制微管組裝（Sasaki et al., Mol Cancer Ther 2002）。

label: release
context: Medium spiny neurons are GABAergic inhibitory projection neurons whose sole neurotransmitter is GABA, released onto downstream basal ganglia nuclei. They are tonically inactive at rest and require convergent excitatory input to fire. This inhibitory output is central to basal ganglia control of movement.
context_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 是 GABA 能抑制性投射神經元，其唯一的神經傳導物質是 GABA，會釋放到下游基底神經節核。它們在靜止時強直性不活躍，需要匯聚的興奮性輸入才能放電。這種抑制性輸出是基底神經節控制運動的核心。

label: are
context: Medium spiny neurons are GABAergic inhibitory projection neurons, the principal output cells of the striatum that integrate cortical, thalamic, and dopaminergic inputs. Their inhibitory nature means dopamine modulation via D1/D2 receptors reshapes striatal output to basal ganglia circuits, controlling movement, habit, and reward. As the main targets of nigrostriatal dopamine, they are central to COMT's striatal effects and to dopamine-regulated behavior. They comprise about 95% of striatal neurons.
context_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 是 GABA 能抑制性投射神經元，是整合皮質、丘腦和多巴胺能輸入的紋狀體的主要輸出細胞。它們的抑制性質意味著透過 D1/D2 受體的多巴胺調節來重塑 basal ganglia 電路的紋狀體輸出，控制 movement、習慣和 reward。作為黑質紋狀體多巴胺的主要標靶，它們是 COMT 紋狀體效應和多巴胺調節行為的核心。它們大約包括95% of striatal neurons。

label: comprise
context: Medium spiny neurons comprise approximately 95% of the neuronal population in the striatum, making them the dominant cell type through which dorsal and ventral striatal circuits operate. Their density underscores why striatal dopamine signaling, and its modulation by COMT and DAT, exerts such broad control over movement, habit, and reward behavior. The remaining 5% consist of interneurons that shape MSN activity. This cellular composition defines the functional architecture of the striatum and of the basal ganglia input stage.
context_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 約佔紋狀體神經元群的 95%，使其成為背側和腹側紋狀體迴路運作的主要細胞類型。它們的密度強調了為什麼紋狀體多巴胺訊號傳導及其由 COMT 和 DAT 的調節對 movement、習慣和 reward 行為發揮如此廣泛的控制。剩下的 5% 由塑造 MSN 活動的中間神經元組成。這種細胞組成定義了紋狀體和 basal ganglia 輸入級的功能架構。

label: bidirectionally_linked_with
context: Medulla Oblongata and Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Medulla Oblongata and Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
context_zh_TW: Medulla Oblongata 和 Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Medulla Oblongata 和 Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: produce
context: Melanocytes also synthesize Pheomelanin, the red and yellow melanin formed under cysteine-rich and low-MC1R conditions. Pheomelanin can generate Reactive Oxygen Species under UV, giving it pro-oxidant potential. The balance of eumelanin versus pheomelanin determines skin and hair color.
context_zh_TW: Melanocytes 也合成 Pheomelanin，即在富含 cysteine 和低 MC1R 條件下形成的紅黃色黑色素。Pheomelanin 在 UV 下可能產生 Reactive Oxygen Species，使其具有促氧化潛力。eumelanin 與 pheomelanin 的平衡決定皮膚和頭髮的顏色。

label: bidirectionally_linked_with
context: Melanocytes and Cutaneous Melanoma are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.

label: participate_in
context: Melanocytes carry out Melanogenesis, the biosynthetic pathway producing melanin pigments. The cascade begins with L-Tyrosine hydroxylation to L-DOPA and then dopaquinone by Tyrosinase. Melanocytes are the principal pigment-producing cells of the skin, hair follicle, uvea, and inner ear.
context_zh_TW: Melanocytes 執行 Melanogenesis，即產生黑色素的生物合成途徑。該級聯始於 L-Tyrosine 羥化為 L-DOPA，再由 Tyrosinase 氧化為 dopaquinone。Melanocytes 是皮膚、毛囊、葡萄膜和內耳的主要色素產生細胞。

label: produce
context: Melanocytes synthesize Eumelanin, the black and brown protective melanin, within melanosomes via the pathway of Melanogenesis. Eumelanin acts as a broad-band radical scavenger and UV absorber. This dark pigment is exported to neighboring keratinocytes for photoprotection.
context_zh_TW: Melanocytes 透過 Melanogenesis 途徑在 melanosomes 內合成 Eumelanin，即黑色和棕色的保護性黑色素。Eumelanin 充當寬頻自由基清除劑和 UV 吸收劑。這種深色色素被輸出到鄰近的 keratinocytes 以提供光保護。

label: bidirectionally_linked_with
context: Melanogenesis and Tyrosinase are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Melanogenesis and Tyrosinase may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
context_zh_TW: Melanogenesis 和 Tyrosinase 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Melanogenesis 和 Tyrosinase 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: is_a_type_of
context: Melanoma is an aggressive malignant neoplasm arising from melanocytes, the pigment-producing cells of the skin. It accounts for the majority of skin-cancer deaths due to its high metastatic potential and ability to evade immune surveillance. It is a distinct subtype within the broader category of cancer.
context_zh_TW: Melanoma 是起源於黑色素細胞（皮膚的產色素細胞）的侵襲性惡性腫瘤。由於其高轉移潛力與逃避免疫監視的能力，它佔皮膚癌死亡的大多數。它是癌症這個更廣泛類別中的一個獨特亞型。

label: is_upregulated_by
context: Melatonin upregulates SIRT3, which promotes mitophagy to mitigate oxidative stress-induced damage, and SIRT3 knockout completely abolishes melatonin's benefits against contrast-induced AKI. In diabetic cardiomyopathy, melatonin promotes autophagy, reduces apoptosis, and mitigates mitochondrial dysfunction by inhibiting Mst1 phosphorylation and upregulating SIRT3, with SIRT3-mediated deacetylation of TFAM at Lys154 acting as a pivotal molecular switch for mitophagic flux.
context_zh_TW: Melatonin 上調 SIRT3，後者促進粒線體自噬以減輕氧化壓力誘導的損傷，且 SIRT3 基因敲除完全消除 melatonin 對比劑誘導 AKI 的保護益處。在糖尿病心肌病變中，melatonin 透過抑制 Mst1 磷酸化和上調 SIRT3 促進自噬、減少凋亡並減輕粒線體功能障礙，其中 SIRT3 介導的 TFAM 在 Lys154 處的去乙醯化作為粒線體自噬通量的關鍵分子開關。

label: deacetylates
context: Melatonin's orchestration of sequential mitophagy processes depends on SIRT3-mediated deacetylation of TFAM at Lys154, the pivotal molecular switch promoting mitophagic flux. In vascular calcification, SIRT3 also deacetylates proteins within the PGC-1alpha/TFAM pathway, promoting mitochondrial biogenesis while attenuating vascular smooth muscle cell calcification.
context_zh_TW: Melatonin 對連續粒線體自噬過程的編排依賴 SIRT3 介導的 TFAM 在 Lys154 處的去乙醯化，這是促進粒線體自噬通量的關鍵分子開關。在血管鈣化中，SIRT3 還去乙醯化 PGC-1alpha/TFAM 途徑中的蛋白，促進粒線體生成同時減輕血管平滑肌細胞鈣化。

label: required_for
context: Mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition (MET) is an early, essential step in the cellular reprogramming of fibroblasts into induced pluripotent stem cells. During MET, cells silence mesenchymal genes and re-express epithelial markers such as E-cadherin (CDH1), EpCAM, and occludin, acquiring the epithelial morphology characteristic of pluripotent cells. The Yamanaka factors enforce MET by repressing EMT transcription factors and TGF-beta signaling, and blocking MET drastically reduces reprogramming efficiency, making it a deterministic early event in the establishment of pluripotency.
context_zh_TW: 間質到上皮細胞的轉變（MET）是成纖維細胞重編程為誘導多能幹細胞的早期重要步驟。在 MET 過程中，細胞沉默間質基因並重新表達上皮標記物，例如 E-鈣粘蛋白 (CDH1)、EpCAM 和 occludin，從而獲得多能細胞的上皮形態特徵。山中因子透過抑制 EMT 轉錄因子和 TGF-β 訊號傳導來強化 MET，而阻斷 MET 會大大降低重編程效率，使其成為多能性建立過程中的確定性早期事件。

label: includes
context: Metabolic Reprogramming includes Warburg Effect. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. The Warburg effect is the preference of many cancer cells for aerobic glycolysis with lactate fermentation even in the presence of oxygen, supporting anabolic growth. The relationship is directional, with Metabolic Reprogramming acting as the operative agent upon Warburg Effect rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context_zh_TW: Metabolic Reprogramming 包括Warburg Effect。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。許多癌細胞即使在有氧的情況下也偏好進行有氧糖解和乳酸發酵，以支持合成代謝生長。這種關係是有方向的，Metabolic Reprogramming 充當Warburg Effect 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: is_a_hallmark
context: Metabolic Reprogramming is a hallmark of Hallmarks of Cancer. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. The Hallmarks of Cancer are the enabling biological capabilities acquired during tumorigenesis, including sustained proliferation, evasion of death, and metastasis. The directionality runs from Hallmarks of Cancer toward Metabolic Reprogramming, so Hallmarks of Cancer is the active agent and Metabolic Reprogramming the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context_zh_TW: Metabolic Reprogramming 是Hallmarks of Cancer 的記號。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。 Hallmarks of Cancer是腫瘤發生過程中所獲得的生物學能力，包括持續增生、逃避死亡和轉移。方向性從 Hallmarks of Cancer 朝向 Metabolic Reprogramming，因此 Hallmarks of Cancer 是活性劑，Metabolic Reprogramming 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: involves
context: Metabolic Reprogramming relates to GLUT1 through the relation involves. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. GLUT1 is a high-capacity glucose transporter markedly upregulated on the tumor-cell surface to feed the glycolytic phenotype. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context_zh_TW: Metabolic Reprogramming 透過關係涉及 與 GLUT1 相關。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。 GLUT1 是一種高容量葡萄糖轉運蛋白，在腫瘤細胞表面顯著上調以供給糖解表型。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

label: involves
context: Metabolic Reprogramming relates to Hexokinase 2 through the relation involves. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. Hexokinase 2 is the glycolytic first-step enzyme most strongly induced in cancer, where it often tethers to mitochondria to couple glycolysis to survival. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context_zh_TW: Metabolic Reprogramming 透過關係涉及 Hexokinase 2 與 Hexokinase 2 相關。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。 Hexokinase 2 是癌症中最強烈誘導的糖解第一步酶，它經常與粒線體結合，將糖解與生存結合。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

label: involves
context: Metabolic Reprogramming relates to Pyruvate Kinase M2 through the relation involves. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. Pyruvate kinase M2 is the embryonic/warburg isoform that diverts glycolytic flux toward biosynthetic precursors rather than efficient ATP production. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context_zh_TW: Metabolic Reprogramming 透過關係涉及 與 Pyruvate Kinase M2 相關。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。 Pyruvate Kinase M2 是胚胎/warburg 亞型，它將糖解通量轉向生物合成前體而不是有效的 ATP 生產。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

label: converts_to
context: Metanephrine is the principal COMT-derived metabolite of epinephrine, formed when catechol-O-methyltransferase methylates one of the catechol hydroxyl groups of adrenaline using S-adenosylmethionine as the methyl donor. Together with MAO-mediated oxidative deamination, this conversion is the primary route of adrenaline breakdown in the body. Because COMT and MAO clear adrenaline rapidly, the alternative oxidative pathway that yields adrenochrome is normally a minor side route. Metanephrine measurements are also clinically useful as markers of catecholamine production, and elevated levels reflect increased release of epinephrine from the adrenal medulla.
context_zh_TW: Metanephrine 是 epinephrine 主要的 COMT 衍生代謝物，由 catechol-O-methyltransferase 使用 S-adenosylmethionine 作為甲基供體甲基化 adrenaline 的其中一個兒茶酚羥基而形成。與 MAO 介導的氧化脫胺一起，此轉化是體內 adrenaline 分解的主要途徑。由於 COMT 與 MAO 迅速清除 adrenaline，產生 adrenochrome 的替代氧化途徑通常為次要旁路。Metanephrine 的測量在臨床上也作為兒茶酚胺生成的標記有用，其濃度升高反映腎上腺髓質釋出更多 epinephrine。

label: activates
context: Meteorin-like (Metrnl) activates the PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 axis, stimulating AMPK at Thr172 and increasing UCP1-dependent proton leak, preserving mitochondrial ultrastructural integrity and regulating energy metabolism in diabetic nephropathy.
context_zh_TW: Meteorin-like（Metrnl）活化 PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 軸線，在 Thr172 處刺激 AMPK 並增加 UCP1 依賴的質子漏，在糖尿病腎病變中維護粒線體超微結構完整性並調節能量代謝。

label: is_activated_by
context: Meteorin-like protein activates the PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 axis, which stimulates AMPK at Thr172 and increases UCP1-dependent proton leak, thereby preserving mitochondrial ultrastructural integrity and regulating energy metabolism, particularly in diabetic nephropathy. The cascade links an exercise-induced myokine to mitochondrial quality control through the PGC-1alpha/SIRT3/AMPK/UCP1 pathway.
context_zh_TW: Meteorin-like 蛋白活化 PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 軸線，後者在 Thr172 處刺激 AMPK 並增加 UCP1 依賴的質子漏，從而維護粒線體超微結構完整性並調節能量代謝，特別是在糖尿病腎病變中。此級聯將運動誘導的肌肉因子透過 PGC-1alpha/SIRT3/AMPK/UCP1 途徑與粒線體品質控制聯繫起來。

label: induces
context: Metformin induces autophagy by activating AMPK and thereby inhibiting mTORC1, relieving the brake on the autophagic machinery. In primary CD4+ T cells isolated from older individuals, metformin treatment restored autophagic flux, suggesting a mechanism to counter age-associated immune dysfunction. The induction is consistent with the drug's broader metabolic and putative longevity effects mediated through energy-sensing pathways. By enhancing autophagic clearance, metformin may reduce senescence-associated inflammation and improve cellular resilience.
context_zh_TW: Metformin透過活化AMPK並從而抑制mTORC1來誘導自噬，解除對自噬機制的制動。在從老年人分離的原代CD4+ T細胞中，metformin治療恢復了自噬流，提示一種抵消與年齡相關免疫功能障碍的機制。此誘導與該藥物透過能量感知途徑發揮的更廣泛代謝和假定長壽效應一致。透過增強自噬清除，metformin可能減少衰老相關發炎並改善細胞韌性。

label: activates
context: Metformin, the first-line type 2 diabetes drug, activates AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) primarily by inhibiting mitochondrial respiratory complex I, which mildly elevates the cellular AMP/ATP ratio. Activated AMPK phosphorylates downstream targets that restore energy homeostasis, including TSC2 and Raptor, which in turn suppress mTORC1. This indirect, energy-stress-mediated activation distinguishes metformin from direct AMPK agonists and underlies many of its metabolic benefits. AMPK activation by metformin also accounts for its autophagy-inducing and potential anti-aging effects.
context_zh_TW: Metformin是一線第二型糖尿病藥物，主要透過抑制粒線體呼吸鏈複合體I來活化AMP活化蛋白激酶（AMPK），輕微提高細胞AMP/ATP比值。活化的AMPK磷酸化下游標靶以恢復能量穩態，包括TSC2和Raptor，後者進而抑制mTORC1。這種間接的、能量壓力介導的活化使metformin有別於直接的AMPK激動劑，並構成其許多代謝益處的基礎。Metformin對AMPK的活化也解釋了其誘導自噬和潛在抗老化的效應。

label: is_a_form_of
context: Methemoglobin (MetHb) is a form of hemoglobin in which the iron in the heme group is oxidized from the ferrous (Fe2+) to the ferric (Fe3+) state. Unlike normal hemoglobin, it cannot effectively bind or transport oxygen and appears bluish chocolate-brown in color. In healthy individuals, a small amount (typically less than 1-2% of total hemoglobin) forms spontaneously but is rapidly reduced back to functional hemoglobin by enzymes, primarily NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase (also called cytochrome b5 reductase or diaphorase). Hemoglobin is a tetramer of 2 alpha and 2 beta chains, each with a heme group containing iron.
context_zh_TW: Methemoglobin (MetHb) is a form of hemoglobin in which the iron in the heme group is oxidized from the ferrous (Fe2+) to the ferric (Fe3+) state。Unlike normal hemoglobin, it cannot effectively bind or transport oxygen and appears bluish chocolate-brown in color。In healthy individuals, a small amount (typically less than 1-2% of total hemoglobin) forms spontaneously but is rapidly reduced back to functional hemoglobin by enzymes, primarily NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase (also called cytochrome b5 reductase or diaphorase)。Hemoglobin is a tetramer of 2 alpha and 2 beta chains, each with a heme group containing iron。

label: causes
context: Methemoglobinemia produces cyanosis, a bluish-gray discoloration of the skin, lips, mucous membranes, and nail beds, typically once methemoglobin reaches 10-20% of total hemoglobin, at which point blood also appears 'chocolate brown'. Cyanosis in methemoglobinemia is notable because it does not improve with supplemental oxygen, since the problem is not oxygenation of hemoglobin but the oxidation state of its heme iron. Higher levels add headache, anxiety, dyspnea on exertion and fatigue (20-30%), progressing to more severe central nervous and cardiovascular symptoms at higher percentages.
context_zh_TW: Methemoglobinemia produces cyanosis, a bluish-gray discoloration of the skin, lips, mucous membranes, and nail beds, typically once methemoglobin reaches 10-20% of total hemoglobin, at which point blood also appears 'chocolate brown'。Cyanosis in methemoglobinemia is notable because it does not improve with supplemental oxygen, since the problem is not oxygenation of hemoglobin but the oxidation state of its heme iron。Higher levels add headache, anxiety, dyspnea on exertion and fatigue (20-30%), progressing to more severe central nervous and cardiovascular symptoms at higher percentages。

label: repair
context: Methionine sulfoxide reductases repair oxidized methionine by reducing methionine sulfoxide back to methionine using the thioredoxin system. This restores protein function and acts as an antioxidant defense because methionine oxidation can be a benign, reversible sink for oxidants. The directionality is MsrA/MsrB-catalyzed reduction to repaired protein. A caveat is that repeated oxidation and repair of the same residue has a kinetic cost and is not unlimited, so chronic stress still accrues damage.
context_zh_TW: Methionine sulfoxide reductases 透過使用硫氧還蛋白系統將甲硫胺酸亞砜還原回甲硫胺酸來修復 oxidized methionine。這可以恢復蛋白質功能並起到抗氧化防禦作用，因為蛋氨酸氧化可以成為氧化劑的良性、可逆的吸收池。方向性是 MsrA/MsrB 催化還原為修復蛋白。需要注意的是，相同殘留物的重複氧化和修復會產生動力成本，而且不是無限的，因此慢性壓力仍然會造成損害。

label: are_donated_by
context: Methyl groups are transferred by methyltransferases that use a high-energy methyl donor, the universal activated donor being SAMe (S-adenosylmethionine). After donating its methyl group, SAMe becomes S-adenosylhomocysteine, which is recycled back to methionine via the methylation cycle. This coupling links methyl-group supply directly to the methionine cycle.
context_zh_TW: Methyl groups 由使用高能量甲基供體的甲基轉移酶轉移，而通用的活化供體是 SAMe（S-腺苷甲硫氨酸）。捐贈其甲基後，SAMe 變成 S-腺苷同型半胱氨酸，並透過 methylation cycle 回收為蛋氨酸。這種耦合將甲基供應與蛋氨酸循環直接連結起來。

label: acts_as
context: MethylB12 (methylcobalamin) functions as the prosthetic group of methionine synthase (MTR), which remethylates homocysteine to methionine using the methyl group supplied by methylfolate. The cobalt-carbon bond is labile, enabling direct transfer of the methyl group to homocysteine. This reaction simultaneously regenerates tetrahydrofolate for nucleotide synthesis.
context_zh_TW: MethylB12（甲鈷胺）充當 methionine synthase (MTR) 的輔助基團，後者使用 methylfolate 提供的甲基將同型半胱氨酸再甲基化為蛋氨酸。鈷-碳鍵不穩定，能直接將甲基轉移至同型半胱氨酸。此反應同時再生四氫葉酸以供核苷酸合成。

label: recruits
context: Methylated DNA is recognized by methyl-CpG-binding domain (MBD) proteins that recruit chromatin remodeling factors and histone deacetylases to the site. These recruited complexes remove acetyl groups and deposit repressive histone modifications, promoting condensation of the chromatin into a transcriptionally inactive state. This cross-talk between DNA methylation and histone modification establishes a self-reinforcing repressive loop that maintains stable gene silencing across cell divisions, and it is a major route by which promoter methylation converts active genes into silenced heterochromatin.
context_zh_TW: 甲基化 DNA 被甲基 CpG 結合域 (MBD) 蛋白識別，將染色質重塑因子和組蛋白去乙醯化酶募集到該位點。這些招募的複合物去除乙醯基並沉積抑制性組蛋白修飾，促進染色質凝結成轉錄失活狀態。 DNA甲基化和組蛋白修飾之間的這種串擾建立了一個自我強化的抑制環，在細胞分裂過程中維持穩定的基因沉默，並且它是啟動子甲基化將活性基因轉化為沉默的異染色質的主要途徑。

label: neutralizes
context: Methylation neutralizes catechols via COMT by transferring a methyl group from SAMe to the catechol hydroxyls, converting reactive catecholamines and xenobiotics into stable, less active O-methylated metabolites for excretion. This detoxification limits oxidative catechol quinone formation and protects tissues from catechol-derived damage. COMT is thus the central catalyst of this neutralizing methylation, and its activity determines the efficiency of catechol clearance. The reaction consumes one SAMe per catechol, linking detoxification to methyl budget.
context_zh_TW: Methylation 透過 COMT 中和兒茶酚，將甲基從 SAMe 轉移到兒茶酚羥基，將反應性 catecholamines 和異生物質轉化為穩定的、活性較低的 O-甲基化代謝物進行排泄。這種解毒作用限制了氧化兒茶酚醌的形成，並保護組織免受兒茶酚衍生的傷害。因此，COMT 是這種中和甲基化的中心催化劑，其活性決定了兒茶酚清除的效率。該反應每種兒茶酚消耗一個 SAMe，將解毒與甲基預算聯繫起來。

label: regulates
context: Methylation regulates gene expression primarily through DNA methyltransferase-mediated addition of methyl groups to cytosine residues in CpG islands, typically repressing transcription and enabling cellular differentiation and genomic imprinting. It also modifies histones and transcription factors via SAMe-dependent reactions, forming an epigenetic regulatory layer responsive to environment and diet. Because SAMe is the universal donor, COMT activity and methyl donor availability indirectly influence the pool available for epigenetic regulation. This connection links catechol metabolism to broader gene regulation.
context_zh_TW: Methylation 主要透過 DNA 甲基轉移酶介導的 methyl groups 添加到 CpG 島的胞嘧啶殘基來調節 gene expression，通常抑制轉錄並實現細胞分化和基因組印記。它也透過 SAMe 依賴性反應修飾組蛋白和轉錄因子，形成對環境和飲食敏感的表觀遺傳調控層。由於 SAMe 是通用供體，COMT activity 和 methyl donor 的可用性間接影響可用於表觀遺傳調控的函式庫。這種關聯將兒茶酚代謝與更廣泛的基因調控聯繫起來。

label: can_cause
context: Methylcobalamin (MethylB12) can cause mood side effects, such as anxiety, irritability, or overstimulation, in slow COMT individuals because it is a direct methyl donor that adds to an already slowly processed methyl burden. The excess methyl groups can shift neurotransmitter and epigenetic methylation beyond the optimal range, producing emotional dysregulation. Slower COMT individuals are therefore often advised to use non-methylated B12 forms such as hydroxocobalamin or adenosylcobalamin. The effect is dose-dependent and genotype-specific.
context_zh_TW: Methylcobalamin (MethylB12) 可能會在緩慢的 COMT 個體中引起情緒副作用，例如焦慮、易怒或過度刺激，因為它是直接的 methyl donor，會增加已經緩慢處理的甲基負擔。過量的 methyl groups 可以使神經傳導物質和表觀遺傳甲基化超出最佳範圍，從而產生情緒失調。因此，速度較慢的 COMT 個體通常被建議使用非甲基化 B12 形式，例如羥鈷胺或腺苷鈷胺。其作用具有劑量依賴性和基因型特異性。

label: is
context: Methylcobalamin is an active coenzyme form of vitamin B12 that serves directly as a methyl donor, functioning as the cofactor for methionine synthase in homocysteine remethylation to methionine. By supplying methyl groups it supports SAMe generation and the methylation cycle, positioning it upstream of COMT's methyl donor supply. Its methyl-donating nature distinguishes it from adenosylcobalamin, which supports mitochondrial energy metabolism instead. It is a common supplement, though its methyl load requires caution in slow COMT individuals.
context_zh_TW: Methylcobalamin 是維生素 B12 的活性輔酶形式，直接充當 methyl donor，在同型半胱氨酸再甲基化為蛋氨酸過程中充當蛋氨酸合成酶的輔因子。透過供應 methyl groups，它支援 SAMe 世代和 methylation cycle，將其定位在 COMT 的 methyl donor 供應的上游。其提供甲基的性質使其與腺苷鈷胺素不同，腺苷鈷胺素支持粒線體能量代謝。它是一種常見的補充劑，但其甲基負荷對於緩慢的 COMT 個體需要謹慎。

label: shunts_electrons_to
context: Methylene blue (MB) accepts electrons from NADH via mitochondrial complex I and transfers them directly to cytochrome c, effectively bypassing respiratory chain Complexes I-III. In isolated-mitochondria complex I-III assays with NADH as electron donor, MB significantly increased the rate of cytochrome c reduction, while the negative-control antimycin A (a complex III inhibitor) blocked it. This electron shunt underlies MB's ability to maintain oxidative phosphorylation and ATP production when upstream complexes are inhibited, and it is the mechanistic basis for MB's enhancement of cellular oxygen consumption.
context_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍 (MB) 通過線粒體複合體 I 接受來自 NADH 的電子，並直接轉移到細胞色素 c，有效地繞過呼吸鏈複合體 I-III。在以 NADH 為電子供體的分離線粒體複合體 I-III 檢測中，MB 顯著增加了細胞色素 c 還原速率，而陰性對照抗黴素 A（一種複合體 III 抑制劑）則阻斷了它。這種電子旁路是 MB 在當上游複合體被抑制時仍能維持氧化磷酸化和 ATP 產生的基礎，也是 MB 增強細胞氧氣消耗的機制基礎。

label: fails_to_protect_against
context: Methylene blue (MB) provides no protection against direct extracellular oxidative stress generated by glucose oxidase, which produces hydrogen peroxide in the culture medium. In HT-22 cells, glucose oxidase induced 80% cell death within 3 hours that was not attenuated by MB at any concentration tested, whereas the conventional antioxidant pyruvate (4 mM) provided robust protection. This distinguishes MB from classical chain-breaking antioxidants: MB acts upstream on mitochondrial electron flow rather than as a direct scavenger of extracellular hydrogen peroxide.
context_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)對葡萄糖氧化酶產生的直接細胞外氧化應激沒有提供保護作用，葡萄糖氧化酶在培養基中產生過氧化氫。在HT-22細胞中，葡萄糖氧化酶在3小時內誘導80%的細胞死亡，這在任何測試濃度下都沒有被MB減弱，而傳統抗氧化劑丙酮酸（4 mM）提供了強大的保護作用。這將MB與經典的鏈斷裂抗氧化劑區分開來：MB在粒線體電子流的上游起作用，而不是作為細胞外過氧化氫的直接清除劑。

label: protects_against
context: Methylene blue (MB) provides potent neuroprotection against glutamate-induced oxidative toxicity in HT-22 hippocampal neurons, a model in which glutamate blocks the cystine/glutamate antiporter and depletes cellular glutathione. MB was protective in both MTT and Calcein AM viability assays with an EC50 of 17.81 nM and without altering total glutathione levels. This protection correlated with attenuation of glutamate-induced ROS production and mitochondrial membrane potential depolarization, establishing MB's action as upstream of ROS generation rather than as a direct antioxidant.
context_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)在HT-22海馬神經元中提供對谷氨酸誘導的氧化毒性的強大神經保護作用，這是一種谷氨酸阻斷胱氨酸/谷氨酸反向轉運蛋白並耗盡細胞谷胱甘肽的模型。MB在MTT和Calcein AM活力測定中具有保護作用，EC50為17.81 nM，並且不改變總谷胱甘肽水平。這種保護作用與谷氨酸誘導的ROS產生和粒線體膜電位去極化的減弱相關，確立了MB的作用是在ROS產生的上游而不是作為直接抗氧化劑。

label: acts_as
context: Methylene blue acts as a monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI), and this activity underlies its mood effects. MAO enzymes break down serotonin, dopamine, and norepinephrine, so inhibiting them leaves more of these neurotransmitters in the synapse - the same mechanism used by antidepressants like phenelzine. Because MAOI activity is potent, methylene blue carries real drug-interaction risks: combining it with SSRIs, SNRIs, tricyclic antidepressants, or other serotonergic medications can raise serotonin to dangerous levels and potentially trigger serotonin syndrome. This interaction is a documented, case-report-level concern and a key contraindication for self-dosing with methylene blue.
context_zh_TW: Methylene blue作為單胺氧化酶抑制劑（MAOI）發揮作用，這種活性是其情緒效應的基礎。MAO酶分解血清素、多巴胺和去甲腎上腺素，因此抑制它們會使更多這些神經遞質留在突觸中——這與phenelzine等抗抑鬱藥的作用機制相同。由於MAOI活性很強，methylene blue帶有真正的藥物相互作用風險：將其與SSRIs、SNRIs、三環類抗抑鬱藥或其他血清素能藥物結合使用可能將血清素提升至危險水平，並可能引發血清素症候群。這種相互作用是已記錄的、病例報告級別的關注點，也是自行服用methylene blue的關鍵禁忌症。

label: crosses
context: Methylene blue crosses the blood-brain barrier easily, which is why its cognitive and mood effects appear at relatively modest doses. Once in the central nervous system it acts as a redox cycling agent inside mitochondria, donating and accepting electrons to keep the mitochondrial electron transport chain running more efficiently, and it has documented effects on tau protein aggregation, monoamine oxidase inhibition, and neuroprotection more broadly. Its central availability combined with its low-dose mitochondrial enhancement is the mechanistic basis for the small but real human evidence of improved memory encoding and retrieval and reduced anxiety and depression scores at low (0.5-4 mg) doses.
context_zh_TW: Methylene blue容易穿過血腦屏障，這就是為什麼其認知和情緒效應在相對適中的劑量下出現。一旦進入中樞神經系統，它在粒線體內作為氧化還原循環劑發揮作用，捐贈和接受電子以使粒線體電子傳遞鏈更有效地運行，並且它對tau蛋白聚集、單胺氧化酶抑制和更廣泛的神經保護具有記錄在案的效果。其中樞可用性與其低劑量粒線體增強相結合，是在低劑量（0.5-4毫克）下改善記憶編碼和提取以及降低焦慮和抑鬱評分的小但真實的人類證據的機制基礎。

label: exhibits
context: Methylene blue demonstrates clear dose-dependent toxicity thresholds. At single doses of 3 mg/kg or more, hypotension, wheezing, and reduced oxygenation have been reported. Cumulative doses of 7 mg/kg or more can cause significant toxicity including nausea, vomiting, precordial pain, dyspnea, tachypnea, chest tightness, tachycardia, apprehension, tremor, mydriasis, abdominal pain, dizziness, paresthesia, headache, confusion, and mild methemoglobinemia up to 7 percent, with effects lasting 2 to 12 hours. Severe overdosage with a single dose of 20 mg/kg or more has caused severe intravascular hemolysis, hyperbilirubinemia, and death, and there is no specific antidote.
context_zh_TW: Methylene blue顯示出明確的劑量依賴性毒性閾值。在單劑量3 mg/kg或更高時，已報告低血壓、喘鳴和氧合減少。累積劑量7 mg/kg或更高可能引起顯著毒性，包括毒性，包括噁心、嘔吐、心前區疼痛、呼吸困難、呼吸急促、胸緊、心動過速、焦慮、震顫、瞳孔散大、腹痛、頭暈、感覺異常、頭痛、意識模糊和輕度methemoglobinemia（高達7%），效果持續2至12小時。單劑量20 mg/kg或更嚴重的過量已導致嚴重的血管內溶血、高膽紅素血癥和死亡，並且沒有特異性解毒劑。

label: follows
context: Methylene blue follows a hormetic dose-response curve: the same mechanism that is beneficial at low doses works against the organism at high ones. The therapeutic window is real and narrow - 1-4 mg is where the benefits are, and above 7-10 mg the risks start - while doses above approximately 2 mg/kg can flip the redox-cycling mechanism from antioxidant to pro-oxidant, generating oxidative stress instead of reducing it. Too little and you do not get the benefits; too much and the redox cycling starts producing oxidative stress. This hormetic behavior explains why more is not better for methylene blue and why micro-to-low-physiological dosing (0.5-4 mg) is the evidence-supported sweet spot for wellness applications.
context_zh_TW: Methylene blue遵循hormetic劑量反應曲線：在低劑量有益的機制在高劑量下對生物體有害。治療窗口是真實且狹窄的——1-4毫克是益處所在，超過7-10毫克風險開始——而劑量超過約2 mg/kg可能使氧化還原循環機制從抗氧化劑轉變為促氧化劑，產生氧化應激而不是減少它。太少你得不到益處；太多氧化還原循環開始產生氧化應激。這種hormetic行為解釋了為什麼對methylene blue來說越多越好不成立，以及為什麼微至低生理劑量（0.5-4毫克）是健康應用的證據支持最佳範圍。

label: interacts_with
context: Methylene blue interacts dangerously with SSRIs and other serotonergic medications. As a monoamine oxidase inhibitor, methylene blue raises synaptic serotonin, and combining it with SSRIs (or SNRIs, tricyclic antidepressants, or other serotonergic drugs) can increase serotonin to dangerous levels, potentially causing serotonin syndrome. This interaction is a documented, case-report-level concern, and the article is emphatic that anyone on an antidepressant or serotonergic drug should not self-dose with methylene blue. If a person is on such medications, physician involvement is required before any dose, and the serotonin interaction screening is cited as a key reason to pursue a supervised protocol.
context_zh_TW: Methylene blue與SSRIs和其他血清素能藥物危險地相互作用。作為單胺氧化酶抑制劑，methylene blue提高突觸血清素，將其與SSRIs（或SNRIs、三環類抗抑鬱藥或其他血清素能藥物）結合使用可能將血清素提升至危險水平，可能導致血清素症候群。這種相互作用是已記錄的、病例報告級別的關注點，文章強調任何服用抗抑鬱藥或血清素能藥物的人都不應自行服用methylene blue。如果一個人正在服用此類藥物，在任何劑量之前都需要醫師參與，並且血清素相互作用篩查被引用為追求監督方案的關鍵原因。

label: donates
context: Methylfolate (5-methyl-THF) donates its methyl group to homocysteine via methionine synthase, using MethylB12 as cofactor, producing methionine and regenerating tetrahydrofolate. Methionine is then converted to SAMe, the universal methyl donor for COMT. Thus methylfolate sits upstream of the methyl-group pool that COMT consumes to inactivate catecholamines.
context_zh_TW: Methylfolate（5-甲基-THF）透過 methionine synthase 將其甲基捐贈給同型半胱氨酸，使用 MethylB12 作為輔因子，產生蛋氨酸並再生四氫葉酸。蛋氨酸隨後轉化為 SAMe，即 COMT 的通用 methyl donor。因此 methylfolate 位於 COMT 滅活兒茶酚胺所消耗的甲基群池上游。

label: is
context: Methylfolate is a critical component of the methylation cycle, providing the methyl group that methionine synthase transfers to homocysteine to form methionine, the precursor of SAMe. Its availability therefore gates the entire downstream methyl donor supply, including that consumed by COMT for catechol O-methylation. Deficiencies or polymorphisms affecting methylfolate generation constrain COMT activity and can elevate homocysteine. It is the primary folate species linking dietary intake to methylation capacity.
context_zh_TW: Methylfolate 是 methylation cycle 的關鍵組件，提供甲基，蛋氨酸合成酶將甲基轉移至高半胱氨酸，形成蛋氨酸（SAMe 的前體）。因此，它的可用性控制了整個下游 methyl donor 的供應，包括 COMT 用於兒茶酚 O-甲基化的消耗。影響甲基葉酸生成的缺陷或多態性會限制 COMT activity 並可能升高同型半胱氨酸。它是將飲食攝取量與甲基化能力聯繫起來的主要 folate 物種。

label: is_produced_by
context: Methylfolate is produced from reduced tetrahydrofolate by the final enzyme methylenetetrahydrofolate reductase (MTHFR), which adds a methyl group at the N5 position. Unlike folic acid, 5-MTHF requires no reductive activation and is directly usable. This is why it is the preferred supplemental form in individuals with MTHFR impairments.
context_zh_TW: Methylfolate 由最終酶 methylenetetrahydrofolate reductase (MTHFR) 從還原的四氫葉酸產生，該酶在 N5 位置添加甲基。與葉酸不同，5-MTHF 不需要還原活化且可直接使用。這就是為什麼它是 MTHFR 功能受損個體的首選補充形式。

label: are_sensitive_to
context: Mice lacking PGC-1α are markedly more sensitive to neuronal loss induced by MPTP, a dopaminergic toxin, and kainic acid, an excitotoxin, revealing PGC-1αs role in neuronal stress resistance. Because SIRT1 activates PGC-1α by deacetylation, this sensitivity indirectly implicates the SIRT1/PGC-1α axis in neuroprotection. Directionally, PGC-1α deficiency heightens vulnerability to these insults, while its activation confers resistance. Since PGC-1α drives mitochondrial biogenesis and antioxidant gene expression, protecting neurons through this axis is a proposed strategy against Parkinsons disease and other neurodegenerative disorders.
context_zh_TW: 缺乏 PGC-1α 的小鼠對 MPTP（多巴胺能毒素）和 kainic acid（興奮性毒素）誘導的神經元損失明顯更敏感，揭示了 PGC-1α 在神經元壓力抗性中的作用。由於 SIRT1 通過去乙醯化活化 PGC-1α，這種敏感性間接將 SIRT1/PGC-1α 軸與神經保護聯繫起來。在方向性上，PGC-1α 缺乏增加了對這些損傷的脆弱性，而其活化賦予抗性。由於 PGC-1α 驅動粒線體生物合成和抗氧化基因表達，通過此軸保護神經元是針對帕金森症和其他神經退行性疾病的擬議策略。

label: display
context: Mice lacking SIRT6 develop a striking premature-aging syndrome with reduced size, loss of subcutaneous fat, lymphopenia, colitis, and spinal curvature, dying early in life. The phenotype reflects defective base-excision repair, genomic instability, and metabolic and inflammatory dysregulation, demonstrating that SIRT6 is essential for maintaining genome integrity and metabolic homeostasis. Directionally, SIRT6 deficiency produces multisystem premature aging. This makes SIRT6 one of the clearest single-gene links between sirtuins and mammalian longevity, and it positions SIRT6 among the strongest candidates for translating sirtuin biology into interventions that delay age-related decline.
context_zh_TW: 缺乏 SIRT6 的小鼠發展出顯著的早衰症候群，表現為體型縮小、皮下脂肪減少、淋巴細胞減少症、結腸炎和脊柱彎曲，並在生命早期死亡。該表型反映了鹼基切除修復缺陷、基因組不穩定性以及代謝和發炎調節失常，證明 SIRT6 對維持基因組完整性及代謝穩態至關重要。在方向性上，SIRT6 缺乏導致多系統早衰。這使 SIRT6 成為 sirtuin 與哺乳動物長壽之間最明確的單基因聯繫之一，並將 SIRT6 定位為將 sirtuin 生物學轉化為延緩衰老相關退化干預措施的最有力候選者之一。

label: decreases_with
context: MicroRNA levels generally decline with age, contributing to the altered gene expression that accompanies aging. In C. elegans, most miRNAs are down-regulated with age and this decline is reversed by caloric restriction, while in mice and humans aging is associated with reproducible changes in miRNA abundance, though not in all organs. The age-related reduction in miRNAs, partly driven by declining levels of the processing enzyme Dicer, contributes to the loss of post-transcriptional gene regulation and to cellular senescence.
context_zh_TW: MicroRNA 水平通常隨著年齡的增長而下降，導致 gene expression 隨年齡增長而改變。在秀麗隱桿線蟲中，大多數 miRNA 會隨著年齡的增長而下調，而這種下降可以透過熱量限制來逆轉，而在小鼠和人類中，老化與 miRNA 豐度的可重複變化相關，儘管並非在所有器官中都如此。與年齡相關的 miRNA 減少，部分是由於加工酶 Dicer 水平下降所致，導致轉錄後基因調控的喪失和細胞老化。

label: has_types
context: Microautophagy involves the direct engulfment of cytoplasmic cargo by the lysosomal (or vacuolar) membrane through invagination, tubulation, or protrusion of the limiting membrane, without the requirement for a distinct autophagosome intermediate.
