context: The 3'UTR of the SIRT1 transcript contains a miR-34a-responsive element; active miR-34a represses SIRT1 translation. Directionally, miR-34a sits upstream to lower SIRT1 protein. Because SIRT1 deacetylates and inhibits p53, this repression is part of a negative feedback loop that helps explain the drop in SIRT1 observed during senescence.
context_zh_TW: SIRT1 轉錄本的 3'UTR 包含一個 miR-34a 響應元件；活性 miR-34a 抑制 SIRT1 的翻譯。方向性上 miR-34a 位於上游以降低 SIRT1 蛋白水平。由於 SIRT1 去乙醯化並抑制 p53，這種抑制是負回饋迴路的一部分，有助於解釋在衰老過程中觀察到的 SIRT1 下降。

label: mediates_binding_to
context: The BH3 domain of Beclin1 binds anti-apoptotic Bcl-2/Bcl-xL proteins, which sequester it and inhibit autophagy, linking apoptosis and autophagy regulation. Directionally, Bcl-2 sits upstream of Beclin1 sequestration. SIRT1 deacetylation of Beclin1 modulates this interaction, illustrating the molecular crosstalk between cell-death and clearance pathways. When Bcl-2 sequesters Beclin1, autophagy is suppressed, but under stress signals that release Beclin1, autophagy proceeds. This interplay determines whether cells commit to apoptosis or to autophagic survival, and it is central to both normal physiology and cancer cell fate decisions.
context_zh_TW: Beclin1 的 BH3 結合域結合抗凋亡 Bcl-2/Bcl-xL 蛋白質，後者將其隔離並抑制自噬，將凋亡和自噬調控聯繫起來。在方向性上，Bcl-2 位於 Beclin1 隔離的上游。SIRT1 對 Beclin1 的去乙醯化調節此相互作用，說明了細胞死亡和清除途徑之間的分子串擾。當 Bcl-2 隔離 Beclin1 時，自噬被抑制，但在釋放 Beclin1 的壓力訊號下，自噬進行。這種相互作用決定細胞是承諾凋亡還是自噬性存活，在正常生理和癌細胞命運決定中都至關重要。

label: increases
context: The COMT Val158 allele increases the thermostability of the enzyme, thereby increasing its level of activity compared to the 158 Met allele. This higher activity increases dopamine turnover in cortical synapses. A common polymorphism resulting in increased COMT activity has been associated with poorer cognitive performance and increased susceptibility to psychiatric disorders.
context_zh_TW: COMT Val158 等位基因增加酶的熱穩定性，從而相對於 158 Met 等位基因提高其活性水平。這種較高的活性增加皮質突觸的多巴胺代謝。導致 COMT activity 增加的常見多態性已與較差的認知表現和精神疾病易感性增加相關。

label: has_dna_activated_deacetylase_activity
context: The DNA-activated deacetylase activity of SIRT7 is dependent on both the N- and C-terminal domains. The SIRT7 N-terminal domain (NTD) is made up of three helices, and according to the findings SIRT7-NTD has structural similarities to transcription factor regulators and may have a role in DNA binding. Directionally, the SIRT7 NTD sits upstream of DNA binding and enzymatic activation, connecting SIRT7 structure to its chromatin-associated functions.
context_zh_TW: SIRT7的DNA活化去乙醯酶活性依賴於N端和C端結構域。SIRT7 N端結構域（NTD）由三條螺旋組成，根據研究結果，SIRT7-NTD與轉錄因子調節器具有結構相似性，可能在DNA結合中具有作用。方向上，SIRT7 NTD位於DNA結合和酵素活化的上游，將SIRT7結構與其染色質相關功能聯繫起來。

label: induces_transcription_of
context: The E2F1 transcription factor binds directly to the SIRT1 promoter and activates its transcription, particularly under proliferative or DNA-damage signals. This positions SIRT1 as a downstream effector of E2F1-driven programs that balance cell-cycle progression with survival. Directionally, E2F1 acts upstream of SIRT1 gene activation, linking growth signals to increased sirtuin abundance. Notably, the relationship is reciprocal, because SIRT1 then feeds back to deacetylate and inhibit E2F1's apoptotic function, creating a regulatory loop in which E2F1 both induces its own regulator and is constrained by it—a circuit relevant to tumor suppression and the DNA-damage response.
context_zh_TW: 轉錄因子 E2F1 直接結合 SIRT1 啟動子並活化其轉錄，特別是在增殖或 DNA 損傷信號下。這將 SIRT1 定位為 E2F1 驅動程序的下游效應因子，平衡細胞週期進展與存活。在方向性上，E2F1 位於 SIRT1 基因活化的上游，將生長信號與 sirtuin 表達量增加聯繫起來。值得注意的是，這種關係是互惠的，因為 SIRT1 然後回饋去乙醯化並抑制 E2F1 的凋亡功能，形成一個 E2F1 既誘導其自身調節因子又被其約束的調節迴路——這個電路與腫瘤抑制和 DNA 損傷反應相關。

label: stabilizes
context: The ETS-family transcription factor ELK4 interacts with SIRT7 and stabilizes the deacetylase at target gene promoters, allowing SIRT7 to deacetylate histone H3 at lysine 18 and repress tumor-suppressor genes. This tethering is required to maintain cancer hallmarks such as anchorage-independent growth and loss of contact inhibition. Directionally, ELK4-bound promoter occupancy precedes SIRT7-dependent H3K18 deacetylation. SIRT7 depletion accordingly reduces the tumorigenicity of human cancer xenografts, highlighting the ELK4-SIRT7-H3K18 axis as an oncogenic regulatory circuit.
context_zh_TW: ETS 家族轉錄因子 ELK4 與 SIRT7 互動並將去乙醯酶穩定於靶基因啟動子處，使 SIRT7 能去乙醯化組蛋白 H3 第 18 位離胺酸並抑制腫瘤抑制基因。這種錨定對於維持锚定非依賴性生長和接觸抑制喪失等癌症特徵是必需的。方向性上 ELK4 結合的啟動子占據先於 SIRT7 依賴的 H3K18 去乙醯化。SIRT7 的耗竭相應地降低人類癌症異種移植的致瘤性，凸顯 ELK4-SIRT7-H3K18 軸線作為致癌性調控迴路的重要性。

label: is_the_primary_mechanism_converting
context: The Fenton reaction is the primary mechanism converting hydrogen peroxide into the damaging hydroxyl radical, especially when H2O2 encounters iron bound to DNA, where OH* inflicts damage at that precise locus. This site-specific chemistry explains why iron-bound DNA is peculiarly vulnerable. The directionality is iron plus peroxide to localized radical lesion. A caveat is that the Haber-Weiss reaction and other metal catalysts can also generate hydroxyl radicals, so Fenton chemistry is the major but not unique route.
context_zh_TW: Fenton reaction 是將 hydrogen peroxide 轉化為 damaging 羥基自由基的主要機制，特別是當 H2O2 遇到與 DNA 結合的 iron 時，OH* 在該精確位點造成損傷。這種特定於位點的化學反應解釋了為什麼 iron 綁定的 DNA 特別容易受到攻擊。方向性是iron加過氧化物對局部自由基損傷。需要注意的是，Haber-Weiss 反應和其他金屬催化劑也可以產生 hydroxyl radicals，因此芬頓化學是主要但不是唯一的路線。

label: produces
context: The Fenton reaction produces hydroxyl radicals according to Fe2+ + H2O2 to Fe3+ + OH* + OH-, a one-electron reduction of hydrogen peroxide by ferrous iron. This reaction is the principal mechanism by which relatively inert H2O2 is converted into the supremely reactive hydroxyl radical at sites of free iron. The directionality is metal-catalyzed conversion of a diffusible oxidant into a locally devastating radical. A caveat is that the ferric product can be recycled back to Fe2+ by reductants, sustaining chain production of hydroxyl radicals as long as iron and peroxide coexist.
context_zh_TW: Fenton reaction 根據 Fe2+ + H2O2 產生 hydroxyl radicals 至 Fe3+ + OH* + OH-，這是亞鐵 iron 對 hydrogen peroxide 的單電子還原。此反應是相對惰性的 H2O2 在 free iron 位點轉化為活性極高的羥基自由基的主要機制。方向性是擴散氧化劑在金屬催化下轉化為局部破壞性自由基。需要注意的是，只要 iron 和過氧化物共存，三價鐵產品就可以透過還原劑回收 Fe2+，從而維持 hydroxyl radicals 的鍊式生產。

label: describes
context: The French paradox describes lower cardiovascular-disease incidence in some French populations despite high-fat diets, often attributed in part to moderate wine and resveratrol consumption. Directionally, moderate wine intake sits upstream of reduced CVD in this epidemiological observation. Causality is debated, with diet and lifestyle confounders complicating the interpretation, and the wine matrix and polyphenol content may contribute. Resveratrol's vascular actions provide a plausible, but not proven, mechanism, and the concept has driven considerable research into wine polyphenols, sirtuins, and cardiovascular health.
context_zh_TW: 法國悖論描述了某些法國人群中儘管高脂飲食但心血管疾病發生率較低的現象，部分歸因於適度的葡萄酒和 resveratrol 消費。在方向性上，適度的葡萄酒攝入在此流行病學觀察中位於降低心血管疾病的上游。因果關係存在爭議，飲食和生活方式混雜因素使解釋複雜化，葡萄酒基質和多酚含量可能有所貢獻。resveratrol 的血管作用提供了一個合理的但尚未被證實的機制，此概念已推動了大量關於葡萄酒多酚、sirtuin 和心血管健康的研究。

label: is_a_part_of
context: The G1 Phase (Gap 1) is the first gap phase of the cell cycle in eukaryotic cell division, following mitosis or exit from quiescence and preceding S phase. During G1 the cell grows, synthesizes RNAs and proteins, and monitors its environment before committing to DNA replication.
context_zh_TW: G1 期（第一間隙期）是真核細胞分裂中細胞週期的第一個間隙期，緊接有絲分裂或退出靜止期，並先於 S 期。在 G1 期，細胞生長、合成 RNA 和蛋白質，並在決定進行 DNA 複製前監測其環境。

label: promote_per_guardians_review
context: The Guardians of Mammalian Healthspan review (Giblin, Skinner and Lombard 2014) concludes that mammalian sirtuins, especially SIRT1, SIRT3 and SIRT6, broadly suppress age-related pathologies and promote healthspan. Directionally, sirtuin activity sits upstream of preserved tissue function across organ systems. Consistent with this, increased SIRT1 or SIRT6 expression extends mouse lifespan, positioning the family as guardians of mammalian health rather than simple lifespan determinants. The review emphasizes that sirtuins oppose inflammation, metabolic decline, and cellular damage, making them attractive targets for interventions aimed at compressing late-life morbidity.
context_zh_TW: 《哺乳動物健康壽命的守護者》（Guardians of Mammalian Healthspan）綜述（Giblin, Skinner and Lombard 2014）總結認為，哺乳動物sirtuin，尤其是SIRT1、SIRT3和SIRT6，廣泛抑制與年齡相關的疾病並促進健康壽命。方向上，sirtuin活性位於各器官系統組織功能維持的上游。與此一致，增加SIRT1或SIRT6表達可延長小鼠壽命，將此家族定位為哺乳動物健康的守護者而非簡單的壽命決定因子。該綜述強調sirtuin對抗發炎、代謝衰退和細胞損傷，使其成為旨在壓縮晚年疾病目標的有吸引力的靶點。

label: uses
context: The ICE (Induced Changes in Epigenetics) Mouse uses inducible I-PpoI expression to introduce targeted double-strand breaks that are repaired without introducing mutations. Directionally, I-PpoI sits upstream of controlled double-strand-break formation. This lets researchers trigger DNA damage alone, isolating epigenetic from mutational effects, and it is the experimental engine of the RCM model. By using sequence-specific breaks that are repaired faithfully, the ICE Mouse creates pure DNA-repair events. This design is central to testing whether DNA damage drives aging through epigenetic information loss.
context_zh_TW: ICE（表觀遺傳誘導變化）小鼠使用誘導型 I-PpoI 表達引入靶向的雙鏈斷裂，這些斷裂在不引入突變的情況下被修復。在方向性上，I-PpoI 位於受控雙鏈斷裂形成的上游。這讓研究人員僅觸發 DNA 損傷，將表觀遺傳與突變效應分離，是 RCM 模型的實驗引擎。透過使用被忠實修復的序列特異性斷裂，ICE 小鼠創造純粹的 DNA 修復事件。此設計對於測試 DNA 損傷是否透過表觀遺傳資訊喪失驅動衰老至關重要。

label: has_iupac_name
context: The IUPAC name of adrenochrome is 3-hydroxy-1-methyl-2,3-dihydroindole-5,6-dione, which encodes the complete structure of the molecule: an indole (indoline) bicyclic core, a hydroxyl group at the 3-position, an N-methyl group on the ring nitrogen, and two ketone carbonyls at the 5- and 6-positions of the benzo ring. The 5,6-dione motif makes adrenochrome a quinone, while the 3-hydroxyl and N-methyl groups are the vestiges of the epinephrine side chain after oxidative cyclization. Alternative names such as indoline-5,6-dione refer to the same compound. The name captures the duality of adrenochrome: a rigid indole ring system that is simultaneously an electron-deficient quinone, explaining both its stability within the indole class and its electrophilic reactivity toward biological nucleophiles.
context_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 的 IUPAC 名稱為 3-hydroxy-1-methyl-2,3-dihydroindole-5,6-dione，它編碼了分子的完整結構：一個吲哚（吲哚啉）雙環核心，3 位的一個羥基，環氮上的 N-甲基，以及苯環 5 和 6 位的兩個酮羰基。5,6-二酮基序使 adrenochrome 成為醌，而 3-羥基和 N-甲基是氧化環化後腎上腺素側鏈的殘留物。替代名稱如 indoline-5,6-dione 指的是同一種化合物。該名稱捕捉了 adrenochrome 的雙重性：一個剛性的吲哚環系統，同時是電子缺陷醌，解釋了其在吲哚類中的穩定性及其對生物親核試劑的親電反應性。

label: is_a_biomarker_of
context: The L-arginine to ADMA ratio is a biomarker of cardiovascular risk because it reflects the balance between NOS substrate and the endogenous inhibitor ADMA. A low ratio predicts impaired NO bioavailability and endothelial dysfunction. The directionality is substrate-inhibitor balance to vascular risk. A caveat is that the ratio is one of several endothelial markers and is influenced by renal function and inflammation, which regulate ADMA clearance. The ratio has been proposed as a clinically accessible biomarker for monitoring NO-related vascular health in at-risk populations.
context_zh_TW: L-arginine 與 ADMA 的比率是 cardiovascular risk 的生物標記物，因為它反映了 NOS 底物和內源性抑制劑 ADMA 之間的平衡。低比率預示著 NO 生物利用度和 endothelial dysfunction 受損。方向性是血管風險的底物-抑制劑平衡。需要注意的是，該比率是幾種內皮標記物之一，並受到腎功能和發炎的影響，從而調節 ADMA 清除率。該比率已被提議作為臨床上可用的生物標記物，用於監測高風險族群中與一氧化氮相關的血管健康。

label: is_receptor_for
context: The MET gene product c-Met is the sole known receptor for hepatocyte growth factor (HGF, also called scatter factor). HGF binding induces receptor dimerization, trans-autophosphorylation, and activation of the invasive growth program.
context_zh_TW: MET 基因產物 c-Met 是肝細胞生長因子（HGF，又稱散射因子）唯一已知的受體。HGF 結合誘導受體二聚化、反式自磷酸化和侵入性生長程式的活化。

label: improves
context: The Mediterranean Diet raises HDL while reducing LDL oxidation through its polyphenol-rich components, improving the overall lipid profile. Directionally, the diet sits upstream of favorable lipid changes. This contributes to its cardiovascular protection, and resveratrol and other polyphenols are putative SIRT1-engaging contributors. By combining healthy fats with antioxidant polyphenols, the diet improves both the quantity and quality of circulating lipoproteins. These lipid effects are part of the broader cardiovascular benefit demonstrated in clinical trials of the Mediterranean diet.
context_zh_TW: 地中海飲食透過其富含多酚的成分提高 HDL 同時減少 LDL 氧化，改善整體血脂特徵。在方向性上，飲食位於有利脂質變化的上游。這有助於其心血管保護作用，resveratrol 和其他多酚是假定的 SIRT1 介入貢獻者。透過結合健康脂肪和抗氧化多酚，飲食同時改善了循環脂蛋白的數量和品質。這些脂質效應是地中海飲食臨床試驗中展示的更廣泛心血管益處的一部分。

label: is_associated_with
context: The Met/Met (slow) COMT genotype is associated with approximately three- to four-fold reduced enzyme activity compared with Val/Val, because the methionine substitution at codon 158 renders the protein thermolabile and less catalytically stable. This lower activity slows catechol O-methylation and elevates extracellular dopamine, especially in the prefrontal cortex where DAT is sparse. The magnitude of the activity difference is among the best-established genotype-enzyme relationships in human genetics. It underlies the elevated dopamine tone and cognitive profile of slow COMT carriers.
context_zh_TW: 與 Val/Val 相比，Met/Met（慢）COMT genotype 的酶活性降低約三到四倍，因為密碼子 158 處的甲硫氨酸取代使蛋白質不耐熱且催化穩定性較差。這種較低的活性會減緩兒茶酚 O-甲基化並提高細胞外多巴胺，尤其是在 DAT 稀疏的前額葉皮質。活性差異的大小是人類遺傳學中最確定的基因型-酵素關係之一。它是慢速 COMT 帶因者多巴胺張力和認知特徵升高的基礎。

label: produces
context: The Met/Met genotype produces low COMT enzyme activity, roughly three- to four-fold below Val/Val levels, due to the thermolabile methionine-containing protein that is degraded more readily at body temperature. This reduced activity slows elimination of catecholamines and catechol drugs, prolonging their action and raising extracellular dopamine, particularly in the prefrontal cortex. It is the defining biochemical feature of the slow COMT end of the spectrum. This biochemical phenotype underpins the associated cognitive, mood, and drug-response differences.
context_zh_TW: Met/Met 基因型產生較低的 COMT 酶活性，大約比 Val/Val 水平低三到四倍，這是因為含有不耐熱蛋氨酸的蛋白質在體溫下更容易降解。這種活性的降低減緩了 catecholamines 和兒茶酚藥物的消除，延長了它們的作用並提高了細胞外多巴胺，特別是在前額葉皮質。這是光譜中緩慢的 COMT 端的決定性生化特徵。這種生化表型是相關認知、情緒和藥物反應差異的基礎。

label: weakens_interaction_with
context: The N308K substitution selectively reduces SIRT6-vimentin interaction, which normally promotes SIRT6 degradation, thereby increasing SIRT6 protein levels. Directionally, N308K sits upstream of weakened vimentin binding. This stabilizes SIRT6 and enhances its functional output, and it is the molecular explanation for the centenarian variant phenotype. Because vimentin normally targets SIRT6 for proteasomal degradation, the N308K variant escapes this turnover. This post-translational stabilization, rather than transcriptional upregulation, underlies the increased SIRT6 abundance seen in carriers of the longevity-associated variant.
context_zh_TW: N308K 取代選擇性地減少 SIRT6-vimentin 的相互作用——後者通常促進 SIRT6 降解——從而增加 SIRT6 蛋白水平。在方向性上，N308K 位於 vimentin 結合弱化的上游。這穩定 SIRT6 並增強其功能輸出，是百歲人瑞變異體表型的分子解釋。由於 vimentin 通常靶向 SIRT6 進行蛋白酶體降解，N308K 變異體逃避了這種周轉。這種轉錄後穩定化（而非轉錄上調）構成了長壽相關變異體攜帶者中 SIRT6 豐度增加的基礎。

label: combines
context: The NAC component of GlyNAC is deacetylated to cysteine, supplying the rate-limiting amino acid for glutathione synthesis.
context_zh_TW: GlyNAC 中的 NAC 成分會去乙醯化為半胱胺酸，提供穀胱甘肽合成中限速的胺基酸來源。

label: quantifies
context: The NAD+ bioluminescence assay measures sirtuin activity by quantifying remaining NAD+ after a deacetylation reaction, coupling NAD+ consumption to bacterial luciferase-catalyzed oxidation of decanal via a NAD+/NADH reduction step. It uses a label-free peptide substrate and is applicable to sirtuins with any peptide substrate. Directionally, NAD+ depletion tracks sirtuin catalytic turnover. Its label-free nature and high amenability to high-throughput screening make it a useful complement to fluorescent substrate-based assays, whose artifacts affect STAC measurements.
context_zh_TW: NAD+ 生物發光測定透過量化去乙醯化反應後剩餘的 NAD+ 來測量 sirtuin 活性，將 NAD+ 消耗與細菌螢光素酶催化的癸醛氧化偶聯，透過 NAD+/NADH 還原步驟。它使用無標記的胜肽受質，適用於任何胜肽受質的 sirtuin。方向性上 NAD+ 耗竭追蹤 sirtuin 催化轉化。其無標記特性和高通量篩選的良好適應性使其成為螢光受質基測定的有用補充，後者的假象影響了 STAC 測量。

label: inhibits
context: The NF-κB (nuclear factor kappa-light-chain-enhancer of activated B cells) pathway is implicated in the regulation of inflammatory responses, and urolithin A has been found to inhibit its activation, reducing the production of inflammatory mediators. The literature indicates that urolithin A blocks the NF-κB/STAT1 axis through the inactivation of TLR3/TRIF signaling. By inhibiting the NF-κB pathway, urolithin A can mitigate muscle damage and pain caused by inflammatory responses, thereby promoting muscle recovery and health.
context_zh_TW: NF-κB (nuclear factor kappa-light-chain-enhancer of activated B cells) 路徑參與發炎反應的調節，且已發現 urolithin A 可抑制其活化，減少發炎介質的產生。文獻指出 urolithin A 透過使 TLR3/TRIF 訊號失活來阻斷 NF-κB/STAT1 軸。透過抑制 NF-κB 路徑，urolithin A 可減輕由發炎反應引起的肌肉損傷與疼痛，從而促進肌肉恢復與健康。

label: reduces
context: The PREDIMED trial showed that a Mediterranean diet supplemented with olive oil or nuts significantly reduced major cardiovascular events. Directionally, the dietary pattern sits upstream of lower CVD incidence. Polyphenols including resveratrol may engage SIRT1, but the effect is multifactorial, and it is a clinically validated dietary intervention. The trial provides the strongest evidence that a Mediterranean dietary pattern reduces cardiovascular risk. Its success supports the concept that whole-diet approaches, engaging multiple pathways including sirtuins, are effective for cardiovascular prevention.
context_zh_TW: PREDIMED 試驗顯示，補充橄欖油或堅果的地中海飲食顯著降低了主要心血管事件。在方向性上，飲食模式位於降低心血管疾病發生率的上游。包括 resveratrol 在內的多酚可能作用於 SIRT1，但此效應是多因素的，是一種經過臨床驗證的飲食干預。該試驗提供了最強的證據表明地中海飲食模式降低心血管風險。其成功支持了全飲食方法（涉及 sirtuin 等多種途徑）對心血管預防有效的概念。

label: partners_with
context: The RRM1 (alpha) catalytic subunit partners with the RRM2 (beta) small subunit to form the active ribonucleotide reductase holoenzyme. RRM2 is S-phase-restricted, so the RRM1/RRM2 dimer delivers the dNTP burst needed for DNA replication.
context_zh_TW: RRM1（alpha）催化次單元與 RRM2（beta）小次單元配對形成活性核醣核苷酸還原酶全酶。RRM2 局限於 S 期，因此 RRM1/RRM2 二聚體供應 DNA 複製所需的 dNTP 爆發。

label: partners_with
context: The RRM1 (alpha) catalytic subunit partners with the p53-inducible RRM2B (beta-prime) small subunit (p53R2) to provision dNTPs for DNA repair and mitochondrial DNA synthesis in non-cycling cells. p53 induces RRM2B, which competes with RRM2 for the RRM1 partner.
context_zh_TW: RRM1（alpha）催化次單元與受 p53 誘導的 RRM2B（beta-prime）小次單元（p53R2）配對，在非增殖細胞中供應 DNA 修復與粒線體 DNA 合成所需的 dNTP。p53 誘導 RRM2B，後者與 RRM2 競爭 RRM1 夥伴。

label: recruits
context: The Ragulator is a multiprotein scaffold anchored at the lysosomal membrane that interacts with Rag GTPases to recruit mTORC1 to the lysosomal surface in response to amino acids. By tethering the Rag-mTORC1 complex at the lysosome, Ragulator enables amino-acid sensing to converge with Rheb-mediated activation. Loss of Ragulator disrupts nutrient-dependent mTORC1 signaling and de-represses autophagy. The complex is therefore the lynchpin coupling lysosomal amino-acid detection to mTORC1 and autophagy control.
context_zh_TW: Ragulator 是錨定於溶酶體膜上的多蛋白支架，與 Rag GTPases 交互作用，以回應胺基酸將 mTORC1 招募至溶酶體表面。透過將 Rag-mTORC1 複合物栓繫於溶酶體，Ragulator 使得胺基酸感知能與 Rheb 介導的活化匯聚。Ragulator 的缺失會破壞依賴營養的 mTORC1 信號並解除對自噬的抑制。因此該複合物是將溶酶體胺基酸偵測連結至 mTORC1 與自噬控制的關鍵樞紐。

label: proposes_that
context: The Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers (RCM) Hypothesis is a key framework in aging biology, primarily developed by David Sinclair and colleagues. It proposes that aging in eukaryotes results largely from the progressive loss of epigenetic information due to the repeated relocalization of chromatin-modifying proteins during DNA repair. Chromatin modifiers normally sit at specific genomic loci to maintain gene expression patterns that define cell identity, but are recruited to damage sites during repair, temporarily disrupting their original positions and altering local gene expression.
context_zh_TW: 染色質修飾因子再定位（RCM）假說是衰老生物學中的關鍵框架，主要由 David Sinclair 及其同事發展。該假說提出，真核生物的衰老主要源於表觀遺傳資訊的漸進性喪失，這是因為在 DNA 修復過程中染色質修飾蛋白質反覆再定位所致。染色質修飾因子通常定位於特定的基因組位點，以維持定義細胞身分的基因表達模式，但在修復期間被招募到損傷位點，暫時破壞其原始位置並改變局部基因表達。

label: contributes_to
context: The SASP contributes to inflammaging, the chronic low-grade inflammation that drives many age-related diseases. Senescent cells secrete pro-inflammatory cytokines, chemokines, and proteases that attract immune cells and remodel tissue, and the accumulation of these cells with age sustains systemic inflammation. Because SASP factors promote pathology in neighboring cells, suppressing the SASP or clearing senescent cells is a major therapeutic strategy to counteract inflammaging. Targeting SASP output is therefore one of the most active areas of geroscience drug development.
context_zh_TW: SASP 會導致炎症，這是一種慢性低度炎症，可引發許多與年齡相關的疾病。衰老細胞分泌促發炎細胞因子、趨化因子和蛋白酶，吸引免疫細胞並重塑組織，這些細胞隨著年齡的增長而積累，維持全身發炎。由於 SASP 因子促進鄰近細胞的病理學，因此抑制 SASP 或清除老化細胞是對抗發炎的主要治療策略。因此，以 SASP 輸出為目標是老年科學藥物開發最活躍的領域之一。

label: is_a_type_of
context: The SASP is a hypersecretory state -- a specialized secretory phenotype -- in which senescent cells upregulate and release hundreds of factors including interleukins, chemokines, growth factors, proteases, and extracellular vesicles. This secreted output contrasts with the quiescent, low-turnover secretome of non-senescent cells and is a defining non-cell-autonomous feature of the senescent state. The composition of the SASP is variable, shaped by the senescence inducer, cell type, and tissue context. Its classification as a secretory phenotype emphasizes that senescence exerts its effects largely through communication with the microenvironment.
context_zh_TW: SASP 是一種高分泌狀態——一種特化的分泌表型——衰老細胞在此狀態下上調並釋放數百種因子，包括介白素、趨化因子、生長因子、蛋白酶與細胞外囊泡。此分泌輸出與非衰老細胞靜止、低更新的分泌組形成對比，是衰老狀態定義性的非細胞自主性特徵。SASP 的組成是可變的，受衰老誘發因子、細胞類型與組織脈絡塑造。將其歸類為分泌表型，強調衰老主要透過與微環境的溝通發揮作用。

label: regulated_by
context: The SASP is primarily regulated by NF-kB, the master transcription factor that controls the expression of most SASP genes. NF-kB is activated in senescent cells by the cGAS-STING pathway, DNA damage signaling, and other SASP-inducing pathways, and it drives the transcription of pro-inflammatory cytokines and chemokines. Epigenetic mechanisms, including enhancer remodeling and relief of repressive marks at SASP loci, cooperate with NF-kB to produce the robust inflammatory secretome. Targeting NF-kB or its upstream activators is thus a central strategy for dampening SASP-driven inflammation.
context_zh_TW: SASP 主要受 NF-kB 調節，NF-kB 是控制大多數 SASP 基因表現的主要轉錄因子。 NF-kB 在衰老細胞中透過 cGAS-STING 通路、DNA 損傷信號傳導和其他 SASP 誘導通路激活，並驅動促炎細胞因子和趨化因子的轉錄。表觀遺傳機制，包括增強子重塑和 SASP 基因座抑制標記的緩解，與 NF-kB 合作產生強大的發炎分泌組。因此，靶向 NF-kB 或其上游活化劑是抑制 SASP 驅動的發炎的核心策略。

label: mitigates
context: The SIRT6 activator MDL-800 mitigates unilateral ureteral obstruction (UUO)-induced kidney tubulointerstitial inflammation and fibrosis, validating SIRT6 activation therapeutically. Directionally, MDL-800 activates SIRT6, which protects the kidney. This complements other evidence that SIRT6 restrains TGF-β/Smad3 fibrogenesis and NF-κB-mediated inflammation. It supports SIRT6 as a target for chronic kidney disease, where tubulointerstitial fibrosis determines outcome. The efficacy of a pharmacologic SIRT6 activator in a standard fibrosis model provides important proof-of-concept for SIRT6-based therapies in renal and fibrotic disease.
context_zh_TW: SIRT6 活化因子 MDL-800 減輕單側輸尿管阻塞（UUO）誘導的腎小管間質發炎和纖維化，在治療上驗證了 SIRT6 活化。在方向性上，MDL-800 活化 SIRT6，SIRT6 保護腎臟。這與 SIRT6 限制 TGF-β/Smad3 纖維化和 NF-κB 介導發炎的其他證據互補。它支持 SIRT6 作為慢性腎病的靶點，在該疾病中小管間質纖維化決定預後。藥理性 SIRT6 活化因子在標準纖維化模型中的療效為基於 SIRT6 的腎臟和纖維化疾病療法提供了重要的概念驗證。

label: developed
context: The Sinclair lab developed the ICE Mouse to test the RCM hypothesis using mutation-free double-strand breaks. Directionally, the model enables tests of epigenetic aging. This provided key evidence for the Information Theory of Aging, and it is a methodological contribution alongside the theoretical framework. By engineering a system to induce faithful DNA breaks, Sinclair created a tool to separate epigenetic from genetic contributions to aging. The ICE Mouse's results have made it a centerpiece of the argument that aging results from loss of epigenetic information.
context_zh_TW: Sinclair 實驗室開發了 ICE 小鼠來使用無突變的雙鏈斷裂測試 RCM 假說。在方向性上，該模型使得表觀遺傳衰老的測試成為可能。這為衰老資訊理論提供了關鍵證據，是與理論框架並列的方法學貢獻。透過設計一個誘導忠實 DNA 斷裂的系統，Sinclair 創造了一個工具來分離表觀遺傳和遺傳對衰老的貢獻。ICE 小鼠的結果使其成為衰老源於表觀遺傳資訊喪失這一論點的核心。

label: inhibits
context: The TSC1-TSC2 tumor-suppressor complex acts as a GTPase-activating protein (GAP) for the small G protein Rheb, converting active GTP-bound Rheb to its inactive GDP-bound form. Because only GTP-Rheb directly activates mTORC1, TSC1/TSC2 functions as a critical upstream brake on mTORC1 in response to energy, oxygen, and growth-factor signals. Loss-of-function mutations in TSC1 or TSC2 cause tuberous sclerosis complex, characterized by constitutive mTORC1 activation, hamartoma formation, and autophagy suppression. The complex is therefore a major gatekeeper of mTORC1 and cellular growth.
context_zh_TW: TSC1-TSC2 腫瘤抑制複合物作為小 G 蛋白 Rheb 的 GTP 酶活化蛋白（GAP），將活化的 GTP 結合態 Rheb 轉化為其失活的 GDP 結合態。由於只有 GTP-Rheb 直接活化 mTORC1，TSC1/TSC2 在回應能量、氧氣和生長因子信號時，作為 mTORC1 關鍵的上游制動。TSC1 或 TSC2 的功能缺失突變導致結節性硬化症複合體，其特徵為 mTORC1 組成型活化、錯構瘤形成和自噬抑制。因此該複合物是 mTORC1 與細胞生長的主要守門者。

label: initiates
context: The ULK1 complex, composed of ULK1 or ULK2 kinase together with Atg13, FIP200, and Atg101, acts as the primary initiator of autophagosome formation downstream of nutrient sensing. Under starvation, AMPK directly activates ULK1 while mTORC1 is withdrawn, allowing the complex to phosphorylate targets and recruit the downstream PI3K III/Beclin 1 nucleation machinery. ULK1 kinase activity is essential for the localized recruitment of ATG proteins to the phagophore assembly site and for the earliest steps of membrane expansion. Thus the ULK1 complex serves as the integration point that converts nutrient and energy signals into the physical initiation of autophagosome biogenesis.
context_zh_TW: ULK1複合體由ULK1或ULK2激酶與Atg13、FIP200和Atg101組成，作為營養感知下游自噬體形成的主要起始者。在飢餓下，AMPK直接活化ULK1，同時mTORC1被撤除，使該複合體能磷酸化標靶並招募下游的PI3K III/Beclin 1成核機制。ULK1激酶活性對於ATG蛋白局部招募至吞噬泡組裝位點以及膜擴展的最早步驟至關重要。因此，ULK1複合體作為將營養和能量訊號轉化為自噬體生物發生實質起始的整合點。

label: is_associated_with
context: The Val/Val (fast) COMT genotype is associated with approximately three- to four-fold higher enzyme activity than Met/Met, because the valine substitution yields a thermostable protein with greater catalytic efficiency. This rapid activity accelerates catecholamine clearance, lowering extracellular dopamine especially in the prefrontal cortex where DAT is sparse. The activity difference is a cornerstone of COMT pharmacogenetics and predicts cognition, stress response, and drug responses. It defines the fast end of the COMT activity spectrum.
context_zh_TW: Val/Val（快速）COMT genotype 的酶活性比 Met/Met 高約三到四倍，因為纈氨酸取代產生具有更高催化效率的熱穩定蛋白。這種快速的活性加速了兒茶酚胺的清除，降低了細胞外多巴胺的水平，尤其是在 DAT 稀疏的前額葉皮質。活性差異是 COMT 藥物基因學的基石，可預測認知、壓力反應和藥物反應。它定義了 COMT activity 系列的快速端。

label: produces
context: The Val/Val genotype produces high COMT enzyme activity, roughly three- to four-fold above Met/Met, due to the thermostable valine-containing enzyme with greater catalytic efficiency. This accelerates inactivation of dopamine, norepinephrine, and epinephrine, lowering their extracellular signaling duration, particularly in the prefrontal cortex. It defines the fast end of the COMT activity spectrum with broad cognitive and physiological consequences. It underlies the rapid catechol clearance seen in Val/Val carriers.
context_zh_TW: Val/Val 基因型產生高 COMT 酶活性，大約是 Met/Met 的三到四倍，因為熱穩定的含纈氨酸酶具有更高的催化效率。這加速了多巴胺、norepinephrine 和腎上腺素的失活，降低了它們的細胞外訊號傳導持續時間，特別是在前額葉皮質。它定義了 COMT activity 系列的快速端，具有廣泛的認知和生理後果。它是 Val/Val 攜帶者中兒茶酚快速清除的基礎。

label: reprograms
context: The Yamanaka factors (Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc, abbreviated OSKM) are a set of four transcription factors used to induce pluripotency in differentiated somatic cells. When introduced into fibroblasts or other somatic cells, they initiate a cascade of transcriptional and epigenetic changes that reset the cell toward an embryonic-stem-cell-like state, erasing somatic memory and installing the pluripotency network. This demonstration, pioneered by Shinya Yamanaka in 2006, established that cellular identity is not fixed but can be reprogrammed.
context_zh_TW: 山中因子（Oct4、Sox2、Klf4 和 c-Myc，縮寫為 OSKM）是一組四個轉錄因子，用於誘導分化體細胞的多能性。當引入成纖維細胞或其他體細胞時，它們會啟動一系列轉錄和表觀遺傳學變化，將細胞重置為胚胎幹細胞樣狀態，消除體細胞記憶並安裝多能性網路。此演示由 Shinya Yamanaka 於 2006 年首創，證實細胞身份不是固定的，而是可以重新編程的。

label: is_alias_for
context: The Yamanaka factors are also known as the OSKM cassette, named after the initials of its four constituent transcription factors: Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc. This quartet was identified by Shinya Yamanaka as sufficient to reprogram differentiated somatic cells into induced pluripotent stem cells, a discovery that earned the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine in 2012. The OSKM designation is used throughout the reprogramming and rejuvenation literature, including in partial reprogramming protocols that express the factors transiently to reverse aging.
context_zh_TW: Yamanaka 因子也稱為 OSKM 盒，以其四個組成轉錄因子的縮寫命名：Oct4、Sox2、Klf4 和 c-Myc。 Shinya Yamanaka 鑑定出這個四重體足以將分化的體細胞重編程為誘導多能幹細胞，這一發現贏得了 2012 年諾貝爾生理學或醫學獎。 OSKM 名稱在整個重編程和復興文獻中使用，包括在短暫表達因子以逆轉衰老的部分重編程方案中。

label: includes
context: The Yamanaka factors are the four transcription factors Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc that reprogram somatic cells into induced pluripotent stem cells, and they include Klf4. Klf4 is a zinc-finger transcription factor that interacts directly with Oct4, is required for activation of Nanog, and promotes the mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition needed for reprogramming. Klf4 can act as both a tumor suppressor and an oncogene depending on cellular context. Klf4's dual nature underscores how context determines the function of reprogramming factors.
context_zh_TW: 山中因子是將體細胞重編程為誘導多能幹細胞的四種轉錄因子Oct4、Sox2、Klf4和c-Myc，其中包括Klf4。 Klf4 是一種鋅指轉錄因子，可與 Oct4 直接相互作用，是激活 Nanog 所必需的，並促進重編程所需的間質到上皮的轉變。根據細胞環境，Klf4 可以充當腫瘤抑制基因和癌基因。 Klf4 的雙重性質強調了情境如何決定重編程因子的功能。

label: includes
context: The Yamanaka factors are the four transcription factors Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc that reprogram somatic cells into induced pluripotent stem cells, and they include Sox2. Sox2 cooperates with Oct4 as a heterodimer to regulate pluripotency genes such as Nanog, Fgf4, and osteopontin, and it is also expressed in neural stem cells where it maintains neural identity. Its ectopic expression is essential for the establishment and maintenance of the pluripotent state. Sox2 is therefore essential both for pluripotency maintenance and for the reprogramming process itself.
context_zh_TW: 山中因子是將體細胞重編程為誘導多能幹細胞的四種轉錄因子Oct4、Sox2、Klf4和c-Myc，其中包括Sox2。 Sox2 與 Oct4 作為異二聚體配合調節 Nanog、Fgf4 和骨橋蛋白等多能性基因，並且在神經幹細胞中也表達，維持神經特性。其異位表達對於多能狀態的建立和維持至關重要。因此，Sox2 對於多能性維持和重編程過程本身至關重要。

label: includes
context: The Yamanaka factors are the four transcription factors used to reprogram somatic cells into induced pluripotent stem cells, and they include the oncogene c-Myc. c-Myc opens chromatin by binding methylated regions and promotes the proliferation and metabolic changes that accompany reprogramming initiation. However, c-Myc is a potent oncogene that increases the risk of tumorigenesis in iPSC-derived cells, motivating efforts to exclude or replace it with safer alternatives. Its dual role as reprogramming enhancer and oncogene highlights the safety concerns of iPSC therapy.
context_zh_TW: 山中因子是用於將體細胞重編程為誘導多能幹細胞的四種轉錄因子，其中包括癌基因 c-Myc。 c-Myc 透過結合甲基化區域打開染色質，並促進伴隨重編程啟動的增殖和代謝變化。然而，c-Myc 是一種強效致癌基因，會增加 iPSC 衍生細胞發生腫瘤的風險，促使人們努力排除它或用更安全的替代品取代它。它作為重編程增強子和癌基因的雙重作用凸顯了 iPSC 治療的安全性問題。

label: includes
context: The Yamanaka factors are the four transcription factors used to reprogram somatic cells to induced pluripotency, and they include Oct4. Oct4 is the master regulator of pluripotency, expressed in pluripotent cells during embryogenesis and in embryonic stem cells, and it is essential for establishing and maintaining the pluripotent state. Because Oct4 is required to initiate the reprogramming process, its inclusion among the Yamanaka factors is central to iPSC generation. Without Oct4, the reprogramming cascade cannot initiate, underscoring its irreplaceable role.
context_zh_TW: 山中因子是用於將體細胞重編程為誘導多能性的四種轉錄因子，其中包括 Oct4。 Oct4 是多能性的主要調節因子，在胚胎髮生過程中的多能細胞和胚胎幹細胞中表達，對於建立和維持多能狀態至關重要。由於需要 Oct4 來啟動重編程過程，因此將其納入 Yamanaka 因子對於 iPSC 生成至關重要。如果沒有Oct4，重編程級聯就無法啟動，這凸顯了其不可取代的作用。

label: generates
context: The adrenochrome semiquinone radical is a highly reactive one-electron reduction product of adrenochrome. It rapidly donates its unpaired electron to molecular oxygen, generating superoxide anion and regenerating adrenochrome; the reaction proceeds at approximately 9 x 10^8 M-1 s-1 in some studies. This reaction is the key step in the adrenochrome redox cycle, allowing one molecule of adrenochrome to catalytically produce many superoxide anions without being consumed. The resulting superoxide can oxidize additional adrenaline to adrenochrome, perpetuating the cycle, and antioxidant enzymes such as superoxide dismutase and catalase interrupt it by removing superoxide and hydrogen peroxide.
context_zh_TW: 腎上腺素色素半醌自由基是腎上腺素色素的高度活性單電子還原產物。它迅速將其未配對電子捐贈給分子氧，產生超氧陰離子並再生腎上腺素色素；某些研究中該反應以約9 x 10^8 M-1 s-1的速率進行。此反應是腎上腺素色素氧化還原循環的關鍵步驟，允許一個腎上腺素色素分子催化產生許多超氧陰離子而不被消耗。產生的超氧陰離子可氧化更多腎上腺素為腎上腺素色素，延續循環，而抗氧化酶如超氧化物歧化酶和過氧化氫酶通過移除超氧陰離子和過氧化氫來中斷它。

label: is_upregulated_by
context: The annexin A1-derived tripeptide Ac2-26 transcriptionally upregulates SIRT3, concurrently reducing oxidative damage while promoting mitochondrial biogenesis and mitophagy. In models of ischemic kidney injury, Ac2-26 increases SIRT3 and augments mitochondrial function to limit injury, linking pro-resolving inflammation biology to mitochondrial quality control.
context_zh_TW: Annexin A1 衍生的三胜肽 Ac2-26 在轉錄水平上調 SIRT3，同時減少氧化損傷並促進粒線體生成和粒線體自噬。在缺血性腎損傷模型中，Ac2-26 增加 SIRT3 並增強粒線體功能以限制損傷，將促消退發炎生物學與粒線體品質控制聯繫起來。

label: was_isolated_at
context: The avermectin-producing strain Streptomyces avermectinius was isolated from Japanese soil at the Kitasato Institute.
context_zh_TW: 產生阿維菌素的菌株Streptomyces avermectinius是從日本土壤分離出來的。

label: dysregulated_in
context: The balance between histone acetyltransferase (HAT) and histone deacetylase (HDAC) activity is often disrupted in aging, with reduced histone acetylation observed in neurodegeneration and other age-related conditions. Because acetylation supports open chromatin and gene expression, its loss contributes to aberrant silencing of protective genes and to altered transcriptional programs. Restoring the HAT/HDAC balance is therefore explored as an intervention to counteract age-related epigenetic decline.
context_zh_TW: 組蛋白乙醯轉移酶 (HAT) 和組蛋白去乙醯化酶 (HDAC) 活性之間的平衡在老化過程中經常被破壞，在神經退化性疾病和其他與年齡相關的疾病中觀察到組蛋白乙醯化減少。由於乙醯化支持開放染色質和 gene expression，其缺失會導致保護基因的異常沉默和轉錄程序的改變。因此，恢復 HAT/HDAC 平衡被探討作為抵消與年齡相關的表觀遺傳衰退的干預措施。

label: characterized_by
context: The best-characterized signature of epigenetic drift is global hypomethylation of repetitive elements and gene bodies coupled with site-specific hypermethylation of gene promoters. This age-related divergence of methylation patterns erodes the stability of the epigenome and contributes to the loss of cellular identity and transcriptional fidelity. Because drift accumulates with time and is modified by environment, lifestyle, and interventions such as caloric restriction, it underlies both biological aging and the age-associated increase in disease risk.
context_zh_TW: 表觀遺傳漂變的最佳特徵是重複元件和基因體的整體低甲基化以及基因啟動子的位點特異性高甲基化。這種與年齡相關的甲基化模式的差異會侵蝕表觀基因組的穩定性，並導致細胞身份和轉錄保真度的喪失。由於漂移會隨著時間的推移而累積，並會受到環境、生活方式和熱量限制等乾預措施的改變，因此它是生物老化和與年齡相關的疾病風險增加的基礎。

label: activates
context: The cGAS-STING pathway activates NF-kB, the master transcription factor of the inflammatory response and a key regulator of the SASP. After cGAS binds cytosolic DNA and activates STING, downstream signaling converges on TBK1 and IKK complexes to activate NF-kB, which drives the transcription of pro-inflammatory cytokines and chemokines. In senescent cells this cGAS-STING to NF-kB cascade is a principal route by which cytosolic self-DNA, including retrotransposon cDNA, induces SASP expression. This pathway is therefore a central node linking genomic surveillance to the aging inflammatory program.
context_zh_TW: cGAS-STING 路徑活化 NF-kB，這是發炎反應的主要轉錄因子，也是 SASP 的關鍵調節因子。 cGAS 結合胞質 DNA 並活化 STING 後，下游訊號傳導匯聚到 TBK1 和 IKK 複合物上以活化 NF-kB，從而驅動促炎細胞因子和趨化因子的轉錄。在老化細胞中，cGAS-STING 到 NF-kB 級聯是胞質自身 DNA（包括逆轉錄轉座子 cDNA）誘導 SASP 表現的主要途徑。因此，該途徑是將基因組監測與老化發炎程序聯繫起來的中心節點。

label: measures
context: The cell-based ELISA-type assay, adapted from histone acetyltransferase inhibitor assays, confirms SIRT2 inhibitors such as 3-arylideneindolin-2-ones: cells seeded in 96-well plates are treated with compounds, fixed, permeabilized, and probed with antibody against acetylated alpha-tubulin, with fluorescence measured after enhancement solution addition. This format is well suited for high-throughput screenings. Directionally, the acetylated tubulin signal directly reflects SIRT2 deacetylase inhibition in cells. It complements Western blot with quantitative, plate-based throughput.
context_zh_TW: 基於細胞的 ELISA 型測定改編自組蛋白乙醯轉移酶抑制劑測定，用於確認 SIRT2 抑制劑如 3-亞苄基吲哚酮-2-酮：將細胞接種於 96 孔板中，經化合物處理、固定、透化後，使用抗乙醯化 α-tubulin 的抗體探測，在加入增強溶液後測量螢光。此格式非常適合高通量篩選。方向性上乙醯化 tubulin 訊號直接反映細胞中的 SIRT2 去乙醯酶抑制。它以定量、微孔板兼容的通量補充了西方墨點法。

label: measures
context: The charcoal binding assay measures sirtuin activity by quantifying 3H-labeled OAADPr released as free acetate: incubation of recombinant sirtuins with a 3H-acetylated peptide and NAD+ produces 3H-OAADPr, which binds activated charcoal, but the 3H-acetate hydrolyzed from OAADPr remains in the supernatant and is counted. This method was used to screen nicotinamide analogs and NAD+ metabolites as inhibitors of SIRT2. Directionally, the assay traces sirtuin catalytic flux through its unique OAADPr by-product rather than through fluorophore release, giving an artifact-free alternative to fluorescent assays.
context_zh_TW: 活性炭結合測定透過量化釋放為游離乙酸的 3H 標記 OAADPr 來測量 sirtuin 活性：將重組 sirtuin 與 3H-乙醯化胜肽和 NAD+ 孵育產生 3H-OAADPr，其與活化活性炭結合，而從 OAADPr 水解的 3H-乙酸留在上清液中並被計數。此方法被用於篩選尼可醯胺類似物和 NAD+ 代謝物作為 SIRT2 的抑制劑。方向性上該測定透過其獨特的 OAADPr 副產物而非螢光基團釋放來追溯 sirtuin 催化通量，提供了無假象的螢光測定替代方案。

label: upregulates
context: The circular RNA circ_0001946 upregulates SIRT1, and the resulting SIRT1 activity promotes cell growth in lung adenocarcinoma by activating the Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway. Directionally, circ_0001946 sits upstream of SIRT1 upregulation, which in turn drives oncogenic Wnt signaling. This represents a tumor-promoting axis in lung adenocarcinoma that is opposite to the tumor-suppressive SIRT1 effect mediated by SNHG10 in NSCLC, illustrating how different noncoding RNAs can direct SIRT1 toward opposing outcomes in the same tissue.
context_zh_TW: 環狀RNA circ_0001946上調SIRT1，由此產生的SIRT1活性透過活化Wnt/β-catenin訊號通路促進肺腺癌中的細胞生長。方向上，circ_0001946位於SIRT1上調的上游，後者反過來驅動致癌性Wnt訊號。這代表了肺腺癌中的一個促腫瘤軸，與SNHG10在NSCLC中介導的腫瘤抑制性SIRT1效果相反，說明了不同的非編碼RNA如何能將SIRT1引導至同一組織中的對立結果。

label: includes_class
context: The class III histone deacetylases are the sirtuins (SIRT1-7), NAD+-dependent deacetylases that link metabolic state to chromatin regulation. Unlike class I and II HDACs, which use zinc-dependent catalysis, sirtuins couple deacetylation to NAD+ hydrolysis, making their activity sensitive to cellular energy status. Sirtuins deacetylate histones and numerous non-histone proteins and are strongly implicated in aging and longevity, with Sir2 overexpression extending lifespan in yeast and sirtuin activation emerging as a candidate anti-aging intervention.
context_zh_TW: III 類組蛋白去乙醯化酶是沉默調節蛋白 (SIRT1-7)，這是一種 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯化酶，將代謝狀態與染色質調節聯繫起來。與使用鋅依賴性催化作用的 I 型和 II 型 HDAC 不同，去乙醯化酶將去乙醯化與 NAD+ 水解結合起來，使其活性對細胞能量狀態敏感。 Sirtuins 使組蛋白和許多非組蛋白去乙醯化，與老化和長壽密切相關，Sir2 過度表達可延長酵母壽命，而 Sirtuin 活化則成為候選抗衰老幹預措施。

label: activates
context: The class III phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase (PI3K III) complex, centered on Vps34 and including Beclin 1, Atg14, Vps15, and Ambra-1, generates phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate (PI3P) at membranes to drive autophagosome nucleation. PI3P recruits effector proteins carrying PI3P-binding domains that organize the expanding phagophore and tether downstream ATG conjugation systems. Beclin 1 is a tumor suppressor whose activity is modulated by interacting partners and by anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family proteins that restrain autophagy under fed conditions. This nucleation complex functions immediately downstream of the ULK1 initiator and is a critical control node for the magnitude of autophagic responses.
context_zh_TW: 第三類磷脂醯肌醇3-激酶（PI3K III）複合體以Vps34為核心，並包含Beclin 1、Atg14、Vps15和Ambra-1，在膜上生成磷脂醯肌醇3-磷酸（PI3P）以驅動自噬體成核。PI3P招募帶有PI3P結合域的效應蛋白，這些蛋白組織擴展中的吞噬泡並繫留下游的ATG共軛系統。Beclin 1是一種腫瘤抑制因子，其活性受交互作用夥伴以及抗凋亡Bcl-2家族蛋白的調節，後者在進食狀態下抑制自噬。此成核複合體作用於ULK1起始者緊接的下游，是自噬反應強度的關鍵控制節點。

label: is_protected_by
context: The cochlea is the auditory organ where cumulative oxidative damage drives age-related hearing loss. Caloric restriction reduces oxidative damage in cochlear cells, but this protection is abolished in SIRT3-deficient mice, making SIRT3 indispensable for CR-induced auditory resilience and a candidate therapeutic target in AHL.
context_zh_TW: 耳蝸是聽覺器官，累積的氧化損傷驅動年齡相關性聽力損失。熱量限制減少耳蝸細胞中的氧化損傷，但此保護在 SIRT3 缺陷小鼠中被消除，使 SIRT3 成為 CR 誘導聽覺韌性不可或缺的因子和 AHL 的候選治療靶標。

label: is_a_type_of
context: The combination of Dasatinib and Quercetin (D+Q) was the first rationally identified senolytic, targeting SCAPs such as Bcl-2 family members and PI3K-delta. Intermittent D+Q treatment improves frailty, osteoporosis, cardiovascular function, and pulmonary fibrosis in aged or progeroid mice, motivating the search for more potent single-agent flavonoids like Fisetin.
context_zh_TW: Dasatinib 與 Quercetin 的合併使用（D+Q）是首個以假說驅動方式發現的 senolytic，可攻擊 Bcl-2 家族成員及 PI3K-delta 等 SCAPs。間歇性 D+Q 治療能改善年老或早衰小鼠的衰弱、骨質疏鬆、心血管功能與肺纖維化，也因此促成尋找如 Fisetin 這類更強效單一成分類黃酮的研究。

label: predicts
context: The conclusion of the review positions SIRT3 as a pleiotropic regulatory hub in cellular senescence and geropathology, a critical determinant across cardiovascular diseases, neurodegenerative conditions, metabolic syndrome, cancer, kidney diseases, COPD, and degenerative spine and joint diseases. It highlights SIRT3's regulation of the mitochondrial acetylome and its profound effect on chromatin remodeling and genome stability, making SIRT3 agonism a promising translational strategy in geroscience.
context_zh_TW: 該綜述的結論將 SIRT3 定位為細胞衰老和老年病理學中的多效性調控中樞，是心血管疾病、神經退化性疾病、代謝症候群、癌症、腎臟疾病、COPD 以及退化性脊柱和關節疾病的關鍵決定因子。它凸顯了 SIRT3 對粒線體乙醯酶組的調節及其對染色質重塑和基因組穩定性的深遠影響，使 SIRT3 激動成為老年科學中一個有前景的轉化策略。

label: contain
context: The conserved catalytic core of sirtuins features a large Rossmann fold domain typical of NAD+ binding proteins, together with a small zinc-binding domain and flexible loops that bring the two domains together around an extended cleft for cofactor and substrate. The Rossmann domain contains six parallel beta-strands and a Gly-X-Gly phosphate-binding motif. Directionally, this architecture is intrinsic to the sirtuin family and explains their strict NAD+ dependence. Understanding the structure underscores why NAD+ analogs and pocket C binders act as sirtuin modulators.
context_zh_TW: Sirtuin 的保守催化核心具有大型 Rossmann 摺疊結構域，這是 NAD+ 結合蛋白的典型特徵，還有一個小型鋅結合結構域和柔性環，將兩個結構域圍繞在一個延伸的溝槽周圍以容納輔因子和受質。Rossmann 結構域包含六條平行 beta 鏈和一個 Gly-X-Gly 磷酸鹽結合基序。方向性上這種架構是 sirtuin 家族固有的，解釋了其嚴格的 NAD+ 依賴性。理解此結構凸顯了為何 NAD+ 類似物和口袋 C 結合分子可作為 sirtuin 調節劑。

label: is_a
context: The crystal structure of human SIRT6 reveals a more open conformation than other sirtuins, with the small domain displaced and the cofactor binding loop replaced by a stable single helix. Kinetic and structural data indicate SIRT6 is the unique sirtuin able to bind NAD+ in the absence of an acetyl-lysine substrate. This raises the possibility that SIRT6 evolved away from a conventional NAD+-dependent deacetylase toward a NAD+ metabolite sensor function. Directionally, this distinctive structural feature sets SIRT6 apart from SIRT2, SIRT3, and SIRT5 and informs the search for SIRT6-specific modulators.
context_zh_TW: 人類 SIRT6 的晶體結構揭示了較其他 sirtuin 更為開放的構象，其小型結構域發生位移，輔因子結合環被一個穩定的單一螺旋取代。動力學和結構數據顯示 SIRT6 是唯一能在沒有乙醯-離胺酸受質存在下結合 NAD+ 的 sirtuin。這提出了 SIRT6 可能從傳統的 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶演化為 NAD+ 代謝物感測器功能的可能性。方向性上此獨特的結構特徵將 SIRT6 與 SIRT2、SIRT3 和 SIRT5 區分開來，並為尋找 SIRT6 特異性調節劑提供了依據。

label: activates
context: The cytoplasmic calcium surge activates calmodulin-dependent protein kinase kinase β (CaMKKβ), which phosphorylates and activates AMPK, the central cellular energy sensor. Directionally, Ca2+ activates CaMKKβ, which in turn phosphorylates AMPK. Activated AMPK then induces NAMPT and raises NAD+, closing the loop on SIRT1 activation and promoting catabolic metabolism. This is a key branch point linking calcium flux to metabolic homeostasis, and it explains how agents that raise cytosolic calcium can indirectly boost sirtuin activity, complementing the direct actions of SIRT1 activators and integrating calcium signaling into energy metabolism.
context_zh_TW: 細胞質鈣離子激增活化鈣調蛋白依賴性蛋白激酶激酶 β（CaMKKβ），後者磷酸化並活化 AMPK——細胞的中心能量感測器。在方向性上，Ca2+ 活化 CaMKKβ，CaMKKβ 再磷酸化 AMPK。活化的 AMPK 然後誘導 NAMPT 並升高 NAD+，完成 SIRT1 活化的迴路並促進分解代謝。這是將鈣離子通量與代謝穩態聯繫起來的關鍵分支點，解釋了提高細胞質鈣離子的試劑如何能間接增強 sirtuin 活性，與 SIRT1 活化因子的直接作用互補，並將鈣離子信號整合到能量代謝中。

label: is_required_for
context: The deacetylase activity of SIRT3 is required for viral suppression, and during infection SIRT3 keeps membrane potential and mitochondrial pH stable. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of mitochondrial homeostasis during viral infection, supporting antiviral defence. By maintaining mitochondrial function under infection-induced stress, SIRT3 protects cells from viral damage and restricts viral replication.
context_zh_TW: SIRT3的去乙醯酶活性對病毒抑制是必需的，在感染期間SIRT3保持膜電位和粒線體pH的穩定。方向上，SIRT3位於病毒感染期間粒線體恆定的上游，支持抗病毒防禦。透過在感染誘導的壓力下維持粒線體功能，SIRT3保護細胞免受病毒損傷並限制病毒複製。

label: inhibits
context: The diphosphate form of gemcitabine (dFdCDP) is a potent inhibitor of ribonucleotide reductase, the rate-limiting enzyme for de novo synthesis of deoxyribonucleoside triphosphates. This inhibition depletes intracellular dNTP pools, particularly dCTP, which paradoxically enhances incorporation of gemcitabine triphosphate into DNA.
context_zh_TW: Gemcitabine 的二磷酸形式（dFdCDP）是 ribonucleotide reductase 的強效抑制劑，該酶是從頭合成去氧核苷三磷酸的速率限制酶。此抑制會耗竭細胞內 dNTP 池（尤其 dCTP），反而提高 gemcitabine 三磷酸嵌入 DNA 的程度。

label: uses
context: The enzyme-coupled assay for nicotinamide detection measures sirtuin activity continuously by coupling nicotinamidase (which hydrolyzes nicotinamide to nicotinic acid and ammonia) to glutamate dehydrogenase, which converts ammonia, alpha-ketoglutarate, and NAD(P)H to glutamate and NAD(P)+, quantified spectrophotometrically at 340 nm. It was developed in 2009 and, while not used yet on the scale of large screenings, could be adapted to a high-throughput format. Directionally, a continuous enzyme-coupled readout avoids the artifacts associated with fluorescent and end-point assays.
context_zh_TW: 用於尼可醯胺偵測的酵素偶聯測定透過將尼可醯胺酶（水解尼可醯胺為尼可酸和氨）與穀氨酸脫氫酶偶聯來連續測量 sirtuin 活性，後者將氨、α-酮戊二酸和 NAD(P)H 轉化為穀氨酸和 NAD(P)+，在 340 nm 處進行分光光度法定量。它於 2009 年開發，儘管尚未大規模應用於大型篩選，但可以改編為高通量格式。方向性上連續的酵素偶聯讀取避免了與螢光和終點測定相關的假象。

label: targets
context: The epigenome's responsiveness makes epigenetics a target for rejuvenation strategies. Because age-related epigenetic changes, including epigenetic drift and altered histone modifications, are reversible, interventions that reset DNA methylation and chromatin marks can restore youthful gene expression patterns. Partial reprogramming with Yamanaka factors, epigenetic drug treatments, and lifestyle interventions such as caloric restriction all exploit this epigenetic plasticity to reduce biological age, with epigenetic clocks serving as readouts of rejuvenation success.
context_zh_TW: 表觀基因組的反應性使表觀遺傳學成為復興策略的目標。由於與年齡相關的表觀遺傳學變化（包括表觀遺傳漂移和組蛋白修飾變化）是可逆的，因此重置 DNA 甲基化和染色質標記的干預措施可以恢復年輕的 gene expression 模式。使用山中因子進行部分重編程、表觀遺傳藥物治療和熱量限制等生活方式乾預都利用這種表觀遺傳可塑性來降低生物年齡，而表觀遺傳時鐘可以作為返老還童成功的讀數。

label: declines_during
context: The expression and activity of DNMT1 decline as organisms age, leading to a gradual loss of methylation marks across the genome. Because DNMT1 is responsible for maintaining methylation patterns after DNA replication, its reduced efficiency promotes passive DNA demethylation, particularly at repetitive elements and gene bodies. This age-associated erosion of methylation contributes to epigenetic drift, activation of transposable elements, and chromatin decompaction, all of which are defining features of the aging epigenome.
context_zh_TW: DNMT1 的表達和活性隨著生物體年齡的增長而下降，導致整個基因組中甲基化標記的逐漸喪失。由於 DNMT1 負責在 DNA 複製後維持甲基化模式，因此其效率降低會促進被動 DNA 去甲基化，特別是在重複元件和基因體上。這種與年齡相關的甲基化侵蝕會導致表觀遺傳漂移、轉座元件活化和染色質解壓縮，而這些都是老化表觀基因組的定義特徵。

label: is_the_first_bacterial_sirtuin_found_in
context: The first bacterial sirtuin was found in Salmonella enterica and was named CobB due to its involvement in cobalamin biosynthesis and propionic catabolism. CobB demonstrates that sirtuins are not restricted to eukaryotes but are also present in prokaryotes, where they regulate various metabolic pathways. In bacteria one or two sirtuins are typically found, and CobB serves as the founding example of prokaryotic sirtuin biology.
context_zh_TW: 第一個細菌sirtuin在腸炎沙門氏菌中被發現，由於其參與鈷胺素生物合成和丙酸分解代謝而被命名為CobB。CobB證明了sirtuin並非僅限於真核生物，也存在於原核生物中，在那裡它們調節各種代謝途徑。在細菌中通常發現一到兩個sirtuin，CobB作為原核sirtuin生物學的奠基範例。

label: produces
context: The four Yamanaka factors revert differentiated somatic cells such as fibroblasts to an embryonic-stem-cell-like state, generating induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs). Reprogramming erases somatic methylation and chromatin marks and re-establishes the pluripotency network, yielding cells capable of differentiating into all three germ layers. iPSCs are widely used for disease modeling, drug discovery, and regenerative medicine, and are validated by their ability to form teratomas containing derivatives of all three germ layers.
context_zh_TW: 四種山中因子將纖維母細胞等分化的體細胞恢復為胚胎幹細胞樣狀態，產生誘導性多能幹細胞 (iPSC)。重編程消除了體細胞甲基化和染色質標記，並重新建立了多能性網絡，產生能夠分化為所有三個胚層的細胞。 iPSC 廣泛用於疾病建模、藥物發現和再生醫學，並透過其形成含有所有三個胚層衍生物的畸胎瘤的能力得到驗證。

label: is_activated_by_cleavage_of
context: The full-length SIRT3 protein is enzymatically inactive and contains a mitochondrial targeting domain at its N-terminus. Mitochondrial matrix processing peptidase cleaves the N-terminal 101 residues, which then activates the enzyme. Directionally, proteolytic processing sits upstream of SIRT3 catalytic activity within the mitochondrial matrix. This maturation step ensures that SIRT3 functions only after import into mitochondria, where it deacetylates metabolic enzymes.
context_zh_TW: 全長SIRT3蛋白在酵素上是不活性的，其N端包含一個粒線體靶向結構域。粒線體基質加工肽酶切除N端101個殘基，從而活化該酶。方向上，蛋白水解加工位於粒線體基質中SIRT3催化活性的上游。此成熟步驟確保SIRT3僅在輸入粒線體後才發揮功能，在那裡它去乙醯化代謝酶。

label: detoxifies
context: The glyoxalase system, composed of GLO1 and GLO2, is the primary defense system against dicarbonyl stress. Methylglyoxal, glyoxal, and 3-deoxyglucosone are highly reactive dicarbonyl intermediates generated during glycolysis and lipid peroxidation, and if left unchecked they form irreversible AGE crosslinks on cysteine, lysine, and arginine residues. The glyoxalase system neutralizes these precursors, and maintaining GLO1 activity is a primary target for reducing endogenous AGE accumulation. Dysfunction of this system is therefore linked to increased dicarbonyl stress and accelerated protein glycation, with consequences for aging, diabetes, and cardiovascular disease.
context_zh_TW: 由 GLO1 與 GLO2 組成的乙二醛酶系統（glyoxalase system）是對抗二羰基壓力的主要防禦系統。甲基乙二醛（methylglyoxal）、乙二醛（glyoxal）與 3-deoxyglucosone 是糖解與脂質過氧化過程中產生的高度反應性二羰基中間產物，若不加控制，它們會在半胱氨酸、賴氨酸與精氨酸殘基上形成不可逆的 AGE 交聯。乙二醛酶系統中和這些前驅物，而維持 GLO1 活性是減少內生性 AGE 堆積的主要標的。因此，此系統的功能障礙與二羰基壓力增加及蛋白質糖化加速有關，對老化、糖尿病與心血管疾病產生影響。

label: is_involved_in
context: The hippocampus is critically involved in memory consolidation, the process by which newly acquired information is stabilized into long-term storage via hippocampal-neocortical dialogue and synaptic plasticity. COMT expressed in the hippocampus modulates the catecholamine tone that supports this plasticity, linking the enzyme to memory processes beyond the prefrontal cortex. Hippocampal integrity is therefore sensitive to COMT-dependent dopaminergic and noradrenergic signaling, and its dysfunction is central to amnesia and age-related cognitive decline. The region's plasticity mechanisms are fundamental to learning.
context_zh_TW: 海馬體在 memory consolidation 中發揮至關重要的作用，memory consolidation 是新獲得的資訊透過海馬體新皮質對話和 synaptic plasticity 穩定並長期儲存的過程。海馬體中表達的 COMT 調節支持這種可塑性的兒茶酚胺基調，將該酶與前額葉皮質以外的記憶過程聯繫起來。因此，海馬完整性對 COMT 依賴性多巴胺能和去甲腎上腺素能訊號傳導敏感，其功能障礙是健忘症和年齡相關認知能力下降的核心。該區域的可塑性機制是學習的基礎。

label: enriched_at
context: The histone variant H2A.J is enriched at the promoters of SASP genes, where it facilitates changes in chromatin accessibility that induce SASP expression. H2A.J accumulates in human senescent fibroblasts, in aged human skin, and in mouse tissues, particularly in response to persistent DNA damage. This DNA damage-associated incorporation of H2A.J at inflammatory gene loci links the DNA damage response to the activation of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype. This enrichment distinguishes H2A.J from canonical histones and marks the switch toward inflammatory gene expression in senescent cells.
context_zh_TW: 組蛋白變異體 H2A.J 在 SASP 基因的啟動子處富集，它促進染色質可及性的變化，從而誘導 SASP 表達。 H2A.J 在人類老化成纖維細胞、衰老人類皮膚和小鼠組織中積累，特別是在對持續 DNA 損傷的反應中。這種與 DNA 損傷相關的 H2A.J 在發炎基因位點的摻入將 DNA 損傷反應與老化相關分泌表型的活化聯繫起來。這種富集將 H2A.J 與典型組蛋白區分開來，並標誌著衰老細胞中向發炎 gene expression 的轉變。

label: were_screened_with
context: The homogeneous fluorescent deacetylase assay, which uses the fluorescent acetyl-lysine substrate ZMAL and NAD+ followed by trypsin treatment to release the AMC fluorophore, was used to screen several compound families as sirtuin inhibitors, including adenosine mimetics, inhibitors of kinases or phosphatases, suramin analogs, splitomicin derivatives, thiobarbiturates, and 3-arylideneindolin-2-ones. Directionally, the assay's ZMAL-ZML trypsin-coupled readout provides a plate-compatible screen for sirtuin inhibition. Its utility explains the breadth of scaffolds identified across independent discovery programs.
context_zh_TW: 均質螢光去乙醯酶測定使用螢光乙醯-離胺酸受質 ZMAL 和 NAD+，隨後經胰蛋白酶處理釋放 AMC 螢光基團，被用於篩選多個化合物家族作為 sirtuin 抑制劑，包括腺嘌呤類似物、激酶或磷酸酶抑制劑、Suramin 類似物、splitomicin 衍生物、硫代巴比妥酸鹽和 3-亞苄基吲哚酮-2-酮。方向性上該測定的 ZMAL-ZML 胰蛋白酶偶聯讀取提供了適用於微孔板的 sirtuin 抑制篩選方法。其實用性解釋了在獨立發現計畫中鑑定出多種骨架結構的廣度。

label: is_deleted_in_up_to
context: The human SIRT3 gene is deleted in up to 20% of all human cancers analyzed overall, and in up to 40% of breast and ovarian cancers. This frequent deletion establishes SIRT3 as a tumor suppressor that acts through reactive oxygen species suppression and metabolic regulation. Directionally, SIRT3 loss sits upstream of increased tumorigenesis susceptibility. By removing mitochondrial antioxidant protection, deletion of SIRT3 raises oxidative stress that can drive oncogenic signaling and genomic damage. The high deletion frequency, especially in breast and ovarian cancer, suggests SIRT3 status is an important determinant of cancer risk and may have prognostic value.
context_zh_TW: 人類SIRT3基因在所分析的所有人類癌症中高達20%被刪除，在乳腺癌和卵巢癌中高達40%被刪除。這種高頻率的刪除確立了SIRT3作為透過活性氧抑制和代謝調節發揮作用的腫瘤抑制因子。方向上，SIRT3缺失位於腫瘤發生易感性增加的上游。透過移除粒線體抗氧化保護，SIRT3的刪除增加了可驅動致癌訊號和基因組損傷的氧化壓力。高頻率的刪除，特別是在乳腺癌和卵巢癌中，表明SIRT3狀態是癌症風險的重要決定因素，可能具有預後價值。

label: is_upregulated_in
context: The level of SIRT2 is upregulated in non-small cell lung cancer cell lines and in metastatic human melanoma tissues compared to healthy cells and tissues. Directionally, SIRT2 expression is increased in these aggressive cancer contexts. In metastatic melanoma, SIRT2 levels are increased compared to tumours of early stage, suggesting involvement of SIRT2 in the advancement of metastatic disease. SIRT2 therefore represents a potential biomarker and drug target in NSCLC and metastatic melanoma.
context_zh_TW: SIRT2在非小細胞肺癌細胞系和轉移性人類黑色素瘤組織中與健康細胞和組織相比表現為上調。方向上，SIRT2表達在這些侵襲性癌症環境中增加。在轉移性黑色素瘤中，SIRT2水平與早期腫瘤相比增加，表明SIRT2參與了轉移性疾病的進展。因此SIRT2在NSCLC和轉移性黑色素瘤中代表了潛在的生物標誌物和藥物靶點。

label: is_potentiated_by
context: The licorice-derived compound liquiritigenin induces Nrf2 translocation, thereby potentiating SIRT3 activity and facilitating mitochondrial biogenesis while simultaneously suppressing apoptosis in acute kidney injury models. This dual action mitigates oxidative stress injury and cell death, highlighting liquiritigenin's therapeutic value in AKI and related redox-driven pathologies.
context_zh_TW: 源自甘草的化合物 liquiritigenin 誘導 Nrf2 轉位，從而增強 SIRT3 活性並促進粒線體生成，同時在急性腎損傷模型中抑制凋亡。此雙重作用減輕氧化壓力損傷和細胞死亡，凸顯 liquiritigenin 在 AKI 及相關氧化還原驅動病變中的治療價值。

label: requires
context: The lifespan extension produced by sir-2.1 overexpression in C. elegans is strictly dependent on the forkhead transcription factor DAF-16, the worm FOXO ortholog. DAF-16 is the downstream effector that induces stress-resistance and xenobiotic-detoxification genes once sir-2.1 releases it from repression. Mechanistically, sir-2.1 deacetylates and cooperates with DAF-16 to drive the longevity transcriptional program. Thus the directionality is sir-2.1 → DAF-16 → lifespan, and removing DAF-16 abolishes the benefit.
context_zh_TW: sir-2.1 過量表達在 C. elegans 中產生的壽命延長嚴格依賴於叉頭轉錄因子 DAF-16，即線蟲的 FOXO 直系同源物。DAF-16 是下游效應因子，一旦 sir-2.1 將其從抑制中釋放，它便誘導壓力抗性和外源物質解毒基因。在機制上，sir-2.1 去乙醯化並與 DAF-16 協同驅動長壽轉錄程序。因此方向性為 sir-2.1 → DAF-16 → 壽命，去除 DAF-16 則消除此益處。

label: upregulates
context: The long noncoding RNA SNHG10 upregulates the tumor-suppressive sirtuin SIRT1 in non-small-cell lung cancer by sponging miR-543, relieving microRNA-mediated repression of SIRT1 expression. Directionally, SNHG10 acts upstream of SIRT1 abundance in the NSCLC ceRNA network. By sequestering miR-543, SNHG10 raises SIRT1 levels, and this upregulation underlies the lncRNA's tumor-suppressive activity in lung cancer. The finding highlights how noncoding RNAs can tune sirtuin expression and thereby influence the balance between tumor suppression and tumor promotion in specific cancer contexts.
context_zh_TW: 長鏈非編碼RNA SNHG10在非小細胞肺癌中透過海綿吸附miR-543來上調腫瘤抑制性sirtuin SIRT1，解除microRNA對SIRT1表達的抑制。方向上，SNHG10在NSCLC ceRNA網路中位於SIRT1豐度的上游。透過隔離miR-543，SNHG10提高SIRT1水平，此上調構成了該lncRNA在肺癌中腫瘤抑制活性的基礎。此發現突顯了非編碼RNA如何能調節sirtuin表達，從而影響特定癌症環境中腫瘤抑制與腫瘤促進之間的平衡。

label: is_a
context: The lysosome is the cell's terminal degradation center, containing acidic hydrolases that break down proteins, lipids, nucleic acids, and carbohydrates delivered by endocytosis, phagocytosis, and autophagy. Beyond catabolism, lysosomes serve as signaling hubs that integrate nutrient and growth-factor inputs, most notably by hosting the activation of mTORC1 at their surface. This duality—as both waste-disposal organelle and metabolic command post—places lysosomes at the center of cellular homeostasis, development, and aging. Lysosomal dysfunction underlies a broad spectrum of storage and degenerative diseases.
context_zh_TW: 溶酶體是細胞的終端降解中心，含有酸性水解酶，可分解經由胞吞作用、吞噬作用和自噬遞送的蛋白質、脂質、核酸和碳水化合物。除了分解代謝，溶酶體還作為整合營養和生長因子輸入的信號樞紐，最顯著者是在其表面主導 mTORC1 的活化。這種雙重性——既是廢物處理胞器也是代謝指揮站——使溶酶體位居細胞恆定性、發育與老化的中心。溶酶體功能失調是廣泛的儲存性和退化性疾病的基礎。

label: is_site_of
context: The lysosome serves as the physical platform for mTORC1 activation, hosting the recruitment of mTORC1 via Rag GTPases and Ragulator and its encounter with the activator Rheb at the lysosomal surface. Amino-acid sensing, growth-factor inputs, and calcium signals all converge at this organelle to determine mTORC1 activity. By colocalizing mTORC1 with its upstream regulators, the lysosome functionally couples nutrient detection to the control of autophagy and anabolism. This spatial organization is essential for the rapid, reversible regulation of the pathway.
context_zh_TW: 溶酶體作為 mTORC1 活化的物理平台，主導 mTORC1 經由 Rag GTPases 和 Ragulator 的招募，以及其與溶酶體表面活化劑 Rheb 的相遇。胺基酸感知、生長因子輸入和鈣信號都在此胞器匯聚以決定 mTORC1 活性。透過將 mTORC1 與其上游調節者共定位，溶酶體在功能上將營養偵測耦合到自噬和合成代謝的控制。此空間組織對途徑快速、可逆的調節至為必要。

label: is_mammalian_homolog_of
context: The mammalian transcription factor MAX, a partner of MYC, is the functional homolog of C. elegans MXL-3, as expression of mouse MAX in worms rescued the mxl-3 mutant phenotype. This conservation indicates that the MYC/MAX network's repression of lysosomal and metabolic genes is an ancient feature retained from nematodes to mammals. The rescue experiment directly demonstrates mechanistic equivalence between the worm repressor and its mammalian counterpart. It strengthens the translational relevance of MXL-3 studies to human lipid and lysosomal regulation.
context_zh_TW: 哺乳動物轉錄因子 MAX（MYC 的夥伴）是線蟲 MXL-3 的功能性同源物，因為在線蟲中表現小鼠 MAX 能拯救 mxl-3 突變表型。這種保守性表明，MYC/MAX 網絡對溶酶體和代謝基因的抑制是從線蟲到哺乳動物都保留的古老特徵。拯救實驗直接證明了線蟲抑制因子與其哺乳動物對應物之間的機制等效性。它強化了 MXL-3 研究對人類脂質和溶酶體調節的轉譯相關性。

label: transcriptionally_regulated_by
context: The master autophagy-lysosomal regulator TFEB directly transactivates glutaminase (GLS and GLS2), coupling lysosomal-autophagy activation to glutamine catabolism. This transcriptional regulation supplies the carbon and nitrogen needed to support tumor metabolism in pancreatic cancer and other malignancies. TFEB-driven glutaminase upregulation supports the metabolic flexibility underlying therapy resistance. Thus glutaminase links amino acid metabolism to TFEB-driven transcription.
context_zh_TW: 自噬—溶酶體主調控因子 TFEB 直接轉錄活化 glutaminase（GLS 和 GLS2），將溶酶體—自噬活化與麩醯胺分解代謝耦合。此轉錄調節提供支持胰腺癌及其他惡性腫瘤代謝所需的碳和氮。TFEB 驅動的 glutaminase 上調支持構成治療抗性基礎的代謝靈活性。因此 glutaminase 將胺基酸代謝與 TFEB 驅動的轉錄連結起來。

label: integrates
context: The mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) pathway integrates a wide array of intracellular and extracellular cues—including growth factors, insulin, amino acids, oxygen, and energy status—to coordinate cell growth, metabolism, proliferation, and survival. Through its two complexes, mTORC1 and mTORC2, it translates these inputs into decisions about biosynthesis versus catabolism, notably by inhibiting autophagy when resources are abundant. This central integrator role makes mTOR a nodal control point for physiology and a target for cancer, aging, and metabolic disease. Its dysregulation is implicated in nearly every major chronic disease.
context_zh_TW: 雷帕黴素機械性標靶（mTOR）途徑整合了廣泛的細胞內與細胞外線索——包括生長因子、胰島素、胺基酸、氧氣和能量狀態——以協調細胞生長、代謝、增殖與存活。透過其兩個複合物 mTORC1 和 mTORC2，它將這些輸入轉化為關於生物合成與分解代謝的決策，特別是在資源充裕時抑制自噬。這種核心整合者角色使 mTOR 成為生理學的節點控制點，以及癌症、老化和代謝疾病的標靶。其失調與幾乎每一種主要慢性疾病都有關聯。

label: accelerates
context: The mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) pathway is an evolutionarily conserved metabolic signaling cascade regulating cell division, growth and survival, and there is growing evidence that its activity accelerates aging and the development of age-related diseases including cancer, atherosclerosis, diabetes, and declining immune function. mTOR pathway activity is elevated in many tissues with age and correlates with a decline in clearance of damaged proteins and organelles. Hyperactive mTOR signaling has been implicated in cancer, type 2 diabetes, neurodegeneration, and the aging process itself. This provides the rationale for mTOR inhibition as a potential mechanism to slow aging.
context_zh_TW: 雷帕霉素機制性靶標（mTOR）通路是一個進化保守的代謝信號級聯，調控細胞分裂、生長和存活，且有越來越多證據表明其活性加速衰老及年齡相關疾病的發展，包括癌症、動脈粥樣硬化、糖尿病和免疫功能衰退。mTOR通路活性在多種組織中隨年齡增長而升高，與受損蛋白質和細胞器的清除能力下降相關。過度活化的mTOR信號與癌症、第二型糖尿病、神經退化和衰老過程本身有關。這為mTOR抑制作為減緩衰老的潛在機制提供了理論依據。

label: regulates
context: The mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) pathway is considered a key regulator of cellular growth, metabolism, and energy homeostasis, integrating metabolic, hormonal, and environmental signals, and is one of the best-understood molecular pathways for regulating lifespan. The activity of the mTOR pathway is now recognized, based on genetic and pharmacological evidence, as a key factor regulating the aging process, and inhibition of mTOR increases life and healthy functioning in laboratory animals. This makes mTOR signaling central to the aging process and a primary pharmacological target for slowing age-related functional decline.
context_zh_TW: 雷帕霉素機制性靶標（mTOR）通路被認為是細胞生長、代謝和能量恆定的關鍵調節因子，整合代謝、荷爾蒙和環境信號，是調節壽命的最佳理解的分子通路之一。基於遺傳和藥理學證據，mTOR通路的活性現在被認為是調節衰老過程的關鍵因素，且mTOR抑制可增加實驗室動物的壽命和健康功能。這使得mTOR信號成為衰老過程的核心和減緩年齡相關功能衰退的主要藥理學靶標。

label: repress
context: The microRNAs miR-297 and miR-421 act as upstream modulators of SIRT3, repressing its expression and consequently influencing apoptosis-related pathways. Directionally, these microRNAs sit upstream of diminished SIRT3 output. Their dysregulation shifts the apoptotic balance in stressed cells and adds a noncoding-RNA regulatory layer to SIRT3's control of cell fate decisions in aging and malignancy.
context_zh_TW: microRNA miR-297 和 miR-421 作为 SIRT3 的上游调节剂，抑制其表达，从而影响细胞凋亡相关途径。从方向上看，这些 microRNA 位于 SIRT3 输出减少的上游。它們的失調改變了壓力細胞中的凋亡平衡，並為 SIRT3 對老化和惡性腫瘤中細胞命運決定的控制添加了非編碼 RNA 調節層。

label: separates
context: The microfluidic mobility shift assay separates SIRT1 substrate and product peptides by differences in electrophoretic mobility caused by charge and mass changes upon lysine deacetylation, quantitating fluorescence of both peaks. The assay effectively separates neutral-acetylated substrate peptides from deacetylated products bearing an additional positive charge. Although it could support high-throughput screening, it is more suitable for hit confirmation and mechanistic studies. Directionally, it provides a label-based yet artifact-minimized readout of SIRT1 activity distinct from fluorophore-release assays.
context_zh_TW: 微流體遷移率位移測定透過離胺酸去乙醯化引起的電荷和質量變化所導致的電泳遷移率差異來分離 SIRT1 受質和產物胜肽，量化兩個峰的螢光。該測定有效地將中性乙醯化受質胜肽與帶有額外正電荷的去乙醯化產物分開。儘管它可用於高通量篩選，但更適合用於命中確認和機制研究。方向性上它提供了一種基於標記但假象最小化的 SIRT1 活性讀取方式，與螢光基團釋放測定不同。

label: regenerates
context: The mitochondrial isoform of thioredoxin reductase (TXNRD2) recycles oxidized thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) to its active reduced form using NADPH, supporting mitochondrial redox balance and peroxiredoxin 3 regeneration.
context_zh_TW: 粒線體型的硫氧還蛋白還原酶（TXNRD2）利用 NADPH 將被氧化的硫氧還蛋白-2 (Trx2) 回收回其活化的還原態，支持粒線體氧化還原平衡與過氧化還原酶 3 的再生成。

label: upregulates
context: The myokine irisin, cleaved from the membrane protein FNDC5 during exercise, is a potent upstream inducer of BDNF in the hippocampus. Irisin crosses the blood-brain barrier and upregulates BDNF expression through a mechanism dependent on endothelial integrin alphaVbeta5 and the FAK/eNOS signaling pathway.
context_zh_TW: 肌肉因子 irisin 在運動期間從膜蛋白 FNDC5 上被剪切產生，是海馬體 BDNF 的強效上游誘導因子。Irisin 穿越血腦屏障，透過依賴內皮整合素 αVβ5 和 FAK/eNOS 信號途徑的機制上調 BDNF 表達。

label: reuptakes
context: The norepinephrine transporter is responsible for the reuptake of norepinephrine from the synaptic cleft into presynaptic terminals, terminating noradrenergic signaling and recycling the transmitter. As a member of the SLC6A family, NET is the primary determinant of noradrenergic tone in brain and periphery, and its blockade underlies many antidepressants and attention treatments. Its dopamine-reuptake capacity additionally links it to prefrontal dopamine regulation where DAT is sparse. It is a major target in psychopharmacology.
context_zh_TW: norepinephrine轉運蛋白負責將norepinephrine從突觸間隙重新攝取到突觸前末梢，終止去甲腎上腺素訊號傳導並回收發射器。作為 SLC6A 家族的一員，NET 是 brain 和周邊去甲腎上腺素能張力的主要決定因素，其阻斷是許多抗憂鬱藥物和注意力治療的基礎。它還具有多巴胺再攝取能力，與 DAT 稀疏的前額多巴胺調節有關。它是精神藥理學的一個主要目標。

label: competes_with
context: The oncogenic transcription factor MYC competes with TFEB for binding to CLEAR elements in the promoters of lysosomal and autophagy genes. By occupying these sites, MYC represses the TFEB-driven transcriptional program while simultaneously driving its own proliferative gene network. This competitive binding creates a molecular antagonism between growth-promoting and degradative transcriptional programs. The interplay explains how MYC-high tumors suppress autophagy-lysosomal capacity even as they increase metabolic demand.
context_zh_TW: 致癌轉錄因子 MYC 與 TFEB 競爭結合溶酶體和自噬基因啟動子中的 CLEAR 元件。透過佔據這些位點，MYC 抑制 TFEB 驅動的轉錄程序，同時驅動其自身的增生基因網絡。這種競爭性結合在促生長和降解的轉錄程序之間創造了分子拮抗。此交互作用解釋了 MYC 高表現的腫瘤如何抑制自噬—溶酶體能力，即使它們增加了代謝需求。

label: produces
context: The oxidative deamination of glutamate by GDH yields alpha-ketoglutarate, which feeds the tricarboxylic acid cycle as an anaplerotic substrate. This conversion is central to coupling amino-acid catabolism to energy production in liver, kidney, and brain.
context_zh_TW: GDH 對穀氨酸的氧化脫氨產生 α-酮戊二酸，作為回補受質供應三羧酸循環。此轉化是將胺基酸分解代謝與肝、腎和腦中的能量產生偶聯的核心。

label: dephosphorylates
context: The phosphatase CDC14B dephosphorylates SIRT2, triggering its ubiquitination and 26S proteasomal degradation, which promotes exit from mitosis. Directionally, CDC14B sits upstream of SIRT2 destabilization. This couples SIRT2 turnover to cell-cycle progression, and it ensures SIRT2 levels fall as cells complete division. By dephosphorylating SIRT2 at mitotic exit, CDC14B inactivates and degrades the enzyme that was active during G2/M. This regulatory circuit links SIRT2 abundance to the cell cycle and explains the oscillation of SIRT2 levels during division.
context_zh_TW: 磷酸酶 CDC14B 去磷酸化 SIRT2，觸發其泛素化和 26S 蛋白酶體降解，促進有絲分裂退出。在方向性上，CDC14B 位於 SIRT6 不穩定化的上游。這將 SIRT6 周轉與細胞週期進程偶聯，並確保 SIRT6 水平在細胞完成分裂時下降。透過在有絲分裂退出時去磷酸化 SIRT6，CDC14B 使在 G2/M 期間活化的酶失活並降解。此調控迴路將 SIRT6 豐度與細胞週期聯繫起來，並解釋了 SIRT6 水平在分裂過程中的振盪。

label: acetylate
context: The positive histone acetyltransferases PCAF and GCN5 acetylate the myogenic transcription factor MyoD, enhancing its DNA-binding and recruitment of transcriptional machinery. Directionally, PCAF/GCN5 sits upstream of MyoD activation. This promotes muscle differentiation, and SIRT1 opposes this by deacetylating both PCAF and MyoD. By acetylating MyoD, these HATs support the expression of muscle-specific genes during differentiation. The balance between PCAF/GCN5 acetylation and sirtuin deacetylation determines the timing and extent of myogenic commitment.
context_zh_TW: 正向組蛋白乙醯基轉移酶 PCAF 和 GCN5 乙醯化肌源性轉錄因子 MyoD，增強其 DNA 結合和轉錄機器的招募。在方向性上，PCAF/GCN5 位於 MyoD 活化的上游。這促進肌肉分化，而 SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 PCAF 和 MyoD 兩者來對抗。透過乙醯化 MyoD，這些 HAT 在分化期間支持肌肉特異性基因的表達。PCAF/GCN5 乙醯化和 sirtuin 去乙醯化之間的平衡決定了肌源性承諾的時間和程度。

label: controls
context: The prefrontal cortex controls executive function, encompassing planning, decision-making, inhibition, and cognitive flexibility, through its extensive reciprocal connections with posterior cortex, striatum, and thalamus. Its operations depend critically on an optimal, COMT-genotype-sensitive level of dopamine, with both excess and deficiency degrading performance. Because prefrontal DAT is sparse, COMT and NET set the dopamine tone that governs these high-level functions. Dysregulation of prefrontal dopamine is implicated in numerous psychiatric and cognitive disorders.
context_zh_TW: 前額葉皮質透過與後皮質、紋狀體和丘腦的廣泛相互連結來控制 executive function，包括計畫、決策、抑制和認知靈活性。其運作關鍵取決於 COMT 基因型敏感的最佳多巴胺水平，過量和缺乏都會降低表現。由於前額葉 DAT 稀疏，COMT 和 NET 設定了控制這些高階功能的多巴胺基調。前額葉多巴胺的失調與許多精神和認知障礙有關。

label: controls
context: The prefrontal cortex controls working memory by maintaining and manipulating information online through sustained firing of pyramidal networks, a process tightly gated by dopamine D1 receptor signaling. Because prefrontal DAT is sparse, COMT and NET set the dopamine tone that determines working memory capacity, making this region exquisitely sensitive to COMT genotype. Genotype-dependent COMT activity is therefore a major modulator of this function. The region is the primary substrate of working memory in humans.
context_zh_TW: 前額葉皮質透過錐體網路的持續放電來在線上維護和操作訊息，從而控制工作記憶，這個過程受到多巴胺 D1 receptor 訊號的嚴格控制。由於前額葉 DAT 稀疏，COMT 和 NET 設定了決定工作記憶容量的多巴胺基調，使該區域對 COMT genotype 極為敏感。因此，基因型依賴性 COMT activity 是此功能的主要調節劑。此區域是人類工作記憶的主要基質。

label: is
context: The prefrontal cortex is the primary brain region for working memory, as demonstrated by lesion, neuroimaging, and single-neuron recording studies showing its necessity for holding and manipulating information online. Its dopamine-dependent networks are exquisitely sensitive to COMT activity, since DAT is sparse and COMT dominates dopamine clearance there. This regional specialization makes it the focal point of COMT-cognition research and of the inverted-U dopamine model. Working memory is among the functions most strongly influenced by COMT genotype.
context_zh_TW: 病變、神經影像學和單神經元記錄研究表明，前額葉皮質是工作記憶的主要 brain 區域，表明其在線保存和操作資訊的必要性。它的多巴胺依賴性網絡對 COMT activity 非常敏感，因為 DAT 稀疏，而 COMT 在那裡主導多巴胺清除。這種區域專業化使其成為 COMT 認知研究和倒 U 型多巴胺模型的焦點。工作記憶是受 COMT genotype 影響最強烈的功能之一。

label: regenerates
context: The primary biochemical function of creatine is to buffer cellular ATP levels through the creatine-phosphocreatine system. Creatine kinase reversibly catalyzes the transfer of a phosphoryl group from phosphocreatine to ADP, regenerating ATP at rates far exceeding mitochondrial or glycolytic ATP production, which is essential for short bursts of intense activity. The creatine kinase reaction therefore acts as a rapid temporal energy buffer, maintaining ATP:ADP ratios during muscle contraction and other energy-demanding processes. This ATP-regenerating capacity is the basis for creatine's ergogenic effects and is also central to hypotheses about its influence on cancer cell metabolism.
context_zh_TW: 肌酸的主要生化功能是透過肌酸—磷酸肌酸系統緩衝細胞 ATP 濃度。肌酸激酶可逆地催化磷酸基團從磷酸肌酸轉移至 ADP，以遠超過粒線體或糖解 ATP 產生的速率再生 ATP，這對短暫的劇烈活動爆發至關重要。因此，肌酸激酶反應作為快速的時間性能量緩衝，在肌肉收縮及其他耗能過程中維持 ATP:ADP 比值。這種 ATP 再生能力是肌酸增能效應的基礎，也是關於其對癌細胞代謝影響之假說的核心。

label: produces
context: The production of urolithin A depends largely on the metabolic activities of the gut microbiota. During digestion, polyphenolic compounds such as tannins and anthocyanins undergo enzymatic reactions and metabolic conversions facilitated by microbial enzymes, culminating in the production of urolithin A. This metabolism predominantly takes place in the colon, which houses a variety of microbial groups including Proteobacteria, Clostridium, Bifidobacterium, Eubacterium, and Enterococcus faecium that possess distinct metabolic functions, so individual differences in intestinal microbial composition influence how much urolithin A a person produces and absorbs.
context_zh_TW: urolithin A 的生成主要取決於腸道菌叢的代謝活動。在消化期間，多酚類化合物（如 tannins（單寧）與 anthocyanins（花青素））經歷由微生物酵素促進的酵素反應與代謝轉化，最終產生 urolithin A。此代謝主要發生於結腸，其中棲息著多種微生物群體，包括 Proteobacteria、Clostridium、Bifidobacterium、Eubacterium 與 Enterococcus faecium，它們具有獨特的代謝功能，因此腸道微生物組成的個體差異會影響一個人生成與吸收的 urolithin A 量。

label: is_processed_by
context: The proteolytic processing of OPA1 is mediated by several mitochondrial proteases, including the metalloendopeptidase OMA1, the ATP-dependent zinc metalloprotease YME1L1, the rhomboid protease PARL, paraplegin and the mAAA protease complex. Under stress conditions such as mitochondrial depolarization, the S1 site of OPA1 is cleaved by YME1L1 or OMA1 to produce the short form S-OPA1, which lacks a membrane anchor but can modulate fusion by complexing with membrane-bound L-OPA1. DRP1-mediated zinc influx into the matrix causes membrane depolarization, resulting in OMA1 activation and OPA1 inactivation to enable clearance of damaged mitochondrial fragments by mitophagy.
context_zh_TW: OPA1的蛋白水解加工由幾種粒線體蛋白酶介導，包括金屬內肽酶OMA1、ATP依賴性鋅金屬蛋白酶YME1L1、菱形蛋白酶PARL、paraplegin和mAAA蛋白酶複合物。在粒線體去極化等壓力條件下，OPA1的S1位點被YME1L1或OMA1裂解以產生短形式S-OPA1，該形式缺乏膜錨定但可通過與膜結合的L-OPA1形成複合物來調節融合。DRP1介導的鋅流入基質導致膜去極化，引起OMA1激活和OPA1失活，從而通過線粒體自噬清除受損的粒線體片段。

label: detects
context: The radiochemical assay measures sirtuin deacetylase activity using an acetylated peptide substrate and [carbonyl-14C]-NAD+, detecting the release of 14C-nicotinamide. Unreacted NAD+ is captured by a boronic acid resin, and the unbound fraction containing released nicotinamide is counted in a scintillation counter, in a format compatible with 96-well high-throughput screening. Directionally, radiolabeled nicotinamide release directly quantifies catalytic rounds. This assay confirmed the identification of indoles as sirtuin inhibitors, although radioactive waste and safety considerations limit routine screening use.
context_zh_TW: 放射化學測定使用乙醯化胜肽受質和 [carbonyl-14C]-NAD+ 測量 sirtuin 去乙醯酶活性，偵測 14C-尼可醯胺的釋放。未反應的 NAD+ 被硼酸樹脂捕獲，含有釋放的尼可醯胺的非結合部分在液體閃爍計數器中計數，格式相容於 96 孔高通量篩選。方向性上放射性標記尼可醯胺的釋放直接量化催化輪次。此測定確認了吲哚類作為 sirtuin 抑制劑的鑑定，儘管放射性廢物和安全考量限制了其在常規篩選中的使用。

label: treated_with
context: The retinal pigment epithelium is a target for cell therapy using iPSC-derived RPE, which is being tested in clinical trials for age-related macular degeneration and Stargardt disease. iPSC-derived RPE cells are transplanted subretinally to replace dysfunctional RPE, restoring phagocytosis of photoreceptor outer segments, the visual cycle, and the blood-retina barrier. Key release criteria for such grafts include polarized monolayer formation, phagocytic competence, and RPE65 expression, though immune rejection and graft integration remain challenges.
context_zh_TW: 視網膜色素上皮是使用 iPSC 衍生的 RPE 進行細胞治療的目標，該細胞療法正在針對老年黃斑部病變和 Stargardt 病的臨床試驗中進行測試。 iPSC 衍生的 RPE 細胞被移植到視網膜下以取代功能失調的 RPE，恢復感光器外節的吞噬作用、視覺週期和血液視網膜屏障。此類移植物的關鍵釋放標準包括極化單層形成、吞噬能力和 RPE65 表達，儘管免疫排斥和移植物整合仍然是挑戰。

label: is_product_of
context: The retinoblastoma protein is the product of the RB1 gene, the prototypical tumor suppressor that controls the G1/S cell cycle checkpoint. In its active, hypophosphorylated state, Rb binds and inactivates E2F transcription factors, blocking the expression of cell cycle genes and enforcing quiescence or senescence. Cyclin-dependent kinase phosphorylation inactivates Rb, releasing E2F to drive proliferation, and loss of RB1 therefore promotes uncontrolled cell division and cancer. RB1 mutations are among the most frequent genetic alterations across human cancers.
context_zh_TW: 視網膜母細胞瘤蛋白是 RB1 基因的產物，RB1 基因是控制 G1/S 細胞週期檢查點的典型腫瘤抑制因子。在其活性、低磷酸化狀態下，Rb 結合 E2F 轉錄因子並使 E2F 轉錄因子失活，阻斷細胞週期基因的表達並強迫靜止或老化。細胞週期蛋白依賴性激酶磷酸化使 Rb 失活，釋放 E2F 來驅動增殖，因此 RB1 的缺失會促進不受控制的細胞分裂和癌症。 RB1 突變是人類癌症中最常見的基因改變之一。

label: is_an_effector_of
context: The senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) is the effector arm of the cellular senescence program: it is the set of cytokines, chemokines, proteases, growth factors, and bioactive lipids released by senescent cells that transmit the senescent state to the tissue microenvironment. As a hallmark feature of the senescent state, the SASP mediates many of the paracrine, inflammatory, and tumor-suppressive or tumor-promoting effects attributed to senescent cells.
context_zh_TW: 衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）是細胞衰老程式的效應臂：它是衰老細胞釋放的細胞激素、趨化激素、蛋白酶、生長因子與生物活性脂質的集合，將衰老狀態傳遞給組織微環境。作為衰老狀態的核心特徵，SASP 介導衰老細胞的許多旁分泌、發炎以及抗腫瘤或促腫瘤效應。

label: drives
context: The senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) is the ensemble of pro-inflammatory cytokines, chemokines, and matrix-remodeling enzymes secreted by senescent cells. Accumulation of senescent cells with age creates a chronic, low-grade inflammatory milieu that drives inflammaging—the sterile inflammation implicated in nearly all age-related diseases. SASP factors recruit immune cells, promote fibrosis, and induce paracrine senescence in neighboring cells, establishing feed-forward tissue deterioration. Targeting senescent cells or their SASP is a major therapeutic avenue to reduce inflammaging.
context_zh_TW: 衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）是衰老細胞分泌的促發炎細胞激素、趨化因子和基質重塑酵素之集合。衰老細胞隨年齡累積，創造出慢性、低度的發炎環境，驅動 inflammaging——一種與幾乎所有與年齡相關疾病有關的無菌性發炎。SASP 因子招募免疫細胞、促進纖維化，並誘發鄰近細胞的旁分泌性衰老，建立前饋式的組織惡化。標靶衰老細胞或其 SASP 是減少 inflammaging 的一個主要治療途徑。

label: divides_into
context: The sirtuin NAD+ binding site is divisible into an adenine binding pocket (pocket A), a nicotinamide ribose pocket (pocket B), and a nicotinamide binding pocket (pocket C), formed by the large Rossmann domain and the cofactor binding loop. NAD+ enters a non-productive conformation outside the C pocket until an acetyl-lysine substrate is present, at which point a productive arrangement engages the C pocket. Directionally, this topology defines how inhibitors such as nicotinamide (pocket C) and suramin (pockets B, C, and substrate site) act, and frames structure-based design of sirtuin modulators.
