The parasympathetic nervous system, the rest-digest-and-repair system controlled heavily by the vagus nerve, allows more fluctuation between heartbeats, raising HRV. A high HRV therefore reflects strong vagal tone and a cardiovascular system that is highly responsive and flexible, while low HRV signals chronic stress, fatigue, or illness.
context_zh_TW: HRV 直接受自律神經系統控制，該系統有兩大作用相反的支系。交感神經系統（戰逃僵系統）會釋放腎上腺素與皮質醇，迫使心臟跳得更快且更規律，進而降低 HRV。副交感神經系統（休息消化修復系統）主要由迷走神經控制，允許心跳之間有較大的波動，進而提高 HRV。因此，高 HRV 反映強大的迷走神經張力，以及高度敏銳且具彈性的心血管系統；而低 HRV 則代表慢性壓力、疲勞或疾病。

label: catalyzes
context: IDO1 is a heme-containing, monomeric cytosolic enzyme (~45 kDa) encoded by the IDO1 gene on chromosome 8p11.21 that catalyzes the first and rate-limiting step in the kynurenine pathway (KP) of tryptophan catabolism. It oxidizes L-tryptophan (and other indoleamine substrates such as D-Trp, 5-hydroxy-Trp, tryptamine and serotonin) to N-formylkynurenine in an O2-dependent reaction. The mechanism involves a heme iron center that binds O2, reduction of inactive ferric heme to active ferrous form, and oxidative cleavage of the indole ring at the 2,3-position. The KP accounts for ~95% of tryptophan degradation outside protein synthesis and serotonin production.
context_zh_TW: IDO1 是含血基質的單體胞質酶（約 45 kDa），由位於第 8 號染色體 8p11.21 的 IDO1 基因編碼，催化色胺酸分解代謝中犬尿胺酸途徑（KP）的第一步且為速率限制步驟。它在依賴 O2 的反應中將 L-色胺酸（及其他吲哚胺類受質，如 D-Trp、5-羥基-Trp、色胺與血清素）氧化為 N-甲醯犬尿胺酸。其機制涉及結合 O2 的血基質鐵中心、非活性三價鐵血基質還原為活性二價鐵形式，以及在 2,3 位置對吲哚環進行氧化斷裂。KP 佔蛋白質合成與血清素生成以外約 95% 的色胺酸分解。

label: is_a_component_of
context: IL-6 is a defining component of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP), the pro-inflammatory secretome of senescent cells that drives inflammaging and feed-forward tissue dysfunction (recorded as 'is_a_component_of' 0.96 and 'is_upregulated_in' 0.95 on the parallel pair IL-6 → SASP).
context_zh_TW: IL-6 是衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）的定義性組分——衰老細胞促發炎分泌體，驅動發炎性老化與前饋式組織失能（平行對 IL-6 → SASP 上記為「is_a_component_of」0.96 與「is_upregulated_in」0.95）。

label: activates
context: IRS1 is the upstream insulin receptor substrate in the mTOR-PI3K signaling cascade: the IRS receptor upstream of the pathway is activated by binding reversibly to insulin, and active IRS1 promotes the activation of PI3K by phosphorylation. PI3K in turn activates mTORC2 by phosphorylation and activates IRS1 indirectly via AKT, forming a positive feedback loop. Active IRS1 is inactivated by phosphorylation by S6K1/2, closing a negative feedback arm. IRS1 therefore sits at the hub of the incoherent bivalent motif, and the backward reaction from the target toward IRS1 is central to the hormetic response.
context_zh_TW: IRS1 是 mTOR-PI3K 訊息傳導級聯中的上游胰島素受體受質：該路徑上游的 IRS 受體透過與胰島素可逆結合而活化，活化的 IRS1 經由磷酸化促進 PI3K 的活化。PI3K 接著經由磷酸化活化 mTORC2，並間接透過 AKT 活化 IRS1，形成正回饋迴路。活化的 IRS1 會被 S6K1/2 磷酸化而失活，封閉負回饋臂。因此 IRS1 位於不一致雙價基序的樞紐，從標靶朝 IRS1 的逆向反應是毒物興奮效應反應的核心。

label: extends
context: In one short-lived mutant strain of mice, the mTOR inhibitor rapamycin (known clinically as sirolimus) extends maximum life span nearly three-fold. Rapamycin also prolongs life in normal mice as well as in yeast, worms and flies, and prevents age-related conditions in rodents, dogs, nonhuman primates and humans. In two dozen studies using different strains of mice, rapamycin extended life span, starting from the thorough study by Harrison and colleagues; rapamycin and its analog everolimus are FDA-approved for human use and have been used safely for decades, and rapamycin extends lifespan even when started late in life.
context_zh_TW: 在一個短壽命的小鼠突變品系中，mTOR抑制劑rapamycin（臨床上稱為sirolimus）將最大壽命延長近三倍。Rapamycin也在正常小鼠以及酵母、蠕蟲和果蠅中延長壽命，並預防囓齒動物、狗、非人類靈長類動物和人類的年齡相關疾病。在使用不同小鼠品系的兩 dozen 研究中，rapamycin延長壽命，從Harrison和同事的徹底研究開始；rapamycin及其類似物everolimus已獲FDA批准用於人類，並且已安全使用數十年，即使在生命晚期開始rapamycin也能延長壽命。

label: extends
context: In the triples graph's parallel-relation inventory, Rapamycin → Lifespan carries both 'extends' (0.96) and 'extends_lifespan_in' (0.96) edges encoding the rapamycin longevity literature (mTOR inhibition); the pair-level union keeps a single relation for the default combined dataset.
context_zh_TW: 在 triples 圖的平行關係清單中，Rapamycin → Lifespan 同時帶有「extends」（0.96）與「extends_lifespan_in」（0.96）兩條邊，編碼 rapamycin 延壽文獻（mTOR 抑制）；成對聯集在預設 combined 資料集中保留單一關係。

label: extends_lifespan_in
context: Inhibition of mTOR through rapamycin and its analogs (rapalogs) consistently prolongs life in numerous animal models while improving age-related physiological functions. The breakthrough occurred in 2009 when rapamycin was reported to extend the life of genetically heterogeneous mice, changing the scientific world's perception of aging. Subsequent studies showed rapamycin extends median lifespan by about 10% in UM-HET3 mice and improves glucose tolerance, frailty indicators, gait speed, liver parameters, and weight, while in Drosophila it extends lifespan through increased autophagy and decreased age-related intestinal pathologies. Rapamycin was the only drug among five tested that altered survival.
context_zh_TW: 透過rapamycin及其類似物（rapalogs）對mTOR的抑制在許多動物模型中一致地延長壽命，同時改善年齡相關的生理功能。突破發生在2009年，當時報告rapamycin延長基因異質性小鼠的壽命，改變了科學界對老化的看法。後續研究顯示rapamycin在UM-HET3小鼠中將中位壽命延長約10%，並改善葡萄糖耐受性、虛弱指標、步態速度、肝臟參數和體重，而在黑腹果蠅中，它透過增加自噬和減少年齡相關的腸道病理來延長壽命。Rapamycin是測試的五種藥物中唯一改變存活率的。

label: is_composed_of
context: Interleukin-6 (IL-6) is a prototypical SASP cytokine and one of the most consistently upregulated and secreted factors in senescent cells. It acts as an essential mediator of paracrine senescence and immune modulation and is widely used as a biomarker of the senescent secretome and of organismal aging. IL-6 signals through the JAK/STAT3 pathway to promote inflammation and, in some contexts, stemness and cancer stem-cell traits, and it contributes to the feed-forward loop that sustains the SASP. Its prominence, reliability, and frequent co-measurement with IL-8 make IL-6 a canonical reference factor for defining and quantifying the senescent secretome.
context_zh_TW: 介白素-6（IL-6）是典型 SASP 細胞激素，也是衰老細胞中最一致上調與分泌最穩定的因子之一。它是旁分泌衰老與免疫調節的必要介導者，並廣泛用作衰老分泌組與機體老化的生物標記。IL-6 經 JAK/STAT3 路徑訊號促進發炎，且在部分脈絡中促進幹性與癌症幹細胞特徵，並貢獻於維持 SASP 的正向迴圈。其突出、可靠且常與 IL-8 共測，使 IL-6 成為定義與量化衰老分泌組的典型參考因子。

label: mediates
context: MFN2 (mitofusin 2), encoded by the MFN2 gene, is an outer mitochondrial membrane GTPase that regulates mitochondrial fusion and is required for outer membrane fusion together with MFN1. Beyond fusion, MFN2 plays roles in mitophagy, mitochondrial movement and lipid transfer, and its tethering action is a vital mediator of mitochondria-endoplasmic reticulum contact sites that regulate calcium homeostasis and lipid metabolism. MFN2 can be phosphorylated by PINK1, promoting Parkin recruitment and inducing Parkin-dependent mitophagy, and heterozygous MFN2 mutations cause Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2A.
context_zh_TW: MFN2（mitofusin 2），由 MFN2 基因編碼，是一種外線粒體膜 GTPase，調控 mitochondrial fusion 且與 MFN1 一起 required for outer membrane fusion。除了 fusion，MFN2 在 mitophagy、mitochondrial movement 和 lipid transfer 中扮演角色，且其 tethering action 是 mitochondria-endoplasmic reticulum contact sites 的 vital mediator，調控 calcium homeostasis 和 lipid metabolism。MFN2 可被 PINK1 磷酸化，促進 Parkin recruitment 並誘導 Parkin-dependent mitophagy，且 heterozygous MFN2 mutations 導致 Charcot-Marie-Tooth 病 type 2A。

label: inhibits
context: Mdivi-1 (mitochondrial division inhibitor 1), a quinazolinone derivative that specifically inhibits DRP1, attenuates cardiac dysfunction in diverse mouse cardiomyopathy models, likely by promoting mitochondrial elongation or reducing autophagy. It also attenuates neuronal cell death through mitochondrial elongation and inhibition of complex I activity and ROS generation in neurodegenerative disease models including Parkinson's and Alzheimer's disease. However, treatment of myocardial infarction in pigs with Mdivi-1 did not reduce infarct size or preserve cardiac function, and Mdivi-1 has off-target effects such as cleaving L-OPA1 and altering OXPHOS complex protein expression.
context_zh_TW: Mdivi-1（粒線體分裂抑制劑 1）是一種喹唑啉酮衍生物，可特異性抑制 DRP1，在多種小鼠心肌病模型中減輕心臟功能障礙，可能透過促進粒線體延長或減少自噬。它在帕金森氏症與阿茲海默症等神經退化性疾病模型中，也透過粒線體延長以及抑制複合體 I 活性與 ROS 生成來減輕神經元細胞死亡。然而，以 Mdivi-1 治療豬的心肌梗塞並未減少梗塞面積或保存心臟功能，且 Mdivi-1 具有脫靶效應，例如切割 L-OPA1 與改變 OXPHOS 複合體蛋白質表現。

label: are_located_in
context: Medium spiny neurons constitute roughly 90-95% of the neuronal population in the striatum (the caudate nucleus and putamen). They are the principal integrators of cortical, thalamic, and dopaminergic input within the basal ganglia. They form the major output pathways regulating voluntary movement and reward-based learning.
context_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 約占 striatum（尾狀核和殼核）神經元群的 90-95%。它們是基底神經節內皮質、丘腦和多巴胺能輸入的主要整合者。它們形成調節自主運動和獎賞學習的主要輸出途徑。

label: transfers
context: Methylation is the biochemical transfer of a methyl group (-CH3) from a donor such as S-adenosylmethionine to an acceptor molecule, DNA, proteins, lipids, or small metabolites like catechols. This covalent modification alters the chemical properties, activity, or signaling of the target without changing its carbon skeleton, enabling regulation of gene expression, neurotransmitter inactivation, and detoxification. COMT-catalyzed catechol methylation is a classic example within neurotransmitter metabolism. Methylation is thus a universal regulatory and detoxifying mechanism.
context_zh_TW: Methylation 是甲基 (-CH3) 從 S-adenosylmethionine 等供體向受體分子、DNA、蛋白質、脂質或兒茶酚等小代謝物的生化轉移。這種共價修飾改變了標靶的化學性質、活性或訊號傳導，而不改變其碳骨架，從而能夠調節 gene expression、神經傳導物質失活和解毒。 COMT 催化的兒茶酚甲基化是神經傳導物質代謝的經典例子。因此，Methylation 是一種通用的調節和解毒機制。

label: accepts_electrons_from
context: Methylene blue (MB) functions as an alternative mitochondrial electron-transfer carrier. It accepts electrons from NADH, likely via mitochondrial complex I, and is reduced to the leuco form (leuco-MB). It then donates those electrons onward to cytochrome c, bypassing the intermediate electron-transport chain complexes. This NADH-dependent reduction is what makes MB's mitochondrial antioxidant activity mitochondria-specific: in cell-free assays MB only reduces oxidative stress when both NADH and mitochondrial lysate are present, whereas classical chain-breaking antioxidants act independently of the electron transport chain.
context_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)作為粒線體電子轉運的替代載體發揮作用。它從NADH接受電子，可能通過粒線體複合物I，並還原為無色形式（leuco-MB）。然後它將這些電子傳遞給細胞色素c，繞過中間的電子傳遞鏈複合物。這種NADH依賴性還原使得MB的粒線體抗氧化活性具有粒線體特異性：在無細胞測定中，只有當NADH和粒線體裂解液同時存在時，MB才能減少氧化應激，而經典的鏈斷裂抗氧化劑則獨立於電子傳遞鏈發揮作用。

label: is_a_derivative_of
context: Methylene blue (MB) is the first lead chemical structure of the phenothiazine class, the parent heterocyclic scaffold from which many other drugs derive. Structure-activity analysis showed that MB's distinctive neuroprotective and bioenergetic phenotype requires two structural features of the phenothiazine nucleus: a free (unsubstituted) 10-nitrogen and the position-5 sulfur of the thiazine ring. Adding an amine side chain to the 10-nitrogen (as in chlorpromazine or promethazine) produced roughly a 1000-fold loss of potency and abolished the complex I-to-cytochrome c electron shunt.
context_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)是吩噻嗪類的第一個先導化學結構，是許多其他藥物衍生的母體雜環骨架。結構-活性分析表明，MB獨特的神經保護和生物能量表型需要吩噻嗪核的兩個結構特徵：游離（未取代的）10-氮和噻嗪環的5位硫。將胺側鏈添加到10-氮（如chlorpromazine或promethazine中）導致效力損失約1000倍，並廢除了複合物I到細胞色素c的電子分流。

label: is
context: Methylfolate (5-methyltetrahydrofolate) is the active, methylated circulating form of folate produced by MTHFR and absorbed directly from diet or supplements. It donates its methyl group to homocysteine via methionine synthase, supporting methionine and SAMe synthesis, the methyl donor supply for COMT. As the bioactive folate, it is central to the methylation cycle that feeds COMT and to homocysteine regulation. Its production is impaired by MTHFR variants, which is why supplementation is common.
context_zh_TW: Methylfolate（5-甲基四氫葉酸）是 folate 的活性甲基化循環形式，由 MTHFR 產生，可直接從飲食或補充劑中吸收。它透過蛋氨酸合成酶將其甲基提供給同型半胱氨酸，支持蛋氨酸和 SAMe 的合成，methyl donor 為 COMT 供應。作為生物活性 folate，它對於為 COMT 提供營養的 methylation cycle 和同型半胱氨酸調節至關重要。 MTHFR variants 會損害其生成，這就是為什麼補充很常見的原因。

label: counterbalances
context: Mitochondrial fusion and mitochondrial fission are opposing, continuously active processes that together maintain the mitochondrial network in a state of dynamic equilibrium known as mitochondrial dynamics. Fusion mixes mitochondrial contents, diluting damaged components, while fission segregates and removes dysfunctional mitochondrial fragments through mitophagy. The fine-tuned balance between the two processes determines mitochondrial morphology, bioenergetic output, and quality control. A shift toward fusion produces elongated, interconnected networks favoring oxidative phosphorylation, whereas a shift toward fission fragments the network and accompanies stress, apoptosis, and pathological remodeling, making the fusion-fission equilibrium central to cellular homeostasis.
context_zh_TW: 粒線體融合和粒線體分裂是相互對立、持續進行的過程，共同維持粒線體網路處於稱為粒線體動力學的動態平衡狀態。融合混合粒線體內容物，稀釋受損成分，而分裂則透過粒線體自噬分離並移除功能失調的粒線體片段。這兩個過程之間的精細平衡決定了粒線體形態、能量代謝產出和品質控制。偏向融合會產生細長、互連的網路，有利於氧化磷酸化，而偏向分裂則會使網路碎片化，伴隨壓力、細胞凋亡和病理性重塑，使融合-分裂平衡成為細胞恆定性的核心。

label: is_mediated_by
context: Mitochondrial fusion is orchestrated by three main dynamin-related GTPases: mitofusin 1 (MFN1), mitofusin 2 (MFN2) and OPA1. MFN1 and MFN2 are outer mitochondrial membrane transmembrane GTPases required for outer membrane fusion, while OPA1 mostly mediates inner membrane fusion. When MFN1 binds and hydrolyzes GTP, conformational changes in its GTPase domains lead to oligomerization, promoting clustering of the two opposing outer membranes and subsequent fusion. MFN1 and MFN2 are highly homologous with redundant functions; low MFN1 expression can be compensated by MFN2, and knockout of either in mice leads to embryonic lethality.
context_zh_TW: 粒線體融合由三個主要的 dynamin 相關 GTP 酶協調：mitofusin 1（MFN1）、mitofusin 2（MFN2）和 OPA1。MFN1 和 MFN2 是位於粒線體外膜的跨膜 GTP 酶，是外膜融合所必需的，而 OPA1 主要介導內膜融合。當 MFN1 結合和水解 GTP 時，其 GTP 酶結構域的構象變化導致寡聚化，促進兩個對向外膜的聚集及後續融合。MFN1 和 MFN2 具有高度同源性和功能冗餘；低 MFN1 表達可由 MFN2 補償，而小鼠中任一基因的敲除會導致胚胎致死。

label: cleave
context: Multiple caspases redundantly cleave SIRT1 at the C-terminal DEPDVP(704-709) motif under severe DNA damage. Only pan-caspase inhibitors (Q-VD-OPh, Boc-D-FMK, z-VAD) blocked cleavage, while individual knockdown of CASP1-9 failed — the cleavage is distributed across the cascade. The D707A point mutant resists cleavage and the ΔC703 truncation mimics the cleaved fragment. Caspase-mediated SIRT1 cleavage places it in the DDR-cleavage set alongside PARP, DNA-PKcs, and ATM itself — dismantling the repair machinery commits the cell to death.
context_zh_TW: 在嚴重 DNA 損傷下，多種 caspases 會以冗餘方式在 SIRT1 的 C 端 DEPDVP(704-709) 基序進行切割。只有廣效 caspase 抑制劑（Q-VD-OPh、Boc-D-FMK、z-VAD）能阻斷切割，個別沉默 CASP1-9 皆無效——切割分布在整個級聯中。D707A 點突變可抵抗切割，ΔC703 截斷則模擬被切割的片段。caspase 對 SIRT1 的切割使其與 PARP、DNA-PKcs 及 ATM 本身同列於 DDR 切割組——拆解修復機器等同讓細胞走向死亡。

label: regulates
context: NF-kB is the master transcription factor regulating SASP gene expression, controlling the bulk of pro-inflammatory cytokines, chemokines, and growth factors in senescent cells. It is activated by p38 MAPK, GATA4, cGAS-STING, and IL-1R/MyD88 signaling and cooperates with C/EBPb at SASP enhancers to coordinate the secretome. Inhibition of NF-kB robustly suppresses the SASP across models, making it a prime senomorphic target. Its regulatory role is central, though it operates with other axes such as mTOR and AP-1 for full secretome output.
context_zh_TW: NF-κB 是調節 SASP 基因表現的主轉錄因子，控制衰老細胞中大部分促發炎細胞激素、趨化因子與生長因子。它被 p38 MAPK、GATA4、cGAS-STING 與 IL-1R/MyD88 訊號活化，並在 SASP 增強子上與 C/EBPb 協作協調分泌組。抑制 NF-κB 在多種模型中強力抑制 SASP，使其成為主要 senomorphic 標靶。其調節角色為中心，但與 mTOR 與 AP-1 等其他軸共同運作以達完整分泌組輸出。

label: is_regulated_by
context: NF-κB is the master transcriptional regulator of the SASP, controlling expression of the bulk of pro-inflammatory interleukins, chemokines, and growth factors. It is activated downstream of multiple senescence inputs including p38 MAPK, GATA4 (via TRAF3IP2), and cGAS-STING, and it cooperates with C/EBPbeta at SASP enhancers. Inhibition of NF-κB robustly suppresses the inflammatory arm of the SASP across many models. A caveat is that NF-κB is necessary but not sufficient -- full SASP establishment requires additional axes such as IL-1α/MyD88 and mTOR.
context_zh_TW: NF-κB 是 SASP 的主要轉錄調節者，控制大部分促發炎介白素、趨化因子與生長因子的表現。它在 p38 MAPK、GATA4（經由 TRAF3IP2）、cGAS-STING 等多種衰老輸入下游被活化，並在 SASP 增強子上與 C/EBPbeta 協作。抑制 NF-κB 在多種模型中強力抑制 SASP 的發炎臂。需注意，NF-κB 是必要的但非充分的——完整的 SASP 建立還需要 IL-1α/MyD88 與 mTOR 等額外軸。

label: mediates
context: OPA1 (optic atrophy 1) is the dynamin-related GTPase that mediates inner mitochondrial membrane fusion, needed in only one of two colliding mitochondria for fusing the inner membranes. OPA1 exists as eight isoforms and is proteolytically processed by OMA1, YME1L1, PARL, paraplegin and the mAAA protease to generate long (L-OPA1) and short (S-OPA1) forms; L-OPA1 promotes fusion while S-OPA1 modulates it by forming complexes with L-OPA1. Decreased OPA1 reduces fusion and contributes to separating dysfunctional mitochondria for mitophagic removal, and OPA1 mutations cause dominant optic atrophy.
context_zh_TW: OPA1（視神經萎縮1）是介導內粒線體膜融合的dynamin相關GTP酶，在兩個碰撞的粒線體中只需一個即可融合內膜。OPA1以八種異構體形式存在，並被OMA1、YME1L1、PARL、paraplegin和mAAA蛋白酶蛋白水解加工以產生長形式（L-OPA1）和短形式（S-OPA1）；L-OPA1促進融合，而S-OPA1通過與L-OPA1形成複合物來調節融合。OPA1減少降低融合並有助於分離功能異常的粒線體以進行線粒體自噬清除，OPA1突變導致顯性視神經萎縮。

label: binds
context: Rapamycin binds specifically and reversibly to mTORC1, the rapamycin-sensitive complex formed when mTOR associates with raptor; the downstream readout of the signaling cascade in this study is instead mTORC2. Long-term rapamycin exposure (around 24 hours) traps mTOR in mTORC1 complexes, and this sequestration obstructs the assembly of mTORC2. Because rapamycin acts as an indirect activator of mTORC2 via PI3K and an indirect inhibitor of mTORC2 through this sequestration, the pathway architecture resembles an incoherent bivalent network motif centered on the target mTORC1.
context_zh_TW: Rapamycin特異性和可逆地結合mTORC1，這是mTOR與raptor結合時形成的rapamycin敏感複合物；本研究中信號級聯的下游讀數是mTORC2。長期rapamycin暴露（約24小時）將mTOR困在mTORC1複合物中，這種隔離阻礙了mTORC2的組裝。由於rapamycin透過PI3K作為mTORC2的間接活化劑，並透過這種隔離作為mTORC2的間接抑制劑，該通路架構類似於以目標mTORC1為中心的不連貫二價網路基序。

label: is_a_component_of
context: Resting metabolic rate (RMR) is the rate at which the body consumes energy while at rest, and it is the single largest component of total daily energy expenditure (TEE), typically accounting for about 60-70 percent of daily energy use. It is measured under standardized conditions of rest, thermal neutrality, and a fasting state. Because RMR dominates total daily energy expenditure, any change in RMR, such as the transient elevation caused by exercise, has a disproportionate impact on overall energy balance and, over time, on body weight regulation. The review by Speakman focuses on how exercise-induced alterations in RMR influence energy balance.
context_zh_TW: 靜息代謝率（RMR）是身體在休息時消耗能量的速率，它是每日總能量消耗（TEE）中最大的單一組成部分，通常佔每日能量使用量的約60-70%。它在休息、熱中性和禁食狀態的標準化條件下測量。由於RMR主導每日總能量消耗，RMR的任何變化，如運動引起的短暫升高，都會對整體能量平衡產生不相稱的影響，並隨時間影響體重調節。Speakman的綜述專注於運動引起的RMR變化如何影響能量平衡。

label: are_a_type_of
context: Senescent cells are individual cells that have entered the state of cellular senescence -- a stable, essentially irreversible cell-cycle arrest accompanied by the SASP, SAHF (in many human cells), and altered metabolism. They are the cellular instantiation of the senescence process and the units that accumulate in tissues. Distinct from quiescent or differentiated cells, they remain viable yet non-proliferative and pro-secretory. Their persistence and accumulation are what translate the senescence program into organismal-level aging and disease effects.
context_zh_TW: 衰老細胞是已進入細胞衰老狀態的個別細胞——一種穩定、本質上不可逆的細胞週期停滯，伴隨 SASP、SAHF（於多數人類細胞）與代謝改變。它們是衰老過程的細胞實例化，也是在組織中累積的單元。不同於靜止或分化細胞，它們仍存活但非增殖且具促分泌性。它們的持續與累積將衰老程序轉化為個體層次的老化與疾病效應。

label: are_not_cleared_by
context: Targeting mitochondrial citrate metabolism suppresses inflammation across tissues and improves tissue function and healthspan during ageing without detectable changes in p16 or p21 expression, consistent with SASP modulation rather than senolytic clearance of senescent cells. In aged muscle, senescent-like nuclei defined by the CoreScence gene signature are present at similar abundance and distribution across conditions despite reduced SASP-associated transcription and chromatin accessibility at loci such as Ccl2 and Igfbp4. In the liver, the abundance of p16-positive and/or p21-positive cells remains unchanged while their nuclear histone acetylation is reduced by CTPI2 treatment.
context_zh_TW: 靶向線粒體枸櫞酸代謝抑制多個組織中的炎症，並在老化過程中改善組織功能和健康壽命，而p16或p21表達沒有可檢測到的變化，這與SASP調節而非衰老細胞的senolytic清除一致。在老年肌肉中，由CoreScence基因特徵定義的衰老樣細胞核在不同條件下以相似的豐度和分佈存在，儘管SASP相關轉錄和染色質可及性在Ccl2和Igfbp4等位點降低。在肝臟中，p16陽性和/或p21陽性細胞的豐度保持不變，而它們的細胞核組蛋白乙酰化被CTPI2治療降低。

label: is
context: The D2 receptor is an inhibitory (Gi/o-coupled) dopamine receptor whose activation reduces cAMP and opens GIRK potassium channels, hyperpolarizing neurons in the central nervous system. It is a major mediator of dopamine's modulatory effects on movement, reward, motivation, and cognition, and is highly expressed on striatal medium spiny neurons. Its inhibition of cAMP signaling contrasts with the excitatory D1 receptor, enabling bidirectional dopaminergic tuning of basal ganglia output. It is also the principal target of antipsychotic medications.
context_zh_TW: D2 receptor 是一種抑制性（Gi/o 偶聯）多巴胺受體，活化可降低 cAMP 並打開 GIRK 鉀通道，使中樞神經系統中的神經元超極化。它是多巴胺對 movement、reward、動機和認知的調節作用的主要介質，並且在紋狀體中型多棘神經元上高度表達。它對 cAMP 訊號傳導的抑制與興奮性 D1 receptor 形成對比，從而實現 basal ganglia 輸出的雙向多巴胺能調節。這也是antipsychotic medications的主要目標。

label: is_associated_with
context: The Met/Met (slow) COMT genotype is associated with better performance on complex working memory tasks, attributed to the elevated prefrontal dopamine tone produced by reduced enzyme activity. Under non-stressful conditions, this higher dopamine level falls near the peak of the inverted-U curve for cognition, favoring stability, accuracy, and maintenance of information. The association is robust at the group level but moderate in effect size and sensitive to task demands, sex, and environmental context such as stress. It is among the most replicated gene-cognition associations in humans.
context_zh_TW: Met/Met（慢）COMT genotype 與複雜工作記憶任務的較佳表現有關，這歸因於酵素活性降低產生的前額葉多巴胺張力升高。在無壓力的情況下，這種較高的多巴胺水平落在認知倒 U 曲線的峰值附近，有利於訊息的穩定性、準確性和維護。這種關聯在群體層面上很強，但效應大小適中，並且對任務要求、性別和壓力等環境背景敏感。它是人類複製最多的基因認知關聯之一。

label: controls
context: The cerebellum controls motor coordination, precision, timing, and motor learning through its integration of sensory and motor inputs, processed by Purkinje cell outputs to deep nuclei and downstream motor pathways. It fine-tunes ballistic and skilled movements rather than initiating them, and its integrity is essential for smooth, coordinated locomotion. Its role provides a useful anatomical contrast to forebrain structures in COMT-OE studies, where the CaMKIIalpha promoter leaves cerebellar function intact. This preserved function serves as a negative control for forebrain manipulations.
context_zh_TW: 小腦透過感覺和運動輸入的整合來控制 motor coordination 的精確度、計時和運動學習，這些輸入由浦肯野細胞輸出處理到深層核和下游運動路徑。它對彈道和熟練的運動進行微調，而不是啟動它們，其完整性對於平穩、協調的運動至關重要。它的作用為 COMT-OE 研究中的前腦結構提供了有用的解剖學對比，其中 CaMKIIalpha 啟動子使小腦功能保持完整。這種保留的功能可作為前腦操作的陰性對照。

label: serves_as
context: The cerebellum serves as a negative control in COMT-OE studies because CaMKIIalpha-promoter-driven transgene expression is forebrain-restricted, leaving cerebellar structure and function intact. Demonstrating preserved cerebellar-dependent performance, such as motor coordination and balance, confirms that observed cognitive or motor effects arise from forebrain COMT overexpression rather than generalized toxicity. This control strengthens causal interpretation of the model's behavioral outcomes. It exemplifies the value of region-specific promoters in behavioral neuroscience.
context_zh_TW: 小腦充當 negative control in COMT-OE studies，因為 CaMKIIalpha 啟動子驅動的轉基因表達受到前腦限制，從而保持小腦結構和功能完整。證明保留的小腦依賴性性能，例如 motor coordination 和平衡，證實觀察到的認知或運動效應是由前腦 COMT 過度表達而不是普遍毒性引起的。這種控制加強了對模型行為結果的因果解釋。它例證了區域特異性啟動子在行為神經科學中的價值。

label: imports
context: The mitochondrial pyruvate carrier (MPC) links glycolysis-derived pyruvate to the tricarboxylic acid cycle, and its expression increases across multiple senescence models including irradiation-induced, doxorubicin-induced and replicative senescence. Pharmacological inhibition of MPC with UK5099 reduces TCA cycle intermediates and increases lactate levels, consistent with impaired mitochondrial pyruvate import, and suppresses SASP gene expression and secretion without affecting cell cycle arrest. CRISPR-Cas9-mediated deletion of MPC1 similarly reduces SASP factors such as IL6 and IL8, identifying pyruvate import as the entry node of the mitochondrial metabolic axis controlling the SASP.
context_zh_TW: 粒線體丙酮酸載體（MPC）將糖酵解產生的丙酮酸連結至三羧酸循環，其表達在多種衰老模型中增加，包括輻射誘導、doxorubicin誘導和複製性衰老。用UK5099對MPC進行藥理學抑制可降低三羧酸循環中間體並增加乳酸水平，符合粒線體丙酮酸輸入受損的特徵，並抑制SASP基因表達和分泌，而不影響細胞週期停滯。CRISPR-Cas9介導的MPC1缺失同樣減少SASP因子如IL6和IL8，確認丙酮酸輸入是控制SASP的粒線體代謝軸的進入節點。

label: is_enforced_by
context: The p16INK4a/Rb pathway enforces the long-term, irreversible phase of senescence independently of p53. p16 inhibits CDK4 and CDK6, keeping Rb hypophosphorylated and bound to E2F, thereby preventing expression of S-phase genes; this locks in a durable growth arrest. Unlike the p53/p21 arm, which can be transient, p16/Rb-mediated arrest is typically sustained for the life of the cell and is the stronger correlate of in vivo senescent burden with age. Its engagement is a key determinant of why senescence is considered irreversible rather than a quiescent state.
context_zh_TW: p16INK4a/Rb 路徑獨立於 p53 地執行衰老的長期、不可逆階段。p16 抑制 CDK4 與 CDK6，使 Rb 維持低磷酸化並結合 E2F，從而阻止 S 期基因表現；這將持久的生長停滯鎖定。與可能短暫的 p53/p21 臂不同，p16/Rb 介導的停滯通常維持細胞終生，且是體內衰老負擔隨年齡更強的相關因子。其啟動是衰老被視為不可逆而非靜止狀態的關鍵決定因素。

label: is_enforced_by
context: The p53/p21 axis is a primary enforcement mechanism of senescence, especially in damage- and stress-induced forms. DNA damage stabilizes p53, which transcriptionally induces the CDK inhibitor p21CIP1; p21 inhibits cyclin E/A-CDK2, preventing phosphorylation of Rb and blocking S-phase entry. This pathway provides a rapid, p53-dose-dependent G1/S arrest that can be engaged acutely after genotoxic insult. A caveat is that the p53 pathway is frequently disabled in cancer, and p53 also restrains the SASP, so its loss reshapes rather than simply abolishes senescence.
context_zh_TW: p53/p21 軸是衰老的主要執行機制，尤其在損傷與壓力誘發的形式中。DNA 損傷穩定 p53，後者轉錄誘導 CDK 抑制因子 p21CIP1；p21 抑制 cyclin E/A-CDK2，阻止 Rb 磷酸化並阻斷 S 期進入。此路徑提供快速、依賴 p53 劑量的 G1/S 停滯，可在基因毒性傷害後立即啟動。需注意，p53 路徑在癌症中常被失能，且 p53 也會抑制 SASP，因此其缺失是重塑而非單純廢除衰老。

label: has_limited
context: The prefrontal cortex has limited dopamine transporter expression compared with the striatum, meaning dopamine persists longer in the extracellular space and is inactivated mainly by diffusion, NET uptake, and COMT O-methylation. This anatomical constraint is the reason COMT genotype exerts its strongest cognitive effects in prefrontal-dependent tasks. It contrasts sharply with the DAT-dominated striatum, where reuptake is fast. This regional difference is foundational to understanding dopamine regulation and COMT's cognitive role.
context_zh_TW: 與紋狀體相比，前額葉皮質的多巴胺轉運蛋白表達有限，這意味著多巴胺在細胞外空間中持續時間更長，並且主要透過擴散、NET 攝取和 COMT O-甲基化而失去活性。這種解剖學限制是 COMT genotype 在前額葉依賴性任務中發揮最強認知作用的原因。它與 DAT 主導的紋狀體形成鮮明對比，後者的再攝取速度很快。這種區域差異是理解多巴胺調節和 COMT 認知作用的基礎。

label: is_part_of
context: The striatum is part of the basal ganglia, forming the principal input station that receives excitatory cortical and thalamic afferents and dopaminergic input from the substantia nigra pars compacta. Its output via the direct and indirect pathways regulates thalamocortical motor and associative loops, making it central to movement, habit, and reward. COMT and DAT modulate the dopamine that shapes this circuitry, with DAT dominating striatal clearance. This anatomical position underlies its broad functional significance in the brain.
context_zh_TW: 紋狀體是 basal ganglia 的一部分，形成主要輸入站，接收興奮性皮質和丘腦傳入神經以及來自黑質緻密部的多巴胺能輸入。它透過直接和間接途徑的輸出調節丘腦皮質運動和聯想環路，使其成為 movement、習慣和 reward 的核心。 COMT 和 DAT 調節形成此電路的多巴胺，其中 DAT 控制紋狀體間隙。這種解剖位置是其在 brain 中廣泛功能意義的基礎。

label: undergoes
context: The thymus exhibits profound age-associated involution, a striking paradoxical feature of this critical lymphoid tissue. Thymic function begins to decrease from the first year of life; the lymphoid component of the thymic epithelial space involutes roughly 3% per year through middle age (35-45 years) and about 1% per year thereafter, while the perivascular space expands with adipocytes and peripheral lymphocytes. By age 70, the TES falls below 10% of total thymus tissue. Although thymic decline is of minimal consequence to healthy individuals, the reduced efficacy of the aging immune system has direct etiological links with opportunistic infections, autoimmunity, and cancer burden.
context_zh_TW: 胸腺表現出顯著的年齡相關退化，這是這一關鍵淋巴組織的一個突出矛盾特徵。胸腺功能從生命第一年開始下降；胸腺上皮空間的淋巴成分以每年約 3% 的速度退化至中年（35-45 歲），此後每年約 1%，而血管周圍空間隨脂肪細胞和外周淋巴細胞擴增。到 70 歲時，TES 降至總胸腺組織的 10% 以下。儘管胸腺衰退對健康個體影響極小，但老化免疫系統效力降低與機會性感染、自身免疫和癌症負擔有直接的病因學聯繫。

label: impacts
context: Val158Met impacts COMT enzyme activity profoundly: the Met allele encodes a thermolabile protein with roughly three- to four-fold lower activity than the Val allele, making it the principal determinant of fast versus slow catechol clearance. This activity difference cascades into altered dopamine tone, cognition, mood, and drug responses, and underlies the warrior-worrier dichotomy. It is the most functionally consequential COMT variant and among the most studied in psychiatric genetics. Its effect on enzyme kinetics is among the best characterized in human genetics.
context_zh_TW: Val158Met 深刻影響 COMT 酶活性：Met 等位基因編碼的不耐熱蛋白的活性比 Val 等位基因低約三到四倍，使其成為快速與慢速兒茶酚清除的主要決定因素。這種活動差異會導致多巴胺音調、認知、情緒和藥物反應的改變，並成為戰士與擔憂者二分法的基礎。它是功能上最重要的 COMT 變體，也是精神遺傳學中研究最多的變體之一。它對酶動力學的影響是人類遺傳學中最具代表性的。

label: involves
context: Val158Met involves a valine-to-methionine amino acid substitution at codon 158 of the COMT enzyme, replacing a hydrophobic residue with a polar one that destabilizes the protein and reduces its catalytic activity in the Met form. This single missense change is the molecular basis of the fast-slow COMT dichotomy and of the three- to four-fold differences in enzyme activity among genotypes. It is the defining feature of the rs4680 polymorphism. The substitution alters protein thermostability rather than substrate binding directly.
context_zh_TW: Val158Met 涉及 COMT 酶密碼子 158 處的纈氨酸至甲硫氨酸氨基酸取代，以極性殘基取代疏水性殘基，從而使蛋白質不穩定並降低其 Met 形式的催化活性。這種單一的錯義變化是快慢 COMT 二分法以及基因型之間酵素活性三到四倍差異的分子基礎。這是 rs4680 多態性的定義特性。這種取代改變了蛋白質的熱穩定性，而不是直接改變底物結合。

label: is_a
context: Val158Met is a SNP in the COMT gene, specifically a missense variant that alters enzyme function rather than merely regulatory sequence, making it a functional polymorphism. Its location within the COMT coding region directly changes protein thermostability and activity, producing the fast-slow enzyme dichotomy. It is therefore both a marker and a mechanistic driver of COMT-related traits, including cognition, mood, and drug response. It exemplifies how a single coding variant can have broad biological consequences.
context_zh_TW: Val158Met 是 COMT 基因中的 SNP，特別是一種錯義變異體，它改變酵素功能而不僅僅是調節序列，使其成為功能性多態性。它在 COMT 編碼區內的位置直接改變蛋白質的熱穩定性和活性，產生快慢酶二分法。因此，它既是 COMT 相關特徵（包括認知、情緒和 drug response）的標記，也是機械驅動因素。它舉例說明了單一編碼變體如何產生廣泛的生物學後果。

label: forms
context: mTOR can bind to raptor to form the complex mTORC1, or to rictor to form mTORC2, and these complexes have distinct functions and sensitivities. Rapamycin binds specifically and reversibly to mTORC1, while the RICTOR subunit of mTORC2 inhibits its interaction with the FKBP12-rapamycin complex, making mTORC2 effectively insensitive to rapamycin. The model of the pathway includes a dynamic equilibrium between free mTOR and mTORC1, and long-term rapamycin treatment sequesters mTOR in mTORC1 complexes, obstructing the assembly of mTORC2.
context_zh_TW: mTOR可與raptor結合形成複合物mTORC1，或與rictor結合形成mTORC2，這些複合物具有不同的功能和敏感性。雷帕霉素特異且可逆地結合mTORC1，而mTORC2的RICTOR亞基抑制其與FKBP12-雷帕霉素複合物的相互作用，使mTORC2對雷帕霉素 effectively 不敏感。該通路的模型包括游離mTOR和mTORC1之間的動態平衡，長期雷帕霉素治療將mTOR隔離在mTORC1複合物中，阻碍mTORC2的組裝。

label: activates
context: mTORC1, the complex formed when mTOR binds to raptor, activates the ribosomal protein S6 kinases S6K1/S6K2 (S6K1/2) by phosphorylation. Active S6K1/2 in turn inactivates IRS1 by phosphorylation, forming a negative feedback loop that regulates insulin signaling, and also deactivates mTORC2. In the mass-action model of the mTOR-PI3K pathway, the Michaelis-Menten constant for the activation of S6K1/2 by mTORC1 is significantly smaller on average than other pathway constants, correlating with the low backward-reaction constant that increases the rate of hormesis in rapamycin-treated networks.
context_zh_TW: mTORC1是mTOR與raptor結合形成的複合物，透過磷酸化激活核糖體蛋白S6激酶S6K1/S6K2（S6K1/2）。活化的S6K1/2反過來透過磷酸化使IRS1失活，形成調節胰島素信號的負反饋環路，並同時使mTORC2失活。在mTOR-PI3K通路的質量作用模型中，mTORC1對S6K1/2的活化的米氏常數顯著小於其他通路常數，與增加雷帕霉素處理網絡中興奮作用速率的低後向反應常數相關。

label: is_independent_of
context: mtDNA-cGAS-STING signalling and mitochondrial control of histone acetylation operate as independently regulated pathways: senescent BAX- and BAK-deficient fibroblasts show reduced SASP gene expression from impaired cytosolic mtDNA release yet unchanged H3K27ac at SASP loci, and STING inhibition suppresses SASP without affecting histone acetylation. Despite this independence the pathways functionally cooperate: disruption of either is sufficient to suppress SASP while activation of either alone is not sufficient to fully restore it. Acetyl-CoA enables chromatin accessibility at SASP loci while mtDNA-driven innate immune signalling provides the activation required to engage these regions.
context_zh_TW: mtDNA-cGAS-STING訊息傳導與粒線體對組蛋白乙醯化的調控，是作為獨立調控的途徑運作的：衰老的BAX與BAK缺陷纖維母細胞因細胞質mtDNA釋放受損而表現出SASP基因表現降低，但SASP基因座的H3K27ac維持不變；抑制STING可抑制SASP，卻不影響組蛋白乙醯化。儘管彼此獨立，這些途徑在功能上仍相互合作：破壞任何一者都足以抑制SASP，而單獨活化任何一者都不足以完全恢復SASP。乙醯輔酶A（Acetyl-CoA）賦予SASP基因座染色質可及性，而mtDNA驅動的先天免疫訊息傳導則提供參與這些區域所需的活化訊號。

label: inhibits
context: p16INK4a inhibits cyclin-dependent kinase 4 (CDK4) by binding the cyclin D-CDK4 complex, preventing Rb phosphorylation and maintaining the growth-suppressive, hypophosphorylated state of Rb. This is a primary mechanism by which p16 enforces the durable, p53-independent phase of senescence, and loss of p16 is a common event in cancer, underscoring its tumor-suppressive role. The inhibition is direct and well established, and its expression rises with age and senescent burden. p16 is therefore both a cell-cycle brake and a senescence biomarker.
context_zh_TW: p16INK4a 抑制 cyclin-dependent kinase 4（CDK4），透過結合 cyclin D-CDK4 複合體，防止 Rb 磷酸化並維持 Rb 的生長抑制、低磷酸化狀態。這是 p16 執行衰老持久、獨立於 p53 階段的主要機制，且 p16 缺失是癌症常見事件，凸顯其腫瘤抑制角色。此抑制直接且確立牢固，且其表現隨年齡與衰老負擔上升。p16 因此既是細胞週期煞車也是衰老生物標記。

label: is
context: A single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) is a variation at a single nucleotide position in the genome, the most common type of genetic variation, occurring roughly every few hundred bases. SNPs such as COMT Val158Met (rs4680) can alter protein function, gene expression, or drug response, making them the primary markers used in pharmacogenetic and behavioral genetics studies. Most SNPs are neutral, but functional variants can have substantial biological effects. They are the foundation of modern association studies.
context_zh_TW: 單核苷酸多態性 (SNP) 是基因組中單一核苷酸位置的變異，是最常見的遺傳變異類型，大約每幾百個鹼基就會發生一次。 SNPs（例如 COMT Val158Met (rs4680)）可以改變蛋白質功能，gene expression 或 drug response，使它們成為藥物遺傳學和行為遺傳學研究中使用的主要標記。大多數 SNPs 是中性的，但功能變異可以產生顯著的生物效應。它們是現代聯想研究的基礎。

label: is_required_for
context: Acetyl-CoA is the obligate donor for protein acetylation, including histone acetylation, a modification associated with chromatin relaxation and increased accessibility to transcriptional machinery. In senescent cells, acetyl-CoA availability determines H3K27ac deposition at SASP gene loci: enhancing acetyl-CoA levels promotes SASP gene expression while depleting it limits the programme. Acetate supplementation, converted intracellularly into acetyl-CoA by ACSS2, increases nuclear acetylation and induces pro-inflammatory genes IL6, IL8, IL1B and CCL2 without affecting cell cycle regulators, linking mitochondrial metabolism to the epigenetic regulation of inflammatory genes.
context_zh_TW: 乙醯輔酶A（acetyl-CoA）是蛋白質乙醯化（包括組蛋白乙醯化）的必然供體；此修飾與染色質鬆弛及轉錄機制可及性增加有關。在衰老細胞中，乙醯輔酶A的可用性決定了 SASP 基因座位的 H3K27ac 沉積：提高乙醯輔酶A濃度可促進 SASP 基因表現，而耗竭乙醯輔酶A則會限制此程序。補充乙酸（在細胞內由 ACSS2 轉化為乙醯輔酶A）可增加細胞核乙醯化，並誘導 IL6、IL8、IL1B 與 CCL2 等促發炎基因表現，但不影響細胞週期調節因子，將粒線體代謝與發炎基因的表觀遺傳調控連結起來。

label: is_a_type_of
context: Aminoguanidine, also developed as pimagedine by Alteon/Synvista Therapeutics, is the first identified inhibitor of advanced glycation end products (AGEs). By trapping reactive carbonyl species, it prevents the cross-linking of tissue proteins that is proposed to drive many features of aging. Most anti-aging research has been carried out using a hydrochloride (HCL) derivative, which is more soluble and less irritating than the bicarbonate form, and aminoguanidine has a half-life of only 4 hours, so dosages of 150-300 mg per day are best administered in split doses.
context_zh_TW: 氨基胍丁 (Aminoguanidine)，也由 Alteon/Synvista Therapeutics 开发为皮马地宁 (pimagadidine)，是先进糖基化终产物 (AGEs) 的首个抑制剂。通过捕获反应性羰基物种，它能阻止组织蛋白的交联，这被认为是导致衰老许多特征的原因。大部分抗衰老研究都使用盐酸盐 (HCL) 衍生物进行，该衍生物比碳酸氢盐形式更可溶且刺激性更小，而氨基胍丁的半衰期仅为 4 小时，因此，每日 150-300 毫克分剂量给药效果最佳。

label: is_a_type_of
context: Apigenin (4',5,7-trihydroxyflavone) is a major plant flavone belonging to the flavonoid subclass flavones within the polyphenols. It is a yellow crystalline powder with the molecular formula C15H10O5 and a molecular weight of 270.24 Da, bearing hydroxyl groups at C-5 and C-7 of the A-ring and C-4' of the B-ring. Structurally it is related to biapigenin and naturally occurs as apigenin-7-O-glucoside and acylated derivatives. Its classification as a flavone underpins its shared antioxidant and anti-inflammatory pharmacology with other plant polyphenols such as quercetin and kaempferol.
context_zh_TW: 阿皮ゲ寧 (4',5,7-三羟基黄酮) 是一種主要植物黃酮類，屬於黃酮類群內的一種黃酮，屬於多酚類。它是一種黃色結晶粉末，分子式為 C15H10O5，分子量為 270.24 Da，在 A 環的 C-5 和 C-7 位以及 B 環的 C-4' 位帶有羟基。結構上與 البيبيجين (biapigenin) 相關，並自然存在於阿皮ゲ寧-7-O-葡萄糖苷和酰基衍生物中。它作為一種黃酮的分類，使其與如槲皮苷 (quercetin) 和  quercetin 苷等其他植物多酚類共享的抗氧化和抗炎藥理作用相符。

label: is_a_type_of
context: Apigenin is a dietary flavone flavonoid identified by screening a 66-compound natural product library against bleomycin-senescent PSC27 human prostate stromal cells. It functions as a senomorphic agent: it suppresses the pro-inflammatory senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) without killing senescent cells or forcing them back into the cell cycle, in contrast to senolytics such as ABT-263 or procyanidin C1, which preferentially lyse senescent cells. Because it leaves the growth arrest intact, apigenin is classified specifically as a natural senomorphic rather than a senolytic, aligning with the ideal profile for SASP-restraining geroprotective therapy.
context_zh_TW: 芹菜素是一種膳食黃酮類化合物（flavone flavonoid），透過以博萊黴素（bleomycin）誘導衰老的人類前列腺基質細胞PSC27篩選含66種化合物的天然產物庫而鑑定出來。它的功能是衰老形態調節劑（senomorphic agent）：在不殺死衰老細胞、也不強迫其重返細胞週期的情況下，抑制促發炎的衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）；這與優先溶解衰老細胞的衰老細胞清除劑（如ABT-263或原花青素C1）形成對比。由於芹菜素保留了生長停滯狀態，它被明確歸類為天然衰老形態調節劑而非衰老細胞清除劑，符合以抑制SASP為目標的老年保護療法之理想特性。

label: developed
context: At Merck, Campbell led the effort to derivatize avermectin B1a into 22,23-dihydroavermectin B1a (ivermectin).
context_zh_TW: 在默克，Campbell 領導了將阿維菌素 B1a 衍生化為 22,23-二氫阿維菌素 B1a（伊維菌素）的工作。

label: is_precursor_of
context: Avermectin B1a is the natural macrocyclic-lactone precursor of ivermectin (22,23-dihydroavermectin B1a), the semi-synthetic lead derivative developed for human and veterinary medicine.
context_zh_TW: Avermectin B1a 是伊維菌素（22,23-二氫阿維菌素 B1a）的天然大環內酯前體，伊維菌素是為人類和獸醫開發的半合成先導衍生物。

label: is_produced_by
context: Avermectins are 16-membered macrocyclic lactones biosynthesized by the soil actinomycete Streptomyces avermectinius (formerly S. avermitilis).
context_zh_TW: 是由土壤放線菌（以前稱為除蟲鏈黴菌）生物合成的 16 元大環內酯。

label: requires
context: COMT requires magnesium as a cofactor, because the enzyme's catalytic domain depends on divalent cations, magnesium in particular, to stabilize the SAMe-substrate complex and support efficient methyl transfer to the catechol ring. Magnesium deficiency can therefore impair COMT efficiency and slow catecholamine clearance, compounding the effects of genetic slow variants. Adequate magnesium status is frequently emphasized in protocols supporting slow or balanced COMT function, since the metal is essential for catalysis. This makes magnesium a practical nutritional lever for maintaining healthy COMT activity.
context_zh_TW: COMT 需要鎂作為輔助因子，因為該酶的催化結構域依賴二價陽離子，特別是鎂，以穩定 SAMe-底物複合物並支持有效的甲基轉移到兒茶酚環。因此，Magnesium 缺陷會損害 COMT 效率並減慢兒茶酚胺清除率，從而加劇遺傳慢變異的影響。在支援緩慢或平衡 COMT 功能的方案中經常強調充足的鎂狀態，因為金屬對於催化至關重要。這使得鎂成為維持健康的實用營養槓桿 COMT activity。

label: inhibits
context: CTPI2 is a third-generation inhibitor of the mitochondrial citrate carrier SLC25A1 with high binding affinity and specificity. CTPI2 treatment results in dose-dependent suppression of SASP components at transcript and protein levels without altering cell cycle regulators, HMGB1 localization, DNA damage foci or proliferation markers. It reduces global nuclear acetylation and H3K27ac at SASP loci and abolishes incorporation of glucose-derived carbon into histone acetylation, yet does not broadly impair mitochondrial function: OXPHOS gene expression, ATP production, coupling efficiency, mitochondrial ROS and morphology remain largely unchanged.
context_zh_TW: CTPI2 是粒線體檸檬酸載體 SLC25A1 的第三代抑制劑，具有高結合親和力與特異性。CTPI2 治療可在轉錄與蛋白質層面劑量依賴性地抑制 SASP 組成，同時不改變細胞週期調控因子、HMGB1 定位、DNA 損傷焦點或增殖標記。它可降低整體細胞核乙醯化及 SASP 基因座的 H3K27ac，並消除葡萄糖來源碳併入組蛋白乙醯化的現象，但不會廣泛損害粒線體功能：OXPHOS 基因表現、ATP 產生、偶聯效率、粒線體 ROS 與形態大多維持不變。

label: is_secreted_by
context: Cellular senescence is a key response to various cellular stresses characterized by a permanent cell cycle arrest and the secretion of a pro-inflammatory cocktail of factors known as the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP). Senescence serves protective roles in embryonic development, tumour suppression and tissue repair, but persistent SASP activation leads to chronic inflammation contributing to tissue dysfunction, ageing and a broad spectrum of age-related diseases including cancer. This dual nature makes SASP a focal point for understanding both the protective and detrimental effects of senescence.
context_zh_TW: 細胞衰老是對各種細胞應激的關鍵反應，其特徵是永久性細胞週期停滯和分泌一組促炎因子混合物，稱為衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）。衰老在胚胎發育、腫瘤抑制和組織修復中起保護作用，但持續的SASP激活導致慢性炎症，從而導致組織功能障礙、老化和包括癌症在內的廣泛年齡相關疾病。這種雙重性質使SASP成為理解衰老的保護性和有害性效應的焦點。

label: is_a
context: Cholangiocarcinoma is a malignancy of the bile-duct epithelium (adenocarcinoma).
context_zh_TW: Cholangiocarcinoma 是膽管上皮的惡性腫瘤（腺癌）。

label: mutation_causes
context: Classical Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2A (CMT2A), a peripheral neuropathy, is directly caused by heterozygous mutations in the mitochondrial fusion-related gene MFN2, which encodes the outer mitochondrial membrane GTPase mitofusin 2. Mutations or deletions in MFN2 slow axonal transport in both directions and impair mitochondrial dynamics in peripheral nerves. MFN2 also participates in mitochondrial transport by interacting with mitochondrial Rho small GTPase, and MFN2 knockout in dopaminergic neurons reduces dopamine nerve terminals and striatal dopamine levels.
context_zh_TW: Classical Charcot-Marie-Tooth 病 type 2A (CMT2A)，一種 peripheral neuropathy，直接由 mitochondrial fusion-related gene MFN2 的 heterozygous mutations 引起，MFN2 編碼外線粒體膜 GTPase mitofusin 2。MFN2 的突變或缺失減慢 axonal transport in both directions 並 impair mitochondrial dynamics in peripheral nerves。MFN2 也通過與 mitochondrial Rho small GTPase 互動參與 mitochondrial transport，且 MFN2 knockout in dopaminergic neurons 減少 dopamine nerve terminals 和 striatal dopamine levels。

label: inhibits
context: Cyclopentenyl cytosine (CPEC) is a synthetic cyclopentenyl-derived cytidine analog whose active triphosphate metabolite (CPEC-TP) acts as a potent, mechanism-based inhibitor of CTP Synthetase. By blocking the ATP-dependent conversion of UTP to CTP, it collapses intracellular pyrimidine pools, especially CTP and dCTP, in rapidly dividing cells and pyrimidine-dependent viruses.
context_zh_TW: Cyclopentenyl cytosine（CPEC）是一種合成的環戊烯基胞苷類似物，其活性三磷酸代謝物（CPEC-TP）是 CTP Synthetase 的強效機制型抑制劑。透過阻斷 UTP 依賴 ATP 轉化為 CTP，它使快速分裂細胞和依賴嘧啶的病毒細胞內嘧啶池（尤其 CTP 和 dCTP）崩潰。

label: is_mediated_by
context: DRP1 (dynamin-related protein 1) is the key mediator of mitochondrial fission and belongs to the GTP-hydrolyzing enzyme family. Under stress, cytosolic DRP1 monomers are recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane, where GTP binding promotes DRP1 linear oligomerization and subsequent GTP hydrolysis shortens and curls the oligomers into helical rings that constrict and sever both the outer and inner mitochondrial membranes. DRP1 activity is regulated by post-translational modifications including phosphorylation, S-nitrosylation, SUMOylation, O-GlcNAcylation and ubiquitination, with opposing phosphorylation sites (e.g., Ser616 stimulating and Ser637/656 inhibiting fission in most contexts).
context_zh_TW: DRP1 (dynamin-related protein 1) is the key mediator of mitochondrial fission and belongs to the GTP-hydrolyzing enzyme family。Under stress, cytosolic DRP1 monomers are recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane, where GTP binding promotes DRP1 linear oligomerization and subsequent GTP hydrolysis shortens and curls the oligomers into helical rings that constrict and sever both the outer and inner mitochondrial membranes。DRP1 activity is regulated by post-translational modifications including phosphorylation, S-nitrosylation, SUMOylation, O-GlcNAcylation and ubiquitination, with opposing phosphorylation sites (e.g., Ser616 stimulating and Ser637/656 inhibiting fission in most contexts)。

label: is_identical_to
context: Dopachrome tautomerase (DDT) is the historical enzyme name for Tyrosinase-related protein-2 (TRP-2), also known as DCT. Both names refer to the same melanosomal enzyme. It is a type I membrane glycoprotein related to Tyrosinase and TRP-1.
context_zh_TW: Dopachrome tautomerase（DDT）是 Tyrosinase-related protein-2（TRP-2，也稱為 DCT）的歷史性酶名稱。兩個名稱指的是同一種 melanosomal 酶。它是一種與 Tyrosinase 和 TRP-1 相關的 I 型膜醣蛋白。

label: cleaves
context: During apoptosis the initiator caspase-9 directly cleaves SIRT1 (Sir2α), the NAD+-dependent deacetylase that normally restrains p53- and FOXO-driven death programs. Cleavage is caspase-dependent: dominant-negative caspase-9 blocks both the lower-molecular-weight SIRT1 band and its nuclear-to-cytoplasmic relocalization in TNF-α-treated HeLa cells. Because caspase-9 sits at the top of the intrinsic cascade, SIRT1 dismantling begins early in the apoptotic process rather than as a late cleanup event. This is the founding observation of the caspase-to-sirtuin feedback direction.
context_zh_TW: 在細胞凋亡過程中，起始半胱天冬酶-9（Caspase-9）會直接切割 SIRT1（Sir2α）——這個通常抑制 p53 與 FOXO 死亡程序的 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶。切割是 caspase 依賴性的：顯性負向 Caspase-9 同時阻斷了 TNF-α 處理的 HeLa 細胞中較低分子量的 SIRT1 條帶及其由細胞核向細胞質的重新定位。由於 Caspase-9 位於內在級聯的頂端，SIRT1 的瓦解在細胞凋亡早期即已開始，而非晚期的清理事件。這是 caspase 至 sirtuin 回饋方向的奠基性觀察。

label: inhibits
context: Enzalutamide (Xtandi) is a second-generation androgen receptor (AR) antagonist that blocks AR nuclear translocation.
context_zh_TW: Enzalutamide (Xtandi) 是一種第二代雄激素受體 (AR) 拮抗劑，阻斷 AR 核轉位。

label: is_used_for
context: Enzalutamide is approved for castration-resistant prostate cancer.
context_zh_TW: Enzalutamide 獲准用於去勢抵抗性前列腺癌。

label: is_a_type_of
context: Fisetin (3,3',4',7-tetrahydroxyflavone) is a natural flavonoid of the flavonol subclass found in strawberries, apples, persimmons, onions, and cucumbers, with strawberries being the richest dietary source. It has the molecular formula C15H10O6 and a molecular weight of 286.24 g/mol. Fisetin is widely studied as a senolytic agent, and its anti-oxidative, anti-inflammatory, anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and neuroprotective activities are reported in numerous in vitro and in vivo studies. Despite its broad pharmacological potential, fisetin has extremely poor aqueous solubility, which severely limits its oral bioavailability.
context_zh_TW: Fisetin（3,3',4',7-四羥基黃酮）是黃酮醇亞類的天然黃酮類化合物，存在於草莓、蘋果、柿子、洋蔥與黃瓜中，其中草莓是最豐富的膳食來源。其分子式為C15H10O6，分子量為286.24 g/mol。Fisetin被廣泛研究作為senolytic藥物，其抗氧化、抗發炎、抗癌、抗糖尿病與神經保護活性在眾多體外與體內研究中均有報告。儘管藥理潛力廣泛，fisetin的水溶性極差，嚴重限制其口服生體可用率。

label: is_a
context: Glioblastoma (GBM) is the most malignant primary brain tumor in adults (grade IV astrocytoma).
context_zh_TW: 膠質母細胞瘤 (GBM) 是成人中最惡性的原發性腦腫瘤（IV級星形細胞瘤）。

label: is_a
context: Humanin is the first small peptide of a putative set of mitochondrial-derived peptides (MDPs), a novel concept that challenges the traditional view of mitochondria as passive end-function organelles. It was discovered in 2001 by screening a cDNA library from the surviving fraction of an Alzheimer's disease patient brain for clones protecting neuronal cells from cell death induced by APP mutants, and identified as a 75bp open reading frame yielding a 24 amino acid peptide encoded within the mitochondrial 16S rRNA. Humanin is a harbinger of additional MDPs, as numerous putative ORFs are dispersed throughout the mitochondrial genome.
context_zh_TW: Humanin 是推定之粒線體衍生胜肽（MDPs）群組中的第一個小胜肽，此一新穎概念挑戰了粒線體是被動終端功能胞器的傳統觀點。它於 2001 年透過篩選阿茲海默症患者腦部存活部分的 cDNA 文庫而被發現，用以尋找可保護神經元細胞免受 APP 突變誘導細胞死亡的選殖株，並被鑑定為 75 bp 的開放閱讀框架，編碼出位於粒線體 16S rRNA 內、由 24 個胺基酸組成的胜肽。Humanin 是更多 MDPs 出現的先兆，因為大量推定的 ORFs 散布於粒線體基因組中。

label: recruits
context: In healthy mitochondria, PINK1 (PTEN-induced putative kinase 1) is continuously imported into the inner membrane, cleaved and degraded by PARL and mitochondrial processing peptidases. When mitochondrial membrane potential becomes abnormal or import is impaired, PINK1 stabilizes and accumulates on the outer mitochondrial membrane, where its kinase domain phosphorylates outer membrane proteins and recruits and activates the E3 ubiquitin ligase Parkin (PRKN). PINK1 phosphorylation of MFN2 acts as a Parkin receptor that facilitates Parkin recruitment, and activated Parkin polyubiquitinates outer membrane proteins, marking damaged mitochondria for autophagic degradation.
context_zh_TW: 在健康的粒線體中，PINK1（PTEN-induced putative kinase 1）持續被輸入內膜，並被PARL和粒線體加工肽酶切割和降解。當粒線體膜電位異常或輸入受損時，PINK1會穩定並累積在外膜上，其激酶結構域在此磷酸化外膜蛋白質並招募和活化E3泛素連接酶Parkin（PRKN）。PINK1對MFN2的磷酸化作為Parkin受體，促進Parkin招募，活化的Parkin將外膜蛋白質多聚泛素化，標記受損粒線體以進行自噬降解。

label: activates
context: In senescence and ageing, mitochondrial dysfunction promotes the cytosolic release of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA), which activates cGAS-STING signalling and drives inflammatory responses and the SASP. Cytosolic mtDNA levels were unchanged in senescent MRC5 and IMR90 fibroblasts following SLC25A1 inhibition, indicating that metabolic regulation of histone acetylation restrains SASP independently of mtDNA release. STING inhibition with SN011 suppresses SASP gene expression without affecting histone acetylation, showing that mtDNA-driven innate immune signalling and mitochondrial control of histone acetylation are independent but complementary inputs that converge to enable full SASP expression.
context_zh_TW: In senescence and ageing，mitochondrial dysfunction promotes cytosolic release of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA)，which activates cGAS-STING signalling 並 drives inflammatory responses 和 SASP。Cytosolic mtDNA levels 在 senescent MRC5 和 IMR90 fibroblasts following SLC25A1 inhibition 時 unchanged，indicating that metabolic regulation of histone acetylation restrains SASP independently of mtDNA release。STING inhibition with SN011 suppresses SASP gene expression without affecting histone acetylation，showing that mtDNA-driven innate immune signalling 和 mitochondrial control of histone acetylation are independent but complementary inputs converging to enable full SASP expression。

label: supplies
context: In senescent cells the mitochondrial pyruvate-citrate-acetyl-CoA axis is upregulated, increasing the availability of acetyl-CoA to support histone acetylation at SASP gene loci. Although acetyl-CoA can be generated from alternative sources such as acetate, fatty acid oxidation and amino acid metabolism, in senescent cells mitochondria constitute a dominant source of acetyl-CoA for chromatin modification, creating a dependence on mitochondrial acetyl-CoA to sustain epigenetic activation of inflammatory gene programmes. Pathways controlling cytosolic acetyl-CoA production, including mitochondrial citrate export and its conversion by ATP-citrate lyase, are upregulated during senescence.
context_zh_TW: In senescent cells，mitochondrial pyruvate-citrate-acetyl-CoA axis 被 upregulated，增加 acetyl-CoA 可用性以支持 SASP gene loci 的 histone acetylation。雖然 acetyl-CoA 可從 alternative sources 如 acetate、fatty acid oxidation 和 amino acid metabolism 產生，但在 senescent cells 中 mitochondria 構成 dominant source of acetyl-CoA for chromatin modification，創造對 mitochondrial acetyl-CoA 的依賴以維持 inflammatory gene programmes 的 epigenetic activation。控制 cytosolic acetyl-CoA production 的 pathways，包括 mitochondrial citrate export 和其 conversion by ATP-citrate lyase，在 senescence 期間 upregulated。

label: is_derived_from
context: Ivermectin is the 22,23-dihydro derivative of avermectin B1a, produced by chemical reduction of the natural avermectin fermentation product.
context_zh_TW: Ivermectin是阿維菌素B1a的22,23-二氫衍生物，由天然阿維菌素發酵產物化學還原而成。

label: was_developed_by
context: Ivermectin was developed from avermectin by William C. Campbell and colleagues at Merck.
context_zh_TW: Ivermectin 是由 William C. Campbell 和默克公司的同事從阿維菌素中開發出來的。

label: is_a
context: Leukemia is a clonal hematologic malignancy arising from abnormal hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells.
context_zh_TW: Leukemia 是一種由異常造血幹/祖細胞引起的克隆性血液惡性腫瘤。

label: is_a
context: Mebendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic in the same class as fenbendazole and albendazole.
context_zh_TW: Mebendazole是一種苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，與芬苯達唑和阿苯達唑屬於同一類。

label: treats
context: Methylene blue is an established treatment for methemoglobinemia, a condition in which red blood cells cannot carry oxygen properly. It has been a first-line treatment for this indication since the early 20th century and remains on the World Health Organization's list of essential medicines. The clinical treatment dose for methemoglobinemia is 0.5-4 mg/kg (roughly 35-280 mg for a 70 kg adult), which is well above the micro-doses used in longevity and cognitive protocols. This medical use is distinct from wellness applications; at the very high doses used in medical settings methylene blue can paradoxically induce methemoglobin formation in some contexts.
context_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍是治療高鐵血紅蛋白血症的 established 方法，這是一種紅血球無法正常攜帶氧氣的疾病。自 20 世紀初以來，它一直是此適應症的一線治療，並仍在世界衛生組織基本藥物清單上。高鐵血紅蛋白血症的臨床治療劑量為 0.5-4 mg/kg（約 35-280 mg，適用於 70 kg 成人），遠高於 longevity 和認知方案中使用的 micro-doses。這種醫療用途與 wellness 應用不同；在醫療環境中使用的非常高劑量下，亞甲基藍在某些情況下可能 paradoxically 誘導高鐵血紅蛋白形成。

label: encompasses
context: Mitochondrial dynamics is the continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network through fusion and fission, two opposing yet coordinated processes that determine mitochondrial number, shape and function. Fusion joins two organelles into a tubular network, enabling content exchange, dilution of mutated mtDNA and superoxide, and maintenance of genetic and biochemical homogeneity; it proceeds through membrane tethering, outer membrane fusion and inner membrane fusion. Fusion is orchestrated by the dynamin-related GTPases MFN1 and MFN2 for the outer membrane and OPA1 for the inner membrane, and must be balanced with fission to sustain mitochondrial homeostasis.
context_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dynamics 是通過 fusion and fission 兩個 opposing yet coordinated processes 進行的 continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network，determining mitochondrial number, shape and function。Fusion joins two organelles into a tubular network，enabling content exchange, dilution of mutated mtDNA and superoxide，and maintenance of genetic and biochemical homogeneity；it proceeds through membrane tethering, outer membrane fusion and inner membrane fusion。Fusion is orchestrated by the dynamin-related GTPases MFN1 and MFN2 for the outer membrane and OPA1 for the inner membrane，and must be balanced with fission to sustain mitochondrial homeostasis。

label: encompasses
context: Mitochondrial dynamics is the continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network through the two opposite but coordinated processes of fission and fusion, accompanied by mitophagy and ultrastructural reshaping of the inner and outer membranes. Fission divides a single mitochondrion into two daughter mitochondria and is driven by the dynamin-related GTPase DRP1 recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane by adaptor proteins. The balance between fission and fusion is tightly regulated by conserved GTPase proteins and must be maintained to support normal mitochondrial and cellular function.
context_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dynamics 是通過 fission and fusion 兩個相反但 coordinated processes 進行的 continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network，accompanied by mitophagy and ultrastructural reshaping of the inner and outer membranes。Fission divides a single mitochondrion into two daughter mitochondria 並由 dynamin-related GTPase DRP1 driven，被 adaptor proteins recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane。Fission and fusion 之間的 balance 由 conserved GTPase proteins tightly regulated 且 must be maintained to support normal mitochondrial and cellular function。

label: is_a_type_of
context: Mitohormesis is defined as the process by which mild mitochondrial stress triggers adaptive cellular responses that rewire metabolism, enhance protein-folding capacity, and remodel the redox environment, ultimately leaving cells less vulnerable to future stress. It is described as a subcellular form of the more general principle of hormesis, in which a mild, non-lethal perturbation induces protective adaptations. The review notes that these stress-induced alterations persist even after the stress is relieved, leaving the cell or tissue in a less vulnerable state, which is the defining hormetic feature applied specifically to the mitochondrion.
context_zh_TW: 粒線體促效應定義為輕度粒線體壓力觸發適應性細胞反應的過程，這些反應重新佈線代謝、增強蛋白質折疊能力並重塑氧化還原環境，最終使細胞較不易受到後續壓力的影響。它被描述為更一般性促效應原理的亞細胞形式，其中輕度、非致死性擾動誘導保護性適應。該綜述指出，這些壓力誘導的改變即使在壓力解除後仍然持續，使細胞或組織處於較不易受損的狀態，這是專門應用於粒線體的定義性促效應特徵。

label: is_a_type_of
context: Mitophagy is a form of selective autophagy in which damaged and dysfunctional mitochondrial fragments are engulfed by double-membraned autophagosomes and delivered to the lysosome for degradation by hydrolytic enzymes. It is triggered by cues that mark mitochondrial damage, such as imbalance in mitochondrial fission-fusion dynamics, and is mediated either by specific outer mitochondrial membrane receptors such as BNIP3, BNIP3L/NIX and FUNDC1, or by ubiquitin molecules conjugated to mitochondrial surface proteins. Mitophagy is a core mitochondrial quality control mechanism closely related to cell fate decisions including senescence, apoptosis and necroptosis.
context_zh_TW: 粒線體自噬是一種選擇性自噬形式，其中受損和功能失調的粒線體片段被雙膜自噬體吞噬，並輸送到溶酶體進行水解酶降解。它由標記粒線體損傷的線索觸發，如粒線體分裂-融合動力學的失衡，並由粒線體外膜上的特定受體如 BNIP3、BNIP3L/NIX 和 FUNDC1 介導，或由與粒線體表面蛋白結合的泛素分子介導。粒線體自噬是與細胞命運決定密切相關的核心粒線體品質控制機制，包括衰老、細胞凋亡和壞死性凋亡。

label: is_affiliated_with
context: Omura conducted the avermectin discovery research at the Kitasato Institute.
context_zh_TW: 大村在 Kitasato Institute 進行了阿維菌素發現研究。

label: discovered
context: Omura isolated and cultured Streptomyces avermectinius from Japanese soil, the sole known natural source of avermectins.
context_zh_TW: 大村從日本土壤中分離和培養，這是阿維菌素唯一已知的天然來源。

label: is_induced_by
context: Progressive telomere shortening with each cell division eventually exposes chromosome ends that are recognized as DNA double-strand breaks, triggering replicative senescence at the Hayflick limit. Critically short or dysfunctional telomeres activate the ATM/p53 and ATR/p21 DDR cascades, halting proliferation to prevent chromosomal instability. This mechanism is the canonical explanation for the finite replicative capacity of primary human cells in culture. The directionality is one-way in normal cells, though telomerase reactivation can bypass the arrest -- a hallmark of cancer.
context_zh_TW: 每一次細胞分裂伴隨的漸進性端粒縮短，最終會暴露出被辨識為 DNA 雙股斷裂的染色體端點，在 Hayflick 極限觸發複製性衰老。過短或功能異常的端粒會活化 ATM/p53 與 ATR/p21 的 DDR 級聯，停止增殖以預防染色體不穩定。此機制是原代人類細胞在培養中有限複製能力的標準解釋。在正常細胞中此方向是單向的，但端粒酶再活化可繞過停滯——這是癌症的特徵。

label: is_a_type_of
context: Rapamycin is a natural anti-fungal antibiotic produced by soil bacteria of Eastern Island whose patent has expired, and pharmacological companies have developed other rapalogs such as everolimus. The term rapalogs encompasses rapamycin, everolimus and any other analogs, and at equipotent doses rapamycin and everolimus exert almost identical therapeutic and adverse effects, although everolimus is weaker and has a shorter half-life. All current rapalogs exhibit the same side effects as rapamycin and everolimus, and their real side effects are mTORC1-dependent.
context_zh_TW: Rapamycin是一種由東方島土壤細菌產生的天然抗真菌抗生素，其專利已過期，藥理學公司已開發出其他rapalog，如everolimus。術語rapalog包括rapamycin、everolimus和任何其他類似物，在等效劑量下，rapamycin和everolimus幾乎產生相同的治療和不良反應，盡管everolimus作用較弱且半衰期較短。所有目前的rapalog都表現出與rapamycin和everolimus相同的副作用，且其真正的副作用是mTORC1依賴性的。

label: inhibits
context: Rapamycin, also called sirolimus, is an organic chemical compound produced by Streptomyces hygroscopicus, isolated from soil samples taken on Easter Island Rapa Nui by Georges Nogrady in the late 1960s. At the molecular level it acts as a specific inhibitor of mTOR by forming a complex with the immunophilin FKBP12, which then binds to mTOR and suppresses its kinase activity. As a result, rapamycin downregulates protein synthesis, cell growth, and anabolic metabolism while promoting autophagy, shifting the cell from anabolic to maintenance and repair processes, a key mechanism underlying its longevity-promoting effects.
context_zh_TW: Rapamycin，也稱為sirolimus，是由吸水鏈黴菌產生的有機化合物，由Georges Nogrady在1960年代末從復活節島Rapa Nui的土壤樣本中分離出來。在分子水平上，它透過與免疫亲合蛋白FKBP12形成複合物作為mTOR的特異性抑制劑，然後結合mTOR並抑制其激酶活性。因此，rapamycin下調蛋白質合成、細胞生長和合成代謝，同時促進自噬，將細胞從合成代謝轉向維護和修復過程，這是其延壽效應的關鍵機制。

label: inhibits
context: Rapamycin, an antibiotic discovered in the 1970s from Streptomyces hygroscopicus on Easter Island (Rapanui), inhibits mTORC1, the master kinase within the mTOR pathway that regulates cell growth, protein synthesis, and metabolism. By inhibiting mTORC1, rapamycin mimics the biochemistry of nutrient scarcity achieved by caloric restriction, shifting cellular activity from anabolic processes toward maintenance and repair pathways, promoting autophagy and improved proteostasis. mTORC1 activity increases with age, contributing to age-related pathologies, so its inhibition is theorized to slow aging.
context_zh_TW: Rapamycin，1970年代從復活節島（Rapanui）的吸水鏈黴菌中發現的抗生素，抑制mTORC1，這是mTOR途徑中的主激酶，調節細胞生長、蛋白質合成和代謝。透過抑制mTORC1，rapamycin模擬由熱量限制實現的營養稀缺的生物化學，將細胞活性從合成代謝過程轉向維護和修復途徑，促進自噬和改善蛋白質恆定性。mTORC1活性隨年齡增長而增加，導致年齡相關病理，因此其理論上可以減緩老化。

label: is_a
context: Renal cell carcinoma (RCC) is the most common malignant kidney tumor, usually clear-cell subtype.
context_zh_TW: 腎細胞癌 (RCC) 是最常見的惡性腎臟腫瘤，通常為透明細胞亞型。

label: is_required_by
context: SAMe (S-adenosylmethionine) is required by COMT as the methyl donor for all catechol O-methylation reactions, without which the enzyme cannot function. Generated from methionine by methionine adenosyltransferase, SAMe sits at the head of the methylation cycle that feeds COMT, linking folate, B12, and betaine metabolism to catechol clearance. Its availability is therefore the rate-limiting permissive factor for COMT activity. It is also the universal methyl donor for DNA, protein, and other methylation reactions.
context_zh_TW: SAMe (S-adenosylmethionine) 是 COMT 所必需的，與 methyl donor 一樣，用於所有兒茶酚 O-甲基化反應，沒有它該酶就無法發揮作用。 SAMe 由蛋氨酸透過蛋氨酸腺苷轉移酶產生，位於為 COMT 提供營養的 methylation cycle 的頭部，將 folate、B12 和甜菜鹼代謝與兒茶酚清除聯繫起來。因此，它的可用性是 COMT activity 的速率限制許可因素。它也是用於 DNA、蛋白質和其他甲基化反應的通用 methyl donor。

label: exports
context: SLC25A1, the mitochondrial citrate carrier, exports citrate from the mitochondrial matrix to the cytosol, where it can be converted to acetyl-CoA. SLC25A1 expression is significantly increased at both mRNA and protein levels in multiple senescence contexts, and this citrate export sustains the nucleocytosolic acetyl-CoA pool required for histone acetylation. Genetic ablation of SLC25A1 does not alter CDK inhibitor expression or cell cycle arrest but markedly reduces SASP gene expression, and inhibition with the third-generation inhibitor CTPI2 selectively suppresses SASP-associated inflammation without clearing senescent cells.
context_zh_TW: SLC25A1，線粒體枸櫞酸載體，將枸櫞酸從線粒體基質輸出到細胞質，在那裡可以轉化為乙酰輔酶A。SLC25A1表達在多種衰老背景下在mRNA和蛋白質水平上都顯著增加，這種枸櫞酸輸出維持組蛋白乙酰化所需的核質乙酰輔酶A池。SLC25A1的基因消融不改變CDK抑製劑表達或細胞週期停滯，但顯著減少SASP基因表達，使用第三代抑製劑CTPI2的抑製選擇性地抑制SASP相關炎症而不清除衰老細胞。

label: is_affiliated_with
context: Satoshi Omura performed the soil-microbe screening that isolated Streptomyces avermectinius at the Kitasato Institute, Tokyo.
context_zh_TW: Satoshi Omura 在東京 Kitasato Institute 進行了土壤微生物篩選並分離出 Streptomyces avermectinius。

label: produce
context: Senescent cells are the producers of the SASP, the ensemble of secreted factors that mediates most of their non-cell-autonomous effects on neighboring cells and the systemic milieu. The SASP is actively synthesized and released by the arrested cell rather than leaking passively, and its composition reflects the upstream inducing pathway and tissue context. This production enables paracrine senescence, immune recruitment, and inflammaging, converting a single arrested cell into a source of broad tissue influence. The senescent cell is thus the source and the SASP its principal effector output.
context_zh_TW: 衰老細胞是 SASP 的產生者，SASP 是介導其對鄰近細胞與全身微環境大多數非細胞自主性效應的分泌因子集合。SASP 由停滯細胞主動合成與釋放，而非被動滲漏，其組成反映上游誘發路徑與組織脈絡。此產生促成旁分泌衰老、免疫招募與 inflammaging，將單一停滯細胞轉化為廣泛組織影響的來源。因此衰老細胞是來源，而 SASP 是其主要指效輸出。

label: is_located_on
context: The COMT gene is located on chromosome 22 at band q11.21, a locus also associated with the 22q11.2 deletion syndrome, which presents with cardiac, craniofacial, and psychiatric features. Its genomic position places it within a region subject to copy-number variation that can affect COMT dosage and enzyme levels, with hemizygosity influencing catecholamine metabolism in deletion carriers. The well-characterized Val158Met polymorphism (rs4680) at this locus is among the most studied functional variants in neuropsychiatry and pharmacogenetics. The locus therefore links structural chromosomal variation to catecholamine physiology.
context_zh_TW: COMT 基因位於 22 號染色體 q11.21 條帶上，該位點也與 22q11.2 缺失症候群相關，該症候群表現為心臟、顱顏和精神特徵。它的基因組位置將其置於一個受拷貝數變異影響的區域內，該變異可以影響 COMT 劑量和酶水平，其半合性影響缺失載體中的兒茶酚胺代謝。該位點的充分錶徵的 Val158Met 多態性 (rs4680) 是神經精神病學和藥物遺傳學中研究最多的功能變異之一。因此，該基因座將結構染色體變異與兒茶酚胺生理學連結起來。

label: modulates
context: The D2 receptor modulates reward processing by inhibiting medium spiny neurons of the striatal indirect pathway, thereby shaping the salience and reinforcement of rewarding stimuli. Its activity integrates dopamine signals that govern motivated behavior, reward learning, and incentive motivation in the ventral striatum and nucleus accumbens. Dysregulation of D2 signaling, including reduced receptor availability, is implicated in addiction, obesity, and schizophrenia. Because dopamine availability is partly set by COMT, genotype can indirectly influence D2-mediated reward function.
context_zh_TW: D2 receptor 透過抑制紋狀體間接路徑的中型多棘神經元來調節 reward 處理，從而塑造獎勵刺激的顯著性和強化。其活性整合了控制動機行為的多巴胺訊號，reward learning，以及腹側紋狀體和伏隔核的激勵動機。 D2 訊號傳導失調，包括受體可用性降低，與成癮、肥胖和精神分裂症有關。由於多巴胺的可用性部分由 COMT 決定，因此基因型可以間接影響 D2 介導的 reward 功能。

label: encodes
context: The MET proto-oncogene encodes the receptor tyrosine kinase c-Met (hepatocyte growth factor receptor), synthesized as a precursor and cleaved into a disulfide-linked alpha/beta heterodimer. MET is the only known receptor gene for hepatocyte growth factor.
context_zh_TW: MET 原致癌基因編碼受體酪胺酸激酶 c-Met（肝細胞生長因子受體），先合成前體，再裂解為雙硫鍵連結的 alpha/beta 異二聚體。MET 是肝細胞生長因子唯一已知的受體基因。

label: ubiquitinates
context: The RING-domain E3 ligase TRIM28/KAP1 polyubiquitinates SIRT1 (K48-linked) and targets it for proteasomal degradation following severe DNA damage (doxorubicin, etoposide, camptothecin, UV). TRIM28 knockdown or CRISPR knockout stabilizes SIRT1 and reduces its ubiquitination; reconstitution of wild-type TRIM28 — but not the E3-dead C65/68A mutant — restores SIRT1 turnover in vivo and in a purified in vitro ubiquitination assay with UBE1/UBE2L6. TRIM28 is thus both necessary and sufficient as the damage-induced SIRT1 E3.
context_zh_TW: RING 結構域 E3 泛素連接酶 TRIM28/KAP1 會對 SIRT1 進行 K48 型多泛素化，並在嚴重 DNA 損傷（doxorubicin、etoposide、camptothecin、UV）後將其送往蛋白酶體降解。TRIM28 的 knockdown 或 CRISPR 基因敲除會穩定 SIRT1 並降低其泛素化；重新表達野生型 TRIM28——但不含 E3 失活的 C65/68A 突變株——可在體內與以 UBE1/UBE2L6 進行的試管內泛素化試驗中恢復 SIRT1 的代謝。因此 TRIM28 對損傷誘導的 SIRT1 E3 角色既必要且充分。

label: cleaves
context: The executioner caspase-3 also directly cleaves SIRT1 during apoptosis. Because both the initiator caspase-9 and executioner caspase-3 process Sir2α, cleavage and the accompanying nuclear-to-cytoplasmic dislocation occur throughout the apoptotic process, not at a single checkpoint. In Ara-C-treated embryonic mouse brain, over 130 of 150 cells with cytoplasmic Sir2α had pyknotic nuclei, confirming in vivo that the caspase-3-era SIRT1 fragments mark terminally dying cells. Cleavage therefore converts an anti-apoptotic survival factor into processed fragments precisely when the death program becomes irreversible.
context_zh_TW: 執行者半胱天冬酶-3（Caspase-3）在細胞凋亡期間同樣會直接切割 SIRT1。由於起始 Caspase-9 與執行者 Caspase-3 都會處理 Sir2α，切割與伴隨的核質易位發生在整個細胞凋亡過程中，而非單一檢查點。在 Ara-C 處理的胚胎小鼠腦中，150 個細胞質型 Sir2α 細胞裡有超過 130 個呈現核固縮，證實在體內帶 caspase-3 特徵的 SIRT1 片段標記著走向終末的死亡細胞。當死亡程序變得不可逆時，切割便將抗凋亡的存活因子轉化為處理後的片段。

label: produces
context: The senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) is the major non-cell-autonomous output of senescent cells, comprising hundreds of secreted factors including cytokines, chemokines, growth factors, and proteases. The SASP is not a passive byproduct but an active program orchestrated by transcription factors such as NF-κB, C/EBPbeta, and AP-1 and by innate immune sensors like cGAS-STING. It mediates paracrine senescence, immune recruitment, and systemic inflammation, making it central to both the beneficial (tumor-suppressive, wound-healing) and deleterious (inflammaging, fibrosis) effects of senescence. Directionally, the SASP is produced by and amplifies the senescence program in a feed-forward loop.
context_zh_TW: 衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）是衰老細胞主要的非細胞自主性輸出，包含數百種分泌因子，如細胞激素、趨化因子、生長因子與蛋白酶。SASP 並非被動的副產物，而是由 NF-κB、C/EBPbeta 與 AP-1 等轉錄因子以及 cGAS-STING 等先天免疫感受器所協調的主動程序。它介導旁分泌性衰老、免疫招募與全身性發炎，使其同時居於衰老有益（腫瘤抑制、傷口癒合）與有害（inflammaging、纖維化）效應的核心。在方向上，SASP 由衰老程序產生並以正向迴圈放大該程序。

label: is_site_of
context: The thymus is a vital organ for homeostatic maintenance of the peripheral immune system. Within its two compartments, the true thymic epithelial space (TES, comprising cortex and medulla) and the perivascular space (PVS), T cells develop, mature, and undergo induction of self-tolerance in a process called thymopoiesis. The cortex hosts early thymocyte development including T cell receptor gene rearrangement and positive selection, while the medulla carries out negative selection to remove autoreactive T cells. The perivascular space, composed of adipocytes, peripheral lymphocytes and stroma, is a non-thymopoietic component.
context_zh_TW: 胸腺是外周免疫系統穩態維持的重要器官。在其兩個隔室——真正的胸腺上皮空間（TES，包含皮質和髓質）和血管周圍空間（PVS）——中，T 細胞發育、成熟並經歷稱為胸腺生成的自身耐受誘導過程。皮質主持早期胸腺細胞發育，包括 T 細胞受體基因重排和陽性選擇，而髓質執行陰性選擇以清除自身反應性 T 細胞。血管周圍空間由脂肪細胞、外周淋巴細胞和基質組成，是非胸腺生成的成分。

label: modulates
context: Val158Met modulates the effect of vitamin E (alpha-tocopherol) supplementation on cancer prevention, such that slow COMT individuals derive protective benefit whereas fast COMT individuals may experience increased cancer risk. The proposed mechanism involves COMT-dependent metabolism of vitamin E-related catecholic intermediates and interactions with catecholestrogen handling, which differ by enzyme activity. This gene-nutrient interaction has emerged from genotype-stratified analyses of supplementation trials. It highlights the need for genotype-aware antioxidant recommendations.
context_zh_TW: Val158Met 調節維生素 E（α-生育醇）補充劑對癌症預防的作用，使得行動緩慢的 COMT 個體獲得保護性益處，而行動快速的 COMT 個體可能會經歷更高的癌症風險。所提出的機制涉及維生素 E 相關兒茶酚中間體的 COMT 依賴性代謝以及與兒茶酚雌激素處理的相互作用，其因酶活性而異。這種基因與營養素的相互作用是從補充劑試驗的基因型分層分析中得出的。它強調了對基因型敏感的抗氧化劑建議的需求。

label: polymerizes_into
context: alpha/beta-tubulin heterodimers polymerize into microtubules, the dynamic polymers of the mitotic spindle and cytoskeleton.
context_zh_TW: α/β-微管蛋白異二聚體聚合成微管，即有絲分裂紡錘體和細胞骨架的動態聚合物。

label: is_phosphorylated_by
context: mTORC1 phosphorylates TFEB at multiple sites with distinct functional consequences: phosphorylation at S211 and S122 causes cytoplasmic retention, at S142 it drives cytoplasmic retention and nuclear export, and at S138 it promotes nuclear export. Phosphorylation of these sites prevents TFEB from translocating to the nucleus, thereby limiting its transcriptional program. This is the canonical nutrient-sensing mechanism by which mTORC1 couples lysosomal and autophagic gene expression to amino acid availability. Dephosphorylation of S211 (by calcineurin) and S122 (by PP2A) releases this brake and allows TFEB nuclear translocation. Cited references include PMID 28055300 and 30120233.
context_zh_TW: mTORC1 在多個位點磷酸化 TFEB，產生不同的功能後果：S211 和 S122 的磷酸化導致胞質保留，S142 的磷酸化驅動胞質保留和核輸出，S138 的磷酸化促進核輸出。這些位點的磷酸化阻止 TFEB 轉位至細胞核，從而限制其轉錄程序。這是 mTORC1 將溶酶體和自噬基因表達與胺基酸可用性耦合的典型營養感知機制。S211 的去磷酸化（由鈣調磷酸酶）和 S122 的去磷酸化（由 PP2A）釋放此制動，允許 TFEB 核轉位。引用的參考文獻包括 PMID 28055300 和 30120233。

label: inhibits
context: Auranofin is a potent, irreversible covalent inhibitor of both cytosolic (TXNRD1) and mitochondrial (TXNRD2) thioredoxin reductase. Its gold(I) cation coordinates the catalytic C-terminal selenocysteine, blocking thioredoxin regeneration and converting the redox-balancing machinery into a source of lethal ROS.
context_zh_TW: Auranofin 是細胞質（TXNRD1）與粒線體（TXNRD2）硫氧還蛋白還原酶的強效、不可逆共價抑制劑。其金(I)陽離子配位催化所需的 C 端硒半胱氨酸，阻斷硫氧還蛋白再生成，並將氧化還原平衡機制轉變為致命 ROS 的來源。

label: was_awarded
context: Campbell shared the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for developing avermectin into ivermectin.
context_zh_TW: 坎貝爾分享了2015年將阿維菌素發展成伊維菌素的歷程。

label: was_awarded
context: Omura shared the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine with William C. Campbell for the discovery of avermectin/ivermectin.
context_zh_TW: 大村與William C. Campbell分享了2015年的阿維菌素/伊維菌素的發現。

label: synthesizes
context: Ribonucleotide reductase (RNR) is the only enzyme that catalyzes the de novo conversion of ribonucleoside diphosphates (NDPs) into deoxyribonucleoside diphosphates (dNDPs), the immediate precursors of the dNTPs required for DNA replication and repair. It is the rate-limiting, allosterically regulated committed step of de novo dNTP synthesis.
context_zh_TW: 核醣核苷酸還原酶（RNR）是唯一能催化核醣核苷二磷酸（NDP）de novo 轉化為去氧核醣核苷二磷酸（dNDP）的酵素，dNDP 是 DNA 複製與修復所需 dNTP 的直接前驅物。它是 de novo dNTP 合成中受別構調控、速率限制的承諾步驟。

label: contains
context: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) contains the CxxC active-site motif (Cys-Gly-Pro-Cys, residues Cys32-Cys35), which forms the catalytic core of its oxidoreductase activity. The N-terminal Cys32 attacks substrate disulfides while Cys35 resolves the mixed disulfide.
context_zh_TW: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 含有 CxxC 活性位點基序（Cys-Gly-Pro-Cys，殘基 Cys32-Cys35），構成其氧化還原酶活性的催化核心。N 端的 Cys32 攻擊受質雙硫鍵，而 Cys35 則解析混合雙硫鍵。

label: inhibits
context: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) is the canonical high-affinity redox-dependent inhibitor of the stress kinase ASK1. In its reduced state Trx1 binds ASK1's N-terminal thioredoxin-binding domain and keeps the kinase inactive, targeting it for degradation; on oxidative stress Trx1 is oxidized and dissociates, de-repressing ASK1 to drive JNK/p38 MAPK apoptosis and senescence signaling.
context_zh_TW: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 是壓力激酶 ASK1 的典型高親和力、依賴氧化還原狀態的抑制劑。在還原態下，Trx1 結合 ASK1 的 N 端硫氧還蛋白結合域並使激酶保持不活化，並使其被降解；在氧化壓力下，Trx1 被氧化並解離，解除對 ASK1 的抑制，驅動 JNK/p38 MAPK 的細胞凋亡與衰老訊息傳遞。
